tgt_seg: 《猪心男孩》剧评——精彩的舞台呈现，忠实再现了玛洛里·布莱克曼这部引人深思的小说

src_seg: Some set designs instantly make sense. Paul Wills's clever arrangement of television screens and speakers, all linked up by glowing capillary-like tubes, encapsulates Malorie Blackman's 1997 novel about a boy whose pig-heart transplant leads to a media frenzy. Andrew Exeter's lighting switches from blood red to cool blue for scenes when 13-year-old Cameron repeatedly puts himself - and, eventually, his new heart - to the test when diving at his local pool.
tgt_seg: 有些舞台设计一目了然，就能让人理解。保罗·威尔斯巧妙地运用了电视屏幕和扬声器，并用发光的、类似毛细血管的管道将它们连接起来，完美地呈现了玛洛里·布莱克曼1997年出版的小说，讲述了一个男孩接受了猪心移植，从而引发了媒体狂潮的故事。安德鲁·埃克塞特的灯光设计，在13岁的卡梅隆不断挑战自己——包括他的新心脏——并在当地游泳池进行跳水训练时，会从血红色切换到冷蓝色。

src_seg: Blackman's novel is itself a deep dive: this "what would you do?" book for young readers considers ethics, animal rights, othering and empathy. Keeping the pre-social media setting, Winsome Pinnock's new adaptation draws upon the heightened poetic style of Blackman's opening chapter. Pinnock retains the narrator's spirited interest in wordplay, boosts the wisdom of Cameron's Nan and makes water more of a unifying theme throughout the story. Her version also takes a thrilling new turn towards the end.
tgt_seg: 布莱克曼的小说本身就极具深度：这部“如果你是…你会怎么做？”的青少年读物，探讨了伦理、动物权利、歧视以及同理心等问题。温索姆·皮诺克的新改编版保留了小说中社交媒体尚未普及的时代背景，并借鉴了布莱克曼小说开篇章节中富有诗意的风格。皮诺克保留了叙述者对文字游戏的热情，突出了卡梅隆奶奶的智慧，并将“水”这一意象贯穿整个故事，使其成为一个更重要的主题。此外，她的改编版在结尾处还加入了令人兴奋的新情节。

src_seg: Tristan Fynn-Aiduenu's boisterous production has some vivid performances, too, including by Immanuel Yeboah in the main role. But by overplaying the comedy it drowns out some of the story's more reflective episodes. In the novel, Cameron often cracks jokes, even when face to face with the animal named Trudy whose heart he will receive, yet that encounter is hugely moving as the boy is overwhelmed with relief, fear, guilt and hope. On stage, Trudy is played as a disco-queen pig with pink puffer jacket and oversized glasses; discovering Cameron's plans for her heart, she squeals in jokey horror. Elsewhere, animal rights are thinly discussed.
tgt_seg: 特里斯坦·芬恩-艾杜努的这部作品充满活力，演员们的表演也十分精彩，尤其是饰演主角的伊曼纽尔·耶博阿。然而，由于过于强调喜剧效果，一些更具深度的情节反而被掩盖了。在原著中，卡梅隆即使是在与那只名叫特鲁迪的动物（他将接受它的心脏）面对面时，也会开玩笑，但那次相遇却非常感人，因为男孩当时既感到如释重负，又感到恐惧、内疚和希望。而在舞台上，特鲁迪被塑造成一只穿着粉色羽绒服、戴着超大眼镜的“迪斯科女王”猪；当她得知卡梅隆要摘取她的心脏时，她会发出带着玩笑意味的惊恐叫声。此外，关于动物权利的讨论也显得相当肤浅。

src_seg: The production is more successful at conveying how Cameron is viewed by his classmates both before the operation (when they see his illness as fragility) and after (when he is still considered different to them). The children are played by an adult cast, most doubling up as the grownup characters. The pioneering Dr Bryce (Tré Medley) is amusingly portrayed as a spy-like smooth operator, all dressed in white both in and out of his laboratory, when that set design again works efficiently. Christina Ngoyi as his best friend Marilyn (Marlon in the book) has the right note of compromised loyalty; Christine During's popular Julie has a buoyant ease but her later fear of Cameron again tips into comedy.
tgt_seg: 这部作品成功地展现了卡梅隆在手术前后，同学们对他的看法：手术前，他们认为他的疾病是一种虚弱；手术后，他们仍然觉得他与众不同。这部作品由成年演员扮演儿童角色，而且大部分演员同时饰演成年角色。饰演先驱医生布莱斯（特雷·梅德利）的演员，以一种幽默的方式将他刻画成一个行事周到、颇有心机的“特工”，无论是在实验室还是其他场合，他都穿着一身白衣，这种布景设计再次发挥了很好的效果。饰演他最好的朋友玛丽莲（书中名为马龙）的克里斯蒂娜·恩戈伊，很好地诠释了她那种忠诚却又有所妥协的情感；克里斯汀·杜林饰演的受欢迎的朱莉，则表现出一种轻松自在，但她后来对卡梅隆的恐惧又带有一丝喜剧色彩。

The screens on stage could be used more effectively during Cameron's TV interview and for the camcorder footage he records for his brother.
tgt_seg: 卡梅隆在剧中时不时会与观众互动，其中一段情节是他大声质问泄露他个人信息给媒体的人，但这段情节显得有些牵强，反而分散了观众对卡梅隆内心挣扎的关注。剧中，在卡梅隆接受电视采访以及他为弟弟录制的录像带片段中，舞台上的屏幕可以得到更有效的利用。

src_seg: The show is aimed at nine to 13-year-olds (probably geared more towards the younger side of that range) and dynamically captures the turbulent world of school thanks in part to DK Fashola's movement direction, especially appealing in an early slo-mo sequence. This staging has plenty of style and flows swiftly, helped by Xana's sound design and compositions - but it never has quite the same direct appeal to head and heart as Blackman's book.
tgt_seg: 这部剧的目标观众是9到13岁的孩子（可能更适合年龄较小的观众），它生动地展现了学校里充满活力和挑战的世界，这得益于DK Fashola的精彩编舞，尤其是在开场的一个慢动作片段中，非常引人入胜。这部剧的舞台设计非常出色，节奏流畅，并得到了Xana的音效和配乐的加持，但它始终无法像Blackman的原著那样，直接触动观众的心灵。

src_seg: Some set designs instantly make sense. Paul Wills's clever arrangement of television screens and speakers, all linked up by glowing capillary-like tubes, encapsulates Malorie Blackman's 1997 novel about a boy whose pig-heart transplant leads to a media frenzy. Andrew Exeter's lighting switches from blood red to cool blue for scenes when 13-year-old Cameron repeatedly puts himself - and, eventually, his new heart - to the test when diving at his local pool.
tgt_seg: 有些舞台设计一亮相就让人觉得浑然天成。保罗·威尔斯巧妙地运用电视屏幕和扬声器，并通过发光的毛细血管状管线将它们连接起来，完美地捕捉了莫里·布莱克曼1997年出版的小说，该小说讲述了一个接受猪心移植的男孩引发媒体狂潮的故事。安德鲁·埃克塞特的灯光设计，在13岁的主人公卡梅隆反复在当地游泳池跳水时，从鲜血般的红色切换到冷静的蓝色。

src_seg: Blackman's novel is itself a deep dive: this "what would you do?" book for young readers considers ethics, animal rights, othering and empathy. Keeping the pre-social media setting, Winsome Pinnock's new adaptation draws upon the heightened poetic style of Blackman's opening chapter. Pinnock retains the narrator's spirited interest in wordplay, boosts the wisdom of Cameron's Nan and makes water more of a unifying theme throughout the story. Her version also takes a thrilling new turn towards the end.
tgt_seg: 布莱克曼的小说本身就是一次深刻的探索：这本书是献给年轻读者的“你会怎么做？”式思考读物，探讨了伦理、动物权利、边缘化和同理心等问题。在保留社交媒体出现之前的时代背景下，温索姆·皮诺克的新编剧作借鉴了布莱克曼开篇章节中那种高亢的诗意风格。皮诺克保留了叙述者对文字游戏的热情，提升了卡梅隆奶奶的智慧，并将水塑造成贯穿整个故事的统一主题。她的版本在故事结尾也增添了一个令人兴奋的新转折。

src_seg: Tristan Fynn-Aiduenu's boisterous production has some vivid performances, too, including by Immanuel Yeboah in the main role. But by overplaying the comedy it drowns out some of the story's more reflective episodes. In the novel, Cameron often cracks jokes, even when face to face with the animal named Trudy whose heart he will receive, yet that encounter is hugely moving as the boy is overwhelmed with relief, fear, guilt and hope. On stage, Trudy is played as a disco-queen pig with pink puffer jacket and oversized glasses; discovering Cameron's plans for her heart, she squeals in jokey horror. Elsewhere, animal rights are thinly discussed.
tgt_seg: 特里斯坦·芬恩-艾杜努的充满活力的制作也呈现出一些生动的表演，包括伊曼纽尔·耶博阿在主角角色中的表现。但由于过度强调喜剧，它淹没了故事中一些更具反思性的片段。在小说中，卡梅隆经常开玩笑，即使面对将要被他接受心脏的动物特鲁迪，但那次相遇却令人深受感动，因为男孩被巨大的解脱、恐惧、内疚和希望所淹没。在舞台上，特鲁迪被塑造成一位穿着粉色羽绒服和超大号眼镜的迪斯科女王；当她得知卡梅隆的计划后，会发出滑稽的尖叫。在其他地方，动物权利的讨论显得有些肤浅。

src_seg: The production is more successful at conveying how Cameron is viewed by his classmates both before the operation (when they see his illness as fragility) and after (when he is still considered different to them). The children are played by an adult cast, most doubling up as the grownup characters. The pioneering Dr Bryce (Tré Medley) is amusingly portrayed as a spy-like smooth operator, all dressed in white both in and out of his laboratory, when that set design again works efficiently. Christina Ngoyi as his best friend Marilyn (Marlon in the book) has the right note of compromised loyalty; Christine During's popular Julie has a buoyant ease but her later fear of Cameron again tips into comedy.
tgt_seg: 这部作品在传达卡梅隆如何被他的同学在手术前（他们将他的疾病视为脆弱）和手术后（他仍然被认为是与他们不同）看待方面，更为成功。孩子们由成年演员扮演，大多数演员还兼演成年角色。开创性的布莱斯医生（特雷·麦德利）被幽默地描绘成一位像间谍一样圆滑的人物，无论在室内还是在实验室里，都穿着一身白衣，而这种舞台设计再次高效地发挥作用。克里斯蒂娜·恩戈伊饰演他的好友玛丽莲（书中的马龙），把握了那种妥协的忠诚度；克里斯汀·杜林饰演的受欢迎的朱莉，拥有轻松愉悦的气氛，但她后来对卡梅隆的恐惧又滑向了喜剧。

src_seg: Cameron's asides to the audience include a raucous interrogation about who sold his story to the press that is strained and distracts from his inner tumult. The screens on stage could be used more effectively during Cameron's TV interview and for the camcorder footage he records for his brother.
tgt_seg: 卡梅隆对观众的独白包括对向媒体出售他故事的人的喧闹盘问，这显得有些勉强，并分散了他内心的动荡。舞台上的屏幕在卡梅隆的电视采访和为他的兄弟录制的摄像机录像中可以更有效地利用。

src_seg: The show is aimed at nine to 13-year-olds (probably geared more towards the younger side of that range) and dynamically captures the turbulent world of school thanks in part to DK Fashola's movement direction, especially appealing in an early slo-mo sequence. This staging has plenty of style and flows swiftly, helped by Xana's sound design and compositions - but it never has quite the same direct appeal to head and heart as Blackman's book.
tgt_seg: 这部作品的目标受众是9到13岁的青少年（可能更偏向于这个年龄段的低端），得益于DK·法肖拉的动作指导，它生动地捕捉了学校里动荡不安的世界，尤其是在一个早期的慢动作序列中。这次舞台呈现充满了风格，并且流畅迅速，这得益于Xana的音响设计和作曲——但它从未像布莱克曼的小说那样，对头脑和心灵产生同样直接的吸引力。

tgt_seg: 《猪心男孩》剧评：马洛里·布莱克曼启发性小说的生动舞台演绎

src_seg: Some set designs instantly make sense. Paul Wills's clever arrangement of television screens and speakers, all linked up by glowing capillary-like tubes, encapsulates Malorie Blackman's 1997 novel about a boy whose pig-heart transplant leads to a media frenzy. Andrew Exeter's lighting switches from blood red to cool blue for scenes when 13-year-old Cameron repeatedly puts himself - and, eventually, his new heart - to the test when diving at his local pool.
tgt_seg: 有些布景设计让人一看便懂。保罗·威尔斯巧妙地布置了电视屏幕和扬声器，并用发光的毛细血管状管道将它们全部连接，这一设计精准地浓缩了马洛里·布莱克曼1997年小说所讲述的故事：一个男孩因接受猪心移植而引发媒体狂热。在13岁的卡梅伦于当地泳池潜水，反复考验自己——并最终考验他那颗新心脏的场景中，安德鲁·埃克塞特的灯光设计在血红色与冷蓝色之间切换。

src_seg: Blackman's novel is itself a deep dive: this "what would you do?" book for young readers considers ethics, animal rights, othering and empathy. Keeping the pre-social media setting, Winsome Pinnock's new adaptation draws upon the heightened poetic style of Blackman's opening chapter. Pinnock retains the narrator's spirited interest in wordplay, boosts the wisdom of Cameron's Nan and makes water more of a unifying theme throughout the story. Her version also takes a thrilling new turn towards the end.
tgt_seg: 布莱克曼的小说本身就是一次深度探索：这本面向年轻读者的“你会怎么做？”式读物，探讨了伦理、动物权利、异化和同理心等议题。温瑟姆·平诺克的新改编版保留了前社交媒体时代的背景，借鉴了布莱克曼原著开篇章节中强烈的诗意风格。平诺克保留了叙述者对文字游戏的热情，突显了卡梅伦奶奶的智慧，并将“水”这一意象提升为贯穿整个故事的统一主题。她的改编版本在结尾处也有了一个激动人心的新转折。

src_seg: Tristan Fynn-Aiduenu's boisterous production has some vivid performances, too, including by Immanuel Yeboah in the main role. But by overplaying the comedy it drowns out some of the story's more reflective episodes. In the novel, Cameron often cracks jokes, even when face to face with the animal named Trudy whose heart he will receive, yet that encounter is hugely moving as the boy is overwhelmed with relief, fear, guilt and hope. On stage, Trudy is played as a disco-queen pig with pink puffer jacket and oversized glasses; discovering Cameron's plans for her heart, she squeals in jokey horror. Elsewhere, animal rights are thinly discussed.

src_seg: The production is more successful at conveying how Cameron is viewed by his classmates both before the operation (when they see his illness as fragility) and after (when he is still considered different to them). The children are played by an adult cast, most doubling up as the grownup characters. The pioneering Dr Bryce (Tré Medley) is amusingly portrayed as a spy-like smooth operator, all dressed in white both in and out of his laboratory, when that set design again works efficiently. Christina Ngoyi as his best friend Marilyn (Marlon in the book) has the right note of compromised loyalty; Christine During's popular Julie has a buoyant ease but her later fear of Cameron again tips into comedy.

src_seg: The show is aimed at nine to 13-year-olds (probably geared more towards the younger side of that range) and dynamically captures the turbulent world of school thanks in part to DK Fashola's movement direction, especially appealing in an early slo-mo sequence. This staging has plenty of style and flows swiftly, helped by Xana's sound design and compositions - but it never has quite the same direct appeal to head and heart as Blackman's book.

src_seg: Pig Heart Boy review - lively staging of Malorie Blackman's stimulating novel
tgt_seg: 《猪心男孩》剧评——活力四射的舞台呈现，演绎马洛里·布莱克曼的刺激小说

src_seg: Some set designs instantly make sense. Paul Wills's clever arrangement of television screens and speakers, all linked up by glowing capillary-like tubes, encapsulates Malorie Blackman's 1997 novel about a boy whose pig-heart transplant leads to a media frenzy. Andrew Exeter's lighting switches from blood red to cool blue for scenes when 13-year-old Cameron repeatedly puts himself - and, eventually, his new heart - to the test when diving at his local pool.
tgt_seg: 有些布景设计瞬间就能让人明白其用意。保罗·威尔斯巧妙地安排了电视屏幕和扬声器，所有设备通过发光的毛细管状管连接起来，这完美地诠释了马洛里·布莱克曼1997年的小说，讲述了一个男孩因接受猪心移植而引发媒体狂潮的故事。在13岁的卡梅伦反复在当地泳池潜水，以此测试自己及其新心脏的场景中，安德鲁·埃克塞特的灯光从血红色切换为冷静的蓝色。

src_seg: Blackman's novel is itself a deep dive: this "what would you do?" book for young readers considers ethics, animal rights, othering and empathy. Keeping the pre-social media setting, Winsome Pinnock's new adaptation draws upon the heightened poetic style of Blackman's opening chapter. Pinnock retains the narrator's spirited interest in wordplay, boosts the wisdom of Cameron's Nan and makes water more of a unifying theme throughout the story. Her version also takes a thrilling new turn towards the end.
tgt_seg: 布莱克曼的小说本身就是一次深入的探索：这本面向年轻读者的“你会怎么做？”的书探讨了伦理、动物权利、他者化和同理心等主题。温索姆·皮诺克的新改编保留了小说中社交媒体出现之前的背景设定，并借鉴了布莱克曼开篇章节中增强的诗意风格。皮诺克保留了叙述者对文字游戏的热情，提升了卡梅伦的奶奶的智慧，并使水成为贯穿整个故事的统一主题。她的版本在结尾处也带来了令人激动的新转折。

src_seg: Tristan Fynn-Aiduenu's boisterous production has some vivid performances, too, including by Immanuel Yeboah in the main role. But by overplaying the comedy it drowns out some of the story's more reflective episodes. In the novel, Cameron often cracks jokes, even when face to face with the animal named Trudy whose heart he will receive, yet that encounter is hugely moving as the boy is overwhelmed with relief, fear, guilt and hope. On stage, Trudy is played as a disco-queen pig with pink puffer jacket and oversized glasses; discovering Cameron's plans for her heart, she squeals in jokey horror. Elsewhere, animal rights are thinly discussed.
tgt_seg: 特里斯坦·芬恩-艾杜努的喧闹制作也有一些生动的表演，包括伊曼纽尔·耶博阿在主角中的表现。但过度强调喜剧效果掩盖了故事中一些更具反思性的情节。在小说中，卡梅伦经常开玩笑，即使在面对名为特鲁迪的动物（他即将接受其心脏）时也是如此，但那次相遇却令人十分感动，因为男孩被解脱、恐惧、内疚和希望所淹没。在舞台上，特鲁迪被描绘成一个穿着粉色蓬蓬外套和超大眼镜的迪斯科女王猪；在发现卡梅伦对她心脏的计划后，她以玩笑般的恐怖尖叫。在其他地方，动物权利问题则很少被讨论。

src_seg: The production is more successful at conveying how Cameron is viewed by his classmates both before the operation (when they see his illness as fragility) and after (when he is still considered different to them). The children are played by an adult cast, most doubling up as the grownup characters. The pioneering Dr Bryce (Tré Medley) is amusingly portrayed as a spy-like smooth operator, all dressed in white both in and out of his laboratory, when that set design again works efficiently. Christina Ngoyi as his best friend Marilyn (Marlon in the book) has the right note of compromised loyalty; Christine During's popular Julie has a buoyant ease but her later fear of Cameron again tips into comedy.
tgt_seg: 该剧更成功地传达了卡梅伦在手术前后被同学们如何看待：手术前，他们认为他的疾病是脆弱的象征；手术后，他们仍然认为他与众不同。孩子们由成年演员扮演，大多数演员同时扮演成年角色。先驱布赖斯医生（特雷·梅德利饰）被有趣地描绘成一个像间谍一样圆滑的操作者，无论是在实验室内还是实验室外，他都穿着全白的服装，这种布景设计再次高效地发挥了作用。克里斯蒂娜·恩戈伊饰演他的最佳朋友玛丽莲（书中为马龙），她恰到好处地表现出妥协的忠诚；克里斯汀·杜林饰演的受欢迎的朱莉充满活力，但她后来对卡梅伦的恐惧再次滑向喜剧。

The screens on stage could be used more effectively during Cameron's TV interview and for the camcorder footage he records for his brother.

src_seg: The show is aimed at nine to 13-year-olds (probably geared more towards the younger side of that range) and dynamically captures the turbulent world of school thanks in part to DK Fashola's movement direction, especially appealing in an early slo-mo sequence. This staging has plenty of style and flows swiftly, helped by Xana's sound design and compositions - but it never has quite the same direct appeal to head and heart as Blackman's book.
tgt_seg: 该剧针对9至13岁的儿童（可能更倾向于该年龄段较低的群体），动态地捕捉了学校世界的动荡，部分归功于DK法索拉的动作指导，特别是在早期慢动作序列中非常吸引人。这种舞台呈现充满风格，流畅迅速，得益于Xana的声音设计和作曲——但它从未像布莱克曼的书那样直接打动人心。

In the novel, Cameron often cracks jokes, even when face to face with the animal named Trudy whose heart he will receive, yet that encounter is hugely moving as the boy is overwhelmed with relief, fear, guilt and hope. On stage, Trudy is played as a disco-queen pig with pink puffer jacket and oversized glasses; discovering Cameron's plans for her heart, she squeals in jokey horror. Elsewhere, animal rights are thinly discussed.
tgt_seg: 特里斯坦-费恩-艾杜努（Tristan Fynn-Aiduenu）的这部沸腾的作品也有一些生动的表演，包括主要角色伊曼纽尔-耶博亚（Immanuel Yeboah）的表演。但由于过度渲染喜剧效果，淹没了故事中一些更值得反思的情节。在小说中，卡梅隆经常开玩笑，甚至在面对名叫特鲁迪的动物时也是如此，他将得到它的心脏，然而，当男孩被解脱、恐惧、愧疚和希望所淹没时，这种相遇是非常动人的。在舞台上，特鲁迪被扮演成一只穿着粉色夹克、戴着超大眼镜的迪斯科女王猪；当她发现卡梅隆要取她的心脏时，她发出了戏谑的尖叫声。在其他地方，对动物权利的讨论也很单薄。

src_seg: The production is more successful at conveying how Cameron is viewed by his classmates both before the operation (when they see his illness as fragility) and after (when he is still considered different to them). The children are played by an adult cast, most doubling up as the grownup characters. The pioneering Dr Bryce (Tré Medley) is amusingly portrayed as a spy-like smooth operator, all dressed in white both in and out of his laboratory, when that set design again works efficiently. tgt_seg: 该剧更成功地传达了同学们在手术前（他们认为卡梅隆的病很脆弱）和手术后（他们仍然认为他与众不同）是如何看待卡梅隆的。孩子们由成人演员扮演，其中大多数人都是大人的替身。开创性的布莱斯博士（特雷-梅德利 Tré Medley 饰）被塑造成一个间谍般圆滑的操作者，无论在他的实验室里还是在实验室外，都是一身白衣，令人捧腹。克里斯蒂娜-恩戈伊（Christina Ngoyi）饰演的布莱斯博士的好友玛丽莲（Marilyn，书中为马龙）的忠诚妥协态度恰到好处；克里斯蒂娜-唐娜（Christine During）饰演的朱莉（Julie）很受欢迎，但她后来对卡梅隆的恐惧又让她的表演充满喜剧色彩。

src_seg: The show is aimed at nine to 13-year-olds (probably geared more towards the younger side of that range) and dynamically captures the turbulent world of school thanks in part to DK Fashola's movement direction, especially appealing in an early slo-mo sequence. tgt_seg: 该制作更成功地展现了卡梅隆在手术前（当同学们将他的疾病视为脆弱时）和手术后（当他们仍然认为他与他们不同）是如何被同学们看待的。孩子们由成人演员扮演，其中大多数人还扮演成年角色。开创性的布莱斯博士（特雷·梅德利）被幽默地描绘成一名类似间谍的精明人物，无论是在实验室内还是外，他都穿着白色衣服，这种布景设计再次有效地运作。克里斯蒂娜·恩戈伊扮演他的好朋友玛龙（在书中是马龙），她有一种妥协的忠诚感；克里斯汀·杜林的受欢迎人物朱莉有一种轻松自如的感觉，但后来对卡梅隆的恐惧又回到了喜剧。

src_seg: Cameron's asides to the audience include a raucous interrogation about who sold his story to the press that is strained and distracts from his inner tumult. tgt_seg: 《猪心男孩》剧评——马洛莉·布莱克曼激励人心的小说的生动舞台剧版

src_seg: Some set designs instantly make sense. Paul Wills's clever arrangement of television screens and speakers, all linked up by glowing capillary-like tubes, encapsulates Malorie Blackman's 1997 novel about a boy whose pig-heart transplant leads to a media frenzy. Andrew Exeter's lighting switches from blood red to cool blue for scenes when 13-year-old Cameron repeatedly puts himself - and, eventually, his new heart - to the test when diving at his local pool.
tgt_seg: 有些布景设计一眼就能看出其意义。保罗·威尔斯巧妙地安排了电视屏幕和扬声器，所有这些都通过发光的毛细管状管道连接起来，这体现了马洛里·布莱克曼1997年的小说，讲述了一个男孩的故事，他接受了猪心移植手术，导致媒体大肆炒作。安德鲁·埃克塞特在13岁的卡梅隆在当地游泳池潜水时，灯光从血红变为冷蓝，以此来展示卡梅隆不断地对自己进行测试，最终对他的新心脏进行测试。

src_seg: Blackman's novel is itself a deep dive: this "what would you do?" book for young readers considers ethics, animal rights, othering and empathy. Keeping the pre-social media setting, Winsome Pinnock's new adaptation draws upon the heightened poetic style of Blackman's opening chapter. Pinnock retains the narrator's spirited interest in wordplay, boosts the wisdom of Cameron's Nan and makes water more of a unifying theme throughout the story. Her version also takes a thrilling new turn towards the end.
tgt_seg: 布莱克曼的小说本身就是一次深入的探讨：这本“你会怎么做？”的书籍针对年轻读者，探讨了伦理、动物权利、异化和同理心。在保持社交媒体前设定的同时，温斯姆·平诺克的新改编借鉴了布莱克曼开篇章节的高度诗意风格。平诺克保留了叙述者对文字游戏的热情兴趣，增强了卡梅隆奶奶的智慧，并使水成为贯穿整个故事的统一主题。她的版本在结尾处也带来了令人兴奋的新转折。

src_seg: Tristan Fynn-Aiduenu's boisterous production has some vivid performances, too, including by Immanuel Yeboah in the main role. But by overplaying the comedy it drowns out some of the story's more reflective episodes. In the novel, Cameron often cracks jokes, even when face to face with the animal named Trudy whose heart he will receive, yet that encounter is hugely moving as the boy is overwhelmed with relief, fear, guilt and hope. On stage, Trudy is played as a disco-queen pig with pink puffer jacket and oversized glasses; discovering Cameron's plans for her heart, she squeals in jokey horror. Elsewhere, animal rights are thinly discussed.

Andrew Exeter's lighting switches from blood red to cool blue for scenes when 13-year-old Cameron repeatedly puts himself - and, eventually, his new heart - to the test when diving at his local pool.
tgt_seg: 一些布景设计立刻就变得有意义了。保罗·威尔斯 (Paul Wills) 巧妙地安排了电视屏幕和扬声器，并通过发光的毛细血管状管子将它们连接起来，体现了马洛里·布莱克曼 (Malorie Blackman) 1997 年的小说，该小说讲述了一个男孩接受猪心脏移植后引起媒体狂热的故事。当 13 岁的卡梅伦在当地游泳池跳水时，他不断考验自己，最终也考验他的新心脏时，安德鲁·埃克塞特的灯光从血红色变成了冷蓝色。

src_seg: Blackman's novel is itself a deep dive: this "what would you do?" book for young readers considers ethics, animal rights, othering and empathy. Keeping the pre-social media setting, Winsome Pinnock's new adaptation draws upon the heightened poetic style of Blackman's opening chapter. Pinnock retains the narrator's spirited interest in wordplay, boosts the wisdom of Cameron's Nan and makes water more of a unifying theme throughout the story. Her version also takes a thrilling new turn towards the end.
tgt_seg: 布莱克曼的小说本身就是一次深刻的探讨：这本面向年轻读者的“你会怎么做？”书籍探讨了道德、动物权利、他者化和同理心。温索姆·皮诺克 (Winsome Pinnock) 的新改编保留了前社交媒体的背景，借鉴了布莱克曼开篇的诗意风格。皮诺克保留了叙述者对文字游戏的浓厚兴趣，增强了卡梅伦笔下奶奶的智慧，并使水成为整个故事的统一主题。她的版本在结尾处也出现了令人激动的新转折。

src_seg: Tristan Fynn-Aiduenu's boisterous production has some vivid performances, too, including by Immanuel Yeboah in the main role. But by overplaying the comedy it drowns out some of the story's more reflective episodes. In the novel, Cameron often cracks jokes, even when face to face with the animal named Trudy whose heart he will receive, yet that encounter is hugely moving as the boy is overwhelmed with relief, fear, guilt and hope. On stage, Trudy is played as a disco-queen pig with pink puffer jacket and oversized glasses; discovering Cameron's plans for her heart, she squeals in jokey horror. Elsewhere, animal rights are thinly discussed.
tgt_seg: 特里斯坦·芬恩·艾杜努 (Tristan Fynn-Aiduenu) 的喧闹作品中也有一些生动的表演，包括主角伊曼纽尔·耶博阿 (Immanuel Yeboah)。但由于喜剧元素的过度渲染，它淹没了故事中一些更引人深思的情节。在小说中，卡梅伦经常开玩笑，即使面对着一只名叫特鲁迪的动物，他也会得到这只动物的心脏，但那次相遇却非常感人，因为这个男孩心中充满了解脱、恐惧、内疚和希望。在舞台上，特鲁迪扮演一只穿着粉色羽绒夹克、戴着大眼镜的迪斯科女王猪；当她发现卡梅伦对她心脏的计划时，她惊恐地尖叫起来。在其他地方，动物权利很少被讨论。

src_seg: The production is more successful at conveying how Cameron is viewed by his classmates both before the operation (when they see his illness as fragility) and after (when he is still considered different to them). The children are played by an adult cast, most doubling up as the grownup characters. The pioneering Dr Bryce (Tré Medley) is amusingly portrayed as a spy-like smooth operator, all dressed in white both in and out of his laboratory, when that set design again works efficiently. Christina Ngoyi as his best friend Marilyn (Marlon in the book) has the right note of compromised loyalty; Christine During's popular Julie has a buoyant ease but her later fear of Cameron again tips into comedy.
tgt_seg: 该剧更成功地传达了卡梅伦在手术前（他们认为他的疾病很脆弱）和手术后（他仍然被认为与他们不同）同学们对他的看法。儿童由成人演员扮演，大多数还兼任成人角色。富有开拓精神的布莱斯博士（特雷·梅德利饰）被有趣地描绘成一个间谍般的老练操作员，无论在实验室内外都穿着白色衣服，当这个布景设计再次有效地发挥作用时。克里斯蒂娜·恩戈伊 (Christina Ngoyi) 饰演他的好友玛丽莲 (Marilyn)（书中为马龙），恰如其分地展现了妥协的忠诚；克里斯汀·杜伦 (Christine Due) 饰演的朱莉 (Julie) 性格活泼轻松，但她后来对卡梅伦的恐惧又一次成为了喜剧元素。

src_seg: Cameron's asides to the audience include a raucous interrogation about who sold his story to the press that is strained and distracts from his inner tumult. The screens on stage could be used more effectively during Cameron's TV interview and for the camcorder footage he records for his brother.
tgt_seg: 卡梅伦对观众的旁白包括对是谁将他的故事出卖给媒体的喧闹质问，这番话显得有些紧张，分散了观众对他内心骚动的注意力。舞台上的屏幕可以在卡梅伦接受电视采访时以及他为他的兄弟录制的摄像机镜头时得到更有效的利用。

src_seg: The show is aimed at nine to 13-year-olds (probably geared more towards the younger side of that range) and dynamically captures the turbulent world of school thanks in part to DK Fashola's movement direction, especially appealing in an early slo-mo sequence. This staging has plenty of style and flows swiftly, helped by Xana's sound design and compositions - but it never has quite the same direct appeal to head and heart as Blackman's book.
tgt_seg: 该节目针对 9 至 13 岁的孩子（可能更适合该范围内的年轻一代），并动态地捕捉了动荡的学校世界，部分归功于 DK Fashola 的运动方向，在早期的慢动作序列中尤其吸引人。在 Xana 的声音设计和作曲的帮助下，这个舞台风格丰富，流程迅速 - 但它从来没有像布莱克曼的书那样直接吸引人的头脑和心灵。

src_seg: The production is more successful at conveying how Cameron is viewed by his classmates both before the operation (when they see his illness as fragility) and after (when he is still considered different to them). The children are played by an adult cast, most doubling up as the grownup characters. The pioneering Dr Bryce (Tré Medley) is amusingly portrayed as a spy-like smooth operator, all dressed in white both in and out of his laboratory, when that set design again works efficiently. Christina Ngoyi as his best friend Marilyn (Marlon in the book) has the right note of compromised loyalty; Christine During's popular Julie has a buoyant ease but her later fear of Cameron again tips into comedy.
tgt_seg: 这部剧在展现卡梅伦在手术前后被同龄人如何看待方面更为成功（手术前他们认为他的病是脆弱的，手术后他们仍然认为他与众不同）。孩子们由成人演员扮演，大多数演员还同时扮演成年角色。开创性的布莱斯博士（特雷·梅德利饰）被幽默地描绘成一位间谍般的圆滑人物，无论在实验室内外都穿着白色服装，这个布景设计再次发挥了高效的作用。克里斯蒂娜·恩戈伊饰演他的好友玛丽莲（书中为马龙），她表现出了妥协的忠诚；克莉丝汀·杜林饰演受欢迎的朱莉，她表现出了轻松从容，但后来她对卡梅伦的恐惧又演变成了喜剧。

src_seg: Cameron's asides to the audience include a raucous interrogation about who sold his story to the press that is strained and distracts from his inner tumult. The screens on stage could be used more effectively during Cameron's TV interview and for the camcorder footage he records for his brother.
tgt_seg: 卡梅伦对观众的旁白包括了一场关于谁将他的故事卖给媒体的激烈质问，这显得有些牵强，分散了他内心的纷扰。舞台上的屏幕在卡梅伦的电视采访和他在录像带中为弟弟录制的镜头中本可以得到更有效的利用。

src_seg: The show is aimed at nine to 13-year-olds (probably geared more towards the younger side of that range) and dynamically captures the turbulent world of school thanks in part to DK Fashola's movement direction, especially appealing in an early slo-mo sequence. This staging has plenty of style and flows swiftly, helped by Xana's sound design and compositions - but it never has quite the same direct appeal to head and heart as Blackman's book.

src_seg: Pig Heart Boy review - lively staging of Malorie Blackman's stimulating novel
tgt_seg: 《猪心男孩》演出评论——对马洛里·布莱克曼小说的生动演绎

src_seg: Some set designs instantly make sense. Paul Wills's clever arrangement of television screens and speakers, all linked up by glowing capillary-like tubes, encapsulates Malorie Blackman's 1997 novel about a boy whose pig-heart transplant leads to a media frenzy. Andrew Exeter's lighting switches from blood red to cool blue for scenes when 13-year-old Cameron repeatedly puts himself - and, eventually, his new heart - to the test when diving at his local pool.
tgt_seg: 有些舞台设计一目了然。保罗·威尔斯巧妙地排列了电视屏幕和扬声器，所有这些都通过发光细管连接在一起，体现了马洛里·布莱克曼的 1997 年小说，该小说讲述了一个男孩因猪心移植而引发媒体狂热的故事。安德鲁·埃克塞特将灯光从鲜血红转变为凉爽的蓝，在 13 岁的卡梅伦反复考验自己——以及最终他的新心脏——时，场景从他当地的游泳池切换。

src_seg: Blackman's novel is itself a deep dive: this "what would you do?" book for young readers considers ethics, animal rights, othering and empathy. Keeping the pre-social media setting, Winsome Pinnock's new adaptation draws upon the heightened poetic style of Blackman's opening chapter. Pinnock retains the narrator's spirited interest in wordplay, boosts the wisdom of Cameron's Nan and makes water more of a unifying theme throughout the story. Her version also takes a thrilling new turn towards the end.
tgt_seg: 布莱克曼的小说本身就是一个深度的潜水：这本面向年轻读者的“你会怎么做？”书探讨了伦理、动物权利、他人和同理心。保持着没有社交媒体的背景，温斯姆·皮诺克的新改编借鉴了布莱克曼开篇章节的高度诗意风格。皮诺克保留了叙述者的活泼兴趣，增强了卡梅伦的奶奶的智慧，并将水作为故事中统一的主题。她的版本也转向了一个令人兴奋的新方向。

src_seg: Tristan Fynn-Aiduenu's boisterous production has some vivid performances, too, including by Immanuel Yeboah in the main role. But by overplaying the comedy it drowns out some of the story's more reflective episodes. In the novel, Cameron often cracks jokes, even when face to face with the animal named Trudy whose heart he will receive, yet that encounter is hugely moving as the boy is overwhelmed with relief, fear, guilt and hope. On stage, Trudy is played as a disco-queen pig with pink puffer jacket and oversized glasses; discovering Cameron's plans for her heart, she squeals in jokey horror. Elsewhere, animal rights are thinly discussed.

tgt_seg: 该剧面向9至13岁的儿童（可能更偏向于这个年龄段的低龄儿童），并动态地捕捉了学校的动荡世界，部分归功于DK·法索拉的运动指导，尤其是在早期的慢动作序列中特别吸引人。这个舞台剧风格十足，节奏明快，得益于Xana的声音设计和作曲 - 但它从未像布莱克曼的书那样直接吸引人心。

src_seg: Pig Heart Boy review - lively staging of Malorie Blackman's stimulating novel
tgt_seg: 《猪心男孩》剧评——玛洛丽·布莱克曼发人深省小说的生动舞台呈现

src_seg: Some set designs instantly make sense. Paul Wills's clever arrangement of television screens and speakers, all linked up by glowing capillary-like tubes, encapsulates Malorie Blackman's 1997 novel about a boy whose pig-heart transplant leads to a media frenzy. Andrew Exeter's lighting switches from blood red to cool blue for scenes when 13-year-old Cameron repeatedly puts himself - and, eventually, his new heart - to the test when diving at his local pool.
tgt_seg: 有些舞台设计一目了然，能够瞬间传达其设计意图。保罗·威尔斯巧妙地将电视屏幕与扬声器布置在舞台上，并用发光的、形似毛细血管的管道将它们连接在一起，完美地呈现了马洛丽·布莱克曼1997年创作的小说情节：一个男孩接受猪心移植手术后，引发了一场媒体风暴。安德鲁·埃克塞特的灯光设计在血红色与冷蓝色之间切换，映衬出13岁的卡梅伦在当地泳池中反复挑战自我——也不断考验着他那颗新心脏——的场景。

src_seg: Blackman's novel is itself a deep dive: this "what would you do?" book for young readers considers ethics, animal rights, othering and empathy. Keeping the pre-social media setting, Winsome Pinnock's new adaptation draws upon the heightened poetic style of Blackman's opening chapter. Pinnock retains the narrator's spirited interest in wordplay, boosts the wisdom of Cameron's Nan and makes water more of a unifying theme throughout the story. Her version also takes a thrilling new turn towards the end.
tgt_seg: 布莱克曼的小说本身就是一次深入的探索：这本面向年轻读者的“你会怎么做？”式读物，探讨了伦理、动物权利、他者化（即对“异类”的排斥）以及同理心等议题。温索姆·平诺克（Winsome Pinnock）的新改编版本保留了原著中“社交媒体尚未普及”的时代背景，并借鉴了布莱克曼原著开篇章节中充满诗意的语言风格。平诺克延续了叙述者对文字游戏的浓厚兴趣，突显了卡梅伦外祖母的智慧，并将“水”塑造成贯穿整个故事的核心主题。她的改编版本在结尾处也带来了令人惊喜的新转折。

src_seg: Tristan Fynn-Aiduenu's boisterous production has some vivid performances, too, including by Immanuel Yeboah in the main role. But by overplaying the comedy it drowns out some of the story's more reflective episodes. In the novel, Cameron often cracks jokes, even when face to face with the animal named Trudy whose heart he will receive, yet that encounter is hugely moving as the boy is overwhelmed with relief, fear, guilt and hope. On stage, Trudy is played as a disco-queen pig with pink puffer jacket and oversized glasses; discovering Cameron's plans for her heart, she squeals in jokey horror. Elsewhere, animal rights are thinly discussed.
tgt_seg: 特里斯坦·芬恩-艾杜努执导的这部作品热闹而富有活力，其中也不乏精彩的表演，尤其是由伊曼纽尔·耶博阿饰演的主角令人印象深刻。然而，过度强调喜剧元素使得故事中一些更具反思性的片段被弱化。在原著中，即便面对即将为自己捐献心脏的猪“特鲁迪”，卡梅伦仍不时开玩笑，但这场相遇却因男孩内心交织着宽慰、恐惧、愧疚与希望而显得格外感人。而在舞台上，特鲁迪被塑造成一位身穿粉色羽绒服、佩戴夸张眼镜的“迪斯科女王”猪，当她得知卡梅伦对她心脏的打算时，以一种夸张而滑稽的方式表达惊恐。此外，剧中对动物权利的探讨也显得较为浅显，缺乏深度。

src_seg: The production is more successful at conveying how Cameron is viewed by his classmates both before the operation (when they see his illness as fragility) and after (when he is still considered different to them). The children are played by an adult cast, most doubling up as the grownup characters. The pioneering Dr Bryce (Tré Medley) is amusingly portrayed as a spy-like smooth operator, all dressed in white both in and out of his laboratory, when that set design again works efficiently. Christina Ngoyi as his best friend Marilyn (Marlon in the book) has the right note of compromised loyalty; Christine During's popular Julie has a buoyant ease but her later fear of Cameron again tips into comedy.
tgt_seg: 该剧更成功地展现了卡梅伦在手术前后被同学们看待的方式的变化：手术前，同学们认为他体弱多病；手术后，则依然将其视为“异类”。剧中的儿童角色均由成年演员扮演，且其中多数演员还同时饰演了成人角色。布莱斯医生（特雷·梅德利饰）这一角色被有趣地塑造成了一个像间谍般圆滑老练的人物，无论在实验室内外，他都身着白衣，这种设定与舞台布景设计巧妙地融为一体。克里斯蒂娜·恩戈伊饰演卡梅伦的挚友玛丽琳（原著中名为马龙），将那种夹在忠诚与压力之间的微妙关系表现得恰到好处；克里斯汀·杜林饰演的人气女孩朱莉则显得轻松活泼，但她后来对卡梅伦的恐惧则被处理成了喜剧效果。

src_seg: Cameron's asides to the audience include a raucous interrogation about who sold his story to the press that is strained and distracts from his inner tumult. The screens on stage could be used more effectively during Cameron's TV interview and for the camcorder footage he records for his brother.
tgt_seg: 卡梅伦对观众的旁白中包含一段关于“谁将他的故事泄露给媒体”的激烈质问，这种处理方式显得有些生硬，反而分散了观众对他内心挣扎与情感波动的关注。舞台上的屏幕本可以被更有效地利用，例如在卡梅伦接受电视采访的场景，以及播放他为弟弟录制的视频时。

src_seg: The show is aimed at nine to 13-year-olds (probably geared more towards the younger side of that range) and dynamically captures the turbulent world of school thanks in part to DK Fashola's movement direction, especially appealing in an early slo-mo sequence. This staging has plenty of style and flows swiftly, helped by Xana's sound design and compositions - but it never has quite the same direct appeal to head and heart as Blackman's book.
tgt_seg: 该剧面向9至13岁的观众（更倾向于该年龄段中较为年幼的群体），在DK·法索拉的动作设计指导下，生动地呈现了校园中充满动荡的氛围，尤其在开场的一段慢动作场景中表现突出。舞台呈现风格鲜明、节奏流畅，得益于夏娜出色的音效设计与配乐——然而，它始终未能像布莱克曼的原著那样，直接触动观众的理智与心灵。

tgt_seg: 有些布景设计一眼就能让人明白其用意。保罗·威尔斯巧妙地布置了电视屏幕和扬声器，所有这些设备都通过发光的毛细管状管线连接在一起，完美地再现了马洛里·布莱克曼 1997 年的小说《猪心奇遇记》。在小说中，一个男孩接受了猪心移植手术，这引发了媒体的疯狂追捧。安德鲁·埃克塞特在灯光设计上从鲜红色切换到冷蓝色，以表现出 13 岁的卡梅隆在当地游泳池潜水时，一次又一次地考验自己——最终，考验着他新移植的心脏。

src_seg: Blackman's novel is itself a deep dive: this "what would you do?" book for young readers considers ethics, animal rights, othering and empathy. Keeping the pre-social media setting, Winsome Pinnock's new adaptation draws upon the heightened poetic style of Blackman's opening chapter. Pinnock retains the narrator's spirited interest in wordplay, boosts the wisdom of Cameron's Nan and makes water more of a unifying theme throughout the story. Her version also takes a thrilling new turn towards the end.
tgt_seg: 布莱克曼的小说本身就是一个深入探讨：这本书是为年轻读者准备的“你会怎么做？”书，探讨了伦理、动物权利、异化和同理心。温索姆·皮诺克的新改编作品保持了社交媒体之前的设定，并借鉴了布莱克曼开篇章中诗意的风格。皮诺克保留了叙述者对文字游戏的热情，增强了卡梅伦奶奶的智慧，并使水成为贯穿整个故事的统一主题。她的版本在结尾处也采取了一个令人振奋的新方向。

src_seg: Tristan Fynn-Aiduenu's boisterous production has some vivid performances, too, including by Immanuel Yeboah in the main role. But by overplaying the comedy it drowns out some of the story's more reflective episodes. In the novel, Cameron often cracks jokes, even when face to face with the animal named Trudy whose heart he will receive, yet that encounter is hugely moving as the boy is overwhelmed with relief, fear, guilt and hope. On stage, Trudy is played as a disco-queen pig with pink puffer jacket and oversized glasses; discovering Cameron's plans for her heart, she squeals in jokey horror. Elsewhere, animal rights are thinly discussed.
tgt_seg: 特里斯坦·芬恩·艾杜恩的喧闹制作中也有几处精彩的表演，包括伊曼纽尔·耶博在主要角色中的表演。但是，由于过度演绎喜剧，淹没了故事中一些更具反思性的情节。在小说中，卡梅隆经常开玩笑了，即使面对着将要接受他心脏的动物特鲁迪，但他与特鲁迪的相遇却非常感人，因为这个男孩被缓解、恐惧、内疚和希望所淹没。在舞台上，特鲁迪被扮演成一个穿着粉红色救生衣和超大眼镜的迪斯科皇后猪；当她发现卡梅隆对她心脏的计划时，她用调笑的方式尖叫起来。在其他地方，动物权利的讨论也很肤浅。

src_seg: The production is more successful at conveying how Cameron is viewed by his classmates both before the operation (when they see his illness as fragility) and after (when he is still considered different to them). The children are played by an adult cast, most doubling up as the grownup characters. The pioneering Dr Bryce (Tré Medley) is amusingly portrayed as a spy-like smooth operator, all dressed in white both in and out of his laboratory, when that set design again works efficiently. Christina Ngoyi as his best friend Marilyn (Marlon in the book) has the right note of compromised loyalty; Christine During's popular Julie has a buoyant ease but her later fear of Cameron again tips into comedy.
tgt_seg: 这部作品更成功地传达了卡梅隆在手术前（当时他们认为他的病情很脆弱）和手术后（他们仍然认为他与众不同）在同学眼中的形象。孩子们由成人演员扮演，大多数演员还扮演成年角色。开创性的布莱斯博士（特雷·梅德利饰）被幽默地描绘成一个像间谍一样的圆滑人物，无论是在实验室里还是实验室外，他都穿着白色的衣服，这个布景设计再次发挥了高效的作用。克里斯蒂娜·恩戈伊饰演他的好友玛丽莲（书中为马龙），她表现出了妥协的忠诚；克里斯汀·杜林饰演的受欢迎的朱莉表现得轻松愉快，但后来她对卡梅隆的恐惧再次演变成了喜剧。

src_seg: Cameron's asides to the audience include a raucous interrogation about who sold his story to the press that is strained and distracts from his inner tumult. The screens on stage could be used more effectively during Cameron's TV interview and for the camcorder footage he records for his brother.
tgt_seg: 卡梅隆对观众的旁白包括了一场关于是谁将他的故事卖给媒体的喧闹质问，这让人感到紧张，并分散了他内心的纷扰。在卡梅隆的电视采访和为他的兄弟录制的摄像机镜头中，舞台上的屏幕本可以得到更有效的利用。

src_seg: The show is aimed at nine to 13-year-olds (probably geared more towards the younger side of that range) and dynamically captures the turbulent world of school thanks in part to DK Fashola's movement direction, especially appealing in an early slo-mo sequence. This staging has plenty of style and flows swiftly, helped by Xana's sound design and compositions - but it never has quite the same direct appeal to head and heart as Blackman's book.
tgt_seg: 该剧面向 9 至 13 岁儿童（可能更偏向于这个年龄段的下限），通过 DK Fashola 的动作指导，尤其是早期的慢动作镜头，动态地捕捉到了学校动荡的世界，尤其引人入胜。这种舞台设计风格独特，流畅快速，得益于 Xana 的音效设计和作曲 - 但它从未像布莱克曼的书那样直接触动人心。

tgt_seg: Tristan Fynn-Aiduenu 激动人心的演出也有一些生动的表演，包括扮演主角色的 Immanuel Yeboah。 但是，由于过度发挥出喜剧元素，它掩盖了故事中一些更具反思性的情节。 在小说中，卡梅伦经常开玩笑，即使是在面对接受他的心脏的叫 Trudy 的动物时，但这种遭遇却让人印象深刻，因为男孩被解脱、恐惧、内疚和希望所淹没。 在舞台上，Trudy 被演绎为穿着粉红色吹风夹和超大眼镜的迪斯科女王猪；她发现卡梅伦计划用她的心脏而尖叫着。 在其他地方，动物权利很少被讨论。

src_seg: The production is more successful at conveying how Cameron is viewed by his classmates both before the operation (when they see his illness as fragility) and after (when he is still considered different to them). The children are played by an adult cast, most doubling up as the grownup characters. The pioneering Dr Bryce (Tré Medley) is amusingly portrayed as a spy-like smooth operator, all dressed in white both in and out of his laboratory, when that set design again works efficiently. Christina Ngoyi as his best friend Marilyn (Marlon in the book) has the right note of compromised loyalty; Christine During's popular Julie has a buoyant ease but her later fear of Cameron again tips into comedy.
tgt_seg: 该制作更加成功地传达了卡梅伦如何被他的同学在手术前（他们认为他的病是一种脆弱性）和手术后（他仍然被认为与他们不同）看待。 儿童由成人演员饰演，其中大部分演员同时饰演成人的角色。 开创性的布莱斯博士(特雷·梅德利)以一个类似间谍的流畅操作者形象有趣地被描绘，他在实验室内和实验室外都身穿白衣；当场景设计再次有效时，克里斯蒂娜·恩戈伊饰演他的最好的朋友玛丽琳（书中的马隆）具有妥协忠诚的正确感；克里斯蒂娜·杜兰特扮演的流行的人朱莉有一种活泼的轻松感，但她后来对卡梅伦的恐惧又回到了喜剧之中。

src_seg: Cameron's asides to the audience include a raucous interrogation about who sold his story to the press that is strained and distracts from his inner tumult. The screens on stage could be used more effectively during Cameron's TV interview and for the camcorder footage he records for his brother.
tgt_seg: 卡梅伦对观众的旁白包括一场关于谁把他的故事卖给了媒体的激烈质询，这让他内心紧张，并使他无法集中精力。 在卡梅伦的电视采访中，以及他在为哥哥录制的视频中，舞台上的屏幕可以更有效率地使用。

src_seg: The show is aimed at nine to 13-year-olds (probably geared more towards the younger side of that range) and dynamically captures the turbulent world of school thanks in part to DK Fashola's movement direction, especially appealing in an early slo-mo sequence. This staging has plenty of style and flows swiftly, helped by Xana's sound design and compositions - but it never has quite the same direct appeal to head and heart as Blackman's book.
tgt_seg: 该剧以9至13岁的儿童（可能更面向这个年龄的年轻群体）为目标，通过 D.K. Fashola 的动作指导，生动地捕捉了学校动荡的世界，尤其是在早期慢动镜头中显得特别吸引人。 这场演出风格丰富，节奏流畅，这得益于 Xana 的声音设计和作曲 — — 但它从未像 Blackman 的书那样直接吸引头脑和心灵。

src_seg: Pig Heart Boy review - lively staging of Malorie Blackman's stimulating novel
tgt_seg: 《猪心男孩》剧评：马洛里·布莱克曼启发性小说的活力舞台呈现

src_seg: Some set designs instantly make sense. Paul Wills's clever arrangement of television screens and speakers, all linked up by glowing capillary-like tubes, encapsulates Malorie Blackman's 1997 novel about a boy whose pig-heart transplant leads to a media frenzy. Andrew Exeter's lighting switches from blood red to cool blue for scenes when 13-year-old Cameron repeatedly puts himself - and, eventually, his new heart - to the test when diving at his local pool.
tgt_seg: 有些布景设计甫一亮相便让人觉得恰到好处。保罗·威尔斯巧妙地布置了电视屏幕和扬声器，所有设备都由发光的毛细血管状管道连接，完美概括了马洛里·布莱克曼这部1997年小说的精髓——一个男孩接受猪心移植后引发媒体狂热的故事。在13岁的卡梅伦反复在当地泳池潜水以考验自己——并最终考验他那颗新心脏——的场景中，安德鲁·埃克塞特的灯光在血红色和冷蓝色之间切换。

src_seg: Blackman's novel is itself a deep dive: this "what would you do?" book for young readers considers ethics, animal rights, othering and empathy. Keeping the pre-social media setting, Winsome Pinnock's new adaptation draws upon the heightened poetic style of Blackman's opening chapter. Pinnock retains the narrator's spirited interest in wordplay, boosts the wisdom of Cameron's Nan and makes water more of a unifying theme throughout the story. Her version also takes a thrilling new turn towards the end.
tgt_seg: 布莱克曼的小说本身就是一次深度探索：这本面向年轻读者的“你会怎么做？”主题作品，探讨了伦理、动物权利、他者化和同理心。温瑟姆·平诺克的新改编保留了前社交媒体时代的背景设定，并借鉴了布莱克曼小说开篇章节中那种强化的诗意风格。平诺克保留了叙述者对文字游戏的浓厚兴趣，增强了卡梅伦外婆的智慧，并让“水”成为贯穿故事的更核心的主题。她的版本在结尾处还有一个激动人心的新转折。

src_seg: Tristan Fynn-Aiduenu's boisterous production has some vivid performances, too, including by Immanuel Yeboah in the main role. But by overplaying the comedy it drowns out some of the story's more reflective episodes. In the novel, Cameron often cracks jokes, even when face to face with the animal named Trudy whose heart he will receive, yet that encounter is hugely moving as the boy is overwhelmed with relief, fear, guilt and hope. On stage, Trudy is played as a disco-queen pig with pink puffer jacket and oversized glasses; discovering Cameron's plans for her heart, she squeals in jokey horror. Elsewhere, animal rights are thinly discussed.
tgt_seg: 特里斯坦·芬恩-艾杜努这部充满活力的作品中也有一些生动的表演，包括主角伊曼纽尔·耶博阿的演出。但由于过分强调喜剧，该剧淹没了一些故事中更引人深思的片段。在小说中，卡梅伦经常开玩笑，即使是面对那只名叫特鲁迪、他将接受其心脏的动物时也是如此，然而那次相遇却极其感人，男孩被解脱、恐惧、内疚和希望等种种情绪淹没。在舞台上，特鲁迪被塑造成一个穿着粉色羽绒夹克、戴着超大号眼镜的迪斯科女王猪；当她发现卡梅伦对其心脏的计划时，她带着开玩笑式的惊恐尖叫起来。在其他地方，关于动物权利的讨论则较为浅薄。

src_seg: The production is more successful at conveying how Cameron is viewed by his classmates both before the operation (when they see his illness as fragility) and after (when he is still considered different to them). The children are played by an adult cast, most doubling up as the grownup characters. The pioneering Dr Bryce (Tré Medley) is amusingly portrayed as a spy-like smooth operator, all dressed in white both in and out of his laboratory, when that set design again works efficiently. Christina Ngoyi as his best friend Marilyn (Marlon in the book) has the right note of compromised loyalty; Christine During's popular Julie has a buoyant ease but her later fear of Cameron again tips into comedy.
tgt_seg: 这部剧在传达卡梅伦的同学如何看待他方面则更为成功，无论是在手术前（他们将他的疾病视为脆弱）还是在手术后（他仍被认为与众不同）。儿童角色由成人演员扮演，其中大多数还兼饰成年人角色。开拓性的布莱斯博士（特雷·梅德利饰）被滑稽地描绘成一个间谍般圆滑老练的人，无论在实验室内外都身着白衣，此时的布景设计再次发挥了高效的作用。克里斯蒂娜·恩戈伊饰演他最好的朋友玛丽莲（书中为男性角色马龙），恰如其分地表现出那种左右为难的忠诚；克里斯汀·杜林饰演备受欢迎的朱莉，这个角色轻松活泼，但她后来对卡梅伦的恐惧再次滑向了喜剧。

src_seg: Cameron's asides to the audience include a raucous interrogation about who sold his story to the press that is strained and distracts from his inner tumult. The screens on stage could be used more effectively during Cameron's TV interview and for the camcorder footage he records for his brother.
tgt_seg: 卡梅伦对观众的旁白包括一段喧闹的质问，追问谁将他的故事卖给了媒体，这段处理显得很别扭，也分散了观众对他内心骚动的关注。舞台上的屏幕本可以在卡梅伦接受电视采访以及播放他为哥哥录制的便携式摄像机录像时得到更有效的利用。

src_seg: The show is aimed at nine to 13-year-olds (probably geared more towards the younger side of that range) and dynamically captures the turbulent world of school thanks in part to DK Fashola's movement direction, especially appealing in an early slo-mo sequence. This staging has plenty of style and flows swiftly, helped by Xana's sound design and compositions - but it never has quite the same direct appeal to head and heart as Blackman's book.
tgt_seg: 这部剧的目标观众是9至13岁的孩子（可能更适合该年龄段中较小的孩子），并凭借DK·法索拉的形体指导，尤其是在一段早期的慢动作片段中，动感十足地捕捉了动荡的校园世界。这部舞台剧风格十足，节奏流畅，萨娜的音效设计和作曲也功不可没——但它始终未能像布莱克曼的书那样，对理智与情感产生同等直接的冲击力。

src_seg: If you thought Elon Musk was bad, look at his dreadful mini-mes and shudder for America
tgt_seg: 如果你觉得埃隆·马斯克已经够糟糕了，那么看看他的那些令人恐惧的“分身”，你会对美国的未来感到担忧。

src_seg: You would be forgiven for thinking we were back at the Bullingdon Club, in the company of Jonty, Munty, Stiffy, Kipper, Chugger and, to use the polite version, Pig Botherer - only in this case it's Big Balls and a guy with a history of racist tweeting. This is the sudden, startling emergence into American political life of a type deeply recognisable to Brits: that is, jaunty young men with juvenile nicknames and a firm belief they should be running the world.
tgt_seg: 你可能会以为我们又回到了布林顿俱乐部，和乔恩蒂、芒蒂、斯蒂菲、基珀、查格尔以及那个礼貌的称呼“猪扰乱者”在一起——只不过这次是“大球”和一个有种族主义推文历史的人。这就是美国政治生活中突然出现的、令英国人似曾相识的一类人：他们是年轻有活力的男人，拥有幼稚的昵称，并且坚信自己应该掌管世界。

src_seg: This being America, the class signifiers are slightly different from those in Britain. But in most regards, the cohort of young men hired by Elon Musk for his cost-cutting taskforce, the department of government efficiency (Doge), will be familiar to anyone who lived through the era of Boris Johnson's weapons-grade flippancy or reports of David Cameron's youthful hijinks. (Donald Trump is very flippant, of course, but his style skews locker room rather than debate chamber - or, in this case, maths olympiad.) And while politics has always run on young, volunteer energy, less common in the US, perhaps, is the imperial swagger, the sheer frivolous entitlement accompanying a crowd that has seemingly been given the keys to the kingdom.
tgt_seg: 在美国，这类人的阶级特征与英国略有不同。但是在很多方面，马斯克为他的成本削减特别工作组——政府效率部（Doge）——招募的年轻男性与经历过鲍里斯·约翰逊时代的人们非常熟悉。那个时代充满了约翰逊式的轻浮和大卫·卡梅伦年轻时的恶作剧。（当然，唐纳德·特朗普也很轻浮，但他的风格更像是更衣室，而不是辩论室——或者说，在这种情况下，更像是数学奥林匹克竞赛。）虽然政治一直以来都依赖于年轻人的志愿者能量，但在美国，帝国式的傲慢和随之而来的放纵可能是较为少见的。

src_seg: Let's look at the lineup. The youngest of Musk's Doge hires, Edward Coristine - online username, Big Balls - is a 19-year-old former intern at Neuralink, Musk's neurotechnology company, who until recently appeared to be a first-year student at Northeastern University in Boston. Luke Farritor is a 23-year-old former SpaceX intern. Marko Elez, 25, used to work for X and SpaceX, and was revealed by the Wall Street Journal to have authored several since-removed tweets asserting, among other things, "You could not pay me to marry outside of my ethnicity." (Elez briefly resigned before Musk announced he'd reinstate him.)
tgt_seg: 让我们来看看这群人的阵容。马斯克的Doge团队中最年轻的成员爱德华·科里斯蒂纳（Edward Coristine），在线用户名为“大球”（Big Balls），是一位19岁的神经科技公司Neuralink的前实习生，最近还是波士顿东北大学的一年级学生。卢克·法里托（Luke Farritor）是一位23岁的SpaceX前实习生。马尔科·埃莱兹（Marko Elez），25岁，曾在X和SpaceX工作，《华尔街日报》曾揭露他发布了一些后来被删除的推文，其中包括“我不会为了任何钱嫁/娶非我族人”。（埃莱兹曾短暂辞职，但马斯克宣布将让他复职。）

src_seg: And Gavin Kliger, a 25-year-old who boosted a post on X by the white supremacist Nick Fuentes, and whose newly launched Substack this week highlighted the perils of skipping freshman English 101 with a post entitled "Why DOGE: Why I gave up a seven-figure salary to save America."
tgt_seg: 还有加文·克利格（Gavin Kliger），一位25岁的人，他曾转发了白人至上主义者尼克·富恩特斯（Nick Fuentes）在X上的帖子，他新推出的Substack本周以一篇名为“为什么是DOGE：为什么我放弃七位数的薪水来拯救美国”的文章，强调了跳过大学一年级英语101课程的危险。

src_seg: Between them, these men have gained access to federal premises and staffing systems that govern agencies including USAid, the Department of Health and Human Services, the education and energy departments, and the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, and contain sensitive information relating to millions of Americans. Elez was, reportedly, erroneously given overwrite access to the Treasury department's payment system before it was yanked back to read-only.
tgt_seg: 这些人共同获得了进入联邦政府机构和人事系统的权限，这些系统涵盖了包括美国国际开发署、卫生与公众服务部、教育部、能源部以及医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心在内的多个机构，并包含了数百万美国人的敏感信息。据报道，埃莱兹被错误地授予了财政部支付系统的修改权限，但后来被撤回，改为只读权限。

src_seg: Of course, given that Doge has not responded to questions about what, if any, security clearance these young men have gone through, read-only is bad enough. The head of Doge, hiring in his own image, has turned to young, male software engineers with startup energy and the conviction that if you understand coding, you understand life. They've established sleeping pods in spare offices at the federal agencies they have been engaged to gut or dismantle, so that while Musk goes on X to mock federal employees for not working at weekends, his mini-mes work round the clock.

tgt_seg: 如果不是因为他们在网上发表的言论和个人简介，暴露了他们能力上的明显不足，那么他们的这一举动会更令人印象深刻。马斯克，一个情商堪比卡通片里抢银行的笨贼的人，正带领着一群人，其中大多数人既没有政府工作经验，也没有管理经验，更不用说在他们被要求改革的那些领域拥有专业知识了。这一幕让人联想到90年代管理咨询业的繁荣时期，当时刚毕业的大学生会带着毫不掩饰的怀疑，看着任何一个35岁以上、还活着的人。正如《纽约时报》报道的那样，一些年轻的工程师私下称联邦政府雇员为“恐龙”，而这些“恐龙”也反过来称那些戴着棒球帽的人为“马斯克鼠”。

src_seg: On X, meanwhile, Musk amplified a post pitching "autistic tech bros" against "non-binary Deep State theater kids," and another that said what's happening in the US right now is equivalent to "the yearbook committe and theater kid types getting rocked by a football team and chess club alliance." Theatre kids and chess nerds are, traditionally, both categories of social death in high school that are targeted by queen bees and jocks, a case of Musk siding with the oppressor that's even sadder when you consider that Trump isn't even a real jock. (For a full account of Trump's hilariously mediocre sports career relative to his claims about it, read Lucky Loser by Russ Buettner and Susanne Craig.)
tgt_seg: 与此同时，马斯克在X（原Twitter）上转发了一篇帖子，该帖子将“患有自闭症的技术人员”与“非二元性别认同的‘深层政府’戏剧爱好者”进行对比，还转发了另一篇帖子，称目前美国发生的情况相当于“高中年鉴委员会和戏剧社成员被由橄榄球队和国际象棋俱乐部组成的联盟‘欺负’”。通常来说，高中里，戏剧社成员和国际象棋爱好者都是容易受到欺负的群体，经常是校园“校花”和“体育健将”的目标。马斯克竟然站在了“欺负者”这一边，这尤其令人感到悲哀，因为考虑到特朗普根本不是一个真正的“体育健将”，这种行为就更显得讽刺。 （要了解特朗普与其自吹自擂的体育生涯之间存在巨大差距的详细情况，请阅读拉塞尔·布特纳和苏珊·克雷格所著的《Lucky Loser》。）

src_seg: Anyway, we know how this ends. In the largest sense, with the cancellation of programmes mandated democratically in Congress by a bunch of unelected goons in puffer vests. And in the smallest sense, with one of these 22-year-old jerks spilling his Big Gulp cup of Mountain Dew over a keyboard at the Treasury and wiping the social security data of 70 million Americans. I look forward to watching as Big Balls and co find new ways to tank an economy even more efficiently and irreversibly than Brexit.
tgt_seg: 总之，我们都知道事情会如何发展。从宏观层面来看，那些未经选举产生的、穿着羽绒服的家伙，会通过国会强制取消一些项目，而这些项目原本是经过民主程序批准的。从微观层面来看，其中一个22岁的家伙可能会在财政部把一大杯“山露”饮料洒在键盘上，从而导致7000万美国人的社保数据丢失。我很期待看到“大人物”及其同伙们，如何以更有效、更不可逆转的方式，进一步损害经济，甚至比“脱欧”还要严重。

src_seg: If you thought Elon Musk was bad, look at his dreadful mini-mes and shudder for America
tgt_seg: 如果你认为伊隆·马斯克很糟糕，看看他那些可怕的迷你版，你会为美国感到不寒而栗

src_seg: You would be forgiven for thinking we were back at the Bullingdon Club, in the company of Jonty, Munty, Stiffy, Kipper, Chugger and, to use the polite version, Pig Botherer - only in this case it's Big Balls and a guy with a history of racist tweeting. This is the sudden, startling emergence into American political life of a type deeply recognisable to Brits: that is, jaunty young men with juvenile nicknames and a firm belief they should be running the world.
tgt_seg: 你或许会以为我们又回到了布灵顿俱乐部，和乔蒂、蒙蒂、斯蒂菲、基珀、查格，以及用礼貌的说法叫“猪头佬”——一起的，不过这次是“大个子”和一个有种族主义推特历史的家伙。美国政坛突然出现了一种英国人耳熟能详的人物：那些轻快活泼的年轻人，有着幼稚的绰号，坚信自己应该统治世界。

src_seg: This being America, the class signifiers are slightly different from those in Britain. But in most regards, the cohort of young men hired by Elon Musk for his cost-cutting taskforce, the department of government efficiency (Doge), will be familiar to anyone who lived through the era of Boris Johnson's weapons-grade flippancy or reports of David Cameron's youthful hijinks. (Donald Trump is very flippant, of course, but his style skews locker room rather than debate chamber - or, in this case, maths olympiad.) And while politics has always run on young, volunteer energy, less common in the US, perhaps, is the imperial swagger, the sheer frivolous entitlement accompanying a crowd that has seemingly been given the keys to the kingdom.
tgt_seg: 这里是美国，阶级象征与英国略有不同。但在大多数方面，埃隆·马斯克为他的成本削减特别小组——政府效率部（Doge）——雇佣的这群年轻人，对于任何经历过鲍里斯·约翰逊武器级轻率时代或戴维·卡梅伦年轻时胡闹的人来说，都不会感到陌生。（唐纳德·特朗普当然也非常轻率，但他的风格更偏向于更衣室，而不是辩论室——或者，在这个例子中，不是数学奥林匹克。）虽然政治总是依靠年轻人和志愿者的活力来运转，但在美国，或许不太常见的是帝国式的傲慢，那种伴随着一群似乎被赋予了王国钥匙的人群的纯粹轻浮的权利。

src_seg: Let's look at the lineup. The youngest of Musk's Doge hires, Edward Coristine - online username, Big Balls - is a 19-year-old former intern at Neuralink, Musk's neurotechnology company, who until recently appeared to be a first-year student at Northeastern University in Boston. Luke Farritor is a 23-year-old former SpaceX intern. Marko Elez, 25, used to work for X and SpaceX, and was revealed by the Wall Street Journal to have authored several since-removed tweets asserting, among other things, "You could not pay me to marry outside of my ethnicity." (Elez briefly resigned before Musk announced he'd reinstate him.)
tgt_seg: 让我们来看看阵容。马斯克聘请的最年轻的“总督”爱德华·科里斯汀（Edward Coristine），网名“大球”（Big Balls），19岁，曾在马斯克的神经科技公司Neuralink实习，直到最近才被外界看成是波士顿东北大学的一名一年级学生。卢克·法里托（Luke Farritor）23岁，曾是SpaceX的实习生。25岁的马尔科·埃莱兹（Marko Elez）曾在X和SpaceX工作，据《华尔街日报》透露，他曾发布过几条现已被删除的推文，其中包括“你不能付钱让我与不同种族的人结婚。”（埃莱兹曾短暂辞职，之后马斯克宣布将恢复他的职位。）

src_seg: And Gavin Kliger, a 25-year-old who boosted a post on X by the white supremacist Nick Fuentes, and whose newly launched Substack this week highlighted the perils of skipping freshman English 101 with a post entitled "Why DOGE: Why I gave up a seven-figure salary to save America."
tgt_seg: 25 岁的加文·克里格 (Gavin Kliger) 在 X 上转发了白人至上主义者尼克·富恩特斯 (Nick Fuentes) 的一篇文章，本周他新推出的 Substack 发表了一篇题为“为什么是 DOGE：为什么我放弃七位数的薪水来拯救美国”的文章，强调了跳过大一英语 101 课程的危险性。

src_seg: Between them, these men have gained access to federal premises and staffing systems that govern agencies including USAid, the Department of Health and Human Services, the education and energy departments, and the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, and contain sensitive information relating to millions of Americans. Elez was, reportedly, erroneously given overwrite access to the Treasury department's payment system before it was yanked back to read-only.
tgt_seg: 这些人窃取了联邦政府办公场所和人事系统的访问权限，这些系统管理着包括美国国际开发署、卫生与公众服务部、教育和能源部以及医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心在内的多个机构，其中包含数百万美国人的敏感信息。据报道，埃莱兹曾被错误地授予财政部支付系统的覆盖权限，但后来被恢复为只读权限。

src_seg: Of course, given that Doge has not responded to questions about what, if any, security clearance these young men have gone through, read-only is bad enough. I look forward to watching as Big Balls and co find new ways to tank an economy even more efficiently and irreversibly than Brexit.
tgt_seg: 无论如何,我们都知道这一切的结局. 在最大意义上,取消了国会民主授权的一些未经选举的,穿着气球背心的暴徒在国会中授权的计划. 在最小意义上,其中一个22岁的混蛋在财政部的键盘上倒了他的"大饮酒杯"山露水,并擦除了7000万美国人的社会保障数据. 我期待着看到大球和同事们找到新的方式来加油经济,甚至比英国脱欧更有效和不可逆转.

src_seg: If you thought Elon Musk was bad, look at his dreadful mini-mes and shudder for America
tgt_seg: 如果你认为埃隆·马斯克已经够糟糕了，那就看看他的这些小跟班，为美国的未来感到担忧吧。

src_seg: You would be forgiven for thinking we were back at the Bullingdon Club, in the company of Jonty, Munty, Stiffy, Kipper, Chugger and, to use the polite version, Pig Botherer - only in this case it's Big Balls and a guy with a history of racist tweeting. This is the sudden, startling emergence into American political life of a type deeply recognisable to Brits: that is, jaunty young men with juvenile nicknames and a firm belief they should be running the world.
tgt_seg: 你可能会觉得我们回到了布林顿俱乐部，和琼蒂、蒙蒂、斯蒂菲、基珀、楚格以及（用委婉的说法）“扰乱猪”在一起——只不过这次是“大球”和一位有种族歧视推文历史的人。这是美国政治生活中一种类型突然、惊人的涌现，这种类型对英国人来说非常熟悉：那就是，那些拥有稚嫩绰号和坚信自己应该掌控世界的年轻男子。

src_seg: This being America, the class signifiers are slightly different from those in Britain. But in most regards, the cohort of young men hired by Elon Musk for his cost-cutting taskforce, the department of government efficiency (Doge), will be familiar to anyone who lived through the era of Boris Johnson's weapons-grade flippancy or reports of David Cameron's youthful hijinks. (Donald Trump is very flippant, of course, but his style skews locker room rather than debate chamber - or, in this case, maths olympiad.) And while politics has always run on young, volunteer energy, less common in the US, perhaps, is the imperial swagger, the sheer frivolous entitlement accompanying a crowd that has seemingly been given the keys to the kingdom.
tgt_seg: 当然，在美国，阶级标志与英国略有不同。但在大多数方面，埃隆·马斯克为削减成本而雇佣的这个年轻男子团队，即政府效率部门（Doge），将让任何经历过鲍里斯·约翰逊的“武器级轻率”或戴维·卡梅伦的青春恶作剧报告的人都感到熟悉。（唐纳德·特朗普当然也很轻率，但他的风格更偏向于更衣室而非辩论厅——或者，就目前而言，数学竞赛。）虽然政治一直依赖于年轻人的志愿热情，但在美国，也许不太常见的是，一种傲慢的姿态，一种伴随着一群人出现的挥霍无度的特权感，他们似乎被授予了王国的大门钥匙。

src_seg: Let's look at the lineup. The youngest of Musk's Doge hires, Edward Coristine - online username, Big Balls - is a 19-year-old former intern at Neuralink, Musk's neurotechnology company, who until recently appeared to be a first-year student at Northeastern University in Boston. Luke Farritor is a 23-year-old former SpaceX intern. Marko Elez, 25, used to work for X and SpaceX, and was revealed by the Wall Street Journal to have authored several since-removed tweets asserting, among other things, "You could not pay me to marry outside of my ethnicity." (Elez briefly resigned before Musk announced he'd reinstate him.)
tgt_seg: 让我们看看这个阵容。马斯克旗下Doge团队中最年轻的一位，爱德华·科里斯廷——在线用户名“大球”——是一位19岁的神经链接公司（Neuralink）的前实习生，直到最近似乎是波士顿东北大学的一名大一学生。卢克·法里托是一位23岁的原SpaceX实习生。马科·埃莱兹，25岁，曾为X和SpaceX工作，据《华尔街日报》报道，他撰写了多条后来被删除的推文，其中声称“我不会为了娶非我族群的人而花钱”。（埃莱兹在马斯克宣布恢复他的职位之前，短暂辞职。）

src_seg: And Gavin Kliger, a 25-year-old who boosted a post on X by the white supremacist Nick Fuentes, and whose newly launched Substack this week highlighted the perils of skipping freshman English 101 with a post entitled "Why DOGE: Why I gave up a seven-figure salary to save America."
tgt_seg: 而加文·克利格，一位25岁的年轻人，在X上推广了白人至上主义者尼克·弗恩特的帖子，他本周刚刚推出的Substack以一篇题为“为什么是Doge：我为什么放弃了七位数的年薪来拯救美国”的文章，强调了跳过大学一年级英语课程的危险。

src_seg: Between them, these men have gained access to federal premises and staffing systems that govern agencies including USAid, the Department of Health and Human Services, the education and energy departments, and the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, and contain sensitive information relating to millions of Americans. Elez was, reportedly, erroneously given overwrite access to the Treasury department's payment system before it was yanked back to read-only.
tgt_seg: 这些人共同获得了访问联邦场所和管理机构人员系统的权限，这些机构包括USAid、卫生及公共服务部、教育和能源部以及医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心，并包含有关数百万美国人的敏感信息。据报道，埃莱兹最初被错误地授予了对财政部支付系统的写入权限，后来又被降级为只读权限。

src_seg: Of course, given that Doge has not responded to questions about what, if any, security clearance these young men have gone through, read-only is bad enough. The head of Doge, hiring in his own image, has turned to young, male software engineers with startup energy and the conviction that if you understand coding, you understand life. They've established sleeping pods in spare offices at the federal agencies they have been engaged to gut or dismantle, so that while Musk goes on X to mock federal employees for not working at weekends, his mini-mes work round the clock.
tgt_seg: 当然，考虑到Doge尚未对这些年轻人是否接受过任何安全审查做出回应，只读权限已经够糟糕了。Doge负责人，以自己的形象招聘人员，转向了拥有创业精神和坚信如果理解编码，就理解人生的年轻软件工程师。他们已经在联邦机构的空闲办公室里设置了睡眠舱，以便在马斯克在X上嘲笑联邦雇员周末不工作时，他的小跟班们可以日夜工作。

src_seg: This feat would be more impressive if their online remarks and bios didn't flag what might diplomatically be called large gaps in their skill-sets. Musk, a man with the emotional maturity of a cartoon bank robber, is leading a group of men most of whom have no government or management experience whatsoever, let alone expertise in fields governed by the agencies they have been tasked to reform. The whole scene is reminiscent of the 90s boom in management consultancy, during which new graduates stared with frank disbelief at anyone who was over 35 and still breathing. And sure enough, as reported in the New York Times, young engineers have been overheard referring to federal employees as "dinosaurs," who have in turn called the guys in baseball caps "Muskrats."
tgt_seg: 如果他们的在线评论和简历没有暴露出可能被外交地称为技能方面的巨大差距，那么这项成就将更令人印象深刻。马斯克，一位情感成熟度如同卡通银行抢劫犯的人，正带领着一群大多数没有政府或管理经验的人，更不用说由他们受托改革的机构所管辖领域的专业知识了。整个场景让人联想到90年代管理咨询业的繁荣时期，当时的新毕业生带着坦率的难以置信的表情看着任何年龄超过35岁且还活着的人。果然，正如《纽约时报》报道的那样，年轻工程师们被听到称联邦雇员为“恐龙”，而联邦雇员则称这些戴棒球帽的人为“麝鼠”。

src_seg: On X, meanwhile, Musk amplified a post pitching "autistic tech bros" against "non-binary Deep State theater kids," and another that said what's happening in the US right now is equivalent to "the yearbook committe and theater kid types getting rocked by a football team and chess club alliance." Theatre kids and chess nerds are, traditionally, both categories of social death in high school that are targeted by queen bees and jocks, a case of Musk siding with the oppressor that's even sadder when you consider that Trump isn't even a real jock. (For a full account of Trump's hilariously mediocre sports career relative to his claims about it, read Lucky Loser by Russ Buettner and Susanne Craig.)
tgt_seg: 与此同时，马斯克在X上推广了一篇帖子，将“自闭症科技极客”与“非二元深层政府剧院孩子”对立，以及另一篇帖子称目前美国发生的事情相当于“年鉴委员会和剧院孩子类型被足球队和国际象棋俱乐部联盟击败”。剧院孩子和国际象棋极客传统上都是高中中被蜂后和运动健将针对的社会死亡类别，马斯克站在压迫者一边，这更令人悲伤，因为考虑到特朗普甚至不是一个真正的运动健将。（要了解有关特朗普与他所声称的运动生涯之间滑稽的平庸程度的详细介绍，请阅读拉塞尔·布特纳和苏珊·克雷格的《幸运输家》。）

And in the smallest sense, with one of these 22-year-old jerks spilling his Big Gulp cup of Mountain Dew over a keyboard at the Treasury and wiping the social security data of 70 million Americans. I look forward to watching as Big Balls and co find new ways to tank an economy even more efficiently and irreversibly than Brexit.
tgt_seg: 总之，我们知道事情会如何结束。从广义上讲，是联邦国会通过一群没有选举权的人在充气背心里颁布的计划被取消。从细微之处来看，就是其中一位22岁的混蛋在财政部的“大杯”山露水（Mountain Dew）上打翻了键盘，并擦掉了7000万美国人的社会保障数据。我期待着看到“大球”和他的同伙以比英国脱欧更有效率和不可逆转的方式找到新的方法来破坏经济。

tgt_seg: 你完全可能误以为我们又回到了布灵顿俱乐部，身边环绕着琼蒂、蒙蒂、斯蒂菲、基珀、查格，以及用礼貌说法称呼的"猪猡骚扰者"——只不过这次的主角换成了"大蛋蛋"和一位有种族主义推文历史的家伙。这群突然闯入美国政坛的年轻人，会让英国人感到异常熟悉：他们顶着幼稚的绰号，迈着轻浮的步伐，却坚信自己理当统治世界。

src_seg: This being America, the class signifiers are slightly different from those in Britain. But in most regards, the cohort of young men hired by Elon Musk for his cost-cutting taskforce, the department of government efficiency (Doge), will be familiar to anyone who lived through the era of Boris Johnson's weapons-grade flippancy or reports of David Cameron's youthful hijinks. (Donald Trump is very flippant, of course, but his style skews locker room rather than debate chamber - or, in this case, maths olympiad.) And while politics has always run on young, volunteer energy, less common in the US, perhaps, is the imperial swagger, the sheer frivolous entitlement accompanying a crowd that has seemingly been given the keys to the kingdom.
tgt_seg: 在美国，阶级标识或许与英国略有不同。但马斯克为"政府效能优化部"（Doge）招募的这支削减成本特遣队，其成员特质足以让任何经历过鲍里斯·约翰逊式"武器级轻浮"或大卫·卡梅伦青年荒唐往事的人会心一笑。（特朗普当然也极度轻浮，但他的风格更衣室气息浓厚，而非议会辩论场——或者说，数学奥林匹克竞赛现场。）尽管政治向来依赖年轻志愿者的活力，但像这样带着帝国式傲慢、手握重权却轻佻任性的群体，在美国政坛仍属罕见。

src_seg: Let's look at the lineup. The youngest of Musk's Doge hires, Edward Coristine - online username, Big Balls - is a 19-year-old former intern at Neuralink, Musk's neurotechnology company, who until recently appeared to be a first-year student at Northeastern University in Boston. Luke Farritor is a 23-year-old former SpaceX intern. Marko Elez, 25, used to work for X and SpaceX, and was revealed by the Wall Street Journal to have authored several since-removed tweets asserting, among other things, "You could not pay me to marry outside of my ethnicity." (Elez briefly resigned before Musk announced he'd reinstate him.)
tgt_seg: 来看看这支队伍吧。最年轻的成员爱德华·科里斯汀——网名"大蛋蛋"——是马斯克神经科技公司Neuralink的19岁前实习生，直到不久前还是波士顿东北大学新生。23岁的卢克·法里托曾效力SpaceX。25岁的马可·埃莱兹先后供职于X公司和SpaceX，《华尔街日报》披露他发表过"倒贴钱我也不跨族通婚"等已被删除的推文（他短暂辞职后，马斯克宣布将恢复其职位）。

src_seg: And Gavin Kliger, a 25-year-old who boosted a post on X by the white supremacist Nick Fuentes, and whose newly launched Substack this week highlighted the perils of skipping freshman English 101 with a post entitled "Why DOGE: Why I gave up a seven-figure salary to save America."
tgt_seg: 还有25岁的加文·克里格，他转发过白人至上主义者尼克·富恩特斯的帖子，其新开设的Substack专栏本周以《为何选择Doge：我为何放弃七位数年薪拯救美国》为题，生动诠释了逃掉大学英语101课程的后果。

src_seg: Between them, these men have gained access to federal premises and staffing systems that govern agencies including USAid, the Department of Health and Human Services, the education and energy departments, and the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, and contain sensitive information relating to millions of Americans. Elez was, reportedly, erroneously given overwrite access to the Treasury department's payment system before it was yanked back to read-only.
tgt_seg: 这群人已获得进入联邦机构的权限，可接触卫生与公众服务部、教育部、能源部、医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心等部门的员工系统，其中包含数百万美国公民的敏感信息。据报道，埃莱兹甚至一度被错误授予财政部支付系统的改写权限，后紧急降级为只读。

src_seg: Of course, given that Doge has not responded to questions about what, if any, security clearance these young men have gone through, read-only is bad enough. The head of Doge, hiring in his own image, has turned to young, male software engineers with startup energy and the conviction that if you understand coding, you understand life. They've established sleeping pods in spare offices at the federal agencies they have been engaged to gut or dismantle, so that while Musk goes on X to mock federal employees for not working at weekends, his mini-mes work round the clock.
tgt_seg: 鉴于Doge部门拒绝说明这些年轻人是否通过安全审查，"只读权限"已足够骇人。这个由马斯克按自身形象打造的团队，清一色招募信奉"懂代码即懂人生"的男性软件工程师。他们在奉命裁撤的联邦机构闲置办公室搭起睡眠舱，当马斯克在X平台上嘲讽公务员周末不加班时，他的分身们正昼夜不休地工作。

src_seg: This feat would be more impressive if their online remarks and bios didn't flag what might diplomatically be called large gaps in their skill-sets. Musk, a man with the emotional maturity of a cartoon bank robber, is leading a group of men most of whom have no government or management experience whatsoever, let alone expertise in fields governed by the agencies they have been tasked to reform. The whole scene is reminiscent of the 90s boom in management consultancy, during which new graduates stared with frank disbelief at anyone who was over 35 and still breathing. And sure enough, as reported in the New York Times, young engineers have been overheard referring to federal employees as "dinosaurs," who have in turn called the guys in baseball caps "Muskrats."
tgt_seg: 若没有其网络言论暴露的能力缺陷，这番"壮举"或许更令人钦佩。情绪管理堪比卡通银行劫匪的马斯克，带领着绝大多数毫无政府管理经验的团队，对奉命改革的领域更是一窍不通。这让人想起90年代管理咨询业黄金期——应届毕业生曾以赤裸的怀疑目光打量35岁以上喘气的生物。果然，《纽约时报》报道称，年轻工程师公然将公务员称为"恐龙"，后者则回敬这些棒球帽小子为"马斯克鼠"。

src_seg: On X, meanwhile, Musk amplified a post pitching "autistic tech bros" against "non-binary Deep State theater kids," and another that said what's happening in the US right now is equivalent to "the yearbook committe and theater kid types getting rocked by a football team and chess club alliance." Theatre kids and chess nerds are, traditionally, both categories of social death in high school that are targeted by queen bees and jocks, a case of Musk siding with the oppressor that's even sadder when you consider that Trump isn't even a real jock. (For a full account of Trump's hilariously mediocre sports career relative to his claims about it, read Lucky Loser by Russ Buettner and Susanne Craig.)
tgt_seg: 与此同时，马斯克在X平台转发帖子，将"自闭症科技宅"与"非二元深暗势力戏剧咖"对立，另一则贴文则将美国现状比喻为"年鉴委员会和戏剧社被橄榄球队与国际象棋社联盟碾压"。戏剧社成员和象棋书呆子传统上同属高中社交链底端，常遭校园女王和运动健将霸凌——马斯克选择与压迫者站队显得尤为可悲，毕竟特朗普连真运动员都算不上（欲知特朗普吹嘘与真实体育生涯的滑稽差距，详见拉斯·比特纳与苏珊娜·克雷格的《幸运输家》）。

src_seg: Anyway, we know how this ends. In the largest sense, with the cancellation of programmes mandated democratically in Congress by a bunch of unelected goons in puffer vests. And in the smallest sense, with one of these 22-year-old jerks spilling his Big Gulp cup of Mountain Dew over a keyboard at the Treasury and wiping the social security data of 70 million Americans. I look forward to watching as Big Balls and co find new ways to tank an economy even more efficiently and irreversibly than Brexit.
tgt_seg: 无论如何，结局早已注定。宏观而言，一群穿着羽绒背心的非民选打手将废除国会立法通过的项目；微观来看，某个22岁蠢货会把激浪饮料泼洒在财政部键盘上，抹去七千万美国人的社保数据。且看"大蛋蛋"们如何以比英国脱欧更高效、更不可逆的方式摧毁经济吧，这场好戏值得期待。

src_seg: And Gavin Kliger, a 25-year-old who boosted a post on X by the white supremacist Nick Fuentes, and whose newly launched Substack this week highlighted the perils of skipping freshman English 101 with a post entitled "Why DOGE: Why I gave up a seven-figure salary to save America."
tgt_seg: 还有25岁的加文·克里格，他曾在X上转发了白人至上主义者尼克·富恩特斯的帖子，他本周新开的Substack博客发表了一篇题为《为何选择DOGE：我为何放弃七位数薪水来拯救美国》的文章，凸显了不上大一英语基础课的风险。

src_seg: Between them, these men have gained access to federal premises and staffing systems that govern agencies including USAid, the Department of Health and Human Services, the education and energy departments, and the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, and contain sensitive information relating to millions of Americans. Elez was, reportedly, erroneously given overwrite access to the Treasury department's payment system before it was yanked back to read-only.
tgt_seg: 这些人合在一起，已经获得了进入联邦办公场所和人事系统的权限，这些系统管理着包括美国国际开发署、卫生与公众服务部、教育部、能源部以及医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心在内的多个机构，并包含数百万美国人的敏感信息。据报道，埃莱兹曾被错误地授予了财政部支付系统的覆写权限，之后该权限才被撤回，降为只读。

src_seg: Of course, given that Doge has not responded to questions about what, if any, security clearance these young men have gone through, read-only is bad enough. The head of Doge, hiring in his own image, has turned to young, male software engineers with startup energy and the conviction that if you understand coding, you understand life. They've established sleeping pods in spare offices at the federal agencies they have been engaged to gut or dismantle, so that while Musk goes on X to mock federal employees for not working at weekends, his mini-mes work round the clock.
tgt_seg: 当然，鉴于Doge部门尚未回应这些年轻人是否经过了任何安全审查的问题，即便只是只读权限也足够糟糕了。Doge的负责人正按照自己的形象招兵买马，他求助于年轻的男性软件工程师，这些人带着创业公司的活力，并坚信只要你懂编程，你就懂生活。他们在受命进行裁撤或解散的联邦机构的空余办公室里设置了睡眠舱，这样，当马斯克在X上嘲笑联邦雇员周末不工作时，他的“迷你版”们可以夜以继日地工作。

src_seg: This feat would be more impressive if their online remarks and bios didn't flag what might diplomatically be called large gaps in their skill-sets. Musk, a man with the emotional maturity of a cartoon bank robber, is leading a group of men most of whom have no government or management experience whatsoever, let alone expertise in fields governed by the agencies they have been tasked to reform. The whole scene is reminiscent of the 90s boom in management consultancy, during which new graduates stared with frank disbelief at anyone who was over 35 and still breathing. And sure enough, as reported in the New York Times, young engineers have been overheard referring to federal employees as "dinosaurs," who have in turn called the guys in baseball caps "Muskrats."
tgt_seg: 如果他们的在线言论和个人简介没有暴露出其技能组合中（说得委婉些）存在的巨大差距，这一“壮举”或许会更令人印象深刻。马斯克，一个情商堪比卡通片里银行劫匪的男人，正领导着一群绝大多数没有任何政府或管理经验的人，更不用说在他们受命改革的机构所管辖领域里的专业知识了。整个场景让人想起90年代管理咨询业的繁荣期，当时刚毕业的大学生们对任何超过35岁还活着的人都投以坦率的怀疑目光。果不其然，正如《纽约时报》报道的那样，有人听到年轻的工程师们称联邦雇员为“恐龙”，而联邦雇员们则反过来称这些戴棒球帽的家伙为“马斯克鼠”。

src_seg: On X, meanwhile, Musk amplified a post pitching "autistic tech bros" against "non-binary Deep State theater kids," and another that said what's happening in the US right now is equivalent to "the yearbook committe and theater kid types getting rocked by a football team and chess club alliance." Theatre kids and chess nerds are, traditionally, both categories of social death in high school that are targeted by queen bees and jocks, a case of Musk siding with the oppressor that's even sadder when you consider that Trump isn't even a real jock. (For a full account of Trump's hilariously mediocre sports career relative to his claims about it, read Lucky Loser by Russ Buettner and Susanne Craig.)

src_seg: Anyway, we know how this ends. In the largest sense, with the cancellation of programmes mandated democratically in Congress by a bunch of unelected goons in puffer vests. tgt_seg: 当然，由于Doge没有回答有关这些年轻人是否经过安全检查的问题时，只读权限也是不妙的。Doge的负责人，以自己的形象雇佣人员，转向了年轻、男性软件工程师，他们拥有创业精神，并且认为如果你理解编程，那么你就理解生命。他们在被委托去剥夺或拆除的联邦机构的空闲办公室里建立了睡觉的床位，这样当Musk在X上嘲笑联邦员工因为没有在周末工作时，他们的小伙伴就在24小时不断工作。

src_seg: This feat would be more impressive if their online remarks and bios didn't flag what might diplomatically be called large gaps in their skill-sets. Musk, a man with the emotional maturity of a cartoon bank robber, is leading a group of men most of whom have no government or management experience whatsoever, let alone expertise in fields governed by the agencies they have been tasked to reform. The whole scene is reminiscent of the 90s boom in management consultancy, during which new graduates stared with frank disbelief at anyone who was over 35 and still breathing. And sure enough, as reported in the New York Times, young engineers have been overheard referring to federal employees as "dinosaurs," who have in turn called the guys in baseball caps "Muskrats."
tgt_seg: 这一点如果他们在线的评论和简介没有掩饰的话，就会更加印象深刻。Musk，一个有儿童银行偷窃的情绪的男人，正在领导一个没有政府或管理经验的一支男孩，甚至没有管理这些机构所管理的领域的专业知识。整个场景与90年代的管理咨询行业的蓬勃发展有些相似，在那个时期，新毕业生面对面看着35岁以上还在呼吸的人，并且确实感到惊讶。而且，据新约翰斯时报报道，年轻的软件工程师在联邦机构里已经被听到称呼联邦员工为“恐怖动物”，而联邦员工又称呼他们为“Muskrats”。

src_seg: On X, meanwhile, Musk amplified a post pitching "autistic tech bros" against "non-binary Deep State theater kids," and another that said what's happening in the US right now is equivalent to "the yearbook committe and theater kid types getting rocked by a football team and chess club alliance." Theatre kids and chess nerds are, traditionally, both categories of social death in high school that are targeted by queen bees and jocks, a case of Musk siding with the oppressor that's even sadder when you consider that Trump isn't even a real jock. (For a full account of Trump's hilariously mediocre sports career relative to his claims about it, read Lucky Loser by Russ Buettner and Susanne Craig.)
tgt_seg: 在X上，Musk则是扩大了一篇文章，推广“autistic tech bros”和“非二元Deep State theater kids”之间的斗争，还有一篇文章说，美国当前正在经历“学生委员会和剧院孩子类型被撞上了足球队和棋队联盟”。剧院孩子和棋子都是高中中等阶层的社会死亡类别，被女王蜜蜂和俄亥俄欺负的情况，Musk的选择更加可惜，因为特朗普实际上不是一个真正的俄亥俄。（对于特朗普的惊人中庸的运动新闻，可以阅读Lucky Loser的Russ Buettner和Susanne Craig。）

src_seg: Anyway, we know how this ends. In the largest sense, with the cancellation of programmes mandated democratically in Congress by a bunch of unelected goons in puffer vests. And in the smallest sense, with one of these 22-year-old jerks spilling his Big Gulp cup of Mountain Dew over a keyboard at the Treasury and wiping the social security data of 70 million Americans. I look forward to watching as Big Balls and co find new ways to tank an economy even more efficiently and irreversibly than Brexit.
tgt_seg: 当然，我们知道这一切会如何结束。在最大的意义上，是由一群没有在国会通过的程序中取消的法律导致的。在最小的意义上，是一个这些22岁的废物洒了一杯大杯Mountain Dew泼在了财政部的键盘，并且擦掉了7000万美国人的社会保险数据。我很期待看看Big Balls和他们的新方法，更有效地破坏经济，比Brexit更不可逆。

src_seg: You would be forgiven for thinking we were back at the Bullingdon Club, in the company of Jonty, Munty, Stiffy, Kipper, Chugger and, to use the polite version, Pig Botherer - only in this case it's Big Balls and a guy with a history of racist tweeting. This is the sudden, startling emergence into American political life of a type deeply recognisable to Brits: that is, jaunty young men with juvenile nicknames and a firm belief they should be running the world.
tgt_seg: 你可能会误以为我们回到了牛岭顿俱乐部（Bullingdon Club），与乔恩蒂（Jonty）、蒙蒂（Munty）、斯蒂菲（Stiffy）、基珀（Kipper）、查格（Chugger）以及——用委婉的表达——“猪扰者”（Pig Botherer）为伍——只不过在这次情况下，是“大蛋”（Big Balls）和一个有种族主义推文历史的人。这种类型的人突然、惊人地出现在美国的政治生活中，对于英国人来说再熟悉不过：那就是，一群自以为是、有着幼稚昵称的年轻人，坚信自己应该统治世界。

src_seg: This being America, the class signifiers are slightly different from those in Britain. But in most regards, the cohort of young men hired by Elon Musk for his cost-cutting taskforce, the department of government efficiency (Doge), will be familiar to anyone who lived through the era of Boris Johnson's weapons-grade flippancy or reports of David Cameron's youthful hijinks. (Donald Trump is very flippant, of course, but his style skews locker room rather than debate chamber - or, in this case, maths olympiad.) src_seg: Anyway, we know how this ends. In the largest sense, with the cancellation of programmes mandated democratically in Congress by a bunch of unelected goons in puffer vests. And in the smallest sense, with one of these 22-year-old jerks spilling his Big Gulp cup of Mountain Dew over a keyboard at the Treasury and wiping the social security data of 70 million Americans.
