src_seg: If you thought Elon Musk was bad, look at his dreadful mini-mes and shudder for America
tgt_seg: 如果你以为埃隆·马斯克已经够糟糕了，看看他的这些小丑般的模仿者，为美国捏一把汗吧

src_seg: You would be forgiven for thinking we were back at the Bullingdon Club, in the company of Jonty, Munty, Stiffy, Kipper, Chugger and, to use the polite version, Pig Botherer - only in this case it's Big Balls and a guy with a history of racist tweeting. This is the sudden, startling emergence into American political life of a type deeply recognisable to Brits: that is, jaunty young men with juvenile nicknames and a firm belief they should be running the world.
tgt_seg: 你可能会以为我们又回到了博林顿俱乐部，与乔尼、蒙蒂、斯蒂菲、基珀、奇格和那个礼貌称呼为“猪骚扰者”的人在一起——只不过这次是“大睾丸”和一个有历史的种族主义推文记录者。这是一群突然出现在美国政治舞台上的年轻人，他们对英国人来说再熟悉不过了：那就是充满轻浮绰号的年轻男子，坚信自己应该掌管世界。

src_seg: This being America, the class signifiers are slightly different from those in Britain. But in most regards, the cohort of young men hired by Elon Musk for his cost-cutting taskforce, the department of government efficiency (Doge), will be familiar to anyone who lived through the era of Boris Johnson's weapons-grade flippancy or reports of David Cameron's youthful hijinks. (Donald Trump is very flippant, of course, but his style skews locker room rather than debate chamber - or, in this case, maths olympiad.) And while politics has always run on young, volunteer energy, less common in the US, perhaps, is the imperial swagger, the sheer frivolous entitlement accompanying a crowd that has seemingly been given the keys to the kingdom.
tgt_seg: 在美国，社会地位的标志与英国略有不同。但总的来说，埃隆·马斯克为他的成本削减工作组——政府效率部门（Doge）招聘的年轻人，会让任何经历过鲍里斯·约翰逊的武器级轻浮或戴维·卡梅伦年轻时的恶作剧报道的人感到熟悉。（当然，唐纳德·特朗普也很轻浮，但他的风格更偏向更衣室而非辩论室——或者在这种情况下，数学奥林匹克竞赛。）而尽管政治一直依赖于年轻、自愿的精力，但在美国，像这样帝国般的傲慢、一群似乎被赋予了王权的年轻人的无尽特权，却并不常见。

src_seg: Let's look at the lineup. The youngest of Musk's Doge hires, Edward Coristine - online username, Big Balls - is a 19-year-old former intern at Neuralink, Musk's neurotechnology company, who until recently appeared to be a first-year student at Northeastern University in Boston. Luke Farritor is a 23-year-old former SpaceX intern. Marko Elez, 25, used to work for X and SpaceX, and was revealed by the Wall Street Journal to have authored several since-removed tweets asserting, among other things, "You could not pay me to marry outside of my ethnicity." (Elez briefly resigned before Musk announced he'd reinstate him.)
tgt_seg: 让我们看看名单。马斯克Doge团队中最年轻的成员爱德华·科里斯廷，网名“大睾丸”，今年19岁，曾是马斯克神经技术公司Neuralink的实习生，直到最近似乎还在波士顿东北大学读大一。卢克·法里托是23岁的前SpaceX实习生。25岁的马科·伊莱兹曾为X和SpaceX工作，据《华尔街日报》报道，他撰写了多条后来被删除的推文，其中一条声称“你无法用金钱让我嫁给非我族类的人”。（伊莱兹短暂辞职后，马斯克宣布重新启用他。）

src_seg: And Gavin Kliger, a 25-year-old who boosted a post on X by the white supremacist Nick Fuentes, and whose newly launched Substack this week highlighted the perils of skipping freshman English 101 with a post entitled "Why DOGE: Why I gave up a seven-figure salary to save America."
tgt_seg: 还有25岁的加文·克莱格，他为白人至上主义者尼克·芬特斯的帖子进行了推广，本周新推出的Substack文章则警告跳过大一英语101课程的危险，标题为“为什么DOGE：为什么我放弃七位数的年薪来拯救美国”。

src_seg: Between them, these men have gained access to federal premises and staffing systems that govern agencies including USAid, the Department of Health and Human Services, the education and energy departments, and the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, and contain sensitive information relating to millions of Americans. Elez was, reportedly, erroneously given overwrite access to the Treasury department's payment system before it was yanked back to read-only.
tgt_seg: 他们三人之间获得了访问包括美国国际发展署、卫生与人类服务部、教育部、能源部和医疗保险与医疗补助服务中心在内的联邦机构的场所和人员系统权限，这些系统包含数百万美国人的敏感信息。据报道，伊莱兹曾被错误授予财政部支付系统的写入权限，后被撤回为只读权限。

src_seg: Of course, given that Doge has not responded to questions about what, if any, security clearance these young men have gone through, read-only is bad enough. The head of Doge, hiring in his own image, has turned to young, male software engineers with startup energy and the conviction that if you understand coding, you understand life. They've established sleeping pods in spare offices at the federal agencies they have been engaged to gut or dismantle, so that while Musk goes on X to mock federal employees for not working at weekends, his mini-mes work round the clock.
tgt_seg: 当然，鉴于Doge没有回应关于这些年轻人是否通过了任何安全审查的问题，只读权限已经很糟糕了。Doge的负责人，以自己的形象招聘，转向了年轻、有创业精神的软件工程师，他们坚信理解编程就理解了生活。他们在联邦机构中被雇佣来削减或拆解的空闲办公室里安放了休息舱，而当马斯克在X上嘲笑联邦员工周末不工作时，他的这些小丑般的模仿者却日夜不停地工作。

src_seg: This feat would be more impressive if their online remarks and bios didn't flag what might diplomatically be called large gaps in their skill-sets. Musk, a man with the emotional maturity of a cartoon bank robber, is leading a group of men most of whom have no government or management experience whatsoever, let alone expertise in fields governed by the agencies they have been tasked to reform. The whole scene is reminiscent of the 90s boom in management consultancy, during which new graduates stared with frank disbelief at anyone who was over 35 and still breathing. And sure enough, as reported in the New York Times, young engineers have been overheard referring to federal employees as "dinosaurs," who have in turn called the guys in baseball caps "Muskrats."

tgt_seg: 你可能会以为我们回到了牛津俱乐部，与乔蒂、芒蒂、斯蒂菲、基珀、查格和，用委婉的说法，那个“猪搅局者”为伍——只不过这次是“大睾丸”和一个有种族主义推文历史的人。这是突然、令人震惊的美国政治生活中的一种景象，对于英国人来说，这种景象是深有感知的：那就是那些精力充沛的年轻人，带着幼稚的昵称，并且坚信他们应该统治世界。

src_seg: This being America, the class signifiers are slightly different from those in Britain. But in most regards, the cohort of young men hired by Elon Musk for his cost-cutting taskforce, the department of government efficiency (Doge), will be familiar to anyone who lived through the era of Boris Johnson's weapons-grade flippancy or reports of David Cameron's youthful hijinks. (Donald Trump is very flippant, of course, but his style skews locker room rather than debate chamber - or, in this case, maths olympiad.) And while politics has always run on young, volunteer energy, less common in the US, perhaps, is the imperial swagger, the sheer frivolous entitlement accompanying a crowd that has seemingly been given the keys to the kingdom.
tgt_seg: 鉴于这是美国，阶级标志与英国略有不同。但在大多数方面，埃隆·马斯克为他的成本削减特别小组“政府效率部门”（Doge）雇佣的一批年轻人，对于经历过鲍里斯·约翰逊的粗俗无礼时代或大卫·卡梅伦年轻时的恶作剧报道的人来说，将会非常熟悉。（当然，唐纳德·特朗普也很粗俗，但他的风格更接近更衣室，而不是辩论厅——或者，在这种情况下，数学奥林匹克竞赛。）虽然政治一直以来都依靠年轻的志愿力量，但或许在美国不太常见的是那种帝国般的傲慢，那种伴随着一群似乎被给予了王国钥匙的人的纯粹的轻率特权。

src_seg: Let's look at the lineup. The youngest of Musk's Doge hires, Edward Coristine - online username, Big Balls - is a 19-year-old former intern at Neuralink, Musk's neurotechnology company, who until recently appeared to be a first-year student at Northeastern University in Boston. Luke Farritor is a 23-year-old former SpaceX intern. Marko Elez, 25, used to work for X and SpaceX, and was revealed by the Wall Street Journal to have authored several since-removed tweets asserting, among other things, "You could not pay me to marry outside of my ethnicity." (Elez briefly resigned before Musk announced he'd reinstate him.)
tgt_seg: 让我们看看这些人的阵容。马斯克Doge部门中最年轻的雇员，爱德华·科里斯坦——网名“大睾丸”——是一位19岁的Neuralink（马斯克的神经技术公司）前实习生，直到最近还是一名波士顿东北大学的一年级学生。卢克·法里托是一位23岁的SpaceX前实习生。马尔科·埃莱兹，25岁，曾为X和SpaceX工作，并被《华尔街日报》披露，他曾发表过几条已被删除的推文，其中声称“你无法付钱让我与我的种族之外的人结婚”。（埃莱兹曾短暂辞职，但在马斯克宣布将重新聘用他之前。）

src_seg: And Gavin Kliger, a 25-year-old who boosted a post on X by the white supremacist Nick Fuentes, and whose newly launched Substack this week highlighted the perils of skipping freshman English 101 with a post entitled "Why DOGE: Why I gave up a seven-figure salary to save America."
tgt_seg: 还有加文·克利格，一位25岁的人，他转发了白人至上主义者尼克·富恩特的帖子，他新推出的Substack本周强调了跳过大学英语101的危险，并发表了一篇题为“为什么Doge：为什么我放弃了七位数年薪来拯救美国”的文章。

src_seg: Between them, these men have gained access to federal premises and staffing systems that govern agencies including USAid, the Department of Health and Human Services, the education and energy departments, and the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, and contain sensitive information relating to millions of Americans. Elez was, reportedly, erroneously given overwrite access to the Treasury department's payment system before it was yanked back to read-only.
tgt_seg: 他们共同获得了对联邦机构和人员编制系统的访问权限，这些机构和系统管理着包括USAid、卫生与公众服务部、教育和能源部门以及医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心等机构，并包含与数百万美国人相关的高度敏感信息。据报道，埃莱兹错误地获得了对财政部支付系统的覆盖访问权限，但在被撤销之前。

src_seg: Of course, given that Doge has not responded to questions about what, if any, security clearance these young men have gone through, read-only is bad enough. The head of Doge, hiring in his own image, has turned to young, male software engineers with startup energy and the conviction that if you understand coding, you understand life. They've established sleeping pods in spare offices at the federal agencies they have been engaged to gut or dismantle, so that while Musk goes on X to mock federal employees for not working at weekends, his mini-mes work round the clock.
tgt_seg: 当然，鉴于Doge部门没有回应关于这些年轻人是否经过任何安全审查的问题，只读权限已经足够糟糕。Doge部门的负责人，以自己的形象进行招聘，转向了年轻的男性软件工程师，他们拥有创业精神，并且坚信如果你理解编码，你就能理解生活。他们在联邦机构的空闲办公室里建立了睡眠舱，以便在马斯克在X上嘲笑联邦雇员周末不工作时，他的“小马斯克”们可以全天候工作。

src_seg: This feat would be more impressive if their online remarks and bios didn't flag what might diplomatically be called large gaps in their skill-sets. Musk, a man with the emotional maturity of a cartoon bank robber, is leading a group of men most of whom have no government or management experience whatsoever, let alone expertise in fields governed by the agencies they have been tasked to reform. The whole scene is reminiscent of the 90s boom in management consultancy, during which new graduates stared with frank disbelief at anyone who was over 35 and still breathing. And sure enough, as reported in the New York Times, young engineers have been overheard referring to federal employees as "dinosaurs," who have in turn called the guys in baseball caps "Muskrats."
tgt_seg: 如果他们的在线言论和个人简介没有暴露他们技能方面可能存在的外交性说法的巨大差距，那么这项壮举会更令人印象深刻。马斯克，一个情商如同卡通银行抢劫犯的人，正在领导一群大多数人没有任何政府或管理经验，更不用说在他们被要求改革的机构所管辖的领域拥有专业知识的人。整个场景让人想起90年代管理咨询行业的繁荣，当时新毕业生带着坦率的难以置信的目光看着任何35岁以上仍然活着的人。正如《纽约时报》报道的那样，年轻的工程师们被听到称联邦雇员为“恐龙”，而后者则称戴棒球帽的家伙为“马斯克鼠”。

src_seg: On X, meanwhile, Musk amplified a post pitching "autistic tech bros" against "non-binary Deep State theater kids," and another that said what's happening in the US right now is equivalent to "the yearbook committe and theater kid types getting rocked by a football team and chess club alliance." Theatre kids and chess nerds are, traditionally, both categories of social death in high school that are targeted by queen bees and jocks, a case of Musk siding with the oppressor that's even sadder when you consider that Trump isn't even a real jock. (For a full account of Trump's hilariously mediocre sports career relative to his claims about it, read Lucky Loser by Russ Buettner and Susanne Craig.)
tgt_seg: 与此同时，在X上，马斯克转发了一篇帖子，将“自闭症技术宅”与“非二元性别深层政府戏剧儿童”对立起来，另一篇帖子称现在美国发生的事情相当于“啦啦队和戏剧社的孩子被一个足球队和象棋俱乐部联盟击败”。戏剧社的孩子和象棋迷传统上都是高中里两种容易受到欺凌的社交死亡类别，而马斯克选择站在压迫者一边，考虑到特朗普甚至不是一个真正的运动员，这更令人悲伤。（要了解特朗普的运动生涯与他所声称的有多么荒谬，请阅读Russ Buettner和Susanne Craig的《幸运失败者》。）

src_seg: Anyway, we know how this ends. In the largest sense, with the cancellation of programmes mandated democratically in Congress by a bunch of unelected goons in puffer vests. And in the smallest sense, with one of these 22-year-old jerks spilling his Big Gulp cup of Mountain Dew over a keyboard at the Treasury and wiping the social security data of 70 million Americans. I look forward to watching as Big Balls and co find new ways to tank an economy even more efficiently and irreversibly than Brexit.
tgt_seg: 无论如何，我们知道结局会怎样。从最大的意义上来说，就是由一群未经选举的穿着羽绒服的混混取消国会民主授权的项目。从最小的意义上来说，就是这些22岁的混蛋把他们的大杯山露水洒在财政部的键盘上，并抹去了7000万美国人的社会保障数据。我期待着看到“大睾丸”等人如何更有效、更不可逆转地摧毁经济，甚至比英国脱欧还要糟糕。

src_seg: Between them, these men have gained access to federal premises and staffing systems that govern agencies including USAid, the Department of Health and Human Services, the education and energy departments, and the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, and contain sensitive information relating to millions of Americans. tgt_seg: 这些人共同获得了对包括美国国际开发署、卫生与公共服务部、教育和能源部以及医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心在内的联邦机构的办公场所和人员系统的访问权限，这些机构包含了数百万美国人的敏感信息。据报道，埃莱斯被错误地赋予了财政部支付系统的覆盖权限，然后被撤回到只读权限。

src_seg: Of course, given that Doge has not responded to questions about what, if any, security clearance these young men have gone through, read-only is bad enough. src_seg: This feat would be more impressive if their online remarks and bios didn't flag what might diplomatically be called large gaps in their skill-sets. And sure enough, as reported in the New York Times, young engineers have been overheard referring to federal employees as "dinosaurs," who have in turn called the guys in baseball caps "Muskrats."
tgt_seg: 这个成就如果他们的在线言论和个人资料没有显示出可以外交上称为技能缺口的明显差距，就会更加令人印象深刻。马斯克，一个情商与卡通银行劫匪相当的男人，正在领导一群大多数没有政府或管理经验的人，更不用说对他们被赋予改革的机构领域的专业知识了。整个场景让人想起了90年代管理咨询的繁荣时期，当时刚毕业的大学生对任何超过35岁还在呼吸的人都充满了坦率的怀疑。而且，正如《纽约时报》报道的那样，年轻的工程师们确实听到过联邦雇员被称为“恐龙”，而这些恐龙则称戴着棒球帽的年轻人为“水獭”。

src_seg: On X, meanwhile, Musk amplified a post pitching "autistic tech bros" against "non-binary Deep State theater kids," and another that said what's happening in the US right now is equivalent to "the yearbook committe and theater kid types getting rocked by a football team and chess club alliance." tgt_seg: 据报道，这两名男子互相帮助，最终成功侵入美国国际开发署、卫生及公共服务部、教育和能源部以及医疗保险与医疗补助服务中心等联邦单位的办公场所和人员管理系统，从而获得了数百万美国人的敏感信息。据报道，埃雷兹（Elez）被错误地授予对财政部支付系统进行修改的权限，但后来被降级为只读权限。

src_seg: Of course, given that Doge has not responded to questions about what, if any, security clearance these young men have gone through, read-only is bad enough. The head of Doge, hiring in his own image, has turned to young, male software engineers with startup energy and the conviction that if you understand coding, you understand life. They've established sleeping pods in spare offices at the federal agencies they have been engaged to gut or dismantle, so that while Musk goes on X to mock federal employees for not working at weekends, his mini-mes work round the clock.
tgt_seg: 当然，既然 Doge 没有回答过关于这些年轻人是否通过了安全审查的问题，那么即使是只允许读取权限，这已经足够糟糕。Doge 的领导形象就是他自己，他向年轻的男性软件工程师伸出橄榄枝，这些工程师充满创业热情，并且相信只要懂编程，就等于懂得人生。他们在联邦机构的空置办公室里搭建了床铺，这些联邦机构正是 Doge 所聘请的团队要彻底清除和重组的。这样，当马斯克在 X 频道嘲笑联邦雇员周末不加班时，他的团队却在不停地加班加点工作。

src_seg: This feat would be more impressive if their online remarks and bios didn't flag what might diplomatically be called large gaps in their skill-sets. Musk, a man with the emotional maturity of a cartoon bank robber, is leading a group of men most of whom have no government or management experience whatsoever, let alone expertise in fields governed by the agencies they have been tasked to reform. The whole scene is reminiscent of the 90s boom in management consultancy, during which new graduates stared with frank disbelief at anyone who was over 35 and still breathing. And sure enough, as reported in the New York Times, young engineers have been overheard referring to federal employees as "dinosaurs," who have in turn called the guys in baseball caps "Muskrats."
tgt_seg: 如果不考虑在线评论和简历中明显存在的一些漏洞，马斯克的成就将更加令人印象深刻。马斯克在情感成熟度方面的表现，简直可与卡通版的银行劫匪相媲美，而且他领导的团队成员多是从政经验和管理经验皆为零的新人，更别提在改革职责范围内的行业领域有什么专长了。这一幕让人不禁想起 90 年代的管理咨询热潮，当时新毕业生们直呼年龄超过 35 岁却还在工作的老头是“傻逼”。事实上，据《纽约时报》报道，年轻工程师们之间私下还称联邦政府员工是“恐龙”，而这些人称年轻戴着棒球帽的团队成员是“小水獭”。

src_seg: On X, meanwhile, Musk amplified a post pitching "autistic tech bros" against "non-binary Deep State theater kids," and another that said what's happening in the US right now is equivalent to "the yearbook committe and theater kid types getting rocked by a football team and chess club alliance." Theatre kids and chess nerds are, traditionally, both categories of social death in high school that are targeted by queen bees and jocks, a case of Musk siding with the oppressor that's even sadder when you consider that Trump isn't even a real jock. (For a full account of Trump's hilariously mediocre sports career relative to his claims about it, read Lucky Loser by Russ Buettner and Susanne Craig.)
tgt_seg: 同时，Musk 在 X 上推送了多篇帖子，其中一篇是将“自闭症技术宅男”与“非二元深层国家剧院小子”进行比较，另一篇则是说当前美国局势相当于“剧本委员会和剧院小子团队被美式足球队和棋类俱乐部联盟打得落花流水”。传统上，高中中的“剧本委员会和剧院小子”这类社交活动都被“女王蜂”和“球圈男孩”排挤和嘲讽，Musk 站在压迫者一方，这更让人感到悲哀，更何况 Trump 连真正意义上的球圈男孩都算不上。（关于 Trump 的运动生涯相比他对自己运动神话的吹捧而言，其荒谬可笑程度可见一斑，参见 Russ Buettner 和 Susanne Craig 合著的《幸运的失败者》一书。）

src_seg: Anyway, we know how this ends. In the largest sense, with the cancellation of programmes mandated democratically in Congress by a bunch of unelected goons in puffer vests. And in the smallest sense, with one of these 22-year-old jerks spilling his Big Gulp cup of Mountain Dew over a keyboard at the Treasury and wiping the social security data of 70 million Americans. I look forward to watching as Big Balls and co find new ways to tank an economy even more efficiently and irreversibly than Brexit.
tgt_seg: 无论如何，我们都知道这么做会带来什么结果。从最大角度说，国会民主选举的议案被一群不经选举而当权的土包子取消了。从最小角度说，一个 22 岁的笨蛋把他的大杯摩尔顿柠檬水洒到了财政部的一台打字机上，清空了 7000 万美国人的社会保障账户。我很期待看到这些大块头及其同伙如何将经济搞垮，他们的方式甚至比脱欧还要有效、不可逆转。

tgt_seg: 如果他们的网上言论和个人简介没有显示出他们技能上的巨大差距（从外交角度来说），这一成就会更令人印象深刻。马斯克的情感成熟度就像卡通片里的银行抢劫犯，但他领导的这群人大多没有任何政府或管理经验，更不用说在他们受命改革的机构所管辖的领域的专业知识了。整个场景让人回想起 90 年代管理咨询业的繁荣时期，当时新毕业生对任何超过 35 岁且仍在呼吸的人都抱有怀疑的态度。果然，正如《纽约时报》报道的那样，有人听到年轻的工程师们把联邦雇员称为“恐龙”，而这些雇员则把戴棒球帽的人称为“麝鼠”。

src_seg: On X, meanwhile, Musk amplified a post pitching "autistic tech bros" against "non-binary Deep State theater kids," and another that said what's happening in the US right now is equivalent to "the yearbook committe and theater kid types getting rocked by a football team and chess club alliance." Theatre kids and chess nerds are, traditionally, both categories of social death in high school that are targeted by queen bees and jocks, a case of Musk siding with the oppressor that's even sadder when you consider that Trump isn't even a real jock. (For a full account of Trump's hilariously mediocre sports career relative to his claims about it, read Lucky Loser by Russ Buettner and Susanne Craig.)
tgt_seg: 与此同时，马斯克在 X 上发布了一篇帖子，将“自闭症科技兄弟”与“非二元深层国家戏剧孩子”进行对比，并在另一篇帖子中表示，美国现在发生的事情相当于“年鉴委员会和戏剧孩子类型被足球队和国际象棋俱乐部联盟震撼”。传统上，戏剧学生和国际象棋迷都是高中社交死亡的类型，他们会成为蜂后和运动员的目标，而马斯克站在压迫者一边的案例就更加令人难过了，尤其是当你考虑到特朗普甚至不是一个真正的运动员时。（若想了解特朗普平庸可笑的体育生涯（与其声称的完全不同），请阅读拉斯·布特纳 (Russ Buettner) 和苏珊娜·克雷格 (Susanne Craig) 合著的《幸运失败者》。）

src_seg: Anyway, we know how this ends. In the largest sense, with the cancellation of programmes mandated democratically in Congress by a bunch of unelected goons in puffer vests. And in the smallest sense, with one of these 22-year-old jerks spilling his Big Gulp cup of Mountain Dew over a keyboard at the Treasury and wiping the social security data of 70 million Americans. I look forward to watching as Big Balls and co find new ways to tank an economy even more efficiently and irreversibly than Brexit.
tgt_seg: 无论如何，我们知道事情的结局。从最广泛的意义上讲，这是一群穿着羽绒背心的未经选举的暴徒取消了国会民主授权的计划。从最小的意义上讲，这些 22 岁的混蛋中的一个将一杯激浪洒在财政部的键盘上，抹去了 7000 万美国人的社会保障数据。我期待看到“大球”及其同伙找到比英国脱欧更有效、更不可逆转地摧毁经济的新方法。

src_seg: If you thought Elon Musk was bad, look at his dreadful mini-mes and shudder for America
tgt_seg: 如果你认为埃隆·马斯克很糟糕，那就看看他那些可怕的“小分身”，为美国感到颤抖

src_seg: You would be forgiven for thinking we were back at the Bullingdon Club, in the company of Jonty, Munty, Stiffy, Kipper, Chugger and, to use the polite version, Pig Botherer - only in this case it's Big Balls and a guy with a history of racist tweeting. This is the sudden, startling emergence into American political life of a type deeply recognisable to Brits: that is, jaunty young men with juvenile nicknames and a firm belief they should be running the world.
tgt_seg: 你可能会误以为我们回到了布林登俱乐部，与乔恩蒂、芒提、斯蒂菲、基珀、查格和，客气点说，猪骚扰者共处一室——不过在这种情况下，是“大球”和一个有种族主义推文历史的家伙。这是一个在美国政治生活中突然、令人震惊地出现的类型，对英国人来说非常熟悉：就是那些拥有幼稚绰号和坚信自己应该统治世界的阳光青年。

src_seg: This being America, the class signifiers are slightly different from those in Britain. But in most regards, the cohort of young men hired by Elon Musk for his cost-cutting taskforce, the department of government efficiency (Doge), will be familiar to anyone who lived through the era of Boris Johnson's weapons-grade flippancy or reports of David Cameron's youthful hijinks. (Donald Trump is very flippant, of course, but his style skews locker room rather than debate chamber - or, in this case, maths olympiad.) And while politics has always run on young, volunteer energy, less common in the US, perhaps, is the imperial swagger, the sheer frivolous entitlement accompanying a crowd that has seemingly been given the keys to the kingdom.
tgt_seg: 在美国，这些社会阶层的标志与英国的略有不同。但在大多数方面，埃隆·马斯克为其成本削减工作组——政府效率部（Doge）——聘请的年轻人，任何经历过鲍里斯·约翰逊的极度随意或大卫·卡梅伦年轻时的胡闹时代的人都会感到熟悉。（唐纳德·特朗普当然也很随便，但他的风格更偏向更衣室，而不是辩论场——或者在这个案例中，数学奥林匹克。）虽然政治一直依靠年轻自愿者的精力，但在美国，这种皇帝般的傲气和伴随而来的完全无所顾忌的特权感或许不那么常见，这群人似乎掌握了王国的钥匙。

src_seg: Let's look at the lineup. The youngest of Musk's Doge hires, Edward Coristine - online username, Big Balls - is a 19-year-old former intern at Neuralink, Musk's neurotechnology company, who until recently appeared to be a first-year student at Northeastern University in Boston. Luke Farritor is a 23-year-old former SpaceX intern. Marko Elez, 25, used to work for X and SpaceX, and was revealed by the Wall Street Journal to have authored several since-removed tweets asserting, among other things, "You could not pay me to marry outside of my ethnicity." (Elez briefly resigned before Musk announced he'd reinstate him.)

tgt_seg: 加文·克里格（25岁）也在这之中，他在X上提升了白人至上主义者尼克·富恩特斯的一条帖子，而他新推出的Substack本周则以“为什么DOGE：我放弃七位数的年薪来拯救美国”为标题，凸显跳过大一英语101的风险。

src_seg: Between them, these men have gained access to federal premises and staffing systems that govern agencies including USAid, the Department of Health and Human Services, the education and energy departments, and the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, and contain sensitive information relating to millions of Americans. Elez was, reportedly, erroneously given overwrite access to the Treasury department's payment system before it was yanked back to read-only.
tgt_seg: 这些人获得了进入联邦机构及其工作人员系统的权限，这些机构包括美国国际开发署（USAid）、卫生与公共服务部、教育与能源部，以及医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心，里面包含与数百万美国人相关的敏感信息。据报道，埃莱兹曾错误地获得了财政部支付系统的覆盖访问权限，随后被撤回至只读状态。

And in the smallest sense, with one of these 22-year-old jerks spilling his Big Gulp cup of Mountain Dew over a keyboard at the Treasury and wiping the social security data of 70 million Americans. I look forward to watching as Big Balls and co find new ways to tank an economy even more efficiently and irreversibly than Brexit.
tgt_seg: 无论如何，我们都知道这会如何结束。从更广泛的意义上说，这将导致一群穿着蓬松夹克的未经选举的暴徒取消国会以民主方式授权的项目。从更小的角度来看，这将导致这些22岁的混蛋之一在财政部把他的大杯芒果露饮料洒在键盘上，抹去7000万美国人的社会安全数据。我期待着看到“大球”和他的伙伴们找到新的方式，以比脱欧更有效和不可逆转的方式摧毁经济。

src_seg: If you thought Elon Musk was bad, look at his dreadful mini-mes and shudder for America
tgt_seg: 如果你认为埃隆·马斯克很糟糕，看看他的可怕小跟班，为美国感到担忧

src_seg: You would be forgiven for thinking we were back at the Bullingdon Club, in the company of Jonty, Munty, Stiffy, Kipper, Chugger and, to use the polite version, Pig Botherer - only in this case it's Big Balls and a guy with a history of racist tweeting. This is the sudden, startling emergence into American political life of a type deeply recognisable to Brits: that is, jaunty young men with juvenile nicknames and a firm belief they should be running the world.
tgt_seg: 你会原谅我以为我们回到了布灵顿俱乐部，与乔蒂、蒙蒂、斯蒂菲、基珀、丘格尔以及使用礼貌版本的“猪烦人”在一起——只是这次是“大球”和一个有种族主义推文历史的人。这是美国政治生活中一种对英国人来说非常熟悉类型人物的突然、令人震惊的出现：即，那些带着幼稚昵称、坚信自己应该统治世界的轻快年轻人。

src_seg: This being America, the class signifiers are slightly different from those in Britain. But in most regards, the cohort of young men hired by Elon Musk for his cost-cutting taskforce, the department of government efficiency (Doge), will be familiar to anyone who lived through the era of Boris Johnson's weapons-grade flippancy or reports of David Cameron's youthful hijinks. (Donald Trump is very flippant, of course, but his style skews locker room rather than debate chamber - or, in this case, maths olympiad.) And while politics has always run on young, volunteer energy, less common in the US, perhaps, is the imperial swagger, the sheer frivolous entitlement accompanying a crowd that has seemingly been given the keys to the kingdom.
tgt_seg: 在美国，阶级标志与英国略有不同。但在大多数方面，埃隆·马斯克为其削减成本特别工作组（Doge）雇佣的年轻男性群体，对于经历过鲍里斯·约翰逊武器级轻浮时代或大卫·卡梅伦年轻时恶作的报道的人来说，会很熟悉。当然，唐纳德·特朗普非常轻浮，但他的风格更偏向更衣室而非辩论厅——或者，在这种情况下，数学奥林匹克。虽然政治一直依赖年轻的志愿者能量，但在美国，也许不太常见的是帝国式的傲慢，以及一群看似被赋予王国钥匙的人所伴随的纯粹的轻率特权。

src_seg: Let's look at the lineup. The youngest of Musk's Doge hires, Edward Coristine - online username, Big Balls - is a 19-year-old former intern at Neuralink, Musk's neurotechnology company, who until recently appeared to be a first-year student at Northeastern University in Boston. Luke Farritor is a 23-year-old former SpaceX intern. Marko Elez, 25, used to work for X and SpaceX, and was revealed by the Wall Street Journal to have authored several since-removed tweets asserting, among other things, "You could not pay me to marry outside of my ethnicity." (Elez briefly resigned before Musk announced he'd reinstate him.)
tgt_seg: 让我们看看阵容。马斯克的Doge雇员中年龄最小的爱德华·科里斯坦——在线用户名“大球”——是马斯克的神经技术公司Neuralink的一名前实习生，直到最近，他似乎是波士顿东北大学的一名一年级学生。卢克·法里托是一名23岁的SpaceX前实习生。25岁的马尔科·埃莱兹曾为X和SpaceX工作，据《华尔街日报》透露，他曾发布了几条推文，其中包括“我不会为了跨种族而结婚。”（埃莱兹短暂辞职，然后马斯克宣布他将重新录用他。）

src_seg: And Gavin Kliger, a 25-year-old who boosted a post on X by the white supremacist Nick Fuentes, and whose newly launched Substack this week highlighted the perils of skipping freshman English 101 with a post entitled "Why DOGE: Why I gave up a seven-figure salary to save America."
tgt_seg: 还有25岁的加文·克利格，他转发了白人至上主义者尼克·富恩特斯的X帖子，他的新推出的Substack本周强调了跳过新生英语101的危险，标题为“为什么DOGE：我为什么放弃七位数的薪水来拯救美国。”

src_seg: Between them, these men have gained access to federal premises and staffing systems that govern agencies including USAid, the Department of Health and Human Services, the education and energy departments, and the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, and contain sensitive information relating to millions of Americans. Elez was, reportedly, erroneously given overwrite access to the Treasury department's payment system before it was yanked back to read-only.
tgt_seg: 他们当中，这些人获得了对包括USAid、卫生与公共服务部、教育和能源部门以及医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心在内的机构进行管理的联邦场所和人员系统的访问权限，这些机构包含了数百万美国人的敏感信息。据报道，埃莱兹曾被错误地授予对财政部支付系统的写入权限，然后被撤销为只读权限。

src_seg: Of course, given that Doge has not responded to questions about what, if any, security clearance these young men have gone through, read-only is bad enough. The head of Doge, hiring in his own image, has turned to young, male software engineers with startup energy and the conviction that if you understand coding, you understand life. They've established sleeping pods in spare offices at the federal agencies they have been engaged to gut or dismantle, so that while Musk goes on X to mock federal employees for not working at weekends, his mini-mes work round the clock.
tgt_seg: 当然，鉴于Doge没有回应关于这些年轻人是否经过任何安全审查的问题，只读权限已经足够糟糕了。以自己的形象招聘的Doge负责人，转向了年轻的男性软件工程师，他们拥有创业能量和这样的信念：如果你懂编程，你就懂生活。他们在联邦机构的备用办公室里设立了睡眠舱，这些机构他们被雇佣来削减或解散，所以当马斯克在X上嘲笑联邦雇员不工作周末时，他的小跟班们全天候工作。

src_seg: This feat would be more impressive if their online remarks and bios didn't flag what might diplomatically be called large gaps in their skill-sets. Musk, a man with the emotional maturity of a cartoon bank robber, is leading a group of men most of whom have no government or management experience whatsoever, let alone expertise in fields governed by the agencies they have been tasked to reform. The whole scene is reminiscent of the 90s boom in management consultancy, during which new graduates stared with frank disbelief at anyone who was over 35 and still breathing. And sure enough, as reported in the New York Times, young engineers have been overheard referring to federal employees as "dinosaurs," who have in turn called the guys in baseball caps "Muskrats."

(Donald Trump is very flippant, of course, but his style skews locker room rather than debate chamber - or, in this case, maths olympiad.) And while politics has always run on young, volunteer energy, less common in the US, perhaps, is the imperial swagger, the sheer frivolous entitlement accompanying a crowd that has seemingly been given the keys to the kingdom.
tgt_seg: 在美国，阶层标志与英国略有不同。但总的来说，埃隆·马斯克为削减成本而聘用的这批年轻男性，组成他的效率部门（代号“道奇”），其形象会令任何经历过鲍里斯·约翰逊那种极度轻浮时期，或见过大卫·卡梅伦年轻时恶作剧的人感到熟悉。（当然，唐纳德·特朗普也十分轻浮，但他的风格更偏向于更衣室而非辩论厅——或者，就目前而言，数学竞赛。）虽然政治一直依赖年轻志愿者的力量，但在美国，像这种盛气凌人，以及伴随这群人仿佛被授予了王国钥匙的优越感，可能并不常见。

src_seg: Let's look at the lineup. The youngest of Musk's Doge hires, Edward Coristine - online username, Big Balls - is a 19-year-old former intern at Neuralink, Musk's neurotechnology company, who until recently appeared to be a first-year student at Northeastern University in Boston. Luke Farritor is a 23-year-old former SpaceX intern. Marko Elez, 25, used to work for X and SpaceX, and was revealed by the Wall Street Journal to have authored several since-removed tweets asserting, among other things, "You could not pay me to marry outside of my ethnicity." (Elez briefly resigned before Musk announced he'd reinstate him.)
tgt_seg: 让我们来看看这份名单。马斯克旗下Doge团队中最年轻的一位是爱德华·科里斯廷，其网名是“Big Balls”，他是一位19岁的年轻人，曾是马斯克神经科技公司Neuralink的实习生，直到最近似乎还是一名就读于波士顿东北大学一年级的学生。卢克·法里托是一位23岁的前SpaceX实习生。马尔科·埃莱兹，25岁，曾就职于X和SpaceX，据《华尔街日报》报道，他曾撰写多条已被删除的推文，其中包括“我不会花钱娶非我族群的人”等言论。（埃莱兹在马斯克宣布恢复其职位之前，曾短暂辞职。）

src_seg: And Gavin Kliger, a 25-year-old who boosted a post on X by the white supremacist Nick Fuentes, and whose newly launched Substack this week highlighted the perils of skipping freshman English 101 with a post entitled "Why DOGE: Why I gave up a seven-figure salary to save America."
tgt_seg: 加文·克利格，一名25岁的年轻人，在X平台上推广了白人至上主义者尼克·弗恩特斯发布的内容，并且本周刚推出的Substack上的一篇文章以“为什么DOGE：我放弃七位数的年薪来拯救美国”为题，强调了跳过大学一年级英语课程的后果。

src_seg: Between them, these men have gained access to federal premises and staffing systems that govern agencies including USAid, the Department of Health and Human Services, the education and energy departments, and the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, and contain sensitive information relating to millions of Americans. Elez was, reportedly, erroneously given overwrite access to the Treasury department's payment system before it was yanked back to read-only.
tgt_seg: 他们共同获得了访问联邦场所和管理包括美国国际发展署、卫生部、教育和能源部以及医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心等机构的系统权限，这些系统包含数百万美国公民的敏感信息。据报道，Elez此前因错误被授予了财政部的支付系统的写入权限，后恢复为只读权限。

src_seg: Of course, given that Doge has not responded to questions about what, if any, security clearance these young men have gone through, read-only is bad enough. The head of Doge, hiring in his own image, has turned to young, male software engineers with startup energy and the conviction that if you understand coding, you understand life. They've established sleeping pods in spare offices at the federal agencies they have been engaged to gut or dismantle, so that while Musk goes on X to mock federal employees for not working at weekends, his mini-mes work round the clock.
tgt_seg: 当然，鉴于Doge尚未回应关于这些年轻男子是否经过任何安全审查的问题，只读权限已经够糟糕了。Doge的负责人，倾向于招聘与他本人相似的、充满创业活力、坚信理解编程就等于理解人生的年轻男性软件工程师。他们还在与这些联邦机构合作期间，在空闲办公室设置了睡眠舱，以便在马斯克在X平台上嘲讽联邦雇员周末不工作时，他的团队成员可以不知疲倦地工作。

src_seg: This feat would be more impressive if their online remarks and bios didn't flag what might diplomatically be called large gaps in their skill-sets. Musk, a man with the emotional maturity of a cartoon bank robber, is leading a group of men most of whom have no government or management experience whatsoever, let alone expertise in fields governed by the agencies they have been tasked to reform. The whole scene is reminiscent of the 90s boom in management consultancy, during which new graduates stared with frank disbelief at anyone who was over 35 and still breathing. And sure enough, as reported in the New York Times, young engineers have been overheard referring to federal employees as "dinosaurs," who have in turn called the guys in baseball caps "Muskrats."
tgt_seg: 如果他们的在线言论和个人简介没有显示出明显的专业技能不足，这项成就将更令人瞩目。 如今，马斯克正带领着一个团队，其中大部分成员缺乏政府或管理经验，更遑论在他们被要求改革的领域内的专业知识。 整个场景让人联想到上世纪九十年代管理咨询行业的蓬勃发展时期，当时的新毕业生们对三十五岁以上的人抱有一定程度的惊讶。 纽约时报报道称，年轻工程师们曾私下称联邦雇员为“恐龙”，而联邦雇员则称戴着棒球帽的这些人叫做“麝鼠”。

src_seg: On X, meanwhile, Musk amplified a post pitching "autistic tech bros" against "non-binary Deep State theater kids," and another that said what's happening in the US right now is equivalent to "the yearbook committe and theater kid types getting rocked by a football team and chess club alliance." Theatre kids and chess nerds are, traditionally, both categories of social death in high school that are targeted by queen bees and jocks, a case of Musk siding with the oppressor that's even sadder when you consider that Trump isn't even a real jock. (For a full account of Trump's hilariously mediocre sports career relative to his claims about it, read Lucky Loser by Russ Buettner and Susanne Craig.)
tgt_seg: 在X平台上，马斯克转发了一则帖子，其中将“自闭症科技极客”与“非二元性别、与政府内部人士有关的戏剧社孩子”对立起来，并发表了另一则帖子，称目前美国发生的事情等同于“年鉴委员会和戏剧社孩子被橄榄球队和国际象棋俱乐部联盟击败”。传统上，戏剧社孩子和国际象棋爱好者都是高中社交圈中容易受到“蜂后”和“运动健将”欺凌的群体，而马斯克此举站在欺凌者一边，考虑到特朗普本人并非真正的运动健将，这更令人唏嘘。（如需了解特朗普与他所宣称的运动生涯之间荒谬的差距，请阅读Russ Buettner和Susanne Craig撰写的《幸运输家》。）

src_seg: Anyway, we know how this ends. In the largest sense, with the cancellation of programmes mandated democratically in Congress by a bunch of unelected goons in puffer vests. And in the smallest sense, with one of these 22-year-old jerks spilling his Big Gulp cup of Mountain Dew over a keyboard at the Treasury and wiping the social security data of 70 million Americans. I look forward to watching as Big Balls and co find new ways to tank an economy even more efficiently and irreversibly than Brexit.
tgt_seg: 总而言之，我们知道事情将如何收场。从宏观层面来看，是国会通过的、民选机构制定的各项计划被未经选举的人取消。从微观层面来看，则是某个22岁的年轻人不小心将一杯山露饮料洒在财政部的工作键盘上，导致7000万美国人的社保数据丢失。我期待着看到某些相关人士以比英国脱欧更高效、更不可逆转的方式，损害经济。

src_seg: And Gavin Kliger, a 25-year-old who boosted a post on X by the white supremacist Nick Fuentes, and whose newly launched Substack this week highlighted the perils of skipping freshman English 101 with a post entitled "Why DOGE: Why I gave up a seven-figure salary to save America."
tgt_seg: 还有25岁的加文·克利格，他曾通过X平台转发过白人至上主义者尼克·富恩特斯的帖子。最近，他在自己新开设的Substack专栏上发表了一篇题为《为何选择DOGE：为何放弃七位数年薪去拯救美国》的文章，这篇文章恰好凸显了跳过大学英语入门课程（即“大学英语101”课程）可能带来的风险。

src_seg: Between them, these men have gained access to federal premises and staffing systems that govern agencies including USAid, the Department of Health and Human Services, the education and energy departments, and the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, and contain sensitive information relating to millions of Americans. Elez was, reportedly, erroneously given overwrite access to the Treasury department's payment system before it was yanked back to read-only.
tgt_seg: 这些人已获得了进入联邦机构及其人事管理系统的权限，这些机构包括美国国际开发署（USAID）、卫生与公众服务部、教育部、能源部以及医疗保险与医疗补助服务中心等，相关系统中存有涉及数百万美国公民的敏感信息。据报道，埃莱兹曾被错误地授予财政部支付系统的修改权限，之后该权限被撤回，仅保留只读权限。

src_seg: Of course, given that Doge has not responded to questions about what, if any, security clearance these young men have gone through, read-only is bad enough. The head of Doge, hiring in his own image, has turned to young, male software engineers with startup energy and the conviction that if you understand coding, you understand life. They've established sleeping pods in spare offices at the federal agencies they have been engaged to gut or dismantle, so that while Musk goes on X to mock federal employees for not working at weekends, his mini-mes work round the clock.
tgt_seg: 当然，鉴于 Doge 尚未回应关于这些年轻人是否经过任何安全审查的问题，仅仅是给予“只读权限”就已经够糟糕的了。Doge 的负责人按照自己的形象进行招聘，专门选择那些充满创业激情、坚信“只要懂编程，就懂生活”的年轻男性软件工程师。他们在被指派进行机构精简或重组工作的联邦机构的闲置办公室里设置了睡眠舱，以便这些工程师能够全天候工作。这样，当马斯克在 X 平台上嘲笑联邦雇员周末不加班时，他的这些“迷你版分身”却在夜以继日地工作。

src_seg: This feat would be more impressive if their online remarks and bios didn't flag what might diplomatically be called large gaps in their skill-sets. Musk, a man with the emotional maturity of a cartoon bank robber, is leading a group of men most of whom have no government or management experience whatsoever, let alone expertise in fields governed by the agencies they have been tasked to reform. The whole scene is reminiscent of the 90s boom in management consultancy, during which new graduates stared with frank disbelief at anyone who was over 35 and still breathing. And sure enough, as reported in the New York Times, young engineers have been overheard referring to federal employees as "dinosaurs," who have in turn called the guys in baseball caps "Muskrats."
tgt_seg: 如果他们的网上言论和个人简介没有暴露出（用外交辞令来说）他们在技能方面的巨大缺陷，这一“壮举”或许会更令人印象深刻。马斯克——这个情感成熟度堪比卡通片中的银行劫匪的人——正在领导着一群几乎毫无政府或管理经验、更别说在他们奉命改革的机构所管辖领域拥有专业知识的人。整个场景让人想起上世纪90年代管理咨询业的繁荣时期：那时刚毕业的大学生们总是用充满怀疑的目光看待任何年过35岁仍在工作的成年人。果不其然，正如《纽约时报》所报道的那样，年轻工程师们私下将联邦雇员称为“恐龙”；而这些联邦雇员则反过来将那些戴棒球帽的家伙称为“马斯克鼠”（Muskrats）。

src_seg: On X, meanwhile, Musk amplified a post pitching "autistic tech bros" against "non-binary Deep State theater kids," and another that said what's happening in the US right now is equivalent to "the yearbook committe and theater kid types getting rocked by a football team and chess club alliance." Theatre kids and chess nerds are, traditionally, both categories of social death in high school that are targeted by queen bees and jocks, a case of Musk siding with the oppressor that's even sadder when you consider that Trump isn't even a real jock. (For a full account of Trump's hilariously mediocre sports career relative to his claims about it, read Lucky Loser by Russ Buettner and Susanne Craig.)
tgt_seg: 与此同时，在X平台上，马斯克推广了一篇帖子，将“自闭症技术宅男”与“非二元性别的深层政府戏剧小子”对立起来；另一篇帖子则称，美国当下发生的事情相当于“年鉴委员会和戏剧小子们被橄榄球队和国际象棋俱乐部的联盟击溃”。在传统的高中校园里，戏剧小子和国际象棋书呆子都属于社交死亡的类别，是校园女王和运动健将们欺凌的对象。这是马斯克站在压迫者一边的又一例证，而考虑到特朗普甚至都算不上一个真正的运动健将，这件事就更显可悲了。（要全面了解特朗普与其自吹自擂相比是何等平庸可笑的运动生涯，请阅读拉斯·比特纳和苏珊·克雷格所著的《幸运的失败者》。)

src_seg: Anyway, we know how this ends. In the largest sense, with the cancellation of programmes mandated democratically in Congress by a bunch of unelected goons in puffer vests. And in the smallest sense, with one of these 22-year-old jerks spilling his Big Gulp cup of Mountain Dew over a keyboard at the Treasury and wiping the social security data of 70 million Americans. I look forward to watching as Big Balls and co find new ways to tank an economy even more efficiently and irreversibly than Brexit.
tgt_seg: 总之，我们知道这将如何收场。从宏观上看，结局将是一群穿着羽绒背心的未经选举的暴徒，取消了国会民主授权的项目。从微观上看，会是某个22岁的混蛋把他的大杯激浪汽水洒在财政部的键盘上，抹掉了7000万美国人的社会保障数据。我期待着看“大球”和他那帮人如何找到比英国脱欧更高效、更不可逆转的新方法来搞垮一个经济体。

Elez was, reportedly, erroneously given overwrite access to the Treasury department's payment system before it was yanked back to read-only.
tgt_seg: 这些人之间，他们已经获得了对包括美国援助署、卫生与人类服务部、教育部、能源部和医疗保健服务中心在内的联邦机构的访问权和员工系统，包含了数百万美国人的敏感信息。埃莱兹据报道曾被错误地授予了财政部的支付系统的覆盖写入权限，后来被撤回为只读权限。

src_seg: Of course, given that Doge has not responded to questions about what, if any, security clearance these young men have gone through, read-only is bad enough. The head of Doge, hiring in his own image, has turned to young, male software engineers with startup energy and the conviction that if you understand coding, you understand life. They've established sleeping pods in spare offices at the federal agencies they have been engaged to gut or dismantle, so that while Musk goes on X to mock federal employees for not working at weekends, his mini-mes work round the clock.
tgt_seg: 当然，鉴于Doge没有回应关于这些年轻人是否经过了安全审查的任何问题，只读权限就足够糟糕了。政府效率部（Doge）的负责人，雇佣了年轻的男性软件工程师，带着创业的能量和坚定的信念：如果你理解编程，你就理解生活。他们在联邦机构的空余办公室里建立了睡眠舱，以便在马斯克在X上嘲笑联邦员工不工作周末的同时，他的“小我”们可以24小时不间断工作。

src_seg: This feat would be more impressive if their online remarks and bios didn't flag what might diplomatically be called large gaps in their skill-sets. Musk, a man with the emotional maturity of a cartoon bank robber, is leading a group of men most of whom have no government or management experience whatsoever, let alone expertise in fields governed by the agencies they have been tasked to reform. The whole scene is reminiscent of the 90s boom in management consultancy, during which new graduates stared with frank disbelief at anyone who was over 35 and still breathing. And sure enough, as reported in the New York Times, young engineers have been overheard referring to federal employees as "dinosaurs," who have in turn called the guys in baseball caps "Muskrats."
tgt_seg: 这个成就如果他们的在线评论和简历没有标志出他们技能缺陷的迹象，就会更令人印象深刻。马斯克，一个情感成熟度与卡通银行劫匪相似的男人，正在领导一个团队，其中大多数人没有政府或管理经验，甚至没有在被他们任务改革的机构所管辖的领域的专长。整个场景令人回忆起90年代管理咨询业的繁荣时期，新毕业生们对仍然呼吸着的35岁以上的人感到惊讶不已。并且，正如《纽约时报》报道的那样，年轻的工程师们被听到称联邦员工为“古老的生物”，而联邦员工们则称他们为“马斯克鼠”。

src_seg: On X, meanwhile, Musk amplified a post pitching "autistic tech bros" against "non-binary Deep State theater kids," and another that said what's happening in the US right now is equivalent to "the yearbook committe and theater kid types getting rocked by a football team and chess club alliance." Theatre kids and chess nerds are, traditionally, both categories of social death in high school that are targeted by queen bees and jocks, a case of Musk siding with the oppressor that's even sadder when you consider that Trump isn't even a real jock. (For a full account of Trump's hilariously mediocre sports career relative to his claims about it, read Lucky Loser by Russ Buettner and Susanne Craig.)
tgt_seg: 在X上，马斯克放大了一条推文，称“自闭症技术男孩”与“非二元性深州戏剧男孩”对立，并且另一条推文称美国当前的局势相当于“年级委员会和戏剧男孩类型被足球队和棋类俱乐部联盟打败”。戏剧男孩和棋类男孩在传统上都是高中社会死亡的类别，被女王蜂和运动员们攻击，马斯克站在压迫者的一边，这更令人悲伤的是，当你考虑到特朗普不是真正的运动员时（关于特朗普的滑稽的中等水平运动生涯与他对其的声称的详细账目，请阅读《幸运输运者》）。

src_seg: Anyway, we know how this ends. In the largest sense, with the cancellation of programmes mandated democratically in Congress by a bunch of unelected goons in puffer vests. And in the smallest sense, with one of these 22-year-old jerks spilling his Big Gulp cup of Mountain Dew over a keyboard at the Treasury and wiping the social security data of 70 million Americans. I look forward to watching as Big Balls and co find new ways to tank an economy even more efficiently and irreversibly than Brexit.
tgt_seg: 总之，我们知道这会如何结束。在最大的意义上，会有民主选举的国会通过的程序被一群没有被选举的穿着羽绒服的混蛋取消。并且，在最小的意义上，会有其中的一个22岁的混蛋在财政部的键盘上倒了山德威杯，擦掉了70万美国人的社会保障数据。我期待着看到大鸡蛋和他的同伴们如何找到新的方法来更有效、不可逆转地摧毁经济，就像布雷西那样。

src_seg: If you thought Elon Musk was bad, look at his dreadful mini-mes and shudder for America

src_seg: You would be forgiven for thinking we were back at the Bullingdon Club, in the company of Jonty, Munty, Stiffy, Kipper, Chugger and, to use the polite version, Pig Botherer - only in this case it's Big Balls and a guy with a history of racist tweeting. This is the sudden, startling emergence into American political life of a type deeply recognisable to Brits: that is, jaunty young men with juvenile nicknames and a firm belief they should be running the world.
tgt_seg: 你会以为我们回到了布灵顿俱乐部，与乔蒂、蒙蒂、斯蒂菲、基珀、丘格尔以及，用礼貌的版本来说，猪烦扰者在一起——只是这次是巨蛋和一个有种族主义推文历史的人。这是那种对英国人来说非常熟悉的人物突然、惊人地出现在美国政治生活中：即那些带着幼稚绰号、坚信自己应该统治世界的轻快年轻人。

src_seg: This being America, the class signifiers are slightly different from those in Britain. tgt_seg: 如果他们的在线评论和简历没有显示出可以礼貌地称为技能空白的话，这一成就会更令人印象深刻。马斯克，一个情感成熟度像卡通抢劫犯的人，领导着一个由大部分人没有任何政府或管理经验，更不用说在他们被赋予改革的机构领域的专业知识的男人组成的团队。整个场景让人想起20世纪90年代管理咨询业的繁荣，当时新毕业生会毫不掩饰地看着35岁以上的人，仍然在呼吸。果然，正如《纽约时报》报道的，年轻的工程师们被听到称联邦雇员为“恐龙”，而戴着棒球帽的男孩子们则被称为“马斯克老鼠”。

src_seg: On X, meanwhile, Musk amplified a post pitching "autistic tech bros" against "non-binary Deep State theater kids," and another that said what's happening in the US right now is equivalent to "the yearbook committe and theater kid types getting rocked by a football team and chess club alliance." Theatre kids and chess nerds are, traditionally, both categories of social death in high school that are targeted by queen bees and jocks, a case of Musk siding with the oppressor that's even sadder when you consider that Trump isn't even a real jock. (For a full account of Trump's hilariously mediocre sports career relative to his claims about it, read Lucky Loser by Russ Buettner and Susanne Craig.)
tgt_seg: 同时，马斯克在X上放大了一篇推文，将“自闭症技术兄弟”与“非二元深层国家戏剧孩子”对比，另一篇推文则说，现在美国发生的事情相当于“年鉴委员会和戏剧孩子类型被橄榄球队和国际象棋俱乐部联盟冲击”。传统上，戏剧孩子和国际象棋宅男都是高中社交死亡的类别，被女王蜂和运动员针对，马斯克站在一个更悲伤的压迫者一边，考虑到特朗普甚至不是一个真正的运动员。 （有关特朗普在体育生涯中与他对比的全面描述，请阅读Russ Buettner和Susanne Craig的《幸运输家》。）

src_seg: Anyway, we know how this ends. In the largest sense, with the cancellation of programmes mandated democratically in Congress by a bunch of unelected goons in puffer vests. And in the smallest sense, with one of these 22-year-old jerks spilling his Big Gulp cup of Mountain Dew over a keyboard at the Treasury and wiping the social security data of 70 million Americans. I look forward to watching as Big Balls and co find new ways to tank an economy even more efficiently and irreversibly than Brexit.
tgt_seg: 无论如何，我们都知道结局如何。在最大的意义上，由一群穿着充气背心的未当选的暴徒取消了国会民主授权的计划。在最小的意义上，其中一个22岁的混蛋将他的大杯山德士的能量饮料洒在财政部的键盘上，抹去了7000万美国人的社会保障数据。我期待着观看Big Balls和他的朋友们找到新的方法，以比脱欧更有效和不可逆转的方式摧毁经济。

src_seg: If you thought Elon Musk was bad, look at his dreadful mini-mes and shudder for America
tgt_seg: 如果你觉得埃隆·马斯克已经够糟糕了，那看看他那些令人不寒而栗的小跟班们吧，为美国感到担忧。

src_seg: You would be forgiven for thinking we were back at the Bullingdon Club, in the company of Jonty, Munty, Stiffy, Kipper, Chugger and, to use the polite version, Pig Botherer - only in this case it's Big Balls and a guy with a history of racist tweeting. This is the sudden, startling emergence into American political life of a type deeply recognisable to Brits: that is, jaunty young men with juvenile nicknames and a firm belief they should be running the world.
tgt_seg: 你完全可以原谅自己以为我们又回到了布林顿俱乐部，和Jonty、Munty、Stiffy、Kipper、Chugger以及用礼貌说法的Pig Botherer为伍——只不过这次是Big Balls和一个有种族主义推文历史的家伙。这种类型的人突然、惊人地出现在美国政治生活中，对英国人来说极为熟悉：也就是那些自信满满、拥有幼稚绰号、坚信自己应该主宰世界的年轻人。

src_seg: This being America, the class signifiers are slightly different from those in Britain. But in most regards, the cohort of young men hired by Elon Musk for his cost-cutting taskforce, the department of government efficiency (Doge), will be familiar to anyone who lived through the era of Boris Johnson's weapons-grade flippancy or reports of David Cameron's youthful hijinks. (Donald Trump is very flippant, of course, but his style skews locker room rather than debate chamber - or, in this case, maths olympiad.) And while politics has always run on young, volunteer energy, less common in the US, perhaps, is the imperial swagger, the sheer frivolous entitlement accompanying a crowd that has seemingly been given the keys to the kingdom.
tgt_seg: 既然是在美国，阶级标志与英国略有不同。但在大多数方面，埃隆·马斯克为其削减成本特别工作组（政府效率部，简称Doge）招募的这批年轻人，对经历过鲍里斯·约翰逊极度轻率时代或听说过戴维·卡梅伦年轻时恶作剧的人来说，并不陌生。（当然，唐纳德·特朗普也很轻率，但他的风格更像更衣室而非辩论厅——或者说，是数学奥林匹克。）虽然政治历来依赖年轻志愿者的活力，但在美国，或许不那么常见的是那种帝国式的傲慢和随意的特权感，这群人似乎被直接交付了“王国的钥匙”。

src_seg: Let's look at the lineup. The youngest of Musk's Doge hires, Edward Coristine - online username, Big Balls - is a 19-year-old former intern at Neuralink, Musk's neurotechnology company, who until recently appeared to be a first-year student at Northeastern University in Boston. Luke Farritor is a 23-year-old former SpaceX intern. Marko Elez, 25, used to work for X and SpaceX, and was revealed by the Wall Street Journal to have authored several since-removed tweets asserting, among other things, "You could not pay me to marry outside of my ethnicity." (Elez briefly resigned before Musk announced he'd reinstate him.)

tgt_seg: 还有加文·克利格，25岁，曾在X上转发白人至上主义者尼克·富恩特斯的帖子，本周他新开的Substack专栏以一篇题为《为什么选择DOGE：我为何放弃七位数年薪拯救美国》的文章，突显了跳过大一英语101课程的风险。

src_seg: Between them, these men have gained access to federal premises and staffing systems that govern agencies including USAid, the Department of Health and Human Services, the education and energy departments, and the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, and contain sensitive information relating to millions of Americans. tgt_seg: 不管怎样，我们都很清楚结果会如何。从广义上讲，这是由一群未经选举的暴徒们在国会中取消了民主授权的计划。从狭义上讲，这是其中一位 22 岁的小笨蛋在财政部键盘上把他的 Mountain Dew 大杯水倒出来，并擦掉了 7000 万美国人的社会保障数据。 我期待着看到 Big Balls 和同事找到新的方法来更有效地、更不可逆转地破坏经济，就像英国脱欧一样。

src_seg: If you thought Elon Musk was bad, look at his dreadful mini-mes and shudder for America
tgt_seg: 如果你觉得埃隆·马斯克很糟糕，看看他那些可怕的迷你翻版，为美国不寒而栗吧

src_seg: You would be forgiven for thinking we were back at the Bullingdon Club, in the company of Jonty, Munty, Stiffy, Kipper, Chugger and, to use the polite version, Pig Botherer - only in this case it's Big Balls and a guy with a history of racist tweeting. This is the sudden, startling emergence into American political life of a type deeply recognisable to Brits: that is, jaunty young men with juvenile nicknames and a firm belief they should be running the world.
tgt_seg: 如果你以为我们回到了布灵顿俱乐部，身边围绕着一群典型的英国上流社会公子哥，那也情有可原——只不过这次的主角是网名为“大球”的家伙和一个有种族主义推文史的人。这是一种英国人极为熟悉的类型突然闯入美国政治生活，令人震惊：他们是些活泼的年轻人，顶着幼稚的绰号，并坚信自己应该统治世界。

src_seg: This being America, the class signifiers are slightly different from those in Britain. But in most regards, the cohort of young men hired by Elon Musk for his cost-cutting taskforce, the department of government efficiency (Doge), will be familiar to anyone who lived through the era of Boris Johnson's weapons-grade flippancy or reports of David Cameron's youthful hijinks. (Donald Trump is very flippant, of course, but his style skews locker room rather than debate chamber - or, in this case, maths olympiad.) And while politics has always run on young, volunteer energy, less common in the US, perhaps, is the imperial swagger, the sheer frivolous entitlement accompanying a crowd that has seemingly been given the keys to the kingdom.
tgt_seg: 在美国，阶级的标志与英国略有不同。但在大多数方面，对于任何经历过鲍里斯·约翰逊那种“武器级”轻浮或听闻过戴维·卡梅伦年轻时胡闹行径报道的人来说，埃隆·马斯克为削减成本而聘请的“政府效率部”（Doge）工作组里的这群年轻人都会让他们感到熟悉。（当然，唐纳德·特朗普也非常轻浮，但他的风格更偏向于“更衣室”而非辩论厅——或者说，不是数学奥林匹克竞赛。）尽管政治活动向来依赖年轻的志愿力量，但在美国，那种帝国主义式的招摇，那种伴随着这群仿佛被授予了整个王国钥匙的人而来的纯粹的轻浮特权感，或许并不那么常见。

src_seg: Let's look at the lineup. The youngest of Musk's Doge hires, Edward Coristine - online username, Big Balls - is a 19-year-old former intern at Neuralink, Musk's neurotechnology company, who until recently appeared to be a first-year student at Northeastern University in Boston. Luke Farritor is a 23-year-old former SpaceX intern. Marko Elez, 25, used to work for X and SpaceX, and was revealed by the Wall Street Journal to have authored several since-removed tweets asserting, among other things, "You could not pay me to marry outside of my ethnicity." (Elez briefly resigned before Musk announced he'd reinstate him.)
tgt_seg: 让我们来看看这个阵容。马斯克“政府效率部”最年轻的成员爱德华·科里斯汀——网络用户名为“大球”（Big Balls）——年仅19岁，曾在马斯克的神经科技公司Neuralink实习，直到最近似乎还是波士顿东北大学的一年级学生。卢克·法里托现年23岁，曾是SpaceX的实习生。25岁的马尔科·埃莱兹曾在X公司和SpaceX工作，《华尔街日报》披露他曾发布数条现已删除的推文，其中一条声称：“给我钱我也不会和我的族裔以外的人结婚。”（在马斯克宣布恢复其职位前，埃莱兹曾短暂辞职。）

src_seg: And Gavin Kliger, a 25-year-old who boosted a post on X by the white supremacist Nick Fuentes, and whose newly launched Substack this week highlighted the perils of skipping freshman English 101 with a post entitled "Why DOGE: Why I gave up a seven-figure salary to save America."
tgt_seg: 还有25岁的加文·克里格，他曾在X平台上转发白人至上主义者尼克·富恩特斯的一篇帖子，并且他本周新开的Substack博客发表了一篇题为《为什么是DOGE：我为何放弃七位数年薪来拯救美国》的文章，凸显了没上大一英语101课程的危险。

src_seg: Between them, these men have gained access to federal premises and staffing systems that govern agencies including USAid, the Department of Health and Human Services, the education and energy departments, and the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, and contain sensitive information relating to millions of Americans. Elez was, reportedly, erroneously given overwrite access to the Treasury department's payment system before it was yanked back to read-only.
tgt_seg: 这些人共同获得了进入联邦办公场所和人事系统的权限，这些系统管理着包括美国国际开发署、卫生与公众服务部、教育部、能源部以及医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心在内的机构，并包含数百万美国人的敏感信息。据报道，埃莱兹曾被错误地授予了财政部支付系统的覆写权限，之后才被撤回至只读权限。

src_seg: Of course, given that Doge has not responded to questions about what, if any, security clearance these young men have gone through, read-only is bad enough. The head of Doge, hiring in his own image, has turned to young, male software engineers with startup energy and the conviction that if you understand coding, you understand life. They've established sleeping pods in spare offices at the federal agencies they have been engaged to gut or dismantle, so that while Musk goes on X to mock federal employees for not working at weekends, his mini-mes work round the clock.
tgt_seg: 当然，鉴于“政府效率部”没有回应关于这些年轻人是否经过任何安全审查的问题，只读权限也已经足够糟糕。“政府效率部”的负责人以自己的形象招兵买马，求助于年轻的男性软件工程师，他们充满创业公司的活力，并坚信只要你懂编程，你就懂生活。他们在被派去“整顿”或“拆解”的联邦机构的空余办公室里设立了睡眠舱，因此当马斯克在X上嘲笑联邦雇员周末不工作时，他的迷你翻版们却在夜以继日地工作。

src_seg: This feat would be more impressive if their online remarks and bios didn't flag what might diplomatically be called large gaps in their skill-sets. Musk, a man with the emotional maturity of a cartoon bank robber, is leading a group of men most of whom have no government or management experience whatsoever, let alone expertise in fields governed by the agencies they have been tasked to reform. The whole scene is reminiscent of the 90s boom in management consultancy, during which new graduates stared with frank disbelief at anyone who was over 35 and still breathing. And sure enough, as reported in the New York Times, young engineers have been overheard referring to federal employees as "dinosaurs," who have in turn called the guys in baseball caps "Muskrats."
tgt_seg: 如果他们的网络言论和个人简介没有暴露出那些或许可以委婉地称为“技能组合上的巨大差距”，这一“壮举”或许会更令人印象深刻。马斯克，一个心智成熟度堪比卡通片里银行劫匪的男人，正领导着一群绝大多数没有任何政府或管理经验的人，更不用说在他们被指派改革的机构所管辖的领域里拥有专业知识了。整个场景让人想起90年代管理咨询业的繁荣景象，当时刚毕业的大学生们以坦率到不加掩饰的怀疑目光打量着任何超过35岁还活着的人。果不其然，据《纽约时报》报道，有人听到年轻工程师称联邦雇员为“恐龙”，而联邦雇员则反过来称这些戴棒球帽的家伙为“马斯克鼠”（Muskrats）。

src_seg: On X, meanwhile, Musk amplified a post pitching "autistic tech bros" against "non-binary Deep State theater kids," and another that said what's happening in the US right now is equivalent to "the yearbook committe and theater kid types getting rocked by a football team and chess club alliance." Theatre kids and chess nerds are, traditionally, both categories of social death in high school that are targeted by queen bees and jocks, a case of Musk siding with the oppressor that's even sadder when you consider that Trump isn't even a real jock. (For a full account of Trump's hilariously mediocre sports career relative to his claims about it, read Lucky Loser by Russ Buettner and Susanne Craig.)
tgt_seg: 同时，在X平台上，马斯克转发了一篇帖子，将“自闭症科技兄弟”与“非二元性别‘深层政府’戏剧小子”对立起来，还转发了另一篇帖子，称美国目前的状况相当于“年鉴委员会和戏剧社的成员被橄榄球队和国际象棋俱乐部的联盟痛扁”。戏剧小子和国际象棋书呆子传统上都是高中里被人排斥的两大群体，是校园女王蜂和体育猛男们的欺凌对象。考虑到特朗普甚至算不上一个真正的体育猛男，马斯克这种与压迫者为伍的做法就显得更加可悲。（若想全面了解特朗普相对于其自我宣传而言有多么滑稽平庸的体育生涯，请阅读拉斯·比特纳和苏珊娜·克雷格合著的《幸运的失败者》。）

src_seg: Anyway, we know how this ends. In the largest sense, with the cancellation of programmes mandated democratically in Congress by a bunch of unelected goons in puffer vests. And in the smallest sense, with one of these 22-year-old jerks spilling his Big Gulp cup of Mountain Dew over a keyboard at the Treasury and wiping the social security data of 70 million Americans. I look forward to watching as Big Balls and co find new ways to tank an economy even more efficiently and irreversibly than Brexit.
tgt_seg: 总之，我们知道这一切将如何收场。从宏观上看，国会经民主程序授权的项目将被一群未经选举、身穿羽绒背心的暴徒取消。从微观上看，某个22岁的混蛋会把他那一大杯“激浪”汽水洒在财政部的键盘上，从而抹掉七千万美国人的社会保障数据。我期待着看“大球”及其同伙如何以比英国脱欧更高效、更不可逆转的方式搞垮一个经济体。

src_seg: A tale of two suckers: Donald Trump's plastic straws and Keir Starmer
tgt_seg: 两名吸管者的故事：唐纳德·特朗普的塑料吸管和基尔·斯塔默

src_seg: It's difficult to know whether to set any store by Donald Trump's bleak and yet also often banal pronouncements, which read as if handfuls of offensive concepts have been tossed into the air by a monkey, read out in whatever order they landed and then made policy. Until it's clear they can't work. At which point, the monkey must toss again.
tgt_seg: 很难判断是否应该相信唐纳德·特朗普那些枯燥乏味、常常令人反感的声明，这些声明读起来就像一群猴子把一大堆冒犯性的概念扔到空中，然后按照它们落下的顺序念出来，再制定成政策。直到人们发现这些政策行不通。届时，猴子们必须再次抛掷。

src_seg: But this month, Trump, whose morning ablutions increasingly appear to consist of dousing himself in sachets of the kind of cheap hot chocolate powder I steal from three-star hotels, like a flightless bird stuck in the machine that glazes Magnum lollies, declared he wanted to build his hotels on the mass graves of Gaza. Hasn't Trump seen The Shining? It won't end well. Pity those whose children have the misfortune to die next to a monetisable stretch of shoreline. And hope humanity's next wave of mass killings happens somewhere uneven and way inland that hopefully wouldn't even make a decent golf course.

Drive your golf carts over the bones of the dead!

src_seg: But maybe Trump's horrible mouth-cack is just continuing evidence of his former acolyte Steve Bannon's advice to "flood the zone with shit"? Does Trump really hate all sea creatures so much that he has to reinstate the plastic straws Joe Biden successfully, and commendably, outlawed? Perhaps he was once told to keep his hands to himself by a mermaid. "These things don't work," Trump said of paper straws. "I've had them many times, and on occasion, they break, they explode." Must millions of seabirds, turtles, manatees and dolphins die because Trump imagines that paper straws explode? Or so he can suck up his Diet Coke fast enough to amuse Elon Musk, Pete Hegseth and JD Vance by burping a smelly chorus of YMCA in Biden's face next time there's a gathering of ex-presidents.

src_seg: Because Trump, a fully grown man with unlimited funds, loves Diet Coke, and it's tempting to wonder how many of his seemingly incomprehensible policy decisions can be traced back to his desire to be continually saturated by the soft drink. Maybe there is a subterranean lake of the stuff somewhere deep beneath the Greenland tundra that the climate crisis, which doesn't exist, will soon make accessible to Trump's deep Diet Coke drills? Delighted Inuit strip off their sealskins and dance in the showering liquid as they realise they have just struck a rich seam of their new master's black gold. Like some kind of infantilised diaper king, Trump has genuinely had a special Diet Coke-summoning button installed in the Oval Office. Hopefully, he won't get it mixed up with that other button. It will be a shame if all life on Earth is fatally irradiated just because Trump wanted a 500ml bucket of fizz to swill down his Big Mac and fries.
tgt_seg: 因为特朗普，一个拥有无限资金的成年人，喜欢健怡可乐，人们不禁想知道，他的许多看似无法理解的政策决定有多少可以追溯到他对不断被这种软饮料包围的渴望。也许在格陵兰苔原深处某个地下湖泊里有大量的健怡可乐，而不存在的气候危机很快就会让特朗普的深层健怡可乐钻井平台触及那里。欣喜若狂的因纽特人脱下他们的海豹皮，在喷涌的液体中跳舞，因为他们意识到自己刚刚发现了他们新主人的黑色黄金的丰富矿层。就像一个被宠坏的婴儿一样，特朗普真的在椭圆形办公室安装了一个特殊的召唤健怡可乐的按钮。希望他不会把它和另一个按钮混淆。如果特朗普只是因为想要一桶500毫升的汽水来冲洗他的巨无霸和薯条，结果却导致地球上的所有生命受到致命辐射，那将是一场悲剧。

src_seg: But are we meant to take Trump's erratic announcements seriously? While the last concerned voices of the dying liberal press pen outraged articles to their dying liberal readers about Gaza hotels, the invasion of Canada and Trump making it compulsory to drink everything through a Trump Plastic Freedom Straw Company Deluxe Plastic Freedom Straw ™ ®, even cauliflower cheese soup, his homunculus Musk has been quietly dismantling the infrastructure of American government as you knew it. There are cup-and-ball tricksters on Parisian street corners with more subtle moves.
tgt_seg: 但我们是否应该认真对待特朗普反复无常的声明？当最后一些濒临死亡的自由派媒体的担忧之声为他们的自由派读者撰写愤怒的文章，讨论加沙酒店、入侵加拿大以及特朗普强制要求人们在喝任何东西（甚至是花椰菜奶酪汤）时都必须使用特朗普塑料自由吸管公司豪华塑料自由吸管™®时，他的小兄弟马斯克已经悄悄地拆除了美国政府的基础设施，就像你所知道的那样。巴黎街头角落里的玩杂耍戏法的人比这还要狡猾。

src_seg: Half a dozen of Musk's own hand-harvested incels-in-waiting, the kind of people who under normal circumstances would have got rich by inventing a way in which hardcore digital pornography could have been mainlined directly into the bloodstream in liquid form, have, under the spurious authority of Musk's imaginary "department of government efficiency," gone in and stolen all the data about everyone and everything in the US ever. Never mind. I am sure they will use it responsibly. What can possibly go wrong?
tgt_seg: 马斯克亲自挑选的六名等待中的“incels”（不自主的禁欲主义者），这些人在正常情况下可能会通过发明一种将硬核数字色情内容直接以液体形式注入血液的方法而变得富有，现在在马斯克虚构的“政府效率部门”的虚假权威下，进入并窃取了美国所有人和所有事物的所有数据。没关系。我相信他们会负责任地使用它。可能出什么问题呢？

src_seg: Some people gathered at the scenes of Musk's cost-cutting exercises and waved placards. Others sat and gawked at news footage of Kanye West's naked wife's arse or enjoyed disappointing trailers for the new Captain America movie, while the world as they knew it crumbled beneath their king-sized sofas. Keir Starmer backed away, as one might from a neighbour's unpredictable weapon dog, avoiding direct comment, dodging a commitment to the AI declaration like a coward and hoping for the best, while Trumpy growls and foams. Which simply won't do.
tgt_seg: 一些人在马斯克削减成本的现场聚集，挥舞着标语牌。其他人坐着，目瞪口呆地看着有关坎耶·韦斯特裸体妻子的臀部的新闻片段，或者欣赏着新的美国队长电影的令人失望的预告片，而他们所知道的世界就在他们的特大号沙发下面崩溃。基尔·斯塔默退缩了，就像人们避开邻居家不可预测的带武器的狗一样，避免直接评论，躲避对人工智能宣言的承诺，希望一切顺利，而特朗普却咆哮并吐着白沫。这根本不行。

src_seg: Look. I'm as disappointed as the next metropolitan liberal elitist champagne socialist by Starmer's government. While I accept, for example, the migration crisis must be addressed, I didn't expect Starmer, who once left his "village and went to the city of Leeds" and "discovered a whole new world of indie bands - like Orange Juice and the Wedding Present," to do it with Nigel Farage-style performative cruelty. Did Orange Juice suffer the indignity of their eponymous third album not even entering the top 50 in 1984 just so, 41 years later, Starmer could send Yvette Cooper out to downgrade the desperate, like Paul Golding in heels.

src_seg: Currently, as Putin puffs up under Trump's protection and unregulated AI threatens to rewrite history in real time, Starmer is on his knees sucking the paper straw of Trump's presidency. I fear it may be about to explode in his mouth.
tgt_seg: 目前，当普京在特朗普的保护下日益嚣张，而不受监管的人工智能威胁着实时重写历史时，斯塔默正跪在地上，吸着特朗普总统任期的纸吸管。我担心它可能很快就会在他的嘴里爆炸。

tgt_seg: “两个‘傻瓜’的故事：唐纳德·特朗普和他的塑料吸管，以及凯尔·斯塔默”

src_seg: It's difficult to know whether to set any store by Donald Trump's bleak and yet also often banal pronouncements, which read as if handfuls of offensive concepts have been tossed into the air by a monkey, read out in whatever order they landed and then made policy. Until it's clear they can't work. At which point, the monkey must toss again.
tgt_seg: 很难判断唐纳德·特朗普那些既令人沮丧，又常常显得空洞无物的言论是否值得重视。这些言论就像是把一些带有攻击性的观点随意地抛向空中，然后按照它们落地的顺序念出来，并以此作为政策依据。直到这些政策被证明行不通，这时，他（或他的团队）才会再次“抛出”新的观点。

src_seg: But this month, Trump, whose morning ablutions increasingly appear to consist of dousing himself in sachets of the kind of cheap hot chocolate powder I steal from three-star hotels, like a flightless bird stuck in the machine that glazes Magnum lollies, declared he wanted to build his hotels on the mass graves of Gaza. Hasn't Trump seen The Shining? It won't end well. Pity those whose children have the misfortune to die next to a monetisable stretch of shoreline. And hope humanity's next wave of mass killings happens somewhere uneven and way inland that hopefully wouldn't even make a decent golf course.
tgt_seg: 不过，这个月，特朗普却声称他想在加沙的万人冢上建造他的酒店。他现在的日常似乎就是把自己弄得像某种廉价热巧克力粉一样（就像我从三星级酒店偷来的那种），而且他就像一只被困在涂上巧克力的冰棒机器里的飞不出翅膀的鸟。难道特朗普没看过《闪灵》吗？结局不会是好的。那些不幸死在可以用来盈利的海滩附近的孩子们，真是太可怜了。希望人类下一轮的大规模屠杀发生在某个地势崎岖、远离海岸的地方，最好连个像样的球场都建不起来。

src_seg: Is Ukraine the frontier upon which the future of European democracy hinges, or is it just a massive stretch of undeveloped fairway, its leisure/conference utility value currently compromised only by the desire of some losers to continue living in the country they consider home? Where we see the falling domino chain that starts with Poland and ends in your back garden, does Trump see only a succession of 18-hole courses full of men in caps and enormous flapping flares brokering manly deals at the tee? Drive your golf carts over the bones of the dead!
tgt_seg: 乌克兰是欧洲民主的未来命脉，还是仅仅是一片广阔的、尚未开发的土地，其作为休闲和会议场所的价值，目前却因一些“失败者”想要继续生活在他们认为的“家园”而受到损害？我们看到的，是从波兰开始，最终波及到你家门口的一系列连锁反应，而特朗普看到的，是否仅仅是一系列拥有18个球洞、到处都是戴着帽子、挥舞着巨大旗帜的男人，他们正在球场上进行着“男子汉”式的交易？让你的高尔夫球车碾过逝者的骸骨吧！

src_seg: But maybe Trump's horrible mouth-cack is just continuing evidence of his former acolyte Steve Bannon's advice to "flood the zone with shit"? Does Trump really hate all sea creatures so much that he has to reinstate the plastic straws Joe Biden successfully, and commendably, outlawed? Perhaps he was once told to keep his hands to himself by a mermaid. "These things don't work," Trump said of paper straws. "I've had them many times, and on occasion, they break, they explode." Must millions of seabirds, turtles, manatees and dolphins die because Trump imagines that paper straws explode? Or so he can suck up his Diet Coke fast enough to amuse Elon Musk, Pete Hegseth and JD Vance by burping a smelly chorus of YMCA in Biden's face next time there's a gathering of ex-presidents.
tgt_seg: 但也许，特朗普那些令人厌恶的言论，只是他昔日“门徒”史蒂夫·班农“用尽一切手段，制造混乱”策略的又一例证？特朗普真的如此痛恨所有海洋生物，以至于他要重新允许使用塑料吸管，而这些吸管此前已经被乔·拜登成功且值得称赞地禁止了？也许他曾经被一位美人鱼警告过，要“管好自己的手”。特朗普还说，关于纸质吸管：“它们根本不好用。我用过很多次，而且有时候它们会断裂，甚至会爆炸。”难道成千上万只海鸟、海龟、儒艮和海豚必须因此而死去，仅仅因为特朗普认为纸质吸管会爆炸？还是为了让他能更快地喝完他的健怡可乐，从而在下次前总统们聚会时，通过打嗝发出难闻的“YMCA”歌曲，来逗乐埃隆·马斯克、皮特·赫格塞斯和J.D.万斯，并以此来嘲讽拜登？

src_seg: Like some kind of infantilised diaper king, Trump has genuinely had a special Diet Coke-summoning button installed in the Oval Office
tgt_seg: 据称，特朗普就像一位“被宠坏的婴儿国王”，他在白宫椭圆形办公室里还特意安装了一个“可口可乐”点餐按钮，以便随时享用。

src_seg: Because Trump, a fully grown man with unlimited funds, loves Diet Coke, and it's tempting to wonder how many of his seemingly incomprehensible policy decisions can be traced back to his desire to be continually saturated by the soft drink. Maybe there is a subterranean lake of the stuff somewhere deep beneath the Greenland tundra that the climate crisis, which doesn't exist, will soon make accessible to Trump's deep Diet Coke drills? Delighted Inuit strip off their sealskins and dance in the showering liquid as they realise they have just struck a rich seam of their new master's black gold. Like some kind of infantilised diaper king, Trump has genuinely had a special Diet Coke-summoning button installed in the Oval Office. Hopefully, he won't get it mixed up with that other button. It will be a shame if all life on Earth is fatally irradiated just because Trump wanted a 500ml bucket of fizz to swill down his Big Mac and fries.
tgt_seg: 特朗普是一位身家丰厚、财力雄厚的成年人，但他却非常喜欢喝健怡可乐。因此，不禁让人想知道，他那些看似难以理解的政策决定，有多少是出于他对这种饮料的持续渴望。也许，在格陵兰岛的冰原深处，存在着一个巨大的健怡可乐湖，而所谓的“气候危机”（实际上并不存在）将很快让特朗普能够开采到这种“黑金”。到时候，当地的因纽特人可能会欣喜若狂，脱下他们的皮衣，在倾泻而下的健怡可乐中欢舞，因为他们意识到自己已经发现了他们这位新主人的宝贵财富。特朗普就像一位沉迷于“尿布”的国王，他甚至还在椭圆形办公室里安装了一个专门用来点健怡可乐的按钮。希望他不会把它和另一个按钮搞混。如果仅仅因为特朗普想喝一桶健怡可乐来搭配他的巨无霸和薯条，就导致地球上所有生命都受到致命辐射，那将是多么令人遗憾的一件事。

src_seg: But are we meant to take Trump's erratic announcements seriously? While the last concerned voices of the dying liberal press pen outraged articles to their dying liberal readers about Gaza hotels, the invasion of Canada and Trump making it compulsory to drink everything through a Trump Plastic Freedom Straw Company Deluxe Plastic Freedom Straw ™ ®, even cauliflower cheese soup, his homunculus Musk has been quietly dismantling the infrastructure of American government as you knew it. There are cup-and-ball tricksters on Parisian street corners with more subtle moves.
tgt_seg: 但我们应该认真对待特朗普那些反复无常的声明吗？当那些“垂死”的自由派媒体纷纷撰写文章，谴责他在加沙的酒店、入侵加拿大以及强制要求人们使用“特朗普塑料自由吸管公司”的“豪华塑料自由吸管™®”来喝任何东西，甚至包括花椰菜奶酪汤时，他的“傀儡”马斯克却在悄悄地破坏着美国政府的现有体制。甚至连巴黎街头的那些玩“套环”游戏的人，也比他更懂得含蓄。

src_seg: Half a dozen of Musk's own hand-harvested incels-in-waiting, the kind of people who under normal circumstances would have got rich by inventing a way in which hardcore digital pornography could have been mainlined directly into the bloodstream in liquid form, have, under the spurious authority of Musk's imaginary "department of government efficiency," gone in and stolen all the data about everyone and everything in the US ever. Never mind. I am sure they will use it responsibly. What can possibly go wrong?
tgt_seg: 一群“马斯克式”的“潜在的孤独者”（这些人通常会通过发明一种将色情内容直接注入血液的方式来发家致富，但现在却在马斯克虚构的“政府效率部门”的授意下，非法窃取了美国所有关于个人和事物的数据库。 没关系，我相信他们会负责任地使用这些数据。 还会出什么问题呢？

src_seg: Some people gathered at the scenes of Musk's cost-cutting exercises and waved placards. Others sat and gawked at news footage of Kanye West's naked wife's arse or enjoyed disappointing trailers for the new Captain America movie, while the world as they knew it crumbled beneath their king-sized sofas. Keir Starmer backed away, as one might from a neighbour's unpredictable weapon dog, avoiding direct comment, dodging a commitment to the AI declaration like a coward and hoping for the best, while Trumpy growls and foams. Which simply won't do.
tgt_seg: 一些人聚集在马斯克进行裁员的现场，并挥舞着标语。另一些人则坐在那里，观看有关坎耶·韦斯特的裸体妻子的新闻报道，或者观看令人失望的《美国队长》新电影预告片，而他们所熟悉的世界却在他们的大沙发下分崩离析。基尔·斯塔默则采取了回避的态度，就像躲避邻居那只难以预测的凶猛狗一样，他避免发表直接评论，也避免承诺支持有关人工智能的声明，而是像个懦夫一样寄希望于一切都能好起来，而与此同时，特朗普却在咆哮和叫嚣。但这种做法是行不通的。

src_seg: Look. I'm as disappointed as the next metropolitan liberal elitist champagne socialist by Starmer's government. While I accept, for example, the migration crisis must be addressed, I didn't expect Starmer, who once left his "village and went to the city of Leeds" and "discovered a whole new world of indie bands - like Orange Juice and the Wedding Present," to do it with Nigel Farage-style performative cruelty. Address the migration crisis, by all means, but don't be a c*** about it. Did Orange Juice suffer the indignity of their eponymous third album not even entering the top 50 in 1984 just so, 41 years later, Starmer could send Yvette Cooper out to downgrade the desperate, like Paul Golding in heels.
tgt_seg: 说实话，我对斯塔默政府的表现感到非常失望，这和那些典型的、生活在都市、思想开明的“精英”一样。虽然我承认，比如，移民问题必须得到解决，但我没想到斯塔默，他曾经“离开家乡，来到利兹这座城市，并发现了全新的独立音乐世界——比如“橙汁”乐队和“婚礼乐队””，会采取像奈杰尔·法拉奇那样，充满表演性质的、残忍的方式来处理这个问题。解决移民问题当然是必要的，但请不要采取如此卑劣的手段。难道“橙汁”乐队的第三张同名专辑在1984年未能进入前50名，仅仅是为了让斯塔默在41年后，派叶维特·库珀出来，像穿着高跟鞋的保罗·戈尔丁一样，对那些绝望的人进行贬低吗？

src_seg: Currently, as Putin puffs up under Trump's protection and unregulated AI threatens to rewrite history in real time, Starmer is on his knees sucking the paper straw of Trump's presidency. I fear it may be about to explode in his mouth.
tgt_seg: 目前，在特朗普的庇护下，普京变得更加嚣张，而人工智能的失控发展又威胁着要篡改历史，此时，斯塔默却像个奴才，卑躬屈膝地试图从特朗普的“政治遗产”中捞取好处。我担心，这样做可能会适得其反，让他自食恶果。

tgt_seg: 马斯克手摘的半打等待成为仇恨分子的，就是那些在正常情况下会通过发明一种将硬核数字色情内容直接注入血液的方式来发家致富的人，在马斯克的虚构“政府效率部门”的虚假权威下，闯入并窃取了美国所有关于每个人和一切的数据。没关系。我相信他们会负责任地使用它。有什么可能出错呢？

src_seg: Some people gathered at the scenes of Musk's cost-cutting exercises and waved placards. Others sat and gawked at news footage of Kanye West's naked wife's arse or enjoyed disappointing trailers for the new Captain America movie, while the world as they knew it crumbled beneath their king-sized sofas. Keir Starmer backed away, as one might from a neighbour's unpredictable weapon dog, avoiding direct comment, dodging a commitment to the AI declaration like a coward and hoping for the best, while Trumpy growls and foams. Which simply won't do.
tgt_seg: 一些人聚集在马斯克的成本削减措施的现场，挥舞着标语。另一些人则坐在那里，目睹了关于坎耶·韦斯特的裸妻的屁股的新闻录像，或者对新的美国队长电影的令人失望的预告片感到失望，而他们所知的世界在他们的大型沙发下崩溃了。凯尔·斯塔默退缩了，就像人们退缩于邻居不可预测的武器狗一样，避免直接评论，躲避对人工智能声明的承诺，像个胆小鬼一样，希望一切都好，而特朗普则咆哮着、冒着泡。这根本行不通。

src_seg: Look. I'm as disappointed as the next metropolitan liberal elitist champagne socialist by Starmer's government. While I accept, for example, the migration crisis must be addressed, I didn't expect Starmer, who once left his "village and went to the city of Leeds" and "discovered a whole new world of indie bands - like Orange Juice and the Wedding Present," to do it with Nigel Farage-style performative cruelty. Address the migration crisis, by all means, but don't be a c*** about it. Did Orange Juice suffer the indignity of their eponymous third album not even entering the top 50 in 1984 just so, 41 years later, Starmer could send Yvette Cooper out to downgrade the desperate, like Paul Golding in heels.
tgt_seg: 看。我对斯塔默的政府感到失望，就像下一个都市自由派精英香槟社会主义者一样。虽然我承认，例如，必须解决移民危机，但我没有指望斯塔默，他曾经离开过他的“村庄，去了利兹市”，并且“发现了一个全新的独立乐队世界——比如 Orange Juice 和 Wedding Present”，会以尼古拉斯·法拉奇式的表演性残酷来解决这个问题。当然，解决移民危机，但不要像个混蛋一样去做。Orange Juice 难道没有遭受过他们同名第三张专辑在 1984 年未能进入前 50 名的侮辱，以便 41 年后，斯塔默将Yvette Cooper派去贬低那些绝望的人，就像 Paul Golding 穿高跟鞋一样吗？

src_seg: Currently, as Putin puffs up under Trump's protection and unregulated AI threatens to rewrite history in real time, Starmer is on his knees sucking the paper straw of Trump's presidency. I fear it may be about to explode in his mouth.
tgt_seg: 目前，普京在特朗普的保护和不受监管的人工智能的威胁下变得越来越强大，而斯塔默则跪在地上，吸吮着特朗普总统的纸吸管。我担心它很快会在他的嘴里爆炸。

src_seg: A tale of two suckers: Donald Trump's plastic straws and Keir Starmer
tgt_seg: 两个傻瓜的故事：唐纳德·特朗普的塑料吸管和基尔·斯塔默

src_seg: It's difficult to know whether to set any store by Donald Trump's bleak and yet also often banal pronouncements, which read as if handfuls of offensive concepts have been tossed into the air by a monkey, read out in whatever order they landed and then made policy. Until it's clear they can't work. At which point, the monkey must toss again.
tgt_seg: 我们很难判断唐纳德·特朗普那些阴郁而往往又平淡无奇的言论是否值得重视，这些言论读起来就像是一只猴子将一堆冒犯性的概念抛向空中，然后按照它们落地的顺序读出来，再变成政策。直到这些政策明显行不通为止。这时，猴子又得重新抛一次。

src_seg: But this month, Trump, whose morning ablutions increasingly appear to consist of dousing himself in sachets of the kind of cheap hot chocolate powder I steal from three-star hotels, like a flightless bird stuck in the machine that glazes Magnum lollies, declared he wanted to build his hotels on the mass graves of Gaza. Hasn't Trump seen The Shining? It won't end well. Pity those whose children have the misfortune to die next to a monetisable stretch of shoreline. And hope humanity's next wave of mass killings happens somewhere uneven and way inland that hopefully wouldn't even make a decent golf course.
tgt_seg: 但本月，特朗普——他早晨的洗漱仪式似乎越来越变成用那种我从三星级酒店偷来的廉价热可可粉冲泡饮品，像一只被困在麦格南冰棒涂层机器里的不会飞的鸟——宣布他想在加沙的万人坑上建造他的酒店。特朗普难道没看过《闪灵》吗？这不会有什么好下场。可怜那些不幸的孩子死在了一段可以商业开发的海岸线旁边。希望人类下一次大规模屠杀发生在某个地形崎岖、深入内陆的地方，连一个像样的高尔夫球场都建不成。

src_seg: Is Ukraine the frontier upon which the future of European democracy hinges, or is it just a massive stretch of undeveloped fairway, its leisure/conference utility value currently compromised only by the desire of some losers to continue living in the country they consider home? Where we see the falling domino chain that starts with Poland and ends in your back garden, does Trump see only a succession of 18-hole courses full of men in caps and enormous flapping flares brokering manly deals at the tee? Drive your golf carts over the bones of the dead!
tgt_seg: 乌克兰究竟是欧洲民主未来的分水岭，还是一大片尚未开发的高尔夫球道，其休闲和会议价值目前仅因一些失败者想继续住在他们自认为是家园的国家而受阻？当我们看到多米诺骨牌从波兰开始倒下，最终倒向你家后院时，特朗普是否只看到一连串18洞的球场，满是戴着帽子、穿着宽松喇叭裤的男人在发球台上进行阳刚的交易？开着你们的高尔夫球车碾过死人的骨头吧！

src_seg: But maybe Trump's horrible mouth-cack is just continuing evidence of his former acolyte Steve Bannon's advice to "flood the zone with shit"? Does Trump really hate all sea creatures so much that he has to reinstate the plastic straws Joe Biden successfully, and commendably, outlawed? Perhaps he was once told to keep his hands to himself by a mermaid. "These things don't work," Trump said of paper straws. "I've had them many times, and on occasion, they break, they explode." Must millions of seabirds, turtles, manatees and dolphins die because Trump imagines that paper straws explode? Or so he can suck up his Diet Coke fast enough to amuse Elon Musk, Pete Hegseth and JD Vance by burping a smelly chorus of YMCA in Biden's face next time there's a gathering of ex-presidents.
tgt_seg: 但也许特朗普满嘴的污言秽语只是继续印证了他的前信徒史蒂夫·班农的建议：“用屎淹没整个区域”？特朗普真的如此憎恨所有海洋生物，以至于他必须恢复乔·拜登成功且值得称赞地禁止的塑料吸管吗？也许他曾经被一个美人鱼告诫过不要动手动脚。“这些玩意儿不管用，”特朗普谈到纸吸管时说，“我用过很多次，有时候它们会断裂，甚至爆炸。”难道数以百万计的海鸟、海龟、海牛和海豚就因此而死吗？或者仅仅是为了让他能更快地吸上一口健怡可乐，好在下次前总统聚会时，让埃隆·马斯克、皮特·海格塞思和J.D.万斯开心地听到他对着拜登放臭屁，齐唱《YMCA》？

Delighted Inuit strip off their sealskins and dance in the showering liquid as they realise they have just struck a rich seam of their new master's black gold. Like some kind of infantilised diaper king, Trump has genuinely had a special Diet Coke-summoning button installed in the Oval Office. Hopefully, he won't get it mixed up with that other button. It will be a shame if all life on Earth is fatally irradiated just because Trump wanted a 500ml bucket of fizz to swill down his Big Mac and fries.
tgt_seg: 因为特朗普，一个拥有无限资金的成年男人，热爱健怡可乐，人们不禁好奇，他那些看似难以理解的政策决定中，有多少可以追溯到他渴望不断被这种软饮料浸润的愿望。也许在格陵兰苔原深处的地下湖泊中，储存着大量这种饮料，而并不存在的气候危机将很快让特朗普的深层健怡可乐钻探设备得以开采？因纽特人高兴地脱下他们的海豹皮，在喷洒的液体中跳舞，因为他们意识到自己刚刚发现了新主人的黑金。像一个幼稚的纸尿裤大王，特朗普真的在椭圆形办公室安装了一个专门召唤健怡可乐的按钮。希望他不要把它和另一个按钮搞混了。如果地球上的所有生命仅仅因为特朗普想要一杯500毫升的冒泡饮料来冲下他的巨无霸和薯条而被致命辐射，那将是一件憾事。
