src_seg: Some people gathered at the scenes of Musk's cost-cutting exercises and waved placards. Others sat and gawked at news footage of Kanye West's naked wife's arse or enjoyed disappointing trailers for the new Captain America movie, while the world as they knew it crumbled beneath their king-sized sofas. Keir Starmer backed away, as one might from a neighbour's unpredictable weapon dog, avoiding direct comment, dodging a commitment to the AI declaration like a coward and hoping for the best, while Trumpy growls and foams. Which simply won't do.
tgt_seg: 有人举牌抗议马斯克的裁员，更多人瘫在加大码沙发上，盯着侃爷裸妻屁股的新闻或《美国队长4》烂预告，任旧世界崩塌。基尔·斯塔默则像躲避邻居的恶犬般回避表态，怯懦地躲开AI宣言承诺，指望特朗普吠叫着自爆。这可不行。

src_seg: Look. I'm as disappointed as the next metropolitan liberal elitist champagne socialist by Starmer's government. While I accept, for example, the migration crisis must be addressed, I didn't expect Starmer, who once left his "village and went to the city of Leeds" and "discovered a whole new world of indie bands - like Orange Juice and the Wedding Present," to do it with Nigel Farage-style performative cruelty. Address the migration crisis, by all means, but don't be a c*** about it. Did Orange Juice suffer the indignity of their eponymous third album not even entering the top 50 in 1984 just so, 41 years later, Starmer could send Yvette Cooper out to downgrade the desperate, like Paul Golding in heels.
tgt_seg: 听着，我和其他都市自由派精英香槟社会主义者一样失望。我理解需解决移民危机，但没料到曾"从村庄来到利兹城"、"发现橙汁乐队等新世界"的斯塔默，竟效仿奈杰尔·法拉奇的作秀式残忍。处理移民危机可以，但别当混账。难道橙汁乐队1984年第三张专辑未进前50的耻辱，就为41年后让斯塔默派伊薇特·库珀学穿高跟鞋的保罗·戈尔丁践踏绝望者？

src_seg: Currently, as Putin puffs up under Trump's protection and unregulated AI threatens to rewrite history in real time, Starmer is on his knees sucking the paper straw of Trump's presidency. I fear it may be about to explode in his mouth.
tgt_seg: 如今普京在特朗普庇护下膨胀，失控AI实时篡改历史，斯塔默却跪着吮吸特朗普总统任期的纸吸管。恐怕那吸管就要在他嘴里炸了。

src_seg: A tale of two suckers: Donald Trump's plastic straws and Keir Starmer
tgt_seg: 两个傻瓜的故事：唐纳德·特朗普的塑料吸管和基尔·斯塔默

src_seg: It's difficult to know whether to set any store by Donald Trump's bleak and yet also often banal pronouncements, which read as if handfuls of offensive concepts have been tossed into the air by a monkey, read out in whatever order they landed and then made policy. Until it's clear they can't work. At which point, the monkey must toss again.
tgt_seg: 难以判断是否应该重视唐纳德·特朗普那些阴郁又时常乏味的宣言，这些宣言听起来就像是一只猴子把一堆冒犯性的想法扔上了天，然后按它们落在地上的顺序读出来，并制定成政策。直到显而易见这些政策无法奏效时，这只猴子就必须再次扔出新的想法。

src_seg: But this month, Trump, whose morning ablutions increasingly appear to consist of dousing himself in sachets of the kind of cheap hot chocolate powder I steal from three-star hotels, like a flightless bird stuck in the machine that glazes Magnum lollies, declared he wanted to build his hotels on the mass graves of Gaza. Hasn't Trump seen The Shining? It won't end well. Pity those whose children have the misfortune to die next to a monetisable stretch of shoreline. And hope humanity's next wave of mass killings happens somewhere uneven and way inland that hopefully wouldn't even make a decent golf course.
tgt_seg: 但这个月，特朗普的晨间盥洗似乎越来越多地变成了用我从三星级酒店里偷来的那种廉价热巧克力粉，往自己身上糊上一层，就像是一只困在涂巧克力糖浆机器里的不会飞的鸟。他宣称，他想在加沙的万人坑上建造自己的酒店。难道特朗普没看过《闪灵》吗？这结局不会好。那些孩子不幸死在这片可以赚大钱的海岸线上的人真是太可怜了。只希望人类的下一次大规模屠杀发生在一些不平坦且远离海岸的地方——希望那地方连个像样的高尔夫球场都造不出来。

src_seg: Is Ukraine the frontier upon which the future of European democracy hinges, or is it just a massive stretch of undeveloped fairway, its leisure/conference utility value currently compromised only by the desire of some losers to continue living in the country they consider home? Where we see the falling domino chain that starts with Poland and ends in your back garden, does Trump see only a succession of 18-hole courses full of men in caps and enormous flapping flares brokering manly deals at the tee? Drive your golf carts over the bones of the dead!
tgt_seg: 乌克兰是决定欧洲民主未来的前沿阵地，还是仅仅是一大片未开发的球道，它的休闲/会议实用价值目前仅仅因为一些失败者想继续居住在他们认为是家的国家而受到影响？当我们看到从波兰开始并向你家后院蔓延的多米诺骨牌效应时，特朗普眼里看到的是否只是一连串18洞的高尔夫球场，球场上满是戴着鸭舌帽、挥舞着巨大旗子、在球道上达成交易的男人？开着你的高尔夫球车越过死人的遗骸吧！

src_seg: But maybe Trump's horrible mouth-cack is just continuing evidence of his former acolyte Steve Bannon's advice to "flood the zone with shit"? Does Trump really hate all sea creatures so much that he has to reinstate the plastic straws Joe Biden successfully, and commendably, outlawed? Perhaps he was once told to keep his hands to himself by a mermaid. "These things don't work," Trump said of paper straws. "I've had them many times, and on occasion, they break, they explode." Must millions of seabirds, turtles, manatees and dolphins die because Trump imagines that paper straws explode? Or so he can suck up his Diet Coke fast enough to amuse Elon Musk, Pete Hegseth and JD Vance by burping a smelly chorus of YMCA in Biden's face next time there's a gathering of ex-presidents.
tgt_seg: 但也许特朗普那可怕的胡言乱语，只是他昔日追随者史蒂夫·班农“用垃圾淹没这片土地”建议的延续？特朗普真的那么讨厌所有海洋生物吗，以至于他要恢复乔·拜登曾成功且值得称道地禁止使用的塑料吸管？也许他曾被一位美人鱼劝告过，要管好自己的手。“这些东西不好用，”特朗普谈到纸制吸管时说，“我用了很多次，有时它们会断掉，甚至会爆炸。”难道就是因为特朗普想象中的纸制吸管会爆炸，就允许数以百万计的海鸟、海龟、海牛和海豚死去吗？还是说他就想这样做的，好让下次前总统们聚在一起时，他能快速地吸完可乐，在乔·拜登面前放声喷出臭烘烘的《YMCA》的哼唱，以此逗乐埃隆·马斯克、皮特·赫格塞茨和JD·万斯？

src_seg: Like some kind of infantilised diaper king, Trump has genuinely had a special Diet Coke-summoning button installed in the Oval Office

src_seg: Because Trump, a fully grown man with unlimited funds, loves Diet Coke, and it's tempting to wonder how many of his seemingly incomprehensible policy decisions can be traced back to his desire to be continually saturated by the soft drink. Maybe there is a subterranean lake of the stuff somewhere deep beneath the Greenland tundra that the climate crisis, which doesn't exist, will soon make accessible to Trump's deep Diet Coke drills? Delighted Inuit strip off their sealskins and dance in the showering liquid as they realise they have just struck a rich seam of their new master's black gold. Like some kind of infantilised diaper king, Trump has genuinely had a special Diet Coke-summoning button installed in the Oval Office. Hopefully, he won't get it mixed up with that other button. It will be a shame if all life on Earth is fatally irradiated just because Trump wanted a 500ml bucket of fizz to swill down his Big Mac and fries.
tgt_seg: 因为特朗普，这个拥有无限资金的成年人，非常钟爱健怡可乐，所以让人忍不住想知道，他那些看似不可思议的政策决定中有多少源于他对这种软饮料的渴望？也许在格陵兰苔原深处有一片地下湖，届时气候危机（其实并不存在）会让特朗普的钻探机能够接触到埋藏深厚的健怡可乐？欣喜若狂的因纽特人脱下他们的海豹皮，跳入倾泻而下的液体中，意识到他们刚刚挖到了他们的新主人的丰厚黑金矿藏。像个被儿童化的尿布大王一样，特朗普在椭圆形办公室里确实安装了一个专门召唤健怡可乐的按钮。希望他不会把它和另一个按钮搞混。如果地球上所有的生命都被致命辐射毁掉，仅仅因为特朗普想喝500毫升的健怡可乐来配他的高热量汉堡和炸薯条，那就太遗憾了。

src_seg: But are we meant to take Trump's erratic announcements seriously? While the last concerned voices of the dying liberal press pen outraged articles to their dying liberal readers about Gaza hotels, the invasion of Canada and Trump making it compulsory to drink everything through a Trump Plastic Freedom Straw Company Deluxe Plastic Freedom Straw ™ ®, even cauliflower cheese soup, his homunculus Musk has been quietly dismantling the infrastructure of American government as you knew it. There are cup-and-ball tricksters on Parisian street corners with more subtle moves.
tgt_seg: 然而，我们真的应该认真对待特朗普那些反复无常的声明吗？当最后一群奄奄一息的自由派媒体还在为加沙的酒店、入侵加拿大以及特朗普强行要求使用特朗普塑料自由吸管公司出品的高级塑料自由吸管™®来喝水（甚至连花椰菜奶酪汤也要用吸管喝）等议题撰写愤怒的文章给那些渐渐消失的自由派读者时，他的傀儡马斯克却在悄然地打碎你所熟悉的美国政府的基础设施。巴黎街角的纸牌魔术师施展的伎俩都要比这更精妙。

但愿他不会把这个按钮和另一个按钮搞混。如果地球上的所有生命都遭受致命的核辐射，而原因仅仅是特朗普想要一桶500毫升的气泡饮料，好就着他的巨无霸和薯条一并灌下，那将是一件憾事。

src_seg: But are we meant to take Trump's erratic announcements seriously? While the last concerned voices of the dying liberal press pen outraged articles to their dying liberal readers about Gaza hotels, the invasion of Canada and Trump making it compulsory to drink everything through a Trump Plastic Freedom Straw Company Deluxe Plastic Freedom Straw ™ ®, even cauliflower cheese soup, his homunculus Musk has been quietly dismantling the infrastructure of American government as you knew it. There are cup-and-ball tricksters on Parisian street corners with more subtle moves.
tgt_seg:
但是，我们应该认真对待特朗普那些反复无常的言论吗？
当濒临消亡的自由派媒体中仅存的那些忧虑之声，还在为他们同样日薄西山的自由派读者撰写着愤怒的文章，内容无外乎加沙的酒店、入侵加拿大，以及特朗普强制要求所有人——即便是喝花椰菜奶酪汤——都必须使用“特朗普塑料自由吸管公司豪华塑料自由吸管™®”之时，他一手炮制的小人马斯克却一直在悄悄地瓦解你所熟知的美国政府的基础设施。
即便是巴黎街头玩三仙归洞的骗子，其手法也比这要精妙。

src_seg: Half a dozen of Musk's own hand-harvested incels-in-waiting, the kind of people who under normal circumstances would have got rich by inventing a way in which hardcore digital pornography could have been mainlined directly into the bloodstream in liquid form, have, under the spurious authority of Musk's imaginary "department of government efficiency," gone in and stolen all the data about everyone and everything in the US ever. Never mind. I am sure they will use it responsibly. What can possibly go wrong?
tgt_seg:
马斯克亲手挑选的六个潜在“非自愿独身者”，就是那种在正常情况下本会通过发明将硬核数字色情内容以液体形式直接注入血脉的方法而发家致富的人，如今却打着马斯克虚构的“政府效率部”的幌子，潜入并窃取了美国有史以来关于每个人和每件事的全部数据。
算了。我相信他们会负责任地使用这些数据。又能出什么乱子呢？

src_seg: Some people gathered at the scenes of Musk's cost-cutting exercises and waved placards. Others sat and gawked at news footage of Kanye West's naked wife's arse or enjoyed disappointing trailers for the new Captain America movie, while the world as they knew it crumbled beneath their king-sized sofas. Keir Starmer backed away, as one might from a neighbour's unpredictable weapon dog, avoiding direct comment, dodging a commitment to the AI declaration like a coward and hoping for the best, while Trumpy growls and foams. Which simply won't do.
tgt_seg:
一些人聚集在马斯克削减成本措施的现场，挥舞着标语牌。其他人则安坐家中，呆看着坎耶·韦斯特妻子裸露臀部的新闻画面，或欣赏着令人失望的新《美国队长》电影预告片，而他们所熟知的世界，正在他们超大号的沙发下分崩离析。
基尔·斯塔默退缩了，就像人们会躲开邻居家那条性情难料的恶犬一样：他回避直接评论，懦弱地逃避对人工智能宣言做出承诺，同时寄望于最好的结果，而特朗普则在一旁咆哮发怒。这根本行不通。

src_seg: Look. I'm as disappointed as the next metropolitan liberal elitist champagne socialist by Starmer's government. While I accept, for example, the migration crisis must be addressed, I didn't expect Starmer, who once left his "village and went to the city of Leeds" and "discovered a whole new world of indie bands - like Orange Juice and the Wedding Present," to do it with Nigel Farage-style performative cruelty. Address the migration crisis, by all means, but don't be a c*** about it. Did Orange Juice suffer the indignity of their eponymous third album not even entering the top 50 in 1984 just so, 41 years later, Starmer could send Yvette Cooper out to downgrade the desperate, like Paul Golding in heels.
tgt_seg:
我和任何一个都市自由派精英、香槟社会主义者一样，对斯塔默政府感到失望。比如，尽管我承认移民危机必须得到解决，但我没想到，曾经离开“村庄”前往利兹市、“发现了一个由‘橙汁’和‘婚礼礼物’等独立乐队组成的全新世界”的斯塔默，会用奈杰尔·法拉奇式的表演性残忍来处理这个问题。解决移民危机当然可以，但别那么下作。
难道“橙汁”乐队在1984年遭受其同名第三张专辑甚至未能进入排行榜前50名的屈辱，就是为了让斯塔默在41年后，能派伊薇特·库珀出去，像个穿了高跟鞋的保罗·戈尔丁一样，去贬低那些走投无路的人吗？

src_seg: Currently, as Putin puffs up under Trump's protection and unregulated AI threatens to rewrite history in real time, Starmer is on his knees sucking the paper straw of Trump's presidency. I fear it may be about to explode in his mouth.
tgt_seg: 当前，普京在特朗普的庇护下愈发张扬，不受监管的人工智能正威胁着实时改写历史，而斯塔默却卑躬屈膝，妄图从特朗普的总统任期中分一杯羹。我担心此举最终会让他自食其果。

src_seg: A tale of two suckers: Donald Trump's plastic straws and Keir Starmer
tgt_seg:
两个“吸管”的故事：唐纳德·特朗普的塑料吸管与基尔·斯塔默
唐纳德·特朗普近日推出了一款印有其姓名缩写的塑料吸管，这一举动引发了广泛关注。这款吸管被视为他对环保政策的公开挑战，尤其是针对美国多个州和城市禁止使用一次性塑料吸管的法规。特朗普的支持者认为，这款吸管象征着他对“自由选择”的坚持，而批评者则认为这是一种对环保议题的漠视。
与此同时，英国工党领袖基尔·斯塔默也因一张照片引发了争议。照片中，他正在使用一根可重复使用的金属吸管，这一细节被部分媒体解读为他对环保议题的支持。然而，也有观察人士指出，这一举动可能更多是出于政治形象的考量，而非真正的环保行动。
两位政治人物的“吸管事件”反映了不同政治立场下的环保议题争议。特朗普的塑料吸管强调个人自由与市场选择，而斯塔默的金属吸管则暗示了对可持续发展的倾向。然而，无论是塑料还是金属，这两个吸管都成为了政治符号，折射出当代社会在环保与政治之间的复杂互动。

src_seg: It's difficult to know whether to set any store by Donald Trump's bleak and yet also often banal pronouncements, which read as if handfuls of offensive concepts have been tossed into the air by a monkey, read out in whatever order they landed and then made policy. Until it's clear they can't work. At which point, the monkey must toss again.
tgt_seg: 很难判断是否该对唐纳德·特朗普那些既阴郁又常常平庸的言论予以重视，这些言论读起来仿佛是一只猴子将一把冒犯性概念抛向空中，然后以它们落地的随机顺序宣读出来，并将其作为政策。直到事实证明这些政策行不通。届时，猴子只能再次抛掷。

src_seg: But this month, Trump, whose morning ablutions increasingly appear to consist of dousing himself in sachets of the kind of cheap hot chocolate powder I steal from three-star hotels, like a flightless bird stuck in the machine that glazes Magnum lollies, declared he wanted to build his hotels on the mass graves of Gaza. Hasn't Trump seen The Shining? It won't end well. Pity those whose children have the misfortune to die next to a monetisable stretch of shoreline. And hope humanity's next wave of mass killings happens somewhere uneven and way inland that hopefully wouldn't even make a decent golf course.
tgt_seg: 但本月，特朗普——其晨间梳洗仪式越来越像是将自己浸泡在从三星级酒店偷来的廉价热巧克力粉包里，活像一只被困在玛格南冰淇淋糖衣机里的不会飞的鸟——宣称他想在加沙的万人坑上建造他的酒店。特朗普难道没看过《闪灵》吗？这不会有好结果的。可怜那些孩子不幸死在一片可开发的海岸线旁的人们。但愿人类下一波大规模杀戮发生在某个崎岖不平的内陆地区，那里甚至连一片像样的高尔夫球场都建不起来。

src_seg: Is Ukraine the frontier upon which the future of European democracy hinges, or is it just a massive stretch of undeveloped fairway, its leisure/conference utility value currently compromised only by the desire of some losers to continue living in the country they consider home? Where we see the falling domino chain that starts with Poland and ends in your back garden, does Trump see only a succession of 18-hole courses full of men in caps and enormous flapping flares brokering manly deals at the tee? Drive your golf carts over the bones of the dead!
tgt_seg: 乌克兰是否是欧洲民主未来的关键前线，还是仅仅是一片尚未开发的广阔区域，其休闲会议功能目前仅因一些失败者希望继续生活在他们视为家园的国家而受到影响？当我们看到从波兰开始、最终延伸到你家后院的多米诺骨牌效应时，特朗普是否只看到了一连串的18洞高尔夫球场，里面满是戴着帽子、穿着宽松裤子的男人在发球台上达成所谓的男子汉协议？让你们的高尔夫球车从死者的骨头上碾过吧！

src_seg: But maybe Trump's horrible mouth-cack is just continuing evidence of his former acolyte Steve Bannon's advice to "flood the zone with shit"? Does Trump really hate all sea creatures so much that he has to reinstate the plastic straws Joe Biden successfully, and commendably, outlawed? Perhaps he was once told to keep his hands to himself by a mermaid. "These things don't work," Trump said of paper straws. "I've had them many times, and on occasion, they break, they explode." Must millions of seabirds, turtles, manatees and dolphins die because Trump imagines that paper straws explode? Or so he can suck up his Diet Coke fast enough to amuse Elon Musk, Pete Hegseth and JD Vance by burping a smelly chorus of YMCA in Biden's face next time there's a gathering of ex-presidents.
tgt_seg:

Delighted Inuit strip off their sealskins and dance in the showering liquid as they realise they have just struck a rich seam of their new master's black gold. It will be a shame if all life on Earth is fatally irradiated just because Trump wanted a 500ml bucket of fizz to swill down his Big Mac and fries.

Delighted Inuit strip off their sealskins and dance in the showering liquid as they realise they have just struck a rich seam of their new master's black gold. Like some kind of infantilised diaper king, Trump has genuinely had a special Diet Coke-summoning button installed in the Oval Office. Hopefully, he won't get it mixed up with that other button. src_seg: But are we meant to take Trump's erratic announcements seriously? And hope humanity's next wave of mass killings happens somewhere uneven and way inland that hopefully wouldn't even make a decent golf course.
tgt_seg: 但这个月，特朗普的早晨沐浴似乎越来越像是用我从三星级酒店偷来的那种廉价热可可粉撒在自己身上，就像一只不会飞的鸟被困在用来给马格努姆棒棒糖上釉的机器里，他宣布他想在加沙的大屠杀墓地上建造他的酒店。特朗普有没有看过《闪灵》？这不会有好结果。那些孩子们不幸死在可货币化的海岸线附近的人们真是可怜。希望下一波大规模屠杀发生在一个崎岖不平的地方，远在内陆，希望那里连一个体面的高尔夫球场都建不起来。

src_seg: Is Ukraine the frontier upon which the future of European democracy hinges, or is it just a massive stretch of undeveloped fairway, its leisure/conference utility value currently compromised only by the desire of some losers to continue living in the country they consider home? Where we see the falling domino chain that starts with Poland and ends in your back garden, does Trump see only a succession of 18-hole courses full of men in caps and enormous flapping flares brokering manly deals at the tee? Drive your golf carts over the bones of the dead!
tgt_seg: 乌克兰是欧洲民主未来的关键边界吗？还是仅仅是一个未开发的广阔区域，其休闲和会议的实用价值目前仅仅因为一些失败者想要继续留在他们认为是家的地方而受到影响？当我们看到从波兰开始，一直延伸到你家门口的多米诺骨牌链，特朗普看到的仅仅是一系列18洞高尔夫球场，里面有戴着帽子的大个子在挥舞着巨大的旗帜，在发球台上进行着男子汉的交易吗？用你的高尔夫球车碾压死人的尸骨！

src_seg: But maybe Trump's horrible mouth-cack is just continuing evidence of his former acolyte Steve Bannon's advice to "flood the zone with shit"? Does Trump really hate all sea creatures so much that he has to reinstate the plastic straws Joe Biden successfully, and commendably, outlawed? Perhaps he was once told to keep his hands to himself by a mermaid. "These things don't work," Trump said of paper straws. "I've had them many times, and on occasion, they break, they explode." Must millions of seabirds, turtles, manatees and dolphins die because Trump imagines that paper straws explode? Or so he can suck up his Diet Coke fast enough to amuse Elon Musk, Pete Hegseth and JD Vance by burping a smelly chorus of YMCA in Biden's face next time there's a gathering of ex-presidents.
tgt_seg: 但也许特朗普的可怕言论只是他前追随者史蒂夫·班农“向区域内倾倒垃圾”的建议的继续吗？特朗普真的如此痛恨所有海洋生物，以至于他不得不重新启用乔·拜登成功并值得称赞地禁止的塑料吸管吗？也许他曾经被一只美人鱼告诫过要把手放在自己身上。“纸吸管不管用，”特朗普说。“我多次使用过，有时会断裂，甚至会爆炸。”特朗普的想法是，数以百万计的海鸟、海龟、海牛和海豚会因此而死吗？这样他就可以快速吸上他的健怡可乐，以便在下一次前总统聚会时，通过在拜登面前打嗝并发出一首臭气熏天的YMCA合唱来取悦埃隆·马斯克、皮特·赫格斯和J·D·万斯。

src_seg: Because Trump, a fully grown man with unlimited funds, loves Diet Coke, and it's tempting to wonder how many of his seemingly incomprehensible policy decisions can be traced back to his desire to be continually saturated by the soft drink. Maybe there is a subterranean lake of the stuff somewhere deep beneath the Greenland tundra that the climate crisis, which doesn't exist, will soon make accessible to Trump's deep Diet Coke drills? Delighted Inuit strip off their sealskins and dance in the showering liquid as they realise they have just struck a rich seam of their new master's black gold. Like some kind of infantilised diaper king, Trump has genuinely had a special Diet Coke-summoning button installed in the Oval Office. Hopefully, he won't get it mixed up with that other button. It will be a shame if all life on Earth is fatally irradiated just because Trump wanted a 500ml bucket of fizz to swill down his Big Mac and fries.
tgt_seg: 因为特朗普这个身家丰厚的成年人喜欢健怡可乐，很容易想到，他的许多看似不可理解的政策决定是否可以追溯到他对不断饮用软饮料的渴望。也许在格陵兰冻土层深处有一个地下湖泊，里面充满了这种饮料，而气候危机（其实并不存在）很快就会使特朗普的深层可乐钻井能够开采到这种饮料。喜悦的因纽特人脱下海豹皮衣，在洒满液体的淋浴间跳舞，他们意识到自己刚刚在他们新主人的黑金矿脉中找到了一处富矿。就像某种幼稚的尿布国王一样，特朗普真的在椭圆形办公室安装了一个专门召唤健怡可乐的按钮。希望他不会把它和另一个按钮搞混。如果地球上的所有生命都因为特朗普想要一桶500毫升的可乐来喝下他的汉堡和薯条而受到致命的辐射，那将是多么的可惜。

src_seg: But are we meant to take Trump's erratic announcements seriously? While the last concerned voices of the dying liberal press pen outraged articles to their dying liberal readers about Gaza hotels, the invasion of Canada and Trump making it compulsory to drink everything through a Trump Plastic Freedom Straw Company Deluxe Plastic Freedom Straw ™ ®, even cauliflower cheese soup, his homunculus Musk has been quietly dismantling the infrastructure of American government as you knew it. There are cup-and-ball tricksters on Parisian street corners with more subtle moves.
tgt_seg: 但我们应该认真对待特朗普的反复无常的声明吗？在自由派媒体的最后一声绝望的呼喊中，他们为自由派读者撰写了愤慨的文章，内容涉及加沙的酒店、加拿大入侵以及特朗普强制要求通过特朗普塑料自由吸管公司豪华塑料自由吸管™®喝下所有东西，甚至是花椰菜奶酪汤，而他的小人儿马斯克则在悄悄地拆除你所熟知的美国政府基础设施。巴黎街角的杯子和球的骗子们则有更隐蔽的手法。

src_seg: Half a dozen of Musk's own hand-harvested incels-in-waiting, the kind of people who under normal circumstances would have got rich by inventing a way in which hardcore digital pornography could have been mainlined directly into the bloodstream in liquid form, have, under the spurious authority of Musk's imaginary "department of government efficiency," gone in and stolen all the data about everyone and everything in the US ever. Never mind. I am sure they will use it responsibly. What can possibly go wrong?
tgt_seg: 马斯克亲手收割的等待着被“政府效率部门”授权的六个人，他们本来应该通过发明一种将硬核数字色情内容直接以液体形式输送到人体血液中的方法而发财，但他们却在马斯克虚构的“政府效率部门”的授权下，盗取了美国所有人和所有事的数据。无所谓。我相信他们会负责任地使用这些数据。什么可能出错呢？

src_seg: Some people gathered at the scenes of Musk's cost-cutting exercises and waved placards. Others sat and gawked at news footage of Kanye West's naked wife's arse or enjoyed disappointing trailers for the new Captain America movie, while the world as they knew it crumbled beneath their king-sized sofas. Keir Starmer backed away, as one might from a neighbour's unpredictable weapon dog, avoiding direct comment, dodging a commitment to the AI declaration like a coward and hoping for the best, while Trumpy growls and foams. Which simply won't do.
tgt_seg: 一些人聚集在马斯克削减成本的现场挥舞标语。其他人则坐着盯着新闻片段，看着肯伊·威斯特裸体妻子的屁股，或者看着令人失望的新版美国队长的电影预告片，而他们所熟知的世界却在他们巨大的沙发下崩溃。基尔·斯塔默（Keir Starmer）退缩了，就像人们对待邻居不可预测的武器狗一样，避免直接评论，像个懦夫一样躲避对人工智能宣言的承诺，希望一切顺利，而特朗比（Trumpy）则狂吠和流口水。这根本行不通。

src_seg: Look. I'm as disappointed as the next metropolitan liberal elitist champagne socialist by Starmer's government. While I accept, for example, the migration crisis must be addressed, I didn't expect Starmer, who once left his "village and went to the city of Leeds" and "discovered a whole new world of indie bands - like Orange Juice and the Wedding Present," to do it with Nigel Farage-style performative cruelty. Address the migration crisis, by all means, but don't be a c*** about it. Did Orange Juice suffer the indignity of their eponymous third album not even entering the top 50 in 1984 just so, 41 years later, Starmer could send Yvette Cooper out to downgrade the desperate, like Paul Golding in heels.
tgt_seg: 看看。我像其他大都市的自由主义精英一样对施马伯政府的表现感到失望。虽然我承认,例如,必须解决移民危机，但我没想到施马伯在“从乡村来到利兹市”并“发现了一个全新的独立乐队世界，比如橙汁乐队和婚礼现场”后，会以尼格尔·法拉奇式的表演性残忍来解决这个问题。当然，要解决移民危机，但不要这样做。41年后，橙汁乐队的第三张同名专辑在1984年没有进入前50名，而施马伯却派伊夫特·库珀去贬低像保罗·戈丁这样绝望的人。

src_seg: Currently, as Putin puffs up under Trump's protection and unregulated AI threatens to rewrite history in real time, Starmer is on his knees sucking the paper straw of Trump's presidency. I fear it may be about to explode in his mouth.
tgt_seg: 目前，在特朗普的保护下，普京气势汹汹，不受监管的人工智能威胁要实时改写历史，而史达默则跪在地上，吮吸着特朗普总统任期内的纸制吸管。我担心这可能会在他嘴里爆炸。

src_seg: It's difficult to know whether to set any store by Donald Trump's bleak and yet also often banal pronouncements, which read as if handfuls of offensive concepts have been tossed into the air by a monkey, read out in whatever order they landed and then made policy. Until it's clear they can't work. At which point, the monkey must toss again.
tgt_seg: 很难判断我们是否该重视唐纳德·特朗普那些悲观且常常单调的言论，这些言论仿佛是一只猴子把一把把冒犯性的概念随意抛掷，然后随意朗读并制定为政策，直到显而易见这些政策无法奏效，此时猴子可能会再次抛出这些概念。

src_seg: But this month, Trump, whose morning ablutions increasingly appear to consist of dousing himself in sachets of the kind of cheap hot chocolate powder I steal from three-star hotels, like a flightless bird stuck in the machine that glazes Magnum lollies, declared he wanted to build his hotels on the mass graves of Gaza. Hasn't Trump seen The Shining? It won't end well. Pity those whose children have the misfortune to die next to a monetisable stretch of shoreline. And hope humanity's next wave of mass killings happens somewhere uneven and way inland that hopefully wouldn't even make a decent golf course.
tgt_seg: 但本月，特朗普，这个早晨的洗漱习惯越来越像是用来自三星级酒店的廉价热巧克力粉喷洒自己的人，犹如困在给冰淇淋光滑的机器里的不会飞的鸟，宣称希望在加沙的集体坟墓上建酒店。特朗普难道没有看过《闪灵》吗？这不会有好的结局。可怜那些孩子不幸死在可以被商业化的海岸附近的人们。希望人类的下一波大规模屠杀发生在某个偏远且不平坦的内陆地方，那里甚至连一座体面的高尔夫球场都建不起来。

src_seg: Is Ukraine the frontier upon which the future of European democracy hinges, or is it just a massive stretch of undeveloped fairway, its leisure/conference utility value currently compromised only by the desire of some losers to continue living in the country they consider home? Where we see the falling domino chain that starts with Poland and ends in your back garden, does Trump see only a succession of 18-hole courses full of men in caps and enormous flapping flares brokering manly deals at the tee? Drive your golf carts over the bones of the dead!
tgt_seg: 乌克兰是未来欧洲民主的关键前线，还是仅仅是一片未开发的广袤草坪？其休闲/会议的实用性如今仅因一些失败者希望继续生活在他们称之为家的国家而受到损害？在我们看到自波兰开始、延伸至你后院的连锁反应时，特朗普是否只看到一系列满是戴着帽子与宽松裤子的男子在发球台上达成交易的18洞球场？驾着高尔夫球车驶过死者的骸骨！

src_seg: But maybe Trump's horrible mouth-cack is just continuing evidence of his former acolyte Steve Bannon's advice to "flood the zone with shit"? Does Trump really hate all sea creatures so much that he has to reinstate the plastic straws Joe Biden successfully, and commendably, outlawed? Perhaps he was once told to keep his hands to himself by a mermaid. "These things don't work," Trump said of paper straws. "I've had them many times, and on occasion, they break, they explode." Must millions of seabirds, turtles, manatees and dolphins die because Trump imagines that paper straws explode? Or so he can suck up his Diet Coke fast enough to amuse Elon Musk, Pete Hegseth and JD Vance by burping a smelly chorus of YMCA in Biden's face next time there's a gathering of ex-presidents.

src_seg: Because Trump, a fully grown man with unlimited funds, loves Diet Coke, and it's tempting to wonder how many of his seemingly incomprehensible policy decisions can be traced back to his desire to be continually saturated by the soft drink. Maybe there is a subterranean lake of the stuff somewhere deep beneath the Greenland tundra that the climate crisis, which doesn't exist, will soon make accessible to Trump's deep Diet Coke drills? Delighted Inuit strip off their sealskins and dance in the showering liquid as they realise they have just struck a rich seam of their new master's black gold. Like some kind of infantilised diaper king, Trump has genuinely had a special Diet Coke-summoning button installed in the Oval Office. Hopefully, he won't get it mixed up with that other button. It will be a shame if all life on Earth is fatally irradiated just because Trump wanted a 500ml bucket of fizz to swill down his Big Mac and fries.
tgt_seg: 由于特朗普是一个拥有无限资金的成年人，热爱健怡可乐，这让人忍不住思考他那些看似难以理解的政策决定中，有多少可以追溯到他希望不断沐浴在这种软饮料中的渴望。或许，在格林兰的冻土深处，有一个地下湖泊，气候危机（其实并不存在）很快将使特朗普的深层健怡可乐钻探可达？兴奋的因纽特人脱下海豹皮，在洒落的液体中舞蹈，他们意识到他们刚发现了新主人的黑金富矿。似乎如同某种幼稚的纸尿裤国王，特朗普真的在白宫安装了一个专门召唤健怡可乐的按钮。希望他不会把这个按钮搞混。如果因为特朗普想要500毫升的气泡饮料而导致地球上所有生命遭受致命辐射，那将实在是遗憾。

src_seg: But are we meant to take Trump's erratic announcements seriously? While the last concerned voices of the dying liberal press pen outraged articles to their dying liberal readers about Gaza hotels, the invasion of Canada and Trump making it compulsory to drink everything through a Trump Plastic Freedom Straw Company Deluxe Plastic Freedom Straw ™ ®, even cauliflower cheese soup, his homunculus Musk has been quietly dismantling the infrastructure of American government as you knew it. While the last concerned voices of the dying liberal press pen outraged articles to their dying liberal readers about Gaza hotels, the invasion of Canada and Trump making it compulsory to drink everything through a Trump Plastic Freedom Straw Company Deluxe Plastic Freedom Straw ™ ®, even cauliflower cheese soup, his homunculus Musk has been quietly dismantling the infrastructure of American government as you knew it. There are cup-and-ball tricksters on Parisian street corners with more subtle moves.
tgt_seg: 但我们是否应该认真对待特朗普的混乱声明？当最后一批死去的自由主义报纸笔者写出关于加沙酒店、加拿大入侵和特朗普让人们通过特朗普塑料自由吸管公司豪华塑料自由吸管™® 甚至是奶油奶酪汤来喝东西的愤怒文章时，他的小伙伴马斯克悄悄地拆除了美国政府基础设施。巴黎街头的魔术师有更精致的招数。

src_seg: Half a dozen of Musk's own hand-harvested incels-in-waiting, the kind of people who under normal circumstances would have got rich by inventing a way in which hardcore digital pornography could have been mainlined directly into the bloodstream in liquid form, have, under the spurious authority of Musk's imaginary "department of government efficiency," gone in and stolen all the data about everyone and everything in the US ever. Never mind. I am sure they will use it responsibly. What can possibly go wrong?
tgt_seg: 马斯克的六个自己精心挑选的网络自慰者，那些在正常情况下会因发明一种方法来直接将硬核色情内容注入血液而致富的人，在马斯克的想象中的“政府效率部门”的授权下，偷走了美国所有关于每个人和所有东西的数据。别担心。我相信他们会负责任地使用它。什么可能出错？

src_seg: Some people gathered at the scenes of Musk's cost-cutting exercises and waved placards. Others sat and gawked at news footage of Kanye West's naked wife's arse or enjoyed disappointing trailers for the new Captain America movie, while the world as they knew it crumbled beneath their king-sized sofas. Keir Starmer backed away, as one might from a neighbour's unpredictable weapon dog, avoiding direct comment, dodging a commitment to the AI declaration like a coward and hoping for the best, while Trumpy growls and foams. Which simply won't do.
tgt_seg: 一些人在马斯克的成本削减现场举着标语牌。其他人坐着看新闻片段，看凯尼·韦斯特裸体妻子的屁股，或者看令人失望的《美国队长》新电影预告片，而世界正如他们所知的在他们国王大小的沙发下崩溃。斯塔默避开了，像一个邻居的危险武器狗，避免直接评论，躲避AI宣言的承诺，像一个胆怯者，希望一切安好，而特朗普则咆哮和泡沫。这绝对不行。

src_seg: Look. I'm as disappointed as the next metropolitan liberal elitist champagne socialist by Starmer's government. While I accept, for example, the migration crisis must be addressed, I didn't expect Starmer, who once left his "village and went to the city of Leeds" and "discovered a whole new world of indie bands - like Orange Juice and the Wedding Present," to do it with Nigel Farage-style performative cruelty. Address the migration crisis, by all means, but don't be a c*** about it. Did Orange Juice suffer the indignity of their eponymous third album not even entering the top 50 in 1984 just so, 41 years later, Starmer could send Yvette Cooper out to downgrade the desperate, like Paul Golding in heels.
tgt_seg: 看吧，我和下一个都市自由主义精英 champagne 社会主义者一样失望斯塔默的政府。虽然我接受移民危机必须得到解决，但我没想到斯塔默，曾经离开他的“村庄去到利兹城市”，并“发现了一个全新的世界 - 像橙汁和婚礼礼物乐队这样的独立乐队”，会用尼吉尔·法尔奇风格的表演性残忍来解决它。解决移民危机，当然，但不要这样做。橙汁是否遭受了他们的同名第三张专辑在1984年没有进入前50名的侮辱，仅仅是为了41年后斯塔默能派耶特·库珀去贬低像保罗·戈丁在高跟鞋上一样的绝望的人。

src_seg: Currently, as Putin puffs up under Trump's protection and unregulated AI threatens to rewrite history in real time, Starmer is on his knees sucking the paper straw of Trump's presidency. I fear it may be about to explode in his mouth.
tgt_seg: 目前，当普京在特朗普的保护下膨胀，而无监管的人工智能威胁到实时重写历史，斯塔默正在跪下，吸特朗普总统的塑料吸管。我担心它可能在他嘴里爆炸。

src_seg: A tale of two suckers: Donald Trump's plastic straws and Keir Starmer
tgt_seg: 特朗普与斯塔默：两个被利用者

src_seg: It's difficult to know whether to set any store by Donald Trump's bleak and yet also often banal pronouncements, which read as if handfuls of offensive concepts have been tossed into the air by a monkey, read out in whatever order they landed and then made policy. Until it's clear they can't work. At which point, the monkey must toss again.
tgt_seg: 很难判断是否应该对唐纳德·特朗普那些既悲观又常常平淡的言论给予重视。这些言论听起来就像一只猴子随意抛出一些具有冒犯性的观点，按照出现的顺序念出，然后就变成了政策。直到这些政策无法奏效的时候。到那时，猴子又将重新开始。

src_seg: But this month, Trump, whose morning ablutions increasingly appear to consist of dousing himself in sachets of the kind of cheap hot chocolate powder I steal from three-star hotels, like a flightless bird stuck in the machine that glazes Magnum lollies, declared he wanted to build his hotels on the mass graves of Gaza. Hasn't Trump seen The Shining? It won't end well. Pity those whose children have the misfortune to die next to a monetisable stretch of shoreline. And hope humanity's next wave of mass killings happens somewhere uneven and way inland that hopefully wouldn't even make a decent golf course.
tgt_seg: 但本月，特朗普，其早间洗漱似乎越来越依赖于用廉价可可粉冲淋自己，就像我从三星级酒店偷来的那种，他像一只无法飞翔的鸟，宣称他想在加沙的万人冢上建造他的酒店。特朗普没看过《闪灵》吗？事情不会有好结果。可悲的是那些孩子不幸在海滨地区丧生的人们。希望人类下一次的大规模屠杀发生在地形崎岖、远离内陆的地方，那样连高尔夫球场都难以建成。

src_seg: Is Ukraine the frontier upon which the future of European democracy hinges, or is it just a massive stretch of undeveloped fairway, its leisure/conference utility value currently compromised only by the desire of some losers to continue living in the country they consider home? Where we see the falling domino chain that starts with Poland and ends in your back garden, does Trump see only a succession of 18-hole courses full of men in caps and enormous flapping flares brokering manly deals at the tee? Drive your golf carts over the bones of the dead!
tgt_seg: 乌克兰是欧洲民主未来命运的试金石，还是仅仅一片尚未开发的广大区域，其作为休闲和会议场所的价值，目前仅因部分人坚持在他们认为的故土上生活而受到影响？当我们看到从波兰开始，最终蔓延至你家后院的连锁反应时，特朗普是否仅仅将此视为一连串的18洞高尔夫球场，在那里，戴着帽子、穿着宽松长裤的男子在开球处进行商业交易？碾过逝者的土地，继续前行！

src_seg: But maybe Trump's horrible mouth-cack is just continuing evidence of his former acolyte Steve Bannon's advice to "flood the zone with shit"? Does Trump really hate all sea creatures so much that he has to reinstate the plastic straws Joe Biden successfully, and commendably, outlawed? Perhaps he was once told to keep his hands to himself by a mermaid. "These things don't work," Trump said of paper straws. "I've had them many times, and on occasion, they break, they explode." Must millions of seabirds, turtles, manatees and dolphins die because Trump imagines that paper straws explode? Or so he can suck up his Diet Coke fast enough to amuse Elon Musk, Pete Hegseth and JD Vance by burping a smelly chorus of YMCA in Biden's face next time there's a gathering of ex-presidents.
tgt_seg: 或许特朗普那些不当言论，只是其前助手史蒂夫·巴农“制造混乱”策略的延续？他是否真的对所有海洋生物都抱有如此强烈的厌恶，以至于要撤销拜登成功且值得称赞的塑料吸管禁令？也许他曾被美人鱼告诫过要避免不必要的举动。“这些东西不起作用，”特朗普说，谈及纸吸管，“我用过很多次，有时它们会断裂，甚至会爆炸。” 为了让数百万海鸟、海龟、儒艮和海豚因特朗普认为纸吸管会爆炸而死亡？或者仅仅为了在下一次前总统们聚会时，能够更快地喝完他的健怡可乐，并以此取悦埃隆·马斯克、彼特·海格塞思和JD·万斯，在拜登面前制造一种戏谑的场面？

src_seg: Because Trump, a fully grown man with unlimited funds, loves Diet Coke, and it's tempting to wonder how many of his seemingly incomprehensible policy decisions can be traced back to his desire to be continually saturated by the soft drink. src_seg: But this month, Trump, whose morning ablutions increasingly appear to consist of dousing himself in sachets of the kind of cheap hot chocolate powder I steal from three-star hotels, like a flightless bird stuck in the machine that glazes Magnum lollies, declared he wanted to build his hotels on the mass graves of Gaza. src_seg: Because Trump, a fully grown man with unlimited funds, loves Diet Coke, and it's tempting to wonder how many of his seemingly incomprehensible policy decisions can be traced back to his desire to be continually saturated by the soft drink. Maybe there is a subterranean lake of the stuff somewhere deep beneath the Greenland tundra that the climate crisis, which doesn't exist, will soon make accessible to Trump's deep Diet Coke drills? Delighted Inuit strip off their sealskins and dance in the showering liquid as they realise they have just struck a rich seam of their new master's black gold. Like some kind of infantilised diaper king, Trump has genuinely had a special Diet Coke-summoning button installed in the Oval Office. Hopefully, he won't get it mixed up with that other button. It will be a shame if all life on Earth is fatally irradiated just because Trump wanted a 500ml bucket of fizz to swill down his Big Mac and fries.
tgt_seg: 因为特朗普，一个拥有无限资金的成年男子，喜欢健怡可口可乐，不禁让人好奇，他那些看似不可思议的政策决定有多少可以追溯到他对这种软饮料的渴望。也许在格陵兰苔原的某个深处，有一个地下湖泊，气候危机（实际上并不存在）很快就会让特朗普的健怡可口可乐钻探设备能够接触到这个湖泊？兴奋的因纽特人脱下他们的海豹皮，在淋浴的液体中跳舞，因为他们意识到他们刚刚发现了这位新主人黑色黄金的丰富矿脉。就像一个被婴儿化了的尿布大王一样，特朗普真的在椭圆形办公室安装了一个专门召唤健怡可口可乐的按钮。希望他不会把它和其他按钮混淆起来。如果地球上的所有生命都因为特朗普想要一桶500毫升的碳酸饮料来搭配他的巨无霸汉堡和薯条而被致命地辐射，那将是一件很遗憾的事情。

src_seg: But are we meant to take Trump's erratic announcements seriously? While the last concerned voices of the dying liberal press pen outraged articles to their dying liberal readers about Gaza hotels, the invasion of Canada and Trump making it compulsory to drink everything through a Trump Plastic Freedom Straw Company Deluxe Plastic Freedom Straw ™ ®, even cauliflower cheese soup, his homunculus Musk has been quietly dismantling the infrastructure of American government as you knew it. There are cup-and-ball tricksters on Parisian street corners with more subtle moves.
tgt_seg: 但是，我们应该认真对待特朗普的反复无常的声明吗？当最后的自由派媒体的哀鸣声在为垂死的自由派读者撰写关于加沙酒店、加拿大入侵以及特朗普强制使用特朗普塑料自由吸管公司豪华塑料自由吸管™®（即使是花椰菜奶酪汤）的文章时，他的傀儡马斯克一直在悄悄拆除你所知道的美国政府的基础设施。巴黎街角的杯球魔术师的动作要更微妙一些。

src_seg: Half a dozen of Musk's own hand-harvested incels-in-waiting, the kind of people who under normal circumstances would have got rich by inventing a way in which hardcore digital pornography could have been mainlined directly into the bloodstream in liquid form, have, under the spurious authority of Musk's imaginary "department of government efficiency," gone in and stolen all the data about everyone and everything in the US ever. Never mind. I am sure they will use it responsibly. What can possibly go wrong?
tgt_seg: 马斯克亲自挑选的六个潜在的“禁欲者”——在正常情况下，这些人会通过发明一种将硬核数字色情直接以液体形式输送到血液中的方法致富——在马斯克虚构的“政府效率部门”的虚假授权下，闯入并窃取了所有关于美国所有人和一切事物的历史数据。别担心，我相信他们会负责任地使用这些数据。可能有什么事情会出错吗？

src_seg: Some people gathered at the scenes of Musk's cost-cutting exercises and waved placards. Others sat and gawked at news footage of Kanye West's naked wife's arse or enjoyed disappointing trailers for the new Captain America movie, while the world as they knew it crumbled beneath their king-sized sofas. Keir Starmer backed away, as one might from a neighbour's unpredictable weapon dog, avoiding direct comment, dodging a commitment to the AI declaration like a coward and hoping for the best, while Trumpy growls and foams. Which simply won't do.

src_seg: Look. I'm as disappointed as the next metropolitan liberal elitist champagne socialist by Starmer's government. Address the migration crisis, by all means, but don't be a c*** about it. Did Orange Juice suffer the indignity of their eponymous third album not even entering the top 50 in 1984 just so, 41 years later, Starmer could send Yvette Cooper out to downgrade the desperate, like Paul Golding in heels.

src_seg: Currently, as Putin puffs up under Trump's protection and unregulated AI threatens to rewrite history in real time, Starmer is on his knees sucking the paper straw of Trump's presidency. I fear it may be about to explode in his mouth.

src_seg: A tale of two suckers: Donald Trump's plastic straws and Keir Starmer
tgt_seg:
两个倒霉蛋的故事：唐纳德·特朗普的塑料吸管与凯尔·斯塔默
在最近的一次演讲中，前美国总统唐纳德·特朗普将塑料吸管与英国工党领袖凯尔·斯塔默相提并论，引发了广泛关注。特朗普声称，斯塔默在处理英国脱欧问题时，就像被塑料吸管缠住的鱼一样，无从下手。
特朗普在演讲中调侃道：“你们看，塑料吸管，多么简单的一个东西，却让那么多的人感到困扰。就好比斯塔默处理脱欧问题一样，完全不知道该从哪里开始。”
这一比喻迅速在社交媒体上传播开来，引发了各种讨论。支持者认为特朗普巧妙地揭露了斯塔默在脱欧问题上的无能；而批评者则认为这种比喻过于简单化，忽视了脱欧问题的复杂性。
斯塔默方面则回应称，特朗普的言论只是为了转移公众注意力，而他本人将继续专注于为英国人民服务，解决实际问题。
尽管特朗普的言论引发了争议，但不可否认的是，这一比喻生动地反映了政治领袖在面对复杂问题时的困境。塑料吸管，这个看似微不足道的物品，却成为了一个象征，折射出政治决策的艰难与复杂。

src_seg: It's difficult to know whether to set any store by Donald Trump's bleak and yet also often banal pronouncements, which read as if handfuls of offensive concepts have been tossed into the air by a monkey, read out in whatever order they landed and then made policy. Until it's clear they can't work. At which point, the monkey must toss again.

src_seg: Is Ukraine the frontier upon which the future of European democracy hinges, or is it just a massive stretch of undeveloped fairway, its leisure/conference utility value currently compromised only by the desire of some losers to continue living in the country they consider home? Drive your golf carts over the bones of the dead!

tgt_seg: 很难判断是否应该认真对待唐纳德·特朗普那些既阴郁又常常平庸的言论，这些言论仿佛是一只猴子把一把冒犯性的概念抛向空中，按它们落地的顺序读出来，然后就成了政策。直到这些政策显然无法奏效时，猴子又得重新抛一次。

src_seg: But this month, Trump, whose morning ablutions increasingly appear to consist of dousing himself in sachets of the kind of cheap hot chocolate powder I steal from three-star hotels, like a flightless bird stuck in the machine that glazes Magnum lollies, declared he wanted to build his hotels on the mass graves of Gaza. Hasn't Trump seen The Shining? It won't end well. Pity those whose children have the misfortune to die next to a monetisable stretch of shoreline. And hope humanity's next wave of mass killings happens somewhere uneven and way inland that hopefully wouldn't even make a decent golf course.
tgt_seg: 但本月，特朗普——他早晨的梳洗似乎越来越像是用我从三星级酒店偷来的那种廉价热巧克力粉小袋往自己身上泼，就像一只困在麦格农冰淇淋涂层机里的不会飞的鸟——宣称他想在加沙的大型万人坑上建造酒店。难道特朗普没看过《闪灵》吗？这不会有好结果。可怜那些孩子不幸死在可以变现的海岸线旁的人们。也只能希望人类下一波大规模屠杀发生在内陆某个地势崎岖、连高尔夫球场都修不起来的地方。

src_seg: Is Ukraine the frontier upon which the future of European democracy hinges, or is it just a massive stretch of undeveloped fairway, its leisure/conference utility value currently compromised only by the desire of some losers to continue living in the country they consider home? Where we see the falling domino chain that starts with Poland and ends in your back garden, does Trump see only a succession of 18-hole courses full of men in caps and enormous flapping flares brokering manly deals at the tee? Drive your golf carts over the bones of the dead!
tgt_seg: 乌克兰究竟是欧洲民主未来的前线，还是一大片尚未开发的球道？它的休闲/会议价值目前仅因一些“失败者”想继续生活在他们视为家园的国家而受损？当我们看到多米诺骨牌从波兰倒到自家后院的连锁反应时，特朗普是否只看见一连串18洞球场，满是戴帽子、穿着宽大喇叭裤的男人们在发球台上达成“男子汉交易”？开着高尔夫球车碾过死者的骨骸！

src_seg: But maybe Trump's horrible mouth-cack is just continuing evidence of his former acolyte Steve Bannon's advice to "flood the zone with shit"? Does Trump really hate all sea creatures so much that he has to reinstate the plastic straws Joe Biden successfully, and commendably, outlawed? Perhaps he was once told to keep his hands to himself by a mermaid. "These things don't work," Trump said of paper straws. "I've had them many times, and on occasion, they break, they explode." Must millions of seabirds, turtles, manatees and dolphins die because Trump imagines that paper straws explode? Or so he can suck up his Diet Coke fast enough to amuse Elon Musk, Pete Hegseth and JD Vance by burping a smelly chorus of YMCA in Biden's face next time there's a gathering of ex-presidents.
tgt_seg: 但也许，特朗普这些令人不适的胡言乱语，只是他前追随者史蒂夫·班农“用垃圾淹没舆论场”建议的又一例证？特朗普真的那么讨厌所有海洋生物，以至于要恢复拜登成功、值得称赞地禁止的塑料吸管吗？也许他曾被美人鱼告诫“手要放好”。特朗普谈到纸吸管时说：“这些东西没用，我用过很多次，有时候会断，有时候会爆。”难道数百万只海鸟、海龟、海牛和海豚都要因为特朗普想象纸吸管会爆炸而死？还是仅仅为了让他能更快地吸完健怡可乐，好在下次前总统聚会时对着拜登打嗝，逗乐埃隆·马斯克、皮特·赫格塞斯和JD·万斯，合唱一曲难闻的《YMCA》。

src_seg: Like some kind of infantilised diaper king, Trump has genuinely had a special Diet Coke-summoning button installed in the Oval Office
tgt_seg: 就像某种被婴儿化的“尿布之王”，特朗普真的在椭圆形办公室里装了一个专门召唤健怡可乐的按钮

src_seg: Because Trump, a fully grown man with unlimited funds, loves Diet Coke, and it's tempting to wonder how many of his seemingly incomprehensible policy decisions can be traced back to his desire to be continually saturated by the soft drink. Maybe there is a subterranean lake of the stuff somewhere deep beneath the Greenland tundra that the climate crisis, which doesn't exist, will soon make accessible to Trump's deep Diet Coke drills? Delighted Inuit strip off their sealskins and dance in the showering liquid as they realise they have just struck a rich seam of their new master's black gold. Like some kind of infantilised diaper king, Trump has genuinely had a special Diet Coke-summoning button installed in the Oval Office. Hopefully, he won't get it mixed up with that other button. It will be a shame if all life on Earth is fatally irradiated just because Trump wanted a 500ml bucket of fizz to swill down his Big Mac and fries.
tgt_seg: 因为特朗普，一个成年且资金无限的人，酷爱健怡可乐，让人不禁想，他那些看似难以理解的政策决策，有多少可以追溯到他想被这种饮料持续浸润的渴望。也许在格陵兰冻原深处，真的有一片健怡可乐的地下湖，气候危机（他认为并不存在）很快就会让他的深井钻机得以开采？欣喜的因纽特人脱下海豹皮，在喷涌的饮料中起舞，因为他们发现了新主人的“黑金”富矿。就像某种被婴儿化的“尿布之王”，特朗普真的在椭圆形办公室里装了一个专门召唤健怡可乐的按钮。希望他不会把它和另一个按钮搞混。如果仅仅因为特朗普想要一桶500毫升的汽水来配他的巨无霸和薯条，导致地球上所有生命都被致命辐射，那就太遗憾了。

src_seg: But are we meant to take Trump's erratic announcements seriously? While the last concerned voices of the dying liberal press pen outraged articles to their dying liberal readers about Gaza hotels, the invasion of Canada and Trump making it compulsory to drink everything through a Trump Plastic Freedom Straw Company Deluxe Plastic Freedom Straw ™ ®, even cauliflower cheese soup, his homunculus Musk has been quietly dismantling the infrastructure of American government as you knew it. There are cup-and-ball tricksters on Parisian street corners with more subtle moves.
tgt_seg: 但我们真的要认真对待特朗普那些反复无常的声明吗？当垂死的自由派媒体最后的担忧之声还在为加沙酒店、入侵加拿大，以及特朗普强制所有人用“特朗普塑料自由吸管公司豪华塑料自由吸管™®”喝饮料（甚至包括菜花奶酪汤）而写给他们垂死的自由派读者时，他的“分身”马斯克却在悄然拆解你所熟知的美国政府基础设施。巴黎街头的杯球戏法骗子都比他们高明。

src_seg: Half a dozen of Musk's own hand-harvested incels-in-waiting, the kind of people who under normal circumstances would have got rich by inventing a way in which hardcore digital pornography could have been mainlined directly into the bloodstream in liquid form, have, under the spurious authority of Musk's imaginary "department of government efficiency," gone in and stolen all the data about everyone and everything in the US ever. Never mind. I am sure they will use it responsibly. What can possibly go wrong?
tgt_seg: 马斯克亲自挑选的半打“准宅男”，这些人在正常情况下本可以靠发明一种能让重口味数字色情以液体形式直接注入血液的方法发财，如今却在马斯克虚构的“政府效率部”的名义下，闯入并窃取了美国历史上所有人和事的数据。没关系，我相信他们会负责任地使用这些数据。还能出什么岔子呢？

src_seg: Some people gathered at the scenes of Musk's cost-cutting exercises and waved placards. Others sat and gawked at news footage of Kanye West's naked wife's arse or enjoyed disappointing trailers for the new Captain America movie, while the world as they knew it crumbled beneath their king-sized sofas. Keir Starmer backed away, as one might from a neighbour's unpredictable weapon dog, avoiding direct comment, dodging a commitment to the AI declaration like a coward and hoping for the best, while Trumpy growls and foams. Which simply won't do.
tgt_seg: 有人在马斯克削减成本的现场举牌抗议。也有人坐在沙发上，盯着新闻画面里坎耶·韦斯特赤裸妻子的臀部发呆，或是看着新《美国队长》电影令人失望的预告片，而他们所熟悉的世界正在自家大沙发下崩塌。基尔·斯塔默则像躲避邻居那只不可预测的凶犬一样后退，避免直接评论，像个懦夫一样回避对AI宣言的承诺，寄希望于一切顺利，而特朗普则咆哮、口吐白沫。这显然是不行的。

src_seg: Look. I'm as disappointed as the next metropolitan liberal elitist champagne socialist by Starmer's government. While I accept, for example, the migration crisis must be addressed, I didn't expect Starmer, who once left his "village and went to the city of Leeds" and "discovered a whole new world of indie bands - like Orange Juice and the Wedding Present," to do it with Nigel Farage-style performative cruelty. Address the migration crisis, by all means, but don't be a c*** about it. Did Orange Juice suffer the indignity of their eponymous third album not even entering the top 50 in 1984 just so, 41 years later, Starmer could send Yvette Cooper out to downgrade the desperate, like Paul Golding in heels.
tgt_seg: 听着。作为下一个都市自由精英香槟社会主义者，我对斯塔默政府也和其他人一样失望。虽然我同意，比如说，移民危机必须得到解决，但我没想到斯塔默——那个曾“离开村庄，前往利兹市”，并“发现了一个全新的独立乐队世界——比如Orange Juice和The Wedding Present”的人，会用奈杰尔·法拉奇式的表演性残酷来处理问题。解决移民危机当然可以，但别做个混蛋。Orange Juice的同名第三张专辑1984年连前50都没进，难道就是为了让41年后的斯塔默派伊薇特·库珀像穿高跟鞋的保罗·戈尔丁一样去贬低那些绝望的人吗？

src_seg: Currently, as Putin puffs up under Trump's protection and unregulated AI threatens to rewrite history in real time, Starmer is on his knees sucking the paper straw of Trump's presidency. I fear it may be about to explode in his mouth.
tgt_seg: 如今，普京在特朗普的庇护下愈发嚣张，失控的AI威胁着实时改写历史，而斯塔默却跪着吸着特朗普总统任期的纸吸管。我担心，这根吸管很快就会在他嘴里爆炸。

src_seg: It's difficult to know whether to set any store by Donald Trump's bleak and yet also often banal pronouncements, which read as if handfuls of offensive concepts have been tossed into the air by a monkey, read out in whatever order they landed and then made policy. Until it's clear they can't work. At which point, the monkey must toss again.
tgt_seg: 很难说唐纳德·特朗普那些既阴郁又常常平庸的声明是否值得信赖，读起来就好像是一只猴子将一把把冒犯性的概念抛向空中，然后按其落地的顺序宣读出来，接着就成了政策。直到事实证明这些政策行不通。到那时，猴子必须再抛一次。

src_seg: But this month, Trump, whose morning ablutions increasingly appear to consist of dousing himself in sachets of the kind of cheap hot chocolate powder I steal from three-star hotels, like a flightless bird stuck in the machine that glazes Magnum lollies, declared he wanted to build his hotels on the mass graves of Gaza. Hasn't Trump seen The Shining? It won't end well. Pity those whose children have the misfortune to die next to a monetisable stretch of shoreline. And hope humanity's next wave of mass killings happens somewhere uneven and way inland that hopefully wouldn't even make a decent golf course.
tgt_seg: 但本月，特朗普宣布他想在加沙的万人坑上建造他的酒店。他早晨的梳洗似乎越来越多地包括将我从三星级酒店偷来的那种廉价热巧克力粉香囊浇在自己身上，就像一只飞不动的鸟，卡在了给梦龙雪糕上釉的机器里。难道特朗普没看过《闪灵》吗？这不会有好下场的。可怜那些孩子们，他们的不幸在于死在了一片可以被商业化的海岸线旁。希望人类下一波大规模杀戮发生在地势不平的内陆地区，最好是连一个像样的高尔夫球场都建不成的。

src_seg: Is Ukraine the frontier upon which the future of European democracy hinges, or is it just a massive stretch of undeveloped fairway, its leisure/conference utility value currently compromised only by the desire of some losers to continue living in the country they consider home? Where we see the falling domino chain that starts with Poland and ends in your back garden, does Trump see only a succession of 18-hole courses full of men in caps and enormous flapping flares brokering manly deals at the tee? Drive your golf carts over the bones of the dead!
tgt_seg: 乌克兰是欧洲民主未来的前沿阵地，还是仅仅一大片未开发的球道，其休闲/会议的利用价值目前只因一些失败者希望继续生活在他们视为家园的国家里而受到影响？在我们看到那始于波兰、止于你家后院的多米诺骨牌链时，特朗普是否只看到一连串的18洞球场，里面满是戴着帽子、穿着巨大喇叭裤的男人，在发球台旁撮合成交着“纯爷们儿”的交易？开着你的高尔夫球车碾过死者的白骨！

src_seg: But maybe Trump's horrible mouth-cack is just continuing evidence of his former acolyte Steve Bannon's advice to "flood the zone with shit"? Does Trump really hate all sea creatures so much that he has to reinstate the plastic straws Joe Biden successfully, and commendably, outlawed? Perhaps he was once told to keep his hands to himself by a mermaid. "These things don't work," Trump said of paper straws. "I've had them many times, and on occasion, they break, they explode." Must millions of seabirds, turtles, manatees and dolphins die because Trump imagines that paper straws explode? Or so he can suck up his Diet Coke fast enough to amuse Elon Musk, Pete Hegseth and JD Vance by burping a smelly chorus of YMCA in Biden's face next time there's a gathering of ex-presidents.
tgt_seg: 但也许特朗普那可怕的口水战只是其前追随者史蒂夫·班农“用狗屁淹没舆论场”建议的延续证据？特朗普真的如此憎恨所有海洋生物，以至于他必须恢复乔·拜登成功且值得称赞地禁止了的塑料吸管吗？也许他曾被一条美人鱼告诫过要管好自己的手。“这些东西不管用，”特朗普谈到纸吸管时说。“我用过很多次，有时候它们会断，会炸开。”难道就因为特朗普想象纸吸管会爆炸，数百万只海鸟、海龟、海牛和海豚就必须死去吗？或者，这样他就能足够快地吸完他的健怡可乐，以便在下次前总统聚会时，通过在拜登脸上打出YMCA的臭味合唱来取悦埃隆·马斯克、皮特·赫格塞斯和J.D.万斯。

src_seg: Because Trump, a fully grown man with unlimited funds, loves Diet Coke, and it's tempting to wonder how many of his seemingly incomprehensible policy decisions can be traced back to his desire to be continually saturated by the soft drink. Maybe there is a subterranean lake of the stuff somewhere deep beneath the Greenland tundra that the climate crisis, which doesn't exist, will soon make accessible to Trump's deep Diet Coke drills? Delighted Inuit strip off their sealskins and dance in the showering liquid as they realise they have just struck a rich seam of their new master's black gold. Like some kind of infantilised diaper king, Trump has genuinely had a special Diet Coke-summoning button installed in the Oval Office. Hopefully, he won't get it mixed up with that other button. It will be a shame if all life on Earth is fatally irradiated just because Trump wanted a 500ml bucket of fizz to swill down his Big Mac and fries.
tgt_seg: 特朗普是个拥有无限资金的成年人，他酷爱健怡可乐，这不禁让人怀疑他那些看似费解的政策决定中有多少可以追溯到他渴望被这种软饮料持续浸泡的欲望。也许在格陵兰苔原深处的某个地下湖里就储藏着这种东西，而那场根本不存在的气候危机很快就会让特朗普的深层健怡可乐钻井得以使用？欣喜若狂的因纽特人脱下他们的海豹皮，在喷洒的液体中跳舞，因为他们意识到自己刚刚发现了他们新主人“黑金”的富矿。就像一个被幼儿化的尿布国王，特朗普真的在椭圆形办公室安装了一个特制的健怡可乐召唤按钮。希望他不会把它和另一个按钮搞混。如果仅仅因为特朗普想用一大桶500毫升的汽水来配他的巨无霸和薯条，就让地球上所有生命都受到致命的辐射，那将是一个耻辱。

src_seg: But are we meant to take Trump's erratic announcements seriously? While the last concerned voices of the dying liberal press pen outraged articles to their dying liberal readers about Gaza hotels, the invasion of Canada and Trump making it compulsory to drink everything through a Trump Plastic Freedom Straw Company Deluxe Plastic Freedom Straw ™ ®, even cauliflower cheese soup, his homunculus Musk has been quietly dismantling the infrastructure of American government as you knew it. There are cup-and-ball tricksters on Parisian street corners with more subtle moves.
tgt_seg: 但我们应该认真对待特朗普这些反复无常的声明吗？当垂死的自由派媒体最后几位忧心忡忡的声音，向他们垂死的自由派读者撰写关于加沙酒店、入侵加拿大以及特朗普强制规定所有东西，甚至是花菜奶酪汤，都必须通过“特朗普塑料自由吸管公司豪华塑料自由吸管™®”来饮用的愤怒文章时，他那小人般的马斯克已经悄悄地拆除了你所知的美国政府的基础设施。即使是巴黎街角玩杯球把戏的骗子，其手法也比这更精妙。

src_seg: Half a dozen of Musk's own hand-harvested incels-in-waiting, the kind of people who under normal circumstances would have got rich by inventing a way in which hardcore digital pornography could have been mainlined directly into the bloodstream in liquid form, have, under the spurious authority of Musk's imaginary "department of government efficiency," gone in and stolen all the data about everyone and everything in the US ever. Never mind. I am sure they will use it responsibly. What can possibly go wrong?
tgt_seg: 马斯克亲手挑选的六个候补“非自愿独身者”——在正常情况下，这些人本可以通过发明一种将硬核数字色情内容以液体形式直接注入血液的方法而致富——在马斯克虚构的“政府效率部”的虚假授权下，进入并窃取了美国有史以来关于所有人和所有事的所有数据。没关系。我相信他们会负责任地使用这些数据。能出什么问题呢？

src_seg: Some people gathered at the scenes of Musk's cost-cutting exercises and waved placards. Others sat and gawked at news footage of Kanye West's naked wife's arse or enjoyed disappointing trailers for the new Captain America movie, while the world as they knew it crumbled beneath their king-sized sofas. Keir Starmer backed away, as one might from a neighbour's unpredictable weapon dog, avoiding direct comment, dodging a commitment to the AI declaration like a coward and hoping for the best, while Trumpy growls and foams. tgt_seg: 一些人聚集在马斯克削减成本的现场挥舞标语。其他人则坐着盯着新闻片段，看着肯伊·威斯特裸体妻子的屁股，或者观看令人失望的新版美国队长的电影预告片，而他们所熟知的世界在他们巨大的沙发下面崩溃。基尔·斯塔默后退，就像人们对待邻居的不可预测的攻击性狗一样，避免直接评论，像个懦夫一样躲避对人工智能宣言的承诺，希望一切顺利，而特朗普则狂吠和流口水。这根本行不通。

src_seg: Look. I'm as disappointed as the next metropolitan liberal elitist champagne socialist by Starmer's government. While I accept, for example, the migration crisis must be addressed, I didn't expect Starmer, who once left his "village and went to the city of Leeds" and "discovered a whole new world of indie bands - like Orange Juice and the Wedding Present," to do it with Nigel Farage-style performative cruelty. Address the migration crisis, by all means, but don't be a c*** about it. Did Orange Juice suffer the indignity of their eponymous third album not even entering the top 50 in 1984 just so, 41 years later, Starmer could send Yvette Cooper out to downgrade the desperate, like Paul Golding in heels.
tgt_seg: 看。我和下一个大都市自由主义精英香槟社会主义者一样失望，对 Starmer 的政府。虽然我承认，例如，必须解决移民危机，但我没想到 Starmer，他曾经离开“村庄去了利兹市”，“发现了一个全新的独立乐队世界 - 比如 Orange Juice 和 Wedding Present”，会用 Nigel Farage 风格的表演性残忍来解决它。解决移民危机，当然，但不要这样做。Orange Juice 是否遭受了他们同名第三张专辑在 1984 年甚至没有进入前 50 名的侮辱，以便 41 年后，Starmer 可以派 Yvette Cooper 去贬低像 Paul Golding 在高跟鞋中的绝望。

src_seg: Currently, as Putin puffs up under Trump's protection and unregulated AI threatens to rewrite history in real time, Starmer is on his knees sucking the paper straw of Trump's presidency. I fear it may be about to explode in his mouth.
tgt_seg: 目前，在特朗普的保护下，普京气势汹汹，不受监管的人工智能威胁着实时改写历史，而史达默则在特朗普总统任期内跪地乞求，我担心这可能会在他嘴里爆炸。

src_seg: Meghan's rebranded herself - and it's another valiant attempt to flog poshness to the little people
tgt_seg: 梅根再次包装自己——这是她又一次试图向普通人兜售高档生活

src_seg: In these days of darkness we must take delight where we can find it, and one reliable source is the Duchess of Sussex. In her latest venture, Meghan, who occupies the tricky position of having a large platform and not enough to fill it (see also: Brooklyn Beckham), launched a new lifestyle brand that, she promised in a short video, would be "beautifully weaving together everything I cherish - food, gardening, entertaining, thoughtful living and finding joy in the everyday." The brand American Riviera Orchard is dead. Long live the new brand, As Ever.
tgt_seg: 在这些黑暗的日子里，我们必须尽力寻找乐趣，而杜克萨斯郡主是一个可靠的信息源。在她最新的尝试中，梅根——她处于拥有很大平台却没有足够内容来填充的尴尬境地（参见：布鲁克林·贝克汉姆）——推出了一个新的生活方式品牌，并在一段短视频中承诺，这个品牌将“把我珍视的一切——食物、园艺、娱乐、体贴的生活和在日常生活中寻找快乐——美丽地交织在一起。”美国里维埃拉果园这个品牌已经寿终正寝。新的品牌“如常”（As Ever）万岁。

src_seg: The duchess and her husband, Prince Harry, have to do something and good luck to them, but it's hard not to study the rollout of As Ever for signs of the widening gap between Meghan's self-image and how the rest of the world sees her. ""As ever,"" writes the duchess on Instagram, "means "as it's always been" or some even say "in the same way as always,"" the "some" in this sentence apparently referring to the dictionary definition of a two-word phrase that no one has ever had trouble understanding.
tgt_seg: 这位公爵夫人与丈夫哈里王子必须做点什么，祝他们好运，但很难不去研究“如常”的推出过程，以寻找梅根自我形象与外界对她的看法之间日益扩大的差距的迹象。“如常”，公爵夫人在Instagram上写道，“意味着‘一如既往’，或者有人说‘以同样的方式’”，这句话中的“有人”显然指的是对一个两个单词的短语的词典定义，从来没有人对此有过理解困难。

src_seg: It's ridiculous, of course, as is the hello-little-people tone adopted by the former royal highness, in keeping with the general attitude of the famous towards the unfamous - namely, one of stating the bleeding obvious as though sharing the key to existence. Still, I find myself sympathising with Meghan, who in her Instagram post and its accompanying video faces the stark challenge of having to pad out thin material. "This is what I do," she says to camera, "and I haven't been able to share it with you for the past few years, but now I can." What is the "it" here, and what has stopped her from sharing it? (It may involve jam, as did her previous brand, which she launched by sending "limited edition" jars of preserve to, among others, Kris Jenner, Mindy Kaling and Tracee Ellis Ross, who apparently also got a fresh bag of lemons.) Anyway, whatever the content, she hints darkly at some "whispers" abroad that forced her to jump the gun and share news of As Ever before she was ready - because "I wanted you to hear it from me first."
tgt_seg: 当然，这很荒谬，就像前皇室高贵成员采用的亲民语气一样，这与名人的普遍态度一致——即把显而易见的事情说得好像在分享存在的秘诀一样。尽管如此，我还是对梅根表示同情，她在Instagram帖子和附带的视频中面临着填充单薄内容的严峻挑战。“这就是我所做的，”她对着镜头说，“在过去的几年里，我无法与你们分享，但现在我可以了。”这里的“它”是什么？是什么阻止了她与我们分享？（它可能与果酱有关，就像她之前的品牌一样，她通过向克里斯·詹纳、明迪·卡琳和特蕾西·埃利斯·罗斯等人发送“限量版”果酱罐头来推出这个品牌，他们显然还收到了一袋新鲜的柠檬。）无论内容是什么，她都暗示了一些“流言”，迫使她抢先分享“如常”的消息——因为“我希望你们能先从我这里听到这个消息。”

src_seg: The fact there is no story here makes Meghan's insistence that she is getting in front of the story all the more enjoyable, but the more curious aspect of the announcement is the "you" to whom she refers and the idea she clearly has of her audience. The celebrity lifestyle space is crowded, ferocious and notoriously fickle, littered with the carcasses of former brand leaders such as Chrissy Teigen. Target and Bloomingdales distanced themselves from the star around the same time as she was accused of, and later apologised for, cyberbullying a woman called Courtney. The space is also dominated by market leaders such as Gwyneth Paltrow and Rachel Zoe.
tgt_seg: 事实上，这里没有故事，这使得梅根坚持认为她正在抢先讲述这个故事更加令人愉快，但更令人好奇的是，她提到的“你们”和她对观众的看法。名人生活方式领域竞争激烈，变幻莫测，到处都是前品牌领导者的失败案例，如克里斯蒂·泰根。Target和Bloomingdales与这位明星保持距离，大约在她被指控（后来道歉）网络欺凌一个叫Courtney的女性的同时。这一领域也被市场领导者如格温妮丝·帕特罗和蕾切尔·佐伊所主导。

src_seg: Meghan is a minnow in these waters, but of course has her own secret weapon she isn't shy about using. In the new video, she deploys good old Harry to hold up the cameraphone and drop a few posh tones - "Is this thing on?" - to remind us that, even if As Ever isn't royal, exactly, it is at least royal adjacent. The new name is clearly a reach for something classier and more timeless than its predecessor, American Riviera Orchard, which sounded like a range of scented gift baskets you'd find at a discount shopping outlet, or the pair's charity arm, Archewell, a play on their son's name. Both brands have an aspirant lower middle-class vibe about them, which it would be rude to point out were it not for the fact that Harry and Meghan trade on class as part of their branding.
tgt_seg: 梅根在这些水域中只是个小人物，但她当然有自己的秘密武器，并且毫不羞于使用。在新的视频中，她让哈里王子拿着手机，冒出一两句高雅的腔调——“这东西开着吗？”——提醒我们，即使“如常”不是皇家品牌，但至少也是皇家相关的。新的品牌名称显然是在试图达到比其前身美国里维埃拉果园更高档、更永恒的境界，后者听起来像是你在折扣店里能找到的一系列香薰礼篮，或者是这对夫妇的慈善机构Archewell，一个与他们儿子的名字有关的玩笑。两个品牌都有一种志在必得的下层中产阶级气息，如果不是因为哈里和梅根把阶级作为他们品牌的一部分来经营的话，指出这一点是不礼貌的。

src_seg: What they are selling isn't poshness itself, which strictly speaking should entail low-comfort, hole-in-the-elbows, bad cooking and draughty houses, but - much like Trump and his performance of "billionaire" - a kind of ersatz poshness they imagine might appeal to the peasants. It's a hard one to get right and, with the new brand name, Meghan seems to have changed course in the direction of, say, a Calvin Klein perfume or something a bit more abstract and upmarket. Although for my money she was on to more of a winner with the obscure and personalised brand name The Tig, her first attempt at lifestyle content that had to be shelved when she started dating Harry. As she explained at the time, The Tig was derived from an abbreviation of her favourite wine, tignanello, and had about it the confidence of something genuinely felt rather than a brand name that has been kicked through a comms team.
tgt_seg: 他们所出售的不是高雅本身——严格来说，高雅应该意味着低舒适度、肘部有洞、糟糕的烹饪和通风的房子——而是类似于特朗普和他表演的“亿万富翁”——一种他们想象中可能吸引普通人的仿冒高雅。这很难做到正确，而梅根似乎已经改变了方向，比如说，转向了卡尔文·克莱恩香水或一些更抽象、更高档的东西。虽然在我看来，她最初尝试的生活方式内容品牌“The Tig”更具潜力，那是一个在她与哈里王子约会时不得不搁置的品牌。正如她当时解释的那样，The Tig源自她最喜欢的葡萄酒——蒂尼亚内罗（tignanello）的缩写，并且具有真正被感受到的信心，而不是一个经过公关团队推敲的品牌名称。

src_seg: Which brings us to the duchess's understanding of audience. Discounting the forfeiture of sympathy that comes with money and privilege, there is something akin to pathos in the video that I find painful to watch. Meghan's aw-shucks, I-know-you-love-me tone assumes not only goodwill but abject fandom on the part of an audience which, I suspect, is at least 50% made up of those who regard her not only critically but with downright derision. It is hard to witness. "Sending lots of love," she signs off with noblesse oblige and an almost charming dedication to what she imagines we think of her.
tgt_seg: 这让我们看到了公爵夫人对观众的理解。撇开因财富和特权而失去的同情心不谈，视频中确实有一种类似悲情的东西，让我感到痛苦难耐。梅根那“啊，我知道你爱我”的语气不仅假设了观众的善意，还假设了他们对她的盲目崇拜，而我怀疑，至少有50%的观众不仅对她持批评态度，甚至是鄙视。很难看到这一幕。“送上很多爱，”她以贵族义务和几乎令人着迷的奉献精神结束了视频，仿佛她真的在乎我们对她的看法。

The brand American Riviera Orchard is dead. Long live the new brand, As Ever.
tgt_seg: 在如今这个充满挑战的时代，我们应该尽力寻找并享受生活中的美好。而梅根·马克尔（苏塞克斯公爵夫人）无疑是其中一个可靠的“快乐源泉”。她最近推出了一家新的生活方式品牌，并在一段简短的视频中承诺，这个品牌将“完美地融合我所珍视的一切——美食、园艺、待客之道、注重生活品质以及在日常生活中寻找乐趣”。不过，她的“美国里维埃拉果园”品牌已经宣告结束，而新的品牌“As Ever”则应运而生。

src_seg: The duchess and her husband, Prince Harry, have to do something and good luck to them, but it's hard not to study the rollout of As Ever for signs of the widening gap between Meghan's self-image and how the rest of the world sees her. ""As ever,"" writes the duchess on Instagram, "means "as it's always been" or some even say "in the same way as always,"" the "some" in this sentence apparently referring to the dictionary definition of a two-word phrase that no one has ever had trouble understanding.
tgt_seg: 梅根公爵夫人和她的丈夫、哈里王子，正在努力做一些事情，祝他们好运。但很难不关注“As Ever”这个品牌发布的情况，并从中观察到梅根对自己的看法与外界对她的看法之间的差距。公爵夫人曾在Instagram上写道，“As Ever”的意思是“一如既往”或者“始终如一”，而她所说的“一些人”显然是指那些认为这个简单易懂的两个词的含义的人。

src_seg: It's ridiculous, of course, as is the hello-little-people tone adopted by the former royal highness, in keeping with the general attitude of the famous towards the unfamous - namely, one of stating the bleeding obvious as though sharing the key to existence. Still, I find myself sympathising with Meghan, who in her Instagram post and its accompanying video faces the stark challenge of having to pad out thin material. "This is what I do," she says to camera, "and I haven't been able to share it with you for the past few years, but now I can." What is the "it" here, and what has stopped her from sharing it? (It may involve jam, as did her previous brand, which she launched by sending "limited edition" jars of preserve to, among others, Kris Jenner, Mindy Kaling and Tracee Ellis Ross, who apparently also got a fresh bag of lemons.) Anyway, whatever the content, she hints darkly at some "whispers" abroad that forced her to jump the gun and share news of As Ever before she was ready - because "I wanted you to hear it from me first."
tgt_seg: 当然，这听起来很荒谬，就像这位前王室成员所表现出的那种居高临下的态度一样。这与名人普遍对待普通人的态度如出一辙——即，把显而易见的事情说得好像是揭示了人生的真谛。不过，我还是对梅根感到同情，她在她的Instagram帖子和相关视频中，面临着一个严峻的挑战，那就是要将内容尽可能地充实起来。“这就是我所做的事情，”她对着镜头说道，“而且在过去几年里，我一直无法与你们分享，但现在我可以了。” 那么，这里的“事情”是什么？又是什么阻止了她分享？（这可能与果酱有关，就像她之前的品牌一样，她通过向克里斯·詹纳、明迪·卡灵和特蕾西·埃利斯·罗斯等人赠送“限量版”果酱来推广该品牌，据说他们还收到了一袋新鲜的柠檬。） 无论内容是什么，她都暗示了一些“流言蜚语”，这些流言蜚语迫使她不得不提前公布“As Ever”的消息，因为“我希望你们首先从我这里听到这个消息”。

src_seg: The fact there is no story here makes Meghan's insistence that she is getting in front of the story all the more enjoyable, but the more curious aspect of the announcement is the "you" to whom she refers and the idea she clearly has of her audience. The celebrity lifestyle space is crowded, ferocious and notoriously fickle, littered with the carcasses of former brand leaders such as Chrissy Teigen. Target and Bloomingdales distanced themselves from the star around the same time as she was accused of, and later apologised for, cyberbullying a woman called Courtney. The space is also dominated by market leaders such as Gwyneth Paltrow and Rachel Zoe.
tgt_seg: 由于这件事本身并没有什么特别之处，梅根却坚持说自己是“掌控”了事件，这让人觉得颇为有趣。但更引人关注的是，她在声明中提到的“你”以及她对目标受众的清晰认知。名人生活领域竞争激烈、变化莫测，而且充斥着许多曾经的“领军人物”，例如克里斯蒂·泰根。当时，梅根还因涉嫌网络欺凌一位名叫考特妮的女性而受到指责，并为此道歉。与此同时，Target和Bloomingdale等品牌也纷纷与她划清界限。此外，这个领域还被格温妮丝·帕特洛和瑞秋·佐伊等市场领导者所主导。

src_seg: Meghan is a minnow in these waters, but of course has her own secret weapon she isn't shy about using. In the new video, she deploys good old Harry to hold up the cameraphone and drop a few posh tones - "Is this thing on?" - to remind us that, even if As Ever isn't royal, exactly, it is at least royal adjacent. The new name is clearly a reach for something classier and more timeless than its predecessor, American Riviera Orchard, which sounded like a range of scented gift baskets you'd find at a discount shopping outlet, or the pair's charity arm, Archewell, a play on their son's name. Both brands have an aspirant lower middle-class vibe about them, which it would be rude to point out were it not for the fact that Harry and Meghan trade on class as part of their branding.
tgt_seg: 在“皇室”圈子里，梅根算是个“小人物”，但她当然也有自己的“秘密武器”，而且她毫不犹豫地使用它。在一段新视频中，她让哈里帮忙拿着手机，并用他那富有贵族气息的声音说了一句“这个东西开着吗？”，以此来提醒我们，即使“As Ever”并非严格意义上的“皇室”，但至少也与“皇室”有所关联。这个新名字显然是为了追求比其前身“American Riviera Orchard”（听起来像是在打折商店里能买到的各种香味礼品篮）以及他们夫妇的慈善机构“Archewell”（这个名字是取自他们儿子的名字）更具品味和更具永恒感的品牌形象。“American Riviera Orchard”和“Archewell”这两个品牌都给人一种“渴望提升社会地位”的感觉，如果不是因为哈里和梅根将“阶级”作为他们品牌的一部分，我们或许不会特意指出这一点。

src_seg: What they are selling isn't poshness itself, which strictly speaking should entail low-comfort, hole-in-the-elbows, bad cooking and draughty houses, but - much like Trump and his performance of "billionaire" - a kind of ersatz poshness they imagine might appeal to the peasants. It's a hard one to get right and, with the new brand name, Meghan seems to have changed course in the direction of, say, a Calvin Klein perfume or something a bit more abstract and upmarket. Although for my money she was on to more of a winner with the obscure and personalised brand name The Tig, her first attempt at lifestyle content that had to be shelved when she started dating Harry. As she explained at the time, The Tig was derived from an abbreviation of her favourite wine, tignanello, and had about it the confidence of something genuinely felt rather than a brand name that has been kicked through a comms team.
tgt_seg: 他们所推销的并非真正的“高雅”，严格来说，“高雅”应该意味着生活简朴、衣着破旧、厨艺不佳以及居住环境简陋。但实际上，他们所推销的更像是一种“伪高雅”，就像特朗普塑造的“亿万富翁”形象一样，他们认为这种“伪高雅”可能会吸引大众。要成功塑造这种形象并不容易，而且，随着新品牌名称的推出，梅根似乎改变了策略，转向了更像卡尔文·克莱恩香水之类的、更抽象和更高端的产品。虽然在我看来，她之前的品牌名称“The Tig”（一个比较小众和个性化的名称）更有潜力，这是她第一次尝试的、关于生活方式的内容，但由于她开始与哈里王子约会，不得不放弃了这个品牌。“The Tig”这个名称源于她最喜欢的葡萄酒“tignanello”的缩写，而且它所蕴含的真诚感，远胜于那些经过市场营销团队精心策划的品牌名称。

src_seg: Which brings us to the duchess's understanding of audience. Discounting the forfeiture of sympathy that comes with money and privilege, there is something akin to pathos in the video that I find painful to watch. Meghan's aw-shucks, I-know-you-love-me tone assumes not only goodwill but abject fandom on the part of an audience which, I suspect, is at least 50% made up of those who regard her not only critically but with downright derision. It is hard to witness. "Sending lots of love," she signs off with noblesse oblige and an almost charming dedication to what she imagines we think of her.
tgt_seg: 这就引出了我们对梅根公爵如何看待观众的问题。撇开财富和特权所带来的同情心丧失不谈，这段视频中她所表现出的情感，让我感到有些难受。梅根那种“我知道你们爱我”的语气，不仅预设了观众对她的好感，还预设了观众对她的狂热崇拜。但实际上，我认为至少有50%的观众对她持批判态度，甚至带有明显的嘲讽。看到这些，让人很难受。“祝大家一切都好”，她以一种带有“贵族责任感”和近乎可爱的姿态，结束了这段视频，她似乎认为自己知道我们是怎么看待她的。

Both brands have an aspirant lower middle-class vibe about them, which it would be rude to point out were it not for the fact that Harry and Meghan trade on class as part of their branding.
tgt_seg: 在这样的水域中，梅根不过是一条小鱼，但她当然也有自己的秘密武器，并且毫不羞怯地加以使用。在新视频中，她请来老好人哈里来举着手机，说几句贵族腔调的话——“这东西开了吗？”——提醒我们，尽管“As Ever”未必真正皇室，但至少也沾点皇室边。新品牌名称显然比前作“美国河畔果园”（听起来像是折扣购物网站上的香氛礼品篮品牌）或他们慈善机构“阿奇韦尔”（Archewell，取自儿子名字）更显高雅、更显永恒。这两个品牌都带有一种令人难为情的中下阶层向上攀附的气息，若不是哈里和梅根将阶级感作为品牌营销的一部分，这种气息本不该被提及。

src_seg: What they are selling isn't poshness itself, which strictly speaking should entail low-comfort, hole-in-the-elbows, bad cooking and draughty houses, but - much like Trump and his performance of "billionaire" - a kind of ersatz poshness they imagine might appeal to the peasants. It's a hard one to get right and, with the new brand name, Meghan seems to have changed course in the direction of, say, a Calvin Klein perfume or something a bit more abstract and upmarket. Although for my money she was on to more of a winner with the obscure and personalised brand name The Tig, her first attempt at lifestyle content that had to be shelved when she started dating Harry. As she explained at the time, The Tig was derived from an abbreviation of her favourite wine, tignanello, and had about it the confidence of something genuinely felt rather than a brand name that has been kicked through a comms team.
tgt_seg: 他们真正兜售的并非真正的贵族气息——严格来说，那应该意味着低舒适度、肘部有洞的衣服、糟糕的烹饪和漏风的房子——而更像特朗普表演“亿万富翁”那样，是一种他们想象中可能吸引平民的伪贵族气息。要准确拿捏这一点并不容易，而新品牌名称似乎正朝着卡尔文·克莱恩（Calvin Klein）香水或更抽象、更高档的方向转变。不过，以我的观点，她此前那个晦涩而个性化的品牌名“The Tig”其实更有潜力，那是她最初尝试生活方式内容时所起的名字，后来因与哈里开始交往而不得不搁置。当时她解释说，“The Tig”源自她最喜欢的葡萄酒“Tignanello”的缩写，这个名字带着一种真实情感的自信，而不是经过公关团队反复推敲出来的品牌名称。

src_seg: Which brings us to the duchess's understanding of audience. Discounting the forfeiture of sympathy that comes with money and privilege, there is something akin to pathos in the video that I find painful to watch. Meghan's aw-shucks, I-know-you-love-me tone assumes not only goodwill but abject fandom on the part of an audience which, I suspect, is at least 50% made up of those who regard her not only critically but with downright derision. It is hard to witness. "Sending lots of love," she signs off with noblesse oblige and an almost charming dedication to what she imagines we think of her.
tgt_seg: 这又引出了公爵夫人对受众的理解。抛开因财富和特权而失去的同情心不谈，这段视频中流露出的某种悲情让我感到痛苦。“我知道你们爱我”的语气，不仅假设了善意，还假设了观众会对她盲目崇拜，而我怀疑，至少有50%的观众对她不仅持批评态度，甚至带着明显的蔑视。观看这样的场景令人难受。她以贵族式的仁慈和近乎可爱的执着结束视频：“送上满满的爱”，并坚信着她想象中我们对她的看法。

The brand American Riviera Orchard is dead. Long live the new brand, As Ever.

tgt_seg: 这让我们回到了公爵夫人对观众的理解上。撇开物质财富和特权所带来的同情心匮乏不谈，我在视频中发现了某种类似于悲情的情感，这种情感让我感到痛苦。梅根那种“哈哈，我知道你们都很爱我”的语气不仅暗示了善意，更是一种对观众盲目崇拜的期待。我怀疑观众中至少有50%的人对她的看法不仅批判，而且充满尖刻的嘲讽。这很难让人接受。她最后用贵族式的责任感和一种近乎迷人的执着宣告道：“送上满满的爱”，仿佛她深信我们对她的观感就是如此。

src_seg: Meghan's rebranded herself - and it's another valiant attempt to flog poshness to the little people
tgt_seg: 梅根重塑自我品牌——又一次向小老百姓兜售贵族气派的勇敢尝试

src_seg: In these days of darkness we must take delight where we can find it, and one reliable source is the Duchess of Sussex. In her latest venture, Meghan, who occupies the tricky position of having a large platform and not enough to fill it (see also: Brooklyn Beckham), launched a new lifestyle brand that, she promised in a short video, would be "beautifully weaving together everything I cherish - food, gardening, entertaining, thoughtful living and finding joy in the everyday." The brand American Riviera Orchard is dead. Long live the new brand, As Ever.
tgt_seg: 在这黑暗的日子里，我们必须在力所能及之处寻觅乐趣，而苏塞克斯公爵夫人便是一个可靠的来源。在其最新的事业中，梅根推出了一个新的生活方式品牌。她身处一个尴尬的境地：平台很大，内容却撑不起来（参见：布鲁克林·贝克汉姆）。她在一个短视频中承诺，新品牌将“把我所珍视的一切——美食、园艺、待客、用心生活以及在日常中寻找乐趣——完美地交织在一起”。American Riviera Orchard 这个品牌已死。新品牌 As Ever 万岁。

src_seg: The duchess and her husband, Prince Harry, have to do something and good luck to them, but it's hard not to study the rollout of As Ever for signs of the widening gap between Meghan's self-image and how the rest of the world sees her. ""As ever,"" writes the duchess on Instagram, "means "as it's always been" or some even say "in the same way as always,"" the "some" in this sentence apparently referring to the dictionary definition of a two-word phrase that no one has ever had trouble understanding.
tgt_seg: 公爵夫人和她的丈夫哈里王子总得做点什么，祝他们好运，但人们很难不去审视 As Ever 的推出过程，并从中寻找梅根的自我形象与外界对她的看法之间日益扩大的鸿沟的迹象。公爵夫人在 Instagram 上写道：“As ever 的意思是‘一如既往’，或者有人说‘和往常一样’。”这句中的“有人”显然指的是词典对这个无人不解的两词短语的定义。

src_seg: It's ridiculous, of course, as is the hello-little-people tone adopted by the former royal highness, in keeping with the general attitude of the famous towards the unfamous - namely, one of stating the bleeding obvious as though sharing the key to existence. Still, I find myself sympathising with Meghan, who in her Instagram post and its accompanying video faces the stark challenge of having to pad out thin material. "This is what I do," she says to camera, "and I haven't been able to share it with you for the past few years, but now I can." What is the "it" here, and what has stopped her from sharing it? (It may involve jam, as did her previous brand, which she launched by sending "limited edition" jars of preserve to, among others, Kris Jenner, Mindy Kaling and Tracee Ellis Ross, who apparently also got a fresh bag of lemons.) Anyway, whatever the content, she hints darkly at some "whispers" abroad that forced her to jump the gun and share news of As Ever before she was ready - because "I wanted you to hear it from me first."
tgt_seg: 这当然很可笑，就像这位前王室殿下所采用的“你们好啊，小老百姓们”的腔调一样，这与名流对普通人的一贯态度相符——即将显而易见的事情说得仿佛在分享生存的秘诀。不过，我发现自己还是有些同情梅根，她在 Instagram 的帖子和附带的视频中，面临着不得不将单薄的内容填充起来的严峻挑战。她对着镜头说：“这就是我做的事，过去几年我一直没能和你们分享，但现在我可以了。”这里的“它”究竟是什么？又是什么阻止了她分享“它”？（这可能与果酱有关，就像她之前的品牌一样。当时她将“限量版”果酱送给了克里斯·詹纳、敏迪·卡灵和翠西·艾利斯·罗斯等人，后者据说还收到了一袋新鲜柠檬。）总之，不管内容为何，她隐晦地暗示，外界的一些“流言蜚语”迫使她抢先一步，在准备好之前就分享了 As Ever 的消息——因为“我想让你们先从我这里听到”。

src_seg: The fact there is no story here makes Meghan's insistence that she is getting in front of the story all the more enjoyable, but the more curious aspect of the announcement is the "you" to whom she refers and the idea she clearly has of her audience. The celebrity lifestyle space is crowded, ferocious and notoriously fickle, littered with the carcasses of former brand leaders such as Chrissy Teigen. Target and Bloomingdales distanced themselves from the star around the same time as she was accused of, and later apologised for, cyberbullying a woman called Courtney. The space is also dominated by market leaders such as Gwyneth Paltrow and Rachel Zoe.
tgt_seg: 事实上这里本无事可说，这让梅根坚称自己是在抢占先机、引领话题的行为显得愈发有趣。但这次宣告中更令人好奇的，是她所指的“你们”，以及她对自己受众的清晰构想。名人生活方式领域拥挤不堪、竞争激烈且出了名的变幻莫测，遍地都是昔日品牌领军人物的“残骸”，比如克莉茜·泰根。大约在泰根被指控网络霸凌一位名叫考特尼的女性并为此道歉的同一时期，塔吉特和布鲁明戴尔百货公司都与她划清了界限。该领域还被格温妮丝·帕特洛和瑞秋·佐伊等市场领导者所主导。

src_seg: Meghan is a minnow in these waters, but of course has her own secret weapon she isn't shy about using. In the new video, she deploys good old Harry to hold up the cameraphone and drop a few posh tones - "Is this thing on?" - to remind us that, even if As Ever isn't royal, exactly, it is at least royal adjacent. The new name is clearly a reach for something classier and more timeless than its predecessor, American Riviera Orchard, which sounded like a range of scented gift baskets you'd find at a discount shopping outlet, or the pair's charity arm, Archewell, a play on their son's name. Both brands have an aspirant lower middle-class vibe about them, which it would be rude to point out were it not for the fact that Harry and Meghan trade on class as part of their branding.
tgt_seg: 在这些水域中，梅根只是一条小鱼，但她当然也有自己毫不避讳使用的秘密武器。在新视频中，她派出了我们亲爱的哈里，让他举着手机摄像头，说几句贵族腔调的话——“这玩意儿开着吗？”——来提醒我们，即使 As Ever 算不上真正的王室品牌，也至少是“王室周边”。新名字显然是为了追求比其前身更经典、更永恒的东西，比如 American Riviera Orchard，它听起来像是在折扣购物中心能找到的香氛礼品篮系列；或是他们夫妇的慈善机构 Archewell——这个名字取自他们儿子的名字。这两个品牌都带有一种渴望向上爬的下层中产阶级的气息，如果不是因为哈里和梅根将阶级作为其品牌的一部分进行交易，指出这一点或许会显得无礼。

src_seg: What they are selling isn't poshness itself, which strictly speaking should entail low-comfort, hole-in-the-elbows, bad cooking and draughty houses, but - much like Trump and his performance of "billionaire" - a kind of ersatz poshness they imagine might appeal to the peasants. It's a hard one to get right and, with the new brand name, Meghan seems to have changed course in the direction of, say, a Calvin Klein perfume or something a bit more abstract and upmarket. Although for my money she was on to more of a winner with the obscure and personalised brand name The Tig, her first attempt at lifestyle content that had to be shelved when she started dating Harry. As she explained at the time, The Tig was derived from an abbreviation of her favourite wine, tignanello, and had about it the confidence of something genuinely felt rather than a brand name that has been kicked through a comms team.
tgt_seg: 他们兜售的并非贵族气质本身（严格来说，真正的贵族气质应该包含低舒适度、手肘磨出洞的衣服、糟糕的厨艺和四处漏风的房子），而是一种他们想象中可能会吸引平民的、仿冒的贵族气质——这很像特朗普和他所表演的“亿万富翁”形象。这一点很难把握得恰到好处，而随着新品牌的命名，梅根似乎已经改变了航向，朝着比如CK香水或某种更抽象、更高端的方向发展。不过依我之见，她用那个晦涩而个人化的品牌名 The Tig 反而更有胜算，那是她对生活方式内容的初次尝试，但在她开始与哈里约会后不得不搁置。她当时解释说，The Tig 源于她最喜欢的葡萄酒 tignanello 的缩写，这个名字带有一种发自内心的自信，而不像是一个被公关团队反复琢磨过的品牌名。

src_seg: Which brings us to the duchess's understanding of audience. It is hard to witness. "Sending lots of love," she signs off with noblesse oblige and an almost charming dedication to what she imagines we think of her.
tgt_seg: 这就让我们谈到了公爵夫人对其受众的理解。撇开金钱和特权所带来的同情心丧失不谈，视频中有一种近乎悲情的东西，让我看得很难受。梅根那种“哎呀，我知道你们都爱我”的故作谦虚的语气，不仅预设了受众的善意，还预设了他们是自己的铁杆粉丝，而我怀疑，这些受众中至少有50%的人不仅对她持批评态度，甚至是赤裸裸的嘲讽。这让人不忍卒睹。她以一种贵族式的责任感和一种近乎迷人的执着，坚信着我们对她的看法，并以“送上许多爱”作为结尾。
