tgt_seg: 公主和她的丈夫，宾夕夺夺，必须做些什么，好运到他们。但是，难免地会在As Ever的推广中寻找扩大之间自我形象和世界上如何看待她之间的裂缝的迹象。“永远”，公主在Instagram上写道，“意味着“就如常”或者某些人称之为“永远一样”，“某些”在这句话中似乎指的是“永远”这个两个单词的字典定义，一个两个单词的短语，从来没有人有困难理解。

src_seg: It's ridiculous, of course, as is the hello-little-people tone adopted by the former royal highness, in keeping with the general attitude of the famous towards the unfamous - namely, one of stating the bleeding obvious as though sharing the key to existence. Still, I find myself sympathising with Meghan, who in her Instagram post and its accompanying video faces the stark challenge of having to pad out thin material. "This is what I do," she says to camera, "and I haven't been able to share it with you for the past few years, but now I can." What is the "it" here, and what has stopped her from sharing it? (It may involve jam, as did her previous brand, which she launched by sending "limited edition" jars of preserve to, among others, Kris Jenner, Mindy Kaling and Tracee Ellis Ross, who apparently also got a fresh bag of lemons.) Anyway, whatever the content, she hints darkly at some "whispers" abroad that forced her to jump the gun and share news of As Ever before she was ready - because "I wanted you to hear it from me first."
tgt_seg: 这显然荒谬，当然是前王子高贵的嫁妻在与众不同的态度，与著名人对于无名人的一般态度一致 - 即，一种声明明显的事实，就像分享生命的秘密一样。尽管如此，我还是感到与梅根同情，她在Instagram帖子和配套视频中面临着挑战，必须填充稀疏的材料。“这就是我做的”，她对摄像机说，“我过去几年没有能够与您分享，但现在我可以了。”“它”在这里到底是什么，她为什么没有能够分享它？（可能涉及榨汁，因为她的前品牌就是这样做的，她通过向克里杰杰娜、明德·卡林格和特里·爱丽丝·罗斯等人发送“限量版”榨汁来推广）。无论内容如何，她暗示着一些“喃喃话语”在海外传播，迫使她提前分享As Ever的消息，因为“我想您第一时间听到它”。

src_seg: The fact there is no story here makes Meghan's insistence that she is getting in front of the story all the more enjoyable, but the more curious aspect of the announcement is the "you" to whom she refers and the idea she clearly has of her audience. The celebrity lifestyle space is crowded, ferocious and notoriously fickle, littered with the carcasses of former brand leaders such as Chrissy Teigen. Target and Bloomingdales distanced themselves from the star around the same time as she was accused of, and later apologised for, cyberbullying a woman called Courtney. The space is also dominated by market leaders such as Gwyneth Paltrow and Rachel Zoe.
tgt_seg: 没有故事的存在使梅根的强调自己在面前的努力更加愉悦，但是更有趣的是这个宣传的“你”到底是谁，以及她对其观众的想象。明星生活空间是拥有众多竞争对手，野蛮和不可靠的，充满了前品牌领导者的尸体，如克里斯蒂怡恩。目标和布林顿莎尔斯在同一时间离开了星人，同时她被控和后悔对一名女子的网络谩骂。这个空间也被市场领导者如琼蕾·帕特罗和莱克尔·泽欧所领导。

src_seg: Meghan is a minnow in these waters, but of course has her own secret weapon she isn't shy about using. In the new video, she deploys good old Harry to hold up the cameraphone and drop a few posh tones - "Is this thing on?" - to remind us that, even if As Ever isn't royal, exactly, it is at least royal adjacent. The new name is clearly a reach for something classier and more timeless than its predecessor, American Riviera Orchard, which sounded like a range of scented gift baskets you'd find at a discount shopping outlet, or the pair's charity arm, Archewell, a play on their son's name. Both brands have an aspirant lower middle-class vibe about them, which it would be rude to point out were it not for the fact that Harry and Meghan trade on class as part of their branding.
tgt_seg: 梅根是这些水中的小鱼，但当然有自己的秘密武器，她不怯于使用。在新视频中，她使用了老实的哈里来握住摄像机，扔出一些奢侈的口音 - “这个东西工作吗？” - 来提醒我们，即使As Ever不是皇家，但它至少是皇家附属的。新名字显然是一种努力寻找更高级、更永久的东西，比它的前身美国西岸橙园品牌更加有吸引力，这 sounded like一个沉香礼盒你在折扣商店找到的产品，或者他们的慈善机构Archewell，一个玩弄他们儿子名字的玩法。两个品牌都有一个劣质中产阶级的感觉，这是吐槽的不好，因为哈里和梅根在品牌营销中交易着奢侈感。

src_seg: What they are selling isn't poshness itself, which strictly speaking should entail low-comfort, hole-in-the-elbows, bad cooking and draughty houses, but - much like Trump and his performance of "billionaire" - a kind of ersatz poshness they imagine might appeal to the peasants. It's a hard one to get right and, with the new brand name, Meghan seems to have changed course in the direction of, say, a Calvin Klein perfume or something a bit more abstract and upmarket. Although for my money she was on to more of a winner with the obscure and personalised brand name The Tig, her first attempt at lifestyle content that had to be shelved when she started dating Harry. As she explained at the time, The Tig was derived from an abbreviation of her favourite wine, tignanello, and had about it the confidence of something genuinely felt rather than a brand name that has been kicked through a comms team.
tgt_seg: 他们在销售的不是奢侈感本身，严格意义上应该包括低舒适、有洞的袖子、糟糕的烹饪和凉爽的房屋，但是，就像特朗普和他的“亿万富翁”演出一样，他们想要的是一种假奢侈感，他们认为可能会吸引农民。这是一个难以实现的目标，并且，通过新的品牌名称，梅根似乎已经改变了方向，朝着像卡尔汀尼香水或者更抽象、更高级的方向走去。尽管如此，我认为她在第一次尝试生活内容时更有可能成功，那是她放弃了The Tig这个匿名的品牌，当她开始和哈里恋爱时被搁置了。她在那时解释说，The Tig是从她最喜欢的葡萄酒槐槓尔洛来的，有着自己真正感到的自信，而不是一个被PR团队挤出来的品牌名称。

src_seg: Which brings us to the duchess's understanding of audience. Discounting the forfeiture of sympathy that comes with money and privilege, there is something akin to pathos in the video that I find painful to watch. Meghan's aw-shucks, I-know-you-love-me tone assumes not only goodwill but abject fandom on the part of an audience which, I suspect, is at least 50% made up of those who regard her not only critically but with downright derision. It is hard to witness. "Sending lots of love," she signs off with noblesse oblige and an almost charming dedication to what she imagines we think of her.
tgt_seg: 这带我们到了公主的对众人的理解。除了金钱和权力的废弃的同情之外，我在视频中感到的有些类似于情感的感觉，我觉得很难看。梅根的“哦哦，我知道你爱我”的口气假设不仅有好意，还假设对其观众的崇拜，我猜测至少50%的观众对于她不仅是批评性的，而且是厌恶的。这很难看到。“向您发送大量的爱”，她在诚恳的意义下和一种几乎可爱的对待我们所想象的她结束了。

The new name is clearly a reach for something classier and more timeless than its predecessor, American Riviera Orchard, which sounded like a range of scented gift baskets you'd find at a discount shopping outlet, or the pair's charity arm, Archewell, a play on their son's name. Both brands have an aspirant lower middle-class vibe about them, which it would be rude to point out were it not for the fact that Harry and Meghan trade on class as part of their branding.
tgt_seg: 梅根在这片水域中只是一条小鱼，但她当然拥有自己的秘密武器，并且毫不掩饰地使用它。在新发布的视频中，她让哈里拿着摄像机，并用一些高雅的口吻说：“这东西能用吗？”来提醒我们，即使“As Ever”并非严格意义上的皇室，至少与皇室有一定关联。这个新名称显然是为了追求比其前身“美国里维埃拉果园”更优雅、更永恒的形象，后者听起来更像是在折扣购物中心能找到的一系列香薰礼品篮，或者这对夫妇的慈善机构“Archewell”，这是对他们儿子的名字的巧妙玩弄。这两个品牌都散发着一种向上的中产阶级氛围，如果不是因为哈里和梅根将阶级作为其品牌的一部分进行交易，指出这一点可能会显得不礼貌。

tgt_seg: 他们所销售的并非真正的奢华，严格来说，奢华应该意味着低舒适度、袖口破洞、糟糕的烹饪和寒冷潮湿的房屋。但——就像特朗普和他的“亿万富翁”形象一样——这是一种他们想象中的替代性奢华，他们认为这种奢华可能会吸引到平民阶层。要做到这一点非常困难，而有了新的品牌名称，梅根似乎已经改变了方向，朝着像卡尔文·克莱恩香水或一些更抽象、更高端的东西发展。尽管在我看来，她最初的品牌名称“The Tig”更具潜力，它是一个晦涩而个性化的名称，是她第一次尝试生活方式内容，但在她开始与哈里约会时不得不搁置。正如她当时解释的那样，“The Tig”源自她最喜欢的葡萄酒“tignanello”的缩写，它带有一种真诚感受的自信，而不是一个经过公关团队推波助澜的品牌名称。

src_seg: Which brings us to the duchess's understanding of audience. Discounting the forfeiture of sympathy that comes with money and privilege, there is something akin to pathos in the video that I find painful to watch. Meghan's aw-shucks, I-know-you-love-me tone assumes not only goodwill but abject fandom on the part of an audience which, I suspect, is at least 50% made up of those who regard her not only critically but with downright derision. It is hard to witness. "Sending lots of love," she signs off with noblesse oblige and an almost charming dedication to what she imagines we think of her.
tgt_seg: 这让我们回到公爵夫人的观众理解问题上。撇开金钱和特权带来的同情心丧失不谈，我发现视频中有一种近似于悲情的氛围，让人感到痛苦。梅根那种“哎呀，我知道你们爱我”的语气，不仅假设了善意，还假设了观众对她的狂热崇拜，而我怀疑至少有50%的观众不仅对她持批判态度，甚至对她充满嘲讽。这很难看下去。“送上满满的爱”，她以一种贵族式的义务和近乎迷人的奉献精神结束了这段话，表达了她想象中我们对她的看法。

The brand American Riviera Orchard is dead. Long live the new brand, As Ever.

tgt_seg: 他们卖的不是 "奢华 "本身，严格说来，"奢华 "应该是低舒适度、"洞中之洞"、糟糕的烹饪和通风的房子，而是--就像特朗普和他的 "亿万富翁 "表演一样--一种他们想象中可能会吸引农民的伪奢华。这是个很难把握的问题，梅根用了新的品牌名称后，似乎已经改变了方向，比如说，Calvin Klein 香水或一些更抽象、更高档的东西。虽然在我看来，梅根的 "The Tig "这个晦涩难懂的个性化品牌名称更像是一个赢家，这是她在生活方式内容方面的首次尝试，但当她开始与哈里约会时，这一尝试不得不被搁置。正如她当时解释的那样，The Tig 源自她最喜欢的葡萄酒 tignanello 的缩写，这个名字充满了真正的自信，而不是一个经过公关团队斟酌的品牌名称。

src_seg: Which brings us to the duchess's understanding of audience. Discounting the forfeiture of sympathy that comes with money and privilege, there is something akin to pathos in the video that I find painful to watch. Meghan's aw-shucks, I-know-you-love-me tone assumes not only goodwill but abject fandom on the part of an audience which, I suspect, is at least 50% made up of those who regard her not only critically but with downright derision. It is hard to witness. "Sending lots of love," she signs off with noblesse oblige and an almost charming dedication to what she imagines we think of her.
tgt_seg: 这就引出了公爵夫人对观众的理解。撇开因金钱和特权而丧失的同情心不谈，这段视频中有些类似于悲怆的东西，我看了觉得很痛苦。梅根的 "我知道你爱我"（aw-shucks, I-know-you-love-me tone）语气不仅假定了观众对她的善意，还假定了观众对她的狂热。这很难目睹。"送上满满的爱"，她以一种高贵的姿态和近乎迷人的献身精神签下了她对我们对她看法的想象。

src_seg: Meghan's rebranded herself - and it's another valiant attempt to flog poshness to the little people
tgt_seg: 梅根重新塑造了自我——而这又是另一次试图将奢华推销给普通民众的努力

src_seg: In these days of darkness we must take delight where we can find it, and one reliable source is the Duchess of Sussex. In her latest venture, Meghan, who occupies the tricky position of having a large platform and not enough to fill it (see also: Brooklyn Beckham), launched a new lifestyle brand that, she promised in a short video, would be "beautifully weaving together everything I cherish - food, gardening, entertaining, thoughtful living and finding joy in the everyday." The brand American Riviera Orchard is dead. Long live the new brand, As Ever.
tgt_seg: 在这些黯淡的日子里，我们必须从能找到的任何事物中汲取快乐，而苏塞克斯公爵夫人梅根就是其中一个可靠的来源。在她的最新尝试中，梅根身处一个微妙的境地，拥有巨大的平台却缺乏足够的内容来填充它（也请参见：布鲁克林·贝克汉姆），她推出了一款新的生活方式品牌，在一段简短的视频中，她承诺该品牌将“完美地融合我所珍视的一切——食物、园艺、娱乐、深思熟虑的生活以及在日常生活中寻找快乐”。American Riviera Orchard品牌已逝，长久远存的新品牌As Ever。

src_seg: The duchess and her husband, Prince Harry, have to do something and good luck to them, but it's hard not to study the rollout of As Ever for signs of the widening gap between Meghan's self-image and how the rest of the world sees her. ""As ever,"" writes the duchess on Instagram, "means "as it's always been" or some even say "in the same way as always,"" the "some" in this sentence apparently referring to the dictionary definition of a two-word phrase that no one has ever had trouble understanding.
tgt_seg: 公爵夫人和她的丈夫哈里王子必须做些什么，祝他们好运，但很难不研究As Ever的推广过程，以寻找梅根自我形象与世界其他地区对她的看法之间日益扩大的差距。“As Ever”公爵夫人写在Instagram上，“意味着‘一如既往’，或者有人甚至说‘总是以同样的方式’”，这句话中的“有人”显然指的是对一个两字短语的字典定义，而这个短语没有人曾经难以理解。

src_seg: It's ridiculous, of course, as is the hello-little-people tone adopted by the former royal highness, in keeping with the general attitude of the famous towards the unfamous - namely, one of stating the bleeding obvious as though sharing the key to existence. Still, I find myself sympathising with Meghan, who in her Instagram post and its accompanying video faces the stark challenge of having to pad out thin material. "This is what I do," she says to camera, "and I haven't been able to share it with you for the past few years, but now I can." What is the "it" here, and what has stopped her from sharing it? (It may involve jam, as did her previous brand, which she launched by sending "limited edition" jars of preserve to, among others, Kris Jenner, Mindy Kaling and Tracee Ellis Ross, who apparently also got a fresh bag of lemons.) Anyway, whatever the content, she hints darkly at some "whispers" abroad that forced her to jump the gun and share news of As Ever before she was ready - because "I wanted you to hear it from me first."
tgt_seg: 这当然是荒谬的，正如这位前王室成员所采用的“你好，小老百姓”的语气一样，这与名人们普遍对待普通人的态度一致——即，将显而易见的事情说得好像分享了存在的关键一样。尽管如此，我发现自己同情梅根，她在Instagram帖子和随附的视频中面临着一个严峻的挑战，即需要用稀薄的内容来填充。“这就是我所做的，”她对着镜头说，“我过去几年一直无法与你们分享，但现在我可以了。”这里的“它”是什么，是什么阻止了她分享？（这可能涉及果酱，就像她之前的品牌一样，她通过向克里斯·詹纳、明迪·卡灵和特蕾西·埃利斯·罗斯等人发送“限量版”果酱来推出该品牌，他们显然也收到了一袋新鲜的柠檬。）无论内容如何，她隐晦地暗示了一些“耳语”迫使她抢先分享As Ever的消息，因为“我希望你们首先从我这里听到”。

src_seg: The fact there is no story here makes Meghan's insistence that she is getting in front of the story all the more enjoyable, but the more curious aspect of the announcement is the "you" to whom she refers and the idea she clearly has of her audience. The celebrity lifestyle space is crowded, ferocious and notoriously fickle, littered with the carcasses of former brand leaders such as Chrissy Teigen. Target and Bloomingdales distanced themselves from the star around the same time as she was accused of, and later apologised for, cyberbullying a woman called Courtney. The space is also dominated by market leaders such as Gwyneth Paltrow and Rachel Zoe.
tgt_seg: 事实上，这里没有故事，这使得梅根坚持自己正在掌控故事更加有趣，但公告中更令人好奇的方面是她所指的“你”以及她对受众的清晰概念。名人生活方式领域拥挤、激烈且臭名昭著地善变，到处是前品牌领导者的残骸，例如克里斯西·泰根。在她被指控并后来为网络欺凌一位名叫考特妮的女性而道歉的同时，Target和Bloomingdales也与这位明星保持距离。这个领域也由圭内斯·帕特洛和瑞秋·佐伊等市场领导者主导。

src_seg: Meghan is a minnow in these waters, but of course has her own secret weapon she isn't shy about using. In the new video, she deploys good old Harry to hold up the cameraphone and drop a few posh tones - "Is this thing on?" - to remind us that, even if As Ever isn't royal, exactly, it is at least royal adjacent. The new name is clearly a reach for something classier and more timeless than its predecessor, American Riviera Orchard, which sounded like a range of scented gift baskets you'd find at a discount shopping outlet, or the pair's charity arm, Archewell, a play on their son's name. Both brands have an aspirant lower middle-class vibe about them, which it would be rude to point out were it not for the fact that Harry and Meghan trade on class as part of their branding.
tgt_seg: 梅根在这些水域中只是微不足道的一员，但她当然拥有自己不吝使用的秘密武器。在新的视频中，她部署了老哈里来举起手机，并说出一些奢华的语气——“这个东西开着吗？”——以提醒我们，即使As Ever不完全是王室的，至少也与王室有关。新名称显然是在努力寻找比其前身American Riviera Orchard更优雅、更永恒的东西，后者听起来像是在折扣商店可以找到的一系列香味礼品篮，或者这对夫妇的慈善机构Archewell，这是他们儿子的名字的变体。这两个品牌都有一种渴望下层中产阶级的感觉，如果不是因为哈里和梅根将阶级作为其品牌的一部分来交易，指出这一点会显得粗鲁。

tgt_seg: 在这黑暗的日子里，我们必须在哪里找到乐趣，而梅根公爵夫人的存在就是一个可靠的源泉。在她的最新项目中，梅根，作为拥有大平台但内容不足（参见：布鲁克林·贝克汉姆）的尴尬位置，推出了一个新的生活方式品牌，她在一段短视频中承诺，这个品牌将“美好地融合我所珍视的一切——食物、园艺、娱乐、生活的思考和日常生活中的快乐”。这个品牌American Riviera Orchard已经不复存在，新的品牌As Ever诞生了。

src_seg: The duchess and her husband, Prince Harry, have to do something and good luck to them, but it's hard not to study the rollout of As Ever for signs of the widening gap between Meghan's self-image and how the rest of the world sees her. ""As ever,"" writes the duchess on Instagram, "means "as it's always been" or some even say "in the same way as always,"" the "some" in this sentence apparently referring to the dictionary definition of a two-word phrase that no one has ever had trouble understanding.
tgt_seg: 梅根和她的丈夫哈里王子必须有所行动，祝他们好运，但很难不在As Ever的推出中寻找梅根自我形象与外界看法之间日益扩大的差距的迹象。“As ever”，公爵夫人写在Instagram上，“意为“一直如此”，或者有些人说“以往的方式”，在这句话中，“有些人”显然指的是两个字的短语，没有人曾经有过理解它的困难。

src_seg: It's ridiculous, of course, as is the hello-little-people tone adopted by the former royal highness, in keeping with the general attitude of the famous towards the unfamous - namely, one of stating the bleeding obvious as though sharing the key to existence. Still, I find myself sympathising with Meghan, who in her Instagram post and its accompanying video faces the stark challenge of having to pad out thin material. "This is what I do," she says to camera, "and I haven't been able to share it with you for the past few years, but now I can." What is the "it" here, and what has stopped her from sharing it? (It may involve jam, as did her previous brand, which she launched by sending "limited edition" jars of preserve to, among others, Kris Jenner, Mindy Kaling and Tracee Ellis Ross, who apparently also got a fresh bag of lemons.) Anyway, whatever the content, she hints darkly at some "whispers" abroad that forced her to jump the gun and share news of As Ever before she was ready - because "I wanted you to hear it from me first."
tgt_seg: 这当然是荒谬的，就像前王妃采用的向平民百姓致意的语气一样，这与名人对普通人的态度一致，即陈述显而易见的事情，仿佛分享了生存的关键。尽管如此，我发现自己同情梅根，她在Instagram帖子和配套视频中面临的挑战是如何填充薄弱的内容。“这是我做的事情，”她对着摄像机说，“我过去几年一直没有能够与你分享，但现在我可以了。”这里的“它”是什么，是什么阻止她分享？（这可能涉及果酱，就像她之前的品牌一样，她通过向克里斯·杰纳、明迪·卡灵和特蕾西·埃利斯·罗斯等名人发送“限量版”果酱罐，来推销这个品牌，他们也收到了新鲜的柠檬）。无论内容如何，她暗示了一些“谣言”，这些谣言在国外流传，迫使她在准备好之前分享As Ever的消息，因为“我想你从我这里先听到。”

src_seg: The fact there is no story here makes Meghan's insistence that she is getting in front of the story all the more enjoyable, but the more curious aspect of the announcement is the "you" to whom she refers and the idea she clearly has of her audience. The celebrity lifestyle space is crowded, ferocious and notoriously fickle, littered with the carcasses of former brand leaders such as Chrissy Teigen. Target and Bloomingdales distanced themselves from the star around the same time as she was accused of, and later apologised for, cyberbullying a woman called Courtney. The space is also dominated by market leaders such as Gwyneth Paltrow and Rachel Zoe.
tgt_seg: 梅根坚持她要在故事前面，这使得梅根的坚持更加有趣，但这个公告更令人感兴趣的方面是她所指的“你”以及她对听众的想法。名人生活空间是拥挤、残酷和众所周知的，充满了前品牌领导者如克里斯蒂·泰根的遗骸。塔吉特和布鲁明戴尔在她被指控和后来为网络欺凌一名叫康妮的女人道歉的同时，与她保持距离。这个空间还由市场领导者如格温妮丝·帕特罗和雷切尔·佐伊主导。

src_seg: Meghan is a minnow in these waters, but of course has her own secret weapon she isn't shy about using. In the new video, she deploys good old Harry to hold up the cameraphone and drop a few posh tones - "Is this thing on?" - to remind us that, even if As Ever isn't royal, exactly, it is at least royal adjacent. The new name is clearly a reach for something classier and more timeless than its predecessor, American Riviera Orchard, which sounded like a range of scented gift baskets you'd find at a discount shopping outlet, or the pair's charity arm, Archewell, a play on their son's name. Both brands have an aspirant lower middle-class vibe about them, which it would be rude to point out were it not for the fact that Harry and Meghan trade on class as part of their branding.
tgt_seg: 梅根在这些水域中只是一个微不足道的人物，但当然她有自己的秘密武器，她并不羞于使用。在新的视频中，她让老哈里拿起摄像手机，说了几句贵族腔，“这个东西开了吗？”提醒我们，即使As Ever不是真正的皇室，至少也是皇室的邻居。新名字显然是为了追求比其前身American Riviera Orchard更高雅、更永恒的东西，这个名字听起来像是你在折扣购物点找到的香水礼品篮，或者是他们夫妇的慈善机构Archewell，这是他们儿子名字的游戏。这两个品牌都有中下层平民的味道，如果不是因为哈里和梅根在品牌推广中利用了阶级，这将是不礼貌的。

src_seg: What they are selling isn't poshness itself, which strictly speaking should entail low-comfort, hole-in-the-elbows, bad cooking and draughty houses, but - much like Trump and his performance of "billionaire" - a kind of ersatz poshness they imagine might appeal to the peasants. It's a hard one to get right and, with the new brand name, Meghan seems to have changed course in the direction of, say, a Calvin Klein perfume or something a bit more abstract and upmarket. Although for my money she was on to more of a winner with the obscure and personalised brand name The Tig, her first attempt at lifestyle content that had to be shelved when she started dating Harry. As she explained at the time, The Tig was derived from an abbreviation of her favourite wine, tignanello, and had about it the confidence of something genuinely felt rather than a brand name that has been kicked through a comms team.
tgt_seg: 他们推销的不是真正的贵族，严格来说，这应该意味着低舒适度、肘部洞、糟糕的烹饪和潮湿的房子，但就像特朗普和他对“亿万富翁”的表演一样，他们推销的是一种看起来可能吸引平民百姓的某种人造贵族。这很难把握，梅根似乎已经改变了方向，朝着像Calvin Klein香水或一些更抽象、更高档的东西发展。尽管我认为她更喜欢The Tig，这是她第一次尝试生活方式内容，当她开始和哈里约会时，她不得不把它搁置一边。她当时解释说，The Tig是她最喜欢的酒之一——蒂加诺的缩写，它有一种真正感受到的自信，而不是一个经过团队沟通的品牌名称。

src_seg: Which brings us to the duchess's understanding of audience. Discounting the forfeiture of sympathy that comes with money and privilege, there is something akin to pathos in the video that I find painful to watch. Meghan's aw-shucks, I-know-you-love-me tone assumes not only goodwill but abject fandom on the part of an audience which, I suspect, is at least 50% made up of those who regard her not only critically but with downright derision. It is hard to witness. "Sending lots of love," she signs off with noblesse oblige and an almost charming dedication to what she imagines we think of her.
tgt_seg: 这让我们来看看公爵夫人的观众理解。除了来自金钱和特权的同情心外，视频中还有一些类似于悲剧的东西，我发现很难看。梅根的“噢，我知道你爱我”的语气不仅假设了观众的好意，还假设了对她的绝对崇拜，我怀疑观众至少有一半的人不仅持批判态度，而且持彻头彻尾的嘲笑态度。这很难看到。“我给你发很多爱”，她以高贵的义务和几乎有吸引力的奉献精神结束，她想象我们认为她是谁。

src_seg: The fact there is no story here makes Meghan's insistence that she is getting in front of the story all the more enjoyable, but the more curious aspect of the announcement is the "you" to whom she refers and the idea she clearly has of her audience. The celebrity lifestyle space is crowded, ferocious and notoriously fickle, littered with the carcasses of former brand leaders such as Chrissy Teigen. Target and Bloomingdales distanced themselves from the star around the same time as she was accused of, and later apologised for, cyberbullying a woman called Courtney. The space is also dominated by market leaders such as Gwyneth Paltrow and Rachel Zoe.

src_seg: Meghan is a minnow in these waters, but of course has her own secret weapon she isn't shy about using. In the new video, she deploys good old Harry to hold up the cameraphone and drop a few posh tones - "Is this thing on?" - to remind us that, even if As Ever isn't royal, exactly, it is at least royal adjacent. The new name is clearly a reach for something classier and more timeless than its predecessor, American Riviera Orchard, which sounded like a range of scented gift baskets you'd find at a discount shopping outlet, or the pair's charity arm, Archewell, a play on their son's name. Both brands have an aspirant lower middle-class vibe about them, which it would be rude to point out were it not for the fact that Harry and Meghan trade on class as part of their branding.
tgt_seg: 梅根在这些圈子中只是小有名气，但她当然有属于自己的秘密武器，而且乐得把它拿出来炫耀。新视频中，她借助哈里王子一展身手，用他那高雅的口吻问道：“设备开启了吗？”这是一个提醒，即使“As Ever”品牌不是真正的皇室品牌，它至少已经非常接近皇室了。从品牌名称来看，显然该品牌正在努力打造一种比其前身“American Riviera Orchard”更为高雅和永恒的形象。后者听起来更像是可以在折扣购物中心买到的一款芬芳礼品篮，或者是这对夫妇的慈善机构 Archewell，这个名字是取自他们儿子的名字。两个品牌都有中产阶级向上的气质，要是他们不利用阶级因素打造品牌，我们也不会轻易指出这一点。

tgt_seg: 梅根在这些领域中只是一条小鱼，但她当然有自己的秘密武器，而且她并不羞于使用。在新视频中，她让老哈里举起摄像手机，并发出几句优雅的声音——“这个东西开着吗？”- 提醒我们，即使 As Ever 不是皇室的，但它至少是皇室相邻的。这个新名字显然比其前身“American Riviera Orchard”更具品位和永恒感，“American Riviera Orchard”听起来就像在折扣购物中心里能找到的一系列香味礼品篮，或者是这对夫妇的慈善机构“Archewell”，这是他们儿子名字的戏称。这两个品牌都散发着上进的下层中产阶级气息，如果不是哈里和梅根将阶级作为其品牌宣传的一部分，那么指出这一点就显得有些不礼貌了。

src_seg: What they are selling isn't poshness itself, which strictly speaking should entail low-comfort, hole-in-the-elbows, bad cooking and draughty houses, but - much like Trump and his performance of "billionaire" - a kind of ersatz poshness they imagine might appeal to the peasants. It's a hard one to get right and, with the new brand name, Meghan seems to have changed course in the direction of, say, a Calvin Klein perfume or something a bit more abstract and upmarket. Although for my money she was on to more of a winner with the obscure and personalised brand name The Tig, her first attempt at lifestyle content that had to be shelved when she started dating Harry. As she explained at the time, The Tig was derived from an abbreviation of her favourite wine, tignanello, and had about it the confidence of something genuinely felt rather than a brand name that has been kicked through a comms team.
tgt_seg: 他们所推销的并不是“高档”本身，严格来说，“高档”应该意味着低舒适度、拥挤不堪、烹饪粗糙和通风不良的房子，而是一种他们想象中的可能吸引农民的虚假高档——就像特朗普和他扮演的“亿万富翁”一样。这是一个很难把握的正确答案，而有了新的品牌名称，梅根似乎已经改变了方向，比如说，朝着 Calvin Klein 香水或更抽象、更高档的产品方向发展。尽管在我看来，她凭借鲜为人知的个性化品牌 The Tig 取得了更大的成功，但当她开始与哈里约会时，她对生活方式内容的首次尝试不得不被搁置。正如她当时解释的那样，The Tig 源自她最喜欢的葡萄酒 tignanello 的缩写，它代表着一种真挚的自信，而不是被传播团队踢出来的品牌名称。

src_seg: Which brings us to the duchess's understanding of audience. Discounting the forfeiture of sympathy that comes with money and privilege, there is something akin to pathos in the video that I find painful to watch. Meghan's aw-shucks, I-know-you-love-me tone assumes not only goodwill but abject fandom on the part of an audience which, I suspect, is at least 50% made up of those who regard her not only critically but with downright derision. It is hard to witness. "Sending lots of love," she signs off with noblesse oblige and an almost charming dedication to what she imagines we think of her.
tgt_seg: 这让我们了解了公爵夫人对观众的理解。且不论金钱和特权所带来的同情心的丧失，视频中还是有某种类似悲情的东西让我看了很痛苦。梅根的“哎呀，”我知道你爱我“的语气不仅赢得了观众的善意，还赢得了他们的崇拜，我怀疑，至少有 50% 的观众不仅对她持批评态度，而且对她嗤之以鼻。很难见证。“送上满满的爱”，她以贵族的义务和近乎迷人的奉献精神结尾，表达了她想象中我们对她的看法。

src_seg: Meghan's rebranded herself - and it's another valiant attempt to flog poshness to the little people
tgt_seg: 梅根重新塑造了自己——这是一种向普通人推销高贵生活的勇敢尝试

src_seg: In these days of darkness we must take delight where we can find it, and one reliable source is the Duchess of Sussex. In her latest venture, Meghan, who occupies the tricky position of having a large platform and not enough to fill it (see also: Brooklyn Beckham), launched a new lifestyle brand that, she promised in a short video, would be "beautifully weaving together everything I cherish - food, gardening, entertaining, thoughtful living and finding joy in the everyday." The brand American Riviera Orchard is dead. Long live the new brand, As Ever.
tgt_seg: 在这黑暗的年代，我们必须在可以找到的地方寻找乐趣，而一个可靠的来源就是苏塞克斯公爵夫人。梅根在她最新的事业中，一个拥有巨大平台但内容匮乏的尴尬角色（另见：布鲁克林·贝克汉姆），推出了一个新的生活方式品牌。她在一段简短的视频中承诺，这个品牌将“美妙地融汇我所珍视的一切——美食、园艺、娱乐、深思熟虑的生活以及寻找日常中的快乐。”美国里维埃拉果园品牌已经死去，新的品牌“如往常一样”横空出世。

src_seg: The duchess and her husband, Prince Harry, have to do something and good luck to them, but it's hard not to study the rollout of As Ever for signs of the widening gap between Meghan's self-image and how the rest of the world sees her. ""As ever,"" writes the duchess on Instagram, "means "as it's always been" or some even say "in the same way as always,"" the "some" in this sentence apparently referring to the dictionary definition of a two-word phrase that no one has ever had trouble understanding.
tgt_seg: 公爵夫人与她的丈夫哈里王子必须做点什么，祝他们好运，但很难不去研究“如往常一样”的推出，寻找梅根自我形象与外界看待她之间不断扩大的差距的迹象。公爵夫人在Instagram上写道：“‘如往常一样’意味着‘一如既往’或有些人甚至会说‘以同样的方式’，”这个句子中的“有些人”显然是指字典对这个组合短语的定义，而这并不会让任何人感到困惑。

src_seg: It's ridiculous, of course, as is the hello-little-people tone adopted by the former royal highness, in keeping with the general attitude of the famous towards the unfamous - namely, one of stating the bleeding obvious as though sharing the key to existence. Still, I find myself sympathising with Meghan, who in her Instagram post and its accompanying video faces the stark challenge of having to pad out thin material. "This is what I do," she says to camera, "and I haven't been able to share it with you for the past few years, but now I can." What is the "it" here, and what has stopped her from sharing it? (It may involve jam, as did her previous brand, which she launched by sending "limited edition" jars of preserve to, among others, Kris Jenner, Mindy Kaling and Tracee Ellis Ross, who apparently also got a fresh bag of lemons.) src_seg: The fact there is no story here makes Meghan's insistence that she is getting in front of the story all the more enjoyable, but the more curious aspect of the announcement is the "you" to whom she refers and the idea she clearly has of her audience. The celebrity lifestyle space is crowded, ferocious and notoriously fickle, littered with the carcasses of former brand leaders such as Chrissy Teigen. Target and Bloomingdales distanced themselves from the star around the same time as she was accused of, and later apologised for, cyberbullying a woman called Courtney. src_seg: Which brings us to the duchess's understanding of audience. Discounting the forfeiture of sympathy that comes with money and privilege, there is something akin to pathos in the video that I find painful to watch. Meghan's aw-shucks, I-know-you-love-me tone assumes not only goodwill but abject fandom on the part of an audience which, I suspect, is at least 50% made up of those who regard her not only critically but with downright derision. It is hard to witness. "Sending lots of love," she signs off with noblesse oblige and an almost charming dedication to what she imagines we think of her.
tgt_seg: 这就引出了公爵夫人对受众的理解。撇开金钱和特权带来的同情心丧失不谈，视频中有一种类似悲剧的东西，我觉得很难观看。梅根那种“哎呀，我知道你们爱我”的语气不仅假设了善意，还假设了观众的绝对崇拜，而我怀疑，至少有50%的观众不仅对她持批评态度，而且对她充满了彻底的蔑视。这很难目睹。“送上很多爱”，她以贵族的义务和几乎迷人的奉献精神结束了演讲，这种奉献精神是基于她想象中我们对她的看法。

src_seg: Meghan's rebranded herself - and it's another valiant attempt to flog poshness to the little people
tgt_seg: 梅根重新塑造了自己的形象——这是她再次尝试将高雅的生活方式推广给普通人

src_seg: In these days of darkness we must take delight where we can find it, and one reliable source is the Duchess of Sussex. In her latest venture, Meghan, who occupies the tricky position of having a large platform and not enough to fill it (see also: Brooklyn Beckham), launched a new lifestyle brand that, she promised in a short video, would be "beautifully weaving together everything I cherish - food, gardening, entertaining, thoughtful living and finding joy in the everyday." The brand American Riviera Orchard is dead. Long live the new brand, As Ever.
tgt_seg: 在这个黑暗的时代，我们必须在可以找到的地方寻找快乐，而苏塞克斯公爵夫人就是其中一个可靠的来源。在她的最新事业中，梅根占据了一个棘手的职位，拥有一个很大的平台却无法填满它（另见：布鲁克林·贝克汉姆），她推出了一个新的生活方式品牌，她在一段短视频中承诺，这个品牌将“美丽地融合我所珍视的一切——美食、园艺、娱乐、有思想的生活以及在日常生活中寻找快乐。”美国里维埃拉果园品牌已经死亡。新的品牌As Ever万岁。

src_seg: The duchess and her husband, Prince Harry, have to do something and good luck to them, but it's hard not to study the rollout of As Ever for signs of the widening gap between Meghan's self-image and how the rest of the world sees her. ""As ever,"" writes the duchess on Instagram, "means "as it's always been" or some even say "in the same way as always,"" the "some" in this sentence apparently referring to the dictionary definition of a two-word phrase that no one has ever had trouble understanding.
tgt_seg: 公爵夫人和她的丈夫哈里王子必须有所作为，祝他们好运，但我们很难不研究As Ever的推出，看看梅根的自我形象与世界其他人的看法之间的差距是否在扩大。“As ever，”公爵夫人在Instagram上写道，“意味着‘一如既往’，或者有人甚至说‘一如既往的方式’”，这里的“一些人”显然指的是字典对这个两词短语的定义，这是没有人理解有困难的。

src_seg: It's ridiculous, of course, as is the hello-little-people tone adopted by the former royal highness, in keeping with the general attitude of the famous towards the unfamous - namely, one of stating the bleeding obvious as though sharing the key to existence. Still, I find myself sympathising with Meghan, who in her Instagram post and its accompanying video faces the stark challenge of having to pad out thin material. "This is what I do," she says to camera, "and I haven't been able to share it with you for the past few years, but now I can." What is the "it" here, and what has stopped her from sharing it? (It may involve jam, as did her previous brand, which she launched by sending "limited edition" jars of preserve to, among others, Kris Jenner, Mindy Kaling and Tracee Ellis Ross, who apparently also got a fresh bag of lemons.) Anyway, whatever the content, she hints darkly at some "whispers" abroad that forced her to jump the gun and share news of As Ever before she was ready - because "I wanted you to hear it from me first."
tgt_seg: 这当然很荒谬，就像这位前王室成员所采用的“你好，普通人”的语气一样，这符合名人和非名人的普遍态度——即，将显而易见的陈述当作分享存在的关键。尽管如此，我发现自己同情梅根，她在Instagram帖子及其配套视频中面临着必须填充稀薄材料的严峻挑战。“这就是我所做的事情，”她对镜头说，“在过去的几年里，我无法与你们分享，但现在我可以。”这里的“它”是什么，是什么阻止了她与我们分享？（它可能涉及果酱，就像她之前推出的品牌一样，她通过向克里斯·詹纳、敏迪·卡林和特蕾西·埃利斯·罗斯等送出“限量版”果酱罐来推出这个品牌，她们显然也收到了新鲜的柠檬。）无论内容如何，她暗指了一些“流言”，迫使她在准备好之前就提前分享As Ever的消息——因为“我想让你从我这里听到这个消息。”

src_seg: The fact there is no story here makes Meghan's insistence that she is getting in front of the story all the more enjoyable, but the more curious aspect of the announcement is the "you" to whom she refers and the idea she clearly has of her audience. The celebrity lifestyle space is crowded, ferocious and notoriously fickle, littered with the carcasses of former brand leaders such as Chrissy Teigen. Target and Bloomingdales distanced themselves from the star around the same time as she was accused of, and later apologised for, cyberbullying a woman called Courtney. The space is also dominated by market leaders such as Gwyneth Paltrow and Rachel Zoe.
tgt_seg: 这里没有故事的事实使得梅根坚持她走在故事前面变得更加令人愉快，但公告中更令人好奇的方面是她所指的“你”以及她对观众的明确想法。名人生活方式领域拥挤、激烈且臭名昭著地反复无常，布满了前品牌领袖的尸体，如克里斯蒂·泰根。目标和Bloomingdales在同一时期与这位明星保持距离，因为她被指控并后来为之道歉，网络欺凌了一位名叫考特尼的女性。这个领域还被市场领导者如格温妮丝·帕特洛和瑞秋·佐伊所主导。

src_seg: Meghan is a minnow in these waters, but of course has her own secret weapon she isn't shy about using. In the new video, she deploys good old Harry to hold up the cameraphone and drop a few posh tones - "Is this thing on?" - to remind us that, even if As Ever isn't royal, exactly, it is at least royal adjacent. The new name is clearly a reach for something classier and more timeless than its predecessor, American Riviera Orchard, which sounded like a range of scented gift baskets you'd find at a discount shopping outlet, or the pair's charity arm, Archewell, a play on their son's name. Both brands have an aspirant lower middle-class vibe about them, which it would be rude to point out were it not for the fact that Harry and Meghan trade on class as part of their branding.
tgt_seg: 梅根在这个领域是小人物，但她当然有自己的秘密武器，她并不羞于使用。在新视频中，她部署了老实的哈里来拿着摄像机，并放下了一些高雅的语气——“这个开了吗？”——提醒我们，即使As Ever不是皇室，但至少是皇室邻近。新名字显然是为了追求比其前身美国里维埃拉果园更优雅、更永恒的东西，后者听起来像是在折扣购物中心找到的一系列芳香礼品篮，或者这对夫妇的慈善部门Archewell，这是他们儿子的名字的谐音。这两个品牌都有一种有抱负的下层中产阶级氛围，这会很无礼地指出，如果不是因为哈里和梅根将阶级作为他们品牌的一部分。

src_seg: The duchess and her husband, Prince Harry, have to do something and good luck to them, but it's hard not to study the rollout of As Ever for signs of the widening gap between Meghan's self-image and how the rest of the world sees her. ""As ever,"" writes the duchess on Instagram, "means "as it's always been" or some even say "in the same way as always,"" the "some" in this sentence apparently referring to the dictionary definition of a two-word phrase that no one has ever had trouble understanding.
tgt_seg: 公爵夫人和她的丈夫哈里王子面临着挑战，祝他们好运。但很难不关注“As Ever”的发布，从中观察梅根的自我形象与外界看法之间的差距。公爵夫人写道，她在Instagram上解释，“As ever”的意思是“一如既往”，或有人说“始终如一”。这句话中的“有人”显然指代一个双字短语的字典含义，这一直以来都很好理解。

src_seg: It's ridiculous, of course, as is the hello-little-people tone adopted by the former royal highness, in keeping with the general attitude of the famous towards the unfamous - namely, one of stating the bleeding obvious as though sharing the key to existence. Still, I find myself sympathising with Meghan, who in her Instagram post and its accompanying video faces the stark challenge of having to pad out thin material. "This is what I do," she says to camera, "and I haven't been able to share it with you for the past few years, but now I can." What is the "it" here, and what has stopped her from sharing it? (It may involve jam, as did her previous brand, which she launched by sending "limited edition" jars of preserve to, among others, Kris Jenner, Mindy Kaling and Tracee Ellis Ross, who apparently also got a fresh bag of lemons.) Anyway, whatever the content, she hints darkly at some "whispers" abroad that forced her to jump the gun and share news of As Ever before she was ready - because "I wanted you to hear it from me first."
tgt_seg: 当然，这实在荒谬可笑，包括这位前王室成员所采取的傲慢姿态，这与名人对普通人的常见态度一致——把理所当然的事情说得好像是分享了什么重要的秘密。尽管如此，我还是对梅根感到同情，她在Instagram帖子及其配视频中面临着将内容填充起来的挑战。“这就是我所做的事情，”她对着镜头说道，“过去几年我一直无法与你们分享，但现在可以了。”这里的“它”指的是什么？是什么阻止了她分享？（这可能与她之前的品牌有关，她曾向克里斯·詹纳、敏迪·卡林和翠西·埃利斯·罗斯等名人寄送限量版的果酱罐，并附赠新鲜柠檬。）总之，无论内容如何，她暗示着外界的一些传言促使她提前分享了“As Ever”的消息，因为“我想让大家第一时间了解”。

src_seg: The fact there is no story here makes Meghan's insistence that she is getting in front of the story all the more enjoyable, but the more curious aspect of the announcement is the "you" to whom she refers and the idea she clearly has of her audience. The celebrity lifestyle space is crowded, ferocious and notoriously fickle, littered with the carcasses of former brand leaders such as Chrissy Teigen. Target and Bloomingdales distanced themselves from the star around the same time as she was accused of, and later apologised for, cyberbullying a woman called Courtney. The space is also dominated by market leaders such as Gwyneth Paltrow and Rachel Zoe.
tgt_seg: 梅根坚持要抢先发布消息，正因没有实质性新闻可讲而显得更加有趣。但更引人好奇的是，她所指的“你”是谁，以及她对受众的明确认知。名人生活领域竞争激烈、残酷，变化无常，充斥着过气前品牌领袖，例如克里斯西·蒂根。在科特尼被指控网络欺凌并随后道歉之际，塔吉特和布鲁明戴尔均与这位明星保持了距离。此外，格温妮丝·帕特罗和蕾切尔·佐伊等市场领导者也主导着该领域。

src_seg: Meghan is a minnow in these waters, but of course has her own secret weapon she isn't shy about using. In the new video, she deploys good old Harry to hold up the cameraphone and drop a few posh tones - "Is this thing on?" - to remind us that, even if As Ever isn't royal, exactly, it is at least royal adjacent. The new name is clearly a reach for something classier and more timeless than its predecessor, American Riviera Orchard, which sounded like a range of scented gift baskets you'd find at a discount shopping outlet, or the pair's charity arm, Archewell, a play on their son's name. Both brands have an aspirant lower middle-class vibe about them, which it would be rude to point out were it not for the fact that Harry and Meghan trade on class as part of their branding.
tgt_seg: 梅根在这些圈子里显得有些不起眼，但她当然也有自己毫不犹豫地使用的秘密武器。在新发布的视频中，她让哈里拿着摄像手机，并用略带贵族腔调说出“这东西能用吗？”，以此提醒我们，即使“As Ever”并非严格意义上的皇室，至少与皇室保持着一定的联系。这个新名称显然是为了追求一种比其前身“美国里维埃拉果园”更具品味和永恒感，后者听起来更像是在打折购物中心里能找到的一系列香薰礼品篮，或者他们夫妇的慈善机构“Archewell”，这名字是借用他们儿子的名字。这两个品牌都带着一股小资情调，指出这一点显得有些不合时宜，但考虑到哈里和梅根将阶级作为其品牌宣传的一部分，这也不难理解。

src_seg: What they are selling isn't poshness itself, which strictly speaking should entail low-comfort, hole-in-the-elbows, bad cooking and draughty houses, but - much like Trump and his performance of "billionaire" - a kind of ersatz poshness they imagine might appeal to the peasants. It's a hard one to get right and, with the new brand name, Meghan seems to have changed course in the direction of, say, a Calvin Klein perfume or something a bit more abstract and upmarket. Although for my money she was on to more of a winner with the obscure and personalised brand name The Tig, her first attempt at lifestyle content that had to be shelved when she started dating Harry. As she explained at the time, The Tig was derived from an abbreviation of her favourite wine, tignanello, and had about it the confidence of something genuinely felt rather than a brand name that has been kicked through a comms team.
tgt_seg: 他们所推销的并非真正的奢华——严格意义上来说，奢华应包含简陋舒适、质朴古旧和烹饪粗糙等特点，而是一种类似于特朗普表演“亿万富翁”的，他们想象中可能吸引大众的替代性奢华。 把握住这一点很不容易，而随着新的品牌名称出现，梅根似乎改变了方向，朝着卡尔文·克雷恩香水或更抽象、更高端的风格靠拢。 尽管在我看来，她最初的品牌名称“The Tig”更具潜力，它是一个个性化且不为人知的名字，是她首次尝试的生活方式内容，但后来因开始与哈里约会而不得不停止运营。正如她当时解释的那样，“The Tig”源于她最喜欢的葡萄酒“tignanello”的缩写，它散发着一种发自内心的自信，而不是经过公关团队推敲的品牌名称。

src_seg: Which brings us to the duchess's understanding of audience. Discounting the forfeiture of sympathy that comes with money and privilege, there is something akin to pathos in the video that I find painful to watch. Meghan's aw-shucks, I-know-you-love-me tone assumes not only goodwill but abject fandom on the part of an audience which, I suspect, is at least 50% made up of those who regard her not only critically but with downright derision. It is hard to witness. "Sending lots of love," she signs off with noblesse oblige and an almost charming dedication to what she imagines we think of her.
tgt_seg: 这让我们转向了这位公爵夫人的受众认知。撇开金钱和特权带来的同情心丧失不谈，我发现观看这段视频时，其中似乎蕴含着一种令人难受的悲怆感。梅根那略显做作的、寻求认同的语气，不仅预设了观众的善意，更预设了近乎盲目的追随，而我怀疑，至少有50%的观众不仅对她持批判态度，甚至带着明显的嘲讽。 观看这一幕令人唏嘘。“祝大家充满爱意”，她以一种带有居高临下的姿态，并对我们如何看待她抱有近乎天真的幻想，结束了这段话。

tgt_seg: 这当然显得荒谬，正如这位前王室成员所采用的那种居高临下、仿佛对“小人物”说话的语气一样荒谬——这正体现了名人对普通人的惯常态度：将显而易见的事实说得仿佛是在分享生命的真谛。尽管如此，我仍对梅根心生同情，因为在她的Instagram帖子及其附带视频中，她面临着一个艰巨的挑战：如何将内容本身颇为单薄的素材加以充实。“这就是我一直在做的事情，”她对着镜头说，“过去几年我一直无法与你们分享，但现在我可以了。”那么，这里的“它”究竟是什么？又是什么原因导致她迟迟未能分享？（这或许与果酱有关，就像她此前创立的品牌一样，当时她曾向克里斯·詹纳（Kris Jenner）、敏迪·卡灵（Mindy Kaling）和特蕾西·埃利斯·罗斯（Tracee Ellis Ross）等人寄送“限量版”果酱罐，据说她们还收到了一袋新鲜柠檬。）无论如何，不论具体内容是什么，她都意味深长地暗示，外界流传的一些“流言蜚语”迫使她不得不提前公布“As Ever”的消息——因为“我希望你们能首先从我这里听到这个消息。”

src_seg: The fact there is no story here makes Meghan's insistence that she is getting in front of the story all the more enjoyable, but the more curious aspect of the announcement is the "you" to whom she refers and the idea she clearly has of her audience. The celebrity lifestyle space is crowded, ferocious and notoriously fickle, littered with the carcasses of former brand leaders such as Chrissy Teigen. Target and Bloomingdales distanced themselves from the star around the same time as she was accused of, and later apologised for, cyberbullying a woman called Courtney. The space is also dominated by market leaders such as Gwyneth Paltrow and Rachel Zoe.
tgt_seg: 事实上，这里根本没有什么值得称道的“新闻”可言，这反而让梅根坚持“抢先发声”的做法显得更加耐人寻味。更值得关注的是，她在声明中所指的“你们”以及她对自身受众的清晰定位。名人生活方式领域竞争激烈、变幻莫测，充斥着不少昔日品牌代言人的失败案例，例如克丽西·泰根（Chrissy Teigen）。在她因网络霸凌一名名叫考特尼（Courtney）的女性而遭到指控并公开道歉的同时，塔吉特（Target）和布鲁明戴尔（Bloomingdales）等品牌也纷纷与她划清界限。如今，这一领域则由格温妮丝·帕特洛（Gwyneth Paltrow）和瑞秋·佐伊（Rachel Zoe）等市场领军人物主导。

src_seg: Meghan is a minnow in these waters, but of course has her own secret weapon she isn't shy about using. In the new video, she deploys good old Harry to hold up the cameraphone and drop a few posh tones - "Is this thing on?" - to remind us that, even if As Ever isn't royal, exactly, it is at least royal adjacent. The new name is clearly a reach for something classier and more timeless than its predecessor, American Riviera Orchard, which sounded like a range of scented gift baskets you'd find at a discount shopping outlet, or the pair's charity arm, Archewell, a play on their son's name. Both brands have an aspirant lower middle-class vibe about them, which it would be rude to point out were it not for the fact that Harry and Meghan trade on class as part of their branding.
tgt_seg: 梅根在这一领域或许只是个“小角色”，但她当然有自己的“秘密武器”，并且毫不避讳地加以使用。在最新发布的视频中，她请出哈里王子帮忙举着手机拍摄，并用带有上流社会腔调的语气回答：“这东西开着吗？”以此提醒观众，尽管“As Ever”严格来说并非真正的王室品牌，但至少与王室有着某种关联。这个新品牌名称显然意在比前一个品牌“美国里维埃拉果园”（American Riviera Orchard）显得更高端、更经典；而“美国里维埃拉果园”这个名字听起来更像是你在折扣购物中心能找到的香氛礼篮产品系列。他们创办的慈善机构“阿奇韦尔”（Archewell）则显然是以他们儿子的名字命名的。这两个品牌都透着一股中产阶级试图攀附上流社会的意味。若不是哈里和梅根将“阶级差异”作为品牌营销的一部分，指出这一点或许确实显得有些无礼。

src_seg: What they are selling isn't poshness itself, which strictly speaking should entail low-comfort, hole-in-the-elbows, bad cooking and draughty houses, but - much like Trump and his performance of "billionaire" - a kind of ersatz poshness they imagine might appeal to the peasants. It's a hard one to get right and, with the new brand name, Meghan seems to have changed course in the direction of, say, a Calvin Klein perfume or something a bit more abstract and upmarket. Although for my money she was on to more of a winner with the obscure and personalised brand name The Tig, her first attempt at lifestyle content that had to be shelved when she started dating Harry. As she explained at the time, The Tig was derived from an abbreviation of her favourite wine, tignanello, and had about it the confidence of something genuinely felt rather than a brand name that has been kicked through a comms team.
tgt_seg: 他们兜售的并非真正意义上的“贵族生活”（严格来说，真正的贵族生活意味着低舒适度、破旧的衣服、糟糕的食物和四处漏风的房子），而是像特朗普刻意营造的“亿万富翁”形象那样，一种他们想象中可能会吸引普通民众的“伪贵族生活”。这种定位其实很难拿捏得恰到好处。从新品牌名称来看，梅根似乎已经改变了方向，转向了类似卡尔文·克莱恩（Calvin Klein）香水那样更抽象、更高档的产品方向。不过依我之见，她最初使用的那个独特且个性化的品牌名称“The Tig”或许更胜一筹。那是她在与哈里王子交往前的一次尝试。正如她当时所解释的，“The Tig”这个名字来源于她最喜爱的葡萄酒“天娜”（Tignanello）的缩写，这个名字显得更加真实、自然，而非经过公关团队反复推敲出来的品牌名称。

src_seg: Which brings us to the duchess's understanding of audience. Discounting the forfeiture of sympathy that comes with money and privilege, there is something akin to pathos in the video that I find painful to watch. Meghan's aw-shucks, I-know-you-love-me tone assumes not only goodwill but abject fandom on the part of an audience which, I suspect, is at least 50% made up of those who regard her not only critically but with downright derision. It is hard to witness. "Sending lots of love," she signs off with noblesse oblige and an almost charming dedication to what she imagines we think of her.

tgt_seg: 他们销售的不是高雅本身，严格来说，高雅应该包括不舒适、肘部有洞、做饭不好和透风的房子，而是——就像特朗普和他的“亿万富翁”表演一样——一种他们想象中的假高雅，可能会吸引农民。这很难做对，梅根似乎改变了方向，选择了一个更抽象、更高端的品牌名称，比如卡尔文·克莱恩的香水。尽管我认为她之前的品牌名称The Tig更能取得成功，这是她第一次尝试生活方式内容，在开始与哈里约会后不得不搁置。当时她解释说，The Tig源自她最喜欢的葡萄酒tignanello的缩写，它有一种真正感受到的自信，而不是一个被公关团队踢来踢去的品牌名称。

src_seg: Which brings us to the duchess's understanding of audience. Discounting the forfeiture of sympathy that comes with money and privilege, there is something akin to pathos in the video that I find painful to watch. Meghan's aw-shucks, I-know-you-love-me tone assumes not only goodwill but abject fandom on the part of an audience which, I suspect, is at least 50% made up of those who regard her not only critically but with downright derision. It is hard to witness. "Sending lots of love," she signs off with noblesse oblige and an almost charming dedication to what she imagines we think of her.
tgt_seg: 这让我们谈到公爵夫人对受众的理解。不考虑因金钱和特权而失去同情心，我发现视频中有类似悲伤的东西，让人痛苦地观看。梅根的啊，我知道你爱我语气不仅假设了善意，还假设了受众中至少50%的人不仅对她持批评态度，而且完全蔑视她。很难见证。“发送很多爱，”她以义务和几乎迷人的奉献精神结束，她想象我们对她的看法。

src_seg: Meghan's rebranded herself - and it's another valiant attempt to flog poshness to the little people
tgt_seg: 梅根重新塑造了自我形象——这又是一场向普通人兜售高贵生活的英勇尝试

src_seg: In these days of darkness we must take delight where we can find it, and one reliable source is the Duchess of Sussex. In her latest venture, Meghan, who occupies the tricky position of having a large platform and not enough to fill it (see also: Brooklyn Beckham), launched a new lifestyle brand that, she promised in a short video, would be "beautifully weaving together everything I cherish - food, gardening, entertaining, thoughtful living and finding joy in the everyday." The brand American Riviera Orchard is dead. Long live the new brand, As Ever.
tgt_seg: 在这个充满阴霾的时代，我们必须在能找到的地方寻求乐趣，而萨塞克斯公爵夫人无疑是一个可靠的来源。在她的最新事业中，梅根——她处于一个拥有巨大平台却内容匮乏的尴尬位置（参见：布鲁克林·贝克汉姆）——推出了一个全新的生活方式品牌。她在一段简短视频中承诺，这个品牌将“美妙地融合我所珍视的一切——美食、园艺、待客、用心生活以及在日常中寻找快乐”。American Riviera Orchard品牌已成过去。新品牌As Ever诞生，愿其长存。

src_seg: The duchess and her husband, Prince Harry, have to do something and good luck to them, but it's hard not to study the rollout of As Ever for signs of the widening gap between Meghan's self-image and how the rest of the world sees her. ""As ever,"" writes the duchess on Instagram, "means "as it's always been" or some even say "in the same way as always,"" the "some" in this sentence apparently referring to the dictionary definition of a two-word phrase that no one has ever had trouble understanding.
tgt_seg: 公爵夫人和她的丈夫哈里王子必须有所作为，祝他们好运，但很难不在As Ever的发布过程中寻找梅根自我形象与外界看法之间日益扩大的差距。“As ever，”公爵夫人在Instagram上写道，“意思是‘一如既往’，或者有人说‘始终如一’。”这句话中的“有人”显然指的是这个两词短语的字典定义，而这个短语从未让任何人感到困惑。

src_seg: It's ridiculous, of course, as is the hello-little-people tone adopted by the former royal highness, in keeping with the general attitude of the famous towards the unfamous - namely, one of stating the bleeding obvious as though sharing the key to existence. Still, I find myself sympathising with Meghan, who in her Instagram post and its accompanying video faces the stark challenge of having to pad out thin material. "This is what I do," she says to camera, "and I haven't been able to share it with you for the past few years, but now I can." What is the "it" here, and what has stopped her from sharing it? (It may involve jam, as did her previous brand, which she launched by sending "limited edition" jars of preserve to, among others, Kris Jenner, Mindy Kaling and Tracee Ellis Ross, who apparently also got a fresh bag of lemons.) Anyway, whatever the content, she hints darkly at some "whispers" abroad that forced her to jump the gun and share news of As Ever before she was ready - because "I wanted you to hear it from me first."
tgt_seg: 这当然很荒谬，就像这位前殿下所采用的“你好，小人物们”的语气一样，这与名人对无名之辈的普遍态度一致——即把显而易见的事情说得仿佛是在分享人生的奥秘。尽管如此，我还是对梅根产生了同情。在她的Instagram帖子及配套视频中，她不得不面对用有限内容填充平台的严峻挑战。“这就是我所做的事情，”她对着镜头说，“过去几年我无法与你们分享，但现在我可以了。”这里的“这”指的是什么？又是什么阻止了她分享？（可能涉及果酱，就像她之前的品牌一样，她曾向克里斯·詹娜、敏迪·卡灵和特雷西·埃利斯·罗斯等人寄送“限量版”果酱，据说她们还收到了新鲜柠檬。）无论内容如何，她神秘地暗示有一些“流言”在外，迫使她提前公布As Ever的消息——因为“我希望你们首先从我这里听到。”

src_seg: The fact there is no story here makes Meghan's insistence that she is getting in front of the story all the more enjoyable, but the more curious aspect of the announcement is the "you" to whom she refers and the idea she clearly has of her audience. The celebrity lifestyle space is crowded, ferocious and notoriously fickle, littered with the carcasses of former brand leaders such as Chrissy Teigen. Target and Bloomingdales distanced themselves from the star around the same time as she was accused of, and later apologised for, cyberbullying a woman called Courtney. The space is also dominated by market leaders such as Gwyneth Paltrow and Rachel Zoe.
tgt_seg: 事实上，这里并没有什么故事可言，梅根却坚持要“抢先发声”，这反而更具娱乐性。但更令人好奇的是她所指的“你们”以及她对受众的明显设想。名人生活方式领域竞争激烈、变化无常，曾经的品牌领袖如克丽茜·泰根也已黯然退场。Target和Bloomingdales在她被指控并随后为网络欺凌一位名叫Courtney的女性道歉时，与她划清了界限。该领域也被格温妮丝·帕特洛和瑞秋·佐伊等市场领导者主导。

src_seg: Meghan is a minnow in these waters, but of course has her own secret weapon she isn't shy about using. In the new video, she deploys good old Harry to hold up the cameraphone and drop a few posh tones - "Is this thing on?" - to remind us that, even if As Ever isn't royal, exactly, it is at least royal adjacent. The new name is clearly a reach for something classier and more timeless than its predecessor, American Riviera Orchard, which sounded like a range of scented gift baskets you'd find at a discount shopping outlet, or the pair's charity arm, Archewell, a play on their son's name. Both brands have an aspirant lower middle-class vibe about them, which it would be rude to point out were it not for the fact that Harry and Meghan trade on class as part of their branding.
tgt_seg: 梅根在这片水域中只是小角色，但她当然有自己的秘密武器，并且毫不羞于使用。在新视频中，她让哈里出镜，举着手机并用上流口音说：“这个开了吗？”——提醒我们，即使As Ever并非真正的皇室品牌，至少也与皇室沾边。新品牌名称显然试图比前身American Riviera Orchard更高雅、更具永恒感，后者听起来像是你会在折扣商场找到的香薰礼篮，或者是他们以儿子名字命名的慈善机构Archewell。这两个品牌都带有一种渴望向上流动的中下阶层气息，如果不是因为哈里和梅根将“阶层”作为品牌的一部分，这种指出本会显得不礼貌。

tgt_seg: 在这些黑暗的日子里，我们必须随处寻找乐趣，而苏塞克斯公爵夫人便是一个可靠的乐趣来源。在她最新的事业中，梅根推出了一个新的生活方式品牌。她在一个短视频中承诺，该品牌将“把我所珍视的一切——美食、园艺、待客之道、有思想的生活以及在日常中寻找乐趣——完美地编织在一起。”梅根的处境颇为尴尬，她拥有一个巨大的平台，却没有足够的内容来填充（参见：布鲁克林·贝克汉姆）。“美洲里维埃拉果园”这个品牌已死。新品牌“一如既往”（As Ever）万岁。

src_seg: The duchess and her husband, Prince Harry, have to do something and good luck to them, but it's hard not to study the rollout of As Ever for signs of the widening gap between Meghan's self-image and how the rest of the world sees her. ""As ever,"" writes the duchess on Instagram, "means "as it's always been" or some even say "in the same way as always,"" the "some" in this sentence apparently referring to the dictionary definition of a two-word phrase that no one has ever had trouble understanding.
tgt_seg: 公爵夫人和她的丈夫哈里王子总得做点什么，祝他们好运，但我们很难不去审视“一如既往”品牌的推出过程，并从中寻找梅根的自我形象与世界其他人对她的看法之间日益扩大的鸿沟的迹象。公爵夫人在Instagram上写道：“‘一如既往’（As Ever）的意思是‘一如往昔’，或者有些人甚至说‘总是以同样的方式’。”这句话中的“一些人”显然指的是字典对这个从来没有人觉得难理解的两个词短语的定义。

src_seg: It's ridiculous, of course, as is the hello-little-people tone adopted by the former royal highness, in keeping with the general attitude of the famous towards the unfamous - namely, one of stating the bleeding obvious as though sharing the key to existence. Still, I find myself sympathising with Meghan, who in her Instagram post and its accompanying video faces the stark challenge of having to pad out thin material. "This is what I do," she says to camera, "and I haven't been able to share it with you for the past few years, but now I can." What is the "it" here, and what has stopped her from sharing it? (It may involve jam, as did her previous brand, which she launched by sending "limited edition" jars of preserve to, among others, Kris Jenner, Mindy Kaling and Tracee Ellis Ross, who apparently also got a fresh bag of lemons.) Anyway, whatever the content, she hints darkly at some "whispers" abroad that forced her to jump the gun and share news of As Ever before she was ready - because "I wanted you to hear it from me first."
tgt_seg: 这当然很荒谬，就像这位前王室殿下所采用的那种“你好，小人物”的腔调一样，这与名人对非名人的普遍态度一脉相承——即将那些再明白不过的道理说得好像分享了存在的密码。尽管如此，我发现自己还是同情梅根的。在她的Instagram帖子和附带的视频中，她面临着一个严峻的挑战，那就是必须充实单薄的内容。“这就是我所做的事情，”她对着镜头说，“过去几年我一直没能和你们分享，但现在我可以了。”这里的“它”到底是什么？又是什么阻止了她分享？（可能和果酱有关，就像她之前的品牌一样。她当时把“限量版”果酱送给了克丽丝·詹纳、敏迪·卡灵和特雷西·埃利斯·罗斯等人，后者显然还收到了一袋新鲜的柠檬。）不管内容是什么，她都阴郁地暗示，国外的一些“流言蜚语”迫使她赶在准备好的时间之前抢先分享“一如既往”（As Ever）品牌的消息——因为“我想让你们先从我这里听到”。

src_seg: The fact there is no story here makes Meghan's insistence that she is getting in front of the story all the more enjoyable, but the more curious aspect of the announcement is the "you" to whom she refers and the idea she clearly has of her audience. The celebrity lifestyle space is crowded, ferocious and notoriously fickle, littered with the carcasses of former brand leaders such as Chrissy Teigen. Target and Bloomingdales distanced themselves from the star around the same time as she was accused of, and later apologised for, cyberbullying a woman called Courtney. The space is also dominated by market leaders such as Gwyneth Paltrow and Rachel Zoe.
tgt_seg: 这里根本没什么故事，这一事实让梅根坚称自己走在故事前面的做法显得更加有趣。但这个声明中更令人好奇的方面是她所指的“你”，以及她对自己受众的清晰构想。名人生活方式领域的竞争激烈且残酷，并且出了名的变幻莫测，遍布着像克丽丝·泰根这样昔日品牌领导者的“尸骸”。在泰根被指控网络霸凌一位名叫考特尼的女性并随后道歉的同时，塔吉特百货和布鲁明戴尔百货公司都与她划清了界限。这个领域也由格温妮丝·帕特洛和瑞秋·佐伊等市场领导者主导。

src_seg: Meghan is a minnow in these waters, but of course has her own secret weapon she isn't shy about using. In the new video, she deploys good old Harry to hold up the cameraphone and drop a few posh tones - "Is this thing on?" - to remind us that, even if As Ever isn't royal, exactly, it is at least royal adjacent. The new name is clearly a reach for something classier and more timeless than its predecessor, American Riviera Orchard, which sounded like a range of scented gift baskets you'd find at a discount shopping outlet, or the pair's charity arm, Archewell, a play on their son's name. Both brands have an aspirant lower middle-class vibe about them, which it would be rude to point out were it not for the fact that Harry and Meghan trade on class as part of their branding.
tgt_seg: 在这片水域中，梅根只是一条小鱼，但她当然有自己的秘密武器，并且毫不避讳地使用它。在新的视频中，她派出了我们亲爱的哈里来举着手机摄像头，并且用几句贵族腔调的话——“这东西开着吗？”——来提醒我们，即使“一如既往”品牌不完全是皇室的，它至少是与皇室沾边的。新品牌名显然是为了追求比其前身“美洲里维埃拉果园”更经典、更永恒的东西。“美洲里维埃拉果园”听起来像是你在一个折扣购物中心能找到的香氛礼品篮系列，而他们的慈善机构“Archewell”则是对他们儿子名字的文字游戏。这两个品牌都带有一种渴望跻身更高阶层的下层中产阶级的感觉，如果不是因为哈里和梅根将阶级作为其品牌的一部分来利用，指出这一点会显得很无礼。

src_seg: What they are selling isn't poshness itself, which strictly speaking should entail low-comfort, hole-in-the-elbows, bad cooking and draughty houses, but - much like Trump and his performance of "billionaire" - a kind of ersatz poshness they imagine might appeal to the peasants. It's a hard one to get right and, with the new brand name, Meghan seems to have changed course in the direction of, say, a Calvin Klein perfume or something a bit more abstract and upmarket. Although for my money she was on to more of a winner with the obscure and personalised brand name The Tig, her first attempt at lifestyle content that had to be shelved when she started dating Harry. As she explained at the time, The Tig was derived from an abbreviation of her favourite wine, tignanello, and had about it the confidence of something genuinely felt rather than a brand name that has been kicked through a comms team.
tgt_seg: 他们卖的不是贵族气质本身（严格来说，这应该意味着低舒适度、手肘有洞的衣服、糟糕的厨艺和四处漏风的房子），而是一种他们想象中可能吸引平民的“代用”贵族气质——这很像特朗普和他对“亿万富翁”的表演。这是一个很难把握的尺度，而随着新品牌名的出现，梅根似乎已经改变了航向，朝着比如CK香水或更抽象、更高档的方向发展。尽管在我看来，她用那个晦涩而个人化的品牌名“The Tig”会更有胜算。那是她第一次尝试做生活方式内容，但在她开始与哈里约会时不得不搁置。正如她当时解释的，“The Tig”源于她最喜欢的葡萄酒天娜（tignanello）的缩写，它带有一种源自真实感受的自信，而不是一个被公关团队反复炮制过的品牌名。

src_seg: Which brings us to the duchess's understanding of audience. Discounting the forfeiture of sympathy that comes with money and privilege, there is something akin to pathos in the video that I find painful to watch. Meghan's aw-shucks, I-know-you-love-me tone assumes not only goodwill but abject fandom on the part of an audience which, I suspect, is at least 50% made up of those who regard her not only critically but with downright derision. It is hard to witness. "Sending lots of love," she signs off with noblesse oblige and an almost charming dedication to what she imagines we think of her.
tgt_seg: 这就引出了公爵夫人对受众的理解。撇开金钱和特权所带来的同情心丧失不谈，视频中有一种近乎悲情的东西，让我看得很难受。梅根那种“哎呀，我知道你们爱我”的腔调，不仅假定了善意，还假定了对方是卑微的粉丝。而我怀疑，她的受众中至少有50%的人不仅批判性地看待她，而且带着彻头彻尾的嘲笑。这让人难以目睹。她以一种贵族的姿态和一种近乎迷人的执着，坚信着她想象中我们对她的看法，最后签上“送上很多爱”。

src_seg:
I am a tweakment holdout. When will wrinkles, bad teeth and big pores be back in fashion?
Totally neutral question, no right or wrong answer: how do you feel about salmon sperm?
tgt_seg:
我是抗拒微调的人。皱纹、牙齿不齐和毛孔粗大什么时候会再次流行？
完全中立的问题，没有对错之分：你对鲑鱼精子有什么看法？

src_seg: It's not a Nordic culinary microtrend or a sex thing, but a beauty treatment, in which "Polydeoxyribonucleotides (PDRN) derived from purified fragments of DNA extracted from yes, "salmon sperm"" are injected into your face. It does seem to work: proper research has found PDRN has wound-repairing properties in hard-to-treat contexts such as diabetic ulcers and deep burns. Good news (unless you're a male salmon). But what is it doing in healthy faces?
tgt_seg: 这不是北欧美食的微趋势，也不是与性相关的话题，而是一种美容治疗，其中“从鲑鱼精子中提取的DNA纯化片段制成的多脱氧核糖核苷酸（PDRN）”被注射到你的脸上。它似乎确实有效：严谨的研究发现，PDRN在治疗糖尿病溃疡和深度烧伤等难以治疗的病症时具有修复伤口的特性。好消息（除非你是雄性鲑鱼）。但它在健康面部的作用是什么呢？

src_seg: I learned about salmon sperm in a Sunday Times article on the "skincare secrets" of "26 tastemakers," which I read, increasingly aghast. It was a litany of lasers, microneedling, injectables and proprietary treatments with silly names that left me shouting crossly at my laptop: "But what does it do?" The only treatment I related to at all was Marina Abramović recounting how a friend of her mother's put hot mashed potato on her face to temporarily erase wrinkles; Abramović herself uses "thermage radiofrequency." No wonder a salmon sperm practitioner says it's "an exciting time in the aesthetic industry."
tgt_seg: 我在《星期日泰晤士报》的一篇关于“26位品位家”的“护肤秘密”的文章中了解到了鲑鱼精子，这篇文章让我读得越来越惊讶。文章中列举了一系列激光、微针、注射和专有疗法，名称荒谬，让我对着笔记本电脑大喊：“但这到底有什么用？”我唯一能理解的疗法是玛丽娜·阿布拉莫维奇（Marina Abramović）讲述她母亲的一个朋友如何把热土豆泥敷在脸上暂时消除皱纹；阿布拉莫维奇自己使用“热玛吉射频疗法”。难怪一位鲑鱼精子从业者说这是“美学行业令人兴奋的时代”。

src_seg: Some contributors were celebs, regularly running the unforgiving gauntlet of high-definition television, and the rest were at least very interested, if not professionally involved, in beauty, so they probably aren't typical. And there's a certain honesty to it, at least. No one is making out their dewy glow is "just good genes" and "loads of water." But I also think this newfound willingness to talk about "tweakments" (a jaunty portmanteau that makes me queasy) is a product of them being absolutely everywhere.

It would be nice to feel better about my neck, but not nice enough to actually do anything painful and expensive about it.
tgt_seg: 而且，感觉自己与时代脱节也让人感到不舒服。我唯一一次尝试“美容”就是把因脱发而变得稀疏的眉毛纹了上去（这也说明了皱眉对我性格的重要性，所以打肉毒杆菌是绝对不可能的）。我并不是对自己的50岁容颜感到特别满意：我新护照上的照片，不知为何，看起来像个“老巫婆”，而且还“一只眼睛乌青”（实际上只是黑眼圈），更增添了“在书店外打架后被捕的老年人”的既视感。我很想改善一下自己的颈部，但并没有到愿意为此花大价钱、忍受痛苦的程度。

src_seg: I suppose we tweakment holdouts will have to wait, and hope, for the tide to turn. As Ozempic and shiny veneers may make thinness and Hollywood teeth look boring and basic, perhaps perfect faces will fall from fashion? I mention the veneers, because when I was watching the Bridget Jones movie, I become fascinated by Chiwetel Ejiofor's teeth. They're absolutely lovely, yes, but sort of ... normal? One lower one peeps out from slightly behind the others. It only added to his charm. Hugh Grant's 64-year-old face looked charismatically crumpled too. Maybe when everyone has been homogenised to a glazed sheen of perfection, sagging, bumps, gaping pores and rough patches will be the height of desirability. At that point, I'll be ready for my closeup.
tgt_seg: 我想，像我们这样对“美容”持保留态度的人，只能耐心等待，并希望潮流能够改变。也许，随着“奥泽姆皮”（一种减肥药）和“亮丽牙齿”的流行，人们会觉得“苗条”和“好莱坞式的牙齿”变得平庸，甚至不再流行？或许，追求“完美”的面容也会过时？我提到“亮丽牙齿”，是因为在观看《BJ单身日记》时，我被奇维特·埃吉奥福的牙齿深深吸引。它们非常漂亮，没错，但却显得……很自然？他的一颗下牙稍微比其他牙齿靠后。这反而增添了他的魅力。休·格兰特64岁的脸也显得很有魅力，而且带着岁月的痕迹。也许，当每个人都变得千篇一律，追求“完美”到极致时，“松弛”、“瑕疵”、“毛孔粗大”和“粗糙的皮肤”反而会成为最令人向往的特征。到那时，我就会准备好迎接我的“特写镜头”。

src_seg:
I am a tweakment holdout. When will wrinkles, bad teeth and big pores be back in fashion?
Totally neutral question, no right or wrong answer: how do you feel about salmon sperm?
tgt_seg: 我是个坚持微调的人。皱纹、坏牙和毛孔粗大什么时候才会重新流行起来？这个问题完全中立，没有正确或错误的答案：你觉得鲑鱼精子怎么样？

src_seg: It's not a Nordic culinary microtrend or a sex thing, but a beauty treatment, in which "Polydeoxyribonucleotides (PDRN) derived from purified fragments of DNA extracted from yes, "salmon sperm"" are injected into your face. It does seem to work: proper research has found PDRN has wound-repairing properties in hard-to-treat contexts such as diabetic ulcers and deep burns. Good news (unless you're a male salmon). But what is it doing in healthy faces?
tgt_seg: 这并非北欧烹饪潮流，也不是性爱话题，而是一种美容疗法，即将“从鲑鱼精子中提取的纯化DNA片段衍生的聚脱氧核糖核苷酸（PDRN）”注射到面部。这种方法似乎确实有效：相关研究发现，PDRN在糖尿病溃疡和深度烧伤等难以治疗的疾病中具有修复伤口的功效。这绝对是个好消息（除非你是雄性鲑鱼）。但它在健康的面部究竟起着什么作用呢？

src_seg: I learned about salmon sperm in a Sunday Times article on the "skincare secrets" of "26 tastemakers," which I read, increasingly aghast. It was a litany of lasers, microneedling, injectables and proprietary treatments with silly names that left me shouting crossly at my laptop: "But what does it do?" The only treatment I related to at all was Marina Abramović recounting how a friend of her mother's put hot mashed potato on her face to temporarily erase wrinkles; Abramović herself uses "thermage radiofrequency." No wonder a salmon sperm practitioner says it's "an exciting time in the aesthetic industry."
tgt_seg: 我是在《星期日泰晤士报》一篇关于“26位时尚达人”的“护肤秘诀”的文章中了解到鲑鱼精子的。读完之后，我越来越震惊。文章里罗列了一大堆激光、微针、注射剂以及一些名字傻乎乎的专利疗法，让我对着笔记本电脑怒吼：“这到底有什么用？” 唯一让我感同身受的疗法是玛丽娜·阿布拉莫维奇讲述她母亲的一位朋友如何将热土豆泥敷在脸上，暂时消除皱纹；阿布拉莫维奇本人使用的是“热玛吉射频”。难怪一位鲑鱼精子美容师说这是“美容行业激动人心的时刻”。

src_seg: Some contributors were celebs, regularly running the unforgiving gauntlet of high-definition television, and the rest were at least very interested, if not professionally involved, in beauty, so they probably aren't typical. And there's a certain honesty to it, at least. No one is making out their dewy glow is "just good genes" and "loads of water." But I also think this newfound willingness to talk about "tweakments" (a jaunty portmanteau that makes me queasy) is a product of them being absolutely everywhere.
tgt_seg: 有些撰稿人是名人，经常在高清电视上露面，而其余的人即使不是专业人士，也至少对美容非常感兴趣，所以他们可能并不典型。而且至少他们的观点还算诚实。没有人会说他们水润的光泽只是“基因好”和“水分多”的缘故。但我认为，这种新近出现的谈论“微调”（一个让我感到不安的轻快的混成词）的意愿，也是因为这些微调无处不在。

src_seg: Because they are everywhere, for everyone. According to researchers at University College London, the UK injectables market will be worth £11.7bn by next year, with Botox and fillers available anywhere from Harley Street to high-street hairdressers. Writing in Grazia last week, the Guardian beauty columnist Sali Hughes described how "women in teaching, policing and the civil service" ask her advice on where to get "good injections." In the US, Botox use by 20- to 29-year-olds has increased 28% since 2010, with gen Z buying into "prejuvenation" (another awful portmanteau), fuelled by the poreless perfection offered by filters, staring at themselves on pandemic screens and social media skinfluencers (argh).
tgt_seg: 因为它们无处不在，人人适用。据伦敦大学学院的研究人员称，到明年，英国注射剂市场的价值将达到117亿英镑，从哈利街到商业街的理发店，肉毒杆菌和填充剂随处可见。《卫报》美容专栏作家萨利·休斯上周在《红秀》杂志上撰文，描述了“从事教学、警察和公务员工作的女性”如何向她咨询哪里可以“获得好的注射”。在美国，自2010年以来，20至29岁人群的肉毒杆菌使用量增长了28%，Z世代开始接受“预年轻化”（又一个糟糕的混成词），这得益于滤镜带来的无毛孔完美效果、疫情期间在社交媒体上晒出的自己以及社交媒体上的皮肤影响者（啊）。

src_seg: I shouldn't be surprised - actual children are buying expensive anti-ageing potions and fretting about their nonexistent crow's feet now. But still, this dramatic normalisation of invasive beauty procedures is unnerving.

tgt_seg: 一些贡献者是名人，他们经常在高清电视的无情考验下度过，而其余的人至少对美容领域非常感兴趣，如果不是专业人士的话，所以他们可能并不具有代表性。 但至少这诚实。 没人声称他们水润的光泽是“仅仅是好基因”和“大量喝水”的结果。 但我也认为，这种对“医美微调”（一个让我感到恶心的俏皮组合词）的新鲜意愿是由于它们无处不在。

src_seg: Because they are everywhere, for everyone. src_seg: I shouldn't be surprised - actual children are buying expensive anti-ageing potions and fretting about their nonexistent crow's feet now. But still, this dramatic normalisation of invasive beauty procedures is unnerving.

It's none of my business how people spend their money - my disposable income is dedicated to becoming the Joe Exotic of decorative poultry - but will we end up with an attractiveness inequality gap? Or will the democratisation of HD face mean almost everyone will be smoothly immobile soon? I suspect there will always be better and worse tweakments: that UCL research also points out how alarmingly unregulated the industry is.
tgt_seg: 首先，微调美容太昂贵了！虽然无权干涉他人如何花钱（我的可支配收入全用来当观赏鸡界的"虎王"乔·异国了），但会不会导致"颜值不平等"？或者高清面孔的平民化会让不久后所有人都变成光滑的蜡像？我怀疑永远存在优劣之分——那项研究同时指出，这个行业缺乏监管的程度触目惊心。

src_seg: It's also uncomfortable feeling so out of step. My only foray into tweakment territory is getting my brows, lost to alopecia, tattooed back on (which demonstrates how central frowning is to my character, so Botox is out). It's not that I'm smugly delighted with my 50-year-old face: the baleful crone in my new passport photo appears, inexplicably, to have a single black eye (actually just a dark circle), adding to the "pensioner arrested after brawl outside bookies" vibe. It would be nice to feel better about my neck, but not nice enough to actually do anything painful and expensive about it.
tgt_seg: 作为局外人也令人不适。我唯一涉足的美容项目是因脱毛症纹了眉毛（这说明皱眉对我的形象多重要，所以肉毒杆菌免谈）。并非我对50岁的面孔洋洋自得：新护照照片里那个凶巴巴的老太婆莫名像有只乌青眼（其实是黑眼圈），浑身散发着"退休老人在博彩店外斗殴被捕"的气场。当然希望颈部状态更好，但还不值得为此承受痛苦又昂贵的治疗。

src_seg: I suppose we tweakment holdouts will have to wait, and hope, for the tide to turn. As Ozempic and shiny veneers may make thinness and Hollywood teeth look boring and basic, perhaps perfect faces will fall from fashion? I mention the veneers, because when I was watching the Bridget Jones movie, I become fascinated by Chiwetel Ejiofor's teeth. They're absolutely lovely, yes, but sort of ... normal? One lower one peeps out from slightly behind the others. It only added to his charm. Hugh Grant's 64-year-old face looked charismatically crumpled too. Maybe when everyone has been homogenised to a glazed sheen of perfection, sagging, bumps, gaping pores and rough patches will be the height of desirability. At that point, I'll be ready for my closeup.
tgt_seg: 我想我们这些顽固派只能等待潮流转向。就像奥赛康和闪亮贴面牙可能让瘦削身材和好莱坞白牙显得乏味，或许完美面孔也会过时？提到贴面牙，看《BJ单身日记》时我被切瓦特·埃加福的牙齿迷住了——非常漂亮，但有点…自然？下排有颗牙稍稍躲在后面，反而增添魅力。64岁的休·格兰特皱纹纵横的脸也充满韵味。当所有人都变成完美无瑕的瓷娃娃时，松弛、凹凸、粗大毛孔和斑驳或许会成为新宠。到那时，我就能从容面对特写镜头了。

src_seg:
I am a tweakment holdout. When will wrinkles, bad teeth and big pores be back in fashion?
Totally neutral question, no right or wrong answer: how do you feel about salmon sperm?
tgt_seg:
我是一个反对整容的人。皱纹、糟糕的牙齿和粗大的毛孔什么时候会重新流行起来呢？
完全中立的问题，没有对或错的答案：你对鲑鱼精液有什么看法？

src_seg: It's not a Nordic culinary microtrend or a sex thing, but a beauty treatment, in which "Polydeoxyribonucleotides (PDRN) derived from purified fragments of DNA extracted from yes, "salmon sperm"" are injected into your face. It does seem to work: proper research has found PDRN has wound-repairing properties in hard-to-treat contexts such as diabetic ulcers and deep burns. Good news (unless you're a male salmon). But what is it doing in healthy faces?
tgt_seg: 这不是一个北欧的烹饪小趋势或与性相关的玩意儿，而是一种美容疗法，其中来自“鲑鱼精液”提取的纯化DNA片段衍生成的“多脱氧核苷酸链（PDRN）”被注射到你的脸上。这款疗法似乎确实有效：科学研究发现，PDRN在糖尿病性溃疡和深度烧伤等难以治疗的病例中具有伤口修复的特性。好消息（除非你是一条雄性鲑鱼）。但它在健康的面部上究竟有什么作用呢？

src_seg: I learned about salmon sperm in a Sunday Times article on the "skincare secrets" of "26 tastemakers," which I read, increasingly aghast. It was a litany of lasers, microneedling, injectables and proprietary treatments with silly names that left me shouting crossly at my laptop: "But what does it do?" The only treatment I related to at all was Marina Abramović recounting how a friend of her mother's put hot mashed potato on her face to temporarily erase wrinkles; Abramović herself uses "thermage radiofrequency." No wonder a salmon sperm practitioner says it's "an exciting time in the aesthetic industry."
tgt_seg: 我在《星期日时报》上读到一篇关于“26位潮流引领者的护肤秘诀”的文章，其中提到了鲑鱼精液。我越读越震惊。文章中大量提及了激光、微针、注射剂和各种带有傻笑名字的专有疗法，这让我对着笔记本电脑恼怒地喊道：“但它到底有什么用？”我唯一表示认同的疗法，是玛瑞娜·阿布拉莫维奇讲述她妈妈的一个朋友把热土豆泥敷在她脸上，以暂时消除皱纹的故事；阿布拉莫维奇自己使用“热能射频疗法”。难怪一位鲑鱼精液的使用者说这“是美容行业的激动人心的时刻”。

src_seg: Some contributors were celebs, regularly running the unforgiving gauntlet of high-definition television, and the rest were at least very interested, if not professionally involved, in beauty, so they probably aren't typical. And there's a certain honesty to it, at least. No one is making out their dewy glow is "just good genes" and "loads of water." But I also think this newfound willingness to talk about "tweakments" (a jaunty portmanteau that makes me queasy) is a product of them being absolutely everywhere.
tgt_seg: 一些参与者是名人，他们经常经受高清电视带来的严峻挑战，而其他人则至少对美容非常感兴趣，即使他们不是专业人员。因此，他们可能并不属于典型群体。至少有一份诚实是让他们值得称道的。没有任何人把自己的光泽外表描述为“只是基因好”或“多喝水”的结果。不过我也认为这种勇于谈论“微整形”的意愿（一个让我感到不适的俏皮合成词）是由于他们无处不在的缘故。

src_seg: Because they are everywhere, for everyone. According to researchers at University College London, the UK injectables market will be worth £11.7bn by next year, with Botox and fillers available anywhere from Harley Street to high-street hairdressers. Writing in Grazia last week, the Guardian beauty columnist Sali Hughes described how "women in teaching, policing and the civil service" ask her advice on where to get "good injections." In the US, Botox use by 20- to 29-year-olds has increased 28% since 2010, with gen Z buying into "prejuvenation" (another awful portmanteau), fuelled by the poreless perfection offered by filters, staring at themselves on pandemic screens and social media skinfluencers (argh).
tgt_seg: 因为它们无处不在，为每个人都提供服务。据伦敦大学学院的研究人员称，到明年，英国注射美容市场将价值117亿英镑，从哈雷街到大型超市里的美容店，都能买到玻尿酸和肉毒杆菌注射产品。上周，《格拉齐亚》杂志刊登了《卫报》美容专栏作家萨莉·休斯的文章，描述了“在教育、警务和政府部门工作的女性”如何向她咨询在哪里可以得到“好的注射服务”。在美国，20至29岁人群的玻尿酸使用率自2010年以来增长了28%，Z世代热衷于“青春前保养”（又一个令人难以接受的组合词），这一热潮是受滤镜带来的无毛孔完美形象、疫情期间屏幕前的自己以及社交媒体美颜博主的影响推动的（真是令人受不了）。

也许当所有人都被同质化，变得完美无瑕、光滑如釉时，皮肤松弛、疙瘩、毛孔粗大和肤质粗糙反而会成为最令人向往的特质。到那时，我就准备好迎接我的特写镜头了。

Totally neutral question, no right or wrong answer: how do you feel about salmon sperm?
tgt_seg:
我是个抗拒微调美容的人。皱纹、牙齿不齐和毛孔粗大什么时候才会重新流行起来？
一个完全中立的问题，没有对错之分：你对鲑鱼精子有什么看法？

src_seg: It's not a Nordic culinary microtrend or a sex thing, but a beauty treatment, in which "Polydeoxyribonucleotides (PDRN) derived from purified fragments of DNA extracted from yes, "salmon sperm"" are injected into your face. It does seem to work: proper research has found PDRN has wound-repairing properties in hard-to-treat contexts such as diabetic ulcers and deep burns. Good news (unless you're a male salmon). But what is it doing in healthy faces?
tgt_seg: 这并非北欧美食微趋势或与性相关的事物，而是一种美容疗法，其过程是将“从鲑鱼精子中提取的纯化DNA片段中衍生的聚脱氧核糖核苷酸（PDRN）”注射到面部。该疗法确实有效：严谨的研究发现，PDRN在难以治疗的病症中具有修复伤口的特性，例如糖尿病溃疡和深度烧伤。这对人类来说是个好消息（除非你是一条雄性鲑鱼）。但这种疗法在健康的面部中又能发挥什么作用呢？

src_seg: I learned about salmon sperm in a Sunday Times article on the "skincare secrets" of "26 tastemakers," which I read, increasingly aghast. It was a litany of lasers, microneedling, injectables and proprietary treatments with silly names that left me shouting crossly at my laptop: "But what does it do?" The only treatment I related to at all was Marina Abramović recounting how a friend of her mother's put hot mashed potato on her face to temporarily erase wrinkles; Abramović herself uses "thermage radiofrequency." No wonder a salmon sperm practitioner says it's "an exciting time in the aesthetic industry."
tgt_seg: 我在《星期日泰晤士报》上读到一篇关于“26位品味引领者”的“护肤秘诀”的文章，其中提到了鲑鱼精子，读得我越来越震惊。文章列举了一系列激光、微针、注射和拥有荒诞名称的专利疗法，让我愤怒地对着笔记本电脑大喊：“但这到底有什么用？”唯一让我稍感亲切的疗法是玛丽娜·阿布拉莫维奇回忆她母亲的一个朋友如何用热土豆泥敷脸来暂时消除皱纹；而阿布拉莫维奇本人则使用“热玛吉射频”疗法。难怪一位鲑鱼精子疗法的从业者会说，这是“美容行业令人兴奋的时刻”。

src_seg: Some contributors were celebs, regularly running the unforgiving gauntlet of high-definition television, and the rest were at least very interested, if not professionally involved, in beauty, so they probably aren't typical. And there's a certain honesty to it, at least. No one is making out their dewy glow is "just good genes" and "loads of water." But I also think this newfound willingness to talk about "tweakments" (a jaunty portmanteau that makes me queasy) is a product of them being absolutely everywhere.
tgt_seg: 一些参与者是名人，他们经常在高清电视的严苛考验下接受检验，其余的人至少对美容非常感兴趣，即使不是专业从事这一行业。因此，他们可能并不具代表性。但至少，这种态度有一定的真诚性。没有人声称自己的水润光泽仅仅是“优良基因”和“多喝水”的结果。不过，我认为这种新兴的、愿意公开讨论“微调美容”（这个轻佻的混成词让我感到不适）的现象，正是因为这类手段如今无处不在。

src_seg: Because they are everywhere, for everyone. According to researchers at University College London, the UK injectables market will be worth £11.7bn by next year, with Botox and fillers available anywhere from Harley Street to high-street hairdressers. Writing in Grazia last week, the Guardian beauty columnist Sali Hughes described how "women in teaching, policing and the civil service" ask her advice on where to get "good injections." In the US, Botox use by 20- to 29-year-olds has increased 28% since 2010, with gen Z buying into "prejuvenation" (another awful portmanteau), fuelled by the poreless perfection offered by filters, staring at themselves on pandemic screens and social media skinfluencers (argh).
tgt_seg: 因为它们无处不在，人人都能使用。根据伦敦大学学院的研究人员，英国注射类产品市场规模预计到明年将达到117亿英镑，从哈雷街到街头理发店，肉毒杆菌素和填充剂随处可得。上周在《Grazia》杂志上撰文的《卫报》美容专栏作家萨莉·休斯描述了“教育、警务和公务员领域的女性”如何向她咨询“哪里能打到好的注射”。在美国，20至29岁人群使用肉毒杆菌素的比例自2010年以来增长了28%，Z世代开始追捧“预防性抗衰老”（又一个可怕的混成词），这股风潮受到滤镜带来的无瑕完美、疫情期间盯着屏幕看自己以及社交媒体上的“皮肤网红”（哎）的推动。

src_seg: I shouldn't be surprised - actual children are buying expensive anti-ageing potions and fretting about their nonexistent crow's feet now. But still, this dramatic normalisation of invasive beauty procedures is unnerving.
tgt_seg: 我不该感到惊讶——如今，真实的孩子们正在购买昂贵的抗衰老产品，并为自己并不存在的鱼尾纹而烦恼。但即便如此，这种侵入性美容手术的急剧常态化仍然令人不安。

src_seg: For one thing, tweakments are so expensive! It's none of my business how people spend their money - my disposable income is dedicated to becoming the Joe Exotic of decorative poultry - but will we end up with an attractiveness inequality gap? Or will the democratisation of HD face mean almost everyone will be smoothly immobile soon? I suspect there will always be better and worse tweakments: that UCL research also points out how alarmingly unregulated the industry is.
tgt_seg: 一方面，微调美容手术实在太贵了！别人怎么花钱与我无关——我的可支配收入都用来成为装饰禽类界的乔·艾克索蒂克了——但我们是否会因此出现吸引力差距？或者，随着高清面部美容的普及，几乎所有人很快都会拥有光滑僵硬的面容？我猜想，微调美容手术总会有优劣之分：伦敦大学学院的那项研究也指出，这一行业的监管状况令人担忧。

src_seg: It's also uncomfortable feeling so out of step. My only foray into tweakment territory is getting my brows, lost to alopecia, tattooed back on (which demonstrates how central frowning is to my character, so Botox is out). It's not that I'm smugly delighted with my 50-year-old face: the baleful crone in my new passport photo appears, inexplicably, to have a single black eye (actually just a dark circle), adding to the "pensioner arrested after brawl outside bookies" vibe. It would be nice to feel better about my neck, but not nice enough to actually do anything painful and expensive about it.
tgt_seg: 感到自己如此格格不入也让人不太舒服。我唯一一次尝试“微调”美容，是将因脱发而消失的眉毛纹了回来（这也证明了皱眉是我性格中不可或缺的一部分，所以肉毒杆菌注射就不考虑了）。并不是说我对自己50岁的面容洋洋自得：新护照照片里那个愁眉苦脸的老妇人，不知为何竟然有一只黑眼睛（其实只是个黑眼圈），更增添了“养老金领取者在博彩店外斗殴后被捕”的氛围。如果能让我的脖子看起来更好，当然不错，但还不至于要为此忍受痛苦和高昂的费用。

src_seg: I suppose we tweakment holdouts will have to wait, and hope, for the tide to turn. As Ozempic and shiny veneers may make thinness and Hollywood teeth look boring and basic, perhaps perfect faces will fall from fashion? I mention the veneers, because when I was watching the Bridget Jones movie, I become fascinated by Chiwetel Ejiofor's teeth. They're absolutely lovely, yes, but sort of ... normal? One lower one peeps out from slightly behind the others. It only added to his charm. Hugh Grant's 64-year-old face looked charismatically crumpled too. Maybe when everyone has been homogenised to a glazed sheen of perfection, sagging, bumps, gaping pores and rough patches will be the height of desirability. At that point, I'll be ready for my closeup.

tgt_seg: 因为它们无处不在，适合每个人。根据伦敦大学学院的研究人员，到明年，英国的注射剂市场将价值117亿英镑，从哈雷街到高街理发店，随处都可以找到肉毒杆菌和填充物。上周在《Grazia》杂志上，卫报美容专栏作家萨利·休斯（Sali Hughes）描述了在“教学、警务和公务员”中工作的女性如何向她咨询在哪里可以获得“好的注射”。在美国，20至29岁的人使用肉毒杆菌的比例自2010年以来增加了28%，Z世代购买“预juvenation”（另一个可怕的组合词），由滤镜提供的无毛孔完美、在疫情屏幕上盯着自己看以及社交媒体皮肤影响者（啊）推动。

src_seg: I shouldn't be surprised - actual children are buying expensive anti-ageing potions and fretting about their nonexistent crow's feet now. But still, this dramatic normalisation of invasive beauty procedures is unnerving.

src_seg: It's also uncomfortable feeling so out of step. src_seg: It's not a Nordic culinary microtrend or a sex thing, but a beauty treatment, in which "Polydeoxyribonucleotides (PDRN) derived from purified fragments of DNA extracted from yes, "salmon sperm"" are injected into your face. It does seem to work: proper research has found PDRN has wound-repairing properties in hard-to-treat contexts such as diabetic ulcers and deep burns. Good news (unless you're a male salmon). src_seg: I learned about salmon sperm in a Sunday Times article on the "skincare secrets" of "26 tastemakers," which I read, increasingly aghast. It was a litany of lasers, microneedling, injectables and proprietary treatments with silly names that left me shouting crossly at my laptop: "But what does it do?" The only treatment I related to at all was Marina Abramović recounting how a friend of her mother's put hot mashed potato on her face to temporarily erase wrinkles; Abramović herself uses "thermage radiofrequency." No wonder a salmon sperm practitioner says it's "an exciting time in the aesthetic industry."

src_seg: Some contributors were celebs, regularly running the unforgiving gauntlet of high-definition television, and the rest were at least very interested, if not professionally involved, in beauty, so they probably aren't typical. And there's a certain honesty to it, at least. No one is making out their dewy glow is "just good genes" and "loads of water." But I also think this newfound willingness to talk about "tweakments" (a jaunty portmanteau that makes me queasy) is a product of them being absolutely everywhere.

src_seg: Because they are everywhere, for everyone. src_seg: I suppose we tweakment holdouts will have to wait, and hope, for the tide to turn.
