As I said a few months ago [boing.world], the estate offered me a garage meaning I finally have somewhere to put a van that I can convert into a microcamper.
So I bought this Berlingo last month.
I thought the fact it was already converted into a van would probably make the camper-conversion easier.
Turns out that's likely not really the case. So it goes. It's previously been converted for a wheelchair ramp, which means the floor has been lowered, and this means there's nowhere safe to bolt rear passenger seats, and so can't have that "rock and roll" bed, that converts into seatbelted seats for passengers.
It does add a large underfloor storage area though.
I thought it would be fairly easy to remove the metal plates over the windows, but that turned out to be a mistaken assumption too. Was no metal plates. They'd just painted over the glass with some metallic paint. Luckily this can be just scraped off, presumably with some paint dissolving solvents applied too. Dunno. I let the professionals handle that.
tgt_seg:
几个月前我曾说过 [boing.world]，房地产经纪人给我提供了一个车库，这意味着我终于有地方存放一辆可以改装成微型露营车的面包车了。
于是，我上个月买了这辆Berlingo。
我当时想，既然它已经被改装成了一辆厢式货车，那么改装成露营车应该会更容易些。
结果事实并非如此。原来它之前被改装过，安装了轮椅坡道，这意味着地板被降低了，这样一来就没有安全的地方来固定后排乘客座椅，也就无法安装那种可以转换成带安全带座椅的“摇滚”床。
不过，这倒是增加了一个很大的地板下储物空间。
我以为移除窗户上的金属板应该相当容易，但结果证明这也是一个错误的假设。根本没有金属板，他们只是用某种金属漆把玻璃涂上了。幸运的是，这层漆可以被刮掉，据推测也可以使用一些油漆溶解溶剂。我让专业人士来处理这件事。

src_seg:
The folks that can do an actually good job of converting it into a microcamper are busy till July, so I get to play at doing a half arsed job to tide it over until then.
First job is taking out the floor to gain access to that underfloor area and to cover that in linoleum. Had some lying around after they did the bathroom last year.
Then to refit the floor and cover all that in a red felt carpet.
The job is shoddy here really. What's needed is to insulate the entire body of the car and then cover professionally and well, but I dunno how to do all that. I just used spray glue to fasten this stretch carpet to the existing wood, that'll be replaced when it's converted proper anyway.
The roof will remain cold and metal till then.
tgt_seg:
那些能把车改装成微型露营车的人要到七月份才有空，所以我得先凑合着做一个半吊子的改装，直到那时。
第一步是拆除地板，以便进入地板下的空间，并铺上软木地板。去年他们装修浴室时，我手头有一些剩余的材料。
然后重新安装地板，并在上面铺上红色的毡毯。
说实话，这活做得很粗糙。真正需要做的是给整个车身隔热，然后进行专业的覆盖，但我不知道怎么做这一切。我只是用喷胶把这块拉伸地毯固定在现有的木头上，反正等专业改装时这块木头也会被换掉。
在那之前，车顶仍然会是冷冰冰的金属。

src_seg:
This chair works very well in the van. Should ideally be fastened better to the floor, but it has a nice three mode positions.
Seating, and chaise-long, and flat as a bed with the passenger seat folded down.
tgt_seg:
这把椅子在车里用得很舒服。理想情况下应该把它固定得更牢靠一些，但它有三个不错的位置模式。
可以当座椅，长椅，甚至可以和乘客座椅折叠起来当床使用。

src_seg:
You can get a folding leaf table, and if you saw off the bottom 15cm or so of the panels forming the sides and front of the table, and also don't bother to attach any of the the back leaf, then it becomes just the right height to mostly fit under the rear window.
It's a little higher than the camper-fridge, but the camper fridge is pretty much the same height as a little bedside cabinet.
There's also a small rectangular sink that fits nicely around the same width as the fridge alongside that cut down table.
And thus, the interior can be mostly constructed in my flat. The kids in the flat upstairs kept waving as me as I was doing a terrible job of cutting down those panels with a jigsaw in the yard.
tgt_seg:
你可以买一个折叠的叶子桌，如果你把桌子侧面和前面的面板底部锯掉15厘米左右，并且不安装后面的叶子，那么它的高度就刚好可以大部分塞到后窗下面。
它比露营冰箱稍微高一点，但露营冰箱的高度和一个小床头柜差不多。
还有一个小的矩形水槽，和冰箱一样宽，可以很好地放在改装过的桌子旁边。
这样一来，内部结构大部分都可以在我的公寓里完成。上层公寓的孩子们一直向我挥手，因为我在院子里用曲线锯切割那些面板，做得很糟糕。

src_seg:
Then there's a whole day of carrying those things out to the van and trying to screw them into the floor.
Had to swap the fridge and the cabinet around from the plan. The fridge is less deep than it is wide and doesn't block the table-leaf when it's at the edge with door facing the front of the car.
I expected to have to pause here and measure up and buy some wood, but someone had thrown out a desk that matches very well and a bit more sawing managed to get that into the right shape to build a frame to hold everything in place.
That sink is attached by only one of the six grips that are supposed to hold it. Two can't be used flat against a wooden board, and 3 aren't against anything at all right now.
Maybe I can get to attach better when the pump and tap arrive.
tgt_seg:
然后还有一整天的时间，把那些东西搬到车里，并试图把它们固定在地板上。
不得不把冰箱和柜子的位置对调一下。冰箱的深度比宽度小，当它放在边缘时，门朝向车头，不会挡住桌子。
我本以为需要停下来测量一下，然后再买些木头，但有人扔掉了一个很合适的桌子，经过再加工，我就能把它改造成合适的形状，用来做一个框架，把所有东西都固定住。
那个水槽目前只用六个夹子中的一个固定着，有两个不能平放在木板上，还有三个现在根本没有固定在任何东西上。
也许等水泵和水龙头到了之后，我可以把它固定得更好。

src_seg:
I like the easy access to battery and water and things from the back. Fair amount of storage there too which is accessible from inside if the table is up.
Still need to put the water pump into the water cannister, and power it, and attach some sort of tap to it.
tgt_seg:
我喜欢从后面就能轻松接触到电池和水箱。后面还有相当大的储物空间，从车内也可以够到。
还需要把水泵装到水箱里，接上电源，并安装一个水龙头。

src_seg:
And that's about as good a job as I can do really. Hopefully some of it will still be useable in a few months when it's done properly by a professional.
At least the fridge ought to carry over.
The bed folding down past the passenger seat is great. I'm too talk for this van really, but that makes it workable. Shame the seat/bed has to be so narrow though. The two-seater was very temping and feels like it ought to just about fit but, wouldn't really be any way to unfold it from within the van and the steering wheel gets in the way for folding the driving seat down like the passenger seat does so couldn't really go flat without also lifting up.
tgt_seg:
这差不多就是我能做到的最好水平了。希望几个月后专业人士来改装时，这些东西还能有一些用处。
至少冰箱应该还能用。
乘客座椅上方的折叠床很不错。我对这辆车来说有点太高了，但这样也还算能用。遗憾的是，座椅/床不得不做得很窄。两座位的座椅很诱人，似乎刚好能放下，但从车内无法展开，而且方向盘会挡住驾驶座椅的折叠，所以如果不抬起座椅，就无法完全放平。

src_seg:
Thank goodness for Blender! Not sure I could have planned all that and had any hope of it all working out if I couldn't do it in virtual 3d first.
3 frames to show the 3 main configurations. Sit, Desk, and Sleep.
tgt_seg:
感谢Blender！如果不能在虚拟3D环境中进行规划，我不确定是否能让所有东西都正常工作。
我制作了三个框架，展示了三种主要配置：坐着、办公和睡觉。

然后重新安装地板，并在上面铺上红色毛毡地毯。
这里的工作确实很粗糙。需要做的是给整个车身做保温，然后专业地好好覆盖，但我不知道怎么做这些。我只是用喷胶把这个弹性地毯固定在现有的木头上，反正等正式改装时这些都会被替换掉。
车顶在那之前会保持冰冷的金属状态。

src_seg:
This chair works very well in the van. Should ideally be fastened better to the floor, but it has a nice three mode positions.
Seating, and chaise-long, and flat as a bed with the passenger seat folded down.
tgt_seg:
这把椅子在货车里效果很好。理想情况下应该更好地固定在地板上，但它有很好的三种模式位置。
坐姿、躺椅和平躺成床的状态，需要把乘客座椅折叠下来。

src_seg:
You can get a folding leaf table, and if you saw off the bottom 15cm or so of the panels forming the sides and front of the table, and also don't bother to attach any of the the back leaf, then it becomes just the right height to mostly fit under the rear window.
It's a little higher than the camper-fridge, but the camper fridge is pretty much the same height as a little bedside cabinet.
There's also a small rectangular sink that fits nicely around the same width as the fridge alongside that cut down table.
And thus, the interior can be mostly constructed in my flat. The kids in the flat upstairs kept waving as me as I was doing a terrible job of cutting down those panels with a jigsaw in the yard.

你可以买一个折叠桌，如果你锯掉构成桌子侧面和前面挡板底部15厘米左右，并且不费心安装任何后挡板，那么它就会变成刚好的高度，基本能放在后窗下面。
它比房车冰箱稍微高一点，但房车冰箱的高度基本和小床头柜一样。
还有一个小的长方形水槽，宽度正好和冰箱差不多，可以放在那个改短的桌子旁边。
因此，内部装修大部分可以在我的公寓里完成。楼上公寓的孩子们一直向我挥手，当时我正在院子里用拼图锯很糟糕地切割那些挡板。

src_seg:
Then there's a whole day of carrying those things out to the van and trying to screw them into the floor.
Had to swap the fridge and the cabinet around from the plan. The fridge is less deep than it is wide and doesn't block the table-leaf when it's at the edge with door facing the front of the car.
I expected to have to pause here and measure up and buy some wood, but someone had thrown out a desk that matches very well and a bit more sawing managed to get that into the right shape to build a frame to hold everything in place.
That sink is attached by only one of the six grips that are supposed to hold it. Two can't be used flat against a wooden board, and 3 aren't against anything at all right now.
Maybe I can get to attach better when the pump and tap arrive.

然后花了整整一天把这些东西搬到货车上，试图把它们拧到地板上。

我原本以为要在这里停下来测量并买一些木材，但有人扔掉了一张很配的桌子，再锯一下就能弄成合适的形状来建造一个框架把所有东西固定到位。
那个水槽只用了本应固定它的六个夹子中的一个。两个不能平贴在木板上，另外三个现在根本没有贴着任何东西。
也许等水泵和水龙头到了我能更好地固定它。

src_seg:
I like the easy access to battery and water and things from the back. Fair amount of storage there too which is accessible from inside if the table is up.
Still need to put the water pump into the water cannister, and power it, and attach some sort of tap to it.
tgt_seg:
我喜欢从后面容易接触到电池、水和其他东西。那里也有相当多的储物空间，如果桌子立起来的话从里面也能够到。
还需要把水泵放进水箱里，给它供电，并给它接上某种水龙头。

src_seg:
And that's about as good a job as I can do really. Hopefully some of it will still be useable in a few months when it's done properly by a professional.
At least the fridge ought to carry over.
The bed folding down past the passenger seat is great. I'm too talk for this van really, but that makes it workable. Shame the seat/bed has to be so narrow though. The two-seater was very temping and feels like it ought to just about fit but, wouldn't really be any way to unfold it from within the van and the steering wheel gets in the way for folding the driving seat down like the passenger seat does so couldn't really go flat without also lifting up.
tgt_seg:
这基本上就是我能做的最好的工作了。希望其中一些在几个月后由专业人士正式完成时还能用得上。
至少冰箱应该可以保留。

src_seg:

3 frames to show the 3 main configurations. Sit, Desk, and Sleep.
tgt_seg:
感谢Blender！如果我不能先在虚拟3D中完成，我不确定我能否规划好这一切并指望它们都能成功。
3个画面展示3种主要配置。坐、桌和睡。

Turns out that's likely not really the case. So it goes. It's previously been converted for a wheelchair ramp, which means the floor has been lowered, and this means there's nowhere safe to bolt rear passenger seats, and so can't have that "rock and roll" bed, that converts into seatbelted seats for passengers.
It does add a large underfloor storage area though.
I thought it would be fairly easy to remove the metal plates over the windows, but that turned out to be a mistaken assumption too. Was no metal plates. They'd just painted over the glass with some metallic paint. Luckily this can be just scraped off, presumably with some paint dissolving solvents applied too. Dunno. I let the professionals handle that.

正如几个月前我所说（[boing.world]），房产方给我提供了一个车库，这意味着我终于有地方可以停放一辆可以改装成小型房车的面包车了。

src_seg:
The folks that can do an actually good job of converting it into a microcamper are busy till July, so I get to play at doing a half arsed job to tide it over until then.
First job is taking out the floor to gain access to that underfloor area and to cover that in linoleum. Had some lying around after they did the bathroom last year.
Then to refit the floor and cover all that in a red felt carpet.
The job is shoddy here really. What's needed is to insulate the entire body of the car and then cover professionally and well, but I dunno how to do all that. I just used spray glue to fasten this stretch carpet to the existing wood, that'll be replaced when it's converted proper anyway.
The roof will remain cold and metal till then.

在那之前，车顶仍然会是冰冷的金属。

src_seg:
As I said a few months ago [boing.world], the estate offered me a garage meaning I finally have somewhere to put a van that I can convert into a microcamper.
So I bought this Berlingo last month.
I thought the fact it was already converted into a van would probably make the camper-conversion easier.
Turns out that's likely not really the case. So it goes. It's previously been converted for a wheelchair ramp, which means the floor has been lowered, and this means there's nowhere safe to bolt rear passenger seats, and so can't have that "rock and roll" bed, that converts into seatbelted seats for passengers.
It does add a large underfloor storage area though.
I thought it would be fairly easy to remove the metal plates over the windows, but that turned out to be a mistaken assumption too. Was no metal plates. They'd just painted over the glass with some metallic paint. Luckily this can be just scraped off, presumably with some paint dissolving solvents applied too. Dunno. I let the professionals handle that.
tgt_seg:
就像我几个月前说过的, 房地产给了我一个车库, 这意味着我终于有地方可以把一辆货车转换成一个小型露营车.
所以我上个月买了这个Berlingo.
我认为事实上它已经转换成一辆面包车可能会使露营者转换更容易.
事实证明,事实并非如此. 它以前被改造为轮椅坡道, 这意味着地板被降低了, 这意味着没有安全的地方可以把后座乘客座椅上, 所以不能有"摇滚"的床, 可以变成乘客带安全带的座椅.
虽然它确实增加了一个大地下储存区域.
我认为将很容易去除窗户上的金属板, 但这也被证明是一个错误的假设. 没有金属板. 他们只是用一些金属油漆涂抹玻璃. 幸运的是, 这可以简单地擦除, 可能也应用一些油漆溶解剂. 不知道. 我让专业人员处理.

src_seg:
The folks that can do an actually good job of converting it into a microcamper are busy till July, so I get to play at doing a half arsed job to tide it over until then.
First job is taking out the floor to gain access to that underfloor area and to cover that in linoleum. Had some lying around after they did the bathroom last year.
Then to refit the floor and cover all that in a red felt carpet.
The job is shoddy here really. What's needed is to insulate the entire body of the car and then cover professionally and well, but I dunno how to do all that. I just used spray glue to fasten this stretch carpet to the existing wood, that'll be replaced when it's converted proper anyway.
The roof will remain cold and metal till then.

那些能把它改造成小型露营车的人到7月份都很忙,
第一个工作是拆除地板, 进入地板下面的区域,
然后重新装修地板并用红色毯覆盖所有这些.
这里的工作真的很糟糕. 需要的是隔热汽车的整个车身,然后专业地覆盖,但我不知道如何做到这一切. 我只是用喷涂来将这张拉伸地毯固定在现有的木材上,
在那之前,屋顶将保持冷和金属.

Seating, and chaise-long, and flat as a bed with the passenger seat folded down.

src_seg:

It's a little higher than the camper-fridge, but the camper fridge is pretty much the same height as a little bedside cabinet.
There's also a small rectangular sink that fits nicely around the same width as the fridge alongside that cut down table.
And thus, the interior can be mostly constructed in my flat. The kids in the flat upstairs kept waving as me as I was doing a terrible job of cutting down those panels with a jigsaw in the yard.

这里还有一个小的矩形水槽, 适合冰箱的宽度,
楼上的孩子们一直在向我挥手,因为我在院子里用拼图刀砍下那些可怕的面板.

src_seg:

Maybe I can get to attach better when the pump and tap arrive.

冰箱的深度不如宽度, 没有堵住桌子的叶子, 当它在边缘, 门面向汽车的前面.
我预计要在这里停下来,测量并购买一些木材, 但有人扔掉了一张非常合适的桌子,

也许我可以在和水龙头到来时更好地固定起来.

src_seg:

Still need to put the water pump into the water cannister, and power it, and attach some sort of tap to it.

Then to refit the floor and cover all that in a red felt carpet.

我本以为拆掉车窗上的金属板会相当容易，但这个想法也错了。车上根本没有金属板，他们只是在玻璃上刷了些金属漆。幸运的是，这些漆可以直接刮掉，大概还需要用些油漆溶剂。我也不清楚，这事我还是交给专业人士来处理吧。

src_seg:
The folks that can do an actually good job of converting it into a microcamper are busy till July, so I get to play at doing a half arsed job to tide it over until then.
First job is taking out the floor to gain access to that underfloor area and to cover that in linoleum. Had some lying around after they did the bathroom last year.
Then to refit the floor and cover all that in a red felt carpet.
The job is shoddy here really. What's needed is to insulate the entire body of the car and then cover professionally and well, but I dunno how to do all that. I just used spray glue to fasten this stretch carpet to the existing wood, that'll be replaced when it's converted proper anyway.
The roof will remain cold and metal till then.

然后是重新装好地板，并在上面铺满一层红色毛毡地毯。
这里的活儿干得真的很糙。真正需要做的是给整个车身做隔热处理，然后再进行专业、精良的铺装，但我不知道该怎么做。我只是用喷胶把这种弹性地毯粘在现有的木板上，反正等正式改装时这些木板也都会被换掉。
在那之前，车顶就先让它光秃秃的，保持冰冷的金属原样吧。

src_seg:

src_seg:
You can get a folding leaf table, and if you saw off the bottom 15cm or so of the panels forming the sides and front of the table, and also don't bother to attach any of the the back leaf, then it becomes just the right height to mostly fit under the rear window.

There's also a small rectangular sink that fits nicely around the same width as the fridge alongside that cut down table.

src_seg:

src_seg:

src_seg:

src_seg:
As I said a few months ago [boing.world], the estate offered me a garage meaning I finally have somewhere to put a van that I can convert into a microcamper.
So I bought this Berlingo last month.
I thought the fact it was already converted into a van would probably make the camper-conversion easier.
Turns out that's likely not really the case. So it goes. It's previously been converted for a wheelchair ramp, which means the floor has been lowered, and this means there's nowhere safe to bolt rear passenger seats, and so can't have that "rock and roll" bed, that converts into seatbelted seats for passengers.
It does add a large underfloor storage area though.
I thought it would be fairly easy to remove the metal plates over the windows, but that turned out to be a mistaken assumption too. Was no metal plates. They'd just painted over the glass with some metallic paint. Luckily this can be just scraped off, presumably with some paint dissolving solvents applied too. Dunno. I let the professionals handle that.
tgt_seg:
几个月前我在 [boing.world] 上说过，房产方提供了一个车库，这意味着我终于有地方放置一辆可以改装成微型房车的小货车了。
所以我上个月买了这辆 Berlingo。
我以为它已经改装成货车的事实可能会让房车改装更容易。
结果可能并非如此。它之前被改装成轮椅坡道，这意味着地板已经被降低，这意味着没有安全的地方可以固定后排乘客座椅，因此不能有那种“摇摆”床，可以转换成带安全带的乘客座椅。
不过，它确实增加了一个大的地板下储物空间。
我以为移除窗户上的金属板会相当容易，但这也被证明是一个错误的假设。没有金属板。他们只是用一些金属漆在玻璃上涂了一层。幸运的是，这可以直接刮掉，假设也施加了一些油漆溶解剂。不知道。我让专业人士处理这个问题。

src_seg:
The folks that can do an actually good job of converting it into a microcamper are busy till July, so I get to play at doing a half arsed job to tide it over until then.
First job is taking out the floor to gain access to that underfloor area and to cover that in linoleum. Had some lying around after they did the bathroom last year.
Then to refit the floor and cover all that in a red felt carpet.
The job is shoddy here really. What's needed is to insulate the entire body of the car and then cover professionally and well, but I dunno how to do all that. I just used spray glue to fasten this stretch carpet to the existing wood, that'll be replaced when it's converted proper anyway.
The roof will remain cold and metal till then.

这里的工作确实很粗糙。需要做的是对整个车体进行绝缘，然后专业且妥善地覆盖，但我不知道如何做到这一点。我只是用喷胶将这块拉伸地毯固定在现有的木头上，反正改装好后会被替换。
屋顶将保持寒冷和金属状态，直到那时。

src_seg:
The folks that can do an actually good job of converting it into a microcamper are busy till July, so I get to play at doing a half arsed job to tide it over until then.
First job is taking out the floor to gain access to that underfloor area and to cover that in linoleum. Had some lying around after they did the bathroom last year.
Then to refit the floor and cover all that in a red felt carpet.
The job is shoddy here really. What's needed is to insulate the entire body of the car and then cover professionally and well, but I dunno how to do all that. I just used spray glue to fasten this stretch carpet to the existing wood, that'll be replaced when it's converted proper anyway.
The roof will remain cold and metal till then.
tgt_seg:
能真正把这辆车改装成迷你旅居车的人要到七月才空闲，所以我得先自己做点粗糙的工作，直到那时。
首先，要移除地板以访问地板下的区域，并在地板下铺上防滑垫。去年他们做浴室时留下的还有一些。
然后重新安装地板，并在上面铺上红色的毛毡地毯。
这项工作相当粗糙。真正需要的是对整个车身进行隔热处理，然后专业地覆盖，但我也不知道怎么做。我只是用喷胶把这块伸缩地毯固定在现有的木板上，等真正改装时会换掉。
车顶会一直保持冰冷和金属的状态。

src_seg:
This chair works very well in the van. Should ideally be fastened better to the floor, but it has a nice three mode positions.
Seating, and chaise-long, and flat as a bed with the passenger seat folded down.
tgt_seg: 这把椅子在货车里工作得很好。理想情况下应该更好地固定在地板上，但它有三种模式：坐姿、躺姿和床铺模式。

src_seg:
You can get a folding leaf table, and if you saw off the bottom 15cm or so of the panels forming the sides and front of the table, and also don't bother to attach any of the the back leaf, then it becomes just the right height to mostly fit under the rear window.
It's a little higher than the camper-fridge, but the camper fridge is pretty much the same height as a little bedside cabinet.
There's also a small rectangular sink that fits nicely around the same width as the fridge alongside that cut down table.
And thus, the interior can be mostly constructed in my flat. The kids in the flat upstairs kept waving as me as I was doing a terrible job of cutting down those panels with a jigsaw in the yard.
tgt_seg:
你可以买到一个可折叠的长方形桌子，如果锯掉桌子底部的15厘米左右，以及不安装后部的叶片，那么它就可以刚好适合后窗下方。
它的高度比旅居车冰箱略高，但冰箱的高度和一个小床头柜差不多。
还有一个小矩形水槽，正好可以贴着桌子的宽度放在冰箱旁边。
这样，大部分内部结构都可以在我的公寓里完成。楼上公寓的孩子们在院子里用锯子切割那些面板时，一直在向我挥手。

src_seg:
Then there's a whole day of carrying those things out to the van and trying to screw them into the floor.
Had to swap the fridge and the cabinet around from the plan. The fridge is less deep than it is wide and doesn't block the table-leaf when it's at the edge with door facing the front of the car.
I expected to have to pause here and measure up and buy some wood, but someone had thrown out a desk that matches very well and a bit more sawing managed to get that into the right shape to build a frame to hold everything in place.
That sink is attached by only one of the six grips that are supposed to hold it. Two can't be used flat against a wooden board, and 3 aren't against anything at all right now.
Maybe I can get to attach better when the pump and tap arrive.
tgt_seg:
然后就是一天的时间把那些东西搬到货车里，并试着把它们固定在地板上。
冰箱和橱柜的位置需要调整。冰箱比它宽，但不阻挡桌子的叶片，当门朝向车头时。
我本以为需要停下来测量并买些木板，但有人扔掉了一张匹配的书桌，多锯了一些，最终把它改成了一个框架，用来固定所有东西。
这个水槽只用了一个应该固定它的六个扣中的一个。两个不能平放在木板上，三个现在没有任何支撑。
也许等泵和水龙头到货时，我可以更好地固定它。

src_seg:
I like the easy access to battery and water and things from the back. Fair amount of storage there too which is accessible from inside if the table is up.
Still need to put the water pump into the water cannister, and power it, and attach some sort of tap to it.
tgt_seg:
我喜欢从后面轻松接触到电池和水等东西。那里还有相当多的储物空间，如果桌子放起来，从里面也可以访问。
还需要把水泵装进水罐里，接上电源，并安装某种水龙头。

src_seg:

At least the fridge ought to carry over.
The bed folding down past the passenger seat is great. I'm too talk for this van really, but that makes it workable. Shame the seat/bed has to be so narrow though. The two-seater was very temping and feels like it ought to just about fit but, wouldn't really be any way to unfold it from within the van and the steering wheel gets in the way for folding the driving seat down like the passenger seat does so couldn't really go flat without also lifting up.
tgt_seg:
这大概就是我能做的最好的工作了。希望几个月后由专业人士完成时，其中一些东西还能用。
至少冰箱应该能保留下来。
乘客座位折叠成床铺很棒。我对这辆货车来说已经说得够多了，但这个功能让它变得可行。只是床铺/座位太窄了，双人座看起来很诱人，但似乎勉强能放下，但无法从车内展开，方向盘挡住了驾驶座的折叠，所以不能完全平放，除非把驾驶座抬起。

src_seg:
Thank goodness for Blender! Not sure I could have planned all that and had any hope of it all working out if I couldn't do it in virtual 3d first.
3 frames to show the 3 main configurations. Sit, Desk, and Sleep.

感谢Blender！如果不是先在虚拟3D中规划，我可能根本无法想象这一切会如何运作。

src_seg:
As I said a few months ago [boing.world], the estate offered me a garage meaning I finally have somewhere to put a van that I can convert into a microcamper.
So I bought this Berlingo last month.
I thought the fact it was already converted into a van would probably make the camper-conversion easier.
Turns out that's likely not really the case. So it goes. It's previously been converted for a wheelchair ramp, which means the floor has been lowered, and this means there's nowhere safe to bolt rear passenger seats, and so can't have that "rock and roll" bed, that converts into seatbelted seats for passengers.
It does add a large underfloor storage area though.
I thought it would be fairly easy to remove the metal plates over the windows, but that turned out to be a mistaken assumption too. Was no metal plates. They'd just painted over the glass with some metallic paint. Luckily this can be just scraped off, presumably with some paint dissolving solvents applied too. Dunno. I let the professionals handle that.
tgt_seg:
我几个月前就说过[boing.world]，房产公司给我提供了一个车库，这意味着我终于有地方停放那辆我可以改造成微房车的小货车。
所以上个月我买了这辆Berlingo。
我原以为这辆车已经改造成货车，所以改造成房车会更容易。
事实证明，情况可能并不如此。这辆车之前被改造成轮椅坡道，这意味着地板已被降低，而这意味着没有安全的地方可以固定后排乘客座椅，所以不能有那种“摇滚和滚动”床，它可以转换成乘客的安全带座椅。
不过，它确实增加了大量的地板储物空间。
我原以为移除窗户上的金属板会比较容易，但事实证明我的假设是错误的。没有金属板。他们只是用金属漆在玻璃上画了一层。幸运的是，这可以轻松去除，可能需要一些去漆剂。我不知道。我让专业人士来处理。

src_seg:
The folks that can do an actually good job of converting it into a microcamper are busy till July, so I get to play at doing a half arsed job to tide it over until then.
First job is taking out the floor to gain access to that underfloor area and to cover that in linoleum. Had some lying around after they did the bathroom last year.
Then to refit the floor and cover all that in a red felt carpet.
The job is shoddy here really. What's needed is to insulate the entire body of the car and then cover professionally and well, but I dunno how to do all that. I just used spray glue to fasten this stretch carpet to the existing wood, that'll be replaced when it's converted proper anyway.
The roof will remain cold and metal till then.
tgt_seg:
那些能够将它改造成微房车的人忙到7月，所以我只能做一个半吊子工作来应付到那时。
第一步是移除地板以进入地板区域，并用地板覆盖。去年他们装修浴室时，我就剩下一些地板。
然后重新安装地板，用红色地毯覆盖所有东西。
这里的工作真的很粗糙。需要对整个车身进行绝缘，然后专业且良好地覆盖，但我不知道如何做到这一点。我只是用喷胶将这张拉伸的地毯固定在现有的木头上，改造成真正的房车时，这些木头会被替换掉。
到那时，屋顶仍然会保持冷金属状态。

src_seg:
This chair works very well in the van. Should ideally be fastened better to the floor, but it has a nice three mode positions.
Seating, and chaise-long, and flat as a bed with the passenger seat folded down.
tgt_seg:
这把椅子在货车里工作得很好。理想情况下，它应该更好地固定在地面上，但它有三个模式位置。
坐着，躺着，以及将乘客座椅折叠下来，变成一张床。

src_seg:
You can get a folding leaf table, and if you saw off the bottom 15cm or so of the panels forming the sides and front of the table, and also don't bother to attach any of the the back leaf, then it becomes just the right height to mostly fit under the rear window.
It's a little higher than the camper-fridge, but the camper fridge is pretty much the same height as a little bedside cabinet.
There's also a small rectangular sink that fits nicely around the same width as the fridge alongside that cut down table.
And thus, the interior can be mostly constructed in my flat. The kids in the flat upstairs kept waving as me as I was doing a terrible job of cutting down those panels with a jigsaw in the yard.
tgt_seg:
你可以得到一个折叠叶表，如果你砍掉形成桌子侧面和前面的面板下约15厘米，并且不要 bothering 连接任何后叶，那么它就刚好适合放在后窗下。
它比房车冰箱略高，但房车冰箱的高度与小床头柜差不多。
还有一个小矩形水槽，宽度与冰箱差不多，可以放在那张减小的桌子旁边。
这样，内部可以大部分在我家里建造。 upstairs 的孩子们不断地向我挥手，因为我在院子里用锯子锯那些面板时做得很糟糕。

src_seg:
Then there's a whole day of carrying those things out to the van and trying to screw them into the floor.
Had to swap the fridge and the cabinet around from the plan. The fridge is less deep than it is wide and doesn't block the table-leaf when it's at the edge with door facing the front of the car.
I expected to have to pause here and measure up and buy some wood, but someone had thrown out a desk that matches very well and a bit more sawing managed to get that into the right shape to build a frame to hold everything in place.
That sink is attached by only one of the six grips that are supposed to hold it. Two can't be used flat against a wooden board, and 3 aren't against anything at all right now.
Maybe I can get to attach better when the pump and tap arrive.
tgt_seg:
然后就是将这些东西搬运到货车里，并尝试将它们拧到地板上。
我必须将冰箱和柜子从计划中交换。冰箱比宽度深，不会阻挡桌子叶片，当它位于边缘，门面向汽车前部时。
我原以为我必须在这里停下来，测量并购买一些木头，但有人扔掉了一个与它非常匹配的桌子，经过一些锯木，我成功地将其切割成合适的形状，以构建一个框架来固定一切。
那个水槽只用其中一个六把手来固定，而六把手应该用来固定它。两个不能平放在一块木板上，三个现在什么都不是。
也许我可以更好地连接，当水泵和水龙头到达时。

src_seg:
I like the easy access to battery and water and things from the back. Fair amount of storage there too which is accessible from inside if the table is up.
Still need to put the water pump into the water cannister, and power it, and attach some sort of tap to it.
tgt_seg:
我喜欢从后面轻松访问电池、水和一些东西。在桌子上时，那里也有相当大的存储空间，可以从内部访问。
仍然需要将水泵放入水罐中，并对其进行供电，并将其连接到某种水龙头。

src_seg:
And that's about as good a job as I can do really. Hopefully some of it will still be useable in a few months when it's done properly by a professional.
At least the fridge ought to carry over.
The bed folding down past the passenger seat is great. I'm too talk for this van really, but that makes it workable. Shame the seat/bed has to be so narrow though. The two-seater was very temping and feels like it ought to just about fit but, wouldn't really be any way to unfold it from within the van and the steering wheel gets in the way for folding the driving seat down like the passenger seat does so couldn't really go flat without also lifting up.
tgt_seg:
这就是我能做的最好的工作。希望几个月后，当专业人士完成它时，其中一些仍然可以使用。
至少冰箱应该可以继承。
将床折叠到乘客座椅后面是很棒的。我对这辆货车真的太话多了，但这使它可行。太遗憾座椅/床必须那么窄了。两人的非常诱人，感觉应该刚好适合，但实际上没有办法从货车内部展开，方向盘妨碍了驾驶座椅像乘客座椅那样折叠，所以不能完全平躺，除非也抬起。

src_seg:
Thank goodness for Blender! Not sure I could have planned all that and had any hope of it all working out if I couldn't do it in virtual 3d first.
3 frames to show the 3 main configurations. Sit, Desk, and Sleep.
tgt_seg:
感谢Blender！如果我不能在虚拟3D中先做出来，我可能无法计划所有这些，并希望它能全部工作。
3个框架来显示3个主要配置。坐着，办公，睡觉。

src_seg:

src_seg:

tgt_seg:
这差不多就是我能做的最好的工作了。希望在几个月后,当专业人士完成工作时,其中一些内容仍然可以使用。

乘客座位后折叠的床非常好。我对这辆货车太过熟悉了，但这使得它可以使用。很遗憾，座椅/床必须这么窄。两座位非常诱人，感觉应该刚好可以放下，但实际上无法从货车内部展开，而且方向盘会阻碍驾驶座的折叠，就像乘客座一样，因此无法完全放平，同时也无法抬起。

src_seg:
As I said a few months ago [boing.world], the estate offered me a garage meaning I finally have somewhere to put a van that I can convert into a microcamper.
So I bought this Berlingo last month.
I thought the fact it was already converted into a van would probably make the camper-conversion easier.
Turns out that's likely not really the case. So it goes. It's previously been converted for a wheelchair ramp, which means the floor has been lowered, and this means there's nowhere safe to bolt rear passenger seats, and so can't have that "rock and roll" bed, that converts into seatbelted seats for passengers.
It does add a large underfloor storage area though.
I thought it would be fairly easy to remove the metal plates over the windows, but that turned out to be a mistaken assumption too. Was no metal plates. They'd just painted over the glass with some metallic paint. Luckily this can be just scraped off, presumably with some paint dissolving solvents applied too. Dunno. I let the professionals handle that.
tgt_seg:
我几个月前在 [boing.world] 上说过，这个庄园给我提供了车库，这意味着我终于有地方放一辆可以改造成微型房车的小货车了。
于是，我就在上个月买了这辆 Berlingo。
我觉得，由于它已经变成了厢式货车，因此将它改装成房车或许会容易一些。
事实证明，情况可能并非如此。原来，这辆车是为了轮椅坡道而改装的，这意味着需要降低地板高度，而这也就意味着无法安全地安装后排乘客座椅的固定装置，因此无法提供可以折叠成乘客安全带座椅的“摇滚床”。
但它确实增加了大量的地下存储空间。
我以为窗户上的金属板非常容易拆卸，但事实证明这也是个错误的假设。实际上窗户上根本没有金属板，上面只是一层金属漆。好在金属漆可以轻松刮掉，估计还需要用一些可以溶解油漆的溶剂。我也不太清楚。我就让专业人士来处理了。

src_seg:
The folks that can do an actually good job of converting it into a microcamper are busy till July, so I get to play at doing a half arsed job to tide it over until then.
First job is taking out the floor to gain access to that underfloor area and to cover that in linoleum. Had some lying around after they did the bathroom last year.
Then to refit the floor and cover all that in a red felt carpet.
The job is shoddy here really. What's needed is to insulate the entire body of the car and then cover professionally and well, but I dunno how to do all that. I just used spray glue to fasten this stretch carpet to the existing wood, that'll be replaced when it's converted proper anyway.
The roof will remain cold and metal till then.
tgt_seg:
能把它真正转换成微型房车的人都忙到 7 月，所以我只能做一些半吊子工作来度过这个时间。
第一个任务是拆掉地板，以便进入地下空间，然后把这个地方铺上塑料防滑板（去年改造卫生间时遗留下来的）。
然后重铺地板，并在上面铺一块红色的地毯。
这项工作做得很粗劣。其实需要将整个车体包起来再用专业的材料进行覆盖，但我不懂这么做。我就使用喷枪胶将这片地毯粘贴在现有的木板上，等到将来进行正式改装时再更换掉。
到那时为止，屋顶依然会保持冷冰冰的金属外表。

src_seg:
This chair works very well in the van. Should ideally be fastened better to the floor, but it has a nice three mode positions.
Seating, and chaise-long, and flat as a bed with the passenger seat folded down.
tgt_seg:
这把椅子在货车里用起来效果不错。最好能更好地固定在地板上，但它有三种位置调节功能，挺不错的。
车上还提供了座椅和沙发床，将后排乘客座椅折叠起来后，可供乘客平躺休息。

src_seg:
You can get a folding leaf table, and if you saw off the bottom 15cm or so of the panels forming the sides and front of the table, and also don't bother to attach any of the the back leaf, then it becomes just the right height to mostly fit under the rear window.
It's a little higher than the camper-fridge, but the camper fridge is pretty much the same height as a little bedside cabinet.
There's also a small rectangular sink that fits nicely around the same width as the fridge alongside that cut down table.

src_seg:

Maybe I can get to attach better when the pump and tap arrive.

也许在水泵和水龙头到达后，我可以更好的将其安装好。

src_seg:
I like the easy access to battery and water and things from the back. Fair amount of storage there too which is accessible from inside if the table is up.
Still need to put the water pump into the water cannister, and power it, and attach some sort of tap to it.
tgt_seg:
我喜欢后部方便取放电池和水等物品的设计。储物空间也足够大，如果把桌面抬起来，还可以从里面取放物品。

src_seg:

这差不多就是我所能做到的了。希望等到专业人士把事情做好后，这些东西还能用上几个月。

然后重新安装地板，并用红色毛毡地毯覆盖。
这里的工作确实很差劲。需要对整个车身进行隔热，然后进行专业且良好的覆盖，但我不知道如何做到这一切。我只是用喷胶将这块弹力地毯固定在现有的木头上，无论如何，当它被适当转换时就会被替换。
直到那时，屋顶仍将保持冰冷和金属状态。

src_seg:
This chair works very well in the van. Should ideally be fastened better to the floor, but it has a nice three mode positions.
Seating, and chaise-long, and flat as a bed with the passenger seat folded down.

src_seg:
You can get a folding leaf table, and if you saw off the bottom 15cm or so of the panels forming the sides and front of the table, and also don't bother to attach any of the the back leaf, then it becomes just the right height to mostly fit under the rear window.
It's a little higher than the camper-fridge, but the camper fridge is pretty much the same height as a little bedside cabinet.
There's also a small rectangular sink that fits nicely around the same width as the fridge alongside that cut down table.
And thus, the interior can be mostly constructed in my flat. The kids in the flat upstairs kept waving as me as I was doing a terrible job of cutting down those panels with a jigsaw in the yard.
tgt_seg:
您可以买一张折叠式桌子，如果您锯掉桌子侧面和正面的面板底部 15 厘米左右，并且不必费心连接任何后叶，那么它的高度就刚好适合放在后窗下方。
它比露营冰箱略高一点，但露营冰箱的高度与小床头柜的高度差不多。
还有一个小矩形水槽，其宽度与那张缩小的桌子旁边的冰箱差不多。
因此，室内大部分都可以在我的公寓里建造。当我在院子里用拼图锯笨拙地锯掉那些面板时，楼上的孩子们不停地向我挥手。

src_seg:
Then there's a whole day of carrying those things out to the van and trying to screw them into the floor.
Had to swap the fridge and the cabinet around from the plan. The fridge is less deep than it is wide and doesn't block the table-leaf when it's at the edge with door facing the front of the car.
I expected to have to pause here and measure up and buy some wood, but someone had thrown out a desk that matches very well and a bit more sawing managed to get that into the right shape to build a frame to hold everything in place.
That sink is attached by only one of the six grips that are supposed to hold it. Two can't be used flat against a wooden board, and 3 aren't against anything at all right now.
Maybe I can get to attach better when the pump and tap arrive.
tgt_seg:
然后花一整天的时间把这些东西搬到货车上并试着把它们拧到地板上。

该水槽仅通过六个用于固定它的夹具中的一个固定。两个不能平放在木板上，而三个现在根本不能放在任何东西上。
当泵和水龙头到达时，也许我可以更好地连接。

src_seg:
I like the easy access to battery and water and things from the back. Fair amount of storage there too which is accessible from inside if the table is up.
Still need to put the water pump into the water cannister, and power it, and attach some sort of tap to it.
tgt_seg:

src_seg:

At least the fridge ought to carry over.
The bed folding down past the passenger seat is great. I'm too talk for this van really, but that makes it workable. Shame the seat/bed has to be so narrow though. The two-seater was very temping and feels like it ought to just about fit but, wouldn't really be any way to unfold it from within the van and the steering wheel gets in the way for folding the driving seat down like the passenger seat does so couldn't really go flat without also lifting up.
tgt_seg:
这确实是我能做的最好的工作了。希望在专业人员正确完成之后，其中的一部分在几个月后仍然可用。

src_seg:

I thought the fact it was already converted into a van would probably make the camper-conversion easier.
Turns out that's likely not really the case. So it goes. It's previously been converted for a wheelchair ramp, which means the floor has been lowered, and this means there's nowhere safe to bolt rear passenger seats, and so can't have that "rock and roll" bed, that converts into seatbelted seats for passengers.
It does add a large underfloor storage area though.
I thought it would be fairly easy to remove the metal plates over the windows, but that turned out to be a mistaken assumption too. Was no metal plates. They'd just painted over the glass with some metallic paint. Luckily this can be just scraped off, presumably with some paint dissolving solvents applied too. Dunno. I let the professionals handle that.
tgt_seg:
几个月前我曾说过[boing.world]，公寓给了我一个车库，这意味着我终于有地方放一辆面包车，可以改装成微型露营车。
所以上个月我买了这辆百灵多。
我以为它已经改装成了面包车，应该更容易改装成露营车。
事实证明，这可能并不是真的。所以事情就是这样。它之前曾被改装成轮椅坡道，这意味着地板被降低了，这意味着没有安全的地方可以将后排乘客座椅固定，所以不能有那种“摇滚”床，它可以改装成带安全带的乘客座椅。
但它确实增加了很大的地板下储物空间。
我以为很容易就能拆掉窗户上的金属板，但事实证明这是一个错误的假设。没有金属板。他们只是在玻璃上涂了一些金属漆。幸运的是，这可以刮掉，可能还需要一些漆溶剂。我不知道。我让专业人士来处理。

src_seg:
The folks that can do an actually good job of converting it into a microcamper are busy till July, so I get to play at doing a half arsed job to tide it over until then.
First job is taking out the floor to gain access to that underfloor area and to cover that in linoleum. Had some lying around after they did the bathroom last year.
Then to refit the floor and cover all that in a red felt carpet.
The job is shoddy here really. What's needed is to insulate the entire body of the car and then cover professionally and well, but I dunno how to do all that. I just used spray glue to fasten this stretch carpet to the existing wood, that'll be replaced when it's converted proper anyway.
The roof will remain cold and metal till then.
tgt_seg:
那些真正能把这辆车改装成微型露营车的人要忙到七月，所以到那时我只能勉强完成。
第一项工作是拆掉地板，以便进入地板下区域，并在那里铺上油毡。去年他们在浴室做了之后，有一些油毡。
然后重新铺地板，并在上面铺上红色的毡毯。
这里的施工质量很差。真正需要的做法是隔热整个车身，然后专业地、良好地覆盖，但我不知道如何做这一切。我只是用喷涂胶将这块伸缩地毯固定在现有的木板上，反正这块木板在正式改装时会被替换。
到那时，屋顶仍然会保持冰冷和金属状态。

src_seg:
This chair works very well in the van. Should ideally be fastened better to the floor, but it has a nice three mode positions.
Seating, and chaise-long, and flat as a bed with the passenger seat folded down.
tgt_seg:
这把椅子在面包车里用起来非常好。应该更好地固定在地板上，但它有三个不错的位置。
坐姿，躺椅，以及与乘客座椅折叠后，床一样平坦。

src_seg:
You can get a folding leaf table, and if you saw off the bottom 15cm or so of the panels forming the sides and front of the table, and also don't bother to attach any of the the back leaf, then it becomes just the right height to mostly fit under the rear window.
It's a little higher than the camper-fridge, but the camper fridge is pretty much the same height as a little bedside cabinet.
There's also a small rectangular sink that fits nicely around the same width as the fridge alongside that cut down table.
And thus, the interior can be mostly constructed in my flat. The kids in the flat upstairs kept waving as me as I was doing a terrible job of cutting down those panels with a jigsaw in the yard.
tgt_seg:
你可以买一张折叠桌，如果把桌子侧面和前面板的下部15厘米左右锯掉，并且不要安装任何后侧板，那么它就变成了合适的高度，大部分可以放在后窗下。
它比露营车冰箱高一点，但露营车冰箱的高度与一个小床头柜差不多。
还有一个小矩形水槽，宽度与冰箱相同，可以放在那张缩短的桌子上。
这样，大部分内饰就可以在我的公寓里完成。楼上公寓里的孩子们在院子里用摆线锯锯那些板子时，一直在向我挥手，因为我做得非常糟糕。

src_seg:
Then there's a whole day of carrying those things out to the van and trying to screw them into the floor.
Had to swap the fridge and the cabinet around from the plan. The fridge is less deep than it is wide and doesn't block the table-leaf when it's at the edge with door facing the front of the car.
I expected to have to pause here and measure up and buy some wood, but someone had thrown out a desk that matches very well and a bit more sawing managed to get that into the right shape to build a frame to hold everything in place.
That sink is attached by only one of the six grips that are supposed to hold it. Two can't be used flat against a wooden board, and 3 aren't against anything at all right now.
Maybe I can get to attach better when the pump and tap arrive.
tgt_seg:
然后，有一整天的时间要将这些东西搬到面包车上，并试图将它们固定在地板上。
不得不改变冰箱和橱柜的计划。冰箱的深度小于宽度，当门朝向汽车前部时，不会挡住桌子的折叠部分。
我原以为需要在这里暂停，测量并购买一些木材，但有人扔出了一张非常匹配的桌子，通过更多的锯切，将其塑造成一个框架，以固定所有东西。
这个水槽只用了一个六个把手中的一个来固定它。两个不能平放在木板上，三个现在根本没有支撑。
也许当水泵和水龙头到货时，我可以更好地固定它们。

src_seg:
I like the easy access to battery and water and things from the back. Fair amount of storage there too which is accessible from inside if the table is up.
Still need to put the water pump into the water cannister, and power it, and attach some sort of tap to it.
tgt_seg:
我喜欢从后面轻松地访问电池和水等物品。那里也有很多存储空间，如果桌子收起的话，可以从里面进入。
仍然需要将水泵放入水罐中，并为其供电，并将其固定在某种水龙头上。

src_seg:
And that's about as good a job as I can do really. Hopefully some of it will still be useable in a few months when it's done properly by a professional.
At least the fridge ought to carry over.
The bed folding down past the passenger seat is great. I'm too talk for this van really, but that makes it workable. Shame the seat/bed has to be so narrow though. The two-seater was very temping and feels like it ought to just about fit but, wouldn't really be any way to unfold it from within the van and the steering wheel gets in the way for folding the driving seat down like the passenger seat does so couldn't really go flat without also lifting up.
tgt_seg:
这就是我真正能做的最好的工作。希望其中一些在几个月后由专业人士正式完成时仍然有用。
至少冰箱应该可以继续使用。
床可以折叠到乘客座椅后面，这很好。我对于这辆面包车来说太高了，但这样它就变得可行了。太遗憾了，座椅/床必须如此狭窄。双座车非常诱人，感觉应该差不多能放进去，但实际上没有办法从面包车内部展开它，方向盘会挡住驾驶座椅的折叠，就像乘客座椅一样，所以不能完全平躺，除非同时抬起。

src_seg:
Thank goodness for Blender! Not sure I could have planned all that and had any hope of it all working out if I couldn't do it in virtual 3d first.
3 frames to show the 3 main configurations. Sit, Desk, and Sleep.
tgt_seg:
感谢Blender！不确定如果我不能先在虚拟3D中做的话，我是否能计划这一切并希望这一切都能成功。
3个框架展示了3种主要配置。坐姿，办公桌和睡眠。

src_seg:
As I said a few months ago [boing.world], the estate offered me a garage meaning I finally have somewhere to put a van that I can convert into a microcamper.
So I bought this Berlingo last month.
I thought the fact it was already converted into a van would probably make the camper-conversion easier.
Turns out that's likely not really the case. So it goes. It's previously been converted for a wheelchair ramp, which means the floor has been lowered, and this means there's nowhere safe to bolt rear passenger seats, and so can't have that "rock and roll" bed, that converts into seatbelted seats for passengers.
It does add a large underfloor storage area though.
I thought it would be fairly easy to remove the metal plates over the windows, but that turned out to be a mistaken assumption too. Was no metal plates. They'd just painted over the glass with some metallic paint. Luckily this can be just scraped off, presumably with some paint dissolving solvents applied too. Dunno. I let the professionals handle that.
tgt_seg:
几个月前我说过[boing.world]，房产公司给了我一个车库，这意味着我终于可以放一辆面包车了，我可以把它改装成一辆微型露营车。
所以我上个月买了这辆Berlingo。
我以为它已经被改装成面包车，这可能会让改装成露营车更容易。
事实证明，情况可能并非如此。它以前被改装成轮椅坡道，这意味着地板已经被降低，这意味着没有安全的地方可以固定后排乘客座椅，所以不能有那种“摇滚床”，可以转换成有安全带的乘客座椅。
不过，它确实增加了一个大型地板下储物区。
我以为去掉窗户上的金属板会很容易，但事实证明这也是一个错误的假设。没有金属板。他们只是用金属漆把玻璃涂掉了。幸运的是，这可以刮掉，可能还需要使用一些溶解油漆的溶剂。我不知道。我让专业人士来处理。

src_seg:
The folks that can do an actually good job of converting it into a microcamper are busy till July, so I get to play at doing a half arsed job to tide it over until then.
First job is taking out the floor to gain access to that underfloor area and to cover that in linoleum. Had some lying around after they did the bathroom last year.
Then to refit the floor and cover all that in a red felt carpet.
The job is shoddy here really. What's needed is to insulate the entire body of the car and then cover professionally and well, but I dunno how to do all that. I just used spray glue to fasten this stretch carpet to the existing wood, that'll be replaced when it's converted proper anyway.
The roof will remain cold and metal till then.
tgt_seg:
那些能真正把车改装成微型露营车的人要到7月才有空，所以我得先做点马马虎虎的工作，先凑合着用。
第一件事是把地板拆下来，以便进入地板下区域，并用亚麻油地毡覆盖。去年他们装修浴室时留下了一些。
然后重新安装地板，并用红色毛毡地毯覆盖所有东西。
这里的工作真的很粗糙。需要做的是对整个车身进行隔热处理，然后进行专业且良好的覆盖，但我不知道如何做到这一点。我只是用喷胶把这块伸缩地毯固定在现有的木头上，反正它在正式改装时会被替换。
到那时，车顶将保持冰冷和金属。

src_seg:
This chair works very well in the van. Should ideally be fastened better to the floor, but it has a nice three mode positions.
Seating, and chaise-long, and flat as a bed with the passenger seat folded down.
tgt_seg:

座位，躺椅，和折叠成床，乘客座位折叠下来。

src_seg:

It's a little higher than the camper-fridge, but the camper fridge is pretty much the same height as a little bedside cabinet.
There's also a small rectangular sink that fits nicely around the same width as the fridge alongside that cut down table.
And thus, the interior can be mostly constructed in my flat. The kids in the flat upstairs kept waving as me as I was doing a terrible job of cutting down those panels with a jigsaw in the yard.

它比露营冰箱高一点，但露营冰箱的高度和一个小床头柜差不多。

src_seg:

Maybe I can get to attach better when the pump and tap arrive.

不得不把冰箱和橱柜从计划中换过来。冰箱的深度比宽度小，不会挡住桌子的叶子，当它在边缘时，门面向汽车的前部。

第一项工作是拆掉地板，以便能使用地板下的空间，并给那块地方铺上油毡。去年他们装修浴室后还剩下一些。
然后重新装上地板，并在上面铺满红色毛毡地毯。
我这活儿做得真的很糙。真正需要的是给整个车身做隔热处理，然后进行专业而妥善的覆盖，但我不知道该怎么做。我只是用了喷胶把这种弹性地毯粘在现有的木板上，反正等正式改装时这些木板也都会被换掉。
在那之前，车顶依然会保持冰冷的金属状态。

src_seg:
This chair works very well in the van. Should ideally be fastened better to the floor, but it has a nice three mode positions.
Seating, and chaise-long, and flat as a bed with the passenger seat folded down.
tgt_seg:

src_seg:
You can get a folding leaf table, and if you saw off the bottom 15cm or so of the panels forming the sides and front of the table, and also don't bother to attach any of the the back leaf, then it becomes just the right height to mostly fit under the rear window.
It's a little higher than the camper-fridge, but the camper fridge is pretty much the same height as a little bedside cabinet.
There's also a small rectangular sink that fits nicely around the same width as the fridge alongside that cut down table.
And thus, the interior can be mostly constructed in my flat. The kids in the flat upstairs kept waving as me as I was doing a terrible job of cutting down those panels with a jigsaw in the yard.
tgt_seg:
你可以买一张折叠桌，如果你锯掉桌子两侧和前面板子底部大约15厘米左右，并且不要费心安装任何背面折叶，那么它的高度就正好能基本塞进后窗下面。
它比房车冰箱稍微高一点，但房车冰箱的高度几乎和小床头柜一样。
还有一个小长方形水槽，宽度正好和冰箱差不多，可以放在那张锯短了的桌子旁边。
因此，内部装修大部分可以在我的公寓里完成。楼上公寓的孩子们一直在向我挥手，当时我正在院子里用线锯笨手笨脚地切割那些面板。

src_seg:
Then there's a whole day of carrying those things out to the van and trying to screw them into the floor.
Had to swap the fridge and the cabinet around from the plan. The fridge is less deep than it is wide and doesn't block the table-leaf when it's at the edge with door facing the front of the car.
I expected to have to pause here and measure up and buy some wood, but someone had thrown out a desk that matches very well and a bit more sawing managed to get that into the right shape to build a frame to hold everything in place.
That sink is attached by only one of the six grips that are supposed to hold it. Two can't be used flat against a wooden board, and 3 aren't against anything at all right now.
Maybe I can get to attach better when the pump and tap arrive.
tgt_seg:
然后就是花一整天时间把那些东西搬到车上，试着把它们用螺丝固定在地板上。
我不得不把冰箱和柜子的位置跟计划中对调一下。冰箱的深度比宽度小，当把它放在边缘、门朝向车头时，就不会挡住桌面折叶。
我原以为做到这里就得停下来，量尺寸再买些木头，但有人扔掉了一张非常匹配的桌子，我再锯了锯，就把它弄成了合适的形状，做成了一个框架来固定所有东西。
那个水槽本应用六个卡扣固定，但现在只用了一个。其中两个没法平贴在木板上使用，另外三个现在则完全没有着力点。
也许等水泵和水龙头到货后，我能把它固定得更好一些。

src_seg:
I like the easy access to battery and water and things from the back. Fair amount of storage there too which is accessible from inside if the table is up.
Still need to put the water pump into the water cannister, and power it, and attach some sort of tap to it.
tgt_seg:
我很喜欢从后面可以轻松拿到电池和水等东西。那里也有相当大的储物空间，如果桌子立起来，从里面也可以拿到。
还需要把水泵放进水罐里，给它通上电，再接上个水龙头。

src_seg:
And that's about as good a job as I can do really. Hopefully some of it will still be useable in a few months when it's done properly by a professional.
At least the fridge ought to carry over.
The bed folding down past the passenger seat is great. I'm too talk for this van really, but that makes it workable. Shame the seat/bed has to be so narrow though. The two-seater was very temping and feels like it ought to just about fit but, wouldn't really be any way to unfold it from within the van and the steering wheel gets in the way for folding the driving seat down like the passenger seat does so couldn't really go flat without also lifting up.
tgt_seg:
这真是我能做到的极限了。希望几个月后专业人士正式改装时，我做的这些东西还有一些能用得上。
至少那个冰箱应该能保留下来。

src_seg:
Thank goodness for Blender! Not sure I could have planned all that and had any hope of it all working out if I couldn't do it in virtual 3d first.
3 frames to show the 3 main configurations. Sit, Desk, and Sleep.

src_seg:
As I said a few months ago [boing.world], the estate offered me a garage meaning I finally have somewhere to put a van that I can convert into a microcamper.
So I bought this Berlingo last month.
I thought the fact it was already converted into a van would probably make the camper-conversion easier.
Turns out that's likely not really the case. So it goes. It's previously been converted for a wheelchair ramp, which means the floor has been lowered, and this means there's nowhere safe to bolt rear passenger seats, and so can't have that "rock and roll" bed, that converts into seatbelted seats for passengers.
It does add a large underfloor storage area though.
I thought it would be fairly easy to remove the metal plates over the windows, but that turned out to be a mistaken assumption too. Was no metal plates. They'd just painted over the glass with some metallic paint. Luckily this can be just scraped off, presumably with some paint dissolving solvents applied too. Dunno. I let the professionals handle that.
tgt_seg:
几个月前我说过（[boing.world]），房产公司给我提供了一个车库，这意味着我终于有地方可以放一辆我可以改装成微型房车的面包车。
所以上个月我买了这辆Berlingo。
我以为它已经改装成面包车会让房车改装变得更容易。
结果似乎并非如此。算了，就是这样。它之前被改装成轮椅坡道的，这意味着地板被降低了，后排乘客座椅没有安全的地方可以固定螺栓，所以不能有那种“摇摆”床，不能转换成有安全带的乘客座椅。
不过它确实增加了大片的地下储物空间。
我以为去除窗户上的金属板会相当简单，但这是一个错误的假设。没有金属板。他们只是用金属漆在玻璃上涂了一层。幸好这可以简单地刮掉，假设使用一些溶剂也可以。我不知道。我让专业人士处理这个。

src_seg:
The folks that can do an actually good job of converting it into a microcamper are busy till July, so I get to play at doing a half arsed job to tide it over until then.
First job is taking out the floor to gain access to that underfloor area and to cover that in linoleum. Had some lying around after they did the bathroom last year.
Then to refit the floor and cover all that in a red felt carpet.
The job is shoddy here really. What's needed is to insulate the entire body of the car and then cover professionally and well, but I dunno how to do all that. I just used spray glue to fasten this stretch carpet to the existing wood, that'll be replaced when it's converted proper anyway.
The roof will remain cold and metal till then.
tgt_seg:
能把它改装成微型房车的人到7月都忙，所以我只能自己做一个马虎的临时改装。
第一步是拆掉地板以进入地下空间，并用油毡覆盖。我去年装修浴室后剩下一些。
然后重新安装地板，用红色的绒面地毯覆盖所有地方。
这里的工作确实很马虎。实际上，需要将汽车的整个车身隔热，然后专业地覆盖好，但我不知道如何做到这一点。我只是用喷胶将这块地毯固定在现有的木板上，反正当它正式改装时也会被替换。
车顶到那时还是冷冰冰的金属。

src_seg:
This chair works very well in the van. Should ideally be fastened better to the floor, but it has a nice three mode positions.
Seating, and chaise-long, and flat as a bed with the passenger seat folded down.
tgt_seg: 这张椅子在面包车里用起来很方便。最好是固定在地板上，但它有三个模式：座椅、躺椅和平放成床，乘客座椅折叠下来。

src_seg:
You can get a folding leaf table, and if you saw off the bottom 15cm or so of the panels forming the sides and front of the table, and also don't bother to attach any of the the back leaf, then it becomes just the right height to mostly fit under the rear window.
It's a little higher than the camper-fridge, but the camper fridge is pretty much the same height as a little bedside cabinet.
There's also a small rectangular sink that fits nicely around the same width as the fridge alongside that cut down table.
And thus, the interior can be mostly constructed in my flat. The kids in the flat upstairs kept waving as me as I was doing a terrible job of cutting down those panels with a jigsaw in the yard.
tgt_seg:
你可以得到一个折叠叶子桌，如果你锯掉组成桌子侧面和前面的面板底部约15厘米，并且也不用麻烦安装后叶，那么它就刚好适合大部分放置在后窗下。
它比房车冰箱高一点，但房车冰箱的高度几乎与一个小床头柜相同。
还有一个小矩形水槽，与冰箱同样宽度，可以很好地放置在削短的桌子旁边。
因此，内部可以在我的公寓里大部分建造。楼上的孩子们在我用电锯在院子里糟糕地切割面板时不断向我挥手。

src_seg:
Then there's a whole day of carrying those things out to the van and trying to screw them into the floor.
Had to swap the fridge and the cabinet around from the plan. The fridge is less deep than it is wide and doesn't block the table-leaf when it's at the edge with door facing the front of the car.
I expected to have to pause here and measure up and buy some wood, but someone had thrown out a desk that matches very well and a bit more sawing managed to get that into the right shape to build a frame to hold everything in place.
That sink is attached by only one of the six grips that are supposed to hold it. Two can't be used flat against a wooden board, and 3 aren't against anything at all right now.
Maybe I can get to attach better when the pump and tap arrive.
tgt_seg:
然后就是花一天时间把那些东西搬出去，试图把它们螺丝固定在地板上。
我不得不交换冰箱和柜子的位置。冰箱比宽更浅，不会挡住桌子叶子，当它位于车前门边时。
我以为我需要在这里停下来测量和购买一些木头，但有人扔掉了一张非常匹配的桌子，再加一些锯切，就可以把它变成一个框架，固定好一切。
水槽只有六个固定卡扣中的一个固定在原地。两个不能平放在木板上，三个现在没有任何东西固定。
也许我可以在水泵和龙头到达时更好地固定它们。

src_seg:
I like the easy access to battery and water and things from the back. Fair amount of storage there too which is accessible from inside if the table is up.
Still need to put the water pump into the water cannister, and power it, and attach some sort of tap to it.
tgt_seg:
我喜欢从后面轻松访问电池、水和东西。那里也有不少储物空间，如果桌子抬起来，可以从内部访问。
我仍然需要将水泵放入水罐中，并供电，并连接某种龙头。

src_seg:
And that's about as good a job as I can do really. Hopefully some of it will still be useable in a few months when it's done properly by a professional.
At least the fridge ought to carry over.
The bed folding down past the passenger seat is great. I'm too talk for this van really, but that makes it workable. Shame the seat/bed has to be so narrow though. The two-seater was very temping and feels like it ought to just about fit but, wouldn't really be any way to unfold it from within the van and the steering wheel gets in the way for folding the driving seat down like the passenger seat does so couldn't really go flat without also lifting up.
tgt_seg:
这就是我能做的尽可能好的工作了。希望其中一些在几个月后专业人士正式改装时仍然可以利用。
至少冰箱应该可以保留。
床折叠下来超过乘客座椅很棒。我对这辆面包车来说确实太高了，但这样可以让它可行。只是很遗憾座椅/床必须这么窄。双人座非常诱人，感觉应该可以刚好适合，但实际上没有办法从面包车内部展开它，方向盘会挡住驾驶座椅像乘客座椅那样折叠，所以不能完全展开而不抬起。

src_seg:
Thank goodness for Blender! Not sure I could have planned all that and had any hope of it all working out if I couldn't do it in virtual 3d first.
3 frames to show the 3 main configurations. Sit, Desk, and Sleep.
tgt_seg:
感谢Blender！如果我不能先在虚拟3D中做，我不确定我能否计划所有这些并希望一切顺利。
展示三个主要配置的3帧：坐、桌子和睡。

原本我想在这里停下来，测量并购买一些木材，但有人扔了一台非常合适的桌子，再锯了一点，就能把它变成正确的形状来构建一个框架，把所有的东西都固定在正确的位置。
那台水盆只靠六根握柄中一根来固定，而这六根握柄中只有一根可以固定。 两根不能平放在木板上，而三根现在根本无法固定任何东西。
当泵和水龙头到达时，也许我就能更好地连接。

src_seg:
I like the easy access to battery and water and things from the back. Fair amount of storage there too which is accessible from inside if the table is up.
Still need to put the water pump into the water cannister, and power it, and attach some sort of tap to it.
tgt_seg:
我喜欢可以从背面轻松接触电池、水和其他东西。 如果把桌子抬起来，也可以从内部访问大量的存储空间。
仍需将水泵装入水罐中，然后通电，并将其连接到某种类型的水龙头上。

src_seg:
And that's about as good a job as I can do really. Hopefully some of it will still be useable in a few months when it's done properly by a professional.
At least the fridge ought to carry over.
The bed folding down past the passenger seat is great. I'm too talk for this van really, but that makes it workable. Shame the seat/bed has to be so narrow though. The two-seater was very temping and feels like it ought to just about fit but, wouldn't really be any way to unfold it from within the van and the steering wheel gets in the way for folding the driving seat down like the passenger seat does so couldn't really go flat without also lifting up.
tgt_seg:
而且这实际上是我所能做的最好工作之一。 希望在几个月后，当它得到专业人士妥善处理时，其中一些内容仍能有用。
至少，冰箱应该还能用。
乘客座椅前折叠下来的床铺很棒。 我对这辆面包车说太多话，但这确实让人感到满意。 可惜的是，座椅/床铺太窄了。 这辆两座座椅非常令人兴奋，感觉应该适合，但实际上无法从面包车内部展开，方向盘也妨碍了驾驶座椅的折叠，就像乘客座椅一样不能完全折叠下来，也不可在没有抬起的情况下平下来。

src_seg:
Thank goodness for Blender! Not sure I could have planned all that and had any hope of it all working out if I couldn't do it in virtual 3d first.
3 frames to show the 3 main configurations. Sit, Desk, and Sleep.
tgt_seg:
谢谢 Blender！ 我不确定自己是否能够规划所有这些事情，如果无法先在虚拟 3D 中完成这些工作，我就不可能指望这一切都会成功。
三个帧显示三个主要配置。坐着、工作、睡觉。

src_seg:
As I said a few months ago [boing.world], the estate offered me a garage meaning I finally have somewhere to put a van that I can convert into a microcamper.
So I bought this Berlingo last month.
I thought the fact it was already converted into a van would probably make the camper-conversion easier.
Turns out that's likely not really the case. So it goes. It's previously been converted for a wheelchair ramp, which means the floor has been lowered, and this means there's nowhere safe to bolt rear passenger seats, and so can't have that "rock and roll" bed, that converts into seatbelted seats for passengers.
It does add a large underfloor storage area though.
I thought it would be fairly easy to remove the metal plates over the windows, but that turned out to be a mistaken assumption too. Was no metal plates. They'd just painted over the glass with some metallic paint. Luckily this can be just scraped off, presumably with some paint dissolving solvents applied too. Dunno. I let the professionals handle that.
tgt_seg:
如我几个月前在[boing.world]说过的，住宅区给我提供了一个车库，这意味着我终于有地方放一辆可以改装成微型露营车的货车了。
所以我上个月买了这辆Berlingo。
我本以为它已经被改装成了一辆货车，这样再改装成露营车可能会更容易些。
结果发现，情况可能并非如此。事已至此，也只能这样了。它之前为了安装轮椅坡道被改装过，这意味着地板被降低了，也就没有安全的地方来固定后排乘客座椅，所以不能安装那种"摇滚"床，也就是可以转换成带安全带的乘客座椅的床。
不过这确实增加了一个很大的地板下储物区域。
我原以为移除窗户上的金属板会相当容易，但这也被证明是一个错误的假设。根本就没有金属板。他们只是用某种金属漆在玻璃上刷了一层。幸运的是，这可以直接刮掉，大概还需要一些溶解油漆的溶剂。我不知道。我让专业人士来处理这个。

src_seg:
The folks that can do an actually good job of converting it into a microcamper are busy till July, so I get to play at doing a half arsed job to tide it over until then.
First job is taking out the floor to gain access to that underfloor area and to cover that in linoleum. Had some lying around after they did the bathroom last year.
Then to refit the floor and cover all that in a red felt carpet.
The job is shoddy here really. What's needed is to insulate the entire body of the car and then cover professionally and well, but I dunno how to do all that. I just used spray glue to fasten this stretch carpet to the existing wood, that'll be replaced when it's converted proper anyway.
The roof will remain cold and metal till then.
tgt_seg:
那些能把这车正经改装成微型露营车的人要忙到七月，所以在那之前，我只能自己先随便搞搞，凑合一下。
第一项工作是拆掉地板，以便能使用地板下的空间，并给那块地方铺上油毡。去年他们装修浴室后还剩下一些。
然后重新装上地板，并在上面铺满红色毛毡地毯。
我这活儿做得真的很糙。真正需要的是给整个车身做隔热处理，然后进行专业而妥善的覆盖，但我不知道该怎么做。我只是用了喷胶把这种弹性地毯粘在现有的木板上，反正等正式改装时这些木板也都会被换掉。
到那时候，车顶依然会保持冰冷的金属状态。

src_seg:
This chair works very well in the van. Should ideally be fastened better to the floor, but it has a nice three mode positions.
Seating, and chaise-long, and flat as a bed with the passenger seat folded down.
tgt_seg:
这把椅子在货车里用得非常不错。理想情况下应该更好地固定在地板上，但它有三种很棒的模式。
坐姿、躺椅，以及在乘客座椅折叠下来时平放成床。

src_seg:
You can get a folding leaf table, and if you saw off the bottom 15cm or so of the panels forming the sides and front of the table, and also don't bother to attach any of the the back leaf, then it becomes just the right height to mostly fit under the rear window.
It's a little higher than the camper-fridge, but the camper fridge is pretty much the same height as a little bedside cabinet.
There's also a small rectangular sink that fits nicely around the same width as the fridge alongside that cut down table.
And thus, the interior can be mostly constructed in my flat. The kids in the flat upstairs kept waving as me as I was doing a terrible job of cutting down those panels with a jigsaw in the yard.
tgt_seg:
您可以买一张折叠桌，如果锯掉桌子两侧和前面板子底部大约15厘米左右，并且不费心安装任何背面折叠板，那么它的高度就正好能基本塞进后窗下面。
它比房车冰箱稍微高一点，但房车冰箱的高度几乎和小床头柜一样。
还有一个小长方形水槽，宽度正好和冰箱差不多，可以放在那张锯短了的桌子旁边。
因此，内部装修大部分可以在我的公寓里完成。楼上公寓的孩子们一直在向我挥手，当时我正在院子里用线锯笨手笨脚地切割那些面板。

src_seg:
Then there's a whole day of carrying those things out to the van and trying to screw them into the floor.
Had to swap the fridge and the cabinet around from the plan. The fridge is less deep than it is wide and doesn't block the table-leaf when it's at the edge with door facing the front of the car.
I expected to have to pause here and measure up and buy some wood, but someone had thrown out a desk that matches very well and a bit more sawing managed to get that into the right shape to build a frame to hold everything in place.
That sink is attached by only one of the six grips that are supposed to hold it. Two can't be used flat against a wooden board, and 3 aren't against anything at all right now.
Maybe I can get to attach better when the pump and tap arrive.
tgt_seg:
然后就是花一整天的时间把那些东西搬到货车里，再试着把它们固定在地板上。
我不得不把冰箱和柜子的位置跟计划中对调一下。冰箱的深度比宽度小，当把它放在边缘、门朝向车头时，就不会挡住桌面折叶。
我原以为做到这里就得停下来，量尺寸再买些木头，但有人扔掉了一张非常匹配的桌子，我再锯了锯，就把它弄成了合适的形状，做成了一个框架来固定所有东西。
那个水槽本来是用六个卡扣固定的，但现在只用了一个。其中两个卡扣无法在木板上平放使用，另外三个则根本没有着力点。
等水泵和水龙头到货后，也许我能把它固定得更好一些。

src_seg:
I like the easy access to battery and water and things from the back. Fair amount of storage there too which is accessible from inside if the table is up.
Still need to put the water pump into the water cannister, and power it, and attach some sort of tap to it.
tgt_seg:
我很喜欢从后面可以轻松拿到电池和水等东西。那里也有相当大的储物空间，如果桌子立起来，从里面也可以拿到。
还需要把水泵放进水罐里，给它通上电，再接上个水龙头。

src_seg:
And that's about as good a job as I can do really. Hopefully some of it will still be useable in a few months when it's done properly by a professional.
At least the fridge ought to carry over.
The bed folding down past the passenger seat is great. I'm too talk for this van really, but that makes it workable. Shame the seat/bed has to be so narrow though. The two-seater was very temping and feels like it ought to just about fit but, wouldn't really be any way to unfold it from within the van and the steering wheel gets in the way for folding the driving seat down like the passenger seat does so couldn't really go flat without also lifting up.
tgt_seg:
我能做的也就这么多了。希望几个月后专业人士正式改装时，我做的这些东西还有一些能用得上。
至少那个冰箱应该能保留下来。
床可以越过副驾驶座放倒，这一点很棒。对这辆车来说，我实在太高了，但这样一来就勉强能睡下。可惜的是，这个座椅/床不得不做得这么窄。双人座椅非常诱人，感觉也差不多能装下，但在车里实在没办法把它展开，而且方向盘在折叠驾驶座时也会碍事，所以无法像乘客座那样放平而不同时抬起驾驶座。

src_seg:
Thank goodness for Blender! Not sure I could have planned all that and had any hope of it all working out if I couldn't do it in virtual 3d first.
3 frames to show the 3 main configurations. Sit, Desk, and Sleep.
tgt_seg:
感谢Blender！要不是能先在虚拟3D环境里做一遍，我真不确定自己能否规划好这一切，并指望它能顺利实现。
用三张图来展示三种主要配置：坐、书桌、睡。

src_seg: Game 9 of #UniversityChallenge was a hell of a match. Oriel Oxford (530 students) vs Durham (20,000), and Oriel won, which surprised me after some mistakes they made. The captain didn't know Wittengstein's name!? Possibly just nerves. Durham was ahead, then it was tied at 170, then they dropped to 165. A pity. I was rooting for them. Great team, with all four strong, so I hope they make the cut.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第9场比赛真是一场激烈的较量。牛津大学奥里尔学院（530名学生）对阵杜伦大学（20,000名学生），结果奥里尔学院获胜，这让我感到意外，因为他们之前犯了一些错误。队长竟然不知道维特根斯坦的名字！？也许只是因为紧张吧。杜伦大学曾一度领先，后来比分被扳平至170分，接着又下降到165分。很遗憾，我原本是支持他们的。他们是一支很强的队伍，四名成员都很优秀，所以我希望他们能晋级。

src_seg:
Game 10 of #UniversityChallenge had a great performance by Christ's Cambridge, who have a consultative captain, a good team, and a strong member named Bethlehem, so Roger Tilling called out "Christ's Bethlehem!" Exeter Oxford never got hold of much, and are out of the running. I could see Christ's Cambridge quietly going far in this series. 
Some nice math questions, a picture round connected to food, and a tricky flag question. Good game.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第10场比赛中，剑桥大学基督学院表现非常出色，他们有一位善于协调的队长，团队合作也很默契，其中一名叫Bethlehem的成员很强，因此Roger Tilling惊呼“基督的伯利恒！”牛津大学埃克塞特学院始终没有找到状态，最终被淘汰。我能看出剑桥大学基督学院在这次系列赛中会走得很远。
有一些很好的数学题，一个与食物相关的图片回合，还有一个很有挑战性的关于国旗的问题。总体来说是一场很好的比赛。

src_seg: Game 11 of #UniversityChallenge was St Andrews (granted university status by an antipope!) vs Cardiff. First round is nearing its end. Some good questions, including mentions of roll-on roll-of ferries, Agnes Martin, and Stax Records. Cardiff Tarsala will never forget her Booker T bloomer, I'm afraid. Nice quizzing from both teams, though it only really got cracking in the last few minutes.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第11场比赛是对阵圣安德鲁斯大学（由一名对教皇的反对者授予大学资格！）和卡迪夫大学。第一轮即将结束。有些很好的问题，包括提到滚装滚卸渡轮、阿格尼丝·马丁和Stax唱片公司。卡迪夫大学的Tarsala恐怕永远不会忘记她在Booker T问题上的失误。两支队伍都表现出色，尽管比赛直到最后几分钟才真正激烈起来。

src_seg: Game 12 of #UniversityChallenge was Leeds vs Edinburgh. Leeds took a long time to get going, then had a surge in the middle but couldn't keep it going. Seemed like a number of film questions this time, and I was glad to hear PEI as an answer; no flags, though it seems like they crop up every time. Edinburgh Myles is a good captain and the whole team is strong and works well together. I think they'll do well.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第12场比赛是利兹大学对阵爱丁堡大学。利兹大学花了很长时间才进入状态，然后在中间阶段突然发力，但没能保持下去。似乎这次有很多关于电影的问题，我很高兴听到PEI作为一个答案；不过没有出现国旗问题，尽管它们似乎每次都会出现。爱丁堡大学的Myles是一位很好的队长，整个团队都很强大，合作得很好。我认为他们会做得很好。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 13 was a curious one, with Leicester being jokey, wasting time and never getting going, while the LSE captain would often turn to the farthest player for an answer, which was not infrequently wrong. Still, LSE cleaned up. I liked the blues bonus round, though sadly Leicester got none. Canadian mentions: WL Mackenzie King and Margaret Atwood. The best part was Roger Tilling saying "Leicester Lister!"
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第13场比赛有些奇怪，莱斯特大学表现得很幽默，浪费了很多时间，始终没有进入状态，而伦敦政治经济学院的队长经常会转向最远的队员寻求答案，但这些答案往往是错误的。尽管如此，伦敦政治经济学院还是赢了。我喜欢蓝色奖励回合，可惜莱斯特大学没有得分。提到了加拿大人：WL Mackenzie King和玛格丽特·阿特伍德。最精彩的部分是Roger Tilling说“莱斯特·利斯特！”

src_seg: Game 14 of #UniversityChallenge was top-notch stuff, solid quizzing, down to business, fast answers, good knowledge, close ending. It seems we'll see both SOAS London and St. Edmund Hall Oxford again, because the loser makes the repechage. Very close at the finish, down to "Naples" and "pollen." An unassumingly great game.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第14场比赛非常精彩，稳健的答题，快速的答案，良好的知识储备，结局非常接近。看来我们将会再次看到伦敦大学亚非学院和牛津大学圣埃德蒙德学院，因为失败者将参加复活赛。比赛非常激烈，最后的答案是“那不勒斯”和“花粉”。一场不引人注目却很精彩的比赛。

src_seg: Game 15 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of two in the repechage, where the four highest-scoring losing teams try to make it through. This week was UCL and St. Andrews, in a good-natured cheery match. Very strong play from UCL, who have a solid team, and UCL Mandel was in top form. Good questions, some tough, such as requiring "panthera" specifically or knowing "day" in Russian.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第15场比赛是复活赛的第一场，四个得分最高的失败队伍将争夺晋级机会。本周是伦敦大学学院和圣安德鲁斯大学，比赛气氛轻松愉快。伦敦大学学院表现出色，团队实力雄厚，伦敦大学学院的Mandel状态极佳。有些问题很有挑战性，比如需要准确回答“panthera”或者知道俄语中的“day”。

src_seg: Just got to game 16 of #UniversityChallenge today, a week late, and it was a nail-biter! Really fast work at the end, with Durham coming from behind in the last few minutes to catch SOAS London in a tie in the final seconds. It went to a starter question that I got on the first clue (being an SF reader I knew "slipstream") but neither team knew. Second question and SOAS London Lambert guessed alpaca but it was llama, so Durham won. Phew, what a finish. 😰
tgt_seg: 我刚刚看了#UniversityChallenge 第16场比赛，晚了一周，这是一场惊心动魄的比赛！最后阶段的答题速度非常快，杜伦大学在最后几分钟内赶上了伦敦大学亚非学院，最终在最后一秒钟与之战平。比赛进入附加题环节，我根据第一个线索就得出了答案（因为我读过科幻小说，知道“slipstream”），但两支队伍都不知道。第二个问题，伦敦大学亚非学院的Lambert猜测是“羊驼”，但答案是“骆驼”，所以杜伦大学赢了。哇，结局太惊险了！😰

src_seg: Game 17 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of eight knockout games in the second round. This was UCL and LSE, and UCL gave an outstanding performance: very fast buzzing, good teamwork, wide general knowledge from them all (UCL Mandel notable again); they took off at the start and never slowed. Very impressive.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第17场比赛是第二轮的淘汰赛的第一场。伦敦大学学院对阵伦敦政治经济学院，伦敦大学学院表现出色：抢答速度非常快，团队合作良好，知识面广（伦敦大学学院的Mandel再次引人注目）；他们一开始就领先，并且从未放慢速度。非常令人印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 18 of #UniversityChallenge was Durham vs Open University. I was rooting for Durham, who have a great team, but in the end to my surprise Open took it, after a number of rather slow answers. I was glad Durham got Marcel Duchamp right on one question; too bad no one knew Yoko Ono as a Fluxus artist. Much respect for Durham Nash, especially on bird silhouettes and flags.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第18场比赛是杜伦大学对阵开放大学。我原本支持杜伦大学，他们是一支很强的队伍，但最终开放大学赢了，之前杜伦大学的反应有点慢。我很高兴杜伦大学在某个问题上正确回答了马塞尔·杜尚；可惜没有人知道Yoko Ono是Fluxus艺术家。非常尊重杜伦大学的Nash，特别是在鸟类轮廓和国旗问题上。

src_seg:
Game 19 of #UniversityChallenge was Exeter vs Bristol. Bristol got going at the start and never looked back, rolling with momentum, finishing with an incredible score. Exeter only clawed their way back to 0 after 17 minutes. 
I liked the question on common terms in Chinese place names, such as 北 (běi) in Beijing etc. Good geographic knowledge shown.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第19场比赛是埃克塞特大学对阵布里斯托大学。布里斯托大学一开始就领先，并且从未被超越，最终取得了令人难以置信的分数。埃克塞特大学直到第17分钟才勉强回到0分。
我喜欢关于中国地名中常见词汇的问题，比如北京等地的“北”（běi）。展现了良好的地理知识。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge is back from the Christmas alumni series, and game 20 was liked greased lightening in comparison. Darwin Cambridge Whitaker tore into questions like a monster, but everyone was in good form on that team and also on Edinburgh. Momentum changed through the game. Good quizzing. Three more games in round two, then the long quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 结束了圣诞校友系列赛，第20场比赛与之前的比赛相比，节奏快了很多。剑桥大学达尔文学院的Whitaker像怪物一样迅速回答问题，但整个团队都表现出色，爱丁堡大学也是如此。比赛的势头在不断变化。答题质量很高。第二轮还有三场比赛，然后就是漫长的四分之一决赛。

src_seg: It's quite a change to go from the Christmas series of #UniversityChallenge, where four people didn't know the name of the narrator of Moby-Dick even when told his name is in the first sentence of the book, to the regular round, where they're racing to buzz on questions like "Fifty-three British thermal units is to grouse hunting as Sydney, Australia, is to what famous star of the London stage?"
tgt_seg: 从#UniversityChallenge 的圣诞系列赛（四个人不知道《白鲸》叙述者的名字，即使被告知他的名字就在书的第一句话中）到常规轮次（他们在听到“53个英国热量单位与猎捕松鸡有什么关系，就像澳大利亚悉尼与伦敦舞台上的哪位著名明星有关？”这样的问题时争相抢答），这是一个很大的变化。

src_seg:
Game 21 of #UniversityChallenge was Wadham Oxford vs Imperial. What a game! Astounding performance from Imperial. 
However, being King Crimson fan, I was disappointed that no one recognized them from the opening of "21st Century Schizoid Man," and dismayed when someone thought "I Zimbra" by Talking Heads (with Fripp on guitar) was by the Bee Gees. Can't have it all. I remain incredibly impressed.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第21场比赛是牛津大学沃德汉姆学院对阵帝国理工学院。多么精彩的比赛！帝国理工学院的表现令人惊叹。
然而，作为King Crimson的粉丝，我很失望没有人能从“I Talk to the Wind”的开头辨认出他们，而且有人认为Talking Heads（Fripp参与吉他演奏）的“I Zimbra”是Bee Gees的作品。不能什么都有。我仍然感到非常佩服。

src_seg: Game 22 of #UniversityChallenge was Christ's Cambridge vs St Edmund Hall Oxford, two small colleges, but that's how the rules are set up.  Nice picture round with the Dunning-Kruger effect, Asch conformity experiments, and bouba-kiki effect.  Another on mushrooms, which seemed tough to me; identifying them by eye is not easy. Solid game, good playing all around.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第22场比赛是剑桥大学基督学院对阵牛津大学圣埃德蒙德学院，两所都是小学院，但规则就是这样设定的。 有一个很好的图片回合，涉及邓宁-克鲁格效应、阿施的从众实验和布巴-基基效应。还有一个关于蘑菇的回合，对我来说似乎很难；仅凭观察来识别它们并不容易。比赛很稳健，各方面表现都很好。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. Nice flag knowledge, and a good picture round identifying physical laws by diagrams of experiments. A bit too much bantz for my taste, but a solid game. One more before the quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第23场比赛是卡迪夫大学对阵皇后大学贝尔法斯特。最终得分比我预期的要低，也许是因为错失了一些奖励分，但抢答题的反应速度很快。很好的国旗知识，还有一个很好的图片回合，通过实验图表识别物理定律。有点太吵闹了，但总体上是一场很不错的比赛。距离四分之一决赛只剩下一场比赛。

src_seg: Game 9 of #UniversityChallenge was a hell of a match. Oriel Oxford (530 students) vs Durham (20,000), and Oriel won, which surprised me after some mistakes they made. The captain didn't know Wittengstein's name!? Possibly just nerves. Durham was ahead, then it was tied at 170, then they dropped to 165. A pity. I was rooting for them. Great team, with all four strong, so I hope they make the cut.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第9场比赛真是激烈。奥里尔牛津学院（530名学生）对阵杜伦大学（20000名学生），奥里尔获胜，这让我很意外，因为他们犯了一些错误。队长竟然不知道维特根斯坦的名字！？可能只是紧张。杜伦一度领先，然后在170分时打平，接着掉到165分。真可惜。我支持他们。很棒的队伍，四个人都很强，希望他们能晋级。

src_seg:
Game 10 of #UniversityChallenge had a great performance by Christ's Cambridge, who have a consultative captain, a good team, and a strong member named Bethlehem, so Roger Tilling called out "Christ's Bethlehem!" Exeter Oxford never got hold of much, and are out of the running. I could see Christ's Cambridge quietly going far in this series. 
Some nice math questions, a picture round connected to food, and a tricky flag question. Good game.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第10场比赛中，剑桥基督学院表现出色，他们有一个善于协商的队长，一个好团队，还有一个叫伯利恒的强队员，所以罗杰·蒂林喊出了"基督的伯利恒！"牛津埃克塞特学院始终没有找到状态，已经出局。我觉得剑桥基督学院可能会在这个系列赛中悄悄走得很远。
