tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第21场比赛是牛津瓦德汉学院对阵帝国理工。多么精彩的比赛！帝国理工表现惊人。
不过，作为深红之王乐队的粉丝，我很失望没人从"21世纪精神分裂症患者"的开头认出他们，当有人认为Talking Heads的"I Zimbra"（弗里普担任吉他手）是比吉斯乐队的歌时，我更是沮丧。不能要求太多。我仍然印象极其深刻。

src_seg: Game 22 of #UniversityChallenge was Christ's Cambridge vs St Edmund Hall Oxford, two small colleges, but that's how the rules are set up.  Nice picture round with the Dunning-Kruger effect, Asch conformity experiments, and bouba-kiki effect.  Another on mushrooms, which seemed tough to me; identifying them by eye is not easy. Solid game, good playing all around.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第22场比赛是剑桥基督学院对阵牛津圣埃德蒙学院，两个小学院，但规则就是这样设定的。不错的图片轮，有邓宁-克鲁格效应、阿希从众实验和布巴-基基效应。还有一个关于蘑菇的，对我来说似乎很难；用眼睛识别它们并不容易。稳固的比赛，各方面都表现良好。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. Nice flag knowledge, and a good picture round identifying physical laws by diagrams of experiments. A bit too much bantz for my taste, but a solid game. One more before the quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第23场比赛是卡迪夫对阵贝尔法斯特女王大学。最终得分比我预期的要低，可能是因为错过了加分题，但抢答题回答得很快。不错的旗帜知识，还有一个通过实验图表识别物理定律的好图片轮。对我来说玩笑话有点太多，但是一场稳固的比赛。四分之一决赛前还有一场。

src_seg: Game 9 of #UniversityChallenge was a hell of a match. Oriel Oxford (530 students) vs Durham (20,000), and Oriel won, which surprised me after some mistakes they made. The captain didn't know Wittengstein's name!? Possibly just nerves. Durham was ahead, then it was tied at 170, then they dropped to 165. A pity. I was rooting for them. Great team, with all four strong, so I hope they make the cut.
tgt_seg: 《大学挑战赛》第九场比赛真是精彩绝伦。牛津大学奥里尔学院（学生人数530人）对阵杜伦大学（学生人数2万），最终奥里尔学院获胜，这让我有些意外，因为他们在比赛中犯了一些错误。他们的队长竟然不知道维特根斯坦的名字！？可能只是因为太紧张了。杜伦大学一度领先，后来比分追平至170，但最终他们以165分落败，真是可惜。我一直支持杜伦大学。他们是一支非常优秀的队伍，四名队员都很出色，希望他们能进入下一轮。

src_seg:
Game 10 of #UniversityChallenge had a great performance by Christ's Cambridge, who have a consultative captain, a good team, and a strong member named Bethlehem, so Roger Tilling called out "Christ's Bethlehem!" Exeter Oxford never got hold of much, and are out of the running. I could see Christ's Cambridge quietly going far in this series. 
Some nice math questions, a picture round connected to food, and a tricky flag question. Good game.
tgt_seg:
在《大学挑战赛》第10场比赛中，剑桥大学的克里斯学院表现出色。他们有一位经验丰富的队长、一支优秀的团队，以及一位名叫“伯利恒”的实力队员，因此主持人罗杰·蒂林激动地喊道：“克里斯学院，伯利恒！” 另一方面，牛津大学的埃克塞特学院表现不佳，已经失去了晋级的机会。我认为剑桥大学的克里斯学院很有可能在本届比赛中取得优异成绩。
比赛中出现了一些不错的数学题，还有一轮与食物相关的图片题，以及一道颇具挑战性的国旗题。这是一场精彩的比赛。

src_seg: Game 11 of #UniversityChallenge was St Andrews (granted university status by an antipope!) vs Cardiff. First round is nearing its end. Some good questions, including mentions of roll-on roll-of ferries, Agnes Martin, and Stax Records. Cardiff Tarsala will never forget her Booker T bloomer, I'm afraid. Nice quizzing from both teams, though it only really got cracking in the last few minutes.
tgt_seg: 《大学挑战赛》第11场是圣安德鲁斯大学（该大学曾获得一位“反教皇”的认可！）对阵卡迪夫大学。第一轮比赛即将结束。本场比赛的问题很有意思，涉及到了“滚装渡轮”、艾格尼丝·马丁以及“斯塔克斯唱片公司”等内容。恐怕卡迪夫大学的塔萨拉永远也不会忘记她在回答“布克·T”问题时犯的错误。双方队伍都表现出色，但精彩的时刻主要集中在比赛的最后几分钟。

src_seg: Game 12 of #UniversityChallenge was Leeds vs Edinburgh. Leeds took a long time to get going, then had a surge in the middle but couldn't keep it going. Seemed like a number of film questions this time, and I was glad to hear PEI as an answer; no flags, though it seems like they crop up every time. Edinburgh Myles is a good captain and the whole team is strong and works well together. I think they'll do well.
tgt_seg: 《大学挑战赛》第12场是利兹大学对阵爱丁堡大学。利兹大学一开始表现不佳，后来一度表现出色，但未能保持。这次的题目似乎有很多关于电影的内容，我很开心听到“PEI”（可能是某个答案），不过没有出现任何关于国旗的题目，虽然感觉每次比赛都会有。爱丁堡大学的队长“迈尔斯”表现出色，整个团队也很强大，并且配合默契。我认为他们会取得好成绩。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 13 was a curious one, with Leicester being jokey, wasting time and never getting going, while the LSE captain would often turn to the farthest player for an answer, which was not infrequently wrong. Still, LSE cleaned up. I liked the blues bonus round, though sadly Leicester got none. Canadian mentions: WL Mackenzie King and Margaret Atwood. The best part was Roger Tilling saying "Leicester Lister!"
tgt_seg: #《大学挑战赛》第13场比赛颇具特色，莱斯特大学的选手表现得不够认真，总是拖延时间，而且始终未能发挥出应有的水平。而伦敦政治经济学院（LSE）的队长则经常会向离自己最远的选手寻求答案，但这些答案往往是不正确的。尽管如此，伦敦政治经济学院最终还是赢得了比赛。我很喜欢那轮“蓝色”加分环节，可惜莱斯特大学一分也没拿到。比赛中提到了两位加拿大人：威廉·莱昂·麦肯齐·金和玛格丽特·阿特伍德。最有趣的一幕是罗杰·蒂林（主持人）喊出了“莱斯特！莱斯特！”

src_seg: Game 14 of #UniversityChallenge was top-notch stuff, solid quizzing, down to business, fast answers, good knowledge, close ending. It seems we'll see both SOAS London and St. Edmund Hall Oxford again, because the loser makes the repechage. Very close at the finish, down to "Naples" and "pollen." An unassumingly great game.
tgt_seg: 《大学挑战赛》第14场比赛非常精彩，题目难度适中，节奏紧凑，选手们反应迅速，知识储备丰富，而且结局非常接近。看来伦敦大学亚非学院和牛津大学圣埃德蒙学院还会再次出现在比赛中，因为输掉比赛的队伍还有机会参加复赛。比赛结果非常接近，最后的胜负取决于“那不勒斯”和“花粉”这两个答案。这是一场出乎意料的精彩比赛。

src_seg: Game 15 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of two in the repechage, where the four highest-scoring losing teams try to make it through. This week was UCL and St. Andrews, in a good-natured cheery match. Very strong play from UCL, who have a solid team, and UCL Mandel was in top form. Good questions, some tough, such as requiring "panthera" specifically or knowing "day" in Russian.
tgt_seg: 《大学挑战赛》第15场是复活赛的第一场，也是两场中的第一场。在复活赛中，四支在之前比赛中失利的队伍将争取晋级机会。本周的比赛是伦敦大学学院（UCL）对阵圣安德鲁斯大学，比赛气氛友好而轻松。伦敦大学学院表现非常出色，他们拥有一支实力强大的队伍，尤其是伦敦大学学院曼德尔学院的队员表现尤为突出。比赛问题质量很高，有些问题难度较大，例如需要准确回答“豹”的拉丁文名称“panthera”，或者知道“day”在俄语中的表达。

src_seg: Just got to game 16 of #UniversityChallenge today, a week late, and it was a nail-biter! Really fast work at the end, with Durham coming from behind in the last few minutes to catch SOAS London in a tie in the final seconds. It went to a starter question that I got on the first clue (being an SF reader I knew "slipstream") but neither team knew. Second question and SOAS London Lambert guessed alpaca but it was llama, so Durham won. Phew, what a finish. 😰
tgt_seg: 今天才看了#UniversityChallenge（一档英国智力竞赛节目）的第16集，比原定时间晚了一周，而且看得我心跳加速！比赛最后阶段非常激烈，杜伦大学在最后几分钟力挽狂澜，在最后一秒追平了伦敦大学亚非学院的比分。然后进入加赛，第一道题我凭借第一条线索就猜对了（因为我喜欢科幻小说，所以知道“slipstream”这个词），但两支队伍都没有猜对。第二道题，伦敦大学亚非学院的选手猜是“羊驼”，但正确答案是“骆驼”，所以杜伦大学赢了。呼，真是太精彩了。😰

src_seg: Game 17 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of eight knockout games in the second round. This was UCL and LSE, and UCL gave an outstanding performance: very fast buzzing, good teamwork, wide general knowledge from them all (UCL Mandel notable again); they took off at the start and never slowed. Very impressive.
tgt_seg: 《大学挑战赛》第17场比赛是第二轮八场淘汰赛中的第一场。这场比赛由伦敦大学学院（UCL）和伦敦政治经济学院（LSE）对决，伦敦大学学院表现出色：反应迅速、团队合作良好，并且各方面知识都非常渊博（尤其是伦敦大学学院曼德尔学院的学生）；他们一开始就取得了领先，并且一直保持着优势。非常令人印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 18 of #UniversityChallenge was Durham vs Open University. I was rooting for Durham, who have a great team, but in the end to my surprise Open took it, after a number of rather slow answers. I was glad Durham got Marcel Duchamp right on one question; too bad no one knew Yoko Ono as a Fluxus artist. Much respect for Durham Nash, especially on bird silhouettes and flags.
tgt_seg: 《大学挑战赛》第18期是杜伦大学对阵开放大学。我原本支持杜伦大学，因为他们队伍很棒，但结果出乎我的意料，开放大学最终获胜，尽管他们的回答过程有些迟缓。我很开心杜伦大学在其中一道题中正确地回答了“马塞尔·杜尚”；可惜没有人知道“小野洋子”是一位“激浪派”艺术家。我非常佩服杜伦大学的纳什，尤其是在辨认鸟类轮廓和旗帜方面。

src_seg:
Game 19 of #UniversityChallenge was Exeter vs Bristol. Bristol got going at the start and never looked back, rolling with momentum, finishing with an incredible score. Exeter only clawed their way back to 0 after 17 minutes. 
I liked the question on common terms in Chinese place names, such as 北 (běi) in Beijing etc. Good geographic knowledge shown.
tgt_seg:
《大学挑战赛》第19场比赛是埃克塞特大学对阵布里斯托大学。布里斯托大学一开始就占据优势，并一路领先，最终取得了令人印象深刻的成绩。埃克塞特大学在比赛开始后的17分钟才艰难地追回了0分。
我特别喜欢一道关于中国地名中常用术语的问题，比如“北京”中的“北”字。这显示了参赛者良好的地理知识。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge is back from the Christmas alumni series, and game 20 was liked greased lightening in comparison. Darwin Cambridge Whitaker tore into questions like a monster, but everyone was in good form on that team and also on Edinburgh. Momentum changed through the game. Good quizzing. Three more games in round two, then the long quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: 《#UniversityChallenge》（一档知识竞赛节目）在圣诞特辑结束后回归，而第20场比赛的节奏明显加快。来自剑桥大学达尔文学院的选手表现出色，如同猛虎般迅速抢答，但整个团队以及来自爱丁堡大学的选手也都表现得非常出色。比赛过程中，双方的优势不断变化。这是一场精彩的知识竞赛。接下来还有三场第二轮比赛，然后就是漫长的四分之一决赛。

src_seg: It's quite a change to go from the Christmas series of #UniversityChallenge, where four people didn't know the name of the narrator of Moby-Dick even when told his name is in the first sentence of the book, to the regular round, where they're racing to buzz on questions like "Fifty-three British thermal units is to grouse hunting as Sydney, Australia, is to what famous star of the London stage?"
tgt_seg: 从《大学挑战赛》的圣诞特别节目，到常规赛，这确实是一个很大的转变。在圣诞特别节目中，有四位选手甚至不知道《白鲸》的作者的名字，即使在被告知作者的名字就在书的第一句话之后，他们仍然不知道。而在常规赛中，他们则会争先恐后地抢答，例如“53英制热量单位（BTU）与英国的狩猎活动相关，那么，澳大利亚的悉尼与哪个著名的伦敦舞台演员相关？”这样的问题。

src_seg:
Game 21 of #UniversityChallenge was Wadham Oxford vs Imperial. What a game! Astounding performance from Imperial. 
However, being King Crimson fan, I was disappointed that no one recognized them from the opening of "21st Century Schizoid Man," and dismayed when someone thought "I Zimbra" by Talking Heads (with Fripp on guitar) was by the Bee Gees. Can't have it all. I remain incredibly impressed.
tgt_seg:
《大学挑战赛》第21场是牛津大学瓦德姆学院对阵帝国理工学院。真是精彩的一场比赛！帝国理工学院表现出色。
不过，作为金字塔乐队（King Crimson）的粉丝，我很失望，因为没有人能从《21世纪精神分裂人》的开头认出他们，而且更令人沮丧的是，有人竟然以为Talking Heads（乐队）的《I Zimbra》（其中吉他由弗里普演奏）是Bee Gees乐队的。凡事不能尽如人意。但我仍然对他们的表现印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 22 of #UniversityChallenge was Christ's Cambridge vs St Edmund Hall Oxford, two small colleges, but that's how the rules are set up.  Nice picture round with the Dunning-Kruger effect, Asch conformity experiments, and bouba-kiki effect.  Another on mushrooms, which seemed tough to me; identifying them by eye is not easy. Solid game, good playing all around.
tgt_seg: 《大学挑战赛》第22场是剑桥大学的基督学院对阵牛津大学的圣埃德蒙学院，这两所都是规模较小的学院，但比赛规则就是如此。本场比赛的图片题很有趣，涉及“邓宁-克鲁格效应”、“阿希从众实验”和“bouba-kiki效应”。还有一道关于蘑菇的题目，我觉得比较难，因为仅凭外观来辨认蘑菇并不容易。这是一场精彩的比赛，双方都表现出色。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. Nice flag knowledge, and a good picture round identifying physical laws by diagrams of experiments. A bit too much bantz for my taste, but a solid game. One more before the quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #“大学挑战赛”第23场是卡迪夫大学对阵贝尔法斯特女王大学。比赛的最终得分比我预期的要低，可能因为错失了一些附加题，但选手们在抢答环节反应很快。他们对国旗知识掌握得很好，而且在“图片题”环节中，通过实验示意图准确地识别出了物理定律。我觉得有些环节的互动过于轻松，但总体来说，这是一场不错的比赛。还有一场比赛就要进入四分之一决赛了。

src_seg: Game 9 of #UniversityChallenge was a hell of a match. Oriel Oxford (530 students) vs Durham (20,000), and Oriel won, which surprised me after some mistakes they made. The captain didn't know Wittengstein's name!? Possibly just nerves. Durham was ahead, then it was tied at 170, then they dropped to 165. A pity. I was rooting for them. Great team, with all four strong, so I hope they make the cut.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 的第九场比赛精彩绝伦。奥里尔牛津大学（530 名学生）对阵杜伦大学（20000 名学生），奥里尔赢了，这让我很惊讶，因为他们犯了一些错误。队长竟然不知道维滕斯坦的名字！？可能只是紧张。杜伦大学一开始领先，然后比分打平到 170 分，最后他们跌到了 165 分。真可惜。我本来还挺支持他们的。这支队伍很棒，四个人都很强，所以我希望他们能晋级。

src_seg:
Game 10 of #UniversityChallenge had a great performance by Christ's Cambridge, who have a consultative captain, a good team, and a strong member named Bethlehem, so Roger Tilling called out "Christ's Bethlehem!" Exeter Oxford never got hold of much, and are out of the running. I could see Christ's Cambridge quietly going far in this series. 
Some nice math questions, a picture round connected to food, and a tricky flag question. Good game.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 的第 10 场比赛中，基督剑桥队表现出色，他们有一位顾问队长、一支优秀的队伍，还有一位名叫伯利恒的强力队员，所以罗杰·蒂林喊出了“基督的伯利恒！”埃克塞特牛津队几乎没怎么得分，已经出局了。我看得出来基督剑桥队会在这个系列赛中默默地走得很远。一些精彩的数学题，一个与食物相关的图片环节，以及一个棘手的旗帜问题。比赛很精彩。

src_seg: Game 11 of #UniversityChallenge was St Andrews (granted university status by an antipope!) vs Cardiff. First round is nearing its end. Some good questions, including mentions of roll-on roll-of ferries, Agnes Martin, and Stax Records. Cardiff Tarsala will never forget her Booker T bloomer, I'm afraid. Nice quizzing from both teams, though it only really got cracking in the last few minutes.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 的第 11 场比赛是圣安德鲁斯大学（由一位对立教皇授予大学地位！）对阵卡迪夫大学。第一轮比赛即将结束。一些问题很有意思，包括提到滚装渡轮、艾格尼丝·马丁和 Stax 唱片公司。卡迪夫大学的塔萨拉恐怕永远不会忘记她那记布克奖得主的精彩表现。两队的问答都很精彩，虽然比赛在最后几分钟才真正开始变得激烈。

src_seg: Game 12 of #UniversityChallenge was Leeds vs Edinburgh. Leeds took a long time to get going, then had a surge in the middle but couldn't keep it going. Seemed like a number of film questions this time, and I was glad to hear PEI as an answer; no flags, though it seems like they crop up every time. Edinburgh Myles is a good captain and the whole team is strong and works well together. I think they'll do well.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 的第 12 场比赛是利兹联对阵爱丁堡。利兹联开局慢了很久，中场突然发起猛攻，但没能保持住势头。这次比赛似乎有很多录像问题，我很高兴听到爱德华王子岛大学的答案；没有红旗，虽然每次都会出现。爱丁堡队的 Myles 是一位优秀的队长，整个队伍实力雄厚，配合默契。我认为他们会取得好成绩。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 13 was a curious one, with Leicester being jokey, wasting time and never getting going, while the LSE captain would often turn to the farthest player for an answer, which was not infrequently wrong. Still, LSE cleaned up. I liked the blues bonus round, though sadly Leicester got none. Canadian mentions: WL Mackenzie King and Margaret Atwood. The best part was Roger Tilling saying "Leicester Lister!"
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第 13 场比赛颇具看点，莱斯特队爱开玩笑，浪费时间，总是一无所获；而 LSE 队长则经常向最远的球员寻求答案，而且经常出错。不过，LSE 最终大获全胜。我喜欢蓝调加分回合，可惜莱斯特队一无所获。加拿大队提名：WL Mackenzie King 和 Margaret Atwood。最精彩的部分是 Roger Tilling 喊出“Leicester Lister！”

src_seg: Game 14 of #UniversityChallenge was top-notch stuff, solid quizzing, down to business, fast answers, good knowledge, close ending. It seems we'll see both SOAS London and St. Edmund Hall Oxford again, because the loser makes the repechage. Very close at the finish, down to "Naples" and "pollen." An unassumingly great game.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 的第 14 场比赛精彩绝伦，问答环节扎实，切中要点，答题迅速，知识点丰富，胜负难料。看来我们又要再次看到伦敦大学亚非学院和牛津大学圣埃德蒙霍尔学院了，因为输的一方要进行复活赛。最后比分非常接近，最后只剩下“那不勒斯”和“花粉”了。这是一场低调却精彩的比赛。

src_seg: Game 15 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of two in the repechage, where the four highest-scoring losing teams try to make it through. This week was UCL and St. Andrews, in a good-natured cheery match. Very strong play from UCL, who have a solid team, and UCL Mandel was in top form. Good questions, some tough, such as requiring "panthera" specifically or knowing "day" in Russian.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛的第15场比赛是复活赛两场比赛中的第一场，四支得分最高的失败队伍将努力争取晋级。本周的比赛是伦敦大学学院（UCL）和圣安德鲁斯大学，气氛轻松愉快。UCL实力强劲，阵容强大，而UCL Mandel队也状态极佳。问题很好，也有一些很难，比如需要具体指代“豹”（panthera）这个词，或者需要知道俄语中“day”（白天）这个词的意思。

src_seg: Just got to game 16 of #UniversityChallenge today, a week late, and it was a nail-biter! Really fast work at the end, with Durham coming from behind in the last few minutes to catch SOAS London in a tie in the final seconds. It went to a starter question that I got on the first clue (being an SF reader I knew "slipstream") but neither team knew. Second question and SOAS London Lambert guessed alpaca but it was llama, so Durham won. Phew, what a finish. 😰
tgt_seg: 今天刚到#UniversityChallenge的第16场比赛，虽然晚了一周，但比赛真是扣人心弦！最后阶段节奏非常快，达勒姆大学在最后几分钟反超比分，在最后几秒追平了伦敦大学亚非学院。比赛一开始我猜了个问题（作为科幻小说的读者，我知道“滑流”这个词），但两队都猜错了。第二题，伦敦大学亚非学院的兰伯特猜是羊驼，结果猜的是骆驼，所以达勒姆大学赢了。呼，结局真棒！😰

src_seg: Game 17 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of eight knockout games in the second round. This was UCL and LSE, and UCL gave an outstanding performance: very fast buzzing, good teamwork, wide general knowledge from them all (UCL Mandel notable again); they took off at the start and never slowed. Very impressive.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第17场比赛是第二轮八场淘汰赛的第一场。这场比赛由伦敦大学学院（UCL）和伦敦政治经济学院（LSE）对阵，UCL表现出色：节奏明快，团队合作良好，知识面广（UCL Mandel队再次表现突出）；他们从一开始就势如破竹，从未放慢脚步。令人印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 18 of #UniversityChallenge was Durham vs Open University. I was rooting for Durham, who have a great team, but in the end to my surprise Open took it, after a number of rather slow answers. I was glad Durham got Marcel Duchamp right on one question; too bad no one knew Yoko Ono as a Fluxus artist. Much respect for Durham Nash, especially on bird silhouettes and flags.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第 18 场比赛是达勒姆大学对阵开放大学。我本来支持达勒姆大学，他们有一支很棒的队伍，但最终出乎意料的是，在几道答题相当慢的题目之后，开放大学赢得了比赛。我很高兴达勒姆大学答对了马塞尔·杜尚的一个问题；可惜当时没人知道小野洋子是一位激浪派艺术家。我非常敬佩达勒姆·纳什，尤其是在鸟类轮廓和旗帜方面。

src_seg:
Game 19 of #UniversityChallenge was Exeter vs Bristol. Bristol got going at the start and never looked back, rolling with momentum, finishing with an incredible score. Exeter only clawed their way back to 0 after 17 minutes. 
I liked the question on common terms in Chinese place names, such as 北 (běi) in Beijing etc. Good geographic knowledge shown.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第19场比赛是埃克塞特大学对阵布里斯托大学。布里斯托大学开局势不可挡，势不可挡，最终以惊人的比分结束比赛。埃克塞特大学在17分钟后才勉强将比分追至0分。我喜欢那个关于中文地名常用词的问题，比如北京的“北”（běi）等等。这体现了他们良好的地理知识。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge is back from the Christmas alumni series, and game 20 was liked greased lightening in comparison. Darwin Cambridge Whitaker tore into questions like a monster, but everyone was in good form on that team and also on Edinburgh. Momentum changed through the game. Good quizzing. Three more games in round two, then the long quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛从圣诞校友系列赛回来了，相比之下，第20场比赛简直是闪电般的轻松。达尔文剑桥大学惠特克像怪物一样猛烈地提问，但那支队伍和爱丁堡大学的每个人都状态很好。比赛的气氛在比赛中不断转变。问答环节很精彩。第二轮还有三场比赛，然后是漫长的四分之一决赛。

src_seg: It's quite a change to go from the Christmas series of #UniversityChallenge, where four people didn't know the name of the narrator of Moby-Dick even when told his name is in the first sentence of the book, to the regular round, where they're racing to buzz on questions like "Fifty-three British thermal units is to grouse hunting as Sydney, Australia, is to what famous star of the London stage?"
tgt_seg: 在#UniversityChallenge 的圣诞节系列中，四个人甚至在被告知《白鲸》叙述者的名字出现在书的第一句话时也不知道他的名字。而在常规环节中，他们会竞相回答诸如“53 英国热量单位对于猎捕松鸡而言，相当于澳大利亚悉尼对于伦敦舞台上哪位著名明星而言？”这样的问题，这真是一个很大的变化。

src_seg:
Game 21 of #UniversityChallenge was Wadham Oxford vs Imperial. What a game! Astounding performance from Imperial. 
However, being King Crimson fan, I was disappointed that no one recognized them from the opening of "21st Century Schizoid Man," and dismayed when someone thought "I Zimbra" by Talking Heads (with Fripp on guitar) was by the Bee Gees. Can't have it all. I remain incredibly impressed.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 的第 21 场比赛是沃德姆牛津大学对阵帝国理工学院。真是精彩的比赛！帝国理工学院的表现令人惊艳。然而，作为深红国王队的球迷，我很失望竟然没人认出他们演唱了《21 世纪精神分裂症患者》的开场曲，也因为有人把 Talking Heads 乐队（Fripp 弹吉他）的《I Zimbra》误认为是比吉斯乐队的而感到沮丧。真是不可多得。我仍然印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 22 of #UniversityChallenge was Christ's Cambridge vs St Edmund Hall Oxford, two small colleges, but that's how the rules are set up.  Nice picture round with the Dunning-Kruger effect, Asch conformity experiments, and bouba-kiki effect.  Another on mushrooms, which seemed tough to me; identifying them by eye is not easy. Solid game, good playing all around.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 的第 22 场比赛是基督剑桥大学对阵圣埃德蒙霍尔牛津大学，两所学院规模不大，但规则就是这样设定的。画面很棒，融入了邓宁-克鲁格效应、阿希从众实验和布巴-基基效应。还有一场关于蘑菇的比赛，我觉得有点难；用肉眼识别蘑菇可不容易。比赛很精彩，各方面都很棒。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. Nice flag knowledge, and a good picture round identifying physical laws by diagrams of experiments. A bit too much bantz for my taste, but a solid game. One more before the quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第23场比赛是卡迪夫大学对阵贝尔法斯特女王大学。比赛比分比我预想的要低，可能是因为错过了奖励，但首发球员很快就被灌醉了。国旗知识不错，还有一轮用实验图表识别物理定律的精彩图片环节。对我来说，bantz有点太多了，但比赛很扎实。四分之一决赛前再来一场。

src_seg: Game 9 of #UniversityChallenge was a hell of a match. Oriel Oxford (530 students) vs Durham (20,000), and Oriel won, which surprised me after some mistakes they made. The captain didn't know Wittengstein's name!? Possibly just nerves. Durham was ahead, then it was tied at 170, then they dropped to 165. A pity. I was rooting for them. Great team, with all four strong, so I hope they make the cut.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛的第九场比赛是一场非常激烈的比赛. 奥里尔牛津 (530名学生) 与达勒姆 (20,000名学生),奥里尔赢了,他们犯了一些错误后,我很惊. 队长不知道维斯坦的名字!? 可能只是神经. 达勒姆领先,然后在170分平局,然后他们下降到165. 太遗憾了. 我一直支持他们. 很棒的球队,四人都是强的,所以我希望他们能进入比赛.

src_seg:
Game 10 of #UniversityChallenge had a great performance by Christ's Cambridge, who have a consultative captain, a good team, and a strong member named Bethlehem, so Roger Tilling called out "Christ's Bethlehem!" Exeter Oxford never got hold of much, and are out of the running. I could see Christ's Cambridge quietly going far in this series. 
Some nice math questions, a picture round connected to food, and a tricky flag question. Good game.
tgt_seg:
在#大学挑战赛的第10场比赛中,基督剑桥队的表现非常出色,他们有一位顾问的队长,一支优秀的球队和一个名叫伯利恒的强大成员,所以罗杰·蒂林喊道:"基督的伯利恒!"埃克塞特·牛津队从来没有抓住过很多,并且已经退出了比赛.我可以看到基督剑桥队在这个系列赛中安静地走得很远.
一些很好的数学问题,与食物相关的图片回合,以及一个棘手的国旗问题.

src_seg: Game 11 of #UniversityChallenge was St Andrews (granted university status by an antipope!) vs Cardiff. First round is nearing its end. Some good questions, including mentions of roll-on roll-of ferries, Agnes Martin, and Stax Records. Cardiff Tarsala will never forget her Booker T bloomer, I'm afraid. Nice quizzing from both teams, though it only really got cracking in the last few minutes.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛的第11场比赛是圣安德鲁斯 (被反教皇授予大学地位!) vs 卡迪夫.第一轮即将结束.一些很好的问题,包括提及滚动滚动的渡轮,阿格尼斯·马丁和斯塔克斯唱片. 卡迪夫·塔萨拉永远不会忘记她的布克·托布鲁默,我担心. 两支球队的比赛都很好,尽管它在最后几分钟才真正破裂.

src_seg: Game 12 of #UniversityChallenge was Leeds vs Edinburgh. Leeds took a long time to get going, then had a surge in the middle but couldn't keep it going. Seemed like a number of film questions this time, and I was glad to hear PEI as an answer; no flags, though it seems like they crop up every time. Edinburgh Myles is a good captain and the whole team is strong and works well together. I think they'll do well.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛的第12场比赛是利兹vs爱丁堡. 利兹花了很长时间才开始,然后在中间出现了激增,但不能继续下去. 这次看起来像是一些电影问题,我很高兴听到PEI作为答案;没有旗,尽管似乎每次都会出现. 爱丁堡迈尔斯是一位很好的队长,整个球队都很强大,一起工作很好. 我认为他们会做得很好.

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 13 was a curious one, with Leicester being jokey, wasting time and never getting going, while the LSE captain would often turn to the farthest player for an answer, which was not infrequently wrong. Still, LSE cleaned up. I liked the blues bonus round, though sadly Leicester got none. Canadian mentions: WL Mackenzie King and Margaret Atwood. The best part was Roger Tilling saying "Leicester Lister!"
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第13场比赛是一个奇怪的比赛,莱斯特是开玩笑的,浪费时间,从来没有开始,而LSE队长经常会向最远的球员寻求答案,这并不罕见.尽管如此,LSE清理.我喜欢蓝色奖金轮,尽管不幸的是莱斯特没有得到任何.加拿大人提到:WL麦肯齐国王和玛格丽特·阿特伍德.最好的部分是罗杰·蒂林说"莱斯特·利斯特!"

src_seg: Game 14 of #UniversityChallenge was top-notch stuff, solid quizzing, down to business, fast answers, good knowledge, close ending. It seems we'll see both SOAS London and St. Edmund Hall Oxford again, because the loser makes the repechage. Very close at the finish, down to "Naples" and "pollen." An unassumingly great game.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛的第14场比赛是顶级的东西,坚实的问卷,下来做生意,快速的答案,良好的知识,接近结束. 看起来我们将再次看到伦敦的SOAS和牛津的圣埃德蒙大厅,因为失败者做了复赛. 非常接近终点,到"那不勒斯"和"花粉". 一场不起眼的伟大比赛.

#UniversityChallenge 第 10 场比赛中，剑桥基督学院表现出色，他们有一位善于协商的船长，一个优秀的团队，以及一位名叫贝特勒恒的强有力队员，所以罗杰·蒂林喊道“剑桥基督学院的贝特勒恒！”。牛津埃克塞特学院并没有掌握太多优势，已经出局了。我能看到剑桥基督学院在这场比赛中默默地取得好成绩。
有一些不错的数学问题，一个与食物相关的图片题，还有一个棘手的国旗题。好比赛。

src_seg: Game 11 of #UniversityChallenge was St Andrews (granted university status by an antipope!) vs Cardiff. First round is nearing its end. Some good questions, including mentions of roll-on roll-of ferries, Agnes Martin, and Stax Records. Cardiff Tarsala will never forget her Booker T bloomer, I'm afraid. Nice quizzing from both teams, though it only really got cracking in the last few minutes.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第 11 场比赛是圣安德鲁斯大学（由一位反教皇授予大学地位！）对阵加的夫。第一轮即将结束。有一些好问题，包括关于滚轮滚落的渡轮、阿格内斯·马丁和Stax唱片公司的提及。加的夫Tarsala恐怕会永远记住她的Booker T失误。尽管双方团队都表现出了不错的问答水平，但直到最后几分钟才真正进入状态。

src_seg: Game 12 of #UniversityChallenge was Leeds vs Edinburgh. Leeds took a long time to get going, then had a surge in the middle but couldn't keep it going. Seemed like a number of film questions this time, and I was glad to hear PEI as an answer; no flags, though it seems like they crop up every time. Edinburgh Myles is a good captain and the whole team is strong and works well together. I think they'll do well.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第 12 场比赛是利兹大学对阵爱丁堡大学。利兹大学起步较慢，然后中间有一阵爆发，但无法维持。看起来这次有很多电影问题，我很高兴听到PEI作为答案；虽然国旗似乎每次都出现。爱丁堡大学的Myles是一位好船长，整个团队都很强大，并且配合得很好。我认为他们会表现出色。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 13 was a curious one, with Leicester being jokey, wasting time and never getting going, while the LSE captain would often turn to the farthest player for an answer, which was not infrequently wrong. Still, LSE cleaned up. I liked the blues bonus round, though sadly Leicester got none. Canadian mentions: WL Mackenzie King and Margaret Atwood. The best part was Roger Tilling saying "Leicester Lister!"
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第 13 场比赛颇为有趣，莱斯特大学开玩笑、浪费时间，而且始终没有起色，而LSE的船长经常转向最远的队员寻求答案，这并不罕见。不过，LSE最终胜出。我喜欢蓝色奖题，可惜莱斯特大学没有获得任何奖项。加拿大相关：WL Mackenzie King 和玛格丽特·阿特伍德。最精彩的部分是罗杰·蒂林说“莱斯特·利斯特！”

src_seg: Game 14 of #UniversityChallenge was top-notch stuff, solid quizzing, down to business, fast answers, good knowledge, close ending. It seems we'll see both SOAS London and St. Edmund Hall Oxford again, because the loser makes the repechage. Very close at the finish, down to "Naples" and "pollen." An unassumingly great game.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第 14 场比赛是顶级的，问答很扎实，直奔主题，快速回答，知识渊博，结局很接近。看来我们还会看到伦敦SOAS和牛津圣爱德华学院，因为输家将进入复赛。结局非常接近，在“那不勒斯”和“花粉”之间。一场不声张却很棒的比赛。

src_seg: Game 15 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of two in the repechage, where the four highest-scoring losing teams try to make it through. This week was UCL and St. Andrews, in a good-natured cheery match. Very strong play from UCL, who have a solid team, and UCL Mandel was in top form. Good questions, some tough, such as requiring "panthera" specifically or knowing "day" in Russian.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第 15 场比赛是复赛的两场比赛中的第一场，四支得分最高的失利队伍试图晋级。本周是UCL和圣安德鲁斯大学，这是一场友好的愉快比赛。UCL表现非常出色，他们有一个强大的团队，UCL Mandel也状态良好。问题很好，有些很困难，例如需要特别指出“panthera”或知道俄语中的“day”。

src_seg: Just got to game 16 of #UniversityChallenge today, a week late, and it was a nail-biter! Really fast work at the end, with Durham coming from behind in the last few minutes to catch SOAS London in a tie in the final seconds. It went to a starter question that I got on the first clue (being an SF reader I knew "slipstream") but neither team knew. Second question and SOAS London Lambert guessed alpaca but it was llama, so Durham won. Phew, what a finish. 😰
tgt_seg: 今天终于赶上了#UniversityChallenge 第 16 场比赛，比原定时间晚一周，结果真是惊险万分！在最后几分钟，达勒姆大学奋起直追，与伦敦SOAS大学打成平局，在最后时刻完成逆转。我第一个就猜对了答案（作为SF读者，我知道“slipstream”），但双方都没有猜对。第二个问题，伦敦SOAS大学的Lambert猜了alpaca，但却是llama，所以达勒姆大学获胜。谢天谢地，真是个精彩的结局。😰

src_seg: Game 17 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of eight knockout games in the second round. This was UCL and LSE, and UCL gave an outstanding performance: very fast buzzing, good teamwork, wide general knowledge from them all (UCL Mandel notable again); they took off at the start and never slowed. Very impressive.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第 17 场比赛是第二轮的八场淘汰赛中的第一场。这场比赛是UCL和LSE，UCL表现出色：快速蜂鸣，团队合作良好，他们所有人都有广泛的常识（UCL Mandel再次表现突出）；他们一开始就起步，并且从未减速。非常令人印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 18 of #UniversityChallenge was Durham vs Open University. I was rooting for Durham, who have a great team, but in the end to my surprise Open took it, after a number of rather slow answers. I was glad Durham got Marcel Duchamp right on one question; too bad no one knew Yoko Ono as a Fluxus artist. Much respect for Durham Nash, especially on bird silhouettes and flags.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第 18 场比赛是达勒姆大学对阵开放大学。我支持达勒姆大学，他们有一个很棒的团队，但最终令我惊讶的是，开放大学获胜，尽管他们给出了许多相当慢的答案。我很高兴达勒姆大学在其中一个问题中正确回答了马塞尔·杜尚；可惜没有人知道横滨良个是Fluxus艺术家。非常敬佩达勒姆大学的Nash，尤其是在鸟类剪影和国旗方面。

src_seg:
Game 19 of #UniversityChallenge was Exeter vs Bristol. Bristol got going at the start and never looked back, rolling with momentum, finishing with an incredible score. Exeter only clawed their way back to 0 after 17 minutes. 
I liked the question on common terms in Chinese place names, such as 北 (běi) in Beijing etc. Good geographic knowledge shown.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第 19 场比赛是埃克塞特大学对阵布里斯托大学。布里斯托大学一开始就起步，而且从未回头，以惊人的分数结束。埃克塞特大学在17分钟后才勉强追回了0分。
我喜欢关于中文地名中常见术语的问题，例如北京中的“北 (běi)”等。展示了良好的地理知识。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge is back from the Christmas alumni series, and game 20 was liked greased lightening in comparison. Darwin Cambridge Whitaker tore into questions like a monster, but everyone was in good form on that team and also on Edinburgh. Momentum changed through the game. Good quizzing. Three more games in round two, then the long quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 圣诞节校友系列赛结束后回归，第 20 场比赛比之前快得多。剑桥达尔文 Whitaker像怪物一样猛烈地抢答问题，但该队的每个人都表现良好，爱丁堡大学也一样。比赛过程中，势头发生了变化。问答很好。第二轮还有三场比赛，然后是漫长的季军赛。

src_seg: It's quite a change to go from the Christmas series of #UniversityChallenge, where four people didn't know the name of the narrator of Moby-Dick even when told his name is in the first sentence of the book, to the regular round, where they're racing to buzz on questions like "Fifty-three British thermal units is to grouse hunting as Sydney, Australia, is to what famous star of the London stage?"
tgt_seg: 从#UniversityChallenge 的圣诞节系列赛，在那个系列赛中，四个人不知道《白鲸记》叙述者的名字，即使被告知他的名字出现在这本书的第一句话中，到常规赛，他们正在竞相回答像“53英热单位对grouse狩猎，正如悉尼，澳大利亚对伦敦舞台上哪位著名明星的什么？”这样的问题，这确实是一种很大的变化。

src_seg:
Game 21 of #UniversityChallenge was Wadham Oxford vs Imperial. What a game! Astounding performance from Imperial. 
However, being King Crimson fan, I was disappointed that no one recognized them from the opening of "21st Century Schizoid Man," and dismayed when someone thought "I Zimbra" by Talking Heads (with Fripp on guitar) was by the Bee Gees. Can't have it all. I remain incredibly impressed.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第 21 场比赛是牛津Wadham学院对阵帝国学院。这是一场多么精彩的比赛！帝国学院表现惊人。
然而，作为King Crimson的粉丝，我很失望没有人从“21世纪偏执狂人”的开头就认出他们，而且当我听到有人认为Talking Heads的“I Zimbra”（Fripp弹吉他）是Bee Gees的歌曲时，我感到沮丧。鱼与熊掌不可兼得。我仍然印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 22 of #UniversityChallenge was Christ's Cambridge vs St Edmund Hall Oxford, two small colleges, but that's how the rules are set up.  Nice picture round with the Dunning-Kruger effect, Asch conformity experiments, and bouba-kiki effect.  Another on mushrooms, which seemed tough to me; identifying them by eye is not easy. Solid game, good playing all around.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第 22 场比赛是剑桥基督学院对阵牛津圣爱德华学院，两所小型学院，但这就是规则设置的方式。一个不错的图片题，涉及邓宁-克鲁格效应、阿什从众实验和bouba-kiki效应。还有一个关于蘑菇的题目，对我来说似乎很困难；通过眼睛识别它们并不容易。问答很扎实，各方面都表现良好。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. Nice flag knowledge, and a good picture round identifying physical laws by diagrams of experiments. A bit too much bantz for my taste, but a solid game. One more before the quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第 23 场比赛是加的夫对阵贝尔法斯特女王学院。比我想象的得分要低，也许是因为错过了奖题，但快速蜂鸣。不错的国旗知识，以及一个很好的图片题，通过实验图表识别物理定律。有点太多闲聊了，但这是一场扎实的比赛。在季军赛之前还有一场比赛。

src_seg: Game 9 of #UniversityChallenge was a hell of a match. Oriel Oxford (530 students) vs Durham (20,000), and Oriel won, which surprised me after some mistakes they made. The captain didn't know Wittengstein's name!? Possibly just nerves. Durham was ahead, then it was tied at 170, then they dropped to 165. A pity. I was rooting for them. Great team, with all four strong, so I hope they make the cut.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 的第九场比赛是一场精彩绝伦的比赛。牛津大学奥里尔学院（530名学生）对阵杜伦大学（20,000名学生），结果奥里尔学院获胜，这让我颇感意外，尤其是在他们犯了一些错误之后。他们的队长竟然不知道维特根斯坦的名字！可能是紧张所致。杜伦大学一度领先，之后比分在170分时打平，然后他们掉到了165分。真遗憾。我一直支持他们。他们是一支实力强劲的队伍，四位队员都很出色，所以我希望他们能晋级。

src_seg:
Game 10 of #UniversityChallenge had a great performance by Christ's Cambridge, who have a consultative captain, a good team, and a strong member named Bethlehem, so Roger Tilling called out "Christ's Bethlehem!" Exeter Oxford never got hold of much, and are out of the running. I could see Christ's Cambridge quietly going far in this series.

Three more games in round two, then the long quarter-finals.

src_seg: It's quite a change to go from the Christmas series of #UniversityChallenge, where four people didn't know the name of the narrator of Moby-Dick even when told his name is in the first sentence of the book, to the regular round, where they're racing to buzz on questions like "Fifty-three British thermal units is to grouse hunting as Sydney, Australia, is to what famous star of the London stage?"
tgt_seg: 从#UniversityChallenge 圣诞节校友系列赛过渡到常规赛，变化确实很大。在那期节目中，四位选手甚至在被告知《白鲸》的叙述者名字就在小说第一句话中时，仍然不知道答案；而在常规赛中，他们却在抢答这样的问题：“53个英国热量单位之于松鸡狩猎，正如澳大利亚悉尼之于伦敦舞台上的哪位著名明星？”

src_seg:
Game 21 of #UniversityChallenge was Wadham Oxford vs Imperial. What a game! Astounding performance from Imperial. 
However, being King Crimson fan, I was disappointed that no one recognized them from the opening of "21st Century Schizoid Man," and dismayed when someone thought "I Zimbra" by Talking Heads (with Fripp on guitar) was by the Bee Gees. Can't have it all. I remain incredibly impressed.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第二十一场比赛是牛津大学瓦德姆学院对阵帝国理工学院。这是一场精彩的比赛！帝国理工学院的表现令人惊叹。  
然而，作为一名King Crimson（红王）乐队的粉丝，我感到失望的是，没有人认出《21世纪精神分裂者》的开头音乐，更令人沮丧的是，有人竟然认为Talking Heads（传声头像）乐队（由Fripp担任吉他手）的歌曲“I Zimbra”是Bee Gees（比吉斯）乐队的作品。不能奢望一切尽如人意。我仍然对他们的表现感到非常钦佩。

src_seg: Game 22 of #UniversityChallenge was Christ's Cambridge vs St Edmund Hall Oxford, two small colleges, but that's how the rules are set up.  Nice picture round with the Dunning-Kruger effect, Asch conformity experiments, and bouba-kiki effect.  Another on mushrooms, which seemed tough to me; identifying them by eye is not easy. Solid game, good playing all around.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第二十二场比赛是剑桥大学基督学院对阵牛津大学圣埃德蒙学堂，两所都是规模较小的学院，但这是比赛规则所决定的。图片题环节很精彩，包括邓宁-克鲁格效应、阿希从众实验和布巴-基基效应。另一个关于蘑菇的题目在我看来难度较高；仅凭肉眼识别并不容易。这是一场扎实的比赛，双方表现都不错。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. Nice flag knowledge, and a good picture round identifying physical laws by diagrams of experiments. A bit too much bantz for my taste, but a solid game. One more before the quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第二十三场比赛是卡迪夫大学对阵贝尔法斯特女王大学。比赛最终得分比我预期的要低，可能是由于错失了一些加分题，但抢答环节反应迅速。国旗知识表现不错，图片题环节是通过实验图示识别物理定律。在我看来，调侃有点多，但整体上是一场扎实的比赛。还有一场比赛后就将进入四分之一决赛。

src_seg: Game 9 of #UniversityChallenge was a hell of a match. Oriel Oxford (530 students) vs Durham (20,000), and Oriel won, which surprised me after some mistakes they made. The captain didn't know Wittengstein's name!? Possibly just nerves. Durham was ahead, then it was tied at 170, then they dropped to 165. A pity. I was rooting for them. Great team, with all four strong, so I hope they make the cut.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第9场比赛精彩绝伦。牛津大学奥里尔学院（530名学生）对阵杜伦大学（2万人），奥里尔获胜的结局令我意外——他们明明犯了些低级错误，队长竟连维特根斯坦的名字都答错！？或许是紧张所致。杜伦一度领先，后战至170平，却因失误降至165分，实在可惜。我本看好这支全员实力均衡的队伍，希望他们能晋级。

src_seg:
Game 10 of #UniversityChallenge had a great performance by Christ's Cambridge, who have a consultative captain, a good team, and a strong member named Bethlehem, so Roger Tilling called out "Christ's Bethlehem!" Exeter Oxford never got hold of much, and are out of the running. I could see Christ's Cambridge quietly going far in this series. 
Some nice math questions, a picture round connected to food, and a tricky flag question. Good game.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第10场中，剑桥大学基督学院表现抢眼：队长善于集思广益，队员伯利恒实力超群，连主持人都高呼"基督的伯利恒！"牛津大学埃克塞特学院全程被动，惨遭淘汰。我看好基督学院在本季走得更远。本场数学题出彩，食物关联图片轮次有趣，还有道棘手的旗帜题，堪称高质量对决。

src_seg: Game 11 of #UniversityChallenge was St Andrews (granted university status by an antipope!) vs Cardiff. First round is nearing its end. Some good questions, including mentions of roll-on roll-of ferries, Agnes Martin, and Stax Records. Cardiff Tarsala will never forget her Booker T bloomer, I'm afraid. Nice quizzing from both teams, though it only really got cracking in the last few minutes.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第11场由圣安德鲁斯大学（其大学资格竟由伪教皇授予！）对阵卡迪夫大学。首轮临近尾声，题目涉及滚装渡轮、艾格尼丝·马丁和斯塔克斯唱片公司等知识点。卡迪夫队员塔萨拉恐怕会永远懊恼布克·T相关失误。两队后期才真正进入状态，最后几分钟才见真章。

src_seg: Game 12 of #UniversityChallenge was Leeds vs Edinburgh. Leeds took a long time to get going, then had a surge in the middle but couldn't keep it going. Seemed like a number of film questions this time, and I was glad to hear PEI as an answer; no flags, though it seems like they crop up every time. Edinburgh Myles is a good captain and the whole team is strong and works well together. I think they'll do well.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第12场利兹对阵爱丁堡。利兹开局慢热，中期发力却后劲不足。本轮电影题频现，听到"PEI"作为答案令我欣慰——虽未见旗帜题踪影，但这题型似乎每场必现。爱丁堡队长迈尔斯领导有方，团队配合默契，晋级前景看好。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 13 was a curious one, with Leicester being jokey, wasting time and never getting going, while the LSE captain would often turn to the farthest player for an answer, which was not infrequently wrong. Still, LSE cleaned up. I liked the blues bonus round, though sadly Leicester got none. Canadian mentions: WL Mackenzie King and Margaret Atwood. The best part was Roger Tilling saying "Leicester Lister!"
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第13场颇具戏剧性：莱斯特队全程插科打诨毫无建树，而LSE队长总征询远端队员却屡获错误答案。最终LSE轻松取胜。蓝调音乐加分轮设计精妙，可惜莱斯特一分未得。加拿大元素包括WL麦肯齐·金总理和玛格丽特·阿特伍德。最妙时刻当属主持人喊出"莱斯特·李斯特！"

src_seg: Game 14 of #UniversityChallenge was top-notch stuff, solid quizzing, down to business, fast answers, good knowledge, close ending. It seems we'll see both SOAS London and St. Edmund Hall Oxford again, because the loser makes the repechage. Very close at the finish, down to "Naples" and "pollen." An unassumingly great game.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第14场堪称教科书级较量：节奏紧凑、知识扎实、比分胶着。伦敦大学亚非学院与牛津圣埃德蒙学堂或将再战，因败者仍可参加复活赛。终局扣人心弦，胜负系于"那不勒斯"与"花粉"两题之间，实为低调的经典之战。

src_seg: Game 15 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of two in the repechage, where the four highest-scoring losing teams try to make it through. This week was UCL and St. Andrews, in a good-natured cheery match. Very strong play from UCL, who have a solid team, and UCL Mandel was in top form. Good questions, some tough, such as requiring "panthera" specifically or knowing "day" in Russian.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第15场开启复活赛首战，四支高分败队争夺晋级资格。本周UCL与圣安德鲁斯展开友好角逐，UCL表现强势，曼德尔队员状态极佳。难题频出：需精确答出"豹属"或俄语"白天"等冷门知识。

src_seg: Just got to game 16 of #UniversityChallenge today, a week late, and it was a nail-biter! Really fast work at the end, with Durham coming from behind in the last few minutes to catch SOAS London in a tie in the final seconds. It went to a starter question that I got on the first clue (being an SF reader I knew "slipstream") but neither team knew. Second question and SOAS London Lambert guessed alpaca but it was llama, so Durham won. Phew, what a finish. 😰
tgt_seg: 迟了一周才看#UniversityChallenge 第16场，却遇上心跳对决！杜伦最后时刻绝地反击，终场秒平伦敦大学亚非学院。加赛首题关于"slipstream"（科幻读者如我秒懂），两队却均未答出。次题亚非学院兰伯特误将羊驼答作骆马，杜伦遂胜。惊心动魄的终局！😰

src_seg: Game 17 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of eight knockout games in the second round. This was UCL and LSE, and UCL gave an outstanding performance: very fast buzzing, good teamwork, wide general knowledge from them all (UCL Mandel notable again); they took off at the start and never slowed. Very impressive.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第17场开启第二轮八强淘汰赛。UCL与LSE交锋中，UCL表现惊艳：抢答神速、配合默契、知识广博（曼德尔再显锋芒），全程保持压制态势，令人叹服。

src_seg: Game 18 of #UniversityChallenge was Durham vs Open University. I was rooting for Durham, who have a great team, but in the end to my surprise Open took it, after a number of rather slow answers. I was glad Durham got Marcel Duchamp right on one question; too bad no one knew Yoko Ono as a Fluxus artist. Much respect for Durham Nash, especially on bird silhouettes and flags.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第18场杜伦对阵开放大学。我虽支持阵容强大的杜伦，但开放大学最终爆冷胜出——尽管其答题屡现迟疑。欣慰的是杜伦答对了马塞尔·杜尚，可惜无人知晓小野洋子也是激浪派成员。特别钦佩杜伦队员纳什的鸟类剪影与旗帜辨识能力。

src_seg:
Game 19 of #UniversityChallenge was Exeter vs Bristol. Bristol got going at the start and never looked back, rolling with momentum, finishing with an incredible score. Exeter only clawed their way back to 0 after 17 minutes. 
I liked the question on common terms in Chinese place names, such as 北 (běi) in Beijing etc. Good geographic knowledge shown.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第19场埃克塞特对阵布里斯托。布里斯托开局即掌控节奏，最终创下惊人高分，而埃克塞特苦战17分钟才破零。中国地名常见字（如"北京"之"北"）相关题目设计精妙，展现了地理知识储备。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge is back from the Christmas alumni series, and game 20 was liked greased lightening in comparison. Darwin Cambridge Whitaker tore into questions like a monster, but everyone was in good form on that team and also on Edinburgh. Momentum changed through the game. Good quizzing. Three more games in round two, then the long quarter-finals.

tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第15场比赛是复赛的首场比赛，四个得分最高的失败队伍将再次尝试争取晋级机会。本周比赛是伦敦大学学院（UCL）和圣安德鲁斯之间的比赛，比赛氛围友好愉快。伦敦大学学院表现十分出色，他们拥有一个强大稳定的团队，UCL的曼德尔表现精采。提问质量很高，有些问题很有挑战性，例如需要专门提到“豹类”（panthera）或需要了解俄语的“日”字的意义。

src_seg: Just got to game 16 of #UniversityChallenge today, a week late, and it was a nail-biter! Really fast work at the end, with Durham coming from behind in the last few minutes to catch SOAS London in a tie in the final seconds. It went to a starter question that I got on the first clue (being an SF reader I knew "slipstream") but neither team knew. Second question and SOAS London Lambert guessed alpaca but it was llama, so Durham won. Phew, what a finish. 😰
tgt_seg: 今天终于看了第16集的《大学挑战》，晚了整整一个星期，不过比赛真是扣人心弦！最后几分钟的赛况非常激烈，达勒姆大学在最后时刻追赶上来，与伦敦大学伦敦学院战成平手，最后一秒才决出胜负。比赛进入开始题环节，我根据第一个提示想到了“滑流（slipstream）”，但两队都不知道。第二个问题中，伦敦大学伦敦学院的兰伯特猜到了“羊驼”（alpaca），但实际上是“牦牛”（llama），所以达勒姆大学赢了。哇，真是惊心动魄的结局啊！😰

src_seg: Game 17 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of eight knockout games in the second round. This was UCL and LSE, and UCL gave an outstanding performance: very fast buzzing, good teamwork, wide general knowledge from them all (UCL Mandel notable again); they took off at the start and never slowed. Very impressive.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛的第17场比赛是第二轮八场淘汰赛中的第一场。参赛的是UCL和LSE，UCL的表现非常出色：答题速度很快，团队合作良好，他们整体的知识储备也很广（UCL的Mandel再次表现出色）；比赛一开始他们就展现了强大的实力，从未放慢脚步。非常令人印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 18 of #UniversityChallenge was Durham vs Open University. I was rooting for Durham, who have a great team, but in the end to my surprise Open took it, after a number of rather slow answers. I was glad Durham got Marcel Duchamp right on one question; too bad no one knew Yoko Ono as a Fluxus artist. Much respect for Durham Nash, especially on bird silhouettes and flags.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第18场是邓迪大学对开放大学的对决。我支持邓迪队，他们的团队实力很强，但最后让我惊讶的是，开放大学获胜了，尽管他们在一些问题上回答得比较慢。我很高兴邓迪队在一个问题上答对了马塞尔·杜尚的名字；遗憾的是，没有任何人知道小野洋子是一位弗洛克斯派艺术家。我很尊重邓迪大学的纳什选手，特别是在鸟类轮廓和国旗的题目上发挥得非常出色。

src_seg:
Game 19 of #UniversityChallenge was Exeter vs Bristol. Bristol got going at the start and never looked back, rolling with momentum, finishing with an incredible score. Exeter only clawed their way back to 0 after 17 minutes. 
I liked the question on common terms in Chinese place names, such as 北 (běi) in Beijing etc. Good geographic knowledge shown.
tgt_seg:
大学挑战赛第19场是埃克塞特对布里斯托尔。布里斯托尔在开场时就占据了优势，并一路保持领先，最终取得了令人惊叹的成绩。埃克塞特在17分钟后才艰难地追平至0分。
我很喜欢那些关于中国地名中常见词汇的问题，比如北京的“北”(běi)等等。展现了良好的地理知识。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge is back from the Christmas alumni series, and game 20 was liked greased lightening in comparison. Darwin Cambridge Whitaker tore into questions like a monster, but everyone was in good form on that team and also on Edinburgh. Momentum changed through the game. Good quizzing. Three more games in round two, then the long quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛从圣诞校友系列赛回来了，与之前的比赛相比，第20场简直如同闪电般精彩。达尔文剑桥大学的惠特克选手像怪物一样激烈地挑战着每一个问题，但那支队伍的每个人都状态极佳，爱丁堡队也是如此。比赛中的气势不断变化。精彩的问答环节。第二轮还有三场比赛，然后便是漫长的四分之一决赛。

src_seg: It's quite a change to go from the Christmas series of #UniversityChallenge, where four people didn't know the name of the narrator of Moby-Dick even when told his name is in the first sentence of the book, to the regular round, where they're racing to buzz on questions like "Fifty-three British thermal units is to grouse hunting as Sydney, Australia, is to what famous star of the London stage?"
tgt_seg: 这确实是一个很大的变化。在《大学挑战赛》的圣诞系列节目中，四个人甚至在被告知《白鲸记》的叙述者名字就在书的第一句中时，都还是不知道那人的名字；而到了常规赛，他们就开始竞相抢答诸如“53个英热单位在松鸡狩猎中相当于悉尼在澳洲的地位，那么伦敦舞台上那位著名的明星相当于什么？”这样的题目。

src_seg:
Game 21 of #UniversityChallenge was Wadham Oxford vs Imperial. What a game! Astounding performance from Imperial. 
However, being King Crimson fan, I was disappointed that no one recognized them from the opening of "21st Century Schizoid Man," and dismayed when someone thought "I Zimbra" by Talking Heads (with Fripp on guitar) was by the Bee Gees. Can't have it all. I remain incredibly impressed.
tgt_seg:
#大学挑战赛的第21场比赛是牛津瓦德姆学院对阵帝国学院。这真是一场精彩的比赛！帝国学院的表现令人惊叹。
然而，作为 King Crimson 的粉丝，我很失望地发现没有人从《21st Century Schizoid Man》的开幕曲中认出他们，而当我听到有人误以为 Talking Heads 的《I Zimbra》（由弗里普担任吉他手）是 Bee Gees 的作品时，我也感到沮丧。事情不能十全十美。我仍然感到非常震撼。

src_seg: Game 22 of #UniversityChallenge was Christ's Cambridge vs St Edmund Hall Oxford, two small colleges, but that's how the rules are set up.  Nice picture round with the Dunning-Kruger effect, Asch conformity experiments, and bouba-kiki effect.  Another on mushrooms, which seemed tough to me; identifying them by eye is not easy. Solid game, good playing all around.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第22场比赛是基督大学（剑桥）对阵圣埃德蒙学院（牛津），两所都是小型学院，但比赛规则就是这样设定的。比赛内容很有趣，涉及邓宁-克鲁格效应、阿什从众实验以及“布巴-基基效应”。还有一道关于蘑菇的题，对我来说很难；靠肉眼识别它们并不容易。整体来说这是一场高质量的比赛，大家表现都很出色。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. Nice flag knowledge, and a good picture round identifying physical laws by diagrams of experiments. A bit too much bantz for my taste, but a solid game. One more before the quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第23场是卡迪夫对阵贝尔法斯特女王大学。比赛结束时的得分比我预想的低，可能是由于错失了一些额外分数，但选手很快就进入了比赛状态。选手表现出了不错的旗帜辨识能力，并且在图片题环节通过实验图示识别了物理定律。虽然对我来说趣味性有点过头，但整体比赛表现不错。四分之一决赛之前还有一场比赛。

src_seg: Game 9 of #UniversityChallenge was a hell of a match. Oriel Oxford (530 students) vs Durham (20,000), and Oriel won, which surprised me after some mistakes they made. The captain didn't know Wittengstein's name!? Possibly just nerves. Durham was ahead, then it was tied at 170, then they dropped to 165. A pity. I was rooting for them. Great team, with all four strong, so I hope they make the cut.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛 第9场真是一场硬仗。牛津大学奥里尔学院（530名学生）对阵杜伦大学（20000名学生），奥里尔学院在犯了一些错误后居然赢了，这让我很惊讶。他们的队长竟然不知道维特根斯坦的名字！？可能是太紧张了吧。杜伦大学一度领先，后来打成170平，接着又被倒扣分到165。真可惜。我本来是支持他们的。这支队伍很棒，四名队员都很强，希望他们能晋级。

src_seg:
Game 10 of #UniversityChallenge had a great performance by Christ's Cambridge, who have a consultative captain, a good team, and a strong member named Bethlehem, so Roger Tilling called out "Christ's Bethlehem!" Exeter Oxford never got hold of much, and are out of the running. I could see Christ's Cambridge quietly going far in this series. 
Some nice math questions, a picture round connected to food, and a tricky flag question. Good game.
tgt_seg:
#大学挑战赛 第10场，剑桥大学基督学院表现出色。他们有一位善于商议的队长，一支优秀的队伍，还有一位名叫伯利恒的强力队员，所以主持人罗杰·蒂林喊出了“基督学院的伯利恒！”牛津大学埃克塞特学院则没抢到多少题，已经出局了。我觉得剑桥大学基督学院可能会成为本季的一匹黑马，悄悄地走得很远。
这场比赛有一些不错的数学题，一轮与食物相关的图片题，还有一道刁钻的国旗题。比赛很精彩。

src_seg: Game 11 of #UniversityChallenge was St Andrews (granted university status by an antipope!) vs Cardiff. First round is nearing its end. Some good questions, including mentions of roll-on roll-of ferries, Agnes Martin, and Stax Records. Cardiff Tarsala will never forget her Booker T bloomer, I'm afraid. Nice quizzing from both teams, though it only really got cracking in the last few minutes.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛 第11场是圣安德鲁斯大学（由一位伪教宗授予其大学地位！）对阵卡迪夫大学。第一轮比赛已接近尾声。出现了一些好题，包括滚装渡轮、艾格尼丝·马丁和斯塔克斯唱片。恐怕卡迪夫大学的塔萨拉永远也忘不了她在布克·T那道题上犯的错。两队都答得不错，不过比赛直到最后几分钟才真正激烈起来。

src_seg: Game 12 of #UniversityChallenge was Leeds vs Edinburgh. Leeds took a long time to get going, then had a surge in the middle but couldn't keep it going. Seemed like a number of film questions this time, and I was glad to hear PEI as an answer; no flags, though it seems like they crop up every time. Edinburgh Myles is a good captain and the whole team is strong and works well together. I think they'll do well.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛 第12场是利兹大学对阵爱丁堡大学。利兹大学花了很长时间才进入状态，中途有过一波小高潮，但没能保持住势头。这次好像有好几道电影题，很高兴听到爱德华王子岛这个答案；没有国旗题，尽管这题目似乎每场都有。爱丁堡大学的迈尔斯是位好队长，整个队伍实力强劲，配合默契。我认为他们会取得好成绩。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 13 was a curious one, with Leicester being jokey, wasting time and never getting going, while the LSE captain would often turn to the farthest player for an answer, which was not infrequently wrong. Still, LSE cleaned up. I liked the blues bonus round, though sadly Leicester got none. Canadian mentions: WL Mackenzie King and Margaret Atwood. The best part was Roger Tilling saying "Leicester Lister!"
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛 第13场有点奇怪。莱斯特大学一直在开玩笑、浪费时间，始终没进入状态；而伦敦政治经济学院的队长则经常向离他最远的队员求助，但答案却常常是错的。尽管如此，伦敦政治经济学院还是轻松取胜了。我很喜欢那轮蓝调音乐附加题，可惜莱斯特大学一分未得。比赛中提到了加拿大的W·L·麦肯齐·金和玛格丽特·阿特伍德。最有意思的部分是主持人罗杰·蒂林喊出“莱斯特的利斯特！”

src_seg: Game 14 of #UniversityChallenge was top-notch stuff, solid quizzing, down to business, fast answers, good knowledge, close ending. It seems we'll see both SOAS London and St. Edmund Hall Oxford again, because the loser makes the repechage. Very close at the finish, down to "Naples" and "pollen." An unassumingly great game.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛 第14场绝对是顶级水准：答题扎实，直入正题，抢答迅速，知识渊博，结局紧张。看来我们还会再次见到伦敦大学亚非学院和牛津大学圣埃德蒙学堂，因为败者将进入复活赛。比赛最后非常胶着，胜负取决于“那不勒斯”和“花粉”这两个词。一场低调但精彩绝伦的比赛。

src_seg: Game 15 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of two in the repechage, where the four highest-scoring losing teams try to make it through. This week was UCL and St. Andrews, in a good-natured cheery match. Very strong play from UCL, who have a solid team, and UCL Mandel was in top form. Good questions, some tough, such as requiring "panthera" specifically or knowing "day" in Russian.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛 第15场是两场复活赛中的第一场，由四支落败队伍中得分最高的队伍争夺晋级名额。这周是伦敦大学学院对阵圣安德鲁斯大学，一场气氛友好愉快的比赛。伦敦大学学院发挥非常出色，他们团队实力雄厚，队里的曼德尔状态绝佳。题目出得很好，有些很难，比如要求答出“豹属”这个专有名词，或者知道俄语里的“天”。

src_seg: Just got to game 16 of #UniversityChallenge today, a week late, and it was a nail-biter! Really fast work at the end, with Durham coming from behind in the last few minutes to catch SOAS London in a tie in the final seconds. It went to a starter question that I got on the first clue (being an SF reader I knew "slipstream") but neither team knew. Second question and SOAS London Lambert guessed alpaca but it was llama, so Durham won. Phew, what a finish. 😰
tgt_seg: 今天才看#大学挑战赛 第16场，晚了一周，比赛真是惊心动魄！结尾部分节奏超快，杜伦大学在最后几分钟奋起直追，在最后几秒与伦敦大学亚非学院打成平手。比赛进入抢答决胜题。我（作为一名科幻小说读者）听到第一个线索就知道答案是“滑流”，但两队都不知道。第二道题，伦敦大学亚非学院的兰伯特猜了羊驼，但正确答案是美洲驼，所以杜伦大学赢了。呼，这结局太刺激了。😰

src_seg: Game 17 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of eight knockout games in the second round. This was UCL and LSE, and UCL gave an outstanding performance: very fast buzzing, good teamwork, wide general knowledge from them all (UCL Mandel notable again); they took off at the start and never slowed. Very impressive.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛 第17场是第二轮八场淘汰赛中的第一场。这场是伦敦大学学院对阵伦敦政治经济学院。伦敦大学学院的表现堪称卓越：抢答神速，团队协作默契，队员们知识面广博（队里的曼德尔再次表现抢眼）；他们从一开始就遥遥领先，并且从未放慢脚步。令人印象非常深刻。

src_seg: Game 18 of #UniversityChallenge was Durham vs Open University. I was rooting for Durham, who have a great team, but in the end to my surprise Open took it, after a number of rather slow answers. I was glad Durham got Marcel Duchamp right on one question; too bad no one knew Yoko Ono as a Fluxus artist. Much respect for Durham Nash, especially on bird silhouettes and flags.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛 第18场是杜伦大学对阵英国公开大学。我支持的是杜伦大学，他们是一支很棒的队伍，但最后英国公开大学在几次相当缓慢的作答后竟然赢了，让我很意外。很高兴杜伦大学答对了一道关于马塞尔·杜尚的题；可惜没人知道小野洋子是一位激浪派艺术家。非常敬佩杜伦大学的纳什，尤其是在鸟类剪影题和国旗题上的表现。

src_seg:
Game 19 of #UniversityChallenge was Exeter vs Bristol. Bristol got going at the start and never looked back, rolling with momentum, finishing with an incredible score. Exeter only clawed their way back to 0 after 17 minutes. 
I liked the question on common terms in Chinese place names, such as 北 (běi) in Beijing etc. Good geographic knowledge shown.
tgt_seg:
#大学挑战赛 第19场是埃克塞特大学对阵布里斯托大学。布里斯托大学从一开始就进入状态，一路高歌猛进，最终以惊人的高分结束比赛。埃克塞特大学在17分钟后才艰难地把分数追回到0分。
我很喜欢那道关于中国地名常用字的题，比如北京的“北”字等等。队员们展现了很好的地理知识。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge is back from the Christmas alumni series, and game 20 was liked greased lightening in comparison. Darwin Cambridge Whitaker tore into questions like a monster, but everyone was in good form on that team and also on Edinburgh. Momentum changed through the game. Good quizzing. Three more games in round two, then the long quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛 在圣诞校友赛后回归了，相比之下，第20场比赛快如闪电。剑桥大学达尔文学院的惠特克像怪兽一样疯狂答题，但他们队和爱丁堡大学队的所有队员状态都很好。比赛中势头几度转换。精彩的问答。第二轮还有三场比赛，然后就是漫长的四分之一决赛了。

src_seg: It's quite a change to go from the Christmas series of #UniversityChallenge, where four people didn't know the name of the narrator of Moby-Dick even when told his name is in the first sentence of the book, to the regular round, where they're racing to buzz on questions like "Fifty-three British thermal units is to grouse hunting as Sydney, Australia, is to what famous star of the London stage?"
tgt_seg: 从圣诞特别版的#大学挑战赛（四个队员在被告知《白鲸记》叙述者的名字就在书的第一句话里后，仍然答不出来）切换到常规赛，感觉变化真大。常规赛里，他们争相抢答的问题是这样的：“五十三英制热量单位之于松鸡狩猎，相当于澳大利亚的悉尼之于伦敦舞台上的哪位著名明星？”

src_seg:
Game 21 of #UniversityChallenge was Wadham Oxford vs Imperial. What a game! Astounding performance from Imperial. 
However, being King Crimson fan, I was disappointed that no one recognized them from the opening of "21st Century Schizoid Man," and dismayed when someone thought "I Zimbra" by Talking Heads (with Fripp on guitar) was by the Bee Gees. Can't have it all. I remain incredibly impressed.
tgt_seg:
#大学挑战赛 第21场是牛津大学沃德姆学院对阵帝国理工学院。多么精彩的比赛！帝国理工学院的表现惊为天人。
然而，作为绯红之王乐队的粉丝，我很失望竟然没人从《21世纪精神分裂者》的开场就认出他们，而当有人把传声头像乐队的《I Zimbra》（吉他手是弗里普）当成比吉斯乐队的歌时，我更是感到沮丧。人不能太贪心啊。但我仍然对他们的表现佩服得五体投地。

src_seg: Game 22 of #UniversityChallenge was Christ's Cambridge vs St Edmund Hall Oxford, two small colleges, but that's how the rules are set up.  Nice picture round with the Dunning-Kruger effect, Asch conformity experiments, and bouba-kiki effect.  Another on mushrooms, which seemed tough to me; identifying them by eye is not easy. Solid game, good playing all around.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛 第22场是剑桥大学基督学院对阵牛津大学圣埃德蒙学堂，两所都是小型学院，但规则就是如此。图片题很不错，涉及了邓宁-克鲁格效应、阿希从众实验和波巴/奇奇效应。还有一轮关于蘑菇的题，我觉得挺难的；用肉眼识别蘑菇可不容易。这是一场硬核的比赛，双方都发挥得很好。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. Nice flag knowledge, and a good picture round identifying physical laws by diagrams of experiments. A bit too much bantz for my taste, but a solid game. One more before the quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛 第23场是卡迪夫大学对阵贝尔法斯特女王大学。最终得分比我预想的要低，可能是因为错失了附加题得分，但抢答题的速度很快。队员们的国旗知识很棒，还有一轮很好的图片题，通过实验示意图来识别物理定律。对我来说，场上玩笑有点太多了，但仍是一场扎实的比赛。还有一场就到四分之一决赛了。

src_seg: Game 9 of #UniversityChallenge was a hell of a match. Oriel Oxford (530 students) vs Durham (20,000), and Oriel won, which surprised me after some mistakes they made. The captain didn't know Wittengstein's name!? Possibly just nerves. Durham was ahead, then it was tied at 170, then they dropped to 165. A pity. I was rooting for them. Great team, with all four strong, so I hope they make the cut.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第9场比赛精彩绝伦。牛津大学奥里尔学院（530名学生）对阵杜伦大学（20,000名学生），最终奥里尔学院获胜，这让我感到惊讶，因为他们之前犯了一些错误。队长居然不知道维特根斯坦的名字？！可能只是紧张了。杜伦大学一度领先，后来比分战平170分，最后又跌至165分。真遗憾。我一直在为他们加油。这是一支优秀的团队，四名成员都很强，希望他们能晋级。

src_seg:
Game 10 of #UniversityChallenge had a great performance by Christ's Cambridge, who have a consultative captain, a good team, and a strong member named Bethlehem, so Roger Tilling called out "Christ's Bethlehem!" Exeter Oxford never got hold of much, and are out of the running. I could see Christ's Cambridge quietly going far in this series. 
Some nice math questions, a picture round connected to food, and a tricky flag question. Good game.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第10场比赛中，剑桥大学基督学院表现出色，他们有一位善于协调的队长，团队合作默契，还有一位名叫伯利恒的强力成员，罗杰·蒂林甚至喊出了“基督学院的伯利恒！”牛津大学埃克塞特学院始终未能掌握主动权，已无缘晋级。我看好基督学院能在本系列比赛中走得更远。
本场比赛有几道不错的数学题，一轮图片题与食物相关，还有一道棘手的国旗题。精彩的比赛。

src_seg: Game 11 of #UniversityChallenge was St Andrews (granted university status by an antipope!) vs Cardiff. First round is nearing its end. Some good questions, including mentions of roll-on roll-of ferries, Agnes Martin, and Stax Records. Cardiff Tarsala will never forget her Booker T bloomer, I'm afraid. Nice quizzing from both teams, though it only really got cracking in the last few minutes.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第11场比赛是圣安德鲁斯大学（由一位对立教皇授予大学地位！）对阵卡迪夫大学。第一轮即将结束。有几道好题，包括提到滚装滚卸渡轮、阿格尼斯·马丁和Stax唱片公司。卡迪夫大学的塔萨拉恐怕永远忘不了她的布克·T失误。两支队伍都表现不错，不过比赛直到最后几分钟才真正激烈起来。

src_seg: Game 12 of #UniversityChallenge was Leeds vs Edinburgh. Leeds took a long time to get going, then had a surge in the middle but couldn't keep it going. Seemed like a number of film questions this time, and I was glad to hear PEI as an answer; no flags, though it seems like they crop up every time. Edinburgh Myles is a good captain and the whole team is strong and works well together. I think they'll do well.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第12场比赛是利兹大学对阵爱丁堡大学。利兹大学一开始进展缓慢，中间阶段有所起色，但未能保持势头。本场似乎有不少电影题，我很高兴听到爱德华王子岛作为答案；虽然没有国旗题，但似乎每次都会出现。爱丁堡大学的迈尔斯是一位优秀的队长，整个团队实力强劲，配合默契。我认为他们会表现不错。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 13 was a curious one, with Leicester being jokey, wasting time and never getting going, while the LSE captain would often turn to the farthest player for an answer, which was not infrequently wrong. Still, LSE cleaned up. I liked the blues bonus round, though sadly Leicester got none. Canadian mentions: WL Mackenzie King and Margaret Atwood. The best part was Roger Tilling saying "Leicester Lister!"
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第13场比赛颇为有趣，莱斯特大学队员开玩笑耽误时间，始终未能进入状态，而伦敦政治经济学院的队长则经常向最远处的队员询问答案，而这些答案往往是错误的。尽管如此，伦敦政治经济学院还是赢了。我喜欢蓝调加分题，尽管遗憾的是莱斯特大学一分未得。加拿大相关题目：WL麦肯齐·金和玛格丽特·阿特伍德。最精彩的部分是罗杰·蒂林说出“莱斯特·利斯特！”

src_seg: Game 14 of #UniversityChallenge was top-notch stuff, solid quizzing, down to business, fast answers, good knowledge, close ending. It seems we'll see both SOAS London and St. Edmund Hall Oxford again, because the loser makes the repechage. Very close at the finish, down to "Naples" and "pollen." An unassumingly great game.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第14场比赛表现出色，答题扎实，节奏紧凑，知识渊博，结局紧张。看来我们还会看到伦敦大学亚非学院和牛津大学圣埃德蒙学院的比赛，因为失败的一方将进入复活赛。比赛结束时比分非常接近，关键在于“拿破仑”和“花粉”。这是一场不显山露水的精彩比赛。

src_seg: Game 15 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of two in the repechage, where the four highest-scoring losing teams try to make it through. This week was UCL and St. Andrews, in a good-natured cheery match. Very strong play from UCL, who have a solid team, and UCL Mandel was in top form. Good questions, some tough, such as requiring "panthera" specifically or knowing "day" in Russian.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第15场比赛是复活赛的第一场，四支最高分的失败队伍争夺晋级资格。本周是伦敦大学学院和圣安德鲁斯大学的比赛，气氛轻松愉快。伦敦大学学院表现强势，团队实力雄厚，曼德尔表现尤为出色。题目设置不错，有些较难，比如需要具体回答“豹属”或知道俄语中的“day”。

src_seg: Just got to game 16 of #UniversityChallenge today, a week late, and it was a nail-biter! Really fast work at the end, with Durham coming from behind in the last few minutes to catch SOAS London in a tie in the final seconds. It went to a starter question that I got on the first clue (being an SF reader I knew "slipstream") but neither team knew. Second question and SOAS London Lambert guessed alpaca but it was llama, so Durham won. Phew, what a finish. 😰
tgt_seg: 今天才看完#UniversityChallenge 第16场比赛，晚了一周，这场比赛太刺激了！最后几分钟杜伦大学从后赶超，在最后时刻与伦敦大学亚非学院战平。比赛进入抢答题环节，我根据第一条线索就猜出了答案（作为科幻读者，我知道“slipstream”），但两支队伍都没答对。第二题时，伦敦大学亚非学院的兰伯特猜了羊驼，但正确答案是美洲驼，因此杜伦大学获胜。哇，太惊险了。😰

src_seg: Game 17 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of eight knockout games in the second round. This was UCL and LSE, and UCL gave an outstanding performance: very fast buzzing, good teamwork, wide general knowledge from them all (UCL Mandel notable again); they took off at the start and never slowed. Very impressive.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第17场比赛是第二轮淘汰赛的第一场。伦敦大学学院对阵伦敦政治经济学院，伦敦大学学院表现出色：抢答速度极快，团队配合默契，知识面广（曼德尔再次表现突出）；他们一开始就领先，从未放缓脚步。非常令人印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 18 of #UniversityChallenge was Durham vs Open University. I was rooting for Durham, who have a great team, but in the end to my surprise Open took it, after a number of rather slow answers. I was glad Durham got Marcel Duchamp right on one question; too bad no one knew Yoko Ono as a Fluxus artist. Much respect for Durham Nash, especially on bird silhouettes and flags.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第18场比赛是杜伦大学对阵英国开放大学。我一直在为杜伦大学加油，他们是一支优秀的团队，但最终出乎意料的是开放大学获胜，尽管他们回答问题的速度较慢。我很高兴杜伦大学在一道题中正确回答了马塞尔·杜尚；遗憾的是，没有人知道小野洋子是Fluxus艺术家。我非常尊敬杜伦大学的纳什，尤其是在鸟类剪影和国旗题上的表现。

src_seg:
Game 19 of #UniversityChallenge was Exeter vs Bristol. Bristol got going at the start and never looked back, rolling with momentum, finishing with an incredible score. Exeter only clawed their way back to 0 after 17 minutes. 
I liked the question on common terms in Chinese place names, such as 北 (běi) in Beijing etc. Good geographic knowledge shown.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第19场比赛是埃克塞特大学对阵布里斯托尔大学。布里斯托尔大学一开始就占据优势，并保持势头，最终以令人难以置信的高分获胜。埃克塞特大学直到17分钟后才勉强得分。
我喜欢关于中国地名中常见术语的题目，比如北京的“北”（běi）等。展现了不错的地理知识。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge is back from the Christmas alumni series, and game 20 was liked greased lightening in comparison. Darwin Cambridge Whitaker tore into questions like a monster, but everyone was in good form on that team and also on Edinburgh. Momentum changed through the game. Good quizzing. Three more games in round two, then the long quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 在圣诞校友系列赛后回归，第20场比赛的节奏明显加快。剑桥大学达尔文学院的惠特克如猛兽般狂答问题，但整个团队都表现出色，爱丁堡大学也不遑多让。比赛中的势头多次变化。精彩的答题表现。第二轮还有三场比赛，然后是漫长的四分之一决赛。

src_seg: It's quite a change to go from the Christmas series of #UniversityChallenge, where four people didn't know the name of the narrator of Moby-Dick even when told his name is in the first sentence of the book, to the regular round, where they're racing to buzz on questions like "Fifty-three British thermal units is to grouse hunting as Sydney, Australia, is to what famous star of the London stage?"
tgt_seg: 从#UniversityChallenge 的圣诞系列赛，其中四位选手甚至在被告知《白鲸记》叙述者的名字出现在书的第一句话时仍不知道，到常规赛，选手们争相抢答诸如“五十三个英国热量单位之于松鸡狩猎，如同澳大利亚悉尼之于伦敦舞台上哪位著名明星？”这样的问题，这种转变相当明显。

src_seg:
Game 21 of #UniversityChallenge was Wadham Oxford vs Imperial. What a game! Astounding performance from Imperial. 
However, being King Crimson fan, I was disappointed that no one recognized them from the opening of "21st Century Schizoid Man," and dismayed when someone thought "I Zimbra" by Talking Heads (with Fripp on guitar) was by the Bee Gees. Can't have it all. I remain incredibly impressed.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第21场比赛是牛津大学沃德姆学院对阵帝国理工学院。精彩的比赛！帝国理工学院表现惊艳。
不过，作为King Crimson乐队的粉丝，我对没有人能从《21世纪精神分裂症》的开头认出他们感到失望，更糟的是，有人竟然认为Talking Heads的《I Zimbra》（弗里普担任吉他手）是Bee Gees的作品。不过，整体表现仍然令人印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 22 of #UniversityChallenge was Christ's Cambridge vs St Edmund Hall Oxford, two small colleges, but that's how the rules are set up.  Nice picture round with the Dunning-Kruger effect, Asch conformity experiments, and bouba-kiki effect.  Another on mushrooms, which seemed tough to me; identifying them by eye is not easy. Solid game, good playing all around.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第22场比赛是剑桥大学基督学院对阵牛津大学圣埃德蒙学院，两所规模较小的学院，但这就是比赛规则。图片题不错，涉及邓宁-克鲁格效应、阿施从众实验和布巴-基基效应。另一道关于蘑菇的题目对我来说似乎很难；仅凭外观识别蘑菇并不容易。扎实的比赛，双方表现都很出色。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. Nice flag knowledge, and a good picture round identifying physical laws by diagrams of experiments. A bit too much bantz for my taste, but a solid game. One more before the quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第23场比赛是卡迪夫大学对阵贝尔法斯特女王大学。最终得分比我预期的要低，可能是因为加分题未能得分，但抢答题回答得很快。国旗知识题不错，图片题通过实验图示识别物理定律也很精彩。玩笑有点多，但整体是一场扎实的比赛。再有一场比赛，四分之一决赛就要开始了。

我喜欢有关中国地名常见术语的问题，例如北（běi）在北京等处。显示了很好的地理知识。

tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛回来了，从圣诞节的大学挑战赛系列中，四个人甚至不知道《摩比鲨》的导演的名字，即使告诉他们名字在书首一句。然而，在正常轮次中，他们正在竞争地点击问题，例如“53英文热量单位与猎鸡狩猎相当于悉尼，澳大利亚与哪个著名的伦敦舞台明星？”

src_seg:
Game 21 of #UniversityChallenge was Wadham Oxford vs Imperial. What a game! Astounding performance from Imperial. 
However, being King Crimson fan, I was disappointed that no one recognized them from the opening of "21st Century Schizoid Man," and dismayed when someone thought "I Zimbra" by Talking Heads (with Fripp on guitar) was by the Bee Gees. Can't have it all. I remain incredibly impressed.
tgt_seg:
#大学挑战赛第21场是伍德姆大学与帝国大学比赛。这是一场非常出色的比赛！帝国大学的表现非常出色。
然而，作为金吾奏乐队的粉丝，我很失望，因为没有人认出他们从“21世纪荒谬男子”的开头。我也很失望，因为有人认为“I Zimbra”（Talking Heads，Fripp在吉他上演奏）是由蝙蝠兄弟演唱。不能有一切。我非常感激。

src_seg: Game 22 of #UniversityChallenge was Christ's Cambridge vs St Edmund Hall Oxford, two small colleges, but that's how the rules are set up.  Nice picture round with the Dunning-Kruger effect, Asch conformity experiments, and bouba-kiki effect.  Another on mushrooms, which seemed tough to me; identifying them by eye is not easy. Solid game, good playing all around.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第22场是克里斯特大学伦敦与圣埃玛顿大学柏林比赛，两个小学院，但这是规则的设置。有一个有趣的图片轮，包括愚蠢效应、Asch 遵从实验和布巴-基基效应。另一个关于蘑菇的，对我来说似乎很难，通过眼睛识别蘑菇并不容易。这是一个不错的比赛，整体表现都很好。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. Nice flag knowledge, and a good picture round identifying physical laws by diagrams of experiments. A bit too much bantz for my taste, but a solid game. One more before the quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第23场是卡迪夫比赛卡迪夫大学。结束得比我想象的低，可能是因为错过了奖励，但开始很快点击。有一些不错的国旗知识，还有一个好的图片轮，通过实验图表识别物理法则。有点多余的嘲笑，但是一个不错的比赛。还有一个比赛，接下来是四分之一决赛。

src_seg: Game 9 of #UniversityChallenge was a hell of a match. Oriel Oxford (530 students) vs Durham (20,000), and Oriel won, which surprised me after some mistakes they made. The captain didn't know Wittengstein's name!? Possibly just nerves. Durham was ahead, then it was tied at 170, then they dropped to 165. A pity. I was rooting for them. Great team, with all four strong, so I hope they make the cut.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第九场比赛真是场精彩的对决。奥里尔牛津（530名学生）对阵达勒姆（20,000名学生），最终奥里尔获胜，这让我感到惊讶，因为他们之前犯了一些错误。队长居然不知道维特根斯坦的名字？可能是因为紧张。达勒姆一开始领先，然后双方打成170平，但达勒姆后来跌至165分。真是遗憾。我一直在为他们加油。这是一支很棒的队伍，四位队员都很强，所以我希望他们能晋级。

src_seg:
Game 10 of #UniversityChallenge had a great performance by Christ's Cambridge, who have a consultative captain, a good team, and a strong member named Bethlehem, so Roger Tilling called out "Christ's Bethlehem!" Exeter Oxford never got hold of much, and are out of the running. I could see Christ's Cambridge quietly going far in this series. 
Some nice math questions, a picture round connected to food, and a tricky flag question. Good game.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第十场比赛，基督圣体学院剑桥表现出色，他们的队长很有决策力，队伍整体实力强，还有名为伯利恒的强力队员，所以罗杰·蒂林喊出了“基督圣体学院的伯利恒！”埃克塞特牛津一直没什么作为，已经被淘汰。我认为基督圣体学院剑桥在这轮比赛中会悄悄走得很远。
有些不错的数学题，一轮与食物相关的图片题，还有一道关于国旗的难题。精彩的比赛。

src_seg: Game 11 of #UniversityChallenge was St Andrews (granted university status by an antipope!) vs Cardiff. First round is nearing its end. Some good questions, including mentions of roll-on roll-of ferries, Agnes Martin, and Stax Records. Cardiff Tarsala will never forget her Booker T bloomer, I'm afraid. Nice quizzing from both teams, though it only really got cracking in the last few minutes.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第十一场比赛是圣安德鲁斯（由一位对立教宗授予大学地位）对阵卡迪夫。第一轮即将结束。有些不错的问题，包括提到滚装滚卸渡轮、艾格尼丝·马丁和Stax唱片公司。卡迪夫的塔萨拉恐怕永远不会忘记她在布克·T上的失误。两队都表现出色，尽管只有在最后几分钟才真正进入状态。

src_seg: Game 12 of #UniversityChallenge was Leeds vs Edinburgh. Leeds took a long time to get going, then had a surge in the middle but couldn't keep it going. Seemed like a number of film questions this time, and I was glad to hear PEI as an answer; no flags, though it seems like they crop up every time. Edinburgh Myles is a good captain and the whole team is strong and works well together. I think they'll do well.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第十二场比赛是利兹对阵爱丁堡。利兹花了很长时间才进入状态，中间有一波高潮，但没能保持下去。这次似乎有很多电影相关的问题，我很高兴听到“PEI”作为答案；没有国旗题，尽管它们似乎每次都会出现。爱丁堡的迈尔斯是一位出色的队长，整个队伍实力强劲，配合默契。我认为他们会表现得很好。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 13 was a curious one, with Leicester being jokey, wasting time and never getting going, while the LSE captain would often turn to the farthest player for an answer, which was not infrequently wrong. Still, LSE cleaned up. I liked the blues bonus round, though sadly Leicester got none. Canadian mentions: WL Mackenzie King and Margaret Atwood. The best part was Roger Tilling saying "Leicester Lister!"
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第十三场比赛很有趣，莱斯特在开玩笑，浪费时间，一直没进入状态，而LSE的队长经常转向最远的队员寻求答案，而且经常答错。尽管如此，LSE还是轻松获胜。我喜欢蓝调加分轮，尽管莱斯特一分未得。加拿大相关题目：威廉·莱昂·麦肯齐·金和玛格丽特·阿特伍德。最精彩的部分是罗杰·蒂林喊出“莱斯特的李斯特！”

src_seg: Game 14 of #UniversityChallenge was top-notch stuff, solid quizzing, down to business, fast answers, good knowledge, close ending. It seems we'll see both SOAS London and St. Edmund Hall Oxford again, because the loser makes the repechage. Very close at the finish, down to "Naples" and "pollen." An unassumingly great game.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第十四场比赛是顶级对决，问题扎实，直奔主题，答案迅速，知识丰富，结局紧张。看起来我们还会看到SOAS伦敦和圣埃德蒙堂牛津，因为败者有复活赛机会。结束时非常接近，最终答案是“那不勒斯”和“花粉”。一场不显山露水但非常精彩的比赛。

src_seg: Game 15 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of two in the repechage, where the four highest-scoring losing teams try to make it through. This week was UCL and St. Andrews, in a good-natured cheery match. Very strong play from UCL, who have a solid team, and UCL Mandel was in top form. Good questions, some tough, such as requiring "panthera" specifically or knowing "day" in Russian.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第十五场比赛是复活赛的第一场，四支得分最高的败者队伍试图晋级。本周是UCL对阵圣安德鲁斯，是一场轻松愉快的比赛。UCL表现非常强劲，队伍扎实，UCL的曼德尔状态极佳。问题不错，有些很难，比如要求具体回答“panthera”或知道俄语中的“day”。

src_seg: Just got to game 16 of #UniversityChallenge today, a week late, and it was a nail-biter! Really fast work at the end, with Durham coming from behind in the last few minutes to catch SOAS London in a tie in the final seconds. It went to a starter question that I got on the first clue (being an SF reader I knew "slipstream") but neither team knew. Second question and SOAS London Lambert guessed alpaca but it was llama, so Durham won. Phew, what a finish. 😰
tgt_seg: 今天刚看完#UniversityChallenge 第十六场比赛，比原定时间晚了一周，这场比赛真是紧张刺激！最后几分钟双方速度飞快，达勒姆在最后几分钟后来居上，在最后几秒与SOAS伦敦打成平手。进入加时赛，我在第一个线索就猜对了（作为科幻读者，我知道“slipstream”），但两队都没答对。第二个问题，SOAS伦敦的兰伯特猜的是羊驼，但正确答案是骆马，所以达勒姆获胜。唉，真是惊心动魄的结局。😰

src_seg: Game 17 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of eight knockout games in the second round. This was UCL and LSE, and UCL gave an outstanding performance: very fast buzzing, good teamwork, wide general knowledge from them all (UCL Mandel notable again); they took off at the start and never slowed. Very impressive.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第十七场比赛是第二轮淘汰赛的第一场。这是UCL对阵LSE，UCL表现出色：抢答迅速，团队合作良好，所有队员的常识都很广泛（UCL的曼德尔再次表现突出）；他们从一开始就领先，从未放慢脚步。非常令人印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 18 of #UniversityChallenge was Durham vs Open University. I was rooting for Durham, who have a great team, but in the end to my surprise Open took it, after a number of rather slow answers. I was glad Durham got Marcel Duchamp right on one question; too bad no one knew Yoko Ono as a Fluxus artist. Much respect for Durham Nash, especially on bird silhouettes and flags.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第十八场比赛是达勒姆对阵开放大学。我为达勒姆加油，他们是一支很棒的队伍，但出人意料的是，开放大学在多次缓慢回答后获胜。我很高兴达勒姆在一道题目上正确回答了马塞尔·杜尚；遗憾的是，没有人知道小野洋子是Fluxus艺术家。我非常尊重达勒姆的纳什，尤其是在鸟类剪影和国旗题目上。

src_seg:
Game 19 of #UniversityChallenge was Exeter vs Bristol. Bristol got going at the start and never looked back, rolling with momentum, finishing with an incredible score. Exeter only clawed their way back to 0 after 17 minutes. 
I liked the question on common terms in Chinese place names, such as 北 (běi) in Beijing etc. Good geographic knowledge shown.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第十九场比赛是埃克塞特对阵布里斯托。布里斯托从一开始就领先，从未回头，势如破竹，最终得分惊人。埃克塞特在17分钟后才将比分追至0。
我喜欢关于中文地名常见词的问题，比如北京的“北”等。展示了良好的地理知识。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge is back from the Christmas alumni series, and game 20 was liked greased lightening in comparison. Darwin Cambridge Whitaker tore into questions like a monster, but everyone was in good form on that team and also on Edinburgh. Momentum changed through the game. Good quizzing. Three more games in round two, then the long quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 从圣诞校友赛回归，第二十场比赛相比之下就像润滑过的闪电。达尔文学院剑桥的惠特克像怪物一样撕裂问题，但两队所有队员都状态极佳。比赛过程中势头不断变化。精彩的抢答。第二轮还有三场比赛，然后是漫长的四分之一决赛。

src_seg: It's quite a change to go from the Christmas series of #UniversityChallenge, where four people didn't know the name of the narrator of Moby-Dick even when told his name is in the first sentence of the book, to the regular round, where they're racing to buzz on questions like "Fifty-three British thermal units is to grouse hunting as Sydney, Australia, is to what famous star of the London stage?"

tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第二十一场比赛是沃德姆牛津对阵帝国理工学院。精彩的比赛！帝国理工学院表现惊人。

tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第二十三场比赛是卡迪夫对阵贝尔法斯特女王大学。最终得分比我预期的要低，可能是因为错失了加分机会，但抢答启动题速度很快。不错的国旗知识，以及通过实验图识别物理定律的图片轮。对我来说，玩笑有点过多，但整体比赛扎实。还有一场比赛就进入四分之一决赛了。
