Good questions, some tough, such as requiring "panthera" specifically or knowing "day" in Russian.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛的第15场比赛是复赛的两场比赛中的第一场，四支得分最高的失利队伍将争夺晋级机会。本周的比赛是UCL和圣安德鲁斯，这是一场友好的、充满活力的比赛。UCL表现非常出色，他们拥有一支实力强劲的队伍，UCL的曼德尔也状态极佳。问题也很棒，有些难度较高，例如需要具体回答“panthera”或知道俄语中的“白天”。

src_seg: Just got to game 16 of #UniversityChallenge today, a week late, and it was a nail-biter! Really fast work at the end, with Durham coming from behind in the last few minutes to catch SOAS London in a tie in the final seconds. It went to a starter question that I got on the first clue (being an SF reader I knew "slipstream") but neither team knew. Second question and SOAS London Lambert guessed alpaca but it was llama, so Durham won. Phew, what a finish. 😰
tgt_seg: 今天终于赶上了#大学挑战赛的第16场比赛，比原定时间晚了一周，真是惊险刺激！在最后几分钟，达勒姆大学从落后中奋起直追，在最后几秒与伦敦SOAS大学打成平局。比赛进入了第一轮问题，我根据第一条线索猜对了“流派”（slipstream），但两队都没有猜对。第二轮问题时，伦敦SOAS大学的兰伯特猜了“羊驼”，但答案是“美洲驼”，因此达勒姆大学获胜。哎呀，真是个惊险的结局。😰

src_seg: Game 17 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of eight knockout games in the second round. This was UCL and LSE, and UCL gave an outstanding performance: very fast buzzing, good teamwork, wide general knowledge from them all (UCL Mandel notable again); they took off at the start and never slowed. Very impressive.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛的第17场比赛是第二轮的八场淘汰赛中的第一场。这场比赛是UCL和LSE之间的对决，UCL表现出色：反应迅速，团队合作良好，所有队员都展现了广泛的常识（UCL的曼德尔再次表现突出）；他们在比赛开始时就占据了优势，并且始终保持领先。非常令人印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 18 of #UniversityChallenge was Durham vs Open University. I was rooting for Durham, who have a great team, but in the end to my surprise Open took it, after a number of rather slow answers. I was glad Durham got Marcel Duchamp right on one question; too bad no one knew Yoko Ono as a Fluxus artist. Much respect for Durham Nash, especially on bird silhouettes and flags.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛的第18场比赛是杜伦大学对阵开放大学。我支持杜伦大学，他们有一支很棒的队伍，但最终令我惊讶的是，开放大学赢了，尽管他们给出了一些相当慢的答案。我很高兴杜伦大学在其中一个问题中正确回答了关于马塞尔·杜尚的问题；可惜没有人知道小野洋子是弗卢克斯艺术家。对杜伦大学的纳什先生致以敬意，尤其是在鸟类剪影和旗帜方面。

src_seg:
Game 19 of #UniversityChallenge was Exeter vs Bristol. Bristol got going at the start and never looked back, rolling with momentum, finishing with an incredible score. Exeter only clawed their way back to 0 after 17 minutes. 
I liked the question on common terms in Chinese place names, such as 北 (běi) in Beijing etc. Good geographic knowledge shown.
tgt_seg:
#大学挑战赛第19场比赛是埃克塞特与布里斯托尔的对决。布里斯托尔在比赛开始时就占据了优势，一路上势如破竹，最终取得了令人难以置信的分数。埃克塞特在17分钟后才勉强追回至0分。
我喜欢关于中国地名中常见术语的问题，比如北京中的“北”（běi）等。展现了良好的地理知识。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge is back from the Christmas alumni series, and game 20 was liked greased lightening in comparison. Darwin Cambridge Whitaker tore into questions like a monster, but everyone was in good form on that team and also on Edinburgh. Momentum changed through the game. Good quizzing. Three more games in round two, then the long quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战回来了，从圣诞校友系列之后，第20场比赛简直像闪电般迅速。达尔文·剑桥·惠特克像怪物一样猛攻问题，但那支队伍的每个人都表现出色，爱丁堡队也一样。比赛过程中，势头不断变化。这是一场精彩的问答比赛。接下来还有三场第二轮的比赛，然后是漫长的四分之一决赛。

src_seg: It's quite a change to go from the Christmas series of #UniversityChallenge, where four people didn't know the name of the narrator of Moby-Dick even when told his name is in the first sentence of the book, to the regular round, where they're racing to buzz on questions like "Fifty-three British thermal units is to grouse hunting as Sydney, Australia, is to what famous star of the London stage?"
tgt_seg: 从#大学挑战（#UniversityChallenge）的圣诞特辑，那里有四个人连莫比·迪克（Moby-Dick）的叙述者名字都不知道，即使告诉他们这个名字就在书的第一句话里，到常规环节，他们争先恐后地抢答诸如“53个英国热量单位与野鸡狩猎的关系，就像悉尼（澳大利亚）与伦敦舞台上的哪位著名明星有关？”这样的问题，这确实是一个很大的转变。

src_seg:
Game 21 of #UniversityChallenge was Wadham Oxford vs Imperial. What a game! Astounding performance from Imperial. 
However, being King Crimson fan, I was disappointed that no one recognized them from the opening of "21st Century Schizoid Man," and dismayed when someone thought "I Zimbra" by Talking Heads (with Fripp on guitar) was by the Bee Gees. Can't have it all. I remain incredibly impressed.
tgt_seg:
#大学挑战赛的第21场比赛是牛津瓦德姆学院对阵帝国学院。真是精彩的一场比赛！帝国学院的表现令人惊叹。
然而，作为King Crimson的粉丝，我感到失望的是，没有人从“21世纪精神分裂者”的开场音乐中认出他们，而且当有人把Talking Heads的“I Zimbra”（弗里普在吉他上演奏）误认为是Bee Gees的歌曲时，我更是感到沮丧。有些事情是无法兼顾的。我仍然对他们的表现印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 22 of #UniversityChallenge was Christ's Cambridge vs St Edmund Hall Oxford, two small colleges, but that's how the rules are set up.  Nice picture round with the Dunning-Kruger effect, Asch conformity experiments, and bouba-kiki effect.  Another on mushrooms, which seemed tough to me; identifying them by eye is not easy. Solid game, good playing all around.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛的第22场比赛是剑桥基督学院对阵牛津圣爱德蒙霍尔学院，两所规模较小的学院，但这就是比赛规则的设置方式。一个不错的图片环节，涉及了邓宁-克鲁格效应、阿什从众实验和布巴-基基效应。还有一个关于蘑菇的环节，对我来说似乎很困难；仅凭肉眼识别它们并不容易。这是一场精彩的比赛，各方面表现都很好。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. Nice flag knowledge, and a good picture round identifying physical laws by diagrams of experiments. A bit too much bantz for my taste, but a solid game. One more before the quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第23场是卡迪夫对阵贝尔法斯特女王大学。最终得分低于我预期的水平，也许是因为错过了很多奖金问题，但开场问题回答速度很快。对国旗的知识掌握得不错，而且在通过实验图示识别物理定律的环节中表现出色。有点太多的玩笑和调侃，不过这是一场不错的比赛。在四分之一决赛之前还有一场比赛。

src_seg: Game 9 of #UniversityChallenge was a hell of a match. Oriel Oxford (530 students) vs Durham (20,000), and Oriel won, which surprised me after some mistakes they made. The captain didn't know Wittengstein's name!? Possibly just nerves. Durham was ahead, then it was tied at 170, then they dropped to 165. A pity. I was rooting for them. Great team, with all four strong, so I hope they make the cut.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第9场 是一场精彩的比赛。奥利尔牛津（530名学生）对阵杜伦大学（20,000名学生），奥利尔牛津获胜，这让我有些惊讶，因为他们之前犯了一些错误。队长竟然不知道维特根斯坦的名字？可能是紧张。杜伦大学一度领先，然后比分被扳成170平，之后又跌至165。真可惜。我为他们加油。这是一个很棒的团队，每个人都很强，所以我希望他们能晋级。

src_seg:
Game 10 of #UniversityChallenge had a great performance by Christ's Cambridge, who have a consultative captain, a good team, and a strong member named Bethlehem, so Roger Tilling called out "Christ's Bethlehem!" Exeter Oxford never got hold of much, and are out of the running. I could see Christ's Cambridge quietly going far in this series. 
Some nice math questions, a picture round connected to food, and a tricky flag question. Good game.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第10场，基督学院剑桥表现出色，他们有一位咨询型队长，一个很强的队员贝利恒，所以罗杰·蒂林喊出了“基督学院贝利恒！”埃克塞特牛津几乎没有机会，已经出局。我能看出基督学院剑桥在这个系列赛中会悄悄走得很远。有些不错的数学题，一个与食物有关的图片轮，以及一个棘手的国旗问题。真是一场好比赛。

src_seg: Game 11 of #UniversityChallenge was St Andrews (granted university status by an antipope!) vs Cardiff. First round is nearing its end. Some good questions, including mentions of roll-on roll-of ferries, Agnes Martin, and Stax Records. Cardiff Tarsala will never forget her Booker T bloomer, I'm afraid. Nice quizzing from both teams, though it only really got cracking in the last few minutes.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第11场 是圣安德鲁斯大学（被反教宗授予大学地位！）对阵卡迪夫大学。第一轮即将结束。有些不错的题目，包括滚轮渡轮、阿格尼斯·马丁和Stax唱片。卡迪夫塔尔萨永远忘不了她的博克特·布洛，我恐怕是这样。两支队伍都表现得很好，但真正开始激烈竞争是在最后几分钟。

src_seg: Game 12 of #UniversityChallenge was Leeds vs Edinburgh. Leeds took a long time to get going, then had a surge in the middle but couldn't keep it going. Seemed like a number of film questions this time, and I was glad to hear PEI as an answer; no flags, though it seems like they crop up every time. Edinburgh Myles is a good captain and the whole team is strong and works well together. I think they'll do well.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第12场 是利兹大学对阵爱丁堡大学。利兹大学一开始进展缓慢，然后在中间有一波爆发，但没能持续。这次似乎有很多电影题目，我很高兴听到有人答对了PEI；没有国旗题，但似乎每次都有。爱丁堡迈尔斯是一位很好的队长，整个团队都很强，配合得很好。我认为他们会做得很好。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 13 was a curious one, with Leicester being jokey, wasting time and never getting going, while the LSE captain would often turn to the farthest player for an answer, which was not infrequently wrong. Still, LSE cleaned up. I liked the blues bonus round, though sadly Leicester got none. Canadian mentions: WL Mackenzie King and Margaret Atwood. The best part was Roger Tilling saying "Leicester Lister!"
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第13场 是一个有趣的比赛，莱斯特大学开起了玩笑，浪费时间，始终没有进入状态，而LSE的队长经常转向最远的队员作答，这并不总是正确的。尽管如此，LSE还是表现得很出色。我喜欢蓝调加时赛，可惜莱斯特没有得分。加拿大提及：威灵顿·麦肯齐·金和玛格丽特·阿特伍德。最精彩的部分是罗杰·蒂林说“莱斯特·利斯特！”

src_seg: Game 14 of #UniversityChallenge was top-notch stuff, solid quizzing, down to business, fast answers, good knowledge, close ending. It seems we'll see both SOAS London and St. Edmund Hall Oxford again, because the loser makes the repechage. Very close at the finish, down to "Naples" and "pollen." An unassumingly great game.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第14场 是顶级比赛，扎实的题目，认真作答，快速回答，良好的知识，接近尾声。似乎我们会再次看到SOAS伦敦和圣埃德蒙学院牛津，因为失败者将进入重赛。比赛非常接近，最后是“那不勒斯”和“花粉”。一场低调而精彩的比赛。

src_seg: Game 15 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of two in the repechage, where the four highest-scoring losing teams try to make it through. Good questions, some tough, such as requiring "panthera" specifically or knowing "day" in Russian.

有几道不错的数学题，一轮与食物有关的图片题，还有一道棘手的国旗题。比赛很精彩

src_seg: Game 11 of #UniversityChallenge was St Andrews (granted university status by an antipope!) vs Cardiff. First round is nearing its end. Some good questions, including mentions of roll-on roll-of ferries, Agnes Martin, and Stax Records. Cardiff Tarsala will never forget her Booker T bloomer, I'm afraid. Nice quizzing from both teams, though it only really got cracking in the last few minutes.
tgt_seg: 大学挑战赛#的第 11 场比赛是圣安德鲁斯（由反教皇授予大学地位！）对阵卡迪夫。第一轮比赛接近尾声。有些问题问得很好，其中提到了滚装轮渡、阿格尼丝-马丁和斯塔克斯唱片。卡迪夫-塔萨拉恐怕永远也忘不了她的布克-T-布卢姆。两支队伍的问答都很精彩，不过最后几分钟才真正进入状态。

src_seg: Game 12 of #UniversityChallenge was Leeds vs Edinburgh. Leeds took a long time to get going, then had a surge in the middle but couldn't keep it going. Seemed like a number of film questions this time, and I was glad to hear PEI as an answer; no flags, though it seems like they crop up every time. Edinburgh Myles is a good captain and the whole team is strong and works well together. I think they'll do well.
tgt_seg: 大学挑战赛#第 12 场由利兹队对阵爱丁堡队。利兹队花了很长时间才进入状态，然后在中段有一波高潮，但未能保持下去。这次似乎有很多电影问题，我很高兴听到 PEI 的回答；没有旗帜，虽然似乎每次都会出现。Edinburgh Myles 是一位优秀的队长，整个团队都很强大，配合默契。我认为他们会做得很好。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 13 was a curious one, with Leicester being jokey, wasting time and never getting going, while the LSE captain would often turn to the farthest player for an answer, which was not infrequently wrong. Still, LSE cleaned up. I liked the blues bonus round, though sadly Leicester got none. Canadian mentions: WL Mackenzie King and Margaret Atwood. The best part was Roger Tilling saying "Leicester Lister!"
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge#第13场比赛很奇特，莱斯特队很爱开玩笑，浪费时间，一直没有进入状态，而伦敦政治经济学院的队长经常会向最远的队员寻求答案，而答案往往是错误的。尽管如此，莱斯特还是胜出了。我喜欢蓝军的红利回合，但遗憾的是莱斯特没有得到红利。加拿大人：WL Mackenzie King和Margaret Atwood。最精彩的部分是罗杰-蒂林说："莱斯特-李斯特！"

src_seg: Game 14 of #UniversityChallenge was top-notch stuff, solid quizzing, down to business, fast answers, good knowledge, close ending. It seems we'll see both SOAS London and St. Edmund Hall Oxford again, because the loser makes the repechage. Very close at the finish, down to "Naples" and "pollen." An unassumingly great game.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛#第 14 场比赛堪称一流，问答扎实，切中要害，回答迅速，知识面广，结局接近。看来我们将再次见到伦敦 SOAS 和牛津圣埃德蒙堂，因为输的一方将进入复赛。最后的比分非常接近，只差 "那不勒斯 "和 "花粉"。一场毫不张扬的精彩比赛。

src_seg: Game 15 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of two in the repechage, where the four highest-scoring losing teams try to make it through. This week was UCL and St. Andrews, in a good-natured cheery match. Very strong play from UCL, who have a solid team, and UCL Mandel was in top form. Good questions, some tough, such as requiring "panthera" specifically or knowing "day" in Russian.
tgt_seg: 大学挑战赛#第15场比赛是复赛两场比赛中的第一场，四支得分最高的败队将力争晋级。本周是 UCL 与圣安德鲁斯队的比赛，这是一场友好欢快的比赛。UCL 的发挥非常出色，他们拥有一支实力雄厚的队伍，而 UCL 的曼德尔也表现出了最佳状态。问题很好，但也有一些难题，例如要求具体说出 "panthera "或知道俄语中的 "day"。

src_seg: Just got to game 16 of #UniversityChallenge today, a week late, and it was a nail-biter! Really fast work at the end, with Durham coming from behind in the last few minutes to catch SOAS London in a tie in the final seconds. It went to a starter question that I got on the first clue (being an SF reader I knew "slipstream") but neither team knew. Second question and SOAS London Lambert guessed alpaca but it was llama, so Durham won. Phew, what a finish. 😰
tgt_seg: 今天刚刚进行了 #UniversityChallenge 的第 16 场比赛，晚了一周，但比赛非常精彩！最后几分钟，杜伦大学在落后的情况下奋起直追，在最后几秒钟追平了伦敦 SOAS 大学。比赛进行到一个起始问题，我得到了第一条线索（作为 SF 读者，我知道 "sipstream"），但两队都不知道。第二题，SOAS 伦敦分校的兰伯特猜是羊驼，但其实是美洲驼，所以杜伦队赢了。呼，真是个完美的结局。😰

src_seg: Game 17 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of eight knockout games in the second round. This was UCL and LSE, and UCL gave an outstanding performance: very fast buzzing, good teamwork, wide general knowledge from them all (UCL Mandel notable again); they took off at the start and never slowed. Very impressive.
tgt_seg: 大学挑战赛 #UniversityChallenge 第 17 场比赛是第二轮八场淘汰赛中的第一场。这场比赛由 UCL 和 LSE 对决，UCL 表现出色：他们的反应很快，团队合作很好，知识面很广（UCL 的 Mandel 又一次表现突出）；他们一开始就起跑，从未放慢过速度。令人印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 18 of #UniversityChallenge was Durham vs Open University. I was rooting for Durham, who have a great team, but in the end to my surprise Open took it, after a number of rather slow answers. I was glad Durham got Marcel Duchamp right on one question; too bad no one knew Yoko Ono as a Fluxus artist. Much respect for Durham Nash, especially on bird silhouettes and flags.
tgt_seg: 大学挑战赛#第 18 场比赛是杜伦大学对阵开放大学。我为杜伦大学加油，因为他们拥有一支出色的队伍，但最后出乎我意料的是，开放大学在几次慢吞吞的答题后拿下了比赛。我很高兴杜伦在一个问题上答对了马塞尔-杜尚；可惜没有人知道小野洋子是一位激浪派艺术家。我非常敬佩杜伦-纳什，尤其是在鸟的剪影和旗帜方面。

src_seg:
Game 19 of #UniversityChallenge was Exeter vs Bristol. Bristol got going at the start and never looked back, rolling with momentum, finishing with an incredible score. Exeter only clawed their way back to 0 after 17 minutes. 
I liked the question on common terms in Chinese place names, such as 北 (běi) in Beijing etc. Good geographic knowledge shown.
tgt_seg:
大学挑战赛#第19场比赛由埃克塞特对阵布里斯托尔。布里斯托尔队一开始就势如破竹，一往无前，最终以令人难以置信的比分结束了比赛。埃克塞特在 17 分钟后才将比分扳回为 0。
我很喜欢关于中国地名中的常见术语的问题，如北京的北（běi）等。很好地体现了地理知识。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge is back from the Christmas alumni series, and game 20 was liked greased lightening in comparison. Darwin Cambridge Whitaker tore into questions like a monster, but everyone was in good form on that team and also on Edinburgh. Momentum changed through the game. Good quizzing. Three more games in round two, then the long quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge#从圣诞校友系列赛中归来，相比之下，第20场比赛就像涂了油的闪电。剑桥大学的达尔文-惠特克（Darwin Cambridge Whitaker）像个怪物一样猛攻问题，但该队和爱丁堡队的每个人都状态良好。整场比赛的势头发生了变化。问答很精彩。第二轮还有三场比赛，然后是漫长的四分之一决赛。

src_seg: It's quite a change to go from the Christmas series of #UniversityChallenge, where four people didn't know the name of the narrator of Moby-Dick even when told his name is in the first sentence of the book, to the regular round, where they're racing to buzz on questions like "Fifty-three British thermal units is to grouse hunting as Sydney, Australia, is to what famous star of the London stage?"
tgt_seg: 从#大学挑战赛#的圣诞系列赛到常规赛，这是一个相当大的变化。在圣诞系列赛中，有四个人即使被告知《白鲸记》叙述者的名字出现在书的第一句话中，也不知道他的名字；而在常规赛中，他们争先恐后地回答问题，比如 "53个英国热量单位对于松鸡狩猎来说，就像澳大利亚悉尼对于伦敦舞台上哪位著名明星一样？

src_seg:
Game 21 of #UniversityChallenge was Wadham Oxford vs Imperial. What a game! Astounding performance from Imperial. 
However, being King Crimson fan, I was disappointed that no one recognized them from the opening of "21st Century Schizoid Man," and dismayed when someone thought "I Zimbra" by Talking Heads (with Fripp on guitar) was by the Bee Gees. Can't have it all. I remain incredibly impressed.
tgt_seg:
#大学挑战赛#第21场是瓦德汉姆牛津大学对阵帝国理工大学。真是一场精彩的比赛！帝国理工的表现令人震惊。
不过，作为深红国王乐队的粉丝，我很失望没有人从 "21 世纪精神分裂症患者 "的开场曲中认出他们，也很沮丧有人把 Talking Heads 乐队（吉他手是 Fripp）的 "I Zimbra "当成了 Bee Gees。不可能面面俱到。我仍然印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 22 of #UniversityChallenge was Christ's Cambridge vs St Edmund Hall Oxford, two small colleges, but that's how the rules are set up.  Nice picture round with the Dunning-Kruger effect, Asch conformity experiments, and bouba-kiki effect.  Another on mushrooms, which seemed tough to me; identifying them by eye is not easy. Solid game, good playing all around.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛#第22场比赛由剑桥大学基督学院对阵牛津大学圣埃德蒙堂学院，这是两所小学院，但规则就是这样制定的。  这一轮的图片不错，有邓宁-克鲁格效应、阿什顺应性实验和布巴-基基效应。  另一个是关于蘑菇的，我觉得很难；用眼睛识别蘑菇并不容易。比赛很精彩，大家都玩得很好。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. Nice flag knowledge, and a good picture round identifying physical laws by diagrams of experiments. A bit too much bantz for my taste, but a solid game. One more before the quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第 23 场比赛是卡迪夫对贝尔法斯特女王大学。最后的得分比我感觉的要低，可能是因为错过了奖金，但开局很快就热闹起来了。国旗知识不错，通过实验图识别物理定律的方法也很好。对我来说，这盘棋有点 "拗口"，但还算稳健。四分之一决赛前还有一场。

src_seg: Game 9 of #UniversityChallenge was a hell of a match. Oriel Oxford (530 students) vs Durham (20,000), and Oriel won, which surprised me after some mistakes they made. The captain didn't know Wittengstein's name!? Possibly just nerves. Durham was ahead, then it was tied at 170, then they dropped to 165. A pity. I was rooting for them. Great team, with all four strong, so I hope they make the cut.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第9场比赛真是精彩绝伦。奥里尔牛津学院（530名学生）对阵杜伦大学（20,000名学生），最终奥里尔学院获胜，这让我有些意外，因为他们犯了一些错误。队长竟然不知道维特根斯坦的名字！？可能只是紧张。杜伦大学一度领先，之后双方战平至170分，随后杜伦大学降至165分。真可惜。我支持他们。他们是一支优秀的队伍，四名队员都很强，希望他们能晋级。

src_seg:
Game 10 of #UniversityChallenge had a great performance by Christ's Cambridge, who have a consultative captain, a good team, and a strong member named Bethlehem, so Roger Tilling called out "Christ's Bethlehem!" Exeter Oxford never got hold of much, and are out of the running. I could see Christ's Cambridge quietly going far in this series. 
Some nice math questions, a picture round connected to food, and a tricky flag question. Good game.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第10场比赛中，基督学院剑桥大学表现出色，他们有一位善于咨询的队长，一支优秀的队伍，以及一位名叫伯利恒的实力队员，因此罗杰·蒂林格喊道：“基督学院伯利恒！”埃克塞特牛津学院几乎没有表现的机会，已经无缘晋级。我看到基督学院剑桥大学在这系列比赛中会一路过关斩将。
有一些不错的数学题，一轮图片题与食物相关，还有一道棘手的国旗题。这是一场精彩的比赛。

src_seg: It's quite a change to go from the Christmas series of #UniversityChallenge, where four people didn't know the name of the narrator of Moby-Dick even when told his name is in the first sentence of the book, to the regular round, where they're racing to buzz on questions like "Fifty-three British thermal units is to grouse hunting as Sydney, Australia, is to what famous star of the London stage?"
tgt_seg: 从#UniversityChallenge 的圣诞系列赛，四个人甚至在得知莫比·迪克叙述者的名字就在书的第一句话中时都不知道他的名字，到常规赛，他们争先恐后地回答像“五十三英热单位对应于鹧鸪狩猎，正如悉尼，澳大利亚对应于伦敦舞台上的哪位著名明星？”这样的问题，这真是太大的变化了。

src_seg:
Game 21 of #UniversityChallenge was Wadham Oxford vs Imperial. What a game! Astounding performance from Imperial. 
However, being King Crimson fan, I was disappointed that no one recognized them from the opening of "21st Century Schizoid Man," and dismayed when someone thought "I Zimbra" by Talking Heads (with Fripp on guitar) was by the Bee Gees. Can't have it all. I remain incredibly impressed.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第21场比赛是瓦德姆牛津学院对阵帝国理工学院。真是太精彩了！帝国理工学院表现惊人。
然而，作为金字塔乐队的粉丝，我失望的是没有人从“21世纪精神分裂症人”的开头认出他们，并且当有人认为Talking Heads的“I Zimbra”（吉他手是弗里普）是由比吉斯兄弟演唱时，我感到沮丧。凡事不能都如人意。我仍然非常印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 22 of #UniversityChallenge was Christ's Cambridge vs St Edmund Hall Oxford, two small colleges, but that's how the rules are set up.  Nice picture round with the Dunning-Kruger effect, Asch conformity experiments, and bouba-kiki effect.  Another on mushrooms, which seemed tough to me; identifying them by eye is not easy. Solid game, good playing all around.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第22场比赛是基督学院剑桥大学对阵圣埃德蒙霍尔牛津学院，两所小型学院，但规则就是这样规定的。一个不错的图片题，包括邓宁-克鲁格效应、阿希从众实验和bouba-kiki效应。还有关于蘑菇的题目，对我来说似乎很难；仅凭肉眼识别它们并不容易。这是一场扎实的比赛，双方都表现出色。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. Nice flag knowledge, and a good picture round identifying physical laws by diagrams of experiments. A bit too much bantz for my taste, but a solid game. One more before the quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第23场比赛是卡迪夫大学对阵贝尔法斯特女王大学。比赛以低于我预期的分数结束，可能是由于错失的加分题，但开场题的反应速度很快。对国旗知识的掌握很好，还有一个通过实验图示识别物理定律的图片题。有点太随意了，但这是一场扎实的比赛。还有一场比赛就进入四分之一决赛了。

src_seg: Game 9 of #UniversityChallenge was a hell of a match. Oriel Oxford (530 students) vs Durham (20,000), and Oriel won, which surprised me after some mistakes they made. The captain didn't know Wittengstein's name!? Possibly just nerves. Durham was ahead, then it was tied at 170, then they dropped to 165. A pity. I was rooting for them. Great team, with all four strong, so I hope they make the cut.
tgt_seg: 第9场比赛是#UniversityChallenge的一场激烈对决。Oriel Oxford（530名学生）对Durham（20,000人），Oriel获胜，这让我感到惊讶，因为他们在比赛中犯了一些错误。队长不知道维滕斯坦的名字！？可能是紧张造成的。Durham领先，然后170平，然后165。太遗憾了。我为他们加油。这是一个很棒的团队，所有成员都很强，所以我希望他们能进入前八。

src_seg:
Game 10 of #UniversityChallenge had a great performance by Christ's Cambridge, who have a consultative captain, a good team, and a strong member named Bethlehem, so Roger Tilling called out "Christ's Bethlehem!" Exeter Oxford never got hold of much, and are out of the running. I could see Christ's Cambridge quietly going far in this series. 
Some nice math questions, a picture round connected to food, and a tricky flag question. Good game.
tgt_seg:
第10场比赛，Christ's Cambridge表现出色，他们的队长是顾问，团队很好，成员 Bethlehem也很强，所以 Roger Tilling 叫出了“Christ's Bethlehem！”Exeter Oxford 没有抓住多少机会，已经被淘汰。我看到 Christ's Cambridge 在这系列赛中悄悄前进。
一些很棒的数学问题，一个与食物相关的图片问题，以及一个 tricky flag 问题。很棒的比赛。

src_seg: Game 11 of #UniversityChallenge was St Andrews (granted university status by an antipope!) vs Cardiff. First round is nearing its end. Some good questions, including mentions of roll-on roll-of ferries, Agnes Martin, and Stax Records. Cardiff Tarsala will never forget her Booker T bloomer, I'm afraid. Nice quizzing from both teams, though it only really got cracking in the last few minutes.
tgt_seg: 第11场比赛是 St Andrews（被一个反教皇授予大学地位！）对 Cardiff。第一轮接近尾声。一些很棒的问题，包括提到滚动的滚轮渡轮、Agnes Martin 和 Stax Records。我担心 Cardiff Tarsala 会忘记她的 Booker T 短裤。两个团队的提问都很棒，虽然只有在最后几分钟才真正开始。

src_seg: Game 12 of #UniversityChallenge was Leeds vs Edinburgh. Leeds took a long time to get going, then had a surge in the middle but couldn't keep it going. Seemed like a number of film questions this time, and I was glad to hear PEI as an answer; no flags, though it seems like they crop up every time. Edinburgh Myles is a good captain and the whole team is strong and works well together. I think they'll do well.
tgt_seg: 第12场比赛是 Leeds 对 Edinburgh。Leeds 需要很长时间才能开始，然后中间有一波高潮，但无法保持。这次似乎有很多电影问题，我很高兴听到 PEI 作为答案；没有旗子，但似乎每次都有。Edinburgh Myles 是一个很棒的队长，整个团队很强，合作得很好。我认为他们会做得很好。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 13 was a curious one, with Leicester being jokey, wasting time and never getting going, while the LSE captain would often turn to the farthest player for an answer, which was not infrequently wrong. Still, LSE cleaned up. I liked the blues bonus round, though sadly Leicester got none. Canadian mentions: WL Mackenzie King and Margaret Atwood. The best part was Roger Tilling saying "Leicester Lister!"
tgt_seg: 第13场比赛是 Leicester  vs LSE。Leicester 很开玩笑，浪费时间，从不开始，而 LSE 队长经常向最远的玩家寻求答案，而且不经常是正确的。不过，LSE 还是赢了。我喜欢蓝色的加分轮，虽然很遗憾 Leicester 没有得到任何加分。提到加拿大：WL Mackenzie King 和 Margaret Atwood。最棒的是 Roger Tilling 说“Leicester Lister！”

src_seg: Game 14 of #UniversityChallenge was top-notch stuff, solid quizzing, down to business, fast answers, good knowledge, close ending. It seems we'll see both SOAS London and St. Edmund Hall Oxford again, because the loser makes the repechage. Very close at the finish, down to "Naples" and "pollen." An unassumingly great game.

src_seg: Game 15 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of two in the repechage, where the four highest-scoring losing teams try to make it through. This week was UCL and St. Andrews, in a good-natured cheery match. Very strong play from UCL, who have a solid team, and UCL Mandel was in top form. Good questions, some tough, such as requiring "panthera" specifically or knowing "day" in Russian.
tgt_seg: 第15场比赛是#UniversityChallenge 的第一场比赛，其中四个得分最高的失败团队试图通过。这一周是 UCL 和 St. Andrews，这是一场友好的欢快比赛。UCL 表现非常出色，他们有一个稳固的团队，UCL Mandel 处于最佳状态。很棒的问题，有些很难，比如需要“panthera”或知道“day”在俄语中的含义。

src_seg: Just got to game 16 of #UniversityChallenge today, a week late, and it was a nail-biter! Really fast work at the end, with Durham coming from behind in the last few minutes to catch SOAS London in a tie in the final seconds. It went to a starter question that I got on the first clue (being an SF reader I knew "slipstream") but neither team knew. Second question and SOAS London Lambert guessed alpaca but it was llama, so Durham won. Phew, what a finish. 😰

src_seg: Game 22 of #UniversityChallenge was Christ's Cambridge vs St Edmund Hall Oxford, two small colleges, but that's how the rules are set up.  Nice picture round with the Dunning-Kruger effect, Asch conformity experiments, and bouba-kiki effect.  Another on mushrooms, which seemed tough to me; identifying them by eye is not easy. src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. src_seg: Game 9 of #UniversityChallenge was a hell of a match. Oriel Oxford (530 students) vs Durham (20,000), and Oriel won, which surprised me after some mistakes they made. The captain didn't know Wittengstein's name!? Possibly just nerves. Durham was ahead, then it was tied at 170, then they dropped to 165. A pity. I was rooting for them. Great team, with all four strong, so I hope they make the cut.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 的第 9 场比赛可谓精彩纷呈。Oriel Oxford (530 名学生) 对阵 Durham (2 万名),Oriel 获胜，这让我感到惊讶，因为他们犯了一些错误。队长居然不知道维特根斯坦的名字？可能是紧张。Durham 领先后被扳平为 170 分，然后又被追至 165 分。真是可惜。我一直在为他们加油。这支球队实力强大，四名成员都很强，希望他们能成功晋级。

src_seg:
Game 10 of #UniversityChallenge had a great performance by Christ's Cambridge, who have a consultative captain, a good team, and a strong member named Bethlehem, so Roger Tilling called out "Christ's Bethlehem!" Exeter Oxford never got hold of much, and are out of the running. I could see Christ's Cambridge quietly going far in this series.

#UniversityChallenge 的第 10 场比赛中，基督学院表现出色，他们的队长非常有经验，团队实力强大，其中贝特勒海姆 (Bethlehem) 表现尤为出色，罗杰·蒂林 (Roger Tilling) 因此喊出了“基督学院的贝特勒海姆!”。埃克塞特大学 (Exeter) 没有取得太多进展，已经被淘汰出局。我可以看到基督学院在这场系列赛中稳步前进。
一些有趣的数学问题、一道与食物相关的图片题，以及一道棘手的旗帜题。比赛精彩。

src_seg: Game 11 of #UniversityChallenge was St Andrews (granted university status by an antipope!) vs Cardiff. First round is nearing its end. Some good questions, including mentions of roll-on roll-of ferries, Agnes Martin, and Stax Records. Cardiff Tarsala will never forget her Booker T bloomer, I'm afraid. Nice quizzing from both teams, though it only really got cracking in the last few minutes.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 的第 11 场比赛是圣安德鲁斯大学（由一位对立教宗授予大学地位！）对阵加迪夫大学。第一轮比赛接近尾声。提问质量不错，包括有关滚轮渡轮、阿格尼斯·马丁和 Stax Records 的提问。我担心加迪夫大学的塔尔萨拉队永远不会忘记她的布克·T·布鲁默。尽管如此，两队的问答都很出色，但比赛的精彩部分只在最后几分钟才展开。

src_seg: Game 12 of #UniversityChallenge was Leeds vs Edinburgh. Leeds took a long time to get going, then had a surge in the middle but couldn't keep it going. Seemed like a number of film questions this time, and I was glad to hear PEI as an answer; no flags, though it seems like they crop up every time. Edinburgh Myles is a good captain and the whole team is strong and works well together. I think they'll do well.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 的第 12 场比赛是利兹大学对爱丁堡大学。利兹大学起步很慢，但中途却爆发出强劲的势头，但未能保持下去。这次似乎有很多电影问题，我很高兴听到 PEI 作为答案；尽管没有旗帜，但似乎每次都会出现。爱丁堡大学的迈尔斯是一位优秀的队长，整个队伍实力强大，合作良好。我认为他们会表现得很好。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 13 was a curious one, with Leicester being jokey, wasting time and never getting going, while the LSE captain would often turn to the farthest player for an answer, which was not infrequently wrong. Still, LSE cleaned up. I liked the blues bonus round, though sadly Leicester got none. Canadian mentions: WL Mackenzie King and Margaret Atwood. The best part was Roger Tilling saying "Leicester Lister!"
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 游戏第 13 场比赛很有趣，莱斯特队开场时开玩笑，浪费时间，始终没有进入状态，而 LSE 队长经常会向最远的球员寻求答案，答案经常是错误的。尽管如此，LSE 队还是取得了胜利。我喜欢蓝队的加分环节，但遗憾的是，莱斯特队没有获得任何加分。加拿大人提到了：W.L. 麦肯齐·金和玛格丽特·阿特伍德。最精彩的部分是罗杰·蒂林说“莱斯特·利斯特！”

src_seg: Game 14 of #UniversityChallenge was top-notch stuff, solid quizzing, down to business, fast answers, good knowledge, close ending. It seems we'll see both SOAS London and St. Edmund Hall Oxford again, because the loser makes the repechage. Very close at the finish, down to "Naples" and "pollen." An unassumingly great game.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 的第 14 场比赛非常精彩，知识问答扎实，紧张激烈，答题速度快，知识面广，结果非常接近。看起来我们将再次看到伦敦 SOAS 和牛津大学圣埃德蒙学院，因为落败者将进入复活赛。比赛结束时非常接近，最后一题是“那不勒斯”和“花粉”。这是一场非常精彩的比赛。

src_seg: Game 15 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of two in the repechage, where the four highest-scoring losing teams try to make it through. This week was UCL and St. Andrews, in a good-natured cheery match. Very strong play from UCL, who have a solid team, and UCL Mandel was in top form. Good questions, some tough, such as requiring "panthera" specifically or knowing "day" in Russian.

src_seg: Just got to game 16 of #UniversityChallenge today, a week late, and it was a nail-biter! Really fast work at the end, with Durham coming from behind in the last few minutes to catch SOAS London in a tie in the final seconds. It went to a starter question that I got on the first clue (being an SF reader I knew "slipstream") but neither team knew. Second question and SOAS London Lambert guessed alpaca but it was llama, so Durham won. Phew, what a finish. 😰
tgt_seg: 今天才完成了 #UniversityChallenge 的第 16 场比赛，比预定时间晚了一周，真是扣人心弦！最后时刻 Durham 奋起直追，在最后几分钟追平了 SOAS London，最终在最后一秒钟以一分之差获胜。比赛进入了初始问题，我根据第一条线索（作为科幻小说读者，我知道“slipstream”）猜测了答案，但两队都不知道。第二个问题，SOAS London 的 Lambert 猜测是 alpaca，但正确答案是 llama，所以 Durham 获胜。唉，真是精彩的结局。😰

src_seg: Game 17 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of eight knockout games in the second round. The best part was Roger Tilling saying "Leicester Lister!"
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第13场比赛十分有意思。莱斯特大学的队员调皮捣蛋，浪费时间，始终无法找到比赛节奏，而LSE队长常常找最远的队员请教问题，得到的答案经常不正确。尽管如此，LSE还是最终取得了胜利。我喜欢蓝队的额外奖分挑战，但不幸的是，莱斯特大学队没有获得任何奖分。加拿大人提及的名字包括：威尔·麦肯齐·金（Wilf McClure King）和玛格丽特·阿特伍德（Margaret Atwood）。最为人津津乐道的是，罗杰·蒂灵（Roger Tilling）说出了“莱斯特利斯特！”

src_seg: Game 14 of #UniversityChallenge was top-notch stuff, solid quizzing, down to business, fast answers, good knowledge, close ending. It seems we'll see both SOAS London and St. Edmund Hall Oxford again, because the loser makes the repechage. Very close at the finish, down to "Naples" and "pollen." An unassumingly great game.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛 第14场比赛精彩纷呈，考题精当，紧张刺激，答题迅速，知识面广，结果紧张激烈。看来伦敦SOAS大学和牛津大学圣埃德蒙学院都要再战一场，因为落败的一方将进入淘汰赛。决赛时比分十分紧张，最后一题问的是“那不勒斯”和“花粉”，简直是一场精彩绝伦的好比赛。

src_seg: Game 15 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of two in the repechage, where the four highest-scoring losing teams try to make it through. This week was UCL and St. Andrews, in a good-natured cheery match. Very strong play from UCL, who have a solid team, and UCL Mandel was in top form. Good questions, some tough, such as requiring "panthera" specifically or knowing "day" in Russian.
tgt_seg: 大学挑战赛第15场比赛是淘汰赛首战，四支得分最低的失利队伍将争夺晋级席位。本周进行了UCL与圣安德鲁斯大学的比赛，赛场上氛围轻松愉快。来自UCL的参赛队伍表现抢眼，特别是在Mandel教授的带领下，发挥得非常出色。比赛中的问题设计也出色，有些问题相当难答，例如具体需要知道“豹子”这个词的含义或者是了解俄语中的“日”字。

src_seg: Just got to game 16 of #UniversityChallenge today, a week late, and it was a nail-biter! Really fast work at the end, with Durham coming from behind in the last few minutes to catch SOAS London in a tie in the final seconds. It went to a starter question that I got on the first clue (being an SF reader I knew "slipstream") but neither team knew. Second question and SOAS London Lambert guessed alpaca but it was llama, so Durham won. Phew, what a finish. 😰
tgt_seg: 今天终于玩到了《大学生挑战赛》第 16 关，比计划晚了一个星期，真是紧张刺激！游戏最后非常激烈，多明格大学在最后几分钟凭借顽强拼搏反超了 SOAS 伦敦大学，结果在最后一秒时比分持平。比赛进入抢答环节，我通过第一条提示（作为科幻小说读者，我知道“湍流”）选出了正确答案，但两队都没有猜对。到了第二轮问题，SOAS 伦敦大学的 Lambert 猜到了“羊驼”，但正确答案是“骆驼”，所以多明格大学赢得了比赛。哎呀，真是个刺激的结局。😰

src_seg: Game 17 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of eight knockout games in the second round. This was UCL and LSE, and UCL gave an outstanding performance: very fast buzzing, good teamwork, wide general knowledge from them all (UCL Mandel notable again); they took off at the start and never slowed. Very impressive.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛的第 17 场比赛是第二轮的八场淘汰赛的第一场。这次参赛的是 UCL 和 LSE，UCL 表现出色：反应迅速、团队合作好、知识面广（特别是 UCL 的曼德尔再一次展现了他的实力）；他们一开始就领先，且势头一直没有减弱。他们的表现非常让人印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 18 of #UniversityChallenge was Durham vs Open University. I was rooting for Durham, who have a great team, but in the end to my surprise Open took it, after a number of rather slow answers. I was glad Durham got Marcel Duchamp right on one question; too bad no one knew Yoko Ono as a Fluxus artist. Much respect for Durham Nash, especially on bird silhouettes and flags.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge第18场比赛由达勒姆大学对阵开放大学。我一直很支持达勒姆大学，他们的球队实力很强，但最后出乎意料地是由开放大学获得胜利，他们在一些问题上回答得较慢。我很高兴达勒姆大学在一个问题上回答正确，那就是答对了马塞尔·杜尚（Marcel Duchamp）；遗憾的是，没有人知道约科·奥诺（Yoko Ono）是流形主义艺术家。达勒姆·纳什（Durham Nash）在鸟形剪影和国旗问题上表现出色，我为他感到佩服。

src_seg:
Game 19 of #UniversityChallenge was Exeter vs Bristol. Bristol got going at the start and never looked back, rolling with momentum, finishing with an incredible score. Exeter only clawed their way back to 0 after 17 minutes. 
I liked the question on common terms in Chinese place names, such as 北 (běi) in Beijing etc. Good geographic knowledge shown.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第 19 场比赛是埃克塞特大学对阵布里斯托尔大学。布里斯托尔大学在开场后一鼓作气，势如破竹，最后以令人赞叹的比分获胜。埃克塞特大学只在比赛进行 17 分钟后才勉强追成 0 平。
关于一些常见的地名（如北京的“北”等）的提问让人觉得有趣。显示了作者具有很好的地理知识。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge is back from the Christmas alumni series, and game 20 was liked greased lightening in comparison. Darwin Cambridge Whitaker tore into questions like a monster, but everyone was in good form on that team and also on Edinburgh. Momentum changed through the game. Good quizzing. Three more games in round two, then the long quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛今年圣诞节校友赛结束后再度开赛。相比之下，第20场比赛就像一阵风一般。达尔文剑桥惠特克如同怪兽般急切地抢答问题，但这支队伍以及爱丁堡队的每个人都保持了高昂的斗志。比赛过程中，局面来回变化。比的是谁能够更快地抢到答案。第二轮还有三场比赛，然后便是漫长的四分之一决赛。

src_seg: It's quite a change to go from the Christmas series of #UniversityChallenge, where four people didn't know the name of the narrator of Moby-Dick even when told his name is in the first sentence of the book, to the regular round, where they're racing to buzz on questions like "Fifty-three British thermal units is to grouse hunting as Sydney, Australia, is to what famous star of the London stage?"
tgt_seg: 从 #UniversityChallenge 的圣诞特辑节目过渡到常规赛，中间的转折之大，简直令人咋舌。在圣诞特辑节目中，四个人连《白鲸记》的第一句都没听懂，不知道书中提到的那位主人公的名字是什么，而在常规赛中，四个人却又能轻松地应答诸如“53 英制热量单位对应的运动是猎鹅，就像澳大利亚悉尼对应的是伦敦著名舞台上的某位明星”这样的问题。

src_seg:
Game 21 of #UniversityChallenge was Wadham Oxford vs Imperial. What a game! Astounding performance from Imperial. 
However, being King Crimson fan, I was disappointed that no one recognized them from the opening of "21st Century Schizoid Man," and dismayed when someone thought "I Zimbra" by Talking Heads (with Fripp on guitar) was by the Bee Gees. Can't have it all. I remain incredibly impressed.
tgt_seg:
#大学挑战赛第21轮比赛是瓦德姆牛津大学与帝国理工大学之间的对决。这场比赛好极了！帝国理工大学的表现令人惊叹。
可是，作为深受 King Crimson 影响的人，我对没有人能从他们演唱的《21st Century Schizoid Man》中辨认出他们感到失望。当有人把 Talking Heads 的《I Zimbra》（弗里普弹吉他）曲目误认为 Bee Gees 的作品时，我更是大失所望。不能把所有东西都做到完美。但总体而言，我还是非常印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 22 of #UniversityChallenge was Christ's Cambridge vs St Edmund Hall Oxford, two small colleges, but that's how the rules are set up.  Nice picture round with the Dunning-Kruger effect, Asch conformity experiments, and bouba-kiki effect.  Another on mushrooms, which seemed tough to me; identifying them by eye is not easy. Solid game, good playing all around.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛 第 22 轮是剑桥大学基督学院与牛津大学圣爱德蒙学院的比赛，这两家都是规模较小的学院，但比赛规则就是这样。这一轮的照片很漂亮，涉及了邓宁-克鲁格效应、阿希顺从实验和布巴-基基效应。另外还有一轮有关蘑菇的知识问答，我觉得非常有趣；仅凭眼睛识别蘑菇的种类很难。总体上来说是一场高质量的比赛，各队的表现都很出色。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. Nice flag knowledge, and a good picture round identifying physical laws by diagrams of experiments. A bit too much bantz for my taste, but a solid game. One more before the quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第 23 场比赛是加的夫大学对阵皇后贝尔法斯特，结果得分比我预期的要低，可能是因为错过了奖励分，但开始阶段进展得很快。知识丰富，画面精美，通过实验图示来阐述物理定律。虽然我个人不喜欢太多 Bantz（一种舞蹈，游戏中角色们都会跳），但整体来说还不错。只差一场就能晋级四分之一决赛了。

src_seg: Game 9 of #UniversityChallenge was a hell of a match. Oriel Oxford (530 students) vs Durham (20,000), and Oriel won, which surprised me after some mistakes they made. The captain didn't know Wittengstein's name!? Possibly just nerves. Durham was ahead, then it was tied at 170, then they dropped to 165. A pity. I was rooting for them. Great team, with all four strong, so I hope they make the cut.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge的第9场比赛是一场地狱般的比赛。 Oriel Oxford（530名学生）vs Durham（20,000），Oriel赢了，这让我在他们犯了一些错误之后感到惊讶。 船长不知道威腾斯坦的名字！? 可能只是紧张。 达勒姆领先，然后在170并列，然后他们下降到165。 可惜。 我支持他们。 很棒的球队，四人都很强，所以我希望他们能晋级。

src_seg:
Game 10 of #UniversityChallenge had a great performance by Christ's Cambridge, who have a consultative captain, a good team, and a strong member named Bethlehem, so Roger Tilling called out "Christ's Bethlehem!" Exeter Oxford never got hold of much, and are out of the running. I could see Christ's Cambridge quietly going far in this series. 
Some nice math questions, a picture round connected to food, and a tricky flag question. Good game.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge的第10场比赛由基督的剑桥（Christ'S Cambridge）有一个伟大的表现，他们有一个协商队长，一个很好的团队，一个名叫伯利恒的强大成员，所以罗杰*蒂林（Roger Tilling）叫出"基督"埃克塞特*牛津从来没有得到太多的东西，而且已经退出了竞选。 我可以看到基督的剑桥在这个系列中悄悄地走了很远。 
一些不错的数学问题，一个与食物相连的图片，以及一个棘手的旗帜问题。 好游戏。

src_seg: Game 11 of #UniversityChallenge was St Andrews (granted university status by an antipope!) vs Cardiff. First round is nearing its end. Some good questions, including mentions of roll-on roll-of ferries, Agnes Martin, and Stax Records. Cardiff Tarsala will never forget her Booker T bloomer, I'm afraid. Nice quizzing from both teams, though it only really got cracking in the last few minutes.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge的第11场比赛是圣安德鲁斯（被一个对立面授予大学地位！）vs卡迪夫。 第一轮接近尾声。 一些很好的问题，包括提到roll-on roll-of ferries，Agnes Martin和Stax Records。 恐怕卡迪夫*塔萨拉永远不会忘记她的布克*布鲁默。 两支球队的测验都很好，尽管它只是在最后几分钟才真正破裂。

src_seg: Game 12 of #UniversityChallenge was Leeds vs Edinburgh. Leeds took a long time to get going, then had a surge in the middle but couldn't keep it going. Seemed like a number of film questions this time, and I was glad to hear PEI as an answer; no flags, though it seems like they crop up every time. Edinburgh Myles is a good captain and the whole team is strong and works well together. I think they'll do well.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge的第12场比赛是利兹vs爱丁堡。 利兹花了很长时间才开始，然后在中间出现了一个激增，但无法保持下去。 这次似乎有很多电影问题，我很高兴听到贝聿铭作为答案；没有旗帜，尽管似乎每次都出现。 爱丁堡迈尔斯是一名优秀的队长，整个团队都很强大，并且一起工作得很好。 我想他们会做得很好的。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 13 was a curious one, with Leicester being jokey, wasting time and never getting going, while the LSE captain would often turn to the farthest player for an answer, which was not infrequently wrong. Still, LSE cleaned up. I liked the blues bonus round, though sadly Leicester got none. Canadian mentions: WL Mackenzie King and Margaret Atwood. The best part was Roger Tilling saying "Leicester Lister!"
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge第13场比赛是一场好奇的比赛，莱斯特被开玩笑，浪费时间，永远不会去，而LSE队长经常会转向最远的球员寻求答案，这并不是很少出错。 尽管如此，LSE还是清理了。 我喜欢蓝军的奖金回合,虽然遗憾的是莱斯特没有得到. 加拿大提到:WL麦肯齐金和玛格丽特阿特伍德. 最精彩的部分是罗杰*蒂林说："莱斯特*利斯特！"

src_seg: Game 14 of #UniversityChallenge was top-notch stuff, solid quizzing, down to business, fast answers, good knowledge, close ending. It seems we'll see both SOAS London and St. Edmund Hall Oxford again, because the loser makes the repechage. Very close at the finish, down to "Naples" and "pollen." An unassumingly great game.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge的第14场比赛是一流的东西，扎实的测验，直截了当，快速的答案，良好的知识，接近尾声。 看来我们会再次看到SOAS伦敦和圣埃德蒙霍尔牛津，因为失败者做出了repechage。 非常接近终点，下到"那不勒斯"和"花粉。"这是一场非常棒的比赛。

src_seg: Game 15 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of two in the repechage, where the four highest-scoring losing teams try to make it through. This week was UCL and St. Andrews, in a good-natured cheery match. Very strong play from UCL, who have a solid team, and UCL Mandel was in top form. Good questions, some tough, such as requiring "panthera" specifically or knowing "day" in Russian.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge的第15场比赛是两场比赛中的第一场，四支得分最高的输球球队试图通过。 本周是伦敦大学学院和圣安德鲁斯，在一场善意的愉快比赛中。 非常强大的发挥从UCL，谁拥有一个坚实的团队，和UCL曼德尔是在最佳状态。 好的问题，一些强硬，如要求"panthera"具体或知道"日"在俄罗斯。

src_seg: Just got to game 16 of #UniversityChallenge today, a week late, and it was a nail-biter! Really fast work at the end, with Durham coming from behind in the last few minutes to catch SOAS London in a tie in the final seconds. It went to a starter question that I got on the first clue (being an SF reader I knew "slipstream") but neither team knew. Second question and SOAS London Lambert guessed alpaca but it was llama, so Durham won. Phew, what a finish. 😰
tgt_seg: 今天刚到#UniversityChallenge的第16场比赛，晚了一个星期，这是一个钉子咬人！ 在最后的比赛中，达勒姆在最后的几分钟里从后面跑来，在最后的几秒钟里赶上了索斯*伦敦的平局。 它进入了一个入门问题，我得到了第一个线索（作为一个SF读者，我知道"滑流"），但两个团队都不知道。 第二个问题和SOAS伦敦兰伯特猜测羊驼，但它是美洲驼，所以达勒姆赢了。 哇，好结束。 😰

src_seg: Game 17 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of eight knockout games in the second round. This was UCL and LSE, and UCL gave an outstanding performance: very fast buzzing, good teamwork, wide general knowledge from them all (UCL Mandel notable again); they took off at the start and never slowed. Very impressive.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge的第17场比赛是第二轮八场淘汰赛中的第一场。 这是UCL和LSE，UCL给出了出色的表现：非常快的嗡嗡声，良好的团队合作，来自他们所有人的广泛一般知识（UCL Mandel再次值得注意）;他们在开始时起飞并且从未放慢 非常令人印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 18 of #UniversityChallenge was Durham vs Open University. I was rooting for Durham, who have a great team, but in the end to my surprise Open took it, after a number of rather slow answers. I was glad Durham got Marcel Duchamp right on one question; too bad no one knew Yoko Ono as a Fluxus artist. Much respect for Durham Nash, especially on bird silhouettes and flags.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge的第18场比赛是达勒姆vs开放大学。 我支持达勒姆，他们有一支伟大的球队，但最终我惊讶地打开了它，经过了一些相当缓慢的答案。 我很高兴达勒姆在一个问题上得到了马塞尔杜尚的权利;太糟糕了，没有人知道小野洋子是一个Fluxus艺术家。 对达勒姆*纳什的尊重，特别是在鸟的剪影和旗帜上。

src_seg:
Game 19 of #UniversityChallenge was Exeter vs Bristol. Bristol got going at the start and never looked back, rolling with momentum, finishing with an incredible score. Exeter only clawed their way back to 0 after 17 minutes. 
I liked the question on common terms in Chinese place names, such as 北 (běi) in Beijing etc. Good geographic knowledge shown.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge的第19场比赛是埃克塞特vs布里斯托尔。 布里斯托尔在开始时就开始了，从不回头，以势头滚动，以令人难以置信的比分结束。 埃克塞特在17分钟后才回到0。 
我喜欢中国地名常用术语的问题，如北京的北风等。 示良好的地理知识。

Three more games in round two, then the long quarter-finals.

tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge的第21场比赛是Wadham Oxford vs Imperial。 真是个游戏！ 帝国的惊人表现。 
然而，作为King Crimson的粉丝，我感到失望的是，从"21st Century Schizoid Man"的开头没有人认出他们，并且当有人认为"我Zimbra"由Talking Heads（与Fripp在吉他上）是由Bee Gees时感到沮丧。 不可能全部拥有。 我仍然印象深刻。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. Nice flag knowledge, and a good picture round identifying physical laws by diagrams of experiments. A bit too much bantz for my taste, but a solid game. One more before the quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge第23场对阵女王的贝尔法斯特。 以低于我认为它会得到的分数结束，也许是由于错过了奖金，但首发很快就嗡嗡作响。 漂亮的国旗知识,和一个很好的图片轮通过实验图识别物理定律. 有点太多的bantz我的口味，但一个坚实的游戏。 四分之一决赛前再来一次。

src_seg: Game 9 of #UniversityChallenge was a hell of a match. Oriel Oxford (530 students) vs Durham (20,000), and Oriel won, which surprised me after some mistakes they made. The captain didn't know Wittengstein's name!? Possibly just nerves. Durham was ahead, then it was tied at 170, then they dropped to 165. A pity. I was rooting for them. Great team, with all four strong, so I hope they make the cut.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 的第 9 场比赛是一场精彩的比赛。奥里尔牛津大学 (530 名学生) 对阵杜伦大学 (20,000 名学生)，奥里尔大学获胜，尽管他们犯了一些错误，但这让我感到惊讶。船长不知道维滕斯坦的名字！？可能只是紧张。达勒姆队一开始领先，但随后比分打平至 170 分，最后比分降至 165 分。可惜。我支持他们。很棒的团队，四个人都很强，所以我希望他们能够成功。

src_seg:
Game 10 of #UniversityChallenge had a great performance by Christ's Cambridge, who have a consultative captain, a good team, and a strong member named Bethlehem, so Roger Tilling called out "Christ's Bethlehem!" Exeter Oxford never got hold of much, and are out of the running. I could see Christ's Cambridge quietly going far in this series. 
Some nice math questions, a picture round connected to food, and a tricky flag question. Good game.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第 10 场比赛基督剑桥队表现出色，他们有一位顾问队长、一支优秀的队伍，还有一位名叫伯利恒的强大成员，因此罗杰蒂林高喊“基督伯利恒！”埃克塞特牛津大学从未取得太大进展，并且已经退出了竞争。我可以看到基督剑桥在这个系列中悄然走得很远。
一些不错的数学问题、一个与食物相关的图片问题和一个棘手的旗帜问题。好游戏。

src_seg: Game 11 of #UniversityChallenge was St Andrews (granted university status by an antipope!) vs Cardiff. First round is nearing its end. Some good questions, including mentions of roll-on roll-of ferries, Agnes Martin, and Stax Records. Cardiff Tarsala will never forget her Booker T bloomer, I'm afraid. Nice quizzing from both teams, though it only really got cracking in the last few minutes.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 的第 11 场比赛是圣安德鲁斯大学（由对立教皇授予大学地位！）对阵卡迪夫大学。第一轮比赛即将结束。一些很好的问题，包括提到滚装渡轮、艾格尼丝·马丁和 Stax Records。恐怕卡迪夫·塔萨拉永远不会忘记她的布克·T·灯笼裤。两队的问答都很精彩，尽管只是在最后几分钟才真正开始激烈较量。

src_seg: Game 12 of #UniversityChallenge was Leeds vs Edinburgh. Leeds took a long time to get going, then had a surge in the middle but couldn't keep it going. Seemed like a number of film questions this time, and I was glad to hear PEI as an answer; no flags, though it seems like they crop up every time. Edinburgh Myles is a good captain and the whole team is strong and works well together. I think they'll do well.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 的第 12 场比赛是利兹对阵爱丁堡。利兹联队花了很长时间才开始进攻，然后在中场发起猛攻，但没能保持下去。这次似乎有很多关于电影的问题，我很高兴听到 PEI 的回答；没有标记，尽管它们似乎每次都会出现。爱丁堡迈尔斯是一名优秀的队长，整个团队实力强大，合作良好。我认为他们会做得很好。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 13 was a curious one, with Leicester being jokey, wasting time and never getting going, while the LSE captain would often turn to the farthest player for an answer, which was not infrequently wrong. Still, LSE cleaned up. I liked the blues bonus round, though sadly Leicester got none. Canadian mentions: WL Mackenzie King and Margaret Atwood. The best part was Roger Tilling saying "Leicester Lister!"
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第 13 场比赛是一场奇怪的比赛，莱斯特城开玩笑，浪费时间，从来没有开始，而 LSE 队长经常向最远的球员寻求答案，这经常是错误的。尽管如此，伦敦政治经济学院还是清理了起来。我喜欢蓝调奖金回合，但遗憾的是莱斯特城没有得到。加拿大提及：WL Mackenzie King 和 Margaret Atwood。最棒的是罗杰·蒂林说“莱斯特李斯特！

src_seg: Game 14 of #UniversityChallenge was top-notch stuff, solid quizzing, down to business, fast answers, good knowledge, close ending. It seems we'll see both SOAS London and St. Edmund Hall Oxford again, because the loser makes the repechage. Very close at the finish, down to "Naples" and "pollen." An unassumingly great game.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 的第 14 场比赛非常精彩，问答扎实，切中要点，答案快速，知识丰富，结局接近。看来我们会再次看到伦敦大学亚非学院和牛津大学圣埃德蒙学院，因为失败者将进行复活赛。终点非常接近，只剩下“那不勒斯”和“花粉”。一款低调却伟大的游戏。

src_seg: Game 15 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of two in the repechage, where the four highest-scoring losing teams try to make it through. This week was UCL and St. Andrews, in a good-natured cheery match. Very strong play from UCL, who have a solid team, and UCL Mandel was in top form. Good questions, some tough, such as requiring "panthera" specifically or knowing "day" in Russian.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第 15 场比赛是复活赛两场比赛中的第一场，其中得分最高的四支失败队伍将努力晋级。本周是伦敦大学学院和圣安德鲁斯大学的一场气氛融洽的比赛。伦敦大学学院 (UCL) 表现非常强劲，他们拥有一支实力雄厚的队伍，而伦敦大学学院曼德尔队 (UCL Mandel) 的状态也十分出色。问题不错，但有些问题很难，比如要求具体说“panthera”或者知道俄语中的“day”。

src_seg: Just got to game 16 of #UniversityChallenge today, a week late, and it was a nail-biter! Really fast work at the end, with Durham coming from behind in the last few minutes to catch SOAS London in a tie in the final seconds. It went to a starter question that I got on the first clue (being an SF reader I knew "slipstream") but neither team knew. Second question and SOAS London Lambert guessed alpaca but it was llama, so Durham won. Phew, what a finish. 😰
tgt_seg: 今天刚刚观看了#UniversityChallenge 的第 16 场比赛，晚了一周，真是一场惊心动魄的比赛！比赛最后阶段节奏非常快，达勒姆大学在最后几分钟反超比分，并在最后几秒追平了伦敦大学亚非学院。它涉及到我在第一个线索上得到的一个初始问题（作为科幻小说读者，我知道“滑流”），但两个团队都不知道。第二个问题，伦敦大学亚非学院兰伯特猜测是羊驼，但实际上是骆驼，因此达勒姆赢了。呼，结局真棒。😰

src_seg: Game 17 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of eight knockout games in the second round. This was UCL and LSE, and UCL gave an outstanding performance: very fast buzzing, good teamwork, wide general knowledge from them all (UCL Mandel notable again); they took off at the start and never slowed. Very impressive.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 的第 17 场比赛是第二轮八场淘汰赛中的第一场。这是伦敦大学学院和伦敦政治经济学院，伦敦大学学院表现出色：非常快的嗡嗡声，良好的团队合作，他们所有人都有广泛的常识（伦敦大学学院曼德尔再次值得注意）;他们一开始就起飞了，从未放慢速度。非常令人印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 18 of #UniversityChallenge was Durham vs Open University. I was rooting for Durham, who have a great team, but in the end to my surprise Open took it, after a number of rather slow answers. I was glad Durham got Marcel Duchamp right on one question; too bad no one knew Yoko Ono as a Fluxus artist. Much respect for Durham Nash, especially on bird silhouettes and flags.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 的第 18 场比赛是达勒姆大学对阵开放大学。我本来支持达勒姆队，他们有一支出色的队伍，但最终令我惊讶的是，在经过多次相当缓慢的回应后，公开队赢得了比赛。我很高兴达勒姆在一个问题上正确地回答了马塞尔·杜尚；可惜没有人知道小野洋子是一位激浪派艺术家。非常尊重达勒姆·纳什，尤其是在鸟类轮廓和旗帜方面。

src_seg:
Game 19 of #UniversityChallenge was Exeter vs Bristol. Bristol got going at the start and never looked back, rolling with momentum, finishing with an incredible score. Exeter only clawed their way back to 0 after 17 minutes. 
I liked the question on common terms in Chinese place names, such as 北 (běi) in Beijing etc. Good geographic knowledge shown.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 的第 19 场比赛是埃克塞特对阵布里斯托尔。布里斯托尔队从一开始就势不可挡，没有回头，势头强劲，最终以令人难以置信的比分结束比赛。埃克塞特队在 17 分钟后才将比分扳为 0。
我喜欢关于中国地名中常用术语的问题，例如北京的北（běi）等。显示出良好的地理知识。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge is back from the Christmas alumni series, and game 20 was liked greased lightening in comparison. Darwin Cambridge Whitaker tore into questions like a monster, but everyone was in good form on that team and also on Edinburgh. Momentum changed through the game. Good quizzing. Three more games in round two, then the long quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 从圣诞校友系列赛中回归，相比之下，第 20 场比赛就像闪电一样。达尔文剑桥惠特克像怪物一样提出问题，但该队和爱丁堡队的每个人都状态良好。比赛的势头发生了变化。很好的測試。第二轮还有三场比赛，然后是漫长的四分之一决赛。

src_seg: It's quite a change to go from the Christmas series of #UniversityChallenge, where four people didn't know the name of the narrator of Moby-Dick even when told his name is in the first sentence of the book, to the regular round, where they're racing to buzz on questions like "Fifty-three British thermal units is to grouse hunting as Sydney, Australia, is to what famous star of the London stage?"
tgt_seg: 在#UniversityChallenge 的圣诞节系列中，四个人甚至在被告知《白鲸》叙述者的名字出现在书的第一句话时也不知道他的名字。而在常规环节中，他们会竞相回答诸如“53 英国热量单位对于猎捕松鸡而言，相当于澳大利亚悉尼对于伦敦舞台上哪位著名明星而言？”这样的问题，这真是一个很大的变化。

src_seg:
Game 21 of #UniversityChallenge was Wadham Oxford vs Imperial. What a game! Astounding performance from Imperial. 
However, being King Crimson fan, I was disappointed that no one recognized them from the opening of "21st Century Schizoid Man," and dismayed when someone thought "I Zimbra" by Talking Heads (with Fripp on guitar) was by the Bee Gees. Can't have it all. I remain incredibly impressed.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 的第 21 场比赛是 Wadham Oxford 对阵 Imperial。真棒的游戏！帝国理工的出色表现。
然而，作为 King Crimson 的粉丝，我很失望没有人从“21st Century Schizoid Man”的开场中认出他们，并且当有人认为 Talking Heads（Fripp 弹吉他）的“I Zimbra”是 Bee Gees 的作品时，我感到很沮丧。不可能拥有一切。我至今仍印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 22 of #UniversityChallenge was Christ's Cambridge vs St Edmund Hall Oxford, two small colleges, but that's how the rules are set up.  Nice picture round with the Dunning-Kruger effect, Asch conformity experiments, and bouba-kiki effect.  Another on mushrooms, which seemed tough to me; identifying them by eye is not easy. Solid game, good playing all around.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 的第 22 场比赛是基督剑桥大学对阵牛津圣埃德蒙霍尔学院，这是两所小型学院，但规则就是这样制定的。这张漂亮的图片体现了邓宁-克鲁格效应、阿希从众实验和布巴-基基效应。另一个是关于蘑菇的，这对我来说似乎很难；用眼睛识别它们并不容易。比赛很精彩，各方面表现都很好。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. Nice flag knowledge, and a good picture round identifying physical laws by diagrams of experiments. A bit too much bantz for my taste, but a solid game. One more before the quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: 第 23 场比赛 #UniversityChallenge 卡迪夫对阵贝尔法斯特女王队。以比我感觉的更低的分数结束，可能是由于错过了奖金，但首发球员很快就嗡嗡作响了。不错的旗帜知识，以及通过实验图识别物理定律的良好图片。对我来说有点太多了，但是一款可靠的游戏。四分之一决赛前还有一场。

src_seg: Game 9 of #UniversityChallenge was a hell of a match. Oriel Oxford (530 students) vs Durham (20,000), and Oriel won, which surprised me after some mistakes they made. The captain didn't know Wittengstein's name!? Possibly just nerves. Durham was ahead, then it was tied at 170, then they dropped to 165. A pity. I was rooting for them. Great team, with all four strong, so I hope they make the cut.
tgt_seg: 第9场#UniversityChallenge是一场精彩的比赛。牛津大学奥里尔学院（530名学生）对阵达勒姆大学（20,000名学生），结果奥里尔获胜，让我感到惊讶，因为他们犯了一些错误。队长居然不知道维特根斯坦的名字！可能只是紧张。达勒姆曾领先，后来两队平局在170分，然后降到165分。真遗憾。我是支持他们的。很棒的团队，四个人都很强，所以我希望他们能晋级。

Game 10 of #UniversityChallenge had a great performance by Christ's Cambridge, who have a consultative captain, a good team, and a strong member named Bethlehem, so Roger Tilling called out "Christ's Bethlehem!" Exeter Oxford never got hold of much, and are out of the running. I could see Christ's Cambridge quietly going far in this series. 
Some nice math questions, a picture round connected to food, and a tricky flag question. Good game.
tgt_seg: 第10场#UniversityChallenge中，剑桥大学基督学院的表现很出色，他们有一位顾问型的队长，一个很棒的团队，以及一位名叫伯利恒的强成员，因此罗杰·蒂林大声喊道：“基督学院的贝特莱赫姆！”牛津大学的埃克塞特始终没有掌握太多机会，已经出局。我能看到剑桥大学基督学院在本系列中稳步前进。一些不错的数学题，一个与食物相关的图片回合，以及一个棘手的国旗问题。精彩的比赛。

tgt_seg: 第11场#UniversityChallenge是圣安德鲁斯大学（由一位假教皇授予大学地位！）对阵加的夫大学。第一轮快结束了。一些不错的问题，包括提到的滚装滚卸渡轮、阿格尼丝·马丁和斯塔克斯唱片。我怕加的夫的塔萨拉永远不会忘记她的布克·T失误。虽然两队在比赛最后几分钟才真正打出气氛，但都有不错的问答表现。

tgt_seg: 第14场#UniversityChallenge是顶级的比赛，问答扎实，迅速反应，知识丰富，比赛结尾十分接近。看来我们会再次看到伦敦的SOAS和牛津的圣埃德蒙学院，因为输的队伍会进行复活赛。比赛非常接近，最终以“那不勒斯”和“花粉症”结束。真是一场低调又出色的比赛。

tgt_seg: 第15场#UniversityChallenge是复活赛中的第一场，四个得分最高的输掉的队伍争取晋级。这周是UCL对圣安德鲁斯大学，比赛气氛轻松愉快。UCL表现非常出色，团队实力强大，UCL的曼德尔状态很好。问答问题优质，有一些比较难的，比如特定要求“美洲豹”或者知道俄语的“日”。

tgt_seg: 第17场#UniversityChallenge是第二轮的首场淘汰赛。这是UCL对LSE，UCL表现出色：反应非常迅速，团队合作良好，所有队员的知识面都很广（UCL的曼德尔再次表现突出）；他们在比赛开始时迅速走高，之后从未放慢。非常令人印象深刻。

src_seg:
Game 19 of #UniversityChallenge was Exeter vs Bristol. Bristol got going at the start and never looked back, rolling with momentum, finishing with an incredible score. Exeter only clawed their way back to 0 after 17 minutes. 
I liked the question on common terms in Chinese place names, such as 北 (běi) in Beijing etc. Good geographic knowledge shown.
tgt_seg: 第19场#UniversityChallenge是埃克塞特大学对布里斯托大学。布里斯托大学一开始就进入正轨，之后再也没有回头，势不可挡，最终得分令人难以置信。埃克塞特在17分钟后才勉强回到0分。我喜欢那个关于中国地名常用词的问题，比如“北”（běi）在北京等地名中的使用。展现了良好的地理知识。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge is back from the Christmas alumni series, and game 20 was liked greased lightening in comparison. Darwin Cambridge Whitaker tore into questions like a monster, but everyone was in good form on that team and also on Edinburgh. Momentum changed through the game. Good quizzing. Three more games in round two, then the long quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge从圣诞校友系列中回来了，20场比赛与之前相比就像是闪电。剑桥大学的达尔文·惠特克如狂暴的怪兽一般冲进问题，但他们团队中每个人的状态都很好，爱丁堡的表现同样不错。比赛的气势不断变化。优秀的问答。第二轮还有三场比赛，然后是漫长的四分之一决赛。

src_seg: It's quite a change to go from the Christmas series of #UniversityChallenge, where four people didn't know the name of the narrator of Moby-Dick even when told his name is in the first sentence of the book, to the regular round, where they're racing to buzz on questions like "Fifty-three British thermal units is to grouse hunting as Sydney, Australia, is to what famous star of the London stage?"
tgt_seg: 从#UniversityChallenge的圣诞系列到常规轮次转换真是很大的变化，其中有四个人甚至不知道《白鲸》的叙述者名字，尽管被告知他的名字在书的第一句中，就迅速竞争回答像是 “五十三英热单位与打猎黑饲龙，悉尼，澳大利亚，与伦敦舞台上的哪个著名明星相对应？”

src_seg:
Game 21 of #UniversityChallenge was Wadham Oxford vs Imperial. What a game! Astounding performance from Imperial. 
However, being King Crimson fan, I was disappointed that no one recognized them from the opening of "21st Century Schizoid Man," and dismayed when someone thought "I Zimbra" by Talking Heads (with Fripp on guitar) was by the Bee Gees. Can't have it all. I remain incredibly impressed.
tgt_seg: 第21场#UniversityChallenge是沃德哈姆大学对帝国学院。比赛真是精彩！帝国学院的表现令人震惊。不过，作为一个King Crimson的粉丝，我有些失望，没人能认出他们是从《21世纪精神分裂症者》的开头；还感到沮丧有人以为Talking Heads的《I Zimbra》（吉他由弗里普演奏）是比吉斯的作品。不能样样都完美。我感到非常震撼。

src_seg: Game 22 of #UniversityChallenge was Christ's Cambridge vs St Edmund Hall Oxford, two small colleges, but that's how the rules are set up.  Nice picture round with the Dunning-Kruger effect, Asch conformity experiments, and bouba-kiki effect.  Another on mushrooms, which seemed tough to me; identifying them by eye is not easy. Solid game, good playing all around.
tgt_seg: 第22场#UniversityChallenge是剑桥的基督学院对牛津的圣埃德蒙学院，两所小学院，但这就是规则的设定。不错的图片回合，涉及邓宁-克鲁格效应、阿施从众实验和bouba-kiki效应。还有关于蘑菇的问题，我觉得有点难；通过视觉识别它们不容易。比赛很出色，整体表现很好。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. Nice flag knowledge, and a good picture round identifying physical laws by diagrams of experiments. A bit too much bantz for my taste, but a solid game. One more before the quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: 第23场#UniversityChallenge是加的夫大学对女王大学贝尔法斯特。最终得分低于我的预期，可能是由于错失加分，但启动题回答得很快。不错的国旗知识，以及一个通过实验的图示识别物理法则的好图片回合。对于我来说调侃的部分有点多，但比赛还是很扎实。在进入四分之一决赛之前还有一场。

src_seg: Game 9 of #UniversityChallenge was a hell of a match. Oriel Oxford (530 students) vs Durham (20,000), and Oriel won, which surprised me after some mistakes they made. The captain didn't know Wittengstein's name!? Possibly just nerves. Durham was ahead, then it was tied at 170, then they dropped to 165. A pity. I was rooting for them. Great team, with all four strong, so I hope they make the cut.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第9场比赛真是精彩绝伦。奥里尔牛津（530名学生）对阵达勒姆（2万名学生），最终奥里尔获胜，这让我感到惊讶，因为他们在比赛中犯了一些错误。队长居然不知道维特根斯坦的名字？！可能是因为紧张。达勒姆一开始领先，然后比分追平到170，最后他们跌到了165分。真遗憾，我一直在为他们加油。这是一支很棒的队伍，所有四名队员都很强，所以我希望他们能晋级。

src_seg:
Game 10 of #UniversityChallenge had a great performance by Christ's Cambridge, who have a consultative captain, a good team, and a strong member named Bethlehem, so Roger Tilling called out "Christ's Bethlehem!" Exeter Oxford never got hold of much, and are out of the running. I could see Christ's Cambridge quietly going far in this series. 
Some nice math questions, a picture round connected to food, and a tricky flag question. Good game.
tgt_seg:
#大学挑战赛第10场比赛，基督学院剑桥表现出色。他们有一位善于咨询的队长，一支优秀的团队，还有一位名叫伯利恒的强力队员，所以罗杰·蒂林喊出了“基督学院的伯利恒！”埃克塞特牛津几乎没有取得什么成绩，已经被淘汰出局。我觉得基督学院剑桥在这轮比赛中会悄悄地走得很远。
有一些不错的数学题，一轮与食物相关的图片题，还有一道棘手的国旗题。精彩的比赛。

src_seg: Game 11 of #UniversityChallenge was St Andrews (granted university status by an antipope!) vs Cardiff. First round is nearing its end. Some good questions, including mentions of roll-on roll-of ferries, Agnes Martin, and Stax Records. Cardiff Tarsala will never forget her Booker T bloomer, I'm afraid. Nice quizzing from both teams, though it only really got cracking in the last few minutes.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第11场比赛是圣安德鲁斯（由一位反教皇授予大学地位）对阵卡迪夫。第一轮比赛即将结束。有一些不错的问题，包括提到滚装滚卸渡轮、艾格尼丝·马丁和Stax唱片公司。卡迪夫的塔萨拉恐怕永远不会忘记她对布克·T的错误回答。两支队伍都表现出了很好的答题水平，尽管比赛只在最后几分钟才真正激烈起来。

src_seg: Game 12 of #UniversityChallenge was Leeds vs Edinburgh. Leeds took a long time to get going, then had a surge in the middle but couldn't keep it going. Seemed like a number of film questions this time, and I was glad to hear PEI as an answer; no flags, though it seems like they crop up every time. Edinburgh Myles is a good captain and the whole team is strong and works well together. I think they'll do well.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第12场比赛是利兹对阵爱丁堡。利兹队花了很长时间才进入状态，然后在中段突然爆发，但没能保持下去。这次似乎有很多电影相关的问题，我很高兴听到PEI作为答案；没有国旗题，尽管它们似乎每次都会出现。爱丁堡的迈尔斯是一位出色的队长，整个团队都很强，合作得也很好。我认为他们会表现得很好。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 13 was a curious one, with Leicester being jokey, wasting time and never getting going, while the LSE captain would often turn to the farthest player for an answer, which was not infrequently wrong. Still, LSE cleaned up. I liked the blues bonus round, though sadly Leicester got none. Canadian mentions: WL Mackenzie King and Margaret Atwood. The best part was Roger Tilling saying "Leicester Lister!"
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第13场比赛很有趣：莱斯特队一直在开玩笑，浪费时间，从来没有进入状态；而LSE的队长经常向最远的队员寻求答案，而这些答案往往是错误的。尽管如此，LSE还是取得了胜利。我喜欢蓝调加分环节，尽管莱斯特队遗憾地没有得到任何分数。加拿大提到的人物有：WL麦肯齐·金和玛格丽特·阿特伍德。最精彩的部分是罗杰·蒂林说“莱斯特·利斯特！”

src_seg: Game 14 of #UniversityChallenge was top-notch stuff, solid quizzing, down to business, fast answers, good knowledge, close ending. It seems we'll see both SOAS London and St. Edmund Hall Oxford again, because the loser makes the repechage. Very close at the finish, down to "Naples" and "pollen." An unassumingly great game.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第14场比赛非常精彩：答题扎实，专注于比赛，回答迅速，知识丰富，结局紧张。看来我们还会再看到SOAS伦敦和圣埃德蒙大厅牛津，因为输掉的队伍可以参加复活赛。比赛结束时非常接近，最终比拼的是“那不勒斯”和“花粉”。这是一场低调但精彩的比赛。

src_seg: Game 15 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of two in the repechage, where the four highest-scoring losing teams try to make it through. This week was UCL and St. Andrews, in a good-natured cheery match. Very strong play from UCL, who have a solid team, and UCL Mandel was in top form. Good questions, some tough, such as requiring "panthera" specifically or knowing "day" in Russian.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第15场比赛是复活赛中的第一场，四支得分最高的失利队伍将尝试晋级。本周是UCL和圣安德鲁斯之间的比赛，这是一场轻松愉快的较量。UCL表现非常出色，他们有一支强大的队伍，UCL的曼德尔状态极佳。问题很好，有些很棘手，比如要求具体回答“panthera”或者知道俄语中的“day”。

src_seg: Just got to game 16 of #UniversityChallenge today, a week late, and it was a nail-biter! Really fast work at the end, with Durham coming from behind in the last few minutes to catch SOAS London in a tie in the final seconds. It went to a starter question that I got on the first clue (being an SF reader I knew "slipstream") but neither team knew. Second question and SOAS London Lambert guessed alpaca but it was llama, so Durham won. Phew, what a finish. 😰
tgt_seg: 今天我终于看了#大学挑战赛第16场比赛，比原定时间晚了一周，这场比赛真是紧张刺激！最后阶段进展迅速，达勒姆队在最后几分钟从落后状态追平了SOAS伦敦，在最后几秒钟打成平手。比赛进入了一个起始问题，我在第一个线索就猜对了（作为科幻小说读者，我知道“slipstream”），但两支队伍都不知道。第二个问题，SOAS伦敦的兰伯特猜测是羊驼，但实际上是羊，所以达勒姆获胜。哇，什么样的结局啊！😰

src_seg: Game 17 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of eight knockout games in the second round. This was UCL and LSE, and UCL gave an outstanding performance: very fast buzzing, good teamwork, wide general knowledge from them all (UCL Mandel notable again); they took off at the start and never slowed. Very impressive.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第17场比赛是第二轮八场淘汰赛中的第一场，由UCL和LSE对阵。UCL表现出色：反应迅速，团队合作良好，所有队员都拥有广泛的知识（UCL的曼德尔再次表现突出）；他们从一开始就领先，从未放慢脚步。非常令人印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 18 of #UniversityChallenge was Durham vs Open University. I was rooting for Durham, who have a great team, but in the end to my surprise Open took it, after a number of rather slow answers. I was glad Durham got Marcel Duchamp right on one question; too bad no one knew Yoko Ono as a Fluxus artist. Much respect for Durham Nash, especially on bird silhouettes and flags.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第18场比赛是达勒姆对阵开放大学。我为达勒姆队加油，他们有一支很棒的队伍，但出人意料的是，开放大学在多次缓慢回答后最终获胜。我很高兴达勒姆队在关于马塞尔·杜尚的问题上答对了；遗憾的是，没有人知道小野洋子是Fluxus艺术运动的成员。我非常尊重达勒姆的纳什，尤其是在鸟类轮廓和国旗方面。

tgt_seg:
#大学挑战赛第19场比赛是埃克塞特对阵布里斯托。布里斯托从一开始就势如破竹，从未回头，最终取得了令人难以置信的成绩。埃克塞特队在17分钟后才将比分追回至0。

tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第十三场比赛很奇怪，莱斯特学院开场调侃，浪费时间，从未真正开始，而LSE的队长经常转向最远的队员寻求答案，这往往是错误的。尽管如此，LSE学院还是赢得了比赛。我喜欢蓝色的加分轮，虽然遗憾的是莱斯特学院没有得到任何分。加拿大提及：WL·麦肯齐·金和玛格丽特·阿特伍德。最好的部分是罗杰·蒂林说“莱斯特·利斯特！”

src_seg: Game 14 of #UniversityChallenge was top-notch stuff, solid quizzing, down to business, fast answers, good knowledge, close ending. It seems we'll see both SOAS London and St. Edmund Hall Oxford again, because the loser makes the repechage. Very close at the finish, down to "Naples" and "pollen." An unassumingly great game.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第十四场比赛是一场顶级比赛，扎实的问答，直接进入正题，快速回答，良好的知识，接近尾声。看起来我们会再次看到伦敦SOAS和牛津大学圣爱德蒙大厦，因为败者将参加复活赛。比赛非常接近，直到“那不勒斯”和“花粉”。这是一场出色的比赛。

src_seg: Game 15 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of two in the repechage, where the four highest-scoring losing teams try to make it through. This week was UCL and St. Andrews, in a good-natured cheery match. Very strong play from UCL, who have a solid team, and UCL Mandel was in top form. Good questions, some tough, such as requiring "panthera" specifically or knowing "day" in Russian.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第十五场比赛是复活赛中的第一场比赛，四支得分最高的落败队伍试图晋级。本周是UCL和圣安德鲁斯大学，这是一场友好的比赛。UCL表现非常出色，他们有一支强大的队伍，UCL曼德尔状态很好。题目不错，有些很难，例如需要具体提到“panthera”或知道俄语中的“day”。

src_seg: Just got to game 16 of #UniversityChallenge today, a week late, and it was a nail-biter! Really fast work at the end, with Durham coming from behind in the last few minutes to catch SOAS London in a tie in the final seconds. It went to a starter question that I got on the first clue (being an SF reader I knew "slipstream") but neither team knew. Second question and SOAS London Lambert guessed alpaca but it was llama, so Durham won. Phew, what a finish. 😰
tgt_seg: 今天才赶上第十六场比赛，比计划晚了整整一周，这是一场扣人心弦的比赛！最后几分钟，达勒姆从落后中追上，在最后几秒钟将伦敦SOAS赶上并列。它变成了一个我从第一个线索就能回答的开场问题（作为一名SF读者，我知道“滑流”），但两支队伍都不知道。第二题，SOAS伦敦的兰伯特猜想是羊驼，但实际上是美洲驼，所以达勒姆赢了。天哪，真是一个精彩的结局。😰

src_seg: Game 17 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of eight knockout games in the second round. This was UCL and LSE, and UCL gave an outstanding performance: very fast buzzing, good teamwork, wide general knowledge from them all (UCL Mandel notable again); they took off at the start and never slowed. Very impressive.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第十七场比赛是第二轮八场淘汰赛中的第一场，是UCL和LSE，UCL表现出色：非常快速的抢答，良好的团队合作，他们所有人都展现了广泛的常识（UCL曼德尔再次表现出色）；他们一开始就冲刺，从未减速。非常令人印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 18 of #UniversityChallenge was Durham vs Open University. I was rooting for Durham, who have a great team, but in the end to my surprise Open took it, after a number of rather slow answers. I was glad Durham got Marcel Duchamp right on one question; too bad no one knew Yoko Ono as a Fluxus artist. Much respect for Durham Nash, especially on bird silhouettes and flags.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第十八场比赛是达勒姆对阵开放大学。我支持达勒姆，他们有一支伟大的队伍，但最终令我惊讶的是开放大学获胜，此前他们回答了许多相当缓慢的问题。我很高兴达勒姆在一道题上正确回答了马塞尔·杜尚；太糟糕了，没有人知道Yoko Ono是Fluxus艺术家。我对达勒姆的纳什表示敬意，尤其是在鸟类剪影和国旗方面。

src_seg:
Game 19 of #UniversityChallenge was Exeter vs Bristol. Bristol got going at the start and never looked back, rolling with momentum, finishing with an incredible score. Exeter only clawed their way back to 0 after 17 minutes. 
I liked the question on common terms in Chinese place names, such as 北 (běi) in Beijing etc. Good geographic knowledge shown.
tgt_seg:
#大学挑战赛第十九场比赛是埃克塞特对阵布里斯托尔。布里斯托尔一开始就领先，从未回头，势头如滚雪球，以令人难以置信的比分结束。埃克塞特在17分钟后才勉强追回0分。
我喜欢关于中文地名中常见术语的问题，例如北京的北（běi）等。展示了良好的地理知识。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge is back from the Christmas alumni series, and game 20 was liked greased lightening in comparison. Darwin Cambridge Whitaker tore into questions like a monster, but everyone was in good form on that team and also on Edinburgh. Momentum changed through the game. Good quizzing. Three more games in round two, then the long quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛从圣诞校友系列回来，与之相比，第二十场比赛就像闪电一样快。达尔文剑桥惠特克像一头野兽一样猛攻问题，但那支队伍和爱丁堡的队伍都状态很好。比赛中的势头发生了变化。问答很好。第二轮还有三场比赛，然后是漫长的四分之一决赛。

src_seg: It's quite a change to go from the Christmas series of #UniversityChallenge, where four people didn't know the name of the narrator of Moby-Dick even when told his name is in the first sentence of the book, to the regular round, where they're racing to buzz on questions like "Fifty-three British thermal units is to grouse hunting as Sydney, Australia, is to what famous star of the London stage?"
tgt_seg: 从圣诞系列的#大学挑战赛，其中四个人甚至不知道《Moby-Dick》讲述者的名字，到常规轮，他们正在争先恐后地抢答诸如“53个英热单位相当于猎鸡，那么澳大利亚的悉尼相当于哪个伦敦舞台上的著名明星？”这样的问题，真是天壤之别。

src_seg:
Game 21 of #UniversityChallenge was Wadham Oxford vs Imperial. What a game! Astounding performance from Imperial. 
However, being King Crimson fan, I was disappointed that no one recognized them from the opening of "21st Century Schizoid Man," and dismayed when someone thought "I Zimbra" by Talking Heads (with Fripp on guitar) was by the Bee Gees. Can't have it all. I remain incredibly impressed.
tgt_seg:
#大学挑战赛第二十一场比赛是牛津大学沃德汉姆学院对阵帝国理工学院。多好的比赛！帝国理工学院的表现令人震惊。
然而，作为一位国王 Crimson 粉丝，我很失望没有人从“21st Century Schizoid Man”的开场就能认出他们，当有人认为Talking Heads的“I Zimbra”（Fripp弹吉他）是Bee Gees的作品时，我感到沮丧。不能兼得。我仍然非常佩服。

src_seg: Game 22 of #UniversityChallenge was Christ's Cambridge vs St Edmund Hall Oxford, two small colleges, but that's how the rules are set up.  Nice picture round with the Dunning-Kruger effect, Asch conformity experiments, and bouba-kiki effect.  Another on mushrooms, which seemed tough to me; identifying them by eye is not easy. Solid game, good playing all around.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第二十二场比赛是剑桥大学基督学院对阵牛津大学圣爱德蒙大厦，两所小学院，但规则就是这样的。图片轮不错，有邓宁-克鲁格效应、阿施顺从实验和bouba-kiki效应。还有关于蘑菇的，对我来说似乎很难；凭肉眼识别它们并不容易。扎实的比赛，各方面都表现出色。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. Nice flag knowledge, and a good picture round identifying physical laws by diagrams of experiments. A bit too much bantz for my taste, but a solid game. One more before the quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第二十三场比赛是加的夫对阵贝尔法斯特皇后大学。比我想象的要低，也许是因为错过了加分，但开场问题抢答得很快。不错的国旗知识，以及一个不错的图片轮，通过实验图解识别物理定律。对我来说，玩笑太多了，但这是一场扎实的比赛。四分之一决赛前还有一场比赛。

src_seg: Game 9 of #UniversityChallenge was a hell of a match. Oriel Oxford (530 students) vs Durham (20,000), and Oriel won, which surprised me after some mistakes they made. The captain didn't know Wittengstein's name!? Possibly just nerves. Durham was ahead, then it was tied at 170, then they dropped to 165. A pity. I was rooting for them. Great team, with all four strong, so I hope they make the cut.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛的第9场比赛真是精彩万分。奥里尔牛津（530名学生）对决杜伦（2万），结果奥里尔获胜，这让我有些惊讶，因为他们之前犯了一些错误。队长竟然不知道维特根斯坦的名字！？也许只是紧张吧。杜伦先领先着，然后比分打平到170，后来又掉到了165。可惜。我为他们加油打气。这是一个非常优秀的团队，四个成员都非常强大，所以我希望他们能进入决赛。

src_seg:
Game 10 of #UniversityChallenge had a great performance by Christ's Cambridge, who have a consultative captain, a good team, and a strong member named Bethlehem, so Roger Tilling called out "Christ's Bethlehem!" Exeter Oxford never got hold of much, and are out of the running. I could see Christ's Cambridge quietly going far in this series. 
Some nice math questions, a picture round connected to food, and a tricky flag question. Good game.
tgt_seg:
#大学挑战赛第10场比赛，剑桥基督学院表现出色，他们有位经验丰富的队长，一支优秀的团队，以及一名实力强大的成员贝特勒赫姆，因此罗杰·蒂林格喊道：“基督学院·贝特勒赫姆！”埃克塞特牛津大学从未有过出色的表现，已经出局。我觉得剑桥基督学院在这个系列赛中会默默走得很远。
一些有趣的数学问题，一轮与食物相关的图片，以及一个棘手的国旗问题。精彩比赛。

src_seg: Game 11 of #UniversityChallenge was St Andrews (granted university status by an antipope!) vs Cardiff. First round is nearing its end. Some good questions, including mentions of roll-on roll-of ferries, Agnes Martin, and Stax Records. Cardiff Tarsala will never forget her Booker T bloomer, I'm afraid. Nice quizzing from both teams, though it only really got cracking in the last few minutes.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第11场：圣安德鲁斯（获得反教皇认可的大学）对卡迪夫。第一轮即将结束。有些好问题，包括滚动渡轮、艾格尼斯·马丁和Stax唱片的提及。卡迪夫Tarsala恐怕会永远记得她的布克特T大腿露点。两队都表现出色，但直到最后几分钟才真正开始激烈竞争。

src_seg: Game 12 of #UniversityChallenge was Leeds vs Edinburgh. Leeds took a long time to get going, then had a surge in the middle but couldn't keep it going. Seemed like a number of film questions this time, and I was glad to hear PEI as an answer; no flags, though it seems like they crop up every time. Edinburgh Myles is a good captain and the whole team is strong and works well together. I think they'll do well.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛的第12场比赛是莱斯特对爱丁堡。莱斯特开局很慢，然后在中段有过一波冲刺，但无法保持。这次似乎有很多电影问题，我很高兴听到PEI作为答案；不过没有旗帜出现，尽管它们似乎每次都会出现。爱丁堡的Myles是一个好的队长，整个团队很强大，合作得很好。我认为他们会做得很好。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 13 was a curious one, with Leicester being jokey, wasting time and never getting going, while the LSE captain would often turn to the farthest player for an answer, which was not infrequently wrong. Still, LSE cleaned up. I liked the blues bonus round, though sadly Leicester got none. Canadian mentions: WL Mackenzie King and Margaret Atwood. The best part was Roger Tilling saying "Leicester Lister!"
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第13期很有趣，莱斯特队玩得轻松，浪费时间，从不集中精力，而LSE队长经常会转向最远的球员提问，答案往往不正确。但LSE还是表现出色。我喜欢蓝队奖励回合，虽然莱斯特队没有得到任何奖励。加拿大提及：WL Mackenzie King和Margaret Atwood。最佳部分是罗杰·蒂林格说“莱斯特·列斯特！”

tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第14场比赛非常精彩，问题设计精良，紧凑有序，答案迅速，知识面广，结局十分接近。看来我们将再次看到伦敦SOAS和牛津圣埃德蒙厅，因为失败者将进入补赛。比赛最后阶段非常激烈，竞争到“那不勒斯”和“花粉”这两个问题。一场令人意想不到的精彩比赛。

The captain didn't know Wittengstein's name!? Possibly just nerves. Durham was ahead, then it was tied at 170, then they dropped to 165. A pity. I was rooting for them.
