tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第9集真是太精彩了！牛津大学Oriel学院（530名学生）对阵达勒姆大学（2万名学生），结果Oriel学院获胜，这让我有点吃惊，毕竟他们犯了一些失误。 队长竟然不知道维特根斯坦的名字！？ 估计是太紧张了。达勒姆大学一度领先，然后比分打平170分，紧接着就降到了165分。真遗憾。我可是支持他们的。他们是个很棒的队伍，四位队员都很强，希望他们能挺过去。

src_seg:
Game 10 of #UniversityChallenge had a great performance by Christ's Cambridge, who have a consultative captain, a good team, and a strong member named Bethlehem, so Roger Tilling called out "Christ's Bethlehem!" Exeter Oxford never got hold of much, and are out of the running. I could see Christ's Cambridge quietly going far in this series. 
Some nice math questions, a picture round connected to food, and a tricky flag question. Good game.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第10期节目中，基督剑桥学院表现出色，他们拥有一位有主见的队长，一个优秀的团队，以及一位名叫Bethlehem的强有力选手，以至于Roger Tilling喊出了“基督 Bethlehem！”。牛津埃克塞特学院未能找到突破口，已无缘晋级。 我觉得基督剑桥学院很有可能在本季节目中走得更远。
一些不错的数学题目，一轮与食物相关的图片题，以及一个棘手的旗帜题。比赛不错。

src_seg: Game 11 of #UniversityChallenge was St Andrews (granted university status by an antipope!) vs Cardiff. First round is nearing its end. Some good questions, including mentions of roll-on roll-of ferries, Agnes Martin, and Stax Records. Cardiff Tarsala will never forget her Booker T bloomer, I'm afraid. Nice quizzing from both teams, though it only really got cracking in the last few minutes.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第11期，圣安德鲁斯大学（曾被反教皇授予大学地位！）对阵卡迪夫。第一轮即将结束。出现了一些好问题，包括关于滚轮渡轮、艾格尼丝·马丁和Stax唱片公司的提及。卡迪夫Tarsala恐怕会永远记得她的 Booker T 失误。双方队伍的表现都很棒，但直到最后几分钟才真正火起来。

src_seg: Game 12 of #UniversityChallenge was Leeds vs Edinburgh. Leeds took a long time to get going, then had a surge in the middle but couldn't keep it going. Seemed like a number of film questions this time, and I was glad to hear PEI as an answer; no flags, though it seems like they crop up every time. Edinburgh Myles is a good captain and the whole team is strong and works well together. I think they'll do well.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第12场比赛是利兹对爱丁堡。利兹开始慢热，后来中段表现有所提升，但没能保持住。这次似乎有很多关于电影的问题，听到“PEI”作为答案我很高兴；不过似乎每次都出现类似的情况，没有被判错。爱丁堡队的Myles是个优秀的队长，整个团队实力强劲，配合很好。我认为他们会取得好成绩。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 13 was a curious one, with Leicester being jokey, wasting time and never getting going, while the LSE captain would often turn to the farthest player for an answer, which was not infrequently wrong. Still, LSE cleaned up. I liked the blues bonus round, though sadly Leicester got none. Canadian mentions: WL Mackenzie King and Margaret Atwood. The best part was Roger Tilling saying "Leicester Lister!"
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第13期真是很有意思的一期节目，莱斯特队开玩笑、拖延时间，而且始终发挥不出水平，而伦敦政经学院的队长经常转向最远的队员寻求答案，而且经常答错。不过，伦敦政经学院最终还是赢了。我喜欢伦敦政经学院的奖励环节，可惜莱斯特队没能获得任何奖励。加拿大提及：威廉·麦肯齐·金和玛格丽特·阿特伍德。最精彩的部分是罗杰·提林说“莱斯特·利斯特！”

src_seg: Game 14 of #UniversityChallenge was top-notch stuff, solid quizzing, down to business, fast answers, good knowledge, close ending. It seems we'll see both SOAS London and St. Edmund Hall Oxford again, because the loser makes the repechage. Very close at the finish, down to "Naples" and "pollen." An unassumingly great game.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第14期非常精彩，题目扎实，直奔主题，回答迅速，知识面广，结局扣人心弦。看来伦敦SOAS和牛津圣爱德蒙学院都有机会再次出现，因为落败者将进入复赛。在终点，竞争异常激烈，悬念集中在“那不勒斯”和“花粉”这两个词上。这是一场毫不起眼却非常精彩的比赛。

src_seg: Game 15 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of two in the repechage, where the four highest-scoring losing teams try to make it through. This week was UCL and St. Andrews, in a good-natured cheery match. Very strong play from UCL, who have a solid team, and UCL Mandel was in top form. Good questions, some tough, such as requiring "panthera" specifically or knowing "day" in Russian.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第15期是复选赛的两期节目中的第一期，四支得分最高的失利队伍将争夺晋级机会。本周是UCL和圣安德鲁斯，比赛气氛轻松愉快。UCL表现非常出色，他们拥有一支实力雄厚的队伍，UCL曼德尔发挥出色。问题设置很好，有些还比较困难，比如需要准确回答“panthera”或知道俄语中的哪一天。

src_seg: Just got to game 16 of #UniversityChallenge today, a week late, and it was a nail-biter! Really fast work at the end, with Durham coming from behind in the last few minutes to catch SOAS London in a tie in the final seconds. It went to a starter question that I got on the first clue (being an SF reader I knew "slipstream") but neither team knew. Second question and SOAS London Lambert guessed alpaca but it was llama, so Durham won. Phew, what a finish. 😰
tgt_seg: 今天看了#UniversityChallenge第16期，晚了一周，真是太刺激了！结尾部分比赛节奏很快，达勒姆大学在最后几分钟奋力反超，与伦敦SOAS大学打平，直到最后一秒。最终，关键题我根据第一个线索就猜对了（作为SF读者，我知道“slipstream”），但两队都没有猜对。第二个问题，伦敦SOAS大学的兰伯特猜了羊驼，但答案是美洲驼，所以达勒姆大学获胜。真是个惊险的结局。😰

src_seg: Game 17 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of eight knockout games in the second round. This was UCL and LSE, and UCL gave an outstanding performance: very fast buzzing, good teamwork, wide general knowledge from them all (UCL Mandel notable again); they took off at the start and never slowed. Very impressive.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第17期是第二轮八场淘汰赛的第一场。这是UCL和LSE的比赛，UCL表现出色：反应极快，团队合作默契，队员们知识面广（UCL Mandel再次表现突出）；他们一开始就遥遥领先，一骑绝尘。非常令人印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 18 of #UniversityChallenge was Durham vs Open University. I was rooting for Durham, who have a great team, but in the end to my surprise Open took it, after a number of rather slow answers. I was glad Durham got Marcel Duchamp right on one question; too bad no one knew Yoko Ono as a Fluxus artist. Much respect for Durham Nash, especially on bird silhouettes and flags.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第18场比赛是杜伦大学对阵开放大学。我支持杜伦大学，他们拥有一支很棒的队伍，但最终让我惊讶的是，开放大学获胜了，尽管他们给出了一些比较慢的答案。我很开心杜伦大学在问题中正确回答了马塞尔·杜尚；可惜没有人知道小野洋子是弗勒克苏斯艺术家。非常敬佩杜伦大学的Nash，尤其在鸟类轮廓和旗帜方面。

src_seg:
Game 19 of #UniversityChallenge was Exeter vs Bristol. Bristol got going at the start and never looked back, rolling with momentum, finishing with an incredible score. Exeter only clawed their way back to 0 after 17 minutes. 
I liked the question on common terms in Chinese place names, such as 北 (běi) in Beijing etc. Good geographic knowledge shown.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第19期是埃克塞特对阵布里斯托尔。布里斯托尔一开始就占据优势，越战越勇，最终取得了惊人的分数。埃克塞特花了17分钟才追到0分。
我喜欢关于中国地名中常见术语的问题，比如北京中的“北”(běi)等等。展现了良好的地理知识。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge is back from the Christmas alumni series, and game 20 was liked greased lightening in comparison. Darwin Cambridge Whitaker tore into questions like a monster, but everyone was in good form on that team and also on Edinburgh. Momentum changed through the game. Good quizzing. Three more games in round two, then the long quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 圣诞校友特别节目回归，第20场比赛简直风驰电掣。达尔文、剑桥、惠特克对问题争夺异常凶猛，但那个队伍和爱丁堡队的队员们都状态良好。比赛过程中，气势不断变化。答题表现不错。接下来还有三场第二轮比赛，然后是漫长的四分之一决赛。

src_seg: It's quite a change to go from the Christmas series of #UniversityChallenge, where four people didn't know the name of the narrator of Moby-Dick even when told his name is in the first sentence of the book, to the regular round, where they're racing to buzz on questions like "Fifty-three British thermal units is to grouse hunting as Sydney, Australia, is to what famous star of the London stage?"
tgt_seg: 从#UniversityChallenge的圣诞特别版，到常规环节，这其中的变化挺大的。在特别版里，有四位选手竟然不知道《白鲸记》的叙述者是谁，即便已经告诉他们这个名字出现在书的开头；而在常规环节，他们则争先恐后地抢答诸如“53英热单位与野鸡狩猎的关系，就像悉尼，澳大利亚与哪个伦敦舞台上的著名明星有关？”这样的问题。

src_seg:
Game 21 of #UniversityChallenge was Wadham Oxford vs Imperial. What a game! Astounding performance from Imperial. 
However, being King Crimson fan, I was disappointed that no one recognized them from the opening of "21st Century Schizoid Man," and dismayed when someone thought "I Zimbra" by Talking Heads (with Fripp on guitar) was by the Bee Gees. Can't have it all. I remain incredibly impressed.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第21期是Wadham牛津对阵帝国理工。太精彩了！帝国理工的表现简直太棒了！
不过作为King Crimson的粉丝，我有点失望没人从《21世纪精神分裂狂人》的开场曲中认出他们，更让人沮丧的是有人把Talking Heads的《I Zimbra》（这首歌里有Fripp参与）错当成了Bee Gees的歌。没办法，鱼与熊掌不可兼得。不过我仍然印象深刻！

src_seg: Game 22 of #UniversityChallenge was Christ's Cambridge vs St Edmund Hall Oxford, two small colleges, but that's how the rules are set up.  Nice picture round with the Dunning-Kruger effect, Asch conformity experiments, and bouba-kiki effect.  Another on mushrooms, which seemed tough to me; identifying them by eye is not easy. Solid game, good playing all around.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第二十二集是剑桥基督学院对阵牛津圣爱德蒙学院，都是规模较小的学院，但这就是规则设定的方式。 图片题设计得不错，有邓宁-克鲁格效应、阿什从众实验和布巴-基基效应。 还有一个关于蘑菇的题目，对我来说感觉挺难的；光凭眼睛很难识别。 比赛很精彩，大家表现都不错。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. Nice flag knowledge, and a good picture round identifying physical laws by diagrams of experiments. A bit too much bantz for my taste, but a solid game. One more before the quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第23期是加的夫大学对贝尔法斯特女王学院。最终得分低于我的预期，也许是错过了加分题，但抢答速度很快。旗帜知识不错，图示实验的物理定律的图片环节也表现良好。有点太轻松的玩笑，不过比赛还不错。距离四分之一决赛还有一场。

src_seg: Game 9 of #UniversityChallenge was a hell of a match. Oriel Oxford (530 students) vs Durham (20,000), and Oriel won, which surprised me after some mistakes they made. Darwin Cambridge Whitaker tore into questions like a monster, but everyone was in good form on that team and also on Edinburgh. Momentum changed through the game. Good quizzing. Three more games in round two, then the long quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 从圣诞校友系列回归，第20场比赛与之相比就像闪电一样。剑桥大学达尔文学院的惠特克像怪物一样抢答问题，但两队的每个人都表现得很好。比赛势头不断变化。很好的答题。第二轮还有三场比赛，然后是漫长的四分之一决赛。

src_seg: It's quite a change to go from the Christmas series of #UniversityChallenge, where four people didn't know the name of the narrator of Moby-Dick even when told his name is in the first sentence of the book, to the regular round, where they're racing to buzz on questions like "Fifty-three British thermal units is to grouse hunting as Sydney, Australia, is to what famous star of the London stage?"
tgt_seg: 从#UniversityChallenge 的圣诞系列到常规轮，这是一个很大的变化，圣诞系列中四个人甚至不知道《白鲸》的叙述者的名字，即使被告知他的名字在书的第一句话中，而常规轮中，他们正在竞相抢答像“五十三个英国热量单位与猎鹬是什么关系，就像澳大利亚的悉尼与伦敦舞台上的哪位著名明星有什么关系？”这样的问题。

src_seg:
Game 21 of #UniversityChallenge was Wadham Oxford vs Imperial. What a game! Astounding performance from Imperial. 
However, being King Crimson fan, I was disappointed that no one recognized them from the opening of "21st Century Schizoid Man," and dismayed when someone thought "I Zimbra" by Talking Heads (with Fripp on guitar) was by the Bee Gees. Can't have it all. I remain incredibly impressed.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第21场比赛是牛津大学沃德汉学院对阵帝国理工学院。真是一场比赛！帝国理工学院的表现令人震惊。
然而，作为国王深红乐队的粉丝，我很失望没有人从《21世纪精神分裂症人》的开场中认出他们，当有人认为Talking Heads（Fripp弹吉他）的《I Zimbra》是由比吉斯乐队演唱时，我感到很沮丧。不能事事如意。我仍然印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 22 of #UniversityChallenge was Christ's Cambridge vs St Edmund Hall Oxford, two small colleges, but that's how the rules are set up.  Nice picture round with the Dunning-Kruger effect, Asch conformity experiments, and bouba-kiki effect.  Another on mushrooms, which seemed tough to me; identifying them by eye is not easy. Solid game, good playing all around.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第22场比赛是剑桥大学基督学院对阵牛津大学圣埃德蒙德学院，两所小学院，但规则就是这样。很好的图片轮，有邓宁-克鲁格效应、阿施从众实验和布巴-基基效应。另一个关于蘑菇的，我觉得很难；用肉眼识别它们并不容易。扎实的比赛，整体表现不错。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. Nice flag knowledge, and a good picture round identifying physical laws by diagrams of experiments. A bit too much bantz for my taste, but a solid game. One more before the quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第23场比赛是卡迪夫大学对阵贝尔法斯特女王大学。得分比我预期的要低，可能是因为错过了加分，但开场问题抢答很快。很好的国旗知识，还有一个很好的图片轮，通过实验图识别物理定律。对我来说，玩笑有点多，但是一场扎实的比赛。四分之一决赛前还有一场。

src_seg: Game 9 of #UniversityChallenge was a hell of a match. Oriel Oxford (530 students) vs Durham (20,000), and Oriel won, which surprised me after some mistakes they made. The captain didn't know Wittengstein's name!? Possibly just nerves. Durham was ahead, then it was tied at 170, then they dropped to 165. A pity. I was rooting for them. Great team, with all four strong, so I hope they make the cut.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge第9场比赛是一场激烈的较量。牛津奥里尔学院（530名学生）对阵杜伦大学（20,000名学生），奥里尔获胜，这让我很意外，因为他们犯了一些错误。队长竟然不知道维特根斯坦的名字！？可能只是紧张。杜伦一度领先，然后在170分时打平，接着又跌到165分。真可惜。我为他们加油。很棒的团队，四名成员都很强，所以我希望他们能晋级。

src_seg:
Game 10 of #UniversityChallenge had a great performance by Christ's Cambridge, who have a consultative captain, a good team, and a strong member named Bethlehem, so Roger Tilling called out "Christ's Bethlehem!" Exeter Oxford never got hold of much, and are out of the running. I could see Christ's Cambridge quietly going far in this series. 
Some nice math questions, a picture round connected to food, and a tricky flag question. Good game.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第10场比赛：剑桥大学基督学院表现出色，队长善于倾听团队意见，团队配合默契，还有一位实力强劲的队员名叫伯利恒（Bethlehem），因此主持人罗杰·蒂林高喊“剑桥大学基督学院，伯利恒！”牛津大学埃克塞特学院则一直没能进入状态，最终被淘汰出局。我认为，剑桥大学基督学院很有可能在本赛季走得更远。
比赛中不仅有不错的数学题，还有与食物相关的图片题，以及一道非常棘手的关于国旗的选择题。这真是一场精彩的比赛！

src_seg: Game 11 of #UniversityChallenge was St Andrews (granted university status by an antipope!) vs Cardiff. First round is nearing its end. Some good questions, including mentions of roll-on roll-of ferries, Agnes Martin, and Stax Records. Cardiff Tarsala will never forget her Booker T bloomer, I'm afraid. Nice quizzing from both teams, though it only really got cracking in the last few minutes.
tgt_seg: #University Challenge# 第11场比赛是圣安德鲁斯大学（其大学地位曾由一位“对立教皇”授予！）对阵卡迪夫大学。第一轮比赛已接近尾声。比赛中出现了一些不错的题目，涉及滚装渡轮、艾格尼丝·马丁以及斯塔克斯唱片公司（Stax Records）等相关内容。恐怕卡迪夫大学的塔萨拉（Tarsala）永远不会忘记自己在关于“布克·T”（Booker T）那道题上的失误。两队的表现都不错，不过比赛直到最后几分钟才真正进入白热化阶段。

src_seg: Game 12 of #UniversityChallenge was Leeds vs Edinburgh. Leeds took a long time to get going, then had a surge in the middle but couldn't keep it going. Seemed like a number of film questions this time, and I was glad to hear PEI as an answer; no flags, though it seems like they crop up every time. Edinburgh Myles is a good captain and the whole team is strong and works well together. I think they'll do well.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge#第12场是利兹大学对阵爱丁堡大学。利兹大学花了很长时间才进入状态，中途一度奋起直追，但没能保持势头。这次似乎有不少电影题，很高兴听到爱德华王子岛（PEI）这个答案；没有国旗题，尽管这题型好像每场都有。爱丁堡大学的迈尔斯是位好队长，整个队伍实力很强，配合默契。我认为他们会取得好成绩。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 13 was a curious one, with Leicester being jokey, wasting time and never getting going, while the LSE captain would often turn to the farthest player for an answer, which was not infrequently wrong. Still, LSE cleaned up. I liked the blues bonus round, though sadly Leicester got none. Canadian mentions: WL Mackenzie King and Margaret Atwood. The best part was Roger Tilling saying "Leicester Lister!"
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge#第13场比赛颇具戏剧性：莱斯特大学队一直在开玩笑、浪费时间，始终未能进入比赛状态；而伦敦政治经济学院（LSE）的队长则经常向离自己最远的队员寻求答案，但那些答案往往都是错误的。尽管如此，伦敦政治经济学院还是轻松获胜。我很喜欢比赛中的附加题环节，可惜莱斯特大学队一道题都没答对。比赛中还提到了两位加拿大人物：威廉·莱昂·麦肯齐·金（William Lyon Mackenzie King）与玛格丽特·阿特伍德（Margaret Atwood）。最精彩的一幕当属主持人罗杰·蒂林（Roger Tilling）喊出“莱斯特·利斯特！”（Leicester Lister!）的那一刻。

src_seg: Game 14 of #UniversityChallenge was top-notch stuff, solid quizzing, down to business, fast answers, good knowledge, close ending. It seems we'll see both SOAS London and St. Edmund Hall Oxford again, because the loser makes the repechage. Very close at the finish, down to "Naples" and "pollen." An unassumingly great game.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge#第14场比赛堪称顶级对决：答题过程扎实，直入主题，回答迅速，知识渊博，结局紧张。看来我们还会再次见到伦敦大学亚非学院和牛津大学圣埃德蒙学院，因为败者将进入复活赛。比赛到最后关头非常胶着，胜负取决于“那不勒斯”和“花粉”这两道题。这是一场低调的精彩比赛。

src_seg: Game 15 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of two in the repechage, where the four highest-scoring losing teams try to make it through. This week was UCL and St. Andrews, in a good-natured cheery match. Very strong play from UCL, who have a solid team, and UCL Mandel was in top form. Good questions, some tough, such as requiring "panthera" specifically or knowing "day" in Russian.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge#第15场比赛是复活赛的第一场，四支在前几轮中落败但得分最高的队伍将在此争夺晋级名额。本周的比赛是伦敦大学学院（UCL）对阵圣安德鲁斯大学，这是一场气氛友好、充满乐趣的比赛。伦敦大学学院表现非常出色，团队实力雄厚，其中队员曼德尔（Mandel）状态极佳。题目设计颇具挑战性，有些问题难度较高，例如要求准确回答“豹属（Panthera）”这一生物学分类，或是知道“天”在俄语中的表达方式。

src_seg: Just got to game 16 of #UniversityChallenge today, a week late, and it was a nail-biter! Really fast work at the end, with Durham coming from behind in the last few minutes to catch SOAS London in a tie in the final seconds. It went to a starter question that I got on the first clue (being an SF reader I knew "slipstream") but neither team knew. Second question and SOAS London Lambert guessed alpaca but it was llama, so Durham won. Phew, what a finish. 😰
tgt_seg: 今天才看到#UniversityChallenge第16场比赛的内容，虽然比原定时间晚了一周，但这场比赛依然十分精彩，简直扣人心弦！比赛最后阶段的节奏非常快，杜伦大学在最后几分钟里奋起直追，最终在最后几秒与伦敦大学亚非学院（SOAS）打成平手。随后，比赛进入抢答环节。第一题的线索是“slipstream”（作为科幻小说爱好者，我知道这个词的意思），但两队竟然都未能答出正确答案。第二题，伦敦大学亚非学院的兰伯特猜测答案是“羊驼”，但实际上正确答案是“美洲驼”，因此杜伦大学最终获胜。哇，真是惊心动魄的结局！😰

src_seg: Game 17 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of eight knockout games in the second round. This was UCL and LSE, and UCL gave an outstanding performance: very fast buzzing, good teamwork, wide general knowledge from them all (UCL Mandel notable again); they took off at the start and never slowed. Very impressive.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge#第17场比赛是第二轮八场淘汰赛中的第一场。对阵双方为伦敦大学学院（UCL）与伦敦政治经济学院（LSE）。伦敦大学学院的表现非常出色：抢答速度极快，团队合作默契，所有队员知识面都很广（其中曼德尔的表现尤为突出）；他们从一开始就取得领先优势，全程保持强劲势头，从未放慢节奏。非常令人印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 18 of #UniversityChallenge was Durham vs Open University. I was rooting for Durham, who have a great team, but in the end to my surprise Open took it, after a number of rather slow answers. I was glad Durham got Marcel Duchamp right on one question; too bad no one knew Yoko Ono as a Fluxus artist. Much respect for Durham Nash, especially on bird silhouettes and flags.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge#第18场比赛是杜伦大学对阵开放大学。我原本支持杜伦大学，因为他们是一支实力强劲的队伍，但出乎我的意料，开放大学最终赢得了比赛，尽管他们在回答问题时显得有些迟缓。我很高兴杜伦大学在一道关于马塞尔·杜尚的问题上答对了；可惜没人能够认出小野洋子是激浪派（Fluxus）艺术家。我非常敬佩杜伦大学的纳什（Nash），尤其是在涉及鸟类剪影和国旗图案的问题上的出色表现。

src_seg:
Game 19 of #UniversityChallenge was Exeter vs Bristol. Bristol got going at the start and never looked back, rolling with momentum, finishing with an incredible score. Exeter only clawed their way back to 0 after 17 minutes. 
I liked the question on common terms in Chinese place names, such as 北 (běi) in Beijing etc. Good geographic knowledge shown.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge#第19场比赛是埃克塞特大学对阵布里斯托大学。布里斯托大学从比赛一开始就迅速进入状态，一路领先，最终以惊人的高分结束了比赛。而埃克塞特大学直到比赛开始17分钟后才艰难地将分数从负分追回到0分。我很喜欢那道关于中国地名中常用字的题目（比如“北京”中的“北”字），这道题很好地展现了参赛者的地理知识。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge is back from the Christmas alumni series, and game 20 was liked greased lightening in comparison. Darwin Cambridge Whitaker tore into questions like a monster, but everyone was in good form on that team and also on Edinburgh. Momentum changed through the game. Good quizzing. Three more games in round two, then the long quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: University Challenge在圣诞校友系列赛后正式回归，第20场比赛的节奏快如闪电。剑桥大学达尔文学院的惠特克（Whitaker）答题如猛兽般迅猛，他所在队伍以及爱丁堡大学的每位成员都表现十分出色。比赛中局势几度反转，竞争异常激烈。第二轮还有三场比赛，之后将进入漫长的四分之一决赛阶段。

Seemed like a number of film questions this time, and I was glad to hear PEI as an answer; no flags, though it seems like they crop up every time. Edinburgh Myles is a good captain and the whole team is strong and works well together. I think they'll do well.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第12场比赛是利兹大学对阵爱丁堡大学。利兹大学花了很长时间才进入状态，中途有过一波猛攻，但没能保持下去。这次似乎有好几道电影题，我很高兴听到有人答出 PEI；不过没有旗帜题，尽管它好像每期都会出现。爱丁堡大学的迈尔斯是一位好队长，整个团队实力强大，合作默契。我认为他们会有不错的表现。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 13 was a curious one, with Leicester being jokey, wasting time and never getting going, while the LSE captain would often turn to the farthest player for an answer, which was not infrequently wrong. Still, LSE cleaned up. I liked the blues bonus round, though sadly Leicester got none. Canadian mentions: WL Mackenzie King and Margaret Atwood. The best part was Roger Tilling saying "Leicester Lister!"
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge第13场比赛很有趣，莱斯特大学一直在开玩笑，浪费时间，始终没能进入状态；而伦敦政治经济学院的队长经常向最远的队员寻求答案，而这些答案往往是错误的。尽管如此，伦敦政治经济学院还是大获全胜。我喜欢蓝调加分轮，不过遗憾的是莱斯特大学一分未得。提到的加拿大人物：WL·麦肯齐·金和玛格丽特·阿特伍德。最精彩的部分是罗杰·蒂林喊道：“莱斯特，利斯特！”

src_seg: Game 14 of #UniversityChallenge was top-notch stuff, solid quizzing, down to business, fast answers, good knowledge, close ending. It seems we'll see both SOAS London and St. Edmund Hall Oxford again, because the loser makes the repechage. Very close at the finish, down to "Naples" and "pollen." An unassumingly great game.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第14场比赛是顶尖水平的对决，扎实的问答，直入主题，回答迅速，知识渊博，结局紧张。看来我们之后还会再次看到伦敦大学亚非学院和牛津大学圣埃德蒙学院，因为败者将进入复活赛。比赛最后非常胶着，胜负取决于关于“那不勒斯”和“花粉”的题目。一场低调而精彩的比赛。

src_seg: Game 15 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of two in the repechage, where the four highest-scoring losing teams try to make it through. This week was UCL and St. Andrews, in a good-natured cheery match. Very strong play from UCL, who have a solid team, and UCL Mandel was in top form. Good questions, some tough, such as requiring "panthera" specifically or knowing "day" in Russian.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第15场比赛是两场复活赛中的第一场，由四支得分最高的败者队伍争夺晋级名额。本周是伦敦大学学院对阵圣安德鲁斯大学，一场气氛友好愉快的比赛。伦敦大学学院发挥非常出色，他们团队实力雄厚，伦敦大学学院的曼德尔状态极佳。题目很好，有些很难，比如要求回答特定的“豹属”，或者知道俄语中的“天”怎么说。

src_seg: Just got to game 16 of #UniversityChallenge today, a week late, and it was a nail-biter! Really fast work at the end, with Durham coming from behind in the last few minutes to catch SOAS London in a tie in the final seconds. It went to a starter question that I got on the first clue (being an SF reader I knew "slipstream") but neither team knew. Second question and SOAS London Lambert guessed alpaca but it was llama, so Durham won. Phew, what a finish. 😰
tgt_seg: 今天才看了#UniversityChallenge 第16场比赛，晚了一周，真是一场紧张刺激的对决！比赛最后阶段节奏飞快，杜伦大学在最后几分钟奋起直追，在最后几秒钟追平了伦敦亚非学院。比赛进入抢答决胜题环节，第一个线索我就知道答案了（作为一个科幻小说读者，我知道“滑流派”），但两队都不知道。第二个问题，伦敦大学亚非学院的兰伯特猜了羊驼，但正确答案是大羊驼，所以杜伦大学赢了。呼，真是精彩的结局。😰

src_seg: Game 17 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of eight knockout games in the second round. This was UCL and LSE, and UCL gave an outstanding performance: very fast buzzing, good teamwork, wide general knowledge from them all (UCL Mandel notable again); they took off at the start and never slowed. Very impressive.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第17场比赛是第二轮八场淘汰赛中的第一场。对阵双方是伦敦大学学院和伦敦政治经济学院，伦敦大学学院的表现极为出色：抢答迅速，团队合作默契，所有队员常识知识面都很广（伦敦大学学院的曼德尔再次表现抢眼）；他们从一开始就一路领先，从未放慢脚步。令人印象非常深刻。

src_seg: Game 18 of #UniversityChallenge was Durham vs Open University. I was rooting for Durham, who have a great team, but in the end to my surprise Open took it, after a number of rather slow answers. I was glad Durham got Marcel Duchamp right on one question; too bad no one knew Yoko Ono as a Fluxus artist. Much respect for Durham Nash, especially on bird silhouettes and flags.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第18场比赛是杜伦大学对阵开放大学。我本来支持杜伦大学，他们队伍很棒，但最终令我惊讶的是开放大学获胜了，尽管他们的回答相当缓慢。我很高兴杜伦大学在一道题上答对了马塞尔·杜尚；遗憾的是，没人知道小野洋子是一位激浪派艺术家。非常敬佩杜伦大学的纳什，尤其是在鸟类剪影和旗帜问题上的表现。

src_seg:
Game 19 of #UniversityChallenge was Exeter vs Bristol. Bristol got going at the start and never looked back, rolling with momentum, finishing with an incredible score. Exeter only clawed their way back to 0 after 17 minutes. 
I liked the question on common terms in Chinese place names, such as 北 (běi) in Beijing etc. Good geographic knowledge shown.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第19场比赛是埃克塞特大学对阵布里斯托大学。布里斯托大学从一开始就进入状态，然后一路高歌猛进，势不可挡，以惊人的高分结束比赛。埃克塞特大学在17分钟后才艰难地将分数追回到0分。
我喜欢那道关于中国地名中常用词的问题，比如北京的“北”字等等。展现了出色的地理知识。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge is back from the Christmas alumni series, and game 20 was liked greased lightening in comparison. Darwin Cambridge Whitaker tore into questions like a monster, but everyone was in good form on that team and also on Edinburgh. Momentum changed through the game. Good quizzing. Three more games in round two, then the long quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 从圣诞校友赛回归了，相比之下，第20场比赛快如闪电。剑桥大学达尔文学院的惠特克像一头猛兽般地回答问题，不过那支队伍和爱丁堡大学队的每个人状态都很好。比赛的势头几经转换。精彩的答题。第二轮还有三场比赛，然后是漫长的四分之一决赛。

src_seg: It's quite a change to go from the Christmas series of #UniversityChallenge, where four people didn't know the name of the narrator of Moby-Dick even when told his name is in the first sentence of the book, to the regular round, where they're racing to buzz on questions like "Fifty-three British thermal units is to grouse hunting as Sydney, Australia, is to what famous star of the London stage?"
tgt_seg: 从#UniversityChallenge圣诞系列赛转到常规赛真是天壤之别，在圣诞系列赛中，即使告诉四个人《白鲸》叙述者的名字就在书的第一句话中，他们都不知道，而在常规赛中，他们争相抢答诸如"五十三英热单位之于松鸡狩猎，如同澳大利亚悉尼之于伦敦舞台上的哪位著名明星？"这样的题目。

src_seg:
Game 21 of #UniversityChallenge was Wadham Oxford vs Imperial. What a game! Astounding performance from Imperial. 
However, being King Crimson fan, I was disappointed that no one recognized them from the opening of "21st Century Schizoid Man," and dismayed when someone thought "I Zimbra" by Talking Heads (with Fripp on guitar) was by the Bee Gees. Can't have it all. I remain incredibly impressed.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第21场比赛是牛津沃德姆学院对阵帝国理工学院。真是一场精彩的比赛！帝国学院的表现令人惊叹。
不过，作为King Crimson的粉丝，我很失望没人从《21st Century Schizoid Man》的开头认出他们，当有人认为Talking Heads的《I Zimbra》（弗里普担任吉他手）是Bee Gees的作品时，我更是沮丧。不能尽如人意，但我依然非常钦佩他们。

src_seg: Game 22 of #UniversityChallenge was Christ's Cambridge vs St Edmund Hall Oxford, two small colleges, but that's how the rules are set up.  Nice picture round with the Dunning-Kruger effect, Asch conformity experiments, and bouba-kiki effect.  Another on mushrooms, which seemed tough to me; identifying them by eye is not easy. Solid game, good playing all around.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第22场比赛是剑桥大学基督学院对阵牛津大学圣埃德蒙学院，两所都是小型学院，但规则就是这么设定的。图片题很不错，涉及邓宁-克鲁格效应、阿希从众实验和波巴-奇奇效应。还有一轮关于蘑菇的题目，对我来说似乎很难；通过肉眼识别它们可不容易。一场硬核的比赛，双方都发挥得很好。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. Nice flag knowledge, and a good picture round identifying physical laws by diagrams of experiments. A bit too much bantz for my taste, but a solid game. One more before the quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge第23场比赛是卡迪夫大学对阵贝尔法斯特女王大学。最终分数比我预期的要低，可能是因为错过了加分题，但抢答题回答得很快。不错的旗帜知识，还有一轮很好的图片题，通过实验图表来识别物理定律。对我来说玩笑话有点太多了，但仍然是一场很棒的比赛。距离四分之一决赛还剩最后一场。

src_seg: Game 9 of #UniversityChallenge was a hell of a match. Oriel Oxford (530 students) vs Durham (20,000), and Oriel won, which surprised me after some mistakes they made. The captain didn't know Wittengstein's name!? Possibly just nerves. Durham was ahead, then it was tied at 170, then they dropped to 165. A pity. I was rooting for them. Great team, with all four strong, so I hope they make the cut.
tgt_seg: 第9场#UniversityChallenge的比赛非常激烈。奥里尔牛津大学（530名学生）vs达勒姆大学（20,000名学生），奥里尔牛津大学赢得了比赛，这让我感到惊讶，因为他们之前犯了几个错误。队长不知道维特根斯坦的名字？可能只是紧张。达勒姆大学一度领先，后来又和奥里尔牛津大学打平，最后他们的分数掉到165分。真可惜。我一直支持他们。他们是一个强大的团队，四个成员都很强大，所以我希望他们能通过。

src_seg:
Game 10 of #UniversityChallenge had a great performance by Christ's Cambridge, who have a consultative captain, a good team, and a strong member named Bethlehem, so Roger Tilling called out "Christ's Bethlehem!" Exeter Oxford never got hold of much, and are out of the running. I could see Christ's Cambridge quietly going far in this series. 
Some nice math questions, a picture round connected to food, and a tricky flag question. Good game.
tgt_seg:
第10场#UniversityChallenge的比赛由基督学院剑桥大学表现出色，他们有一个咨询性的队长，一个强大的团队，一个叫贝塞伦的成员，所以罗杰·蒂林称呼他们“基督学院贝塞伦！”牛津大学的埃克塞特从来没有抓住机会，已经被淘汰了。我可以看出基督学院剑桥大学在这个系列中会取得很好的成绩。
这个比赛有很多好问题，包括一个与食物相关的图像题和一个困难的国旗题。很好的比赛。

src_seg: Game 11 of #UniversityChallenge was St Andrews (granted university status by an antipope!) vs Cardiff. First round is nearing its end. Some good questions, including mentions of roll-on roll-of ferries, Agnes Martin, and Stax Records. Cardiff Tarsala will never forget her Booker T bloomer, I'm afraid. Nice quizzing from both teams, though it only really got cracking in the last few minutes.
tgt_seg: 第11场#UniversityChallenge的比赛是圣安德鲁斯大学（被反教皇授予大学地位！）vs卡迪夫大学。第一轮快要结束了。有很多好问题，包括提到了轮船、安吉斯·马丁和斯塔克斯唱片。卡迪夫大学的塔萨拉会永远记得她在博克·T的比赛中犯下的错误，我很抱歉。双方都表现出色，尽管只有最后几分钟才真正开始。

src_seg: Game 12 of #UniversityChallenge was Leeds vs Edinburgh. Leeds took a long time to get going, then had a surge in the middle but couldn't keep it going. Seemed like a number of film questions this time, and I was glad to hear PEI as an answer; no flags, though it seems like they crop up every time. Edinburgh Myles is a good captain and the whole team is strong and works well together. I think they'll do well.
tgt_seg: 第12场#UniversityChallenge的比赛是利兹大学vs爱丁堡大学。利兹大学花了很长时间才开始，然后在中间突然爆发，但最后他们还是没能保持下去。这个比赛似乎有很多电影题，我很高兴听到PEI作为答案；没有国旗题，似乎每次都有国旗题。爱丁堡大学的迈尔斯队长是一个很好的队长，整个团队都很强大，合作得很好。我认为他们会取得很好的成绩。

Nice picture round with the Dunning-Kruger effect, Asch conformity experiments, and bouba-kiki effect.  Another on mushrooms, which seemed tough to me; identifying them by eye is not easy. Solid game, good playing all around.
tgt_seg: 第22场#UniversityChallenge是基督学院剑桥大学vs圣埃德蒙德霍尔牛津大学，这两个都是小型学院，但这就是规则。有一个很好的图像题，题目是Dunning-Kruger效应、阿什同调实验和bouba-kiki效应。还有一个关于蘑菇的题目，似乎很难回答，通过眼睛识别蘑菇不是容易的。很好的比赛，所有人都表现出色。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. Nice flag knowledge, and a good picture round identifying physical laws by diagrams of experiments. A bit too much bantz for my taste, but a solid game. One more before the quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: 第23场#UniversityChallenge是卡迪夫大学vs皇后大学贝尔法斯特。最后的分数比我想象的要低，可能是因为错过了加分题，但starter题都很快答对。有很好的国旗知识，图像题也很好，包括通过实验图解的物理定律。有点太多的玩笑了，但总体来说是一个很好的比赛。还有一个比赛就要进入四分之一决赛了。

src_seg: Game 9 of #UniversityChallenge was a hell of a match. Oriel Oxford (530 students) vs Durham (20,000), and Oriel won, which surprised me after some mistakes they made. The captain didn't know Wittengstein's name!? Possibly just nerves. Durham was ahead, then it was tied at 170, then they dropped to 165. A pity. I was rooting for them. Great team, with all four strong, so I hope they make the cut.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第九轮比赛真是精彩纷呈。牛津大学奥里尔学院（530名学生）对阵达勒姆大学（20,000名学生），奥里尔学院获胜，这让我有些惊讶，因为他们犯了一些错误。队长不知道维滕斯坦的名字！？可能是紧张。达勒姆大学领先，然后比分达到170平，然后降至165。太可惜了。我一直在为他们加油。这是一支伟大的队伍，四个人都很强，所以我希望他们能晋级。

src_seg:
Game 10 of #UniversityChallenge had a great performance by Christ's Cambridge, who have a consultative captain, a good team, and a strong member named Bethlehem, so Roger Tilling called out "Christ's Bethlehem!" Exeter Oxford never got hold of much, and are out of the running. I could see Christ's Cambridge quietly going far in this series. 
Some nice math questions, a picture round connected to food, and a tricky flag question. Good game.
tgt_seg:
在 #UniversityChallenge 的第 10 轮比赛中，剑桥基督学院表现出色，他们有一位富有洞察力的队长、一支优秀的团队，以及一位名叫伯利恒的强力成员，因此罗杰·蒂林（Roger Tilling）大声喊出了“基督学院的伯利恒！”埃克塞特牛津队几乎没有得分，已经落败。我可以预见剑桥基督学院在这一系列比赛中会取得不错的成绩。
一些不错的数学题、一个与食物相关的图片题以及一个棘手的国旗问题。这是一场精彩的比赛。

src_seg: Game 11 of #UniversityChallenge was St Andrews (granted university status by an antipope!) vs Cardiff. First round is nearing its end. Some good questions, including mentions of roll-on roll-of ferries, Agnes Martin, and Stax Records. Cardiff Tarsala will never forget her Booker T bloomer, I'm afraid. Nice quizzing from both teams, though it only really got cracking in the last few minutes.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 的第 11 轮比赛是圣安德鲁斯大学（由反教皇授予大学地位！）对阵加的夫。第一轮即将结束。有些问题很好，包括轮渡、阿格尼丝·马丁和 Stax Records 的提法。恐怕加的夫的 Tarsala 会永远记住她的 Booker T 的失误。两支队伍的测验都很好，不过真正精彩的部分是在最后几分钟。

src_seg: Game 12 of #UniversityChallenge was Leeds vs Edinburgh. Leeds took a long time to get going, then had a surge in the middle but couldn't keep it going. Seemed like a number of film questions this time, and I was glad to hear PEI as an answer; no flags, though it seems like they crop up every time. Edinburgh Myles is a good captain and the whole team is strong and works well together. I think they'll do well.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 的第 12 轮比赛是利兹队对阵爱丁堡队。利兹队起步较慢，然后在中间阶段有所提升，但没能保持下去。这次似乎有很多电影相关的问题，我很高兴听到 PEI 是一个答案；没有出现任何错误，尽管它们似乎每次都会出现。爱丁堡的 Myles 是一个优秀的队长，整个团队都很强大，而且合作得很好。我认为他们会表现得很好。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 13 was a curious one, with Leicester being jokey, wasting time and never getting going, while the LSE captain would often turn to the farthest player for an answer, which was not infrequently wrong. Still, LSE cleaned up. I liked the blues bonus round, though sadly Leicester got none. Canadian mentions: WL Mackenzie King and Margaret Atwood. The best part was Roger Tilling saying "Leicester Lister!"
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第13期很有趣，莱斯特队开玩笑了，浪费时间，始终没能进入状态，而LSE队长经常转向最远的选手寻求答案，这往往是错误的。尽管如此，LSE还是赢得了胜利。我喜欢蓝队的加分环节，可惜莱斯特队没有得到任何加分。加拿大相关内容：WL·麦肯齐·金和玛格丽特·阿特伍德。最精彩的部分是罗杰·蒂林说“莱斯特·利斯特！”

src_seg: Game 14 of #UniversityChallenge was top-notch stuff, solid quizzing, down to business, fast answers, good knowledge, close ending. It seems we'll see both SOAS London and St. Edmund Hall Oxford again, because the loser makes the repechage. Very close at the finish, down to "Naples" and "pollen." An unassumingly great game.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 的第 14 轮比赛非常精彩，问题严谨，紧迫感十足，回答迅速，知识面广，结局紧张。看起来我们会再次看到伦敦 SOAS 和牛津圣埃德蒙德大厅的比赛，因为输的一方将参加复活赛。比赛非常激烈，最终缩小到“那不勒斯”和“花粉”。这是一场出乎意料的精彩比赛。

src_seg: Game 15 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of two in the repechage, where the four highest-scoring losing teams try to make it through. This week was UCL and St. Andrews, in a good-natured cheery match. Very strong play from UCL, who have a solid team, and UCL Mandel was in top form. Good questions, some tough, such as requiring "panthera" specifically or knowing "day" in Russian.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第 15 轮是附加赛的两轮中的第一轮，四支得分最高的落败队伍在此轮比赛中努力争取晋级。本周的比赛由 UCL 和圣安德鲁斯大学参加，是一场友好的欢快比赛。UCL 表现非常出色，他们拥有一支实力雄厚的队伍，UCL 曼德尔更是状态极佳。问题很好，有些很难，比如需要具体说出“panthera”或知道俄语中的“day”。

src_seg: Just got to game 16 of #UniversityChallenge today, a week late, and it was a nail-biter! Really fast work at the end, with Durham coming from behind in the last few minutes to catch SOAS London in a tie in the final seconds. It went to a starter question that I got on the first clue (being an SF reader I knew "slipstream") but neither team knew. Second question and SOAS London Lambert guessed alpaca but it was llama, so Durham won. Phew, what a finish. 😰
tgt_seg: 今天才赶上第 16 场 #UniversityChallenge 的比赛，比预定时间晚了整整一周，真是惊险万分！最后几分钟比赛非常激烈，达勒姆大学在最后几分钟逆转，在最后几秒与伦敦 SOAS 大学并列。比赛最终以一个我第一个提示就能答对的开场问题而定（作为 SF 的读者，我知道“滑流”），但两个队伍都答错了。第二个问题，伦敦 SOAS 大学的拉姆伯特猜的是羊驼，但正确答案是拉马，所以达勒姆大学赢了。哇，真是惊险的结局。😰

src_seg: Game 17 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of eight knockout games in the second round. This was UCL and LSE, and UCL gave an outstanding performance: very fast buzzing, good teamwork, wide general knowledge from them all (UCL Mandel notable again); they took off at the start and never slowed. Very impressive.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第 17 轮是第二轮八强淘汰赛的第一轮。这次是 UCL 和 LSE 对决，UCL 表现出色：反应非常快，团队合作好，知识面广（UCL 曼德尔再次表现突出）；他们一开始就冲刺，从未放慢脚步。非常令人印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 18 of #UniversityChallenge was Durham vs Open University. I was rooting for Durham, who have a great team, but in the end to my surprise Open took it, after a number of rather slow answers. I was glad Durham got Marcel Duchamp right on one question; too bad no one knew Yoko Ono as a Fluxus artist. Much respect for Durham Nash, especially on bird silhouettes and flags.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 的第 18 轮比赛是达勒姆大学对阵开放大学。我支持达勒姆大学，因为他们有一个很棒的团队，但最后令我惊讶的是，开放大学在回答了一系列相当缓慢的问题后赢得了比赛。我很高兴达勒姆大学在其中一个问题上正确回答了马塞尔·杜尚；太遗憾了，没有人知道洋子是一位 Fluxus 艺术家。我对达勒姆大学的纳什表示深深的敬意，尤其是在鸟类剪影和旗帜方面。

src_seg:
Game 19 of #UniversityChallenge was Exeter vs Bristol. Bristol got going at the start and never looked back, rolling with momentum, finishing with an incredible score. Exeter only clawed their way back to 0 after 17 minutes. 
I liked the question on common terms in Chinese place names, such as 北 (běi) in Beijing etc. Good geographic knowledge shown.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 的第 19 轮比赛是埃克塞特大学对阵布里斯托尔大学。布里斯托尔大学一开始就占据了上风，并一直保持领先，最终以一个令人难以置信的比分获胜。埃克塞特大学在 17 分钟后才艰难地追回了 0 分。
我喜欢关于中国地名中常见用词的问题，例如北京的“北”（běi）等。这显示出良好的地理知识。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge is back from the Christmas alumni series, and game 20 was liked greased lightening in comparison. Darwin Cambridge Whitaker tore into questions like a monster, but everyone was in good form on that team and also on Edinburgh. Momentum changed through the game. Good quizzing. Three more games in round two, then the long quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛从圣诞校友系列回来，与之相比，第20场比赛简直如行云流水。达尔文·剑桥·惠特克像一头野兽一样猛攻问题，但该队以及爱丁堡队都表现得非常出色。比赛过程中，势头发生了变化。问答环节很棒。第二轮还有三场比赛，然后是漫长的四分之一决赛。

src_seg: It's quite a change to go from the Christmas series of #UniversityChallenge, where four people didn't know the name of the narrator of Moby-Dick even when told his name is in the first sentence of the book, to the regular round, where they're racing to buzz on questions like "Fifty-three British thermal units is to grouse hunting as Sydney, Australia, is to what famous star of the London stage?"
tgt_seg: 从圣诞节系列的《大学挑战》开始，四个人连《Moby-Dick》讲述者的名字都不知道，即使有人告诉他们书的第一句就提到了这个名字，到常规轮，他们争先恐后地抢答诸如“53英热单位对火鸡狩猎来说意味着什么，就像澳大利亚悉尼对伦敦舞台上哪位著名明星来说意味着什么？”这样的问题，变化可真大。

src_seg:
Game 21 of #UniversityChallenge was Wadham Oxford vs Imperial. What a game! Astounding performance from Imperial. 
However, being King Crimson fan, I was disappointed that no one recognized them from the opening of "21st Century Schizoid Man," and dismayed when someone thought "I Zimbra" by Talking Heads (with Fripp on guitar) was by the Bee Gees. Can't have it all. I remain incredibly impressed.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 的第二十一期比赛是牛津大学的 Wadham 学院对阵帝国理工学院。真是精彩的比赛！帝国理工学院的表现令人惊叹。
然而，作为一位深爱的金士瑞姆乐迷，我很失望没有人能从《21st Century Schizoid Man》的开场就能认出他们，而且当有人认为 Talking Heads 的《I Zimbra》（Fripp 担任吉他手）是 Bee Gees 的时候，我感到很沮丧。不能兼得。我仍然非常佩服。

src_seg: Game 22 of #UniversityChallenge was Christ's Cambridge vs St Edmund Hall Oxford, two small colleges, but that's how the rules are set up.  Nice picture round with the Dunning-Kruger effect, Asch conformity experiments, and bouba-kiki effect.  Another on mushrooms, which seemed tough to me; identifying them by eye is not easy. Solid game, good playing all around.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 的第二十二期比赛是剑桥大学克莱斯特学院对阵牛津大学圣埃德蒙大楼，这两个学院规模不大，但这就是比赛规则的设定。图片轮考验不错，涉及邓宁-克鲁格效应、阿施从众实验和布巴-基基效应。还有关于蘑菇的题目，我觉得挺难的；凭肉眼辨别它们并不容易。比赛很精彩，各方表现都很出色。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. Nice flag knowledge, and a good picture round identifying physical laws by diagrams of experiments. A bit too much bantz for my taste, but a solid game. One more before the quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第二十三轮比赛是卡迪夫队对阵贝尔法斯特皇后大学队。最终得分低于我的预期，可能是因为错过了加分，但发问者回答得很快。不错的国旗知识，还有通过实验图解识别物理定律的图片轮。对我来说，有些过于调侃，但总体是一场不错的比赛。还有最后一轮，就要进入四分之一决赛了。

src_seg: Game 9 of #UniversityChallenge was a hell of a match. Oriel Oxford (530 students) vs Durham (20,000), and Oriel won, which surprised me after some mistakes they made. The captain didn't know Wittengstein's name!? Possibly just nerves. Durham was ahead, then it was tied at 170, then they dropped to 165. A pity. I was rooting for them. Great team, with all four strong, so I hope they make the cut.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛# 的第9场比赛是一场激烈的较量。牛津奥里埃尔学院（530名学生）对阵达勒姆大学（20,000人），结果奥里埃尔学院获胜，这让我感到惊讶，因为他们之前犯了一些错误。队长居然不知道维特根斯坦（Wittengstein）的名字！可能是太紧张了。达勒姆大学一度领先，然后战成170平，但最后降至165分。真是遗憾。我原本在为他们加油。这支队伍很强大，四个成员都非常出色，所以我希望他们能晋级。

src_seg:
Game 10 of #UniversityChallenge had a great performance by Christ's Cambridge, who have a consultative captain, a good team, and a strong member named Bethlehem, so Roger Tilling called out "Christ's Bethlehem!" Exeter Oxford never got hold of much, and are out of the running. I could see Christ's Cambridge quietly going far in this series. 
Some nice math questions, a picture round connected to food, and a tricky flag question. Good game.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛# 的第10场比赛，剑桥基督学院表现出色，他们的队长有咨询能力，队伍整体不错，还有一个名叫贝特勒姆（Bethlehem）的强将，所以罗杰·蒂林（Roger Tilling）大叫“基督的贝特勒姆！”牛津埃克塞特学院一直没有占据上风，已经出局了。我觉得剑桥基督学院在这届比赛中可能会悄悄走得很远。一些不错的数学题，一轮与食物相关的图片题，还有一道棘手的旗帜题。精彩的比赛。

src_seg: Game 11 of #UniversityChallenge was St Andrews (granted university status by an antipope!) vs Cardiff. First round is nearing its end. Some good questions, including mentions of roll-on roll-of ferries, Agnes Martin, and Stax Records. Cardiff Tarsala will never forget her Booker T bloomer, I'm afraid. Nice quizzing from both teams, though it only really got cracking in the last few minutes.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛# 的第11场比赛是圣安德鲁斯大学（由一位对立教皇授予大学地位！）对阵卡迪夫大学。第一轮即将结束。一些不错的问题，包括提到滚装滚卸渡轮、阿格尼斯·马丁（Agnes Martin）和Stax唱片公司。卡迪夫大学的Tarsala永远不会忘记她在Booker T比赛中的失误，我想。两支队伍都表现不错，但真正开始激烈竞争的只有最后几分钟。

Seemed like a number of film questions this time, and I was glad to hear PEI as an answer; no flags, though it seems like they crop up every time. Edinburgh Myles is a good captain and the whole team is strong and works well together. I think they'll do well.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛# 的第12场比赛是利兹大学对阵爱丁堡大学。利兹大学花了很长时间才进入状态，然后在中间阶段有一段冲刺，但没能保持下去。这次似乎有很多电影问题，我很高兴听到PEI作为答案；不过没有旗帜题，虽然它们似乎每次都会出现。爱丁堡大学的Myles是一名优秀的队长，整个队伍很强大，合作得很好。我认为他们会表现出色。

tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛# 的第13场比赛很有趣，莱斯特大学开玩笑、拖延时间，一直没有进入状态，而伦敦经济学院（LSE）的队长经常转身向最远的球员寻求答案，但答案经常是错误的。尽管如此，伦敦经济学院还是赢得了比赛。我喜欢蓝调奖励轮，但遗憾的是莱斯特大学没有获得任何奖励。提到加拿大的人物：WL麦肯齐·金（WL Mackenzie King）和玛格丽特·阿特伍德（Margaret Atwood）。最好的一部分是罗杰·蒂林（Roger Tilling）说“莱斯特的莱斯特！”

tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛# 的第14场比赛是顶级赛事，扎实的问答，直接进入主题，快速回答，知识渊博，结局非常接近。看来我们将再次看到伦敦SOAS大学和牛津圣埃德蒙堂学院，因为输掉的比赛会进入复活赛。最后阶段非常接近，最终以“那不勒斯”和“花粉”作为答案。不显山露水但非常精彩的一场比赛。

Good questions, some tough, such as requiring "panthera" specifically or knowing "day" in Russian.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛# 的第15场比赛是复活赛的第一场，四支最高分输球队伍将试图晋级。本周是伦敦大学学院（UCL）和圣安德鲁斯大学，这是一场充满善意和欢笑的比赛。伦敦大学学院的表现非常出色，他们拥有一支坚实的队伍，而UCL的Mandel表现出色。一些不错的问题，有些很难，例如需要具体提到“豹（panthera）”或知道俄语中的“天（day）”。

Really fast work at the end, with Durham coming from behind in the last few minutes to catch SOAS London in a tie in the final seconds. It went to a starter question that I got on the first clue (being an SF reader I knew "slipstream") but neither team knew. This was UCL and LSE, and UCL gave an outstanding performance: very fast buzzing, good teamwork, wide general knowledge from them all (UCL Mandel notable again); they took off at the start and never slowed. Very impressive.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛# 的第17场比赛是八强赛的第一场。这是伦敦大学学院（UCL）对阵伦敦经济学院（LSE）的比赛，UCL表现出色：非常快的按铃，良好的团队合作，广泛的常识（UCL的Mandel再次值得一提）；他们从一开始就领先，从未放慢速度。非常令人印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 18 of #UniversityChallenge was Durham vs Open University. I was rooting for Durham, who have a great team, but in the end to my surprise Open took it, after a number of rather slow answers. I was glad Durham got Marcel Duchamp right on one question; too bad no one knew Yoko Ono as a Fluxus artist. Much respect for Durham Nash, especially on bird silhouettes and flags.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛# 的第18场比赛是达勒姆大学对阵开放大学。我原本在为达勒姆大学加油，他们有一支优秀的队伍，但最后出人意料地被开放大学击败，这可能是因为他们给出了几条相当慢的答案。我很高兴达勒姆大学在其中一道题中正确地识别了马塞尔·杜尚（Marcel Duchamp）；遗憾的是，没有人知道小野洋子（Yoko Ono）是Fluxus艺术家。非常尊重达勒姆的Nash，尤其是在识别鸟的轮廓和旗帜方面。

src_seg:
Game 19 of #UniversityChallenge was Exeter vs Bristol. Bristol got going at the start and never looked back, rolling with momentum, finishing with an incredible score. Exeter only clawed their way back to 0 after 17 minutes. 
I liked the question on common terms in Chinese place names, such as 北 (běi) in Beijing etc. Good geographic knowledge shown.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛# 的第19场比赛是埃克塞特大学对阵布里斯托大学。布里斯托大学从一开始就占据上风，并一直保持领先，势如破竹，最终获得令人难以置信的高分。埃克塞特大学在17分钟后才艰难地追平了0分。我喜欢关于中文地名中常见词语的问题，比如北京中的“北（běi）”。展示了很好的地理知识。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge is back from the Christmas alumni series, and game 20 was liked greased lightening in comparison. Darwin Cambridge Whitaker tore into questions like a monster, but everyone was in good form on that team and also on Edinburgh. Momentum changed through the game. Good quizzing. Three more games in round two, then the long quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛# 在圣诞校友系列赛后回归，第20场比赛就像闪电般迅速。剑桥达尔文学院的Whitaker像怪物一样迅速地回答问题，但这支队伍的所有成员都表现得非常出色，爱丁堡大学也表现不错。比赛的势头不断变化。精彩的问答环节。还有三场比赛是八强赛，然后是漫长的四分之一决赛。

src_seg: It's quite a change to go from the Christmas series of #UniversityChallenge, where four people didn't know the name of the narrator of Moby-Dick even when told his name is in the first sentence of the book, to the regular round, where they're racing to buzz on questions like "Fifty-three British thermal units is to grouse hunting as Sydney, Australia, is to what famous star of the London stage?"
tgt_seg: 从圣诞系列赛#大学挑战赛# 过渡到常规赛，变化很大，在圣诞系列赛中，四个人甚至不知道《白鲸》的叙述者名字，尽管书的第一句话就提到了他的名字，而常规赛中，他们正在争夺按铃回答的问题，例如：“53英国热量单位与猎雉鸡有关，悉尼，澳大利亚，与伦敦舞台上哪位著名明星有关？”

src_seg:
Game 21 of #UniversityChallenge was Wadham Oxford vs Imperial. What a game! Astounding performance from Imperial. 
However, being King Crimson fan, I was disappointed that no one recognized them from the opening of "21st Century Schizoid Man," and dismayed when someone thought "I Zimbra" by Talking Heads (with Fripp on guitar) was by the Bee Gees. Can't have it all. I remain incredibly impressed.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛# 的第21场比赛是牛津瓦德汉学院对阵帝国理工学院。这是一场精彩的比赛！帝国理工学院表现令人惊叹。然而，作为国王红色（King Crimson）的粉丝，我感到失望的是，没有人从“21世纪精神分裂人”的开头认出他们，当有人认为由弗里普（Fripp）弹吉他的“I Zimbra”是蜂鸟组合（Bee Gees）的歌曲时，我感到很沮丧。不能都拥有。我仍然非常印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 22 of #UniversityChallenge was Christ's Cambridge vs St Edmund Hall Oxford, two small colleges, but that's how the rules are set up.  Nice picture round with the Dunning-Kruger effect, Asch conformity experiments, and bouba-kiki effect.  Another on mushrooms, which seemed tough to me; identifying them by eye is not easy. Solid game, good playing all around.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛# 的第22场比赛是剑桥基督学院对阵牛津圣埃德蒙堂学院，两所学院规模较小，但这是规则的设定方式。一轮有趣的图片题，包括邓宁-克鲁格效应、阿什（Asch）符合实验和bouba-kiki效应。还有一轮关于蘑菇的问题，对我来说似乎很困难；仅凭眼睛识别它们并不容易。精彩的比赛，所有人都表现出色。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. Nice flag knowledge, and a good picture round identifying physical laws by diagrams of experiments. A bit too much bantz for my taste, but a solid game. One more before the quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛# 的第23场比赛是卡迪夫大学对阵贝尔法斯特女王大学。最终得分比我预期的要低，可能是因为错过了奖励题，但启动题被快速按铃。不错的旗帜知识，还有一轮通过实验图表识别物理定律的图片题。有点太多玩笑了，但是一场扎实的比赛。四分之一决赛还有一场比赛。

src_seg: Game 9 of #UniversityChallenge was a hell of a match. Oriel Oxford (530 students) vs Durham (20,000), and Oriel won, which surprised me after some mistakes they made. The captain didn't know Wittengstein's name!? Possibly just nerves. Durham was ahead, then it was tied at 170, then they dropped to 165. A pity. I was rooting for them. Great team, with all four strong, so I hope they make the cut.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第9场比赛真是一场精彩的对决。牛津奥里尔学院（530名学生）对阵杜伦大学（2万名学生），结果奥里尔获胜，这让我很惊讶，毕竟他们中间还出现了一些失误。队长竟然不知道维特根斯坦的名字！？可能只是紧张吧。杜伦一度领先，后来打成170平，之后又掉到165分。真可惜。我一直在为他们加油。这是一支很棒的队伍，四个人都很强，希望他们能晋级。

src_seg:
Game 10 of #UniversityChallenge had a great performance by Christ's Cambridge, who have a consultative captain, a good team, and a strong member named Bethlehem, so Roger Tilling called out "Christ's Bethlehem!" Exeter Oxford never got hold of much, and are out of the running. I could see Christ's Cambridge quietly going far in this series. 
Some nice math questions, a picture round connected to food, and a tricky flag question. Good game.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第10场比赛，剑桥基督学院表现出色，队长善于商议，团队配合很好，还有一位叫Bethlehem的强力队员，所以Roger Tilling喊出了“Christ's Bethlehem！”牛津埃克塞特学院几乎没能掌控比赛，已经被淘汰。我觉得剑桥基督学院有望在本季中悄悄走得很远。
有一些很棒的数学题，一轮与食物相关的图片题，还有一道很难的国旗题。好比赛。

src_seg: Game 11 of #UniversityChallenge was St Andrews (granted university status by an antipope!) vs Cardiff. First round is nearing its end. Some good questions, including mentions of roll-on roll-of ferries, Agnes Martin, and Stax Records. Cardiff Tarsala will never forget her Booker T bloomer, I'm afraid. Nice quizzing from both teams, though it only really got cracking in the last few minutes.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第11场比赛是圣安德鲁斯大学（由一位反教皇授予大学地位！）对阵卡迪夫大学。第一轮快要结束了。有一些很好的题目，包括滚装船、阿格尼丝·马丁和Stax唱片公司的相关内容。卡迪夫的Tarsala恐怕永远不会忘记她关于Booker T的失误。两队的答题都很精彩，不过真正激烈是在最后几分钟。

src_seg: Game 12 of #UniversityChallenge was Leeds vs Edinburgh. Leeds took a long time to get going, then had a surge in the middle but couldn't keep it going. Seemed like a number of film questions this time, and I was glad to hear PEI as an answer; no flags, though it seems like they crop up every time. Edinburgh Myles is a good captain and the whole team is strong and works well together. I think they'll do well.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第12场比赛是利兹大学对爱丁堡大学。利兹一开始很慢热，中段发力但没能保持住。这次似乎有不少电影相关的问题，我很高兴听到PEI作为答案；没有国旗题，虽然感觉每次都会出现。爱丁堡的Myles是个很好的队长，整个团队都很强，配合默契。我觉得他们会有不错的表现。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 13 was a curious one, with Leicester being jokey, wasting time and never getting going, while the LSE captain would often turn to the farthest player for an answer, which was not infrequently wrong. Still, LSE cleaned up. I liked the blues bonus round, though sadly Leicester got none. Canadian mentions: WL Mackenzie King and Margaret Atwood. The best part was Roger Tilling saying "Leicester Lister!"
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第13场比赛有点奇特，莱斯特大学开玩笑、浪费时间，始终没能进入状态，而伦敦政治经济学院的队长经常向最远的队员求答案，但答案也常常不对。即便如此，LSE还是大获全胜。我很喜欢蓝色主题的加分题，可惜莱斯特一分未得。加拿大相关内容有：WL麦肯齐·金和玛格丽特·阿特伍德。最有趣的是Roger Tilling喊出“Leicester Lister！”

src_seg: Game 14 of #UniversityChallenge was top-notch stuff, solid quizzing, down to business, fast answers, good knowledge, close ending. It seems we'll see both SOAS London and St. Edmund Hall Oxford again, because the loser makes the repechage. Very close at the finish, down to "Naples" and "pollen." An unassumingly great game.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第14场比赛堪称顶级，答题扎实，直奔主题，反应迅速，知识面广，结局紧张。看起来伦敦大学亚非学院和牛津圣埃德蒙堂学院都还有机会，因为输的一方可以进入复活赛。比赛最后非常接近，决胜在“那不勒斯”和“花粉”两个答案上。这是一场低调却精彩的比赛。

src_seg: Game 15 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of two in the repechage, where the four highest-scoring losing teams try to make it through. This week was UCL and St. Andrews, in a good-natured cheery match. Very strong play from UCL, who have a solid team, and UCL Mandel was in top form. Good questions, some tough, such as requiring "panthera" specifically or knowing "day" in Russian.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第15场比赛是复活赛的第一场，四支得分最高的失利队伍争取晋级。本周是伦敦大学学院对圣安德鲁斯大学，比赛气氛友好愉快。UCL表现非常强势，团队稳健，UCL的Mandel状态极佳。题目很不错，有些很难，比如要求准确说出“panthera”或知道俄语中的“day”。

src_seg: Just got to game 16 of #UniversityChallenge today, a week late, and it was a nail-biter! Really fast work at the end, with Durham coming from behind in the last few minutes to catch SOAS London in a tie in the final seconds. It went to a starter question that I got on the first clue (being an SF reader I knew "slipstream") but neither team knew. Second question and SOAS London Lambert guessed alpaca but it was llama, so Durham won. Phew, what a finish. 😰
tgt_seg: 今天刚看到#UniversityChallenge 第16场比赛，晚了一周，这场比赛真是扣人心弦！最后阶段节奏极快，杜伦在最后几分钟反超伦敦大学亚非学院，最终在最后几秒追平。比赛进入抢答题，我在第一个提示就猜到了（因为我是科幻迷，知道“slipstream”），但两队都没答出来。第二题SOAS London的Lambert猜了羊驼，但答案是美洲驼，所以杜伦获胜。呼，真是惊险的结局。

Seemed like a number of film questions this time, and I was glad to hear PEI as an answer; no flags, though it seems like they crop up every time. tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第 12 场比赛是利兹队对阵爱丁堡队。 利兹队花了很长时间才开始比赛，然后在比赛的中期出现了激增，但没能持续下去。 这一次似乎有很多电影问题，我很高兴听到PEI作为答案；没有旗帜，尽管看起来它们每次都会出现。 爱丁堡队的队长迈尔斯是一个很好的队长，整个球队都很强，并且很好地协同工作。 我认为他们会做得不错。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 13 was a curious one, with Leicester being jokey, wasting time and never getting going, while the LSE captain would often turn to the farthest player for an answer, which was not infrequently wrong. Still, LSE cleaned up. I liked the blues bonus round, though sadly Leicester got none. Canadian mentions: WL Mackenzie King and Margaret Atwood. The best part was Roger Tilling saying "Leicester Lister!"
tgt_seg: 第13场“大学挑战赛”是一场有趣的比赛，莱斯特队以玩笑式的方式浪费了时间并且从未取得胜利，而伦敦经济学院队长经常向最远的球员寻求答案，但答案往往不准确。 尽管如此，伦敦经济学院还是取得了胜利。 我喜欢蓝队的奖励回合，但遗憾的是莱斯特队没有得到任何奖励。 加拿大人提到： WL Mackenzie King 和 Margaret Atwood。 最棒的是 Roger Tilling 说“莱斯特 Lister！

src_seg: Game 14 of #UniversityChallenge was top-notch stuff, solid quizzing, down to business, fast answers, good knowledge, close ending. It seems we'll see both SOAS London and St. Edmund Hall Oxford again, because the loser makes the repechage. Very close at the finish, down to "Naples" and "pollen." An unassumingly great game.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第 14 场比赛是一场一流的比赛，质实的问答，务实、快速回答、知识渊博、结局紧密。 看来我们将再次看到伦敦 SOAS 和牛津大学圣埃德蒙学院，因为失败者将进入补队。 比赛结束时非常接近，最后只有“那不勒斯”和“花粉”剩下。 这是一场毫不夸张的出色比赛。

src_seg: Game 15 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of two in the repechage, where the four highest-scoring losing teams try to make it through. This week was UCL and St. Andrews, in a good-natured cheery match. Very strong play from UCL, who have a solid team, and UCL Mandel was in top form. Good questions, some tough, such as requiring "panthera" specifically or knowing "day" in Russian.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第 15 场比赛是复赛中的两场比赛中第一个，四名得分最高的输队试图通过。 本周是 UCL 和圣安德鲁斯的比赛，一场热情愉快的比赛。 UCL 的表现非常出色，他们拥有一支坚不可摧的球队，UCL Mandel 处于最佳状态。 有好问题，有些很难，比如要求“panthera”具体或者知道俄语中的“day”。

src_seg: Just got to game 16 of #UniversityChallenge today, a week late, and it was a nail-biter! Really fast work at the end, with Durham coming from behind in the last few minutes to catch SOAS London in a tie in the final seconds. It went to a starter question that I got on the first clue (being an SF reader I knew "slipstream") but neither team knew. Second question and SOAS London Lambert guessed alpaca but it was llama, so Durham won. Phew, what a finish. 😰
tgt_seg: 今天我刚刚参加 #UniversityChallenge 的第 16 场比赛，迟了一个星期，比赛非常激动人心！ 在最后几分钟里，达勒姆队从落后状态中脱颖而出，在最后几秒钟内与 SOAS 伦敦队扳平比分。 比赛开始时，我回答了第一个线索的问题（作为 SF 读者，我知道“滑流”），但两支球队都不知道答案。 在第二个问题时，SOAS 伦敦兰伯特猜到了阿尔帕卡，但其实那是拉马，因此达勒姆队获胜。 哇，真是激动人心的结局。 😰

src_seg: Game 17 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of eight knockout games in the second round. This was UCL and LSE, and UCL gave an outstanding performance: very fast buzzing, good teamwork, wide general knowledge from them all (UCL Mandel notable again); they took off at the start and never slowed. Very impressive.
tgt_seg: “#大学挑战赛”第 17 场比赛是第二轮八场淘汰赛中的第一个比赛。这是 UCL 和 LSE 的比赛，UCL 表现出色：嗡嗡声非常快，团队合作良好，所有人都拥有广泛的一般知识（UCL Mandel 再次脱颖而出）；他们在开始时起飞，再也没有减速过。 非常令人印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 18 of #UniversityChallenge was Durham vs Open University. I was rooting for Durham, who have a great team, but in the end to my surprise Open took it, after a number of rather slow answers. I was glad Durham got Marcel Duchamp right on one question; too bad no one knew Yoko Ono as a Fluxus artist. Much respect for Durham Nash, especially on bird silhouettes and flags.
tgt_seg: 大学挑战赛第 18 场比赛是 Durham 与 Open University 的对决。 我支持 Durham，他们拥有一支很棒的球队，但最终令人惊讶的是，Open University 在几个相当缓慢的回答中获胜。 我很高兴 Durham 在一个问题上正确地回答了 Marcel Duchamp；很遗憾没有人知道 Yoko Ono 是 Fluxus 艺术家。 非常尊重 Durham Nash，尤其是他对鸟类影和旗帜的理解。

src_seg:
Game 19 of #UniversityChallenge was Exeter vs Bristol. Bristol got going at the start and never looked back, rolling with momentum, finishing with an incredible score. Exeter only clawed their way back to 0 after 17 minutes. 
I liked the question on common terms in Chinese place names, such as 北 (běi) in Beijing etc. Good geographic knowledge shown.
tgt_seg:
#大学挑战赛第 19 场比赛是埃克塞特队对阵布里斯托尔队。 布里斯托尔队在比赛开始时表现出色，一直保持领先优势，最终取得了令人难以置信的成绩。 在 17 分钟之后，埃克塞特队才以0比0的比分回归。
我喜欢关于中国地名中的常用词的问题，比如北京市的北（北京）等。表现出了很好的地理知识。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge is back from the Christmas alumni series, and game 20 was liked greased lightening in comparison. Darwin Cambridge Whitaker tore into questions like a monster, but everyone was in good form on that team and also on Edinburgh. Momentum changed through the game. Good quizzing. Three more games in round two, then the long quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: 圣诞节校友系列“大学挑战”回归，与之前的比赛相比第20场比赛就像闪电一样令人印象深刻。 Darwin Cambridge Whitaker 像怪物一样冲入问题，但球队和爱丁堡队都表现良好。 比赛中的势头发生了变化。 测验成绩不错。 第二轮还有三场比赛，然后是漫长的四分之一决赛阶段。

src_seg: It's quite a change to go from the Christmas series of #UniversityChallenge, where four people didn't know the name of the narrator of Moby-Dick even when told his name is in the first sentence of the book, to the regular round, where they're racing to buzz on questions like "Fifty-three British thermal units is to grouse hunting as Sydney, Australia, is to what famous star of the London stage?"
tgt_seg: 这与《大学挑战》中的圣诞系列截然不同，在圣诞系列中，即使被告知《莫比·迪克》的叙述者的名字就在这本书的第一句话里，但四名参与者仍然不知道他的名字。而在常规比赛中，他们都在竞相回答诸如“五十三英热单位对猎雪鸟来说就像澳大利亚悉尼对伦敦舞台上的哪个著名明星一样？”这样的问题。

src_seg:
Game 21 of #UniversityChallenge was Wadham Oxford vs Imperial. What a game! Astounding performance from Imperial. 
However, being King Crimson fan, I was disappointed that no one recognized them from the opening of "21st Century Schizoid Man," and dismayed when someone thought "I Zimbra" by Talking Heads (with Fripp on guitar) was by the Bee Gees. Can't have it all. I remain incredibly impressed.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第21场比赛是瓦德姆牛津大学对阵帝国大学的比赛。 这是一场精彩的比赛！帝国大学表现惊人。
尽管如此，作为《King Crimson》的粉丝，我很失望没有人从《21st Century Schizoid Man》的开头就认出了他们，当有人认为Talking Heads（弗里普在吉他上）的《I Zimbra》是Bee Gees的作品时，我感到很沮丧。 我们不可能做到一切。 我仍然印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 22 of #UniversityChallenge was Christ's Cambridge vs St Edmund Hall Oxford, two small colleges, but that's how the rules are set up.  Nice picture round with the Dunning-Kruger effect, Asch conformity experiments, and bouba-kiki effect.  Another on mushrooms, which seemed tough to me; identifying them by eye is not easy. Solid game, good playing all around.
tgt_seg: 大学挑战赛第二十二场比赛是基督的剑桥大学对阵圣埃德蒙学院牛津大学，这两所学校规模较小，但这就是规则的设置。 有趣的是，图圈中出现了邓宁-克鲁格效应、阿什一致性实验和bouba-kiki效应。 另一场关于蘑菇的比赛对我来说有点难；用眼睛识别它们并不容易。 比赛非常激烈，每个人都表现出色。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. Nice flag knowledge, and a good picture round identifying physical laws by diagrams of experiments. A bit too much bantz for my taste, but a solid game. One more before the quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: University Challenge 23 号比赛是 Cardiff 与 Queen's Belfast 的比赛。虽然最终得出的分数低于我的预期，这可能是由于错过了奖励，但首发队员都很快兴奋起来。 有趣的旗帜知识，以及通过实验图来识别物理定律的好图圈。 对我来说有点过于滑稽，但这是一个不错的比赛。 在四分之一决赛前还有一场比赛。

src_seg: Game 9 of #UniversityChallenge was a hell of a match. Oriel Oxford (530 students) vs Durham (20,000), and Oriel won, which surprised me after some mistakes they made. The captain didn't know Wittengstein's name!? Possibly just nerves. Durham was ahead, then it was tied at 170, then they dropped to 165. A pity. I was rooting for them. Great team, with all four strong, so I hope they make the cut.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第9场比赛真是一场激烈的对决。牛津大学奥里尔学院（530名学生）对阵杜伦大学（20000名学生），结果奥里尔学院赢了，这在我看来有些出人意料，因为他们犯了一些错误。队长竟然不知道维特根斯坦的名字！？可能只是紧张吧。杜伦大学本来领先，后来比分打到170平，再后来他们掉到了165分。真可惜，我本来是支持他们的。他们是一支很棒的队伍，四名队员都很强，所以我希望他们能成功晋级。

src_seg:
Game 10 of #UniversityChallenge had a great performance by Christ's Cambridge, who have a consultative captain, a good team, and a strong member named Bethlehem, so Roger Tilling called out "Christ's Bethlehem!" Exeter Oxford never got hold of much, and are out of the running. I could see Christ's Cambridge quietly going far in this series. 
Some nice math questions, a picture round connected to food, and a tricky flag question. Good game.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第10场比赛中，剑桥大学基督学院的表现非常出色，他们有位善于商议的队长，一支优秀的团队，还有一位名叫伯利恒的强力队员，所以罗杰·蒂林喊出了“基督的伯利恒！”。牛津大学埃克塞特学院则没有什么突出的表现，已经出局了。我能预见到基督学院会在这一季比赛中悄悄地走得很远。
这场有一些不错的数学题，一轮与食物相关的图片题，还有一道棘手的旗帜题。非常好的比赛。

src_seg: Game 11 of #UniversityChallenge was St Andrews (granted university status by an antipope!) vs Cardiff. First round is nearing its end. Some good questions, including mentions of roll-on roll-of ferries, Agnes Martin, and Stax Records. Cardiff Tarsala will never forget her Booker T bloomer, I'm afraid. Nice quizzing from both teams, though it only really got cracking in the last few minutes.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第11场比赛是圣安德鲁斯大学（其大学地位由一位对立教宗授予！）对阵卡迪夫大学。第一轮比赛已近尾声。有一些很好的题目，包括提到了滚装渡轮、阿格尼丝·马丁和斯塔克斯唱片公司。恐怕卡迪夫大学的塔萨拉永远也忘不了她在布克·T问题上的失误。两队的答题表现都不错，不过比赛只在最后几分钟才真正进入高潮。

src_seg: Game 12 of #UniversityChallenge was Leeds vs Edinburgh. Leeds took a long time to get going, then had a surge in the middle but couldn't keep it going. Seemed like a number of film questions this time, and I was glad to hear PEI as an answer; no flags, though it seems like they crop up every time. Edinburgh Myles is a good captain and the whole team is strong and works well together. I think they'll do well.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第12场比赛是利兹大学对阵爱丁堡大学。利兹大学花了很长时间才进入状态，中途有过一波猛攻，但没能保持下去。这次似乎有好几道电影题，我很高兴听到有人答出 PEI；没有旗帜题，不过它好像每期都会出现。爱丁堡大学的迈尔斯是一位好队长，整个团队实力强大，合作默契。我认为他们会有不错的表现。

Still, LSE cleaned up. I liked the blues bonus round, though sadly Leicester got none. Canadian mentions: WL Mackenzie King and Margaret Atwood. The best part was Roger Tilling saying "Leicester Lister!"

src_seg: Game 14 of #UniversityChallenge was top-notch stuff, solid quizzing, down to business, fast answers, good knowledge, close ending. It seems we'll see both SOAS London and St. Edmund Hall Oxford again, because the loser makes the repechage. Very close at the finish, down to "Naples" and "pollen." An unassumingly great game.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第14场比赛是顶尖水平的对决，扎实的问答，直入主题，回答迅速，知识渊博，结局紧张。看来我们之后还会再次看到伦敦大学亚非学院和牛津大学圣埃德蒙学院，因为败者将进入复活赛。比赛最后非常胶着，胜负取决于关于“那不勒斯”和“花粉”的题目。一场低调而精彩的比赛。

src_seg: Game 15 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of two in the repechage, where the four highest-scoring losing teams try to make it through. This week was UCL and St. Andrews, in a good-natured cheery match. Very strong play from UCL, who have a solid team, and UCL Mandel was in top form. Good questions, some tough, such as requiring "panthera" specifically or knowing "day" in Russian.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第15场比赛是两场复活赛中的第一场，由四支得分最高的败者队伍争夺晋级名额。本周是伦敦大学学院对阵圣安德鲁斯大学，一场气氛友好愉快的比赛。伦敦大学学院发挥非常出色，他们团队实力雄厚，伦敦大学学院的曼德尔状态极佳。题目很好，有些很难，比如要求回答特定的“豹属”，或者知道俄语中的“天”怎么说。

src_seg: Just got to game 16 of #UniversityChallenge today, a week late, and it was a nail-biter! Really fast work at the end, with Durham coming from behind in the last few minutes to catch SOAS London in a tie in the final seconds. It went to a starter question that I got on the first clue (being an SF reader I knew "slipstream") but neither team knew. Second question and SOAS London Lambert guessed alpaca but it was llama, so Durham won. Phew, what a finish. 😰
tgt_seg: 我今天才看了#UniversityChallenge 第16场比赛，晚了一周，真是一场紧张刺激的对决！比赛最后阶段节奏飞快，杜伦大学在最后几分钟奋起直追，在最后几秒钟追平了伦敦大学亚非学院。比赛进入抢答决胜题环节，第一个线索我就知道答案了（作为一个科幻小说读者，我知道“滑流派”），但两队都不知道。第二个问题，伦敦大学亚非学院的兰伯特猜了羊驼，但正确答案是大羊驼，所以杜伦大学赢了。呼，真是精彩的结局。😰

src_seg: Game 17 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of eight knockout games in the second round. This was UCL and LSE, and UCL gave an outstanding performance: very fast buzzing, good teamwork, wide general knowledge from them all (UCL Mandel notable again); they took off at the start and never slowed. Very impressive.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第17场比赛是第二轮八场淘汰赛中的第一场。对阵双方是伦敦大学学院和伦敦政治经济学院，伦敦大学学院的表现极为出色：抢答迅速，团队合作良好，所有队员常识知识面都很广（伦敦大学学院的曼德尔再次表现抢眼）；他们从一开始就一路领先，从未放慢脚步。令人印象非常深刻。

I was rooting for Durham, who have a great team, but in the end to my surprise Open took it, after a number of rather slow answers. I was glad Durham got Marcel Duchamp right on one question; too bad no one knew Yoko Ono as a Fluxus artist. Much respect for Durham Nash, especially on bird silhouettes and flags.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第18场比赛是杜伦大学对阵开放大学。我本来支持杜伦大学，他们队伍很棒，但最终令我惊讶的是开放大学获胜了，尽管他们的回答相当缓慢。我很高兴杜伦大学在一道题上答对了马塞尔·杜尚；遗憾的是，没人知道小野洋子是一位激浪派艺术家。非常敬佩杜伦大学的纳什，尤其是在鸟类剪影和旗帜问题上的表现。

src_seg:
Game 19 of #UniversityChallenge was Exeter vs Bristol. Bristol got going at the start and never looked back, rolling with momentum, finishing with an incredible score. Exeter only clawed their way back to 0 after 17 minutes. 
I liked the question on common terms in Chinese place names, such as 北 (běi) in Beijing etc. Good geographic knowledge shown.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第19场比赛是埃克塞特大学对阵布里斯托大学。布里斯托大学从一开始就进入状态，然后一路高歌猛进，势不可挡，以惊人的高分结束比赛。埃克塞特大学在17分钟后才艰难地将分数追回到0分。
我喜欢那道关于中国地名中常用词的问题，比如北京的“北”字等等。展现了出色的地理知识。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge is back from the Christmas alumni series, and game 20 was liked greased lightening in comparison. Darwin Cambridge Whitaker tore into questions like a monster, but everyone was in good form on that team and also on Edinburgh. Momentum changed through the game. Good quizzing. Three more games in round two, then the long quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 从圣诞校友赛回归了，相比之下，第20场比赛快如闪电。剑桥大学达尔文学院的惠特克像一头猛兽般地回答问题，不过那支队伍和爱丁堡大学队的每个人状态都很好。比赛的势头几经转换。精彩的答题。第二轮还有三场比赛，然后是漫长的四分之一决赛。
