tgt_seg: 从#UniversityChallenge圣诞系列赛转到常规赛真是天壤之别，在圣诞系列赛中，即使告诉四个人《白鲸》叙述者的名字就在书的第一句话中，他们都不知道，而在常规赛中，他们争相抢答诸如"五十三英热单位之于松鸡狩猎，如同澳大利亚悉尼之于伦敦舞台上的哪位著名明星？"这样的题目。

src_seg:
Game 21 of #UniversityChallenge was Wadham Oxford vs Imperial. What a game! Astounding performance from Imperial. 
However, being King Crimson fan, I was disappointed that no one recognized them from the opening of "21st Century Schizoid Man," and dismayed when someone thought "I Zimbra" by Talking Heads (with Fripp on guitar) was by the Bee Gees. Can't have it all. I remain incredibly impressed.
tgt_seg:
#UniversityChallenge 第21场比赛是牛津沃德姆学院对阵帝国理工学院。真是一场精彩的比赛！帝国理工学院的表现令人惊叹。
不过，作为King Crimson的粉丝，我很失望没人从《21st Century Schizoid Man》的开头认出他们，当有人认为Talking Heads的《I Zimbra》（弗里普担任吉他手）是Bee Gees的作品时，我更是沮丧。不能尽如人意，但我依然非常钦佩他们。

src_seg: Game 22 of #UniversityChallenge was Christ's Cambridge vs St Edmund Hall Oxford, two small colleges, but that's how the rules are set up.  Nice picture round with the Dunning-Kruger effect, Asch conformity experiments, and bouba-kiki effect.  Another on mushrooms, which seemed tough to me; identifying them by eye is not easy. Solid game, good playing all around.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge 第22场比赛是剑桥大学基督学院对阵牛津大学圣埃德蒙学院，两所都是小型学院，但规则就是这么设定的。图片题很不错，涉及邓宁-克鲁格效应、阿希从众实验和波巴-奇奇效应。还有一轮关于蘑菇的题目，对我来说似乎很难；通过肉眼识别它们可不容易。一场硬核的比赛，双方都发挥得很好。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. Nice flag knowledge, and a good picture round identifying physical laws by diagrams of experiments. A bit too much bantz for my taste, but a solid game. One more before the quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #UniversityChallenge第23场比赛是卡迪夫大学对阵贝尔法斯特女王大学。最终分数比我预期的要低，可能是因为错过了加分题，但抢答题回答得很快。不错的旗帜知识，还有一轮很好的图片题，通过实验图表来识别物理定律。对我来说玩笑话有点太多了，但仍然是一场很棒的比赛。距离四分之一决赛还剩最后一场。

src_seg: Game 9 of #UniversityChallenge was a hell of a match. Oriel Oxford (530 students) vs Durham (20,000), and Oriel won, which surprised me after some mistakes they made. The captain didn't know Wittengstein's name!? Possibly just nerves. Durham was ahead, then it was tied at 170, then they dropped to 165. A pity. I was rooting for them. Great team, with all four strong, so I hope they make the cut.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第9场比赛真是精彩。奥里尔牛津（530名学生）对阵达勒姆（20,000人），奥里尔牛津获胜，这让我感到惊讶，因为他们犯了一些错误。队长居然不知道维特根斯坦的名字？可能是紧张。达勒姆领先，然后比分变成170平，然后他们又被拉下了165分。真是太遗憾了。我一直在为他们加油。他们是一个很棒的团队，四个成员都很强，所以我希望他们能成功晋级。

src_seg:
Game 10 of #UniversityChallenge had a great performance by Christ's Cambridge, who have a consultative captain, a good team, and a strong member named Bethlehem, so Roger Tilling called out "Christ's Bethlehem!" Exeter Oxford never got hold of much, and are out of the running. I could see Christ's Cambridge quietly going far in this series. 
Some nice math questions, a picture round connected to food, and a tricky flag question. Good game.
tgt_seg:
剑桥基督学院在 #UniversityChallenge 的第 10 场比赛中表现出色，他们有顾问队长、优秀的团队和强大的成员贝特勒海姆，因此罗杰·蒂林喊出了“基督学院的贝特勒海姆！”埃克塞特牛津从未掌握过太多，已经被淘汰。我可以看到基督学院在这个系列赛中悄悄地走得很远。
一些很好的数学问题、与食物相关的图片问题和棘手的旗帜问题。好比赛。

src_seg: Game 11 of #UniversityChallenge was St Andrews (granted university status by an antipope!) vs Cardiff. First round is nearing its end. Some good questions, including mentions of roll-on roll-of ferries, Agnes Martin, and Stax Records. Cardiff Tarsala will never forget her Booker T bloomer, I'm afraid. Nice quizzing from both teams, though it only really got cracking in the last few minutes.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第 11 场比赛是圣安德鲁斯大学（由一位对立教宗授予大学地位！）对阵加的夫大学。第一轮比赛接近尾声。提到了一些好问题，包括滚轮渡轮、阿格尼斯·马丁和斯塔克斯唱片。我担心加的夫塔尔萨拉将永远不会忘记她的布克·T 滑倒事件。尽管如此，两队都表现出色，但比赛直到最后几分钟才真正开始。

src_seg: Game 12 of #UniversityChallenge was Leeds vs Edinburgh. Leeds took a long time to get going, then had a surge in the middle but couldn't keep it going. Seemed like a number of film questions this time, and I was glad to hear PEI as an answer; no flags, though it seems like they crop up every time. Edinburgh Myles is a good captain and the whole team is strong and works well together. I think they'll do well.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第 12 场比赛是利兹大学对阵爱丁堡大学。利兹大学起步很慢，然后在中场时刻突然爆发，但无法保持。这次似乎有很多电影问题，我很高兴听到 PEI 作为答案；没有旗帜，但似乎每次都会出现。爱丁堡迈尔斯是一个好队长，整个队伍实力强大，合作良好。我认为他们会表现得很好。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 13 was a curious one, with Leicester being jokey, wasting time and never getting going, while the LSE captain would often turn to the farthest player for an answer, which was not infrequently wrong. Still, LSE cleaned up. I liked the blues bonus round, though sadly Leicester got none. Canadian mentions: WL Mackenzie King and Margaret Atwood. The best part was Roger Tilling saying "Leicester Lister!"
tgt_seg: #大学挑战游戏13很有趣，莱斯特开玩笑，浪费时间，从来没有起步，而LSE队长经常向最远的球员寻求答案，答案经常是错误的。尽管如此，LSE还是取得了胜利。我喜欢蓝色奖励回合，但不幸的是，莱斯特没有得到任何奖励。加拿大提及：WL麦肯齐·金和玛格丽特·阿特伍德。最好的部分是罗杰·蒂林说“莱斯特利斯特！”

src_seg: Game 14 of #UniversityChallenge was top-notch stuff, solid quizzing, down to business, fast answers, good knowledge, close ending. It seems we'll see both SOAS London and St. Edmund Hall Oxford again, because the loser makes the repechage. Very close at the finish, down to "Naples" and "pollen." An unassumingly great game.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第 14 场比赛精彩绝伦，知识问答扎实，快速作答，知识丰富，结局紧张。看起来我们将再次看到 SOAS 伦敦和圣埃德蒙霍尔牛津，因为落败者将进入复活赛。比赛结束时非常接近，只差“那不勒斯”和“花粉”。一场不起眼的精彩比赛。

src_seg: Game 15 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of two in the repechage, where the four highest-scoring losing teams try to make it through. This week was UCL and St. Andrews, in a good-natured cheery match. Very strong play from UCL, who have a solid team, and UCL Mandel was in top form. Good questions, some tough, such as requiring "panthera" specifically or knowing "day" in Russian.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第 15 场比赛是复赛的第一场，四支得分最低的球队将试图晋级。本周是 UCL 和圣安德鲁斯，比赛充满了友好的欢声笑语。UCL 表现非常出色，他们有一个坚实的团队，UCL Mandel 发挥得非常出色。问题很好，有些很难，比如需要特别指定“豹”或知道俄语中的“日”。

src_seg: Just got to game 16 of #UniversityChallenge today, a week late, and it was a nail-biter! Really fast work at the end, with Durham coming from behind in the last few minutes to catch SOAS London in a tie in the final seconds. It went to a starter question that I got on the first clue (being an SF reader I knew "slipstream") but neither team knew. Second question and SOAS London Lambert guessed alpaca but it was llama, so Durham won. Phew, what a finish. 😰
tgt_seg: 今天刚到 #UniversityChallenge 的第 16 场比赛，一周后，真是紧张刺激！最后几分钟，杜伦大学从落后中反超，在最后几秒与 SOAS 伦敦大学打成平手。比赛进入抢答题，我根据第一条线索（作为科幻小说读者，我知道“slipstream”）猜对了答案，但两队都不知道。第二个问题，SOAS 伦敦大学的 Lambert 猜对了 alpaca，但答案是 llama，所以杜伦大学获胜。哎呀，真是精彩的结局。😰

src_seg: Game 17 of #UniversityChallenge is the first of eight knockout games in the second round. This was UCL and LSE, and UCL gave an outstanding performance: very fast buzzing, good teamwork, wide general knowledge from them all (UCL Mandel notable again); they took off at the start and never slowed. Very impressive.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第 17 场比赛是第二轮八场淘汰赛中的第一场。这是 UCL 和 LSE 的比赛，UCL 表现出色：非常快的交流，良好的团队合作，他们都拥有广泛的知识（UCL Mandel 再次表现出色）；他们从一开始就冲刺，从未减速。非常令人印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 18 of #UniversityChallenge was Durham vs Open University. I was rooting for Durham, who have a great team, but in the end to my surprise Open took it, after a number of rather slow answers. I was glad Durham got Marcel Duchamp right on one question; too bad no one knew Yoko Ono as a Fluxus artist. Much respect for Durham Nash, especially on bird silhouettes and flags.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第 18 场比赛是杜伦大学对阵开放大学。我支持杜伦大学，他们有一个很棒的团队，但最终令我惊讶的是，开放大学在经过一系列较慢的回答后赢得了比赛。我很高兴杜伦大学在一个问题上答对了马塞尔·杜尚；很遗憾没有人知道约克·奥诺作为流派艺术家。我非常尊重杜伦·纳什，尤其是鸟形剪影和旗帜。

src_seg:
Game 19 of #UniversityChallenge was Exeter vs Bristol. Bristol got going at the start and never looked back, rolling with momentum, finishing with an incredible score. Exeter only clawed their way back to 0 after 17 minutes. 
I liked the question on common terms in Chinese place names, such as 北 (běi) in Beijing etc. Good geographic knowledge shown.
tgt_seg:
#大学挑战赛第 19 场比赛是埃克塞特对布里斯托尔。布里斯托尔一开始就领先，势头一发不可收拾，最终以令人难以置信的比分结束比赛。埃克塞特在比赛开始 17 分钟后才勉强追回比分。
我喜欢关于中国地名中常见词汇的问题，例如北京的“北”等。地理知识很好。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge is back from the Christmas alumni series, and game 20 was liked greased lightening in comparison. Darwin Cambridge Whitaker tore into questions like a monster, but everyone was in good form on that team and also on Edinburgh. Momentum changed through the game. Good quizzing. Three more games in round two, then the long quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战回归了圣诞校友系列，而第20场比赛在比较中就像是油滑的闪电。达尔文剑桥惠特克像怪物一样撕碎了问题，但那支球队和爱丁堡的每个人都处于良好状态。比赛中势头发生了变化。好问答。第二轮还有三场比赛，然后是漫长的四分之一决赛。

src_seg: It's quite a change to go from the Christmas series of #UniversityChallenge, where four people didn't know the name of the narrator of Moby-Dick even when told his name is in the first sentence of the book, to the regular round, where they're racing to buzz on questions like "Fifty-three British thermal units is to grouse hunting as Sydney, Australia, is to what famous star of the London stage?"
tgt_seg: 从 #UniversityChallenge 的圣诞系列，四个人即使被告知书名的第一句话中包含了叙述者的名字，也不会知道 Moby-Dick 的叙述者名字，到常规回合，他们在“五十三个英热单位对应于猎鹅，就像悉尼，澳大利亚对应于伦敦舞台上的哪位著名明星？”这样的问题上争先恐后地抢答，确实是一个很大的变化。

src_seg:
Game 21 of #UniversityChallenge was Wadham Oxford vs Imperial. What a game! Astounding performance from Imperial. 
However, being King Crimson fan, I was disappointed that no one recognized them from the opening of "21st Century Schizoid Man," and dismayed when someone thought "I Zimbra" by Talking Heads (with Fripp on guitar) was by the Bee Gees. Can't have it all. I remain incredibly impressed.
tgt_seg:
#大学挑战赛第 21 场比赛是瓦德姆牛津队对阵帝国队。真是精彩的一场比赛！帝国队的表现令人惊叹。
然而，作为 King Crimson 粉丝，我很失望没有人认出他们在“21st Century Schizoid Man”的开场，更令人沮丧的是有人认为 Talking Heads (弗里普弹吉他) 的“I Zimbra”是 Bee Gees 演唱的。不可能样样都做到完美。我仍然非常印象深刻。

src_seg: Game 22 of #UniversityChallenge was Christ's Cambridge vs St Edmund Hall Oxford, two small colleges, but that's how the rules are set up.  Nice picture round with the Dunning-Kruger effect, Asch conformity experiments, and bouba-kiki effect.  Another on mushrooms, which seemed tough to me; identifying them by eye is not easy. Solid game, good playing all around.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第 22 场比赛是基督学院 vs 牛津大学圣埃德蒙霍尔，两个小学院，但规则就是这样设定的。 图片轮回有很好的效果，包括邓宁-克鲁格效应、阿希顺从实验和布巴-基基效应。 另一个关于蘑菇的，对我来说似乎很难；用眼睛识别它们并不容易。 比赛很扎实，各方面表现都很好。

src_seg: #UniversityChallenge game 23 was Cardiff against Queen's Belfast. Ended with a lower score than I felt it would get, maybe due to missed bonuses, but the starters were buzzed fast. Nice flag knowledge, and a good picture round identifying physical laws by diagrams of experiments. A bit too much bantz for my taste, but a solid game. One more before the quarter-finals.
tgt_seg: #大学挑战赛第 23 场比赛是卡迪夫对阵皇后贝尔法斯特。最终得分低于预期，可能是因为错过了奖励，但首发队员表现出色。旗帜知识很好，实验图表识别物理定律的图像回合也很好。我个人觉得 bantz 太多了，但总体来说是一场稳定的比赛。还有最后一场比赛，然后进入四分之一决赛。

src_seg:
I idly proposed doing this yesterday so for March I will be posting one card I draw fom Suzanne Treister's Hexen 2.0 Tarot Deck per day of March.
The deck consists of all the major and minor arcana depicted by alchemical drawings of people and things from the history of technology, or, more specifically, "the scientific underpinnings of what Michel Foucault called bio-political governance."
Why? Because I actually have to do some tech-related talks this month, and also with the dark side of tech being so blatant lately, I felt the need to think about it more, and explore my associations/values etc!
tgt_seg:
我昨天漫不经心地提议要做这件事，所以在三月份，我每天都会从苏珊娜·特雷斯特（Suzanne Treister）的Hexen 2.0塔罗牌中抽出一张牌来分享。
这副牌由所有大阿卡那和小阿卡那组成，描绘了来自技术史的人和事的炼金术图，或者更具体地说，“米歇尔·福柯（Michel Foucault）所说的生命政治治理的科学基础”。
为什么？因为这个月我实际上必须要做一些与技术相关的演讲，而且最近技术的黑暗面如此明显，我感到有必要更多地思考它，并探索我的联想/价值观等！

src_seg:
March 1 - Starting with the 10 of Wands, typically representing overload, burden.
Here it is represented by a variety of early computing projects, many subsidized by their respective governments.
I think of how before a computer or calculator was a thing it was a job. Even after they existed, people still had to mediate, calculate, punch cards, interpret, etc. And in my own work I still often feel like a babysitter of inflexible computational quirks... why can't the spreadsheet software, or CMS, or database just do that mind-numbingly boring and burdensome stuff for me?
I also think how, even if it's built on what were once dull analog tasks, it's not -exactly- the same though, is it? In middle school computer lab I was taught a bit of BASIC, and being able to make a simple text "frogger" or branching adventure program, even if they were super rudimentary, was more compelling for some reason than imagining them or drawing them in a notebook... the sort of action at a delay/distance that computing offers, or that is computing's illusion...
tgt_seg:
3月1日 - 从十根权杖开始，通常代表过载、负担。
在这里，它由各种早期的计算项目代表，其中许多由各自的政府资助。
我想到在计算机或计算器出现之前，这是一份工作。即使在它们存在之后，人们仍然需要中介、计算、打孔卡、解释等。在我自己的工作中，我经常觉得自己像是在照顾不灵活的计算怪癖……为什么电子表格软件、CMS或数据库不能替我做那些令人麻木的枯燥和繁重的工作呢？
我还想到，即使它是建立在曾经枯燥的模拟任务之上，但也不完全是相同的，对吧？在中学计算机实验室，我学了一点BASIC编程，出于某种原因，能够制作一个简单的文本“青蛙过河”或分支冒险程序，即使它们非常原始，也比想象它们或在笔记本上画它们更令人信服……计算提供的延迟/距离的行动，或者说是计算的幻觉……

src_seg:
March 2 - 9 of Swords... following on from the feelings of overload and burden yesterday, this card represents nightmares and anxiety about the future.
Appropriately it's represented here by The Tavistock Institute of Human Relations, a UK governmental body established in 1946 that acted regionally, nationally, and internationally for “the social engagement of social sciences” or more bluntly, using theoretical methods to “change behavior in groups and civilian populations.”
Obviously the name Tavistock brings to mind the overbearing interference of the UK government in constantly trying to block any sort of trans care, or only dispensing it as a last resort after you’ve gone through years of waiting around and a thorough psychiatric probing. A population where everyone just conformed to the two standard cis gender roles would indeed be much easier to control, so to a “Labour” government obsessed with means testing, pathologizing and cutting benefits, it’s of course desirable to treat “normality” as a virtue and any difference as disease to eliminate.
I could talk about so many things, the awful CBT and soft conversion therapy I’ve personally received in the UK, how state surveillance and punishment disproportionately targets autistic people, how even punitive and inadequate psychological care is too hard to access, how outcomes are measured in “productivity” rather than happiness. A tendency that is not technic in the big machines or internet enabled devices way, but has infested every aspect of life as much as people fear tiktok attention spans have; people I want to ally with constantly crowing “just be normal” or getting sucked down a health and fitness grifthole.
An exhausting and sad card. I’ll be honest, I almost put it back when I pulled it lol. But obviously a big part of contemporary technological thought nevertheless.
tgt_seg:
3月2日 - 九把剑……继昨天的过载和负担的感觉之后，这张牌代表了噩梦和对未来的焦虑。
在这里，它恰如其分地由塔维斯托克人类关系研究所（Tavistock Institute of Human Relations）代表，这是一个1946年成立的英国政府机构，在地区、国家和国际范围内开展工作，以实现“社会科学的社会参与”，或者更直白地说，使用理论方法来“改变群体和民众的行为”。
显然，塔维斯托克这个名字让人联想到英国政府不断试图阻止任何形式的跨性别医疗，或者只在你经过多年的等待和彻底的精神病学审查后才将其作为最后的手段。一个每个人都符合两个标准的两性角色的人群确实更容易被控制，所以对于一个痴迷于经济状况调查、病理化和削减福利的“工党”政府来说，把“正常”当作美德，把任何差异当作需要消除的疾病当然是可取的。
我可以谈论很多事情，比如我在英国接受的糟糕的认知行为疗法和软性转换疗法，国家监控和惩罚如何不成比例地针对自闭症患者，甚至惩罚性和不充分的心理保健也太难获得，如何以“生产力”而不是幸福来衡量结果。这种趋势不仅仅是技术上的大机器或互联网设备的方式，而是已经感染了生活的每个方面，就像人们害怕TikTok上的注意力持续时间一样；我想要结盟的人不断高喊“做个正常人”或陷入健康和健身的无底洞。
一张令人疲惫和悲伤的牌。老实说，我抽到它时差点把它放回去。但显然，它仍然是当代技术思想的重要组成部分。

src_seg:
March 3 - The Star, hope, inspiration, future goals. A much more positive card than we've had so far!
But it's hard to feel positive about the massively exploitative and yet still totally underwhelming reality of artifical intelligence and quantum computing hype at the moment. The idea of an omnipotent computer, that could, indeed, simulate or work at an atomic or subatomic level, has kind of been the great dream of computing for a long time. It's almost a philosopher's stone type of thing.
Yesterday I reread this great essay on the current generative AI models by Hito Steyerl (https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images). She does a great job of going into how reliant these systems still are on human-made images, cleaned data, and ongoing human moderation at every level, but she also makes the observation that while their outputs masquerade as bits of text or images, which people wrongly attribute intention or creativity to, they're really statistical representations, with all of the inherent ideology and limitations of statistics baked in.
What would a truly intelligent computer capable of expanding our analytical powers and relieving the burden of tedious labor and the risks of incomplete information look like, and under what context would it be used to reinvent life towards more autonomy and joy rather than accelerating exploitation and control? Can we hope for such a thing with IBM and DARPA still in the picture...?
tgt_seg:
3月3日 - 星星，希望，灵感，未来的目标。比我们迄今为止看到的牌更积极！
但很难对目前人工智能和量子计算的炒作感到乐观，尽管它被过度利用，但仍然令人失望。能够模拟或在原子或亚原子水平上工作的全能计算机的想法，长期以来一直是计算的伟大梦想。这几乎是一种哲人石类型的东西。
昨天，我重读了Hito Steyerl（https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images）关于当前生成式人工智能模型的一篇优秀文章。她很好地探讨了这些系统如何仍然依赖于人类制作的图像、清理的数据和每个层面上的人工调节，但她也指出，虽然它们的输出伪装成文本或图像，人们错误地将其归因于意图或创造力，但它们实际上是统计表示，带有所有固有的意识形态和统计学的局限性。
一个真正智能的计算机，能够扩展我们的分析能力，减轻枯燥劳动的负担和不完整信息的风险，会是什么样的？在什么背景下，它将被用来重新创造生活，以实现更多的自主和快乐，而不是加速剥削和控制？我们能希望在IBM和DARPA仍然参与的情况下实现这样的事情吗……？

src_seg:
March 4 - The King of Swords, intellectual drive, clarity, calling for authoritative action. A go-for-it type of thing.
Timothy Leary certainly was a sort of intellectually driven, though more of a “question authority” type. Likewise, looking it up, the Eight-circuit Model of Consciousness here is generally thought to have little actual scientific credibility. Still… what model of consciousness does? Despite being how all of our “information” comes to us, it’s kind of ambiguous what this thing actually is, much less if there’s any systemic patterns that determine how it works.
I find it kind of inspiring to contemplate a multi-part model of consciousness that is both inward and outward looking. Leary was also of a period where there was optimism about space exploration, and the possibility of making contact with other species, from Earth or beyond. Now we seem to find this idea kind of embarrassing, because the idea of explaining ourselves feels embarrassing. Which in a way is it’s own kind of constantly-reinforcing self-centeredness.
There’s nothing more self-centered in the irritating way than how psychedelics as self-help, a “miracle” mental illness cure, the one weird trick to go 10x or come up with that sick disruptive business deal or chill out your bitch wife, have kind of become mainstream now. It’s all very inward-looking to the point that there’s nothing besides inward-ness. What’s the point of a honed mind if you can’t, like the king of swords, point it outwards?
tgt_seg:
3月4日 - 剑王，智力驱动，清晰度，号召权威行动。一种“放手去做”的事情。
蒂莫西·利里（Timothy Leary）当然是一个智力驱动的人，尽管更像是一个“质疑权威”类型的人。同样，八电路意识模型在这里通常被认为几乎没有实际的科学可信度。尽管如此……什么样的意识模型才是有意义的？尽管我们所有的“信息”都是通过它传来的，但这东西到底是什么，还是有点模糊，更不用说是否有任何系统模式决定了它是如何工作的。
我觉得思考一个多部分的意识模型既有内在又有外在的视角是挺有启发的。利里也是一个对太空探索持乐观态度的时代的人，他认为有可能与来自地球或其他地方的其他物种接触。现在我们似乎觉得这个想法有点尴尬，因为解释自己的想法感觉很尴尬。在某种程度上，这是一种自我中心主义。
没有什么比致幻剂作为自我帮助、一种“奇迹般的”精神疾病治愈方法、一种奇怪的技巧，可以让你在商业交易中10倍提升或想出一个绝妙的商业计划或让你的妻子平静下来，这些已经变得很主流了。这都是非常内向的，以至于除了内向之外什么都没有。如果你的思维不能像剑王一样指向外部，那么磨练心智又有什么意义呢？

src_seg:
March 5 - Five of Pentacles... A difficult situation, struggle, financial insecurity.
Infrastructure... precisely that thing it never feels like there's enough cash for. ESPECIALLY in tech, where it always flows towards hype and disruption rather than maintaining what already exists.
The Internet is so huge, has such great practical benefits, and is an important part of so many peoples' lives, that of course we want the infrastructure maintained, and there to be good governance... Maybe it was the hype of the Internet itself that allowed some of these early gestures towards standardization and productive ground rules to stick.
Though there are a ton of tech corporations involved, a surprising amount was also done via the US Department of Defense directly, and now a lot of the corporations (ex- Don't Be Evil Google, for example) are chipping away at the principles they once helped set up... Whose infrastructure? It's always tied to governance, and always ideological. Be careful who you go asking for cash when you're broke...
tgt_seg:
3月5日 - 五个五角星…… 困难的情况，挣扎，财务不安全。
基础设施……正是那种感觉上永远没有足够的钱来支持的东西。尤其是在科技领域，资金总是流向炒作和颠覆，而不是维护已经存在的东西。
互联网如此庞大，具有如此巨大的实际利益，并且是许多人生活中重要的一部分，当然我们希望基础设施得到维护，并有良好的治理……也许正是互联网本身的炒作使得这些早期的标准化尝试和建设性的基本规则得以坚持。
尽管有许多科技公司参与，但令人惊讶的是，很多工作也是由美国国防部直接完成的，而现在很多公司（例如，不要作恶的谷歌）正在削弱他们曾经帮助建立的原则……谁的基础设施？它总是与治理和意识形态联系在一起。小心你向谁求助，当你身无分文时……

src_seg:
March 6 - DEATH!! An inevitable and total transformation, possibly painful, but not necessarily The End...
A lot of anti-tech sentiment seems to wish that we could just put certain things back in the box. But the world where the technology that provides connection and access to information was entangled by its maybe well-intentioned originators with military and surveillance culture, game theory and bombs, is the world we have.
I always found the PVP gimmick for MGSV's online mode to be weirdly inspiring... if we want to live in a world without the atomic bomb, it'll have to be one where we took them all apart with our own hands. And it'll be one where the knowledge that it was made at one time will also always be a thing. How we frame it is up to us... there is no going back. How terrifying, how wonderful.
tgt_seg:
3月6日 - 死亡！！ 一个不可避免的和彻底的转变，可能是痛苦的，但不一定是终结……
很多反科技情绪似乎希望我们能把某些东西放回盒子里。但我们生活的世界里，提供连接和信息获取的技术与军事和监视文化、博弈论和炸弹纠缠在一起，这就是我们所拥有的。
我一直觉得《MGSV》在线模式的PVP噱头很奇怪地令人鼓舞……如果我们想生活在一个没有原子弹的世界里，那么它将是一个我们用自己的双手把它们全部拆解的世界。而且它将是一个这样的世界：我们知道它曾经被制造出来的知识也将始终存在。我们如何看待它取决于我们……没有回头路。令人恐惧，但也令人惊叹。

src_seg:
I idly proposed doing this yesterday so for March I will be posting one card I draw fom Suzanne Treister's Hexen 2.0 Tarot Deck per day of March.
The deck consists of all the major and minor arcana depicted by alchemical drawings of people and things from the history of technology, or, more specifically, "the scientific underpinnings of what Michel Foucault called bio-political governance."
Why? Because I actually have to do some tech-related talks this month, and also with the dark side of tech being so blatant lately, I felt the need to think about it more, and explore my associations/values etc!
tgt_seg:
我昨天随口提议要做这件事，所以三月份我将每天发布一张从苏珊娜·特雷斯特的《女巫2.0塔罗牌》中抽取的卡片。
这副牌包含所有大阿卡纳和小阿卡纳，通过炼金术绘画描绘了技术史上的人物和事物，或者更具体地说，"米歇尔·福柯所称的生物政治治理的科学基础"。
为什么？因为这个月我确实要做一些与技术相关的演讲，而且最近技术的阴暗面如此明显，我觉得需要更多地思考这个问题，探索我的联想和价值观等！

src_seg:
March 1 - Starting with the 10 of Wands, typically representing overload, burden.
Here it is represented by a variety of early computing projects, many subsidized by their respective governments.
I think of how before a computer or calculator was a thing it was a job. Even after they existed, people still had to mediate, calculate, punch cards, interpret, etc. And in my own work I still often feel like a babysitter of inflexible computational quirks... why can't the spreadsheet software, or CMS, or database just do that mind-numbingly boring and burdensome stuff for me?
I also think how, even if it's built on what were once dull analog tasks, it's not -exactly- the same though, is it? In middle school computer lab I was taught a bit of BASIC, and being able to make a simple text "frogger" or branching adventure program, even if they were super rudimentary, was more compelling for some reason than imagining them or drawing them in a notebook... the sort of action at a delay/distance that computing offers, or that is computing's illusion...
tgt_seg:
3月1日 - 从权杖十开始，通常代表超负荷、负担。
这里用各种早期计算项目来表示，其中许多都得到了各自政府的资助。
我想到在计算机或计算器成为一种东西之前，它曾经是一种工作。即使在它们存在之后，人们仍然必须进行调解、计算、打孔卡、解释等等。在我自己的工作中，我仍然经常感觉像是在照看那些不灵活的计算怪癖...为什么电子表格软件、内容管理系统或数据库就不能为我做那些令人麻木无聊和繁重的事情呢？
我还想到，即使它建立在曾经枯燥的模拟任务基础上，但它并不完全相同，不是吗？在中学计算机实验室里，我学了一点BASIC语言，能够制作一个简单的文本"青蛙过河"或分支冒险程序，即使它们非常初级，但出于某种原因比想象它们或在笔记本上画出它们更有吸引力...计算提供的那种延迟/距离的行动，或者说是计算的幻觉...

src_seg:
March 2 - 9 of Swords... following on from the feelings of overload and burden yesterday, this card represents nightmares and anxiety about the future.
Appropriately it's represented here by The Tavistock Institute of Human Relations, a UK governmental body established in 1946 that acted regionally, nationally, and internationally for “the social engagement of social sciences” or more bluntly, using theoretical methods to “change behavior in groups and civilian populations.”
Obviously the name Tavistock brings to mind the overbearing interference of the UK government in constantly trying to block any sort of trans care, or only dispensing it as a last resort after you’ve gone through years of waiting around and a thorough psychiatric probing. A population where everyone just conformed to the two standard cis gender roles would indeed be much easier to control, so to a “Labour” government obsessed with means testing, pathologizing and cutting benefits, it’s of course desirable to treat “normality” as a virtue and any difference as disease to eliminate.
I could talk about so many things, the awful CBT and soft conversion therapy I’ve personally received in the UK, how state surveillance and punishment disproportionately targets autistic people, how even punitive and inadequate psychological care is too hard to access, how outcomes are measured in “productivity” rather than happiness. A tendency that is not technic in the big machines or internet enabled devices way, but has infested every aspect of life as much as people fear tiktok attention spans have; people I want to ally with constantly crowing “just be normal” or getting sucked down a health and fitness grifthole.
An exhausting and sad card. I’ll be honest, I almost put it back when I pulled it lol. But obviously a big part of contemporary technological thought nevertheless.
tgt_seg:
3月2日 - 宝剑九...延续昨天的超负荷和负担感，这张牌代表对未来的噩梦和焦虑。
恰当地，这里用塔维斯托克人际关系研究所来表示，这是英国政府在1946年建立的一个机构，在地区、国家和国际层面进行"社会科学的社会参与"，或者更直白地说，使用理论方法来"改变群体和平民人口的行为"。
显然，塔维斯托克这个名字让人想到英国政府在不断试图阻止任何形式的跨性别护理方面的专横干预，或者只是在你经历了多年的等待和彻底的精神病学探查后，作为最后手段才提供护理。一个每个人都只是符合两种标准顺性别角色的人口确实会更容易控制，所以对于一个痴迷于经济状况调查、病理化和削减福利的"工党"政府来说，将"正常"视为美德，将任何差异视为要消除的疾病当然是可取的。
我可以谈论很多事情，我个人在英国接受的可怕的认知行为疗法和软性转化疗法，国家监控和惩罚如何不成比例地针对自闭症患者，即使是惩罚性和不充分的心理护理也很难获得，结果如何以"生产力"而不是幸福来衡量。这种倾向不是大型机器或互联网设备意义上的技术性的，但已经像人们担心抖音注意力持续时间那样感染了生活的每个方面；我想要结盟的人不断叫嚷"正常一点"或被吸入健康和健身骗局的漩涡。
一张令人疲惫和悲伤的卡片。老实说，当我抽到它时，我几乎把它放回去了哈哈。但显然仍然是当代技术思想的重要组成部分。

src_seg:
March 3 - The Star, hope, inspiration, future goals. A much more positive card than we've had so far!
But it's hard to feel positive about the massively exploitative and yet still totally underwhelming reality of artifical intelligence and quantum computing hype at the moment. The idea of an omnipotent computer, that could, indeed, simulate or work at an atomic or subatomic level, has kind of been the great dream of computing for a long time. It's almost a philosopher's stone type of thing.
Yesterday I reread this great essay on the current generative AI models by Hito Steyerl (https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images). She does a great job of going into how reliant these systems still are on human-made images, cleaned data, and ongoing human moderation at every level, but she also makes the observation that while their outputs masquerade as bits of text or images, which people wrongly attribute intention or creativity to, they're really statistical representations, with all of the inherent ideology and limitations of statistics baked in.
What would a truly intelligent computer capable of expanding our analytical powers and relieving the burden of tedious labor and the risks of incomplete information look like, and under what context would it be used to reinvent life towards more autonomy and joy rather than accelerating exploitation and control? Can we hope for such a thing with IBM and DARPA still in the picture...?

我昨天一时兴起，提议要做这件事，所以这个三月，我每天都会发布一张来自苏珊·特赖斯特（Suzanne Treister）的“Hexen 2.0 塔罗牌”中的牌。
这套牌包含了所有的大阿卡纳和小阿卡纳，牌面都以描绘科技历史中人物和事物的炼金术图画为主题，或者更具体地说，是“米歇尔·福柯所说的‘生物政治治理’的科学基础”。
为什么？因为这个月我需要做一些与科技相关的演讲，而且最近科技的负面影响越来越明显，所以我感到有必要更深入地思考这个问题，并探索我对科技的看法和价值观等等！

src_seg:
March 1 - Starting with the 10 of Wands, typically representing overload, burden.
Here it is represented by a variety of early computing projects, many subsidized by their respective governments.
I think of how before a computer or calculator was a thing it was a job. Even after they existed, people still had to mediate, calculate, punch cards, interpret, etc. And in my own work I still often feel like a babysitter of inflexible computational quirks... why can't the spreadsheet software, or CMS, or database just do that mind-numbingly boring and burdensome stuff for me?
I also think how, even if it's built on what were once dull analog tasks, it's not -exactly- the same though, is it? In middle school computer lab I was taught a bit of BASIC, and being able to make a simple text "frogger" or branching adventure program, even if they were super rudimentary, was more compelling for some reason than imagining them or drawing them in a notebook... the sort of action at a delay/distance that computing offers, or that is computing's illusion...
tgt_seg:
3月1日——从“十根权杖”开始，这张牌通常代表着负担过重、压力巨大。
在这里，它象征着各种早期的计算机项目，其中许多都得到了各自政府的资助。
我想到，在计算机或计算器出现之前，这些工作都是由人来完成的。即使在计算机出现之后，人们仍然需要进行协调、计算、打孔、解读等等。而在我的工作中，我经常觉得自己就像是在照顾一些死板的计算机程序……为什么电子表格软件、内容管理系统或数据库不能帮我完成这些枯燥乏味、令人厌烦的工作呢？
此外，我也想到，即使这些技术是建立在曾经单调乏味的模拟任务之上的，但它们毕竟是不一样的，不是吗？在中学计算机课上，我学过一点BASIC编程，能够编写一个简单的文字游戏“青蛙过河”或一个简单的冒险游戏，即使它们非常简陋，也比想象它们或在笔记本上画它们更有吸引力……这种计算机所提供的“延迟/距离感”，或者说，计算机所创造的“幻觉”，是其他方式无法比拟的。

src_seg:
March 2 - 9 of Swords... following on from the feelings of overload and burden yesterday, this card represents nightmares and anxiety about the future.
Appropriately it's represented here by The Tavistock Institute of Human Relations, a UK governmental body established in 1946 that acted regionally, nationally, and internationally for “the social engagement of social sciences” or more bluntly, using theoretical methods to “change behavior in groups and civilian populations.”
Obviously the name Tavistock brings to mind the overbearing interference of the UK government in constantly trying to block any sort of trans care, or only dispensing it as a last resort after you’ve gone through years of waiting around and a thorough psychiatric probing. A population where everyone just conformed to the two standard cis gender roles would indeed be much easier to control, so to a “Labour” government obsessed with means testing, pathologizing and cutting benefits, it’s of course desirable to treat “normality” as a virtue and any difference as disease to eliminate.
I could talk about so many things, the awful CBT and soft conversion therapy I’ve personally received in the UK, how state surveillance and punishment disproportionately targets autistic people, how even punitive and inadequate psychological care is too hard to access, how outcomes are measured in “productivity” rather than happiness. A tendency that is not technic in the big machines or internet enabled devices way, but has infested every aspect of life as much as people fear tiktok attention spans have; people I want to ally with constantly crowing “just be normal” or getting sucked down a health and fitness grifthole.
An exhausting and sad card. I’ll be honest, I almost put it back when I pulled it lol. But obviously a big part of contemporary technological thought nevertheless.
tgt_seg:
3月2日 - “九剑”（9 of Swords）……继昨天那种感到压力过大和负担沉重之后，这张牌代表着噩梦和对未来的焦虑。
有趣的是，这张牌与英国的“塔维斯托克人类关系研究所”（Tavistock Institute of Human Relations）相关，这是一个成立于1946年的英国政府机构，它在地区、国家和国际层面都致力于“社会科学的社会应用”，或者更直白地说，就是利用理论方法来“改变群体和民众的行为”。
“塔维斯托克”这个名字很容易让人联想到英国政府不断干预，试图阻止任何形式的跨性别医疗服务，或者只在经过多年等待和严格的精神评估后才提供这种服务。如果社会中的每个人都仅仅符合传统的两种性别角色，那么社会控制起来无疑会更容易。因此，对于一个痴迷于“手段测试”、将“异于常态”视为疾病并削减福利的政府来说，将“正常”视为一种美德，并将任何差异视为需要消除的疾病，当然是理想的。
我可以谈论很多事情，比如我在英国亲身经历的糟糕的认知行为疗法（CBT）和“温和的转变疗法”，以及国家监控和惩罚如何不成比例地针对自闭症患者，甚至连惩罚性和不足的心理护理都难以获得，而且结果的衡量标准是“生产力”而不是幸福。这种倾向并非仅仅体现在大型机器或互联网设备上，而是已经渗透到生活的方方面面，就像人们担心TikTok一样。我希望与我结盟的人总是不断地强调“要正常”，或者沉迷于健康和健身的陷阱。
这是一张令人疲惫和悲伤的牌。说实话，当我抽到这张牌时，我几乎想把它放回去。但显然，它仍然是当代科技思想的重要组成部分。

src_seg:
March 3 - The Star, hope, inspiration, future goals. A much more positive card than we've had so far!
But it's hard to feel positive about the massively exploitative and yet still totally underwhelming reality of artifical intelligence and quantum computing hype at the moment. The idea of an omnipotent computer, that could, indeed, simulate or work at an atomic or subatomic level, has kind of been the great dream of computing for a long time. It's almost a philosopher's stone type of thing.
Yesterday I reread this great essay on the current generative AI models by Hito Steyerl (https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images). She does a great job of going into how reliant these systems still are on human-made images, cleaned data, and ongoing human moderation at every level, but she also makes the observation that while their outputs masquerade as bits of text or images, which people wrongly attribute intention or creativity to, they're really statistical representations, with all of the inherent ideology and limitations of statistics baked in.
What would a truly intelligent computer capable of expanding our analytical powers and relieving the burden of tedious labor and the risks of incomplete information look like, and under what context would it be used to reinvent life towards more autonomy and joy rather than accelerating exploitation and control? Can we hope for such a thing with IBM and DARPA still in the picture...?
tgt_seg:
3月3日——“星星”这张牌象征着希望、启发和未来的目标。与我们之前看到的牌相比，这张牌更加积极！
但目前，人工智能和量子计算的炒作，虽然极具剥削性，却又远未达到人们的期望，很难让人感到乐观。长期以来，“能够模拟或在原子甚至亚原子层面运作的万能计算机”一直是计算机领域的一个伟大梦想。这几乎就像是炼金术士梦寐以求的“点石成金”一样。
昨天，我重新阅读了希托·施泰尔（Hito Steyerl）一篇关于当前生成式人工智能模型的精彩文章（https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images）。她很好地阐述了这些系统仍然依赖于人类制作的图像、清洗后的数据以及各个层面的持续人工干预。此外，她还指出，虽然这些系统的输出呈现为文本或图像，人们却错误地认为它们具有意图或创造力，但实际上它们只是统计数据的表现，其中包含了统计学固有的意识形态和局限性。
如果有一种真正智能的计算机，能够扩展我们的分析能力，减轻繁琐的劳动负担，并降低信息不完整带来的风险，那么它会是什么样子？又会在什么样的背景下，它才能被用来重塑生活，从而实现更大的自主性和快乐，而不是加速剥削和控制？在IBM和DARPA仍然参与的情况下，我们还能期待这样的事情吗？

src_seg:
March 4 - The King of Swords, intellectual drive, clarity, calling for authoritative action. A go-for-it type of thing.
Timothy Leary certainly was a sort of intellectually driven, though more of a “question authority” type. Likewise, looking it up, the Eight-circuit Model of Consciousness here is generally thought to have little actual scientific credibility. Still… what model of consciousness does? Despite being how all of our “information” comes to us, it’s kind of ambiguous what this thing actually is, much less if there’s any systemic patterns that determine how it works.
I find it kind of inspiring to contemplate a multi-part model of consciousness that is both inward and outward looking. Leary was also of a period where there was optimism about space exploration, and the possibility of making contact with other species, from Earth or beyond. Now we seem to find this idea kind of embarrassing, because the idea of explaining ourselves feels embarrassing. Which in a way is it’s own kind of constantly-reinforcing self-centeredness.
There’s nothing more self-centered in the irritating way than how psychedelics as self-help, a “miracle” mental illness cure, the one weird trick to go 10x or come up with that sick disruptive business deal or chill out your bitch wife, have kind of become mainstream now. It’s all very inward-looking to the point that there’s nothing besides inward-ness. What’s the point of a honed mind if you can’t, like the king of swords, point it outwards?
tgt_seg:
3月4日——“宝剑”（权杖）牌，代表着智慧、清晰的思维，以及采取果断行动。它鼓励人们积极主动，勇于行动。
蒂莫西·利里无疑是一位充满智慧的人，但他更倾向于质疑权威。同样，从科学角度来看，这里提到的“八回路意识模型”通常被认为缺乏实际的科学依据。但即便如此……又有哪个意识模型能够真正做到这一点呢？尽管我们所有的“信息”都通过它来获取，但我们对它的本质仍然知之甚少，更不用说是否存在任何系统性的规律来解释它的运作方式了。
我发现，思考一个既关注内在又关注外在的多元意识模型，是一件很有启发性的事情。利里也生活在一个对太空探索和与地球内外其他物种建立联系充满乐观的时代。而现在，我们似乎觉得这种想法有些可笑，因为我们觉得解释自己是一件很尴尬的事情。而这种尴尬感，本身就是一种不断强化自我中心的表现。
如今，将迷幻药物作为一种自我提升手段、一种“奇迹般”的精神疾病疗法、一种能够让你事半功倍、缔造颠覆性商业交易或让你的“唠叨妻子”冷静下来的“神奇秘诀”，并将其推向主流，这种做法无疑是极度自我中心的，而且这种自我中心已经到了令人厌烦的地步。它完全是向内看的，以至于除了关注自身之外，再也没有其他。如果不能像“宝剑”一样，将智慧用于外在世界，那么拥有敏锐的头脑又有什么意义呢？

src_seg:
March 5 - Five of Pentacles... A difficult situation, struggle, financial insecurity.
Infrastructure... precisely that thing it never feels like there's enough cash for. ESPECIALLY in tech, where it always flows towards hype and disruption rather than maintaining what already exists.
The Internet is so huge, has such great practical benefits, and is an important part of so many peoples' lives, that of course we want the infrastructure maintained, and there to be good governance... Maybe it was the hype of the Internet itself that allowed some of these early gestures towards standardization and productive ground rules to stick.
Though there are a ton of tech corporations involved, a surprising amount was also done via the US Department of Defense directly, and now a lot of the corporations (ex- Don't Be Evil Google, for example) are chipping away at the principles they once helped set up... Whose infrastructure? It's always tied to governance, and always ideological. Be careful who you go asking for cash when you're broke...
tgt_seg:
3月5日——“五枚硬币”（塔罗牌）…… 困境、挣扎、经济不稳定。
“基础设施”…… 总是感觉资金不足，尤其是在科技领域，资金往往流向炒作和颠覆性创新，而不是用于维护现有系统。
互联网规模庞大，具有巨大的实用价值，并且是许多人生活中不可或缺的一部分，因此，我们当然希望能够维护好互联网基础设施，并建立良好的管理制度…… 或许正是互联网本身的炒作，使得一些早期的标准化和建设性规则得以推行。
虽然有许多科技公司参与其中，但令人惊讶的是，很多工作也是由美国国防部直接完成的，而现在，许多公司（例如，曾经秉持“不作恶”理念的谷歌）正在逐渐削弱他们曾经帮助建立的原则…… 谁来负责基础设施建设？这始终与治理和意识形态息息相关。当您身无分文时，请务必谨慎选择您寻求资金的对象……

src_seg:
March 6 - DEATH!! An inevitable and total transformation, possibly painful, but not necessarily The End...
A lot of anti-tech sentiment seems to wish that we could just put certain things back in the box. But the world where the technology that provides connection and access to information was entangled by its maybe well-intentioned originators with military and surveillance culture, game theory and bombs, is the world we have.
I always found the PVP gimmick for MGSV's online mode to be weirdly inspiring... if we want to live in a world without the atomic bomb, it'll have to be one where we took them all apart with our own hands. And it'll be one where the knowledge that it was made at one time will also always be a thing. How we frame it is up to us... there is no going back. How terrifying, how wonderful.
tgt_seg:
3月6日——“死亡”！！一种不可避免且彻底的转变，可能伴随着痛苦，但并非意味着“终结”……
似乎很多人对科技发展持负面态度，希望能够“回到过去”，但现实是，我们所处的世界，就是这样一个科技与军事、监控、博弈论和武器紧密相连的世界。而这一切，都源于那些最初的科技开发者，尽管他们的初衷可能是好的。
我一直觉得《合金装备5：幻痛》的PVP模式（玩家对战）颇具启发意义……如果我们想生活在一个没有核武器的世界，那就必须亲手拆解所有核武器。而且，即使我们拆解了它们，关于核武器曾经存在过的知识也将永远存在。我们如何看待这件事，取决于我们自己……我们无法回到过去。这既令人恐惧，又令人感到希望。

src_seg:
I idly proposed doing this yesterday so for March I will be posting one card I draw fom Suzanne Treister's Hexen 2.0 Tarot Deck per day of March.
The deck consists of all the major and minor arcana depicted by alchemical drawings of people and things from the history of technology, or, more specifically, "the scientific underpinnings of what Michel Foucault called bio-political governance."
Why? Because I actually have to do some tech-related talks this month, and also with the dark side of tech being so blatant lately, I felt the need to think about it more, and explore my associations/values etc!

tgt_seg: 3月3日 - 星报，希望，灵感，未来目标。这比我们迄今为止看到的要积极得多！但对于目前人工智能和量子计算的炒作，尽管其被广泛利用，却依然令人失望的现实，我们很难感到乐观。万能的计算机，能够模拟或在原子或亚原子层面上工作，长期以来一直是计算领域的伟大梦想。这几乎就像点金石一样难以实现。昨天我重读了Hito Steyerl关于当前生成式人工智能模型的精彩文章（https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images）。她出色地阐述了这些系统在多大程度上仍然依赖于人造图像、经过清理的数据以及各个层面持续的人为调节。但她也指出，虽然它们的输出伪装成文本或图像，人们错误地将意图或创造力赋予其中，但它们实际上是统计数据的表征，带有统计学固有的所有意识形态和局限性。一台真正智能的计算机，能够扩展我们的分析能力，减轻繁琐劳动的负担和信息不完整带来的风险，它会是什么样子？在什么情况下，它会被用来重塑生活，使之更加自主和快乐，而不是加速剥削和控制？在IBM和DARPA仍然在位的情况下，我们还能指望这样的事情吗……？

src_seg:

There’s nothing more self-centered in the irritating way than how psychedelics as self-help, a “miracle” mental illness cure, the one weird trick to go 10x or come up with that sick disruptive business deal or chill out your bitch wife, have kind of become mainstream now. tgt_seg: 3月4日 - 宝剑国王，智识驱动，清晰明了，呼吁权威行动。一种敢于尝试的类型。蒂莫西·利里无疑是一种智识驱动型的人，尽管更像是“质疑权威”的类型。同样，查一下资料，这里的意识八回路模型通常被认为缺乏实际的科学可信度。然而……意识模型究竟是什么呢？尽管它代表了我们所有“信息”的来源，但它究竟是什么却有些模糊，更不用说是否存在决定其运作方式的系统模式了。我发现，思考一个既向内又向外的多部分意识模型颇具启发性。利里所处的时代也对太空探索充满乐观，人们期待着与地球或地球以外的其他物种接触。现在我们似乎觉得这个想法有点尴尬，因为解释我们自己的想法让人感到尴尬。这在某种程度上本身就是一种不断强化的自我中心主义。没有什么比迷幻药这种自我救助手段、所谓的“神奇”精神疾病疗法、让精神状态提升十倍、想出一桩颠覆性的商业交易、或是让你的泼妇老婆冷静下来的古怪伎俩，如今几乎成了主流，更令人恼火的以自我为中心了。这一切都非常内向，以至于除了内向之外什么也没有。如果你不能像宝剑之王那样将你的心智向外投射，那么磨练你的心智又有何意义呢？

I also think how, even if it's built on what were once dull analog tasks, it's not -exactly- the same though, is it? In middle school computer lab I was taught a bit of BASIC, and being able to make a simple text "frogger" or branching adventure program, even if they were super rudimentary, was more compelling for some reason than imagining them or drawing them in a notebook... the sort of action at a delay/distance that computing offers, or that is computing's illusion...

March 2 - 9 of Swords... following on from the feelings of overload and burden yesterday, this card represents nightmares and anxiety about the future.
Appropriately it's represented here by The Tavistock Institute of Human Relations, a UK governmental body established in 1946 that acted regionally, nationally, and internationally for “the social engagement of social sciences” or more bluntly, using theoretical methods to “change behavior in groups and civilian populations.”
Obviously the name Tavistock brings to mind the overbearing interference of the UK government in constantly trying to block any sort of trans care, or only dispensing it as a last resort after you’ve gone through years of waiting around and a thorough psychiatric probing. A population where everyone just conformed to the two standard cis gender roles would indeed be much easier to control, so to a “Labour” government obsessed with means testing, pathologizing and cutting benefits, it’s of course desirable to treat “normality” as a virtue and any difference as disease to eliminate.
I could talk about so many things, the awful CBT and soft conversion therapy I’ve personally received in the UK, how state surveillance and punishment disproportionately targets autistic people, how even punitive and inadequate psychological care is too hard to access, how outcomes are measured in “productivity” rather than happiness. A tendency that is not technic in the big machines or internet enabled devices way, but has infested every aspect of life as much as people fear tiktok attention spans have; people I want to ally with constantly crowing “just be normal” or getting sucked down a health and fitness grifthole.
An exhausting and sad card. I’ll be honest, I almost put it back when I pulled it lol. But obviously a big part of contemporary technological thought nevertheless.
tgt_seg:
3月2日至9日的剑... 继昨天的过度负担和负担之后, 这张卡片代表了对未来的梦和焦虑.
塔维斯托克人际关系研究所是一个英国政府机构,成立于1946年,在地区,国家和国际上为"社会科学的社会参与"采取行动,
显然,塔维斯托克这个名字让人想起英国政府在不断地试图阻止任何形式的跨性别护理,或者在经历了多年的等待和彻底的精神病学调查后才作为最后的手段分配它. 一个每个人都符合两个标准的cis性别角色的人口确实会更容易被控制,所以对于一个痴迷于测试手段,病理化和削减福利的"工党"政府来说,当然是希望把"正常"视为美德,并将任何差异视为消除疾病.
我可以谈论很多事情,比如我在英国所接受的可怕的认知转化疗法和软转化疗法,国家监视和惩罚如何不成比例地针对自闭症患者,甚至惩罚性和不充分的心理护理是如何难以获得的,结果如何以"生产力"而不是幸福度来衡量. 这种趋势并非以大型机器或支持互联网的设备的方式来衡量技术,但它已经染了生活的各个方面,就像人们担心TikTok的注意力延长一样; 我希望与不断喊"只要正常"或被吸入健康和健身骗局的人结盟.
一张令人疲和悲伤的卡片. 诚实地说,当我把它拉出来的时候,我差点把它放回去.

The idea of an omnipotent computer, that could, indeed, simulate or work at an atomic or subatomic level, has kind of been the great dream of computing for a long time. It's almost a philosopher's stone type of thing.
Yesterday I reread this great essay on the current generative AI models by Hito Steyerl (https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images). She does a great job of going into how reliant these systems still are on human-made images, cleaned data, and ongoing human moderation at every level, but she also makes the observation that while their outputs masquerade as bits of text or images, which people wrongly attribute intention or creativity to, they're really statistical representations, with all of the inherent ideology and limitations of statistics baked in.
What would a truly intelligent computer capable of expanding our analytical powers and relieving the burden of tedious labor and the risks of incomplete information look like, and under what context would it be used to reinvent life towards more autonomy and joy rather than accelerating exploitation and control? Can we hope for such a thing with IBM and DARPA still in the picture...?

能够扩大我们的分析能力,减轻繁劳动的负担和不完整信息的风险的真正智能计算机会是什么样子,在什么情况下它会被用来重新发明生活,以获得更多的自主性和快乐,而不是加速剥削和控制?

3月1日——从权杖十开始，通常代表过度和负担。

我也想，即使它建立在曾经单调的模拟任务之上，但它也并非完全一样，对吧？在中学计算机实验室里，我学了一些BASIC，能够制作一个简单的文本“青蛙”或分支冒险程序，即使它们非常原始，也比在笔记本上想象它们或画它们更有吸引力……计算所提供的或计算所产生的这种延迟/远程行动，或者计算的幻觉……

src_seg:
March 2 - 9 of Swords... following on from the feelings of overload and burden yesterday, this card represents nightmares and anxiety about the future.
Appropriately it's represented here by The Tavistock Institute of Human Relations, a UK governmental body established in 1946 that acted regionally, nationally, and internationally for “the social engagement of social sciences” or more bluntly, using theoretical methods to “change behavior in groups and civilian populations.”
Obviously the name Tavistock brings to mind the overbearing interference of the UK government in constantly trying to block any sort of trans care, or only dispensing it as a last resort after you’ve gone through years of waiting around and a thorough psychiatric probing. A population where everyone just conformed to the two standard cis gender roles would indeed be much easier to control, so to a “Labour” government obsessed with means testing, pathologizing and cutting benefits, it’s of course desirable to treat “normality” as a virtue and any difference as disease to eliminate.
I could talk about so many things, the awful CBT and soft conversion therapy I’ve personally received in the UK, how state surveillance and punishment disproportionately targets autistic people, how even punitive and inadequate psychological care is too hard to access, how outcomes are measured in “productivity” rather than happiness. A tendency that is not technic in the big machines or internet enabled devices way, but has infested every aspect of life as much as people fear tiktok attention spans have; people I want to ally with constantly crowing “just be normal” or getting sucked down a health and fitness grifthole.
An exhausting and sad card. I’ll be honest, I almost put it back when I pulled it lol. But obviously a big part of contemporary technological thought nevertheless.
tgt_seg:
3月2日——宝剑九……在昨天感受过度和负担之后，这张牌代表着对未来的噩梦和焦虑。
恰如其分地，它在这里由牛津人类关系研究所（The Tavistock Institute of Human Relations）来代表，这是一个于1946年由英国政府建立的机构，在区域、国家和国际层面为“社会科学的社会参与”而行动，或者更直白地说，使用理论方法来“改变群体和民间人群的行为”。
显然，Tavistock这个名字让人联想到英国政府过度干预，不断试图阻止任何形式的跨性别护理，或者只有在经过多年的等待和彻底的精神病学检查后才将其作为最后的手段提供。一个所有人都符合两种标准顺性别角色的群体，确实更容易控制，因此对于一个痴迷于资格认证、病理化和削减福利的“工党”政府来说，将“正常”视为美德，将任何差异视为需要消除的疾病，当然是可取的。
我可以谈论很多事情，我个人在英国接受过的可怕的CBT和软性强制改造疗法，国家监控和惩罚不成比例地针对自闭症患者，即使是惩罚性和不足的心理护理也很难获得，结果以“生产力”而不是幸福来衡量。这种趋势不仅体现在大型机器或互联网设备中，而且已经渗透到生活的方方面面，就像人们害怕TikTok注意力跨度一样；我想要联合的人们不断地吹嘘“变得正常”或者沉迷于健康和健身的骗局。
一张令人精疲力竭和悲伤的牌。老实说，我抽到它的时候差点把它放回去哈哈。但显然，它仍然是当代技术思想的重要组成部分。

src_seg:
March 3 - The Star, hope, inspiration, future goals. A much more positive card than we've had so far!
But it's hard to feel positive about the massively exploitative and yet still totally underwhelming reality of artifical intelligence and quantum computing hype at the moment. The idea of an omnipotent computer, that could, indeed, simulate or work at an atomic or subatomic level, has kind of been the great dream of computing for a long time. It's almost a philosopher's stone type of thing.
Yesterday I reread this great essay on the current generative AI models by Hito Steyerl (https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images). She does a great job of going into how reliant these systems still are on human-made images, cleaned data, and ongoing human moderation at every level, but she also makes the observation that while their outputs masquerade as bits of text or images, which people wrongly attribute intention or creativity to, they're really statistical representations, with all of the inherent ideology and limitations of statistics baked in.
What would a truly intelligent computer capable of expanding our analytical powers and relieving the burden of tedious labor and the risks of incomplete information look like, and under what context would it be used to reinvent life towards more autonomy and joy rather than accelerating exploitation and control? Can we hope for such a thing with IBM and DARPA still in the picture...?
tgt_seg:
3月3日——星辰，希望、灵感、未来目标。一张比我们之前看到的更积极的牌！
但现在，很难对人工智能和量子计算炒作的巨大剥削和仍然令人失望的现实感到乐观。一台可以模拟或在原子或亚原子层面工作的全能计算机的想法，一直是计算的伟大梦想。它几乎是一种炼金术士的石头。
昨天我重读了Hito Steyerl关于当前生成式人工智能模型的精彩文章（https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images）。她很好地阐述了这些系统仍然依赖于人类制作的图像、清理后的数据以及在各个层面的持续的人类审核，但她也指出，虽然它们的输出伪装成文本或图像的片段，人们错误地将意图或创造力归因于它们，但它们实际上是统计表示，带有统计固有的所有意识形态和局限性。
一个真正智能的计算机，能够扩展我们的分析能力，减轻繁重劳动和不完整信息的风险，会是什么样子？在什么背景下，它会被用来重塑生活，以实现更大的自主性和快乐，而不是加速剥削和控制？我们能否期望出现这样的事物，IBM和DARPA还在其中发挥作用的情况下……？

src_seg:
March 4 - The King of Swords, intellectual drive, clarity, calling for authoritative action. A go-for-it type of thing.
Timothy Leary certainly was a sort of intellectually driven, though more of a “question authority” type. Likewise, looking it up, the Eight-circuit Model of Consciousness here is generally thought to have little actual scientific credibility. Still… what model of consciousness does? Despite being how all of our “information” comes to us, it’s kind of ambiguous what this thing actually is, much less if there’s any systemic patterns that determine how it works.
I find it kind of inspiring to contemplate a multi-part model of consciousness that is both inward and outward looking. Leary was also of a period where there was optimism about space exploration, and the possibility of making contact with other species, from Earth or beyond. Now we seem to find this idea kind of embarrassing, because the idea of explaining ourselves feels embarrassing. Which in a way is it’s own kind of constantly-reinforcing self-centeredness.
There’s nothing more self-centered in the irritating way than how psychedelics as self-help, a “miracle” mental illness cure, the one weird trick to go 10x or come up with that sick disruptive business deal or chill out your bitch wife, have kind of become mainstream now. It’s all very inward-looking to the point that there’s nothing besides inward-ness. What’s the point of a honed mind if you can’t, like the king of swords, point it outwards?
tgt_seg:
3月4日——宝剑之王，智力驱动、清晰、呼吁采取权威行动。一种积极进取的类型。
蒂莫西·李里当然是一种智力驱动的人，但更像是一种“质疑权威”的人。同样，查询结果显示，这里的八回路意识模型通常被认为缺乏实际的科学可信度。不过……意识的模型是什么？尽管它是我们所有“信息”来源，但它到底是什么？更不用说是否存在决定其运作方式的系统模式了。
我发现思考一个既内向又外向的意识多部分模型很有启发性。李里也生活在一个对太空探索和与地球内外其他物种建立联系的可能性持乐观态度的时代。现在，我们似乎觉得这个想法有点尴尬，因为向他人解释自己的感觉很尴尬。从某种意义上说，这本身就是一种不断自我强化以自我为中心的表现。
现在，将迷幻药作为自助疗法、“奇迹”精神疾病治疗法、实现10倍增长或促成令人兴奋的颠覆性商业交易或让你的妻子冷静下来的“秘诀”变得主流，这是一种非常内向的现象，以至于除了内向性之外，什么都没有。如果不能像宝剑之王一样，将磨练过的头脑指向外部，那么一个磨练过的头脑有什么意义呢？

src_seg:
March 5 - Five of Pentacles... A difficult situation, struggle, financial insecurity.
Infrastructure... precisely that thing it never feels like there's enough cash for. ESPECIALLY in tech, where it always flows towards hype and disruption rather than maintaining what already exists.
The Internet is so huge, has such great practical benefits, and is an important part of so many peoples' lives, that of course we want the infrastructure maintained, and there to be good governance... Maybe it was the hype of the Internet itself that allowed some of these early gestures towards standardization and productive ground rules to stick.
Though there are a ton of tech corporations involved, a surprising amount was also done via the US Department of Defense directly, and now a lot of the corporations (ex- Don't Be Evil Google, for example) are chipping away at the principles they once helped set up... Whose infrastructure? It's always tied to governance, and always ideological. Be careful who you go asking for cash when you're broke...
tgt_seg:
3月5日——五枚五角星……一种困难的处境、挣扎、经济不稳定。
基础设施……正是那种永远感觉资金不足的东西。尤其是在技术领域，资金总是流向炒作和颠覆，而不是维护现有事物。
互联网规模巨大，具有极大的实际好处，并且是许多人生活中重要的一部分，因此我们当然希望基础设施得到维护，并且有良好的治理……也许正是互联网本身的炒作，才使得一些早期针对标准化和富有成效的规则的尝试得以坚持。
尽管有许多科技公司参与其中，但也有大量的资金是通过美国国防部直接提供的，现在许多公司（例如前“不要作恶”的谷歌）正在削弱他们曾经帮助建立的原则……谁的基础设施？它总是与治理相关，并且总是具有意识形态色彩。当你身无分文时，最好小心你向谁寻求资金……

src_seg:
March 6 - DEATH!! An inevitable and total transformation, possibly painful, but not necessarily The End...
A lot of anti-tech sentiment seems to wish that we could just put certain things back in the box. But the world where the technology that provides connection and access to information was entangled by its maybe well-intentioned originators with military and surveillance culture, game theory and bombs, is the world we have.
I always found the PVP gimmick for MGSV's online mode to be weirdly inspiring... if we want to live in a world without the atomic bomb, it'll have to be one where we took them all apart with our own hands. And it'll be one where the knowledge that it was made at one time will also always be a thing. How we frame it is up to us... there is no going back. How terrifying, how wonderful.
tgt_seg:
3月6日——死亡！！一场不可避免的、彻底的转变，可能痛苦，但并非最终的终结……
许多反技术情绪希望我们能够将某些事物重新放回盒子里。但我们生活在一个技术为连接和获取信息提供便利的世界，而这个世界又与军事和监控文化、博弈论和炸弹纠缠在一起。
我一直觉得MGSV在线模式中的PVP机制很奇怪地鼓舞人心……如果我们想生活在一个没有原子弹的世界里，那必须是一个我们用自己的双手拆除它们的的世界。而且，它也将永远存在着它曾经被制造出来的知识。我们如何构建它取决于我们……多么可怕，多么美好。

src_seg:
I idly proposed doing this yesterday so for March I will be posting one card I draw fom Suzanne Treister's Hexen 2.0 Tarot Deck per day of March.
The deck consists of all the major and minor arcana depicted by alchemical drawings of people and things from the history of technology, or, more specifically, "the scientific underpinnings of what Michel Foucault called bio-political governance."
Why? Because I actually have to do some tech-related talks this month, and also with the dark side of tech being so blatant lately, I felt the need to think about it more, and explore my associations/values etc!

我昨天随意提议了一下，所以整个三月，我每天都会从Suzanne Treister的Hexen 2.0塔罗牌中抽出一张牌并发布。
这副牌包含了所有大阿尔卡那和小阿尔卡那，以炼金术风格的插图描绘了科技史上的人物和事物，或者更具体地说，“是米歇尔·福柯所说的生物政治治理的科学基础”。

It’s all very inward-looking to the point that there’s nothing besides inward-ness. What’s the point of a honed mind if you can’t, like the king of swords, point it outwards?
tgt_seg:
3月4日 - 宝剑国王，理智驱动力、清晰、呼吁权威行动。一种果断行动的象征。
蒂莫西·利里（Timothy Leary）当然算得上某种理智驱动型人物，尽管他更偏向“质疑权威”的类型。同样，查阅资料可知，这里的八回路意识模型（Eight-circuit Model of Consciousness）普遍被认为缺乏真正的科学可信度。尽管如此……又有哪种意识模型真正具备科学可信度呢？尽管它是我们所有“信息”的来源，但意识本身到底是什么，仍然模糊不清，更不用说是否存在决定其运作方式的系统性模式了。
我发现自己挺受启发的，去思考一个既向内又向外的多部分意识模型。利里所处的时代，人们对太空探索和与地球或其他星球上的其他物种接触的可能性充满乐观。而现在，我们似乎觉得这个想法有点尴尬，因为解释我们自己的想法让人感到尴尬。从某种意义上说，这本身就是一种不断自我强化的自我中心。
没有什么比迷幻剂作为自我帮助工具、作为“奇迹”精神疾病疗法、作为实现10倍增长或想出颠覆性商业计划或让你那“烦人的妻子”冷静下来的“神奇技巧”而变得主流更令人讨厌的自我中心了。它变得如此内向，以至于除了内向之外，似乎再无其他。如果不能像宝剑国王那样，将敏锐的头脑指向外部，那它的意义又何在？

The Internet is so huge, has such great practical benefits, and is an important part of so many peoples' lives, that of course we want the infrastructure maintained, and there to be good governance... Maybe it was the hype of the Internet itself that allowed some of these early gestures towards standardization and productive ground rules to stick.
Though there are a ton of tech corporations involved, a surprising amount was also done via the US Department of Defense directly, and now a lot of the corporations (ex- Don't Be Evil Google, for example) are chipping away at the principles they once helped set up... Whose infrastructure? It's always tied to governance, and always ideological. Be careful who you go asking for cash when you're broke...

基础设施……恰恰是那种我们总觉得资金永远不够的东西。尤其是在科技领域，资金总是流向炒作和颠覆，而不是维护已有的东西。
互联网如此庞大，带来了巨大的实际好处，是许多人生活中重要的一部分，所以我们当然希望基础设施得到维护，并有良好的治理……也许正是互联网本身的炒作，才使得早期一些标准化和建立有效规则的努力得以坚持下来。
尽管有许多科技公司参与其中，但令人惊讶的是，其中也有大量工作是直接由美国国防部完成的，而现在许多公司（例如曾经“不作恶”的谷歌）正在逐渐削弱它们曾经帮助建立的原则……基础设施总是与治理相关，也总是带有意识形态的。当你身无分文时，要小心你向谁去寻求资金……

And it'll be one where the knowledge that it was made at one time will also always be a thing. How we frame it is up to us... there is no going back. How terrifying, how wonderful.

3月6日 - 死亡！！一种不可避免且彻底的转变，可能痛苦，但不一定是终结……

src_seg:
March 1 - Starting with the 10 of Wands, typically representing overload, burden.

3月1日 - 从权杖十开始，通常象征过载与负担。

src_seg:
March 2 - 9 of Swords... following on from the feelings of overload and burden yesterday, this card represents nightmares and anxiety about the future.
Appropriately it's represented here by The Tavistock Institute of Human Relations, a UK governmental body established in 1946 that acted regionally, nationally, and internationally for “the social engagement of social sciences” or more bluntly, using theoretical methods to “change behavior in groups and civilian populations.”
Obviously the name Tavistock brings to mind the overbearing interference of the UK government in constantly trying to block any sort of trans care, or only dispensing it as a last resort after you’ve gone through years of waiting around and a thorough psychiatric probing. A population where everyone just conformed to the two standard cis gender roles would indeed be much easier to control, so to a “Labour” government obsessed with means testing, pathologizing and cutting benefits, it’s of course desirable to treat “normality” as a virtue and any difference as disease to eliminate.
I could talk about so many things, the awful CBT and soft conversion therapy I’ve personally received in the UK, how state surveillance and punishment disproportionately targets autistic people, how even punitive and inadequate psychological care is too hard to access, how outcomes are measured in “productivity” rather than happiness. A tendency that is not technic in the big machines or internet enabled devices way, but has infested every aspect of life as much as people fear tiktok attention spans have; people I want to ally with constantly crowing “just be normal” or getting sucked down a health and fitness grifthole.
An exhausting and sad card. I’ll be honest, I almost put it back when I pulled it lol. But obviously a big part of contemporary technological thought nevertheless.

3月2日 - 宝剑九...延续昨日过载与负担的情绪，这张牌代表对未来的噩梦与焦虑。  
恰如其分地，此处呈现的是塔维斯托克人类关系研究所——1946年成立的英国政府机构，在地区、国家和国际层面推动"社会科学的社会应用"，更直白地说，运用理论方法"改变群体和平民行为"。  
显然"塔维斯托克"这个名字让人联想到英国政府霸道干预，不断阻挠任何跨性别关怀，或仅在你经历数年等待和彻底精神评估后才作为最后手段提供。一个人人顺从两种标准顺性别角色的社会确实更易控制，因此对痴迷于经济审查、病理化和削减福利的"工党"政府而言，将"正常"视为美德、将差异当作待消除的疾病自然是理想状态。  
我能谈论太多：我在英国亲身经历过的糟糕认知行为治疗与温和转化疗法、国家监控与惩罚如何不成比例地针对自闭人群、连惩罚性且不足的心理关怀都难以获取、结果如何以"生产力"而非幸福感衡量。这种倾向虽非巨型机器或联网设备式的技术，却如人们恐惧TikTok侵蚀注意力般渗透生活每个角落——我想结盟的人们不断叫嚷"正常点行吗"，或陷入健康健身的骗局漩涡。  
令人精疲力尽又悲伤的牌。说实话抽到它时我差点放回去。但这显然是当代技术思想的重要部分。

March 3 - The Star, hope, inspiration, future goals. A much more positive card than we've had so far!
But it's hard to feel positive about the massively exploitative and yet still totally underwhelming reality of artifical intelligence and quantum computing hype at the moment. The idea of an omnipotent computer, that could, indeed, simulate or work at an atomic or subatomic level, has kind of been the great dream of computing for a long time. It's almost a philosopher's stone type of thing.
Yesterday I reread this great essay on the current generative AI models by Hito Steyerl (https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images). She does a great job of going into how reliant these systems still are on human-made images, cleaned data, and ongoing human moderation at every level, but she also makes the observation that while their outputs masquerade as bits of text or images, which people wrongly attribute intention or creativity to, they're really statistical representations, with all of the inherent ideology and limitations of statistics baked in.
What would a truly intelligent computer capable of expanding our analytical powers and relieving the burden of tedious labor and the risks of incomplete information look like, and under what context would it be used to reinvent life towards more autonomy and joy rather than accelerating exploitation and control? Can we hope for such a thing with IBM and DARPA still in the picture...?

3月3日 - 星星牌，象征希望、灵感与未来目标。比前两张积极多了！

昨天重读了Hito Steyerl关于当前生成式AI模型的精彩文章(https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images)。她深入剖析了这些系统仍如何依赖人造图像、清洗数据和持续人工审核，同时指出：当输出伪装成文本或图像碎片（人们错误地赋予其意图或创造性时），它们本质是统计表征，内嵌着统计学固有的意识形态与局限。  
真正能扩展分析能力、减轻繁琐劳动负担与信息不全风险的智能计算机会是什么形态？在什么情境下它会被用于重塑生活、追求更多自主与快乐而非加速剥削与控制？当IBM和DARPA仍在局中，我们还能期待这样的存在吗...？

March 2 - 9 of Swords... following on from the feelings of overload and burden yesterday, this card represents nightmares and anxiety about the future.
Appropriately it's represented here by The Tavistock Institute of Human Relations, a UK governmental body established in 1946 that acted regionally, nationally, and internationally for “the social engagement of social sciences” or more bluntly, using theoretical methods to “change behavior in groups and civilian populations.”
Obviously the name Tavistock brings to mind the overbearing interference of the UK government in constantly trying to block any sort of trans care, or only dispensing it as a last resort after you’ve gone through years of waiting around and a thorough psychiatric probing. A population where everyone just conformed to the two standard cis gender roles would indeed be much easier to control, so to a “Labour” government obsessed with means testing, pathologizing and cutting benefits, it’s of course desirable to treat “normality” as a virtue and any difference as disease to eliminate.
I could talk about so many things, the awful CBT and soft conversion therapy I’ve personally received in the UK, how state surveillance and punishment disproportionately targets autistic people, how even punitive and inadequate psychological care is too hard to access, how outcomes are measured in “productivity” rather than happiness. A tendency that is not technic in the big machines or internet enabled devices way, but has infested every aspect of life as much as people fear tiktok attention spans have; people I want to ally with constantly crowing “just be normal” or getting sucked down a health and fitness grifthole.
An exhausting and sad card. I’ll be honest, I almost put it back when I pulled it lol. But obviously a big part of contemporary technological thought nevertheless.
tgt_seg:
3月2日——九把剑……延续着昨天的过度压力与负担的感受，这张牌代表了对未来的噩梦与焦虑。
正如其名称所暗示的，这里有代表性的机构是塔维斯托克人际关系研究所，它是一个成立于1946年的英国政府机构，致力于在地区、国家和国际层面上推动“社会科学的社会参与”，或更直接地说，就是利用理论方法“改变群体和普通民众的行为。”
显然，特维斯托克这个名字让人联想到英国政府那种不断干预的行为，他们试图阻止任何形式的跨性别护理，或者在你经过多年的等待和彻底的精神病学调查后才作为最后的措施提供这种护理。一个所有人只遵从两种标准异性恋角色的社会确实更容易被控制，因此，对于一个痴迷于经济调查、病态分析和削减福利的“工党”政府来说，将“正常”视为一种美德，并将任何差异视为需要消除的疾病，是他们当然会推崇的做法。
我可以谈论很多事情，比如我在英国亲身经历过的糟糕的认知行为疗法和软性转化疗法，国家的监控和惩罚如何不成比例地针对自闭症患者，即使是惩罚性且不充分的心理治疗也难以获得，结果是以“生产力”而不是以幸福感来衡量的。这种倾向并不限于大型机器或互联网设备，而是像人们担心抖音会让注意力持续下降那样，渗入生活的各个方面；我想与之结盟的人们却总是不断喊着“要正常一点”，或者沉迷于健康和健身领域的误区。
一张令人疲惫且悲伤的牌。说实话，我在抽到它的时候差点把它放回去，哈哈。但显然它仍然是当代科技思想中很重要的一部分。

src_seg:
March 3 - The Star, hope, inspiration, future goals. A much more positive card than we've had so far!
But it's hard to feel positive about the massively exploitative and yet still totally underwhelming reality of artifical intelligence and quantum computing hype at the moment. The idea of an omnipotent computer, that could, indeed, simulate or work at an atomic or subatomic level, has kind of been the great dream of computing for a long time. It's almost a philosopher's stone type of thing.
Yesterday I reread this great essay on the current generative AI models by Hito Steyerl (https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images). She does a great job of going into how reliant these systems still are on human-made images, cleaned data, and ongoing human moderation at every level, but she also makes the observation that while their outputs masquerade as bits of text or images, which people wrongly attribute intention or creativity to, they're really statistical representations, with all of the inherent ideology and limitations of statistics baked in.
What would a truly intelligent computer capable of expanding our analytical powers and relieving the burden of tedious labor and the risks of incomplete information look like, and under what context would it be used to reinvent life towards more autonomy and joy rather than accelerating exploitation and control? Can we hope for such a thing with IBM and DARPA still in the picture...?
tgt_seg:
3月3日 - 星星、希望、灵感、未来目标。这张牌比我们之前抽到的要积极得多！
然而，目前很难对人工智能和量子计算的极端商业炒作及其仍然毫无亮点的现实感到乐观。一台能够模拟或在原子或亚原子层面工作的全能计算机，长期以来一直被视作计算机学界的一场伟大梦想。这几乎是像哲学家梦寐以求的“点金石”一样的东西。
昨天，我重读了希托·斯泰耶尔（Hito Steyerl）关于当前生成式人工智能模型的这篇精彩文章（https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images）。她很好地分析了这些系统在各个层面上依然依赖于人类制作的图像、清理过的数据以及持续的人为审核，但她也指出，这些系统的输出虽然伪装成文本或图像，人们错误地将其视为具有意图或创造力的表现，但它们实际上只是统计表征，充满了统计学本身所固有的意识形态和局限性。
真正聪明的计算机应该是什么模样呢？它能够扩展我们的分析能力，减轻繁琐劳动的负担，并消除因信息不完整而带来的风险。在什么样的背景下，它才能被用来重新定义生活，使之更具自主性和乐趣，而不是加速剥削和控制呢？在IBM和DARPA仍然存在的情况下，我们能够期待这样的事情吗……？

src_seg:
March 4 - The King of Swords, intellectual drive, clarity, calling for authoritative action. A go-for-it type of thing.
Timothy Leary certainly was a sort of intellectually driven, though more of a “question authority” type. Likewise, looking it up, the Eight-circuit Model of Consciousness here is generally thought to have little actual scientific credibility. Still… what model of consciousness does? Despite being how all of our “information” comes to us, it’s kind of ambiguous what this thing actually is, much less if there’s any systemic patterns that determine how it works.
I find it kind of inspiring to contemplate a multi-part model of consciousness that is both inward and outward looking. Leary was also of a period where there was optimism about space exploration, and the possibility of making contact with other species, from Earth or beyond. Now we seem to find this idea kind of embarrassing, because the idea of explaining ourselves feels embarrassing. Which in a way is it’s own kind of constantly-reinforcing self-centeredness.
There’s nothing more self-centered in the irritating way than how psychedelics as self-help, a “miracle” mental illness cure, the one weird trick to go 10x or come up with that sick disruptive business deal or chill out your bitch wife, have kind of become mainstream now. It’s all very inward-looking to the point that there’s nothing besides inward-ness. What’s the point of a honed mind if you can’t, like the king of swords, point it outwards?
tgt_seg:
3月4日——剑之王，代表着智力驱动、清晰思维、呼唤权威行动。一种勇往直前的态度。
蒂莫西·利里确实是一种智力驱动型的人物，不过他更偏向于“质疑权威”的风格。同样，查阅相关资料后发现，这里的八环意识模型通常被认为并没有多少实际的科学可信度。然而……什么是意识模型呢？尽管这是所有“信息”传递给我们的方式，但这种方式到底是什么却有些模糊，更不用说是否存在任何系统性的模式来决定它的运作方式了。
我觉得思考一种同时面向内和面向外的多维意识模型还是挺有启发性的。莱里所处的时代对太空探索充满乐观，也相信与地球或其他地方的其他物种接触是可能的。现在我们似乎对这种想法感到有些尴尬，因为解释自身的想法让人感到有些羞愧。从某种意义上来说，这本身也是一种不断自我强化的自我中心观念。
没有任何事情比这种自我崇拜的方式更让人恼火，比如将迷幻药物作为自我帮助的工具、作为“奇迹”的精神疾病治疗方法、作为能够让你变得十倍聪明或创造出某个极具突破性的商业交易的“奇招”或是用来安抚你那难缠的老婆的“秘方”，现在这些已经成了主流了。一切都太过于内向了，以至于没有任何东西是向外而存在的。如果你不能像剑王那样把注意力投向外部，一个被磨练过的头脑有什么用呢？

src_seg:
March 5 - Five of Pentacles... A difficult situation, struggle, financial insecurity.
Infrastructure... precisely that thing it never feels like there's enough cash for. ESPECIALLY in tech, where it always flows towards hype and disruption rather than maintaining what already exists.
The Internet is so huge, has such great practical benefits, and is an important part of so many peoples' lives, that of course we want the infrastructure maintained, and there to be good governance... Maybe it was the hype of the Internet itself that allowed some of these early gestures towards standardization and productive ground rules to stick.
Though there are a ton of tech corporations involved, a surprising amount was also done via the US Department of Defense directly, and now a lot of the corporations (ex- Don't Be Evil Google, for example) are chipping away at the principles they once helped set up... Whose infrastructure? It's always tied to governance, and always ideological. Be careful who you go asking for cash when you're broke...
tgt_seg:
3月5日 - 五角星牌... 困难的局势、挣扎、财务不安全。
基础设施……恰恰是那种总让人觉得资金不足的领域。尤其是在科技领域，资金总是流向炒作和颠覆，而不是用于维持现有设施。
互联网如此庞大，具有如此巨大的实用价值，并且成为许多人生活中的重要组成部分，因此我们当然希望其基础设施得到维护，并且有良好的管理……也许正是互联网本身的热潮使得早期的一些标准化和有效规则的倡议得以延续。
虽然有许多科技公司参与其中，但令人惊讶的是，相当一部分工作还是直接由美国国防部完成的，而现在许多公司（比如过去提倡“别做邪恶者”的谷歌）正在悄悄背弃它们曾经帮助建立的原则……基础设施是谁的？这总是与治理有关，而且总是与意识形态相连。当你没钱时，务必小心选择向谁寻求资金支援……

src_seg:
March 6 - DEATH!! An inevitable and total transformation, possibly painful, but not necessarily The End...
A lot of anti-tech sentiment seems to wish that we could just put certain things back in the box. But the world where the technology that provides connection and access to information was entangled by its maybe well-intentioned originators with military and surveillance culture, game theory and bombs, is the world we have.
I always found the PVP gimmick for MGSV's online mode to be weirdly inspiring... if we want to live in a world without the atomic bomb, it'll have to be one where we took them all apart with our own hands. And it'll be one where the knowledge that it was made at one time will also always be a thing. How we frame it is up to us... there is no going back. How terrifying, how wonderful.
tgt_seg:
3月6日 - 死亡！！一种不可避免且彻底的转变，可能会很痛苦，但不一定意味着终结……
许多反对科技进步的人似乎希望我们能将某些东西重新放回“盒子里”。但我们如今面对的世界是这样：提供连接和信息获取的技术被其或许出于良好意图的创造者与军事和监视文化、博弈论及炸弹结合起来，这就是我们所面对的世界。
我总是觉得《合金装备V》在线模式中的PVP玩法令人感到诡异而又充满启示……如果我们想生活在一个没有原子弹的世界里，我们必须亲手把它们全部拆解掉。而且，这个世界的某种记忆将永远存在，那就是曾经拥有过原子弹的事实。如何解读这个存在由我们决定……没有回头路。多么可怕，多么美妙。

src_seg:
I idly proposed doing this yesterday so for March I will be posting one card I draw fom Suzanne Treister's Hexen 2.0 Tarot Deck per day of March.
The deck consists of all the major and minor arcana depicted by alchemical drawings of people and things from the history of technology, or, more specifically, "the scientific underpinnings of what Michel Foucault called bio-political governance."
Why? Because I actually have to do some tech-related talks this month, and also with the dark side of tech being so blatant lately, I felt the need to think about it more, and explore my associations/values etc!
tgt_seg:
昨天我随口一提，于是决定在三月里，每天从苏珊娜·特雷斯特的《女巫2.0塔罗牌》中抽一张牌并发布出来。
这副牌包含了所有大阿卡那和小阿卡那，牌面描绘了科技史中的人物与事物，采用了炼金术风格的绘画，或者更具体地说，是“米歇尔·福柯所谓的生命政治治理的科学基础”。
为什么这么做？因为这个月我正好要做一些技术相关的讲座，而且最近科技的阴暗面暴露得如此明目张胆，我觉得有必要对此进行更深入的思考，并探索我自己的联想和价值观等等！

src_seg:
March 1 - Starting with the 10 of Wands, typically representing overload, burden.
Here it is represented by a variety of early computing projects, many subsidized by their respective governments.
I think of how before a computer or calculator was a thing it was a job. Even after they existed, people still had to mediate, calculate, punch cards, interpret, etc. And in my own work I still often feel like a babysitter of inflexible computational quirks... why can't the spreadsheet software, or CMS, or database just do that mind-numbingly boring and burdensome stuff for me?
I also think how, even if it's built on what were once dull analog tasks, it's not -exactly- the same though, is it? In middle school computer lab I was taught a bit of BASIC, and being able to make a simple text "frogger" or branching adventure program, even if they were super rudimentary, was more compelling for some reason than imagining them or drawing them in a notebook... the sort of action at a delay/distance that computing offers, or that is computing's illusion...
tgt_seg:
三月一日 - 从权杖十开始，这张牌通常代表超负荷和重担。
在这副牌里，它由一系列早期的计算项目来代表，其中许多项目都得到了各自政府的资助。
我想到，在计算机或计算器成为一种“物”之前，它曾是一种“工作”。即使在它们出现之后，人们仍然需要进行协调、计算、打孔、解读等工作。在我自己的工作中，我仍然常常感觉自己像是那些死板的计算怪癖的保姆……为什么电子表格软件、内容管理系统或数据库就不能替我完成那些枯燥乏味、令人头脑麻木的繁重工作呢？
我也在想，即使它是建立在曾经枯燥的模拟任务之上，但这和过去也并不完全一样，不是吗？中学时，我在计算机课上学了一点BASIC语言，能够制作一个简单的文本版“青蛙过河”或分支冒险程序，即便它们都超级简陋，但不知为何，这比在笔记本上想象或画出它们要吸引人得多……计算所提供的那种延迟的、有距离感的行动，或者说，这本身就是计算的幻觉……
