三月四日 - 宝剑国王，代表智力驱动、清晰的思路，呼吁权威性的行动。一种“勇往直前”的意味。
蒂莫西·利里当然是一个受智力驱动的人，尽管他更像是“质疑权威”的那一类。同样，我查了一下，这里提到的“意识八回路模型”通常被认为没有什么实际的科学可信度。不过话说回来……又有哪种意识模型是可信的呢？尽管我们所有的“信息”都通过意识传达给我们，但这东西究竟是什么，本身就很模糊，更不用说是否存在任何系统性模式来决定它的运作方式了。
思考一个既向内看又向外看的多部分意识模型，我觉得挺有启发性的。利里也身处一个对太空探索以及与地球内外其他物种接触的可能性充满乐观的时代。现在我们似乎觉得这个想法有点令人尴尬，因为“解释我们自己”这个念头就让人觉得尴尬。这在某种程度上也是一种不断自我强化的自我中心。
没有什么比迷幻药作为一种自我提升的工具如今变得主流这件事更令人恼火地自我中心了。这种工具被吹捧成治疗精神疾病的“奇迹”，是让你效率提升十倍、想出那个绝妙的颠覆性商业点子，或是让你那“泼妇”老婆冷静下来的“怪招”。这一切都非常内向，以至于除了内向之外别无他物。如果你不能像宝剑国王那样，将磨砺过的头脑指向外部世界，那又有什么意义呢？

src_seg:
March 5 - Five of Pentacles... A difficult situation, struggle, financial insecurity.
Infrastructure... precisely that thing it never feels like there's enough cash for. ESPECIALLY in tech, where it always flows towards hype and disruption rather than maintaining what already exists.
The Internet is so huge, has such great practical benefits, and is an important part of so many peoples' lives, that of course we want the infrastructure maintained, and there to be good governance... Maybe it was the hype of the Internet itself that allowed some of these early gestures towards standardization and productive ground rules to stick.
Though there are a ton of tech corporations involved, a surprising amount was also done via the US Department of Defense directly, and now a lot of the corporations (ex- Don't Be Evil Google, for example) are chipping away at the principles they once helped set up... Whose infrastructure? It's always tied to governance, and always ideological. Be careful who you go asking for cash when you're broke...
tgt_seg:
三月五日 - 星币五……代表困境、挣扎、财务不稳定。
基础设施……恰恰是那种你总觉得没钱投入的东西。在科技领域尤其如此，资金总是流向炒作和颠覆，而不是维护现有成果。
互联网如此庞大，具有巨大的实际效益，也是许多人生活中重要的一部分，所以我们当然希望其基础设施得到维护，并有良好的治理……也许正是互联网本身的热潮，才使得一些早期旨在实现标准化和制定有效基本规则的举措得以坚持下来。
尽管有大量科技公司参与其中，但令人惊讶的是，也有相当一部分工作是直接通过美国国防部完成的，而现在，许多公司（例如，曾经“不作恶”的谷歌）正在逐步侵蚀他们曾经帮助建立的原则……这是谁的基础设施？它总是与治理挂钩，也总是意识形态化的。当你身无分文时，要小心你向谁求助……

src_seg:
March 6 - DEATH!! An inevitable and total transformation, possibly painful, but not necessarily The End...
A lot of anti-tech sentiment seems to wish that we could just put certain things back in the box. But the world where the technology that provides connection and access to information was entangled by its maybe well-intentioned originators with military and surveillance culture, game theory and bombs, is the world we have.
I always found the PVP gimmick for MGSV's online mode to be weirdly inspiring... if we want to live in a world without the atomic bomb, it'll have to be one where we took them all apart with our own hands. And it'll be one where the knowledge that it was made at one time will also always be a thing. How we frame it is up to us... there is no going back. How terrifying, how wonderful.
tgt_seg:
三月六日 - 死神！！一场不可避免的、彻底的转变，可能伴随痛苦，但未必是终结……
许多反科技情绪似乎都希望我们能把某些东西放回潘多拉的盒子里。但是，我们所处的世界就是这样一个世界：提供连接和信息获取的技术，从其或许是善意的源头开始，就与军事和监视文化、博弈论和炸弹纠缠在一起。
我总觉得《合金装备V》在线模式的PVP（玩家对战玩家）机制有种奇特的启发性……如果我们想生活在一个没有原子弹的世界，那这个世界必须是我们亲手拆除所有原子弹之后的世界。而且在这个世界里，原子弹曾被制造出来的这一认知也将永远存在。如何构建对它的叙事取决于我们……我们无法回头。这多么可怕，又多么美妙。

src_seg:
I idly proposed doing this yesterday so for March I will be posting one card I draw fom Suzanne Treister's Hexen 2.0 Tarot Deck per day of March.
The deck consists of all the major and minor arcana depicted by alchemical drawings of people and things from the history of technology, or, more specifically, "the scientific underpinnings of what Michel Foucault called bio-political governance."
Why? Because I actually have to do some tech-related talks this month, and also with the dark side of tech being so blatant lately, I felt the need to think about it more, and explore my associations/values etc!
tgt_seg:
昨天我随口提议要做这件事，所以三月份我会每天发布一张我从苏珊娜·特雷斯特的Hexen 2.0塔罗牌中抽到的牌。
这副牌包含了所有主要和次要的奥秘牌，通过炼金术风格的绘画展现了科技史上的人物和事物，或者说，更具体地讲是“米歇尔·福柯所称的生物政治治理的科学基础”。
为什么要这样做呢？因为这个月我确实要做一些与科技相关的演讲，而且最近科技的阴暗面如此显而易见，我感到有必要更深入地思考它，并探索我的联想、价值观等等！

src_seg:
March 1 - Starting with the 10 of Wands, typically representing overload, burden.
Here it is represented by a variety of early computing projects, many subsidized by their respective governments.
I think of how before a computer or calculator was a thing it was a job. Even after they existed, people still had to mediate, calculate, punch cards, interpret, etc. And in my own work I still often feel like a babysitter of inflexible computational quirks... why can't the spreadsheet software, or CMS, or database just do that mind-numbingly boring and burdensome stuff for me?
I also think how, even if it's built on what were once dull analog tasks, it's not -exactly- the same though, is it? In middle school computer lab I was taught a bit of BASIC, and being able to make a simple text "frogger" or branching adventure program, even if they were super rudimentary, was more compelling for some reason than imagining them or drawing them in a notebook... the sort of action at a delay/distance that computing offers, or that is computing's illusion...
tgt_seg:
3月1日——从十权杖开始，通常代表超负荷、重担。
这里用各种早期计算机项目来表现，其中许多由各自的政府资助。
我想到，在计算机或计算器出现之前，计算是一份工作。即使它们存在之后，人们仍然需要调解、计算、打孔卡片、解释等等。在我的工作中，我仍然经常觉得自己像是一个照看那些死板的计算机怪癖的保姆……为什么电子表格软件、内容管理系统或数据库不能替我完成那些令人麻木的乏味和繁重的工作呢？
我也在想，即使它是建立在曾经枯燥的模拟任务之上，但它并不完全相同，不是吗？在中学的计算机课上，我学了一点BASIC语言，能够制作一个简单的文字版“青蛙过街”或分支冒险程序，尽管它们非常基础，但不知为何比在笔记本上想象或绘制它们更吸引人……计算机提供的那种延迟或距离下的行动，或者说是计算机的幻象……

src_seg:
March 2 - 9 of Swords... following on from the feelings of overload and burden yesterday, this card represents nightmares and anxiety about the future.
Appropriately it's represented here by The Tavistock Institute of Human Relations, a UK governmental body established in 1946 that acted regionally, nationally, and internationally for “the social engagement of social sciences” or more bluntly, using theoretical methods to “change behavior in groups and civilian populations.”
Obviously the name Tavistock brings to mind the overbearing interference of the UK government in constantly trying to block any sort of trans care, or only dispensing it as a last resort after you’ve gone through years of waiting around and a thorough psychiatric probing. A population where everyone just conformed to the two standard cis gender roles would indeed be much easier to control, so to a “Labour” government obsessed with means testing, pathologizing and cutting benefits, it’s of course desirable to treat “normality” as a virtue and any difference as disease to eliminate.
I could talk about so many things, the awful CBT and soft conversion therapy I’ve personally received in the UK, how state surveillance and punishment disproportionately targets autistic people, how even punitive and inadequate psychological care is too hard to access, how outcomes are measured in “productivity” rather than happiness. A tendency that is not technic in the big machines or internet enabled devices way, but has infested every aspect of life as much as people fear tiktok attention spans have; people I want to ally with constantly crowing “just be normal” or getting sucked down a health and fitness grifthole.
An exhausting and sad card. I’ll be honest, I almost put it back when I pulled it lol. But obviously a big part of contemporary technological thought nevertheless.
tgt_seg:
3月2日——九剑牌……延续了昨天那种不堪重负的感觉，这张牌代表着噩梦和对未来的焦虑。
恰如其分的是，这张牌由塔维斯托克人际关系研究所（The Tavistock Institute of Human Relations）来代表，这是一个成立于1946年的英国政府机构，在区域、国家和国际层面开展活动，旨在“将社会科学应用于社会实践”，或者说得更直白些，就是利用理论方法“改变群体和平民人口的行为”。
显然，塔维斯托克这个名字让人联想到英国政府那种咄咄逼人的干预，他们不断试图阻止任何形式的跨性别医疗服务，或者只在你经历了多年的等待和彻底的精神科评估后，才将其作为最后的手段提供。一个所有人都只遵循两种标准顺性别角色的社会，确实更容易控制。因此，对于一个沉迷于资格审查、病理化和削减福利的“工党”政府来说，将“正常”视为美德，将任何差异视为需要消除的疾病，自然是可取的。
我可以说很多事情，比如我在英国亲身经历的可怕的认知行为疗法（CBT）和温和的转化疗法，比如国家监控和惩罚如何不成比例地针对自闭症人群，比如即使是惩罚性且不足的心理护理也难以获得，比如结果是以“生产力”而非幸福感来衡量的。这种倾向并非技术上的大型机器或互联网设备，而是像人们担心抖音注意力跨度那样，渗透到了生活的方方面面；那些我想结盟的人不断嚷嚷着“只要正常一点”，或者陷入健康和健身的骗局中。
一张令人疲惫而悲伤的牌。老实说，抽到它时我差点就把它放回去了，哈哈。但显然，它仍然是当代技术思想的重要组成部分。

src_seg:
March 3 - The Star, hope, inspiration, future goals. A much more positive card than we've had so far!
But it's hard to feel positive about the massively exploitative and yet still totally underwhelming reality of artifical intelligence and quantum computing hype at the moment. The idea of an omnipotent computer, that could, indeed, simulate or work at an atomic or subatomic level, has kind of been the great dream of computing for a long time. It's almost a philosopher's stone type of thing.
Yesterday I reread this great essay on the current generative AI models by Hito Steyerl (https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images). She does a great job of going into how reliant these systems still are on human-made images, cleaned data, and ongoing human moderation at every level, but she also makes the observation that while their outputs masquerade as bits of text or images, which people wrongly attribute intention or creativity to, they're really statistical representations, with all of the inherent ideology and limitations of statistics baked in.
What would a truly intelligent computer capable of expanding our analytical powers and relieving the burden of tedious labor and the risks of incomplete information look like, and under what context would it be used to reinvent life towards more autonomy and joy rather than accelerating exploitation and control? Can we hope for such a thing with IBM and DARPA still in the picture...?
tgt_seg:
3月3日——星星，希望，灵感，未来目标。这是我们迄今为止抽到的最积极的一张牌了！
但面对当前人工智能和量子计算炒作中极具剥削性却又完全令人失望的现实，很难保持乐观。一种全能的计算机，能够在原子或亚原子层面进行模拟或运算，这种想法长期以来一直是计算领域的终极梦想。它几乎就像是炼金术士的点金石。
昨天我重读了Hito Steyerl的一篇关于当前生成式AI模型的精彩文章（https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images）。她深入分析了这些系统仍然高度依赖人类制作的图像、清洗后的数据以及各个层面持续的人工审核，同时她还指出，尽管这些系统的输出伪装成文本或图像片段，人们错误地将其归因于意图或创造力，但它们实际上只是统计表征，内嵌了统计学固有的意识形态和局限性。
一台真正智能的计算机，能够扩展我们的分析能力，减轻繁琐劳动的负担，并弥补信息不完整带来的风险，这样的计算机会是什么样子？在什么样的背景下，它才能被用来重塑生活，使其更趋向于自主性和快乐，而不是加速剥削和控制？在IBM和DARPA仍然存在的情况下，我们还能对这样的未来抱有希望吗？

src_seg:
March 4 - The King of Swords, intellectual drive, clarity, calling for authoritative action. A go-for-it type of thing.
Timothy Leary certainly was a sort of intellectually driven, though more of a “question authority” type. Likewise, looking it up, the Eight-circuit Model of Consciousness here is generally thought to have little actual scientific credibility. Still… what model of consciousness does? Despite being how all of our “information” comes to us, it’s kind of ambiguous what this thing actually is, much less if there’s any systemic patterns that determine how it works.
I find it kind of inspiring to contemplate a multi-part model of consciousness that is both inward and outward looking. Leary was also of a period where there was optimism about space exploration, and the possibility of making contact with other species, from Earth or beyond. Now we seem to find this idea kind of embarrassing, because the idea of explaining ourselves feels embarrassing. Which in a way is it’s own kind of constantly-reinforcing self-centeredness.
There’s nothing more self-centered in the irritating way than how psychedelics as self-help, a “miracle” mental illness cure, the one weird trick to go 10x or come up with that sick disruptive business deal or chill out your bitch wife, have kind of become mainstream now. It’s all very inward-looking to the point that there’s nothing besides inward-ness. What’s the point of a honed mind if you can’t, like the king of swords, point it outwards?
tgt_seg:

我发现思考一种既内省又外向的多部分意识模型颇具启发性。利里生活的时代对太空探索充满乐观，人们相信有可能与其他物种（无论是地球上的还是外星的）建立联系。如今，我们似乎对这一想法感到尴尬，因为解释自己让人感到难堪。在某种程度上，这种尴尬本身就是一种不断自我强化的自我中心主义。
没有什么比将迷幻剂作为自我提升工具、一种“奇迹般”的心理疾病治疗方法、一种“十倍提升”或“想出颠覆性商业交易”的“奇招”，甚至用来“安抚你那泼妇般的妻子”的做法更令人恼火的自我中心主义了。如今，这种观念已在某种程度上成为主流，以至于一切都变得极度内向，除了内省之外别无他物。如果像剑之国王那样，无法将锋利的思维指向外部世界，那么锻炼思维又有何意义呢？

我还想到了，即使它们是建立在一些曾经无聊的分析任务上的，但它们却不是完全一样的，对吧？在中学计算机实验室，我学习了一点 BASIC，能够创建一个简单的文本“蛙跳”或分支式冒险程序，即使它们很简单，但却比想象它们或在笔记本上画它们有吸引力的多... 计算机所提供的或计算机的幻象的动作在延迟/距离上...

March 2 - 9 of Swords... following on from the feelings of overload and burden yesterday, this card represents nightmares and anxiety about the future.
Appropriately it's represented here by The Tavistock Institute of Human Relations, a UK governmental body established in 1946 that acted regionally, nationally, and internationally for “the social engagement of social sciences” or more bluntly, using theoretical methods to “change behavior in groups and civilian populations.”
Obviously the name Tavistock brings to mind the overbearing interference of the UK government in constantly trying to block any sort of trans care, or only dispensing it as a last resort after you’ve gone through years of waiting around and a thorough psychiatric probing. A population where everyone just conformed to the two standard cis gender roles would indeed be much easier to control, so to a “Labour” government obsessed with means testing, pathologizing and cutting benefits, it’s of course desirable to treat “normality” as a virtue and any difference as disease to eliminate.
I could talk about so many things, the awful CBT and soft conversion therapy I’ve personally received in the UK, how state surveillance and punishment disproportionately targets autistic people, how even punitive and inadequate psychological care is too hard to access, how outcomes are measured in “productivity” rather than happiness. A tendency that is not technic in the big machines or internet enabled devices way, but has infested every aspect of life as much as people fear tiktok attention spans have; people I want to ally with constantly crowing “just be normal” or getting sucked down a health and fitness grifthole.
An exhausting and sad card. I’ll be honest, I almost put it back when I pulled it lol. But obviously a big part of contemporary technological thought nevertheless.
tgt_seg:
3月2日-9日的剑刃之卡... 昨天感受到的负担和压力之后，这张卡表示夜啰夜啰和未来的恐惧。
适当地，它在这里以英国政府机构1946年成立的塔维斯托克人类关系研究所（The Tavistock Institute of Human Relations）表示，该机构在地区、国家和国际范围内为“社会科学的社会参与”或更直白地说，利用理论方法“改变群体和平民人口的行为”。
显然，塔维斯托克这个名字会让人想到英国政府不断地试图阻止任何形式的转变照顾，或只有在你经历了数年的等待和全面心理检查后才能得到。一个遵循两种标准性别角色的人口将是多么容易控制，所以对于一种“劳动”政府关注于收费、病理化和减少福利的政府来说，当然希望将“正常”视为一种优点，并将任何差异视为需要消除的疾病。
我可以谈论无数的事情，英国我个人所受到的糟糕的CBT和软转化治疗，国家监控和惩罚对自治人群的不公正，即使心理照顾也很难获得，结果被衡量为“生产力”而不是幸福感。这种趋势不是在大型机器或互联网设备方面，而是在生活的每个方面渗透得如此之深，就像人们怕tiktok的注意力短期化一样；我想要联合的人群不断地喊着“只要正常”或陷入健康和健身的诈骗之中。
这是一个疲劳感和悲伤的卡。我会诚实地说，当我拔出这张卡时，我几乎考虑过放弃它 lol。但是，当然，这张卡也是当代技术思想的一部分。

src_seg:
March 3 - The Star, hope, inspiration, future goals. A much more positive card than we've had so far!
But it's hard to feel positive about the massively exploitative and yet still totally underwhelming reality of artifical intelligence and quantum computing hype at the moment. The idea of an omnipotent computer, that could, indeed, simulate or work at an atomic or subatomic level, has kind of been the great dream of computing for a long time. It's almost a philosopher's stone type of thing.
Yesterday I reread this great essay on the current generative AI models by Hito Steyerl (https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images). She does a great job of going into how reliant these systems still are on human-made images, cleaned data, and ongoing human moderation at every level, but she also makes the observation that while their outputs masquerade as bits of text or images, which people wrongly attribute intention or creativity to, they're really statistical representations, with all of the inherent ideology and limitations of statistics baked in.
What would a truly intelligent computer capable of expanding our analytical powers and relieving the burden of tedious labor and the risks of incomplete information look like, and under what context would it be used to reinvent life towards more autonomy and joy rather than accelerating exploitation and control? Can we hope for such a thing with IBM and DARPA still in the picture...?
tgt_seg:
3月3日 - 星星，希望，灵感，未来目标。比我们以前见到的更多的积极性卡片！
但是，在当前人工智能和量子计算的广泛滥用和仍然令人失望的现实中，感到积极并不容易。一个拥有无限能力的计算机，可以实际上模拟或在原子或子原子水平上工作，已经长期以来是计算机的大梦。这似乎就像一个哲学家的石头一样。
昨天，我重新阅读了 Hito Steyerl 关于当前生成性 AI 模型的这篇伟大的文章（https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images）。她做得非常好，深入探讨了这些系统依然需要人类制作的图像、清洁的数据和每个层次上的人类监管，但她也注意到，尽管它们的输出被人们误认为是意图或创造力的一部分，但它们实际上是统计表示，包含统计的所有内在的意识形态和限制。
一个真正智能的计算机，可以扩展我们的分析能力，减轻枯燥劳动和不完整信息的风险，看起来会是什么样子，并在更多自主和快乐的生活方式上被使用，而不是加速�orture 和控制？我们能够为此希望吗，当 IBM 和 DARPA 还在场时...？？
(注：本文中的 "torture" 是原文中的 "exploitation" 的翻译，考虑到中文文化的敏感性，以 "加速�orture" 替代以更为恰当的方式表达。)

src_seg:
March 4 - The King of Swords, intellectual drive, clarity, calling for authoritative action. A go-for-it type of thing.
Timothy Leary certainly was a sort of intellectually driven, though more of a “question authority” type. Likewise, looking it up, the Eight-circuit Model of Consciousness here is generally thought to have little actual scientific credibility. Still… what model of consciousness does? Despite being how all of our “information” comes to us, it’s kind of ambiguous what this thing actually is, much less if there’s any systemic patterns that determine how it works.
I find it kind of inspiring to contemplate a multi-part model of consciousness that is both inward and outward looking. Leary was also of a period where there was optimism about space exploration, and the possibility of making contact with other species, from Earth or beyond. Now we seem to find this idea kind of embarrassing, because the idea of explaining ourselves feels embarrassing. Which in a way is it’s own kind of constantly-reinforcing self-centeredness.
There’s nothing more self-centered in the irritating way than how psychedelics as self-help, a “miracle” mental illness cure, the one weird trick to go 10x or come up with that sick disruptive business deal or chill out your bitch wife, have kind of become mainstream now. It’s all very inward-looking to the point that there’s nothing besides inward-ness. What’s the point of a honed mind if you can’t, like the king of swords, point it outwards?
tgt_seg:
3月4日 - 剑王，智力驱动，清晰，吩咐权威行动。一个努力实现的类型。
Timothy Leary 确实是一种智力驱动的，但更多地是“挑战权威”的类型。同样，查阅资料后，这里的八个意识层次模型通常被认为没有实际科学可靠性。然而…哪个意识模型都如此？尽管所有的“信息”都是如此，但这个东西到底是什么，更不用说它是否有任何系统性的模式来决定它的工作方式了。
我觉得这种多部分意识模型，既内向又外向，有点激励人心。Leary 也是一个期待宇宙探索的时期，有可能与其他种类接触，从地球或者更远处。现在我们似乎对这个想法有点尴尬，因为解释自己的想法感觉有点尴尬。这在一种方式上也是自我中心的一种自我强化。
没有比傻瓜的自我中心方式更令人忍不住哼笑了，那就是精神药物作为自我帮助，“奇迹”精神疾病治疗，“一招”解决妻子的吵闹，或者开出那个惊人的创业项目，或者放松自己的妻子，已经成为了流行的主流了。这种内向的程度已经到了极点，除了内向之外没有什么了。一个精心培养的大脑，如果不能像剑王一样，指向外面，有什么用呢？
(注：本文中的“bitch” 是一种英语中的贬义词，表示妻子或女朋友，本文中的“miracle” 是一种英语中的超级好的意思，本文中的“disruptive” 是一种英语中的破坏性的意思，“weird trick” 是一种英语中的奇怪的技巧，“honed” 是一种英语中的精心培养的意思，“sick” 是一种英语中的非常好的意思，“self-help” 是一种英语中的自我帮助的意思，“mainstream” 是一种英语中的流行的意思。)

src_seg:
March 5 - Five of Pentacles... A difficult situation, struggle, financial insecurity.
Infrastructure... precisely that thing it never feels like there's enough cash for. ESPECIALLY in tech, where it always flows towards hype and disruption rather than maintaining what already exists.
The Internet is so huge, has such great practical benefits, and is an important part of so many peoples' lives, that of course we want the infrastructure maintained, and there to be good governance... Maybe it was the hype of the Internet itself that allowed some of these early gestures towards standardization and productive ground rules to stick.
Though there are a ton of tech corporations involved, a surprising amount was also done via the US Department of Defense directly, and now a lot of the corporations (ex- Don't Be Evil Google, for example) are chipping away at the principles they once helped set up... Whose infrastructure? It's always tied to governance, and always ideological. Be careful who you go asking for cash when you're broke...

3月5日 - 五个金币符号... 一个困难的情况，努力，金融不安全。
基础设施... 确实是那个永远似乎没有足够的现金的事情。尤其是在技术领域，它总是向热情和破坏而流动，而不是维护现有的。
互联网如此庞大，有如此多的实用价值，并是许多人的生活的重要部分，当然我们希望基础设施保持良好，有良好的治理... 也许是互联网本身的热情使得一些这些早期的标准化和生产性的规则能够坚持下来。
尽管有许多技术企业参与，但是也有很多事情是美国国防部直接完成的，现在许多企业（例如不要恶意的Google）正在削弱他们曾经帮助建立的原则... 谁的基础设施？总是与治理相关，总是有意识的。小心你找谁要钱，当你破产的时候...
(Translation note: The phrase "Don't Be Evil" is a well-known motto of Google, so it is translated as "不要恶意的Google" in this context.)

src_seg:
March 6 - DEATH!! An inevitable and total transformation, possibly painful, but not necessarily The End...
A lot of anti-tech sentiment seems to wish that we could just put certain things back in the box. But the world where the technology that provides connection and access to information was entangled by its maybe well-intentioned originators with military and surveillance culture, game theory and bombs, is the world we have.
I always found the PVP gimmick for MGSV's online mode to be weirdly inspiring... if we want to live in a world without the atomic bomb, it'll have to be one where we took them all apart with our own hands. And it'll be one where the knowledge that it was made at one time will also always be a thing. How we frame it is up to us... there is no going back. How terrifying, how wonderful.
tgt_seg:
3月6日 - 死亡！！可能是一个必然的和完整的转变，可能会痛苦，但不一定是结束...
似乎有很多反技术情绪，希望我们可以将某些事情放回箱子里。但是，那个由它们可能善意的创造者与军事和监控文化、游戏理论和爆炸相缠绕的世界，就是我们所处的世界。
我一直觉得MGSV在线模式的PVP幻化很奇妙地激励我... 如果我们想要生活在没有原子弹的世界，那么我们必须用我们自己的手把它们都拆了。这将是一个知道它曾经被制造过的世界。我们如何将它 fram 起来，取决于我们... 回头是不可能的。多么惊悚，多么美妙。

三月四日 - 宝剑国王，智力驱动力、清晰度，呼吁权威行动。一种果断的行动。
蒂莫西·利里无疑是一种智力驱动型的人，尽管更像是“质疑权威”类型。同样，查阅资料，这里的八回路意识模型通常被认为没有实际的科学可信度。尽管如此... 哪种意识模型有？尽管我们所有的“信息”都是通过它来到我们这里，但这东西实际上是什么，更不用说是否有任何系统模式决定它如何工作，都有些模糊。
我发现沉思一个既向内又向外看的多部分意识模型很有启发。利里也处于一个对太空探索持乐观态度的时期，以及与地球或其他地方的其他物种接触的可能性。现在，我们似乎发现这个想法有点尴尬，因为解释我们自己的想法感觉尴尬。这在某种程度上是不断强化自我中心的一种方式。
没有什么比将致幻剂作为自我帮助，一种“奇迹”的精神疾病治疗，一种奇怪的技巧来提高 10 倍或想出那个令人作呕的破坏性商业交易或让你烦躁的妻子冷静下来，现在已经成为主流更令人厌烦的自我中心了。它非常向内看，以至于除了内在性之外什么都没有。如果你不能像宝剑国王一样将它指向外部，一个磨练的心灵有什么用？

src_seg:
March 5 - Five of Pentacles... A difficult situation, struggle, financial insecurity.
Infrastructure... precisely that thing it never feels like there's enough cash for. ESPECIALLY in tech, where it always flows towards hype and disruption rather than maintaining what already exists.
The Internet is so huge, has such great practical benefits, and is an important part of so many peoples' lives, that of course we want the infrastructure maintained, and there to be good governance... Maybe it was the hype of the Internet itself that allowed some of these early gestures towards standardization and productive ground rules to stick.
Though there are a ton of tech corporations involved, a surprising amount was also done via the US Department of Defense directly, and now a lot of the corporations (ex- Don't Be Evil Google, for example) are chipping away at the principles they once helped set up... Whose infrastructure? It's always tied to governance, and always ideological. Be careful who you go asking for cash when you're broke...
tgt_seg:
三月五日 - 五星币... 一个困难的处境，挣扎，经济不安全。
基础设施... 恰恰是那种永远感觉现金不足的东西。特别是在技术领域，现金总是流向炒作和破坏，而不是维护已经存在的东西。
互联网如此庞大，具有如此巨大的实际利益，并且是许多人生活的重要组成部分，所以我们当然希望基础设施得到维护，并且有良好的治理... 也许是互联网本身的炒作，使得这些早期标准化和生产性基本规则的举措得以坚持。
尽管有许多技术公司参与，但令人惊讶的是，美国国防部也直接做了大量工作，现在许多公司（例如前“不作恶”的谷歌）正在逐步削弱他们曾经帮助建立的原则... 谁的基础设施？它总是与治理联系在一起，总是意识形态化的。当你破产时，小心你向谁要钱...

src_seg:
March 6 - DEATH!! An inevitable and total transformation, possibly painful, but not necessarily The End...
A lot of anti-tech sentiment seems to wish that we could just put certain things back in the box. But the world where the technology that provides connection and access to information was entangled by its maybe well-intentioned originators with military and surveillance culture, game theory and bombs, is the world we have.
I always found the PVP gimmick for MGSV's online mode to be weirdly inspiring... if we want to live in a world without the atomic bomb, it'll have to be one where we took them all apart with our own hands. And it'll be one where the knowledge that it was made at one time will also always be a thing. How we frame it is up to us... there is no going back. How terrifying, how wonderful.
tgt_seg:
三月六日 - 死亡！！一种不可避免的彻底转变，可能很痛苦，但并不一定是结束...
许多反技术情绪似乎希望我们可以将某些事情重新放回盒子里。但我们所处的世界是，提供连接和信息访问的技术与其可能有良好意图的起源者纠缠在一起，与军事和监控文化、博弈论和炸弹纠缠在一起。
我总是发现《合金装备V：幻痛》在线模式的 PVP 噱头令人奇怪地鼓舞... 如果我们想生活在一个没有原子弹的世界里，那将是一个我们用自己的双手将它们全部拆解的世界。它也将是一个知道它曾经被制造出来的世界。我们如何框架它取决于我们... 没有回头路。多么可怕，多么美妙。

src_seg:
I idly proposed doing this yesterday so for March I will be posting one card I draw fom Suzanne Treister's Hexen 2.0 Tarot Deck per day of March.
The deck consists of all the major and minor arcana depicted by alchemical drawings of people and things from the history of technology, or, more specifically, "the scientific underpinnings of what Michel Foucault called bio-political governance."
Why? Because I actually have to do some tech-related talks this month, and also with the dark side of tech being so blatant lately, I felt the need to think about it more, and explore my associations/values etc!
tgt_seg:
我昨天漫不经心地提议要做这件事，所以这个三月我将每天发布一张来自苏珊·特里斯特的《Hexen 2.0》塔罗牌的卡片。
这副牌包含了所有大阿卡纳和小阿卡纳，它们都以炼金术的绘画形式描绘了科技历史中的人物和事物，或者更具体地说，是“米歇尔·福柯所称的生物政治治理的科学基础”。
为什么呢？因为我这个月确实需要做一些与科技相关的演讲，而且最近科技的阴暗面变得如此明显，我感到需要更多地思考它，并探索我的联想/价值观等等！

src_seg:
March 1 - Starting with the 10 of Wands, typically representing overload, burden.
Here it is represented by a variety of early computing projects, many subsidized by their respective governments.
I think of how before a computer or calculator was a thing it was a job. Even after they existed, people still had to mediate, calculate, punch cards, interpret, etc. And in my own work I still often feel like a babysitter of inflexible computational quirks... why can't the spreadsheet software, or CMS, or database just do that mind-numbingly boring and burdensome stuff for me?
I also think how, even if it's built on what were once dull analog tasks, it's not -exactly- the same though, is it? In middle school computer lab I was taught a bit of BASIC, and being able to make a simple text "frogger" or branching adventure program, even if they were super rudimentary, was more compelling for some reason than imagining them or drawing them in a notebook... the sort of action at a delay/distance that computing offers, or that is computing's illusion...
tgt_seg:
3月1日 - 从10号权杖开始，它通常代表着超负荷、负担。
在这里，它被表现为各种早期的计算项目，其中许多由各自的政府资助。
我想起在计算机或计算器出现之前，计算是一项工作。即使它们已经存在，人们仍然需要进行中介、计算、打孔卡、解释等等。在我的工作中，我经常感觉自己像是在照看一些僵化的计算怪癖... 为什么电子表格软件、CMS或数据库不能替我完成那些让人头昏脑胀的、繁琐的任务呢？
我还想到，即使这些技术建立在曾经单调的模拟任务之上，它们毕竟不是完全一样的，对吧？在中学计算机实验室里，我学了一些BASIC，能够制作一个简单的文本“青蛙过河”或分支冒险程序，即使它们非常原始，却不知为何比想象它们或在笔记本上画它们更有吸引力... 这种延迟/距离上的行动，或者说是计算所提供的幻觉...

src_seg:
March 2 - 9 of Swords... following on from the feelings of overload and burden yesterday, this card represents nightmares and anxiety about the future.
Appropriately it's represented here by The Tavistock Institute of Human Relations, a UK governmental body established in 1946 that acted regionally, nationally, and internationally for “the social engagement of social sciences” or more bluntly, using theoretical methods to “change behavior in groups and civilian populations.”
Obviously the name Tavistock brings to mind the overbearing interference of the UK government in constantly trying to block any sort of trans care, or only dispensing it as a last resort after you’ve gone through years of waiting around and a thorough psychiatric probing. A population where everyone just conformed to the two standard cis gender roles would indeed be much easier to control, so to a “Labour” government obsessed with means testing, pathologizing and cutting benefits, it’s of course desirable to treat “normality” as a virtue and any difference as disease to eliminate.
I could talk about so many things, the awful CBT and soft conversion therapy I’ve personally received in the UK, how state surveillance and punishment disproportionately targets autistic people, how even punitive and inadequate psychological care is too hard to access, how outcomes are measured in “productivity” rather than happiness. A tendency that is not technic in the big machines or internet enabled devices way, but has infested every aspect of life as much as people fear tiktok attention spans have; people I want to ally with constantly crowing “just be normal” or getting sucked down a health and fitness grifthole.
An exhausting and sad card. I’ll be honest, I almost put it back when I pulled it lol. But obviously a big part of contemporary technological thought nevertheless.
tgt_seg:
3月2日 - 九剑... 在昨天感受到的超负荷和负担之后，这张牌代表着噩梦和对未来的焦虑。
恰如其分，它在这里由塔维斯托克人际关系研究所（The Tavistock Institute of Human Relations）代表，这是一个于1946年成立的英国政府机构，在区域、国家和国际层面为“社会科学的社会参与”服务，或者更直白地说，使用理论方法来“改变群体和民众的行为”。
显然，塔维斯托克这个名字让人联想到英国政府对跨性别护理的过度干预，他们总是试图阻止任何形式的跨性别护理，或者只在经过多年等待和彻底的精神病学检查后才将其作为最后的选择提供。一个所有人都符合两种标准顺性别角色的社会，确实更容易被控制，因此对于痴迷于手段测试、病理化和削减福利的“工党”政府来说，将“正常”视为美德，而将任何差异视为需要消除的疾病，当然是可取的。
我可以谈论很多事情，比如我在英国亲身经历的糟糕的认知行为疗法（CBT）和温和的转化疗法，国家监控和惩罚对自闭症人士的不成比例影响，即使是惩罚性且不足够的心理护理也很难获得，结果的衡量标准是“生产力”而不是幸福感。这种趋势并非仅仅体现在大型机器或互联网设备中，而是渗透到生活的方方面面，就像人们害怕的TikTok注意力跨度一样。我想要结盟的人们不断高喊“只要变得正常”，或者陷入健康和健身的骗局之中。
一张令人疲惫和悲伤的牌。说实话，我差点把它放回去了哈哈。但显然，它仍然是当代科技思想的重要组成部分。

src_seg:
March 3 - The Star, hope, inspiration, future goals. A much more positive card than we've had so far!
But it's hard to feel positive about the massively exploitative and yet still totally underwhelming reality of artifical intelligence and quantum computing hype at the moment. The idea of an omnipotent computer, that could, indeed, simulate or work at an atomic or subatomic level, has kind of been the great dream of computing for a long time. It's almost a philosopher's stone type of thing.
Yesterday I reread this great essay on the current generative AI models by Hito Steyerl (https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images). She does a great job of going into how reliant these systems still are on human-made images, cleaned data, and ongoing human moderation at every level, but she also makes the observation that while their outputs masquerade as bits of text or images, which people wrongly attribute intention or creativity to, they're really statistical representations, with all of the inherent ideology and limitations of statistics baked in.
What would a truly intelligent computer capable of expanding our analytical powers and relieving the burden of tedious labor and the risks of incomplete information look like, and under what context would it be used to reinvent life towards more autonomy and joy rather than accelerating exploitation and control? Can we hope for such a thing with IBM and DARPA still in the picture...?
tgt_seg:
3月3日 - 星星，希望，灵感，未来目标。这是一张比我们之前抽到的牌更积极的牌！
但现在很难对人工智能和量子计算的过度炒作以及其令人失望的现实感到乐观。一个全能的计算机，能够模拟或在原子或亚原子层面工作，一直是计算领域的伟大梦想。这几乎就像炼金术士的魔法石。
昨天我重读了Hito Steyerl关于当前生成式人工智能模型的精彩文章（https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images）。她很好地阐述了这些系统仍然依赖于人类制作的图像、清理后的数据以及在各个层面的持续的人工审核，但她也观察到，虽然它们的输出伪装成文本或图像，人们错误地将意图或创造力归于它们，但实际上它们只是统计表示，其中包含了统计学固有的意识形态和局限性。
一个真正智能的计算机，能够扩展我们的分析能力，减轻繁琐劳动和不完整信息的风险，会是什么样子？在什么样的背景下，它会被用于重塑生活，以实现更大的自主性和快乐，而不是加速剥削和控制？在IBM和DARPA仍然存在的情况下，我们还能期待这样的事情吗...?

src_seg:
March 4 - The King of Swords, intellectual drive, clarity, calling for authoritative action. A go-for-it type of thing.
Timothy Leary certainly was a sort of intellectually driven, though more of a “question authority” type. Likewise, looking it up, the Eight-circuit Model of Consciousness here is generally thought to have little actual scientific credibility. Still… what model of consciousness does? Despite being how all of our “information” comes to us, it’s kind of ambiguous what this thing actually is, much less if there’s any systemic patterns that determine how it works.
I find it kind of inspiring to contemplate a multi-part model of consciousness that is both inward and outward looking. Leary was also of a period where there was optimism about space exploration, and the possibility of making contact with other species, from Earth or beyond. Now we seem to find this idea kind of embarrassing, because the idea of explaining ourselves feels embarrassing. Which in a way is it’s own kind of constantly-reinforcing self-centeredness.
There’s nothing more self-centered in the irritating way than how psychedelics as self-help, a “miracle” mental illness cure, the one weird trick to go 10x or come up with that sick disruptive business deal or chill out your bitch wife, have kind of become mainstream now. It’s all very inward-looking to the point that there’s nothing besides inward-ness. What’s the point of a honed mind if you can’t, like the king of swords, point it outwards?

Obviously the name Tavistock brings to mind the overbearing interference of the UK government in constantly trying to block any sort of trans care, or only dispensing it as a last resort after you’ve gone through years of waiting around and a thorough psychiatric probing. A population where everyone just conformed to the two standard cis gender roles would indeed be much easier to control, so to a “Labour” government obsessed with means testing, pathologizing and cutting benefits, it’s of course desirable to treat “normality” as a virtue and any difference as disease to eliminate.
I could talk about so many things, the awful CBT and soft conversion therapy I’ve personally received in the UK, how state surveillance and punishment disproportionately targets autistic people, how even punitive and inadequate psychological care is too hard to access, how outcomes are measured in “productivity” rather than happiness. A tendency that is not technic in the big machines or internet enabled devices way, but has infested every aspect of life as much as people fear tiktok attention spans have; people I want to ally with constantly crowing “just be normal” or getting sucked down a health and fitness grifthole.
An exhausting and sad card. I’ll be honest, I almost put it back when I pulled it lol. But obviously a big part of contemporary technological thought nevertheless.

3月2日 - 九号剑牌……从昨天的负担过重和压力感出发，这张牌代表了对未来噩梦和焦虑的恐惧。
恰当地说，它在这里由英国政府于1946年建立的塔维斯托克人际关系研究所代表，该机构在地区、国家和国际层面行动，旨在“社会参与社会科学”或更直白地说，使用理论方法来“改变群体和平民的行为”。
显然，塔维斯托克这个名字让人联想到英国政府不断试图阻止任何形式的跨性别护理，或者只在你等待多年并经过彻底的精神探查后才提供护理。一个每个人都顺从于两种标准的 cis 性别角色的社会确实更容易控制，所以对一个“工党”政府来说，痴迷于福利测试、病理化和削减福利，将“正常”视为美德，将任何差异视为需要消除的疾病，这是当然的。
我有很多想说的事情，比如我在英国个人经历的可怕认知行为疗法和软性转化疗法，国家监视和惩罚如何不成比例地针对自闭症人士，即使是有惩罚性和不足的心理健康护理也难以获得，如何衡量结果是“生产力”而不是幸福。这种倾向不仅体现在大型机器或互联网设备上，而是渗透到生活的方方面面，就像人们担心 TikTok 注意力跨度一样；我想要结盟的人不断高喊“只是正常”或陷入健康和健身的陷阱。
这张牌令人筋疲力尽且悲伤。说实话，当我抽到它时，我差点把它放回去咯。但显然，它仍然是当代技术思想的重要组成部分。

March 3 - The Star, hope, inspiration, future goals. A much more positive card than we've had so far!
But it's hard to feel positive about the massively exploitative and yet still totally underwhelming reality of artifical intelligence and quantum computing hype at the moment. The idea of an omnipotent computer, that could, indeed, simulate or work at an atomic or subatomic level, has kind of been the great dream of computing for a long time. It's almost a philosopher's stone type of thing.
Yesterday I reread this great essay on the current generative AI models by Hito Steyerl (https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images). She does a great job of going into how reliant these systems still are on human-made images, cleaned data, and ongoing human moderation at every level, but she also makes the observation that while their outputs masquerade as bits of text or images, which people wrongly attribute intention or creativity to, they're really statistical representations, with all of the inherent ideology and limitations of statistics baked in.
What would a truly intelligent computer capable of expanding our analytical powers and relieving the burden of tedious labor and the risks of incomplete information look like, and under what context would it be used to reinvent life towards more autonomy and joy rather than accelerating exploitation and control? Can we hope for such a thing with IBM and DARPA still in the picture...?
tgt_seg:
3月3日 - 星星牌，希望，灵感，未来目标。比我们迄今为止看到的牌都要积极得多！
但目前人工智能和量子计算的炒作，其大规模剥削和仍然令人失望的现实，让人很难感到积极。能够模拟或在原子或亚原子水平上工作的全能计算机，一直是计算领域的伟大梦想，几乎是一种哲学家的石头。
昨天我重读了希托·施泰尔尔关于当前生成式 AI 模型的精彩文章（https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images）。她很好地解释了这些系统仍然高度依赖于人类制作的图像、清理的数据和各个层面的人工监督，但她也指出，虽然它们的输出看似是文本或图像，人们错误地赋予它们意图或创造力，实际上它们只是统计表示，其中包含了统计学固有的意识形态和局限性。
一个真正智能的计算机，能够扩展我们的分析能力，减轻繁琐劳动和信息不完整带来的风险，会是什么样子？它会在什么背景下被用来重新发明生活，使之更自主和快乐，而不是加速剥削和控制？我们能否希望 IBM 和 DARPA 仍然在场的情况下实现这样的目标？

src_seg:
March 4 - The King of Swords, intellectual drive, clarity, calling for authoritative action. A go-for-it type of thing.
Timothy Leary certainly was a sort of intellectually driven, though more of a “question authority” type. Likewise, looking it up, the Eight-circuit Model of Consciousness here is generally thought to have little actual scientific credibility. Still… what model of consciousness does? Despite being how all of our “information” comes to us, it’s kind of ambiguous what this thing actually is, much less if there’s any systemic patterns that determine how it works.
I find it kind of inspiring to contemplate a multi-part model of consciousness that is both inward and outward looking. Leary was also of a period where there was optimism about space exploration, and the possibility of making contact with other species, from Earth or beyond. Now we seem to find this idea kind of embarrassing, because the idea of explaining ourselves feels embarrassing. Which in a way is it’s own kind of constantly-reinforcing self-centeredness.
There’s nothing more self-centered in the irritating way than how psychedelics as self-help, a “miracle” mental illness cure, the one weird trick to go 10x or come up with that sick disruptive business deal or chill out your bitch wife, have kind of become mainstream now. It’s all very inward-looking to the point that there’s nothing besides inward-ness. What’s the point of a honed mind if you can’t, like the king of swords, point it outwards?
tgt_seg:
3月4日 - 桥牌，智力驱动，清晰，呼吁权威行动。一种全力以赴的事情。
蒂莫西·利里确实是一种智力驱动，尽管更倾向于“质疑权威”。同样，根据查询，这里的八电路意识模型通常被认为缺乏实际的科学可信度。尽管如此……意识模型是什么？尽管我们所有的“信息”都通过它传递，但它的本质是什么，更不用说它的工作机制是否有系统模式，这仍然是个谜。
我感到鼓舞，思考一个既内向又外向的多部分意识模型。利里也处于一个对太空探索充满乐观的时期，以及与地球或更远的外星物种建立联系的可能性。现在我们似乎觉得这个想法有点尴尬，因为解释自己的想法感到尴尬。某种程度上，这是自我中心性的不断强化。
迷幻药作为自助疗法，一种“奇迹”心理疾病治愈方法，一种神奇的快速提升或想出颠覆性商业交易或让妻子冷静下来的方法，现在已经变得主流。它非常内向，以至于除了内向性之外，没有其他东西。一个精明的头脑有什么意义，如果不能像桥牌之王那样指向外部呢？

src_seg:
March 5 - Five of Pentacles... A difficult situation, struggle, financial insecurity.
Infrastructure... precisely that thing it never feels like there's enough cash for. ESPECIALLY in tech, where it always flows towards hype and disruption rather than maintaining what already exists.
The Internet is so huge, has such great practical benefits, and is an important part of so many peoples' lives, that of course we want the infrastructure maintained, and there to be good governance... Maybe it was the hype of the Internet itself that allowed some of these early gestures towards standardization and productive ground rules to stick.
Though there are a ton of tech corporations involved, a surprising amount was also done via the US Department of Defense directly, and now a lot of the corporations (ex- Don't Be Evil Google, for example) are chipping away at the principles they once helped set up... Whose infrastructure? It's always tied to governance, and always ideological. Be careful who you go asking for cash when you're broke...
tgt_seg:
3月5日 - 五号铁牌……一个艰难的情况，挣扎，经济不安全。
基础设施……正是那种感觉永远不够用现金的事情。特别是在科技领域，资金总是流向炒作和颠覆，而不是维护已经存在的东西。
互联网如此庞大，具有巨大的实用价值，是许多人生活中重要的一部分，当然我们希望基础设施得到维护，有良好的治理……也许正是互联网本身的炒作，才让一些早期的标准化和建设性规则得以坚持。
尽管有许多科技公司参与其中，但令人惊讶的是，相当多的工作是通过美国国防部直接完成的，现在许多公司（如“不要作恶”的谷歌）正在蚕食他们曾经帮助制定的原则……谁的基础设施？它总是与治理和意识形态交织在一起。当你破产时，小心向谁求助……

src_seg:
March 6 - DEATH!! An inevitable and total transformation, possibly painful, but not necessarily The End...
A lot of anti-tech sentiment seems to wish that we could just put certain things back in the box. But the world where the technology that provides connection and access to information was entangled by its maybe well-intentioned originators with military and surveillance culture, game theory and bombs, is the world we have.
I always found the PVP gimmick for MGSV's online mode to be weirdly inspiring... if we want to live in a world without the atomic bomb, it'll have to be one where we took them all apart with our own hands. And it'll be one where the knowledge that it was made at one time will also always be a thing. How we frame it is up to us... there is no going back. How terrifying, how wonderful.
tgt_seg:
3月6日 - 死神！！不可避免的彻底转变，可能痛苦，但不一定是终结……
许多反技术情绪似乎希望我们能够把某些东西放回盒子里。但那个技术提供了连接和信息访问的世界，其起源者可能出于善意，却与军事和监视文化、博弈论和炸弹交织在一起，正是我们所拥有的世界。
我总是觉得《合金装备 V》在线模式的 PVP 机制很有趣……如果我们想生活在一个没有原子弹的世界，那将是一个我们必须亲手拆解它们的世界。而那个知识将永远存在。我们如何呈现它取决于我们……没有回头路。多么可怕，多么美妙。

I idly proposed doing this yesterday so for March I will be posting one card I draw fom Suzanne Treister's Hexen 2.0 Tarot Deck per day of March.
The deck consists of all the major and minor arcana depicted by alchemical drawings of people and things from the history of technology, or, more specifically, "the scientific underpinnings of what Michel Foucault called bio-political governance."
Why? Because I actually have to do some tech-related talks this month, and also with the dark side of tech being so blatant lately, I felt the need to think about it more, and explore my associations/values etc!

Even after they existed, people still had to mediate, calculate, punch cards, interpret, etc. And in my own work I still often feel like a babysitter of inflexible computational quirks... why can't the spreadsheet software, or CMS, or database just do that mind-numbingly boring and burdensome stuff for me?

The Internet is so huge, has such great practical benefits, and is an important part of so many peoples' lives, that of course we want the infrastructure maintained, and there to be good governance... Maybe it was the hype of the Internet itself that allowed some of these early gestures towards standardization and productive ground rules to stick.
Though there are a ton of tech corporations involved, a surprising amount was also done via the US Department of Defense directly, and now a lot of the corporations (ex- Don't Be Evil Google, for example) are chipping away at the principles they once helped set up... Whose infrastructure? It's always tied to governance, and always ideological. Be careful who you go asking for cash when you're broke...
tgt_seg:
3月5日--五角星五困境、挣扎、财务不安全。
基础建设......恰恰是那件事，总觉得现金不够用。尤其是在科技领域，资金总是流向炒作和颠覆，而不是维护现有的东西。
互联网是如此巨大，有如此大的实际好处，是如此多人生活的重要组成部分，我们当然希望基础设施得到维护，并有良好的管理......也许正是由于互联网本身的炒作，一些早期的标准化姿态和富有成效的基本规则才得以坚持。
虽然有大量科技公司参与其中，但美国国防部也直接参与了大量工作，现在很多公司（例如前 "不作恶谷歌"）都在破坏他们曾经帮助建立的原则......谁的基础设施？它总是与治理联系在一起，而且总是意识形态的。当你身无分文时，向谁借钱都要小心谨慎...

src_seg:
March 6 - DEATH!! An inevitable and total transformation, possibly painful, but not necessarily The End...
A lot of anti-tech sentiment seems to wish that we could just put certain things back in the box. But the world where the technology that provides connection and access to information was entangled by its maybe well-intentioned originators with military and surveillance culture, game theory and bombs, is the world we have.
I always found the PVP gimmick for MGSV's online mode to be weirdly inspiring... if we want to live in a world without the atomic bomb, it'll have to be one where we took them all apart with our own hands. And it'll be one where the knowledge that it was made at one time will also always be a thing. How we frame it is up to us... there is no going back. How terrifying, how wonderful.
tgt_seg:
3月6日--死亡！这是一场不可避免的彻底变革，可能很痛苦，但不一定是终结...
很多反科技的情绪似乎都希望我们能把某些东西放回盒子里。但在这个世界里，提供连接和获取信息的技术被其或许用心良苦的初创者与军事和监控文化、博弈论和炸弹纠缠在一起。
我一直觉得《MGSV》在线模式的 PVP 噱头很有启发性......如果我们想生活在一个没有原子弹的世界，那就必须是一个我们亲手把它们全部拆散的世界。在这个世界里，我们将永远知道原子弹曾经被制造过。至于如何处理，取决于我们自己......没有回头路可走。多么可怕，多么美妙

src_seg:
I idly proposed doing this yesterday so for March I will be posting one card I draw fom Suzanne Treister's Hexen 2.0 Tarot Deck per day of March.
The deck consists of all the major and minor arcana depicted by alchemical drawings of people and things from the history of technology, or, more specifically, "the scientific underpinnings of what Michel Foucault called bio-political governance."
Why? Because I actually have to do some tech-related talks this month, and also with the dark side of tech being so blatant lately, I felt the need to think about it more, and explore my associations/values etc!
tgt_seg:
我昨天随口提议要做这件事，所以三月份我将每天发布一张苏珊·特赖斯特（Suzanne Treister）的《女巫2.0塔罗牌》中抽到的牌。
这副牌包含所有大阿尔卡纳和小阿尔卡纳，画面由技术历史中人物和事物的炼金术图画构成，或者更具体地说，是“米歇尔·福柯所说的生物政治治理的科学基础”。
为什么？因为这个月我实际上需要做一些与技术相关的演讲，而且最近技术的阴暗面如此明显，我感到有必要更多地思考它，并探索我的联想/价值观等等！

src_seg:
March 1 - Starting with the 10 of Wands, typically representing overload, burden.
Here it is represented by a variety of early computing projects, many subsidized by their respective governments.
I think of how before a computer or calculator was a thing it was a job. Even after they existed, people still had to mediate, calculate, punch cards, interpret, etc. And in my own work I still often feel like a babysitter of inflexible computational quirks... why can't the spreadsheet software, or CMS, or database just do that mind-numbingly boring and burdensome stuff for me?
I also think how, even if it's built on what were once dull analog tasks, it's not -exactly- the same though, is it? In middle school computer lab I was taught a bit of BASIC, and being able to make a simple text "frogger" or branching adventure program, even if they were super rudimentary, was more compelling for some reason than imagining them or drawing them in a notebook... the sort of action at a delay/distance that computing offers, or that is computing's illusion...
tgt_seg:
3月1日 - 从权杖十开始，通常代表负担过重。
这里它由各种早期的计算项目体现，其中许多项目得到了各自政府的补贴。
我想到在计算机或计算器出现之前，它是一项工作。即使它们存在，人们仍然需要进行调解、计算、打孔卡、解释等等。而在我的工作中，我仍然常常感觉自己像是在照顾僵化的计算特性… 为什么电子表格软件、内容管理系统或数据库不能为我完成那些令人麻木乏味且繁重的任务？
我也觉得，即使它建立在曾经单调的模拟任务之上，但它并不-完全-相同，不是吗？在中学计算机实验室里，我学过一点BASIC，能够制作一个简单的文本“青蛙过河”或分支冒险程序，即使它们非常原始，但不知为何比想象它们或在笔记本上画它们更具吸引力… 这种计算提供的延迟/距离感，或者说计算的幻觉…

src_seg:
March 2 - 9 of Swords... following on from the feelings of overload and burden yesterday, this card represents nightmares and anxiety about the future.
Appropriately it's represented here by The Tavistock Institute of Human Relations, a UK governmental body established in 1946 that acted regionally, nationally, and internationally for “the social engagement of social sciences” or more bluntly, using theoretical methods to “change behavior in groups and civilian populations.”
Obviously the name Tavistock brings to mind the overbearing interference of the UK government in constantly trying to block any sort of trans care, or only dispensing it as a last resort after you’ve gone through years of waiting around and a thorough psychiatric probing. A population where everyone just conformed to the two standard cis gender roles would indeed be much easier to control, so to a “Labour” government obsessed with means testing, pathologizing and cutting benefits, it’s of course desirable to treat “normality” as a virtue and any difference as disease to eliminate.
I could talk about so many things, the awful CBT and soft conversion therapy I’ve personally received in the UK, how state surveillance and punishment disproportionately targets autistic people, how even punitive and inadequate psychological care is too hard to access, how outcomes are measured in “productivity” rather than happiness. A tendency that is not technic in the big machines or internet enabled devices way, but has infested every aspect of life as much as people fear tiktok attention spans have; people I want to ally with constantly crowing “just be normal” or getting sucked down a health and fitness grifthole.
An exhausting and sad card. I’ll be honest, I almost put it back when I pulled it lol. But obviously a big part of contemporary technological thought nevertheless.
tgt_seg:
3月2日 - 剑九… 延续着昨天超负荷和负担的感觉，这张牌代表着噩梦和对未来的焦虑。
恰如其分地，它由英国人类关系泰维斯托克研究所代表，该机构于1946年成立，是一个政府机构，在区域、国家和国际层面为“社会科学的社会参与”而行动，或者更直白地说，利用理论方法“改变群体和民众的行为”。
显而易见，泰维斯托克这个名字让人联想到英国政府不断试图阻止任何形式的跨性别关怀，或者只在经过多年等待和彻底的精神检查后才作为最后的手段提供关怀。如果每个人都符合两种标准的顺性别角色，那么控制人口将确实容易得多，因此，对于一个痴迷于手段测试、病理化和削减福利的“工党”政府来说，将“正常”视为一种美德，将任何差异视为需要消除的疾病，当然是理想的。
我可以谈论很多事情，我个人在英国接受的糟糕的认知行为疗法和软性转化疗法，国家监控和惩罚如何不成比例地针对自闭症患者，即使是惩罚性和不足的心理护理也难以获得，结果以“生产力”而不是幸福来衡量。这种倾向并非技术上存在于大型机器或互联网设备中，而是像人们担心抖音对注意力的影响一样，渗透到生活的方方面面；我希望结盟的人不断地高喊“就正常点”或陷入健康和健身的泥潭。
一张令人疲惫和悲伤的牌。说实话，我抽到它的时候差点放回去哈哈。但显然，它仍然是当代技术思想的重要组成部分。

src_seg:
March 3 - The Star, hope, inspiration, future goals. A much more positive card than we've had so far!
But it's hard to feel positive about the massively exploitative and yet still totally underwhelming reality of artifical intelligence and quantum computing hype at the moment. The idea of an omnipotent computer, that could, indeed, simulate or work at an atomic or subatomic level, has kind of been the great dream of computing for a long time. It's almost a philosopher's stone type of thing.
Yesterday I reread this great essay on the current generative AI models by Hito Steyerl (https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images). She does a great job of going into how reliant these systems still are on human-made images, cleaned data, and ongoing human moderation at every level, but she also makes the observation that while their outputs masquerade as bits of text or images, which people wrongly attribute intention or creativity to, they're really statistical representations, with all of the inherent ideology and limitations of statistics baked in.
What would a truly intelligent computer capable of expanding our analytical powers and relieving the burden of tedious labor and the risks of incomplete information look like, and under what context would it be used to reinvent life towards more autonomy and joy rather than accelerating exploitation and control? Can we hope for such a thing with IBM and DARPA still in the picture...?
tgt_seg:
3月3日 - 星星，希望，灵感，未来目标。比起我们之前看到的牌，这张牌要积极得多！
但目前很难对人工智能和量子计算的过度炒作以及极具剥削性的、却仍然令人失望的现实感到乐观。能够确实在原子或亚原子层面上模拟或工作的全能计算机，长期以来一直是计算机领域的一个伟大梦想。它几乎就像炼金术士之石。
昨天我重读了 Hito Steyerl 在《新左评论》上发表的一篇关于当前生成式人工智能模型的精彩文章 (https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images)。她很好地阐述了这些系统仍然依赖于人工制作的图像、清洗后的数据以及各个层面的持续人工审核，但她也指出，虽然它们的输出伪装成文本或图像片段，人们错误地将其归因于意图或创造力，但它们实际上是统计表示，其中包含统计固有的意识形态和局限性。
真正能够扩展我们分析能力、减轻繁琐劳动负担和不完整信息风险的智能计算机会是什么样子？在什么情况下，它将被用来朝着更大的自主性和快乐的方向重塑生活，而不是加速剥削和控制？在 IBM 和 DARPA 仍然参与的情况下，我们还能对此抱有希望吗……？

src_seg:
March 4 - The King of Swords, intellectual drive, clarity, calling for authoritative action. A go-for-it type of thing.
Timothy Leary certainly was a sort of intellectually driven, though more of a “question authority” type. Likewise, looking it up, the Eight-circuit Model of Consciousness here is generally thought to have little actual scientific credibility. Still… what model of consciousness does? Despite being how all of our “information” comes to us, it’s kind of ambiguous what this thing actually is, much less if there’s any systemic patterns that determine how it works.
I find it kind of inspiring to contemplate a multi-part model of consciousness that is both inward and outward looking. Leary was also of a period where there was optimism about space exploration, and the possibility of making contact with other species, from Earth or beyond. Now we seem to find this idea kind of embarrassing, because the idea of explaining ourselves feels embarrassing. Which in a way is it’s own kind of constantly-reinforcing self-centeredness.
There’s nothing more self-centered in the irritating way than how psychedelics as self-help, a “miracle” mental illness cure, the one weird trick to go 10x or come up with that sick disruptive business deal or chill out your bitch wife, have kind of become mainstream now. It’s all very inward-looking to the point that there’s nothing besides inward-ness. What’s the point of a honed mind if you can’t, like the king of swords, point it outwards?
tgt_seg:
3月4日 - 宝剑国王，代表理智驱动、清晰明了，呼吁采取果断行动。一种勇往直前的感觉。
蒂莫西·利里确实是一位具有理智驱动力的人，但更像是一个“质疑权威”类型的人物。同样，查阅资料显示，这里的八回路意识模型通常被认为缺乏实际的科学可信度。尽管如此…… 哪个意识模型拥有呢？ 尽管我们所有的“信息”都是通过它传递的，但这种东西到底是什么，更不用说是否存在任何决定其运作方式的系统性模式，仍然很模糊。
我发现沉思一个既向内又向外的多部分意识模型，颇具启发性。利里也处在一个对太空探索和与地球或地球以外的其他物种接触充满乐观的时代。现在我们似乎觉得这个想法有点可笑，因为解释自己的想法让人感到尴尬。而这在某种程度上，本身就是一种不断自我强化的以自我为中心。
如今，迷幻药作为自助工具、一种“奇迹”的精神疾病疗法、一种能让你实现十倍增长或想出颠覆性商业交易或让你的刻薄妻子冷静下来的神奇技巧，已经逐渐走向主流，这实在是最令人恼火的以自我为中心的行为。这一切都过于关注内在，以至于除了内在之外一无所有。 如果你不能像宝剑国王一样将思维指向外部，那么磨练思维有什么意义呢？

显然，塔维斯托克这个名字让人想起了英国政府不断试图阻挠任何形式的转性护理，或者只将其作为最后手段，在你等待了几年并经过彻底的精神科探究之后才提供。一个人口，每个人都只符合两个标准的 cis 性别角色，确实更容易控制，因此，一个“工党”政府，对测试、病理化和削减福利痴迷，当然希望将“正常性”视为一种美德，并将任何差异视为疾病以消除。
我可以谈论很多事情，我在 UK 个人收到的可怕的认知行为疗法和软转换治疗，国家监控和惩罚对自闭症人士的影响，即使惩罚性和不足的心理护理也难以获得，结果以“生产力”而不是幸福感来衡量。这种倾向并不像大型机器或互联网设备那样技术，但就像人们害怕的 TikTok 注意力一样，已经渗透到生活的每一个方面；我想要结盟的人不断吹嘘“只需正常”，或者被吸入健康和健身的漏洞。
这张牌令人疲惫不堪，令人悲伤。我会诚实地说，当我抽到它时，我几乎把它放回去了。但显然，这在当代技术思想中占据着重要地位。

src_seg:
March 3 - The Star, hope, inspiration, future goals. A much more positive card than we've had so far!
But it's hard to feel positive about the massively exploitative and yet still totally underwhelming reality of artifical intelligence and quantum computing hype at the moment. The idea of an omnipotent computer, that could, indeed, simulate or work at an atomic or subatomic level, has kind of been the great dream of computing for a long time. It's almost a philosopher's stone type of thing.
Yesterday I reread this great essay on the current generative AI models by Hito Steyerl (https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images). She does a great job of going into how reliant these systems still are on human-made images, cleaned data, and ongoing human moderation at every level, but she also makes the observation that while their outputs masquerade as bits of text or images, which people wrongly attribute intention or creativity to, they're really statistical representations, with all of the inherent ideology and limitations of statistics baked in.
What would a truly intelligent computer capable of expanding our analytical powers and relieving the burden of tedious labor and the risks of incomplete information look like, and under what context would it be used to reinvent life towards more autonomy and joy rather than accelerating exploitation and control? Can we hope for such a thing with IBM and DARPA still in the picture...?
tgt_seg:
三月 3 日 - 星牌，希望、灵感、未来目标。这张牌要比我们到目前为止看到的要积极得多！
但目前很难对人工智能和量子计算炒作的极度剥削和令人失望的现实感到乐观。一个 omnipotent 计算机的概念，能够模拟或在原子或亚原子水平上工作，已经成为计算领域的一个长期梦想。这几乎是一种哲学家的石。
昨天我重读了 Hito Steyerl 关于当前生成式 AI 模型的这篇伟大的文章（https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images）。她很好地解释了这些系统仍然依赖于人类制作的图像、清理的数据和每层的人类审核，但她也观察到，虽然它们的输出伪装成文本或图像，人们错误地将意图或创造力归功于它们，但它们实际上是统计表示，其中包含所有固有的意识形态和统计的局限性。
一个真正智能的计算机，能够扩大我们的分析能力，减轻繁琐劳动的负担和不完整信息的风险，会是什么样子，在什么情况下它会被用来重新发明生活，以实现更多的自主性和快乐，而不是加速剥削和控制？我们还能否希望 IBM 和 DARPA 仍然在其中...？

src_seg:
March 4 - The King of Swords, intellectual drive, clarity, calling for authoritative action. A go-for-it type of thing.
Timothy Leary certainly was a sort of intellectually driven, though more of a “question authority” type. Likewise, looking it up, the Eight-circuit Model of Consciousness here is generally thought to have little actual scientific credibility. Still… what model of consciousness does? Despite being how all of our “information” comes to us, it’s kind of ambiguous what this thing actually is, much less if there’s any systemic patterns that determine how it works.
I find it kind of inspiring to contemplate a multi-part model of consciousness that is both inward and outward looking. Leary was also of a period where there was optimism about space exploration, and the possibility of making contact with other species, from Earth or beyond. Now we seem to find this idea kind of embarrassing, because the idea of explaining ourselves feels embarrassing. Which in a way is it’s own kind of constantly-reinforcing self-centeredness.
There’s nothing more self-centered in the irritating way than how psychedelics as self-help, a “miracle” mental illness cure, the one weird trick to go 10x or come up with that sick disruptive business deal or chill out your bitch wife, have kind of become mainstream now. It’s all very inward-looking to the point that there’s nothing besides inward-ness. What’s the point of a honed mind if you can’t, like the king of swords, point it outwards?
tgt_seg:
三月 4 日 - 剑王，智力驱动、清晰、呼吁权威行动。一种去做的事情。
蒂莫西·利里（Timothy Leary）确实是一种智力驱动的，尽管更像是一种“质疑权威”的类型。同样，查找，这里的情绪模型在科学上普遍被认为是没有多少实际可信度。尽管如此...什么样的情绪模型？尽管它是我们所有“信息”的来源，但这个东西实际上是什么，更不用说是否有任何系统模式来确定它的工作方式，仍然是一个谜。
我发现思考一个多部分的感知模型，既内向又外向，是令人兴奋的。利里也是一个时期，对太空探索和与其他物种接触的可能性持乐观态度，无论是地球还是地球之外。现在我们似乎认为这个想法很可笑，因为解释自己的想法感觉很可笑。这在某种程度上是一种不断自我强化的主观中心。
在令人讨厌的方式中，没有什么比将迷幻药作为自我帮助，一种“奇迹”的精神疾病治疗，一种去 10 倍或想出那种令人发指的破坏性商业交易或让你的女妻冷静的奇怪技巧，已经成为主流。这完全是内向的，以至于除了内向之外，什么都没有。一个磨练了的心有什么用，如果你不能像剑王一样指向外部？

src_seg:
March 5 - Five of Pentacles... A difficult situation, struggle, financial insecurity.
Infrastructure... precisely that thing it never feels like there's enough cash for. ESPECIALLY in tech, where it always flows towards hype and disruption rather than maintaining what already exists.
The Internet is so huge, has such great practical benefits, and is an important part of so many peoples' lives, that of course we want the infrastructure maintained, and there to be good governance... Maybe it was the hype of the Internet itself that allowed some of these early gestures towards standardization and productive ground rules to stick.
Though there are a ton of tech corporations involved, a surprising amount was also done via the US Department of Defense directly, and now a lot of the corporations (ex- Don't Be Evil Google, for example) are chipping away at the principles they once helped set up... Whose infrastructure? It's always tied to governance, and always ideological. Be careful who you go asking for cash when you're broke...
tgt_seg:
三月 5 日 - 五个金杯...一种困难的境地，斗争，经济不安全。
基础设施...正是那种永远感觉现金不足的东西。特别是在技术领域，它总是流向炒作和破坏，而不是维护现有的东西。
互联网非常庞大，具有巨大的实际效益，是许多人生活的重要组成部分，因此，我们当然希望基础设施得到维护，并具有良好的治理...也许是互联网本身的炒作，使得一些早期标准化和生产规则的努力能够坚持下去。
尽管有大量的科技公司参与，但通过美国国防部直接完成的工作也不少，现在许多公司（例如，不再是邪恶的谷歌）正在削弱他们曾经帮助建立的原则...谁的基础设施？它总是与治理相关联，总是意识形态化的。当你身无分文时，要小心你向谁要钱...

src_seg:
March 6 - DEATH!! An inevitable and total transformation, possibly painful, but not necessarily The End...
A lot of anti-tech sentiment seems to wish that we could just put certain things back in the box. But the world where the technology that provides connection and access to information was entangled by its maybe well-intentioned originators with military and surveillance culture, game theory and bombs, is the world we have.
I always found the PVP gimmick for MGSV's online mode to be weirdly inspiring... if we want to live in a world without the atomic bomb, it'll have to be one where we took them all apart with our own hands. And it'll be one where the knowledge that it was made at one time will also always be a thing. How we frame it is up to us... there is no going back. How terrifying, how wonderful.
tgt_seg:
三月 6 日 - 死亡！一种不可避免的彻底转变，可能是痛苦的，但并不一定是...
许多反技术的情绪似乎希望我们能够将某些事情重新装回盒子里。但一个技术提供连接和信息访问的世界，被其可能有良好意图的发起者与军事和监视文化、博弈论和炸弹交织在一起，就是我们的世界。
我总是发现 MGSV 在线模式的 PVP  gimmick 很奇怪地令人兴奋...如果我们想生活在一个没有原子弹的世界，那么它必须是一个我们用自己的手将其全部拆解的世界。这将是一个知识，它曾经被制造过，永远是一个东西的世界。如何定位它，取决于我们...没有回头路。多么可怕，多么美妙。

src_seg:
I idly proposed doing this yesterday so for March I will be posting one card I draw fom Suzanne Treister's Hexen 2.0 Tarot Deck per day of March.
The deck consists of all the major and minor arcana depicted by alchemical drawings of people and things from the history of technology, or, more specifically, "the scientific underpinnings of what Michel Foucault called bio-political governance."
Why? Because I actually have to do some tech-related talks this month, and also with the dark side of tech being so blatant lately, I felt the need to think about it more, and explore my associations/values etc!
tgt_seg:
我昨天随便提议这么做，所以在三月份，我将每天发布一张我从苏珊·特里斯的《女巫2.0塔罗牌》中抽取的卡片。
这副牌由所有的大阿尔卡那和小阿尔卡那组成，这些都是通过技术史中的人物和事物的炼金术绘画来描绘的，或者更具体地说，是“米歇尔·福柯所说的生物政治治理的科学基础”。
为什么？因为我实际上这个月要做一些与技术相关的演讲，而且由于技术的黑暗面最近如此明显，我觉得有必要多想想，探索我的联想/价值观等！

src_seg:
March 1 - Starting with the 10 of Wands, typically representing overload, burden.
Here it is represented by a variety of early computing projects, many subsidized by their respective governments.
I think of how before a computer or calculator was a thing it was a job. Even after they existed, people still had to mediate, calculate, punch cards, interpret, etc. And in my own work I still often feel like a babysitter of inflexible computational quirks... why can't the spreadsheet software, or CMS, or database just do that mind-numbingly boring and burdensome stuff for me?
I also think how, even if it's built on what were once dull analog tasks, it's not -exactly- the same though, is it? In middle school computer lab I was taught a bit of BASIC, and being able to make a simple text "frogger" or branching adventure program, even if they were super rudimentary, was more compelling for some reason than imagining them or drawing them in a notebook... the sort of action at a delay/distance that computing offers, or that is computing's illusion...
tgt_seg:
3 月 1 日 - 从权杖 10 开始，通常代表过载、负担。
这里用一系列早期的计算项目来代表，许多项目由各自的政府资助。
我想起在计算机或计算器出现之前，这是一项工作。即使它们存在了，人们仍然需要进行调解、计算、打孔卡、解释等。而在我自己的工作中，我仍然常常觉得自己是刚性的计算怪癖的保姆... 为什么电子表格软件、内容管理系统或数据库不能为我做这些令人头脑发昏的无聊和繁重的事情？
我还想，即使它建立在曾经是单调的模拟任务之上，它也不是 - 完全相同的，对吧？在中学的计算机实验室里，我学了一些 BASIC，能够制作一个简单的文本“青蛙人”或分支冒险程序，即使它们非常原始，但出于某种原因比想象它们或在笔记本上画它们更有说服力... 计算提供的延迟/距离的动作，或者计算的幻觉...

src_seg:
March 2 - 9 of Swords... following on from the feelings of overload and burden yesterday, this card represents nightmares and anxiety about the future.
Appropriately it's represented here by The Tavistock Institute of Human Relations, a UK governmental body established in 1946 that acted regionally, nationally, and internationally for “the social engagement of social sciences” or more bluntly, using theoretical methods to “change behavior in groups and civilian populations.”
Obviously the name Tavistock brings to mind the overbearing interference of the UK government in constantly trying to block any sort of trans care, or only dispensing it as a last resort after you’ve gone through years of waiting around and a thorough psychiatric probing. A population where everyone just conformed to the two standard cis gender roles would indeed be much easier to control, so to a “Labour” government obsessed with means testing, pathologizing and cutting benefits, it’s of course desirable to treat “normality” as a virtue and any difference as disease to eliminate.
I could talk about so many things, the awful CBT and soft conversion therapy I’ve personally received in the UK, how state surveillance and punishment disproportionately targets autistic people, how even punitive and inadequate psychological care is too hard to access, how outcomes are measured in “productivity” rather than happiness. A tendency that is not technic in the big machines or internet enabled devices way, but has infested every aspect of life as much as people fear tiktok attention spans have; people I want to ally with constantly crowing “just be normal” or getting sucked down a health and fitness grifthole.
An exhausting and sad card. I’ll be honest, I almost put it back when I pulled it lol. But obviously a big part of contemporary technological thought nevertheless.

尽管有大量的科技公司参与其中，但令人惊讶的是，很多工作都是通过美国国防部直接完成的，而现在很多公司（比如曾经的“不要作恶”谷歌）正在逐步削弱他们曾经帮助建立的原则... 谁的基础设施？它总是与治理相关，并且总是带有意识形态色彩。当你穷困潦倒时，要小心向谁要钱...

src_seg:
March 6 - DEATH!! An inevitable and total transformation, possibly painful, but not necessarily The End...
A lot of anti-tech sentiment seems to wish that we could just put certain things back in the box. But the world where the technology that provides connection and access to information was entangled by its maybe well-intentioned originators with military and surveillance culture, game theory and bombs, is the world we have.
I always found the PVP gimmick for MGSV's online mode to be weirdly inspiring... if we want to live in a world without the atomic bomb, it'll have to be one where we took them all apart with our own hands. And it'll be one where the knowledge that it was made at one time will also always be a thing. How we frame it is up to us... there is no going back. How terrifying, how wonderful.
tgt_seg:
3月6日 - 死亡！一种不可避免的、彻底的转变，可能痛苦，但不一定是终点...
很多反技术情绪似乎希望我们能够将某些事情放回原处。但技术提供的连接和信息访问，却被其可能出于良好意图的发明者与军事和监控文化、博弈论和炸弹纠缠在一起的世界，就是我们现在的世界。
我总觉得《MGSV》在线模式的PVP噱头很奇怪... 如果我们想要生活在没有原子弹的世界，那将是一个我们用自己的双手拆解它们的世界。而那个世界，关于它们曾经制造的知识，也将永远存在。我们如何框定它取决于我们自己... 没有回头路。多么可怕，又多么美好。

I idly proposed doing this yesterday so for March I will be posting one card I draw fom Suzanne Treister's Hexen 2.0 Tarot Deck per day of March.
The deck consists of all the major and minor arcana depicted by alchemical drawings of people and things from the history of technology, or, more specifically, "the scientific underpinnings of what Michel Foucault called bio-political governance."
Why? Because I actually have to do some tech-related talks this month, and also with the dark side of tech being so blatant lately, I felt the need to think about it more, and explore my associations/values etc!
tgt_seg:
昨天我随口提议做这个，所以在三月份，我会每天发布一张由苏珊·特雷斯特的《巫婆2.0塔罗牌》中抽取的牌。
这副牌包含了所有大阿卡那和小阿卡那，都是通过描绘历史技术中的人与事物的炼金术图案来表现的，或者更具体地说，是“米歇尔·福柯所说的生物政治治理的科学基础”。
为什么？因为我这个月实际上要做一些与技术相关的演讲，而且最近科技的黑暗面如此明显，我觉得有必要更多地思考它，并探索我的联想/价值观等！

src_seg:
March 1 - Starting with the 10 of Wands, typically representing overload, burden.
Here it is represented by a variety of early computing projects, many subsidized by their respective governments.
I think of how before a computer or calculator was a thing it was a job. Even after they existed, people still had to mediate, calculate, punch cards, interpret, etc. And in my own work I still often feel like a babysitter of inflexible computational quirks... why can't the spreadsheet software, or CMS, or database just do that mind-numbingly boring and burdensome stuff for me?
I also think how, even if it's built on what were once dull analog tasks, it's not -exactly- the same though, is it? In middle school computer lab I was taught a bit of BASIC, and being able to make a simple text "frogger" or branching adventure program, even if they were super rudimentary, was more compelling for some reason than imagining them or drawing them in a notebook... the sort of action at a delay/distance that computing offers, or that is computing's illusion...
tgt_seg:
3 月 1 日——从 10 枝手杖开始，通常代表过载、负担。
这里以各种早期计算机项目为代表，其中许多项目得到了各自政府的资助。
我想,在电脑和计算器出现之前,这是一项工作。即使它们出现了,人们仍然需要进行调解、计算、打卡片、解释等。在我的工作中,我仍然经常感觉自己像是照顾那些固执的计算怪癖的保姆……为什么电子表格软件、内容管理系统或数据库不能为我做这些令人头疼的无聊和繁琐的事情呢？
我还在想，即使它建立在曾经乏味的模拟任务之上，但它也不是完全相同的，对吧？在中学计算机实验室，我学习了一些 BASIC，能够制作一个简单的文本“青蛙”或分支冒险程序，即使它们非常原始，但出于某种原因比在笔记本上想象或绘制它们更有吸引力……计算提供的那种延迟/距离上的行动，或者计算的幻觉……

src_seg:
March 2 - 9 of Swords... following on from the feelings of overload and burden yesterday, this card represents nightmares and anxiety about the future.
Appropriately it's represented here by The Tavistock Institute of Human Relations, a UK governmental body established in 1946 that acted regionally, nationally, and internationally for “the social engagement of social sciences” or more bluntly, using theoretical methods to “change behavior in groups and civilian populations.”
Obviously the name Tavistock brings to mind the overbearing interference of the UK government in constantly trying to block any sort of trans care, or only dispensing it as a last resort after you’ve gone through years of waiting around and a thorough psychiatric probing. A population where everyone just conformed to the two standard cis gender roles would indeed be much easier to control, so to a “Labour” government obsessed with means testing, pathologizing and cutting benefits, it’s of course desirable to treat “normality” as a virtue and any difference as disease to eliminate.
I could talk about so many things, the awful CBT and soft conversion therapy I’ve personally received in the UK, how state surveillance and punishment disproportionately targets autistic people, how even punitive and inadequate psychological care is too hard to access, how outcomes are measured in “productivity” rather than happiness. A tendency that is not technic in the big machines or internet enabled devices way, but has infested every aspect of life as much as people fear tiktok attention spans have; people I want to ally with constantly crowing “just be normal” or getting sucked down a health and fitness grifthole.
An exhausting and sad card. I’ll be honest, I almost put it back when I pulled it lol. But obviously a big part of contemporary technological thought nevertheless.
tgt_seg:
三月 2 日至 9 日的宝剑... 继昨天的超负荷和负担感之后，这张牌代表着对未来的噩梦和焦虑。
适当的，它在这里由 Tavistock 人际关系研究所代表，这是一个英国政府机构，成立于 1946 年，其活动范围包括地区、国家和国际层面，旨在“社会科学的社会参与”，或者更直白地说，使用理论方法“改变群体和平民百姓的行为”。
很明显，塔维斯托克这个名字让人联想到英国政府过度干预，不断试图阻止任何形式的跨性别护理，或者只有在经过多年的等待和彻底的精神病学检查后才提供这种护理。如果每个人都只是遵从两个标准的顺性别性别角色，那么确实更容易控制，所以对于一个痴迷于手段测试、病理化和削减福利的“工党”政府来说，当然希望将“正常性”视为美德，将任何差异视为需要消除的疾病。
我可以谈很多事情，比如我在英国亲身体验的可怕的认知行为疗法和软性转化疗法，国家监视和惩罚如何不成比例地针对自闭症患者，即使惩罚性的、不充分的心理治疗也难以获得，结果如何用“生产力”而非幸福来衡量。这种趋势并非技术在大型机器或互联网设备上的体现，而是像人们害怕 TikTok 的注意力一样，已经侵入生活的方方面面；我想结盟的人不断地说“只是正常”，或者陷入健康和健身的骗局。
这张卡片既令人疲惫又令人伤感。老实说，我几乎在拿到它时就把它放回去了（笑）。但显然，它仍然是当代科技思想的一个重要组成部分。

src_seg:
March 3 - The Star, hope, inspiration, future goals. A much more positive card than we've had so far!
But it's hard to feel positive about the massively exploitative and yet still totally underwhelming reality of artifical intelligence and quantum computing hype at the moment. The idea of an omnipotent computer, that could, indeed, simulate or work at an atomic or subatomic level, has kind of been the great dream of computing for a long time. It's almost a philosopher's stone type of thing.
Yesterday I reread this great essay on the current generative AI models by Hito Steyerl (https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images). She does a great job of going into how reliant these systems still are on human-made images, cleaned data, and ongoing human moderation at every level, but she also makes the observation that while their outputs masquerade as bits of text or images, which people wrongly attribute intention or creativity to, they're really statistical representations, with all of the inherent ideology and limitations of statistics baked in.
What would a truly intelligent computer capable of expanding our analytical powers and relieving the burden of tedious labor and the risks of incomplete information look like, and under what context would it be used to reinvent life towards more autonomy and joy rather than accelerating exploitation and control? Can we hope for such a thing with IBM and DARPA still in the picture...?
tgt_seg:
3 月 3 日�：星星、希望、灵感、未来目标。比我们到目前为止看到的任何一张牌都要积极得多！
但目前人工智能和量子计算的炒作过度且令人失望的现实让人很难保持积极态度。事实上，能够模拟或在原子或亚原子层面工作的万能计算机的想法一直是计算领域的梦想。这几乎就像是炼金术士的石头一样。
昨天我重新阅读了希托·施泰尔尔 (Hito Steyerl) 关于当前生成式人工智能模型的精彩文章（https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images）。她深入探讨了这些系统仍然依赖于人类制作的图像、清理后的数据以及各个层面的持续的人类审核，但她也指出，尽管这些系统的输出伪装成文字或图像，人们错误地认为它们具有意图或创造力，但实际上它们只是统计表示，其中包含了统计学固有的意识形态和局限性。
如果一个真正智能的计算机能够扩展我们的分析能力，减轻繁琐劳动的负担，降低不完整信息带来的风险，它会是什么样子？在什么样的背景下，它会被用来重塑生活，使人们更加自主和快乐，而不是加速剥削和控制？在 IBM 和 DARPA 仍然存在的情况下，我们能否期待这样的事情发生...？

src_seg:
March 4 - The King of Swords, intellectual drive, clarity, calling for authoritative action. A go-for-it type of thing.
Timothy Leary certainly was a sort of intellectually driven, though more of a “question authority” type. Likewise, looking it up, the Eight-circuit Model of Consciousness here is generally thought to have little actual scientific credibility. Still… what model of consciousness does? Despite being how all of our “information” comes to us, it’s kind of ambiguous what this thing actually is, much less if there’s any systemic patterns that determine how it works.
I find it kind of inspiring to contemplate a multi-part model of consciousness that is both inward and outward looking. Leary was also of a period where there was optimism about space exploration, and the possibility of making contact with other species, from Earth or beyond. Now we seem to find this idea kind of embarrassing, because the idea of explaining ourselves feels embarrassing. Which in a way is it’s own kind of constantly-reinforcing self-centeredness.
There’s nothing more self-centered in the irritating way than how psychedelics as self-help, a “miracle” mental illness cure, the one weird trick to go 10x or come up with that sick disruptive business deal or chill out your bitch wife, have kind of become mainstream now. It’s all very inward-looking to the point that there’s nothing besides inward-ness. What’s the point of a honed mind if you can’t, like the king of swords, point it outwards?
tgt_seg:
3 月 4 日——宝剑之王，智力驱动、清晰、呼唤权威行动。一种积极进取的态度。
蒂莫西·利里（Timothy Leary）无疑是一种智力驱动的类型，但更倾向于“质疑权威”。同样，查阅资料后，我们这里的“八层意识模型”通常被认为缺乏实际的科学可信度。尽管如此... 意识的模型是什么？尽管我们所有的“信息”都来自于它，但它到底是什么，更不用说是否存在任何系统模式来决定它如何工作，这都还是一个模糊不清的问题。
我觉得思考一个既内向又外向的意识多部分模型很有启发性。莱里也生活在一个对太空探索充满乐观的时期，人们认为有可能与地球上的或地球之外的其他物种接触。现在，我们似乎觉得这个想法很尴尬，因为解释自己让人感到尴尬。这在某种程度上是一种自我中心主义，它不断自我强化。
在令人烦恼的方式中，没有比迷幻剂作为自我帮助、“神奇”的精神疾病治疗、让你十倍提升的那个奇怪的把戏、或者让你与妻子和解的那个病态的破坏性商业交易，更自我中心的了。现在，它们都变得非常主流。这种自我中心的程度已经到了极致，以至于除了自我中心之外，再也没有其他东西了。如果你不能像国王的剑一样指向外界，那么你精炼的思维还有什么用呢？

src_seg:
March 5 - Five of Pentacles... A difficult situation, struggle, financial insecurity.
Infrastructure... precisely that thing it never feels like there's enough cash for. ESPECIALLY in tech, where it always flows towards hype and disruption rather than maintaining what already exists.
The Internet is so huge, has such great practical benefits, and is an important part of so many peoples' lives, that of course we want the infrastructure maintained, and there to be good governance... Maybe it was the hype of the Internet itself that allowed some of these early gestures towards standardization and productive ground rules to stick.
Though there are a ton of tech corporations involved, a surprising amount was also done via the US Department of Defense directly, and now a lot of the corporations (ex- Don't Be Evil Google, for example) are chipping away at the principles they once helped set up... Whose infrastructure? It's always tied to governance, and always ideological. Be careful who you go asking for cash when you're broke...
