我可以谈很多事，比如我在英国遭遇的可恶的认知行为疗法和软性精神转化疗法，国家如何对自闭症群体进行不成比例的监视和惩罚，即使是惩罚性和不足的心理健康服务也太难获得了，以及如何把“生产力”而非“幸福”作为衡量成果的标准。这种现象不仅仅在大型机器和互联网设备上存在，而是像人们害怕的抖音短视频那样，已经侵蚀了生活的方方面面；我想要结盟的人却总是在喋喋不休地说“要做个正常人”，或是陷入健康和健身骗局。
这张牌可谓既令人精疲力竭又令人悲伤。老实说，我差点就把它放回去了（笑）。但它无疑也是当代科技思想的重要组成部分。

src_seg:
March 3 - The Star, hope, inspiration, future goals. A much more positive card than we've had so far!
But it's hard to feel positive about the massively exploitative and yet still totally underwhelming reality of artifical intelligence and quantum computing hype at the moment. The idea of an omnipotent computer, that could, indeed, simulate or work at an atomic or subatomic level, has kind of been the great dream of computing for a long time. It's almost a philosopher's stone type of thing.
Yesterday I reread this great essay on the current generative AI models by Hito Steyerl (https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images). She does a great job of going into how reliant these systems still are on human-made images, cleaned data, and ongoing human moderation at every level, but she also makes the observation that while their outputs masquerade as bits of text or images, which people wrongly attribute intention or creativity to, they're really statistical representations, with all of the inherent ideology and limitations of statistics baked in.
What would a truly intelligent computer capable of expanding our analytical powers and relieving the burden of tedious labor and the risks of incomplete information look like, and under what context would it be used to reinvent life towards more autonomy and joy rather than accelerating exploitation and control? Can we hope for such a thing with IBM and DARPA still in the picture...?
tgt_seg:
3月3日：明星、希望、灵感和未来目标。这张牌比前几张要积极得多！
可是，当前人工智能和量子计算热潮下的大规模掠夺和极度不尽如人意的情况让人难以保持乐观。自从很久以来，就有人梦想能创造一种全能的计算机，这台计算机能进行原子级或者亚原子级别的模拟和计算。这大概就是计算机界最伟大的梦想，它几乎等同于寻找“通往万物的钥匙”一样。
昨天我再次读了 Hito Steyerl 的一篇关于当前生成式 AI 模型的精彩文章（网址：https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images），她深入地谈到这些系统仍然依赖于人类制作的图像、经过整理的数据以及各个层面的持续的人为审查。但她还指出，这些系统的输出虽然貌似是文字或图像，但人们往往错误地认为它们具有目的性或创造力，其实它们只是统计数据的体现，其中蕴含了统计学中的固有意识形态和局限性。
一个真正智能的计算机能够增强我们的分析能力，减少繁琐劳动带来的压力，减轻信息不完整带来的风险，它究竟会是什么样子？在什么情境下，它会被用来为人类带来更加自主和幸福的生活，而不是加速剥削和控制？在 IBM 和 DARPA 仍在其中的情况下，我们还能抱有这样的希望吗？

src_seg:
March 4 - The King of Swords, intellectual drive, clarity, calling for authoritative action. A go-for-it type of thing.
Timothy Leary certainly was a sort of intellectually driven, though more of a “question authority” type. Likewise, looking it up, the Eight-circuit Model of Consciousness here is generally thought to have little actual scientific credibility. Still… what model of consciousness does? Despite being how all of our “information” comes to us, it’s kind of ambiguous what this thing actually is, much less if there’s any systemic patterns that determine how it works.
I find it kind of inspiring to contemplate a multi-part model of consciousness that is both inward and outward looking. Leary was also of a period where there was optimism about space exploration, and the possibility of making contact with other species, from Earth or beyond. Now we seem to find this idea kind of embarrassing, because the idea of explaining ourselves feels embarrassing. Which in a way is it’s own kind of constantly-reinforcing self-centeredness.
There’s nothing more self-centered in the irritating way than how psychedelics as self-help, a “miracle” mental illness cure, the one weird trick to go 10x or come up with that sick disruptive business deal or chill out your bitch wife, have kind of become mainstream now. It’s all very inward-looking to the point that there’s nothing besides inward-ness. What’s the point of a honed mind if you can’t, like the king of swords, point it outwards?
tgt_seg:
3 月 4 日——宝剑骑士，智慧驱动，清晰明了，呼唤权威行动。一种全力出击的姿态。
蒂莫西·利瑞（Timothy Leary）确实具有一种学术精神，但他更倾向于“挑战权威”。同样，通过查找资料可知，本文提到的“八层意识模型”通常被认为缺乏实际科学依据。不过，所有的“意识模型”都有一个共同点，那就是它们试图解释我们的所有“信息”都来自何处。然而，这个东西是什么，更不用说有没有系统模式可以解释它运作的原理，这些都还是一个很大的未解之谜。
我认为思考一个既向内看又向外看的多维意识模型颇有启发性。赖瑞所处的时期人们对太空探索充满乐观，并相信能与地球上的或地球以外的其他物种建立联系。而如今我们觉得这样的想法很尴尬，因为我们觉得向别人解释自己的想法很难为情。这在某种程度上体现了自我中心的思维模式，这种模式总是不断自我强化。
以令人烦躁的方式，把致幻剂当作自助工具、“神奇”精神疾病的治疗方法、能让你十倍出色的一个奇妙技巧，或者让你能实现绝妙商业交易或让你妻子平静下来等等，已经越来越流行了。所有这些都变得过于自我中心，以至于我们除了自我以外，再也没有其他目标了。如果你像王牌劍士一樣无法把你锋利的心智指向外界，还谈什么心智的锻炼？

src_seg:
March 5 - Five of Pentacles... A difficult situation, struggle, financial insecurity.
Infrastructure... precisely that thing it never feels like there's enough cash for. ESPECIALLY in tech, where it always flows towards hype and disruption rather than maintaining what already exists.
The Internet is so huge, has such great practical benefits, and is an important part of so many peoples' lives, that of course we want the infrastructure maintained, and there to be good governance... Maybe it was the hype of the Internet itself that allowed some of these early gestures towards standardization and productive ground rules to stick.
Though there are a ton of tech corporations involved, a surprising amount was also done via the US Department of Defense directly, and now a lot of the corporations (ex- Don't Be Evil Google, for example) are chipping away at the principles they once helped set up... Whose infrastructure? It's always tied to governance, and always ideological. Be careful who you go asking for cash when you're broke...
tgt_seg:
3 月 5 日——五芒星中的五：困境、艰难险阻、财务风险。
基础设施……恰好是那个似乎总是资金不足的领域。尤其是在科技领域，所有资金都流向炒作和颠覆，而不是用于维护现有体系。
互联网的规模非常庞大，有其显著的实际应用价值，为很多人的生活带来了重要益处，因此我们当然希望维护它的基础设施，同时进行妥善的管理……也许是因为互联网本身吸引了大家的关注，才使得人们较早地采取了一些促进标准化和制定规则的措施，并取得了成效。
虽然参与进来的科技公司数量众多，但相当多的项目是美国国防部直接推动的，现在，许多这些公司（比如曾经标语是“不要做恶”的谷歌）正悄然破坏他们当初参与创建的原则……那是谁的技术基础设施？它总是与政府相关，而且带有意识形态色彩。没钱时千万要小心选择找谁借款……

src_seg:
March 6 - DEATH!! An inevitable and total transformation, possibly painful, but not necessarily The End...
A lot of anti-tech sentiment seems to wish that we could just put certain things back in the box. But the world where the technology that provides connection and access to information was entangled by its maybe well-intentioned originators with military and surveillance culture, game theory and bombs, is the world we have.
I always found the PVP gimmick for MGSV's online mode to be weirdly inspiring... if we want to live in a world without the atomic bomb, it'll have to be one where we took them all apart with our own hands. And it'll be one where the knowledge that it was made at one time will also always be a thing. How we frame it is up to us... there is no going back. How terrifying, how wonderful.
tgt_seg:
3月6日——死亡！一种不可避免且彻底的变化，可能带来痛苦，但不一定是最后的结局...
许多人似乎都对科技持负面态度，希望某些科技产品能被收回到盒子里。但实际上，科技提供了连接信息和获取信息的方法，而正是这个科技产品的制造者在可能出于美好初衷的同时，也将其与军事、监控文化、博弈论以及炸弹等联系在一起。这个世界就是我们如今所处的那个世界。
MGSV 的 PVP 模式总是让人觉得诡异而又神奇，它提醒我：如果要想生活在没有原子弹的世界里，那么我们只能亲手将它们拆毁。在这样一个世界里，关于原子弹制造的知识也将会永远存在。我们该如何看待这段历史，端看我们自己的选择……一切都已经无法改变。这既令人恐怖，也令人兴奋。

src_seg:
I idly proposed doing this yesterday so for March I will be posting one card I draw fom Suzanne Treister's Hexen 2.0 Tarot Deck per day of March.
The deck consists of all the major and minor arcana depicted by alchemical drawings of people and things from the history of technology, or, more specifically, "the scientific underpinnings of what Michel Foucault called bio-political governance."
Why? Because I actually have to do some tech-related talks this month, and also with the dark side of tech being so blatant lately, I felt the need to think about it more, and explore my associations/values etc!

我昨天无所事事地建议这样做，所以三月我将张贴一张卡片，我画Fom苏珊特雷斯特的Hexen2.0塔罗牌每天三月。
甲板包括所有主要和次要的奥术，由炼金术画描绘的人和物从技术的历史，或者更具体地说，"米歇尔*福柯所谓的生物政治治理的科学基础。"
为啥? 因为这个月我真的要做一些与技术有关的谈话，而且最近技术的黑暗面如此明目张胆，我觉得有必要多想想，探索我的协会/价值观等等！

March 1 - Starting with the 10 of Wands, typically representing overload, burden.
Here it is represented by a variety of early computing projects, many subsidized by their respective governments.
I think of how before a computer or calculator was a thing it was a job. Even after they existed, people still had to mediate, calculate, punch cards, interpret, etc. And in my own work I still often feel like a babysitter of inflexible computational quirks... why can't the spreadsheet software, or CMS, or database just do that mind-numbingly boring and burdensome stuff for me?
I also think how, even if it's built on what were once dull analog tasks, it's not -exactly- the same though, is it? In middle school computer lab I was taught a bit of BASIC, and being able to make a simple text "frogger" or branching adventure program, even if they were super rudimentary, was more compelling for some reason than imagining them or drawing them in a notebook... the sort of action at a delay/distance that computing offers, or that is computing's illusion...

3月1日-从魔杖的10开始，通常代表过载，负担。
在这里，它由各种早期计算项目代表，许多由各自政府补贴。
我想到在计算机或计算器成为一件事之前，它是一份工作。 即使在它们存在之后，人们仍然不得不进行调解，计算，打牌，解释等。 在我自己的工作中，我仍然经常觉得自己像一个不灵活的计算怪癖的保姆。.. 为什么电子表格软件、CMS或数据库不能为我做那些令人麻木的无聊和繁重的事情呢？
我也认为，即使它是建立在曾经沉闷的模拟任务之上，但它并不完全相同，是吗？ 在中学计算机实验室，我被教了一些基本的东西，并且能够制作一个简单的文本"frogger"或分支冒险程序，即使它们是超级简陋的，由于某种原因比想象它们或.. 计算提供的延迟/距离的动作，或者是计算的幻觉。..

March 2 - 9 of Swords... following on from the feelings of overload and burden yesterday, this card represents nightmares and anxiety about the future.
Appropriately it's represented here by The Tavistock Institute of Human Relations, a UK governmental body established in 1946 that acted regionally, nationally, and internationally for “the social engagement of social sciences” or more bluntly, using theoretical methods to “change behavior in groups and civilian populations.”
Obviously the name Tavistock brings to mind the overbearing interference of the UK government in constantly trying to block any sort of trans care, or only dispensing it as a last resort after you’ve gone through years of waiting around and a thorough psychiatric probing. A population where everyone just conformed to the two standard cis gender roles would indeed be much easier to control, so to a “Labour” government obsessed with means testing, pathologizing and cutting benefits, it’s of course desirable to treat “normality” as a virtue and any difference as disease to eliminate.
I could talk about so many things, the awful CBT and soft conversion therapy I’ve personally received in the UK, how state surveillance and punishment disproportionately targets autistic people, how even punitive and inadequate psychological care is too hard to access, how outcomes are measured in “productivity” rather than happiness. A tendency that is not technic in the big machines or internet enabled devices way, but has infested every aspect of life as much as people fear tiktok attention spans have; people I want to ally with constantly crowing “just be normal” or getting sucked down a health and fitness grifthole.
An exhausting and sad card. I’ll be honest, I almost put it back when I pulled it lol. But obviously a big part of contemporary technological thought nevertheless.

tgt_seg:
三月五日-五旬节。.. 一个困难的局面，斗争，财政不安全。
基础设施。.. 确切地说，它永远不会觉得有足够的现金。 特别是在科技领域，它总是流向炒作和破坏，而不是维持已经存在的东西。
互联网是如此巨大，具有如此巨大的实际利益，并且是许多人民生活的重要组成部分，我们当然希望基础设施得到维护，并且有良好的治理。.. 也许正是互联网本身的炒作让这些早期的标准化和生产性基本规则中的一些姿态得以坚持。
虽然有大量的科技公司参与其中，但也通过美国国防部直接完成了令人惊讶的数量，现在很多公司（例如，前不要邪恶的谷歌）正在削减他们曾经帮助建立的.. 谁的基础设施？ 它总是与治理联系在一起，并且总是意识形态。 当你身无分文的时候,小心你去找谁要钱...

src_seg:
March 6 - DEATH!! An inevitable and total transformation, possibly painful, but not necessarily The End...
A lot of anti-tech sentiment seems to wish that we could just put certain things back in the box. But the world where the technology that provides connection and access to information was entangled by its maybe well-intentioned originators with military and surveillance culture, game theory and bombs, is the world we have.
I always found the PVP gimmick for MGSV's online mode to be weirdly inspiring... if we want to live in a world without the atomic bomb, it'll have to be one where we took them all apart with our own hands. And it'll be one where the knowledge that it was made at one time will also always be a thing. How we frame it is up to us... there is no going back. How terrifying, how wonderful.
tgt_seg:
3月6日-死亡！! 一个不可避免的和彻底的转变，可能是痛苦的，但不一定是结束。..
很多反科技情绪似乎希望我们可以把某些东西放回盒子里。 但是，提供连接和获取信息的技术被其可能善意的发起人与军事和监视文化，博弈论和炸弹纠缠在一起的世界是我们拥有的世界。
我总是发现MGSV在线模式的PVP噱头非常鼓舞人心。.. 如果我们想生活在一个没有原子弹的世界里，那就必须是我们亲手把它们拆开的世界。 这将是一个知识，它是在同一时间也将永远是一件事。 我们如何构建它取决于我们。.. 没有回头路了。 多么可怕，多么美妙。

src_seg:
I idly proposed doing this yesterday so for March I will be posting one card I draw fom Suzanne Treister's Hexen 2.0 Tarot Deck per day of March.
The deck consists of all the major and minor arcana depicted by alchemical drawings of people and things from the history of technology, or, more specifically, "the scientific underpinnings of what Michel Foucault called bio-political governance."
Why? Because I actually have to do some tech-related talks this month, and also with the dark side of tech being so blatant lately, I felt the need to think about it more, and explore my associations/values etc!
tgt_seg:
我昨天无意中提议这样做，所以在三月份，我将每天发布一张我从 Suzanne Treister 的 Hexen 2.0 塔罗牌中抽出的牌。
这副牌包含了所有大阿卡纳和小阿卡纳，这些阿卡纳是用炼金术图画描绘的技术史上的人物和事物，或者更具体地说，是“米歇尔·福柯所说的生物政治治理的科学基础”。
为什么？因为这个月我实际上必须做一些与技术相关的演讲，而且最近技术的阴暗面如此明显，我觉得有必要更多地思考它，并探索我的联想/价值观等！

src_seg:
March 1 - Starting with the 10 of Wands, typically representing overload, burden.
Here it is represented by a variety of early computing projects, many subsidized by their respective governments.
I think of how before a computer or calculator was a thing it was a job. Even after they existed, people still had to mediate, calculate, punch cards, interpret, etc. And in my own work I still often feel like a babysitter of inflexible computational quirks... why can't the spreadsheet software, or CMS, or database just do that mind-numbingly boring and burdensome stuff for me?
I also think how, even if it's built on what were once dull analog tasks, it's not -exactly- the same though, is it? In middle school computer lab I was taught a bit of BASIC, and being able to make a simple text "frogger" or branching adventure program, even if they were super rudimentary, was more compelling for some reason than imagining them or drawing them in a notebook... the sort of action at a delay/distance that computing offers, or that is computing's illusion...
tgt_seg:
3 月 1 日——以权杖十开始，通常代表超负荷、负担。
这里展示了各种早期的计算项目，其中许多项目由各自的政府资助。
我想，在计算机或计算器出现之前，它是一种工作。即使在它们存在之后，人们仍然需要进行调解、计算、打卡、解释等。而在我自己的工作中，我仍然常常感觉自己像是一个不灵活的计算怪癖的保姆......为什么电子表格软件、CMS 或数据库不能帮我完成这些令人麻木的无聊和繁重的工作？
我还想，即使它建立在曾经枯燥的模拟任务之上，但它也不完全一样，不是吗？在中学计算机实验室里，我学了一些 BASIC 语言，能够制作一个简单的文本“青蛙过河”或分支冒险程序，即使它们非常简单，但出于某种原因，比想象它们或在笔记本上画出来更引人注目……计算提供的延迟/距离动作类型，或者这是计算的幻觉......

src_seg:
March 2 - 9 of Swords... following on from the feelings of overload and burden yesterday, this card represents nightmares and anxiety about the future.
Appropriately it's represented here by The Tavistock Institute of Human Relations, a UK governmental body established in 1946 that acted regionally, nationally, and internationally for “the social engagement of social sciences” or more bluntly, using theoretical methods to “change behavior in groups and civilian populations.”
Obviously the name Tavistock brings to mind the overbearing interference of the UK government in constantly trying to block any sort of trans care, or only dispensing it as a last resort after you’ve gone through years of waiting around and a thorough psychiatric probing. A population where everyone just conformed to the two standard cis gender roles would indeed be much easier to control, so to a “Labour” government obsessed with means testing, pathologizing and cutting benefits, it’s of course desirable to treat “normality” as a virtue and any difference as disease to eliminate.
I could talk about so many things, the awful CBT and soft conversion therapy I’ve personally received in the UK, how state surveillance and punishment disproportionately targets autistic people, how even punitive and inadequate psychological care is too hard to access, how outcomes are measured in “productivity” rather than happiness. A tendency that is not technic in the big machines or internet enabled devices way, but has infested every aspect of life as much as people fear tiktok attention spans have; people I want to ally with constantly crowing “just be normal” or getting sucked down a health and fitness grifthole.
An exhausting and sad card. I’ll be honest, I almost put it back when I pulled it lol. But obviously a big part of contemporary technological thought nevertheless.
tgt_seg:
3 月 2 日 - 宝剑 9……继昨天超负荷和负担的感觉之后，这张牌代表着对未来的噩梦和焦虑。
恰当地说，它在这里由塔维斯托克人类关系研究所代表，该研究所是 1946 年成立的英国政府机构，在地区、国家和国际范围内开展“社会科学的社会参与”活动，或者更直白地说，使用理论方法来“改变群体和平民的行为”。
显然，塔维斯托克这个名字让人想起英国政府的专横干涉，他们不断试图阻止任何形式的跨性别护理，或者只在经过多年的等待和彻底的精神检查后才将其作为最后的手段。每个人都遵守两个标准顺性别角色的人口确实会更容易控制，因此对于痴迷于经济状况调查、病态化和削减福利的“工党”政府来说，当然希望将“正常”视为一种美德，将任何差异视为需要消除的疾病。
我可以谈论很多事情，比如我在英国接受过的糟糕的认知行为疗法和软转化疗法，国家监控和惩罚如何不成比例地针对自闭症患者，甚至惩罚性和不充分的心理治疗也难以获得，结果是如何用“生产力”而不是幸福来衡量的。这种趋势并不是大型机器或互联网设备方面的技术，而是已经蔓延到生活的方方面面，就像人们担心抖音的注意力持续时间一样；我想与之结盟的人要么不断吹嘘“做个正常人”，要么被健康和健身的陷阱所吞噬。
一张令人疲惫又悲伤的卡片。老实说，当我把它拉出来时，我差点就把它放回去了，哈哈。但显然这仍然是当代技术思想的重要组成部分。

src_seg:
March 3 - The Star, hope, inspiration, future goals. A much more positive card than we've had so far!
But it's hard to feel positive about the massively exploitative and yet still totally underwhelming reality of artifical intelligence and quantum computing hype at the moment. The idea of an omnipotent computer, that could, indeed, simulate or work at an atomic or subatomic level, has kind of been the great dream of computing for a long time. It's almost a philosopher's stone type of thing.
Yesterday I reread this great essay on the current generative AI models by Hito Steyerl (https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images). She does a great job of going into how reliant these systems still are on human-made images, cleaned data, and ongoing human moderation at every level, but she also makes the observation that while their outputs masquerade as bits of text or images, which people wrongly attribute intention or creativity to, they're really statistical representations, with all of the inherent ideology and limitations of statistics baked in.
What would a truly intelligent computer capable of expanding our analytical powers and relieving the burden of tedious labor and the risks of incomplete information look like, and under what context would it be used to reinvent life towards more autonomy and joy rather than accelerating exploitation and control? Can we hope for such a thing with IBM and DARPA still in the picture...?
tgt_seg:
3 月 3 日——星星、希望、灵感、未来目标。这是我们迄今为止收到的一张比以往更加积极的卡片！
但目前人工智能和量子计算的炒作虽然具有大规模的剥削性，但其现实却仍然令人失望，我们很难对此抱有乐观的态度。能够模拟或在原子或亚原子层面工作的万能计算机的想法长期以来一直是计算领域的伟大梦想。它几乎是一种点金石类型的东西。
昨天我重读了 Hito Steyerl 的这篇关于当前生成式 AI 模型的精彩文章（https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images）。她出色地阐述了这些系统在多大程度上仍然依赖于人造图像、清理数据以及各个层面持续的人为调节，但她也观察到，虽然它们的输出伪装成文本或图像片段，人们错误地将意图或创造力归因于它们，但它们实际上是统计表示，带有统计数据固有的所有意识形态和局限性。
一台能够扩展我们的分析能力、减轻繁琐劳动负担和信息不完整风险的真正智能的计算机会是什么样子？在什么情况下它会被用来重塑生活，使之更加自主和快乐，而不是加速剥削和控制？在 IBM 和 DARPA 仍然参与的情况下，我们还能指望这样的事情发生吗……？

src_seg:
March 4 - The King of Swords, intellectual drive, clarity, calling for authoritative action. A go-for-it type of thing.
Timothy Leary certainly was a sort of intellectually driven, though more of a “question authority” type. Likewise, looking it up, the Eight-circuit Model of Consciousness here is generally thought to have little actual scientific credibility. Still… what model of consciousness does? Despite being how all of our “information” comes to us, it’s kind of ambiguous what this thing actually is, much less if there’s any systemic patterns that determine how it works.
I find it kind of inspiring to contemplate a multi-part model of consciousness that is both inward and outward looking. Leary was also of a period where there was optimism about space exploration, and the possibility of making contact with other species, from Earth or beyond. Now we seem to find this idea kind of embarrassing, because the idea of explaining ourselves feels embarrassing. Which in a way is it’s own kind of constantly-reinforcing self-centeredness.
There’s nothing more self-centered in the irritating way than how psychedelics as self-help, a “miracle” mental illness cure, the one weird trick to go 10x or come up with that sick disruptive business deal or chill out your bitch wife, have kind of become mainstream now. It’s all very inward-looking to the point that there’s nothing besides inward-ness. What’s the point of a honed mind if you can’t, like the king of swords, point it outwards?
tgt_seg:
3 月 4 日——宝剑国王，智慧驱动，清晰，呼吁权威行动。一种勇往直前的事情。
蒂莫西·利里 (Timothy Leary) 确实是知识分子，尽管他更属于“质疑权威”的类型。同样，查阅资料后发现，这里的意识八回路模型通常被认为几乎没有实际的科学可信度。但是……什么意识模型可以做到这一点？尽管我们所有的“信息”都是通过这种方式传递给我们的，但它到底是什么却有点模糊，更不用说是否有任何系统模式决定它如何运作。
我发现思考一个既向内又向外的多部分意识模型是很有启发性的。利里所处的时期也对太空探索充满乐观，并认为有可能与地球或地球以外的其他物种进行接触。现在我们似乎觉得这个想法有点尴尬，因为解释我们自己的想法让人感到尴尬。从某种程度上来说，这是一种不断强化的自我中心主义。
没有什么比迷幻药作为自助手段、一种“神奇”的精神疾病治疗方法、一种让病情增加 10 倍或想出那种令人作呕的破坏性商业交易或让你的婊子妻子冷静下来的奇怪技巧现在已经成为主流，更令人恼火的以自我为中心了。一切都非常内向，以至于除了内向之外什么也没有。如果你不能像宝剑之王一样将心智向外发掘，那么磨练心智又有什么意义呢？

src_seg:
March 5 - Five of Pentacles... A difficult situation, struggle, financial insecurity.
Infrastructure... precisely that thing it never feels like there's enough cash for. ESPECIALLY in tech, where it always flows towards hype and disruption rather than maintaining what already exists.
The Internet is so huge, has such great practical benefits, and is an important part of so many peoples' lives, that of course we want the infrastructure maintained, and there to be good governance... Maybe it was the hype of the Internet itself that allowed some of these early gestures towards standardization and productive ground rules to stick.
Though there are a ton of tech corporations involved, a surprising amount was also done via the US Department of Defense directly, and now a lot of the corporations (ex- Don't Be Evil Google, for example) are chipping away at the principles they once helped set up... Whose infrastructure? It's always tied to governance, and always ideological. Be careful who you go asking for cash when you're broke...
tgt_seg:
3 月 5 日——五角星币……处境艰难、挣扎、经济不稳定。
基础设施...正是这种东西让人感觉永远没有足够的钱来买。特别是在科技领域，总是趋向于炒作和颠覆，而不是维持现状。
互联网如此庞大，具有如此巨大的实际利益，并且是许多人生活中的重要组成部分，因此我们当然希望维护其基础设施，并实现良好的治理......也许正是互联网本身的炒作使得一些早期的标准化和生产基本规则的举措得以坚持下来。

我可以谈论很多事情，包括我在英国亲身经历的可怕的认知行为疗法和温和的转化治疗，国家监控和惩罚如何极度不成比例地针对自闭症人士，甚至是惩罚性和不充分的心理护理是多么难以获得，结果是以“生产力”而非幸福来衡量的。这种倾向并不是在大型机械或网络设备的技术范畴内，而是渗透到了生活的方方面面，就像人们担心的抖音注意力持续时间那样；我想与之结盟的人不断高呼“只要正常就好”，或者被卷入健康和健身的骗局。
一张令人疲惫而悲伤的牌。老实说，当我抽到它时我差点把它放回去，哈哈。但无可否认，这仍然是当代技术思想的重要一部分。

src_seg:
March 3 - The Star, hope, inspiration, future goals. A much more positive card than we've had so far!
But it's hard to feel positive about the massively exploitative and yet still totally underwhelming reality of artifical intelligence and quantum computing hype at the moment. The idea of an omnipotent computer, that could, indeed, simulate or work at an atomic or subatomic level, has kind of been the great dream of computing for a long time. It's almost a philosopher's stone type of thing.
Yesterday I reread this great essay on the current generative AI models by Hito Steyerl (https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images). She does a great job of going into how reliant these systems still are on human-made images, cleaned data, and ongoing human moderation at every level, but she also makes the observation that while their outputs masquerade as bits of text or images, which people wrongly attribute intention or creativity to, they're really statistical representations, with all of the inherent ideology and limitations of statistics baked in.
What would a truly intelligent computer capable of expanding our analytical powers and relieving the burden of tedious labor and the risks of incomplete information look like, and under what context would it be used to reinvent life towards more autonomy and joy rather than accelerating exploitation and control? Can we hope for such a thing with IBM and DARPA still in the picture...?
tgt_seg:
三月三日 - 星星，代表希望、灵感、未来目标。这张牌比之前的牌积极得多！
但在目前人工智能和量子计算的巨大剥削性以及仍然令人失望的现实面前，很难感到积极。一个全能的计算机的概念，确实能够在原子或亚原子层面进行模拟或运算，一直以来都是计算的伟大梦想。这几乎是一种哲学家的石头式的向往。
昨天我重读了这篇关于当前生成式AI模型的精彩文章，作者是希托·斯泰耶尔（https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images）。她很好地分析了这些系统仍然是多么依赖人类创建的图像、清洗过的数据，以及在每个层面上持续的人类监督，但她也观察到，尽管它们的输出伪装成文本或图像，人们错误地认为这些具有意图或创造性，但它们实际上是统计表现，包含了固有的意识形态和统计局限性。
一台真正智能的计算机，能够扩展我们分析能力并减轻繁琐劳动和不完整信息风险的计算机会是什么样子，在什么情况下被用来重塑生活以追求更多的自主和快乐，而不是加速剥削和控制？在IBM和DARPA依然存在的情况下，我们能对这样一件事情抱有希望吗……？

src_seg:
March 4 - The King of Swords, intellectual drive, clarity, calling for authoritative action. A go-for-it type of thing.
Timothy Leary certainly was a sort of intellectually driven, though more of a “question authority” type. Likewise, looking it up, the Eight-circuit Model of Consciousness here is generally thought to have little actual scientific credibility. Still… what model of consciousness does? Despite being how all of our “information” comes to us, it’s kind of ambiguous what this thing actually is, much less if there’s any systemic patterns that determine how it works.
I find it kind of inspiring to contemplate a multi-part model of consciousness that is both inward and outward looking. Leary was also of a period where there was optimism about space exploration, and the possibility of making contact with other species, from Earth or beyond. Now we seem to find this idea kind of embarrassing, because the idea of explaining ourselves feels embarrassing. Which in a way is it’s own kind of constantly-reinforcing self-centeredness.
There’s nothing more self-centered in the irritating way than how psychedelics as self-help, a “miracle” mental illness cure, the one weird trick to go 10x or come up with that sick disruptive business deal or chill out your bitch wife, have kind of become mainstream now. It’s all very inward-looking to the point that there’s nothing besides inward-ness. What’s the point of a honed mind if you can’t, like the king of swords, point it outwards?
tgt_seg:
三月四日 - 剑王，智力驱动、清晰，呼唤权威行动，一种积极向前的态度。
蒂莫西·利瑞肯定是一个智力驱动的人，但更倾向于“质疑权威”。同样查找了一下，这里的八电路意识模型通常被认为没有实际的科学依据。但……有什么意识模型是呢？尽管所有的“信息”都是通过这种方式传递给我们的，但这种东西到底是什么仍然有些模糊，更不用说是否存在任何系统性的模式来决定它是如何运作的。
我发现思考一个多元的意识模型，既向内又向外，令人鼓舞。利瑞所处的时代对太空探索抱有乐观态度，还有与地球或更远处其他物种建立联系的可能性。现在，我们似乎对这个想法感到有些尴尬，因为解释自己这一点让人觉得难堪。在某种程度上，这本身就是一种不断自我强化的自我中心。
没有什么比将迷幻药作为自我帮助，“奇迹”心理疾病治愈法，那个神奇的技巧帮助你翻10倍或促成那个炫酷的颠覆性商业交易或让你的脾气暴躁的妻子冷静下来更自我中心了。这一切都非常向内，以至于除了向内的东西几乎没有其他。精细的思维要是无法像剑王一样，向外指向又有什么意义？

src_seg:
March 5 - Five of Pentacles... A difficult situation, struggle, financial insecurity.
Infrastructure... precisely that thing it never feels like there's enough cash for. ESPECIALLY in tech, where it always flows towards hype and disruption rather than maintaining what already exists.
The Internet is so huge, has such great practical benefits, and is an important part of so many peoples' lives, that of course we want the infrastructure maintained, and there to be good governance... Maybe it was the hype of the Internet itself that allowed some of these early gestures towards standardization and productive ground rules to stick.
Though there are a ton of tech corporations involved, a surprising amount was also done via the US Department of Defense directly, and now a lot of the corporations (ex- Don't Be Evil Google, for example) are chipping away at the principles they once helped set up... Whose infrastructure? It's always tied to governance, and always ideological. Be careful who you go asking for cash when you're broke...
tgt_seg:
三月五日 - 五个硬币……困境、斗争、经济不安全。
基础设施……正是那些永远感觉就没有足够现金的东西。特别是在技术领域，资金总是流向炒作和颠覆，而不是维护现有的东西。
互联网如此庞大，带来了巨大的实际好处，成了许多人生活中不可或缺的一部分，因此我们自然希望基础设施得到维护，并有良好的治理……也许恰恰是互联网本身的炒作让早期一些标准化和生产性基本规则得以落实。
尽管有许多科技公司参与其中，但也有很多工作是由美国国防部直接完成的，现在许多公司（例如曾经的“别做恶”的谷歌）正在蚕食它们曾经帮助建立的原则……究竟是哪里的基础设施？这总是与治理紧密相关，并且总是带有意识形态色彩。破产时小心你向谁求钱……

src_seg:
March 6 - DEATH!! An inevitable and total transformation, possibly painful, but not necessarily The End...
A lot of anti-tech sentiment seems to wish that we could just put certain things back in the box. But the world where the technology that provides connection and access to information was entangled by its maybe well-intentioned originators with military and surveillance culture, game theory and bombs, is the world we have.
I always found the PVP gimmick for MGSV's online mode to be weirdly inspiring... if we want to live in a world without the atomic bomb, it'll have to be one where we took them all apart with our own hands. And it'll be one where the knowledge that it was made at one time will also always be a thing. How we frame it is up to us... there is no going back. How terrifying, how wonderful.
tgt_seg:
三月六日 - 死亡！！！一种不可避免且全面的变革，可能是痛苦的，但不一定是结束……
许多反技术情绪似乎希望我们能把某些东西重新放进箱子里。但那个由可能出于良好初衷的创始者与军事和监控文化、博弈论和炸弹纏绕在一起的提供连接和获取信息的技术世界就是我们所拥有的世界。
我一直觉得MGSV在线模式的PVP gimmick奇怪地鼓舞人心……如果我们想生活在一个没有原子弹的世界，那将是一个我们需要亲手拆解所有原子弹的世界。而且，这将是一个永远存在的事实——我们曾在某个时期创造了它。我们如何呈现这一切，取决于我们自己……不再回头。多么可怕，多么美妙。

src_seg:
I idly proposed doing this yesterday so for March I will be posting one card I draw fom Suzanne Treister's Hexen 2.0 Tarot Deck per day of March.
The deck consists of all the major and minor arcana depicted by alchemical drawings of people and things from the history of technology, or, more specifically, "the scientific underpinnings of what Michel Foucault called bio-political governance."
Why? Because I actually have to do some tech-related talks this month, and also with the dark side of tech being so blatant lately, I felt the need to think about it more, and explore my associations/values etc!
tgt_seg:
我昨天随口提议要做这件事，所以在三月份，我每天都会发布一张我从苏珊·特赖斯特（Suzanne Treister）的《Hexen 2.0 塔罗牌》中抽出的牌。
这副牌包含了所有大阿卡纳牌和小阿卡纳牌，它们通过炼金术式的绘画描绘了科技史上的人物和事件，或者更具体地说，描绘了“米歇尔·福柯所说的生物政治治理的科学基础”。
为什么呢？因为我这个月要进行几场与科技相关的演讲，而且最近科技的黑暗面如此明显，我觉得有必要更多地思考它，并探索我的关联性、价值观等。

src_seg:
March 1 - Starting with the 10 of Wands, typically representing overload, burden.
Here it is represented by a variety of early computing projects, many subsidized by their respective governments.
I think of how before a computer or calculator was a thing it was a job. Even after they existed, people still had to mediate, calculate, punch cards, interpret, etc. And in my own work I still often feel like a babysitter of inflexible computational quirks... why can't the spreadsheet software, or CMS, or database just do that mind-numbingly boring and burdensome stuff for me?
I also think how, even if it's built on what were once dull analog tasks, it's not -exactly- the same though, is it? In middle school computer lab I was taught a bit of BASIC, and being able to make a simple text "frogger" or branching adventure program, even if they were super rudimentary, was more compelling for some reason than imagining them or drawing them in a notebook... the sort of action at a delay/distance that computing offers, or that is computing's illusion...
tgt_seg:
三月一日——从圣杯十开始，这张牌通常代表超负荷和负担。
在这里，它由各种早期的计算机项目所代表，其中许多项目得到了各自政府的资助。
我想起在计算机或计算器成为一种工具之前，它是一项工作。即使在它们出现之后，人们仍然需要调解、计算、打孔、解释等。在我自己的工作中，我仍然经常觉得自己像是一个照顾不灵活的计算怪癖的保姆……为什么电子表格软件、CMS 或数据库不能为我完成这些令人头疼的无聊和繁重的工作呢？
我还想到了，即使它建立在曾经枯燥的模拟任务之上，但它并不完全相同，对吧？在中学的计算机实验室里，我学了一点 BASIC，能够制作一个简单的文本“青蛙”游戏或分支冒险程序，即使它们非常简单，但这比在笔记本上想象或绘制它们更有吸引力……这种计算提供的延迟/远距离行动，或者说计算的幻觉……

src_seg:
March 2 - 9 of Swords... following on from the feelings of overload and burden yesterday, this card represents nightmares and anxiety about the future.
Appropriately it's represented here by The Tavistock Institute of Human Relations, a UK governmental body established in 1946 that acted regionally, nationally, and internationally for “the social engagement of social sciences” or more bluntly, using theoretical methods to “change behavior in groups and civilian populations.”
Obviously the name Tavistock brings to mind the overbearing interference of the UK government in constantly trying to block any sort of trans care, or only dispensing it as a last resort after you’ve gone through years of waiting around and a thorough psychiatric probing. A population where everyone just conformed to the two standard cis gender roles would indeed be much easier to control, so to a “Labour” government obsessed with means testing, pathologizing and cutting benefits, it’s of course desirable to treat “normality” as a virtue and any difference as disease to eliminate.
I could talk about so many things, the awful CBT and soft conversion therapy I’ve personally received in the UK, how state surveillance and punishment disproportionately targets autistic people, how even punitive and inadequate psychological care is too hard to access, how outcomes are measured in “productivity” rather than happiness. A tendency that is not technic in the big machines or internet enabled devices way, but has infested every aspect of life as much as people fear tiktok attention spans have; people I want to ally with constantly crowing “just be normal” or getting sucked down a health and fitness grifthole.
An exhausting and sad card. I’ll be honest, I almost put it back when I pulled it lol. But obviously a big part of contemporary technological thought nevertheless.
tgt_seg:

三月五日——五便士（Five of Pentacles）……代表一个艰难的处境、挣扎和经济不安全。
基础设施……这正是那种永远感觉没有足够资金的东西。特别是在科技领域，资金总是流向炒作和颠覆，而不是维护已有的东西。
互联网如此庞大，具有如此巨大的实际益处，是许多人生活的重要组成部分，因此我们当然希望基础设施得到维护，并有一个良好的治理体系……也许正是互联网本身的炒作，使得这些早期标准化和生产性基本规则的尝试得以坚持下来。
尽管有许多科技公司参与其中，但令人惊讶的是，相当一部分工作是由美国国防部直接完成的，而现在许多公司（例如前“不作恶”的谷歌）正在逐步削弱它们曾经帮助建立的原则……谁的基础设施？它总是与治理相关，总是意识形态化的。当你身处困境时，要小心你向谁寻求帮助……

src_seg:
March 6 - DEATH!! An inevitable and total transformation, possibly painful, but not necessarily The End...
A lot of anti-tech sentiment seems to wish that we could just put certain things back in the box. But the world where the technology that provides connection and access to information was entangled by its maybe well-intentioned originators with military and surveillance culture, game theory and bombs, is the world we have.
I always found the PVP gimmick for MGSV's online mode to be weirdly inspiring... if we want to live in a world without the atomic bomb, it'll have to be one where we took them all apart with our own hands. And it'll be one where the knowledge that it was made at one time will also always be a thing. How we frame it is up to us... there is no going back. How terrifying, how wonderful.
tgt_seg:
三月六日——死亡！！一种不可避免的、彻底的转变，可能很痛苦，但并不一定是结束……
许多反科技情绪似乎希望我们能够把某些事情重新放回盒子里。但我们所处的这个世界，提供连接和信息获取的技术，却被其可能怀有善意的创造者与军事和监控文化、博弈论和炸弹纠缠在一起。
我总是觉得《MGSV》在线模式的 PVP 噱头很有启发性……如果我们想生活在一个没有原子弹的世界里，那将是一个我们用自己的双手把它们全部拆解的世界。在那个世界里，曾经制造原子弹的知识也将永远存在。我们如何定义它取决于我们自己……没有回头路。多么可怕，多么美妙。

这副牌包含了所有主要的和次要的奥秘，通过对技术历史中人物和事物的炼金术绘画描绘，或者更具体地说，“米歇尔·福柯所谓的生物政治治理的科学基础”来表现出来。
为什么？因为这个月我确实有一些与技术相关的演讲要做，而且最近科技的阴暗面如此明显，我觉得有必要多想想，探索我的联想/价值观等等！

src_seg:
March 1 - Starting with the 10 of Wands, typically representing overload, burden.
Here it is represented by a variety of early computing projects, many subsidized by their respective governments.
I think of how before a computer or calculator was a thing it was a job. Even after they existed, people still had to mediate, calculate, punch cards, interpret, etc. And in my own work I still often feel like a babysitter of inflexible computational quirks... why can't the spreadsheet software, or CMS, or database just do that mind-numbingly boring and burdensome stuff for me?
I also think how, even if it's built on what were once dull analog tasks, it's not -exactly- the same though, is it? In middle school computer lab I was taught a bit of BASIC, and being able to make a simple text "frogger" or branching adventure program, even if they were super rudimentary, was more compelling for some reason than imagining them or drawing them in a notebook... the sort of action at a delay/distance that computing offers, or that is computing's illusion...
tgt_seg:
3月1日 - 从十个魔杖开始，通常代表超负荷、负担。
这里它由各种早期计算项目来表现，其中许多由各自的政府资助。
我想到了在电脑或计算器成为现实之前，计算是一项工作。即使它们存在之后，人们仍然不得不进行调解、计算、穿孔卡、解释等。在我的工作中，我仍然经常觉得自己是计算固有缺陷的保姆……为什么电子表格软件、CMS或数据库不能为我做那些令人眼花缭乱、繁琐的工作呢？
我也想，即使它建立在曾经是单调的模拟任务之上，它也不完全一样，对吧？在中学电脑实验室，我学到了一点BASIC，能够制作一个简单的文本“frogger”或分支冒险程序，即使它们非常基础，但出于某种原因，比想象或在笔记本上画它们更有吸引力……计算所提供的或计算所构想的延迟/距离的行动...

src_seg:
March 2 - 9 of Swords... following on from the feelings of overload and burden yesterday, this card represents nightmares and anxiety about the future.
Appropriately it's represented here by The Tavistock Institute of Human Relations, a UK governmental body established in 1946 that acted regionally, nationally, and internationally for “the social engagement of social sciences” or more bluntly, using theoretical methods to “change behavior in groups and civilian populations.”
Obviously the name Tavistock brings to mind the overbearing interference of the UK government in constantly trying to block any sort of trans care, or only dispensing it as a last resort after you’ve gone through years of waiting around and a thorough psychiatric probing. A population where everyone just conformed to the two standard cis gender roles would indeed be much easier to control, so to a “Labour” government obsessed with means testing, pathologizing and cutting benefits, it’s of course desirable to treat “normality” as a virtue and any difference as disease to eliminate.
I could talk about so many things, the awful CBT and soft conversion therapy I’ve personally received in the UK, how state surveillance and punishment disproportionately targets autistic people, how even punitive and inadequate psychological care is too hard to access, how outcomes are measured in “productivity” rather than happiness. A tendency that is not technic in the big machines or internet enabled devices way, but has infested every aspect of life as much as people fear tiktok attention spans have; people I want to ally with constantly crowing “just be normal” or getting sucked down a health and fitness grifthole.
An exhausting and sad card. I’ll be honest, I almost put it back when I pulled it lol. But obviously a big part of contemporary technological thought nevertheless.
tgt_seg:
3月2日 - 剑九...继昨天超负荷和负担的感觉之后，这张牌代表了关于未来的噩梦和焦虑。
恰当地，它在这里由塔维斯托克人类关系研究所来表现，这是一个成立于1946年的英国政府机构，在区域、国家和国际层面为“社会科学的社会参与”或更直白地说，使用理论方法“改变群体和平民人口的行为”而存在。
显然，塔维斯托克这个名字让人联想到英国政府不断干涉阻挠任何变性护理，或者只在经过多年的等待和彻底的精神病学探查之后才提供护理，这种令人讨厌的干涉。一个所有人都只符合两个标准的顺性别角色的人口确实更容易控制，所以对于一个执着于手段测试、病理化和削减福利的“工党”政府来说，当然希望将“正常”视为美德，将任何差异视为需要消除的疾病。
我可以谈论很多事情，比如我在英国亲身经历的可怕的认知行为疗法和软性转换疗法，国家监视和惩罚为何不成比例地针对自闭症患者，惩罚性和不充分的心理护理为何难以获得，结果为何以“生产力”而非幸福来衡量。这种倾向并非存在于大型机器或互联网设备中，而是已经渗透到生活的方方面面，就像人们害怕抖音的注意力一样；我想要结盟的人不断宣称“只要正常”或被健康和健身骗局吸引。一张令人筋疲力尽且悲伤的牌。老实说，我几乎在抽牌时就放它回去lol。但显然，它仍然是当代技术思想的一个重要组成部分。

src_seg:
March 3 - The Star, hope, inspiration, future goals. A much more positive card than we've had so far!
But it's hard to feel positive about the massively exploitative and yet still totally underwhelming reality of artifical intelligence and quantum computing hype at the moment. The idea of an omnipotent computer, that could, indeed, simulate or work at an atomic or subatomic level, has kind of been the great dream of computing for a long time. It's almost a philosopher's stone type of thing.
Yesterday I reread this great essay on the current generative AI models by Hito Steyerl (https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images). She does a great job of going into how reliant these systems still are on human-made images, cleaned data, and ongoing human moderation at every level, but she also makes the observation that while their outputs masquerade as bits of text or images, which people wrongly attribute intention or creativity to, they're really statistical representations, with all of the inherent ideology and limitations of statistics baked in.
What would a truly intelligent computer capable of expanding our analytical powers and relieving the burden of tedious labor and the risks of incomplete information look like, and under what context would it be used to reinvent life towards more autonomy and joy rather than accelerating exploitation and control? Can we hope for such a thing with IBM and DARPA still in the picture...?
tgt_seg:
3月3日 - 星星，希望，灵感，未来目标。比我们迄今为止看到的要积极得多！
但目前人工智能和量子计算炒作的极度剥削且仍然令人失望的现实很难让人感到积极。关于一个无所不能的计算机，确实可以在原子或亚原子水平上模拟或工作，的想法长期以来一直是计算的伟大梦想。它几乎是一种哲学石。
昨天我重读了希托·斯泰耶尔关于当前生成式人工智能模型的精彩文章（https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images）。她很好地阐述了这些系统仍然依赖于人类制作的图像、清理的数据和持续的人类调停，但在各个层面上，她还指出，尽管它们的输出伪装成文本或图像片段，人们错误地将意图或创造力归因于它们，但它们实际上是统计表示，其中包含了统计的固有意识形态和局限性。
一个真正智能的计算机将如何运作，能够扩展我们的分析能力，减轻乏味劳动和不完整信息风险的负担，以及在什么背景下它将被用来重塑生活，以实现更多的自主和快乐，而不是加速剥削和控制？我们是否能指望IBM和DARPA仍然在图景中...?

src_seg:
March 4 - The King of Swords, intellectual drive, clarity, calling for authoritative action. A go-for-it type of thing.
Timothy Leary certainly was a sort of intellectually driven, though more of a “question authority” type. Likewise, looking it up, the Eight-circuit Model of Consciousness here is generally thought to have little actual scientific credibility. Still… what model of consciousness does? Despite being how all of our “information” comes to us, it’s kind of ambiguous what this thing actually is, much less if there’s any systemic patterns that determine how it works.
I find it kind of inspiring to contemplate a multi-part model of consciousness that is both inward and outward looking. Leary was also of a period where there was optimism about space exploration, and the possibility of making contact with other species, from Earth or beyond. Now we seem to find this idea kind of embarrassing, because the idea of explaining ourselves feels embarrassing. Which in a way is it’s own kind of constantly-reinforcing self-centeredness.
There’s nothing more self-centered in the irritating way than how psychedelics as self-help, a “miracle” mental illness cure, the one weird trick to go 10x or come up with that sick disruptive business deal or chill out your bitch wife, have kind of become mainstream now. It’s all very inward-looking to the point that there’s nothing besides inward-ness. What’s the point of a honed mind if you can’t, like the king of swords, point it outwards?
tgt_seg:
3月4日 - 剑王，智力驱动，清晰度，呼吁权威行动。一种全力以赴的事情。

我发现一个既向内又向外的多部分意识模型的想法很有启发性。利里生活在一个对太空探索充满乐观，以及与其他物种接触的可能性的时期。现在，我们似乎觉得这个想法很尴尬，因为解释自己的想法让人感到尴尬。从某种意义上说，这是一种不断自我强化、自我中心的自我中心主义。
没有什么比精神药物作为自我帮助、一种“奇迹”精神疾病治疗、一种奇特的诀窍来实现10倍增长或想出那个令人讨厌的颠覆性商业交易或让你的婊子妻子冷静下来的方式，更令人讨厌和自我中心的。它们现在已经成为主流。所有的一切都非常内向，以至于除了内向之外什么都没有。如果像剑王一样，你不能将你的心灵指向外部，那么一个磨练的思想有什么意义呢？

src_seg:
March 5 - Five of Pentacles... A difficult situation, struggle, financial insecurity.

这是一张令人疲惫和悲伤的牌。我坦白地说，我几乎把它放回了抽牌器里了。但显然，它与当代技术思想仍然密切相关。

src_seg:
March 3 - The Star, hope, inspiration, future goals. A much more positive card than we've had so far!
But it's hard to feel positive about the massively exploitative and yet still totally underwhelming reality of artifical intelligence and quantum computing hype at the moment. The idea of an omnipotent computer, that could, indeed, simulate or work at an atomic or subatomic level, has kind of been the great dream of computing for a long time. It's almost a philosopher's stone type of thing.
Yesterday I reread this great essay on the current generative AI models by Hito Steyerl (https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images). She does a great job of going into how reliant these systems still are on human-made images, cleaned data, and ongoing human moderation at every level, but she also makes the observation that while their outputs masquerade as bits of text or images, which people wrongly attribute intention or creativity to, they're really statistical representations, with all of the inherent ideology and limitations of statistics baked in.
What would a truly intelligent computer capable of expanding our analytical powers and relieving the burden of tedious labor and the risks of incomplete information look like, and under what context would it be used to reinvent life towards more autonomy and joy rather than accelerating exploitation and control? Can we hope for such a thing with IBM and DARPA still in the picture...?
tgt_seg:
三月 3 日 - 星座，希望、灵感、未来目标。与我们到目前为止看到的相比，这张牌更积极！
但目前人工智能和量子计算的炒作和虚假令人难以感到积极。计算机的终极梦想，能够模拟或在原子或亚原子层面上工作，已经是计算领域的伟大梦想很久了。它几乎是哲学家的石头一样。
昨天我重新读了Hito Steyerl关于当前生成AI模型的文章（https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images），她很好的分析了这些系统仍然依赖于人类制造的图像、清理后的数据和每层的人类监督，但她也观察到，虽然它们的输出伪装成文本或图像，人们错误地将其归因于意图或创造力，但它们实际上是统计表示，与统计本身的意识形态和局限性相结合。
一个真正智能的计算机将如何看待，以及如何用于重塑生活以实现更多自主和快乐，而不是加速剥削和控制？我们能否希望在IBM和DARPA仍然存在的情况下有这样的事情...？

src_seg:
March 4 - The King of Swords, intellectual drive, clarity, calling for authoritative action. A go-for-it type of thing.
Timothy Leary certainly was a sort of intellectually driven, though more of a “question authority” type. Likewise, looking it up, the Eight-circuit Model of Consciousness here is generally thought to have little actual scientific credibility. Still… what model of consciousness does? Despite being how all of our “information” comes to us, it’s kind of ambiguous what this thing actually is, much less if there’s any systemic patterns that determine how it works.
I find it kind of inspiring to contemplate a multi-part model of consciousness that is both inward and outward looking. Leary was also of a period where there was optimism about space exploration, and the possibility of making contact with other species, from Earth or beyond. Now we seem to find this idea kind of embarrassing, because the idea of explaining ourselves feels embarrassing. Which in a way is it’s own kind of constantly-reinforcing self-centeredness.
There’s nothing more self-centered in the irritating way than how psychedelics as self-help, a “miracle” mental illness cure, the one weird trick to go 10x or come up with that sick disruptive business deal or chill out your bitch wife, have kind of become mainstream now. It’s all very inward-looking to the point that there’s nothing besides inward-ness. What’s the point of a honed mind if you can’t, like the king of swords, point it outwards?
tgt_seg:
三月 4 日 - 剑王，知识驱动力、清晰度、呼吁权威行动。一种前进的感觉。
蒂莫西·利里当然是一个知识驱动的，尽管他更像一个“质疑权威”的人。同样，我查了下，八回路意识模型在这里通常被认为是缺乏实际科学可信度的。但... 哪种意识模型有？尽管它是我们所有“信息”的来源，但它本身就是模糊的，更不用说是否有系统性的模式来确定它的工作方式了。
我认为反思一个既内省又外省的多部分意识模型很有启发性。利里也属于一个充满太空探索乐观主义的时代，以及与外星物种接触的可能性。现在，我们似乎觉得这种想法很尴尬，因为解释自己感觉很尴尬。这本身就是一种自我中心的方式。
现在将迷幻药作为自我帮助、“奇迹”精神疾病疗法、一个疯狂的商业交易或放松你糟糕的妻子的一招，已经变得主流了。它完全是内省的，以至于除了内省之外，什么都没有。一个磨练的头脑如果不能指向外部，有什么用呢？

src_seg:
March 5 - Five of Pentacles... A difficult situation, struggle, financial insecurity.
Infrastructure... precisely that thing it never feels like there's enough cash for. ESPECIALLY in tech, where it always flows towards hype and disruption rather than maintaining what already exists.
The Internet is so huge, has such great practical benefits, and is an important part of so many peoples' lives, that of course we want the infrastructure maintained, and there to be good governance... Maybe it was the hype of the Internet itself that allowed some of these early gestures towards standardization and productive ground rules to stick.
Though there are a ton of tech corporations involved, a surprising amount was also done via the US Department of Defense directly, and now a lot of the corporations (ex- Don't Be Evil Google, for example) are chipping away at the principles they once helped set up... Whose infrastructure? It's always tied to governance, and always ideological. Be careful who you go asking for cash when you're broke...
tgt_seg:
三月 5 日 - 五个五笔... 困难的处境、挣扎、财务不安全。
基础设施... 恰恰是那种我们永远觉得资金不足的东西。特别是在科技领域，资金总是流向炒作和破坏，而不是维护现有的东西。
互联网如此庞大，有如此实际的好处，是如此重要地成为许多人生活的一部分，因此我们当然希望基础设施得到维护，并存在良好的治理... 也许是互联网本身的炒作让一些早期的标准化和有成效的规则得以坚持。
尽管有大量科技公司参与，但一些直接来自美国国防部（例如）也做了一些事情，现在许多公司（曾经的“不要做坏事”的谷歌等）正在侵蚀它们曾经帮助制定的原则... 谁的基础设施？它总是与治理和意识形态联系在一起。当你破产时，小心向谁要钱...

src_seg:
March 6 - DEATH!! An inevitable and total transformation, possibly painful, but not necessarily The End...
A lot of anti-tech sentiment seems to wish that we could just put certain things back in the box. But the world where the technology that provides connection and access to information was entangled by its maybe well-intentioned originators with military and surveillance culture, game theory and bombs, is the world we have.
I always found the PVP gimmick for MGSV's online mode to be weirdly inspiring... if we want to live in a world without the atomic bomb, it'll have to be one where we took them all apart with our own hands. And it'll be one where the knowledge that it was made at one time will also always be a thing. How we frame it is up to us... there is no going back. How terrifying, how wonderful.
tgt_seg:
三月 6 日 - 死亡！不可避免的、完全的转变，可能很痛苦，但不是终结...
许多反科技情绪似乎希望我们能把某些东西放回盒子里。但我们所处的这个世界，技术提供连接和获取信息的工具与军事和监视文化、游戏理论和炸弹交织在一起，是我们现在所处的这个世界。
我一直觉得MGSV在线模式的PVP机制很有启发性... 如果我们想生活在没有原子弹的世界里，我们必须用自己的双手把它们拆开。而且，知识它曾经被创造出来的时候也会永远存在。如何框架它取决于我们... 没有回头路。多么可怕，多么美好。

src_seg:
I idly proposed doing this yesterday so for March I will be posting one card I draw fom Suzanne Treister's Hexen 2.0 Tarot Deck per day of March.
The deck consists of all the major and minor arcana depicted by alchemical drawings of people and things from the history of technology, or, more specifically, "the scientific underpinnings of what Michel Foucault called bio-political governance."
Why? Because I actually have to do some tech-related talks this month, and also with the dark side of tech being so blatant lately, I felt the need to think about it more, and explore my associations/values etc!
tgt_seg:
我昨天随口提议要做这件事，所以这个三月，我将每天发布一张来自苏珊·崔斯特的《Hexen 2.0》塔罗牌组的卡牌。
这副牌包含所有大牌和小牌，它们都以炼金术绘画的形式描绘了科技历史中的人物和事物，更准确地说，是“米歇尔·福柯所说的生物政治治理的科学原理”。
为什么？因为我这个月确实需要做一些与科技相关的演讲，而且最近科技的负面影响也越来越明显，我感觉需要更多地思考这些问题，并探索我的想法和价值观！#

src_seg:
March 1 - Starting with the 10 of Wands, typically representing overload, burden.
Here it is represented by a variety of early computing projects, many subsidized by their respective governments.
I think of how before a computer or calculator was a thing it was a job. Even after they existed, people still had to mediate, calculate, punch cards, interpret, etc. And in my own work I still often feel like a babysitter of inflexible computational quirks... why can't the spreadsheet software, or CMS, or database just do that mind-numbingly boring and burdensome stuff for me?
I also think how, even if it's built on what were once dull analog tasks, it's not -exactly- the same though, is it? In middle school computer lab I was taught a bit of BASIC, and being able to make a simple text "frogger" or branching adventure program, even if they were super rudimentary, was more compelling for some reason than imagining them or drawing them in a notebook... the sort of action at a delay/distance that computing offers, or that is computing's illusion...
tgt_seg:
3月1日——从“第十根权杖”开始，它通常代表着负担过重、不堪重负。
在这里，它被表现为各种早期的计算项目，其中许多都得到了各自政府的补贴。
我想起在计算机或计算器出现之前，计算本身就是一项工作。即使它们已经存在，人们仍然需要进行调解、计算、打孔、解释等等。而在我自己的工作中，我常常感到自己像是在照看一些僵化的计算怪癖……为什么电子表格软件、内容管理系统（CMS）或数据库不能替我完成那些枯燥乏味、繁琐而又沉重的任务呢？
我也想，即使这些技术建立在曾经单调的模拟任务之上，它们毕竟还是不完全一样的，对吧？我在中学计算机实验室学过一点BASIC，能够编写一个简单的文字“青蛙过河”或分支冒险程序，即使它们非常原始，也比在笔记本上想象或画它们更有吸引力……计算所提供的这种延迟/远程操作，或者说是计算所产生的错觉……

src_seg:
March 2 - 9 of Swords... following on from the feelings of overload and burden yesterday, this card represents nightmares and anxiety about the future.
Appropriately it's represented here by The Tavistock Institute of Human Relations, a UK governmental body established in 1946 that acted regionally, nationally, and internationally for “the social engagement of social sciences” or more bluntly, using theoretical methods to “change behavior in groups and civilian populations.”
Obviously the name Tavistock brings to mind the overbearing interference of the UK government in constantly trying to block any sort of trans care, or only dispensing it as a last resort after you’ve gone through years of waiting around and a thorough psychiatric probing. A population where everyone just conformed to the two standard cis gender roles would indeed be much easier to control, so to a “Labour” government obsessed with means testing, pathologizing and cutting benefits, it’s of course desirable to treat “normality” as a virtue and any difference as disease to eliminate.
I could talk about so many things, the awful CBT and soft conversion therapy I’ve personally received in the UK, how state surveillance and punishment disproportionately targets autistic people, how even punitive and inadequate psychological care is too hard to access, how outcomes are measured in “productivity” rather than happiness. A tendency that is not technic in the big machines or internet enabled devices way, but has infested every aspect of life as much as people fear tiktok attention spans have; people I want to ally with constantly crowing “just be normal” or getting sucked down a health and fitness grifthole.
An exhausting and sad card. I’ll be honest, I almost put it back when I pulled it lol. But obviously a big part of contemporary technological thought nevertheless.
tgt_seg:
3月2日——九号权杖……延续昨日的过度和负担感，这张牌代表着噩梦和对未来的焦虑。
它恰如其分地以英国人类关系塔维斯托克研究所（The Tavistock Institute of Human Relations）来呈现，该研究所是1946年在英国建立的政府机构，在区域、国家和国际层面开展活动，旨在“促进社会科学的社会参与”，或者更直白地说，就是利用理论方法来“改变群体和民众的行为”。
显然，塔维斯托克这个名字让人联想到英国政府过度干涉，不断试图阻止任何形式的跨性别护理，或者仅将其作为在经过多年等待和彻底的精神病学检查后才提供的最后手段。一个每个人都仅仅符合两种标准的顺性别角色的人口，无疑更容易被控制，因此对于一个痴迷于资格审查、病理化和削减福利的工党政府来说，将“正常”视为美德，并将任何差异视为需要消除的疾病，自然是可取的。
我可以谈论很多事情，比如我个人在英国经历过的可怕的认知行为疗法和温和的转化疗法，国家监控和惩罚不成比例地针对自闭症患者，即使是惩罚性且不足的心理护理也很难获得，结果的衡量标准是“生产力”而不是幸福感。这种趋势并非仅仅体现在大型机器或互联网设备中，而是已经渗透到生活的方方面面，就像人们对抖音注意力跨度所担心的那样；我想要结盟的人们不断高呼“变得正常”，或者沉迷于虚假的健康和健身宣传之中。
一张令人精疲力竭和悲伤的牌。老实说，我差点把它放回去。但显然，它仍然是当代技术思想的重要组成部分。#

src_seg:
March 1 - Starting with the 10 of Wands, typically representing overload, burden.

Even after they existed, people still had to mediate, calculate, punch cards, interpret, etc. And in my own work I still often feel like a babysitter of inflexible computational quirks... why can't the spreadsheet software, or CMS, or database just do that mind-numbingly boring and burdensome stuff for me?
I also think how, even if it's built on what were once dull analog tasks, it's not -exactly- the same though, is it? tgt_seg:
3月1日 - 从权杖十开始，通常代表超负荷、负担。
在这里，它由各种早期计算项目代表，其中许多由各自政府资助。
我想起在计算机或计算器出现之前，它是一种工作。即使在它们存在之后，人们仍然需要调解、计算、打孔卡、解释等。在我的工作中，我仍然经常觉得自己像是僵化的计算怪癖的保姆...为什么电子表格软件、CMS 或数据库不能为我们做那些令人麻木的无聊和繁重的工作呢？
我也在想，即使它建立在曾经枯燥的模拟任务之上，它也不是 -完全- 相同的，对吧？在中学的电脑实验室里，我学到了一点 BASIC，能够制作一个简单的文本“青蛙”或分支冒险程序，即使它们非常初级，也比想象或在笔记本上画它们更有吸引力...计算所提供的延迟/距离行动，或者计算的幻觉...

src_seg:
March 2 - 9 of Swords... following on from the feelings of overload and burden yesterday, this card represents nightmares and anxiety about the future.
Appropriately it's represented here by The Tavistock Institute of Human Relations, a UK governmental body established in 1946 that acted regionally, nationally, and internationally for “the social engagement of social sciences” or more bluntly, using theoretical methods to “change behavior in groups and civilian populations.”
Obviously the name Tavistock brings to mind the overbearing interference of the UK government in constantly trying to block any sort of trans care, or only dispensing it as a last resort after you’ve gone through years of waiting around and a thorough psychiatric probing. A population where everyone just conformed to the two standard cis gender roles would indeed be much easier to control, so to a “Labour” government obsessed with means testing, pathologizing and cutting benefits, it’s of course desirable to treat “normality” as a virtue and any difference as disease to eliminate.
I could talk about so many things, the awful CBT and soft conversion therapy I’ve personally received in the UK, how state surveillance and punishment disproportionately targets autistic people, how even punitive and inadequate psychological care is too hard to access, how outcomes are measured in “productivity” rather than happiness. A tendency that is not technic in the big machines or internet enabled devices way, but has infested every aspect of life as much as people fear tiktok attention spans have; people I want to ally with constantly crowing “just be normal” or getting sucked down a health and fitness grifthole.
An exhausting and sad card. I’ll be honest, I almost put it back when I pulled it lol. But obviously a big part of contemporary technological thought nevertheless.
tgt_seg:
3月2日 - 剑九...继昨天的超负荷和负担感之后，这张牌代表噩梦和对未来焦虑。
恰如其分地，它在这里由 Tavistock 人际关系研究所代表，该研究所是英国政府于 1946 年成立的一个机构，它在地区、国家和国际上“进行社会参与的社会科学”或更直白地说，使用理论方法“改变群体和公民人口的行为。”
显然，Tavistock 这个名字让人联想到英国政府不断试图阻止任何形式的变性护理，或者只有在经过多年的等待和彻底的精神病学检查后才将其作为最后的手段。一个每个人都符合两个标准的顺性别角色的人口确实更容易控制，所以对于一个痴迷于手段测试、病理化和削减福利的“工党”政府来说，将“正常”视为一种美德，将任何差异视为需要消除的疾病当然是可取的。
我可以谈论很多事情，我在英国亲身经历的可怕的认知行为疗法和软性转化疗法，国家监视和惩罚不成比例地针对自闭症患者，即使惩罚性和不充分的心理护理也很难获得，结果是以“生产力”而不是幸福来衡量。这种倾向不是以大型机器或互联网启用设备的方式存在，而是像人们害怕 tiktok 注意力持续时间一样，已经渗透到生活的方方面面；我想要结盟的人不断高喊“只要正常就好”或者陷入健康和健身的陷阱。
一张令人筋疲力尽和悲伤的牌。老实说，当我抽到它时，我差点把它放回去 lol。但显然，它是当代技术思想的重要组成部分。

src_seg:
March 3 - The Star, hope, inspiration, future goals. A much more positive card than we've had so far!
But it's hard to feel positive about the massively exploitative and yet still totally underwhelming reality of artifical intelligence and quantum computing hype at the moment. The idea of an omnipotent computer, that could, indeed, simulate or work at an atomic or subatomic level, has kind of been the great dream of computing for a long time. It's almost a philosopher's stone type of thing.
Yesterday I reread this great essay on the current generative AI models by Hito Steyerl (https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images). She does a great job of going into how reliant these systems still are on human-made images, cleaned data, and ongoing human moderation at every level, but she also makes the observation that while their outputs masquerade as bits of text or images, which people wrongly attribute intention or creativity to, they're really statistical representations, with all of the inherent ideology and limitations of statistics baked in.
What would a truly intelligent computer capable of expanding our analytical powers and relieving the burden of tedious labor and the risks of incomplete information look like, and under what context would it be used to reinvent life towards more autonomy and joy rather than accelerating exploitation and control? Can we hope for such a thing with IBM and DARPA still in the picture...?
tgt_seg:
3月3日 - 星星，希望，灵感，未来目标。到目前为止，这是一张比我们之前看到的更积极的牌！
但很难对人工智能和量子计算的炒作感到积极，这些炒作目前既具有极大的剥削性，又完全令人失望。一个全能的计算机的想法，它确实可以模拟或在原子或亚原子水平上工作，长期以来一直是计算的伟大梦想。它几乎就像哲学家的石头一样。
昨天我重读了 Hito Steyerl 关于当前生成式 AI 模型的精彩文章（https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images）。她很好地阐述了这些系统仍然依赖于人类制作的图像、清理数据以及每个层面的持续人类监督，但她也指出，虽然它们的输出伪装成文本或图像的片段，人们错误地将意图或创造力归因于它们，但它们实际上是统计表示，具有统计学的所有固有意识形态和局限性。
一个真正智能的计算机，能够扩展我们的分析能力，减轻繁琐劳动的负担和不完整信息的风险，会是什么样子，以及在什么情况下会被用来重新发明生活，以实现更多的自主和快乐，而不是加速剥削和控制？我们还能指望这样的事情吗，IBM 和 DARPA 仍然在场...？

src_seg:
March 4 - The King of Swords, intellectual drive, clarity, calling for authoritative action. A go-for-it type of thing.
Timothy Leary certainly was a sort of intellectually driven, though more of a “question authority” type. Likewise, looking it up, the Eight-circuit Model of Consciousness here is generally thought to have little actual scientific credibility. Still… what model of consciousness does? Despite being how all of our “information” comes to us, it’s kind of ambiguous what this thing actually is, much less if there’s any systemic patterns that determine how it works.
I find it kind of inspiring to contemplate a multi-part model of consciousness that is both inward and outward looking. Leary was also of a period where there was optimism about space exploration, and the possibility of making contact with other species, from Earth or beyond. Now we seem to find this idea kind of embarrassing, because the idea of explaining ourselves feels embarrassing. Which in a way is it’s own kind of constantly-reinforcing self-centeredness.
There’s nothing more self-centered in the irritating way than how psychedelics as self-help, a “miracle” mental illness cure, the one weird trick to go 10x or come up with that sick disruptive business deal or chill out your bitch wife, have kind of become mainstream now. It’s all very inward-looking to the point that there’s nothing besides inward-ness. What’s the point of a honed mind if you can’t, like the king of swords, point it outwards?
tgt_seg:
3月4日 - 剑王，智力驱动，清晰，呼吁采取权威行动。一种全力以赴的类型。
蒂莫西·利里当然是一种智力驱动的类型，尽管更多的是“质疑权威”的类型。同样，查阅资料后，这里的八回路意识模型通常被认为几乎没有实际的科学可信度。尽管如此...什么意识模型有？尽管这是我们所有“信息”的来源，但这个东西到底是什么，更不用说是否有任何系统模式决定了它的运作方式。
我发现思考一个多部分的意识模型，既向内又向外看，是很有启发性的。利里也处于一个对太空探索持乐观态度的时期，以及与地球或其他地方的其他物种接触的可能性。现在，我们似乎觉得这个想法有点令人尴尬，因为解释自己的想法让人觉得尴尬。这在某种程度上是它自己的不断自我强化的自我中心主义。
没有什么比迷幻药作为自助、一种“奇迹”精神疾病疗法、一种奇怪的技巧来实现 10 倍增长或想出一个令人讨厌的颠覆性商业交易或让你的婊子妻子冷静下来更令人讨厌的自我中心主义了。它现在已经成为主流。它非常向内看，以至于除了向内性之外什么都没有。一个磨练的心灵有什么用，如果你不能像剑王一样指向外部？

src_seg:
March 5 - Five of Pentacles... A difficult situation, struggle, financial insecurity.
Infrastructure... precisely that thing it never feels like there's enough cash for. ESPECIALLY in tech, where it always flows towards hype and disruption rather than maintaining what already exists.
The Internet is so huge, has such great practical benefits, and is an important part of so many peoples' lives, that of course we want the infrastructure maintained, and there to be good governance... Maybe it was the hype of the Internet itself that allowed some of these early gestures towards standardization and productive ground rules to stick.
Though there are a ton of tech corporations involved, a surprising amount was also done via the US Department of Defense directly, and now a lot of the corporations (ex- Don't Be Evil Google, for example) are chipping away at the principles they once helped set up... Whose infrastructure? It's always tied to governance, and always ideological. Be careful who you go asking for cash when you're broke...

3月3日——星星牌，象征希望、灵感与未来目标。这是迄今为止我们抽到的最为积极的一张牌！
然而，面对当前人工智能与量子计算领域炒作不断、现实却充满剥削性且令人失望的状况，实在难以保持乐观。能够模拟或在原子乃至亚原子层面运行的全能计算机，长期以来一直是计算技术的伟大梦想，几乎如同炼金术中的“贤者之石”一般令人神往。
昨天，我重读了希托·施泰尔（Hito Steyerl）关于当前生成式AI模型的精彩文章（https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images）。她深入剖析了这些系统在多大程度上仍然依赖人类制作的图像、清洗后的数据以及各层级持续的人工审核。同时她也指出，尽管AI的输出常被误认为具有意图性或创造力，实际上它们只是统计学意义上的表达，承载着统计方法所固有的意识形态与局限。
那么，一台真正智能的计算机，应当是能够拓展人类分析能力、减轻繁琐劳动的负担、并降低信息不完整所带来的风险的工具。它应当在怎样的背景下被使用，才能真正助力我们重塑生活，使其更加自主、富有趣味，而非进一步加剧剥削与控制？当IBM与DARPA等机构依然主导这一领域之时，我们是否还能期待这样一种理想的未来？

src_seg:
March 4 - The King of Swords, intellectual drive, clarity, calling for authoritative action. A go-for-it type of thing.
Timothy Leary certainly was a sort of intellectually driven, though more of a “question authority” type. Likewise, looking it up, the Eight-circuit Model of Consciousness here is generally thought to have little actual scientific credibility. Still… what model of consciousness does? Despite being how all of our “information” comes to us, it’s kind of ambiguous what this thing actually is, much less if there’s any systemic patterns that determine how it works.
I find it kind of inspiring to contemplate a multi-part model of consciousness that is both inward and outward looking. Leary was also of a period where there was optimism about space exploration, and the possibility of making contact with other species, from Earth or beyond. Now we seem to find this idea kind of embarrassing, because the idea of explaining ourselves feels embarrassing. Which in a way is it’s own kind of constantly-reinforcing self-centeredness.
There’s nothing more self-centered in the irritating way than how psychedelics as self-help, a “miracle” mental illness cure, the one weird trick to go 10x or come up with that sick disruptive business deal or chill out your bitch wife, have kind of become mainstream now. It’s all very inward-looking to the point that there’s nothing besides inward-ness. What’s the point of a honed mind if you can’t, like the king of swords, point it outwards?
tgt_seg:
3月4日——宝剑国王，象征理性驱动、思维清晰，呼唤权威与果断行动。这是一种鼓励积极进取的能量。
蒂莫西·利里（Timothy Leary）无疑是一位极具理性驱动力的人物，尽管他更倾向于“质疑权威”的立场。同样地，他提出的“意识八回路模型”在科学界普遍被认为缺乏足够的实证支持。然而，话又说回来……目前又有哪种关于意识的模型真正具备完整的科学可信度呢？尽管我们所接收到的一切“信息”都依赖于意识，但意识本身的本质依然模糊不清，更不用说是否存在某种系统性的运作机制了。
我认为，构想一种既关注内在又面向外在的多维度意识模型，是非常有启发性的。利里所处的时代正值人们对太空探索充满乐观，相信有可能与地球以外的生命建立联系。而如今，我们却似乎对这种想法感到尴尬，因为解释“我们自己”这件事本身让人觉得难堪。某种程度上，这恰恰体现出一种不断自我强化的自我中心倾向。
如今，迷幻剂被广泛宣传为自我提升的工具、治愈精神疾病的“奇迹”疗法、提升十倍效率的奇招，甚至是解决婚姻问题的偏方，这些趋势已逐渐成为主流。然而，没有什么比这种极度内向、以自我为中心的视角更令人不适的了。一切似乎只剩下对内心的凝视，而如果无法像宝剑国王那样，将一个经过锤炼的敏锐头脑投向外部世界，那么再清晰的思维又有何意义呢？

src_seg:
March 5 - Five of Pentacles... A difficult situation, struggle, financial insecurity.
Infrastructure... precisely that thing it never feels like there's enough cash for. ESPECIALLY in tech, where it always flows towards hype and disruption rather than maintaining what already exists.
The Internet is so huge, has such great practical benefits, and is an important part of so many peoples' lives, that of course we want the infrastructure maintained, and there to be good governance... Maybe it was the hype of the Internet itself that allowed some of these early gestures towards standardization and productive ground rules to stick.
Though there are a ton of tech corporations involved, a surprising amount was also done via the US Department of Defense directly, and now a lot of the corporations (ex- Don't Be Evil Google, for example) are chipping away at the principles they once helped set up... Whose infrastructure? It's always tied to governance, and always ideological. Be careful who you go asking for cash when you're broke...
tgt_seg:
3月5日——“五芒星”牌，象征着困境、挣扎与财务上的不确定性。  
基础设施……恰恰就是那种永远让人觉得资金不足、难以维持的领域。尤其是在科技领域，资金总是流向那些充满噱头、具有颠覆性的项目，而非用于维护已有的系统与结构。  
互联网规模庞大、效益显著，且已成为许多人生活中不可或缺的一部分，因此我们当然希望其基础设施能得到妥善维护，并建立起良好的治理机制……也许正是互联网本身的炒作热潮，才使得一些早期关于标准化与基础规则的尝试得以坚持下来。  
尽管有许多科技公司参与其中，但令人惊讶的是，美国国防部其实也直接承担了许多相关工作。如今，许多公司（比如曾经宣称“不作恶”的谷歌）正在逐渐背离自己曾经帮助建立的原则……基础设施究竟属于谁？它总是与治理机制紧密相关，也永远带有意识形态色彩。当你身无分文时，务必谨慎选择向谁求助……

src_seg:
March 6 - DEATH!! An inevitable and total transformation, possibly painful, but not necessarily The End...
A lot of anti-tech sentiment seems to wish that we could just put certain things back in the box. But the world where the technology that provides connection and access to information was entangled by its maybe well-intentioned originators with military and surveillance culture, game theory and bombs, is the world we have.
I always found the PVP gimmick for MGSV's online mode to be weirdly inspiring... if we want to live in a world without the atomic bomb, it'll have to be one where we took them all apart with our own hands. And it'll be one where the knowledge that it was made at one time will also always be a thing. How we frame it is up to us... there is no going back. How terrifying, how wonderful.
tgt_seg:
3月6日——死亡！！一种不可避免且彻底的转变，或许充满痛苦，但未必意味着终结……
许多反科技的情绪似乎希望我们能将某些技术重新“封存”起来。然而，现实世界正是如此：那些最初或许怀着善意的技术创造者，将原本用于连接与信息获取的科技，与军事、监控文化、博弈论乃至炸弹紧密纠缠在了一起。这便是我们所生活的世界。
我始终觉得，《合金装备V》在线模式中的PVP（玩家对战）机制，虽然奇特，却意外地令人深思与鼓舞……如果我们希望生活在一个没有原子弹的世界，那这个世界必须是由我们亲手将所有核武器彻底拆除后的结果。而在那个世界里，“人类曾制造过原子弹”这一事实与知识，也将永远留存。如何诠释这段历史，取决于我们自己……我们已无法回头。多么令人畏惧，又多么令人惊叹。

src_seg:
I idly proposed doing this yesterday so for March I will be posting one card I draw fom Suzanne Treister's Hexen 2.0 Tarot Deck per day of March.
The deck consists of all the major and minor arcana depicted by alchemical drawings of people and things from the history of technology, or, more specifically, "the scientific underpinnings of what Michel Foucault called bio-political governance."
Why? Because I actually have to do some tech-related talks this month, and also with the dark side of tech being so blatant lately, I felt the need to think about it more, and explore my associations/values etc!
tgt_seg:
昨天我随口提议要做这件事，所以三月份我将每天发布一张我从苏珊娜·特雷斯特的Hexen 2.0塔罗牌组中抽取的卡片。
这副牌包含了所有大阿卡纳和小阿卡纳，牌面由炼金术风格的绘画构成，描绘了科技史中的人物和事物，或者更具体地说，是“米歇尔·福柯所谓的生物政治治理的科学基础”。
为什么？因为这个月我确实要做一些与科技相关的讲座，而且最近科技的阴暗面如此昭然若揭，我觉得有必要对此进行更深入的思考，并探索我的联想/价值观等！

src_seg:
March 1 - Starting with the 10 of Wands, typically representing overload, burden.
Here it is represented by a variety of early computing projects, many subsidized by their respective governments.
I think of how before a computer or calculator was a thing it was a job. Even after they existed, people still had to mediate, calculate, punch cards, interpret, etc. And in my own work I still often feel like a babysitter of inflexible computational quirks... why can't the spreadsheet software, or CMS, or database just do that mind-numbingly boring and burdensome stuff for me?
I also think how, even if it's built on what were once dull analog tasks, it's not -exactly- the same though, is it? In middle school computer lab I was taught a bit of BASIC, and being able to make a simple text "frogger" or branching adventure program, even if they were super rudimentary, was more compelling for some reason than imagining them or drawing them in a notebook... the sort of action at a delay/distance that computing offers, or that is computing's illusion...
tgt_seg:
三月一日 - 从权杖十开始，这张牌通常代表超负荷和负担。
在这里，它由各种早期的计算项目来代表，其中许多项目都得到了各自政府的资助。
我想到在计算机或计算器成为一种东西之前，它是一份工作。即使在它们存在之后，人们仍然必须进行调解、计算、打孔、解释等。在我自己的工作中，我仍然经常感觉像是在照看不灵活的计算怪癖的保姆...为什么电子表格软件、内容管理系统或数据库不能为我做那些令人头脑麻木的繁重事务呢？
我也想到，即便这些技术是建立在曾经枯燥的模拟任务之上，它们也并不完全相同，不是吗？在中学的计算机实验室里，我学了一点 BASIC 编程，能够制作一个简单的文本版“青蛙过河”或分支冒险程序，即使它们非常初级，但某种原因让我觉得比在笔记本上构思或绘制它们更有吸引力……那种计算所提供的延迟/远程行动，或者说，是计算所制造的幻觉……

src_seg:
March 2 - 9 of Swords... following on from the feelings of overload and burden yesterday, this card represents nightmares and anxiety about the future.
Appropriately it's represented here by The Tavistock Institute of Human Relations, a UK governmental body established in 1946 that acted regionally, nationally, and internationally for “the social engagement of social sciences” or more bluntly, using theoretical methods to “change behavior in groups and civilian populations.”
Obviously the name Tavistock brings to mind the overbearing interference of the UK government in constantly trying to block any sort of trans care, or only dispensing it as a last resort after you’ve gone through years of waiting around and a thorough psychiatric probing. A population where everyone just conformed to the two standard cis gender roles would indeed be much easier to control, so to a “Labour” government obsessed with means testing, pathologizing and cutting benefits, it’s of course desirable to treat “normality” as a virtue and any difference as disease to eliminate.
I could talk about so many things, the awful CBT and soft conversion therapy I’ve personally received in the UK, how state surveillance and punishment disproportionately targets autistic people, how even punitive and inadequate psychological care is too hard to access, how outcomes are measured in “productivity” rather than happiness. A tendency that is not technic in the big machines or internet enabled devices way, but has infested every aspect of life as much as people fear tiktok attention spans have; people I want to ally with constantly crowing “just be normal” or getting sucked down a health and fitness grifthole.
An exhausting and sad card. I’ll be honest, I almost put it back when I pulled it lol. But obviously a big part of contemporary technological thought nevertheless.
tgt_seg:
三月二日 - 宝剑九……继昨天的超负荷和负担感之后，这张牌代表着对未来的噩梦和焦虑。
恰如其分地，它在这里由塔维斯托克人类关系研究所代表，这是一个于1946年成立的英国政府机构，在地区、国家和国际层面为“社会科学的社会参与”而行动，或者更直白地说，是利用理论方法来“改变团体和平民的行为”。
显然，塔维斯托克这个名字让人联想到英国政府的专横干预，他们不断试图阻挠任何形式的跨性别关怀，或者只有在你经历了数年的等待和彻底的精神病学探查后，才作为最后手段提供。一个所有人都遵循两种标准顺性别角色的群体确实更容易控制，因此，对于一个痴迷于经济状况调查、病态化和削减福利的“工党”政府来说，将“正常”视为美德，将任何差异视为需要消除的疾病，当然是可取的。
我可以谈论很多事情，比如我在英国亲身经历的可怕的认知行为疗法和软性扭转治疗，国家监控和惩罚如何不成比例地针对自闭症患者，即使是惩罚性的、不充分的心理关怀也难以获得，以及结果如何以“生产力”而非幸福来衡量。这种趋势并非体现在大型机器或互联网设备的技术层面，而是像人们担心TikTok影响注意力时长一样，已经渗透到生活的方方面面；那些我想与之结盟的人却不断鼓吹“正常点”，或者陷入健康和健身的骗局中。
一张令人精疲力竭和悲伤的牌。说实话，抽到它的时候我差点就把它放回去了，哈哈。但显然，它仍然是当代科技思想的重要组成部分。

src_seg:
March 3 - The Star, hope, inspiration, future goals. A much more positive card than we've had so far!
But it's hard to feel positive about the massively exploitative and yet still totally underwhelming reality of artifical intelligence and quantum computing hype at the moment. The idea of an omnipotent computer, that could, indeed, simulate or work at an atomic or subatomic level, has kind of been the great dream of computing for a long time. It's almost a philosopher's stone type of thing.
Yesterday I reread this great essay on the current generative AI models by Hito Steyerl (https://newleftreview.org/issues/ii140/articles/hito-steyerl-mean-images). She does a great job of going into how reliant these systems still are on human-made images, cleaned data, and ongoing human moderation at every level, but she also makes the observation that while their outputs masquerade as bits of text or images, which people wrongly attribute intention or creativity to, they're really statistical representations, with all of the inherent ideology and limitations of statistics baked in.
What would a truly intelligent computer capable of expanding our analytical powers and relieving the burden of tedious labor and the risks of incomplete information look like, and under what context would it be used to reinvent life towards more autonomy and joy rather than accelerating exploitation and control? Can we hope for such a thing with IBM and DARPA still in the picture...?

我总觉得《合金装备5》在线模式的PVP机制有种奇异的启发性……如果我们想生活在一个没有原子弹的世界里，那这个世界必须是我们亲手将所有原子弹拆除的世界。而且在这个世界里，原子弹曾被制造出来的这一认知也将永远存在。我们如何看待它取决于我们自己……没有回头路可走。多么可怕，又多么美妙。

src_seg:
March 1 - Starting with the 10 of Wands, typically representing overload, burden.

tgt_seg:
3月1日 - 从十根杖开始，通常代表过载、负担。
它被早期计算机项目所代表，许多项目都是由各自政府补贴的。
我想起以前，计算机或计算器还不存在时，计算工作是需要付费的。即使计算机和计算器存在了，人们仍然需要进行中介、计算、输入卡片、解释等工作。 在我的工作中，我经常感到自己像照顾孩子一样照顾计算机的僵硬的特性... 为什么电子表格软件、CMS 或数据库不能为我完成那些令人昏昏欲睡的枯燥乏味的工作呢?
