There are plenty of cheap N64 imitation controllers, but the three-pronged original was an objectively bad design. I could play N64 games with a modern controller using clever configuration to make the face buttons function as C-buttons, but it's not the same for so many reasons.
I got the RetroFighters Brawler 64 to solve this anachronistic conundrum, and it's gone above and beyond my expectations. It was made to mimic the official NSO N64 controller down to the Switch recognizing it as one, with a toggle to make it register as a Pro controller sans right-stick.
It has some problems, but between its layout and compatibility it solves way more problems the official version has. It's perfect for showing someone N64 emulation without the intimidation of the original or the anachronism from finagling a modern controller to work the same.
It's very good at what it's trying to do.
tgt_seg:
找一个现代化的N64手柄有多难？
有很多便宜的N64仿制手柄，但三叉原版客观上是一个糟糕的设计。我可以用现代手柄通过巧妙配置让面键充当C键来玩N64游戏，但由于很多原因这不一样。
我买了RetroFighters Brawler 64来解决这个时代错误的难题，它超出了我的期望。它被制作来模仿官方NSO N64手柄，Switch甚至将其识别为一个，有一个切换开关让它注册为没有右摇杆的Pro手柄。
它有一些问题，但在布局和兼容性之间，它解决了官方版本的更多问题。它非常适合向某人展示N64模拟，没有原版的威胁感或让现代手柄以同样方式工作的时代错误感。
它在试图做的事情上非常出色。

src_seg:
I got this steam controller from a pawn shop after negotiating the price down shortly after the fire sale came to an end on steam. It needed some TLC, and I did what I could to get it up and running again.
It remains one of the most customizable controllers in my collection, with a unique [if questionable] design and features ahead of it's time (gyro aim, back paddles, haptic feedback, etc). It has some problems though; It requires AAs, uses Micro-USB for wired connections, occasionally turns itself back on after being turned off, the back paddles are stiff enough to cause fatigue, the thumbstick cap is necessary since the rubber on it is deteriorating, and it's functionality tends to fluctuate with every update to steam input.
It's more of a unique historical artifact than a regularly used input, but it's a welcome addition and fun to tinker with on rainy days.
It also isn't my number 2 pick, that honour goes to the fact that...
tgt_seg:
我在Steam大甩卖结束后不久从当铺以谈判价格买到了这个Steam手柄。它需要一些修理，我尽我所能让它重新运行。
它仍然是我收藏中最可定制的手柄之一，具有独特（如果有问题的话）设计和超前的功能（陀螺瞄准，背部拨片，触觉反馈等）。但它有一些问题；它需要AA电池，有线连接使用Micro-USB，偶尔在关闭后会自己重新打开，背部拨片足够硬以致疲劳，摇杆帽是必需的因为上面的橡胶在恶化，它的功能往往随着Steam输入的每次更新而波动。
它更像是一个独特的历史文物而不是常规使用的输入设备，但它是一个受欢迎的补充，在雨天很有趣。
它也不是我的第二选择，这个荣誉归于...

src_seg:
The 8BitDo Ultimate Bluetooth controller is an almost perfect controller.
Hall-effect sticks, included charging dock that doubles as a port for the included dongle, dedicated 2.4ghz/bluetooth toggle switch, NS Pro layout with a much improved D-pad, analog triggers, and programmable back paddles. When I sit down on a couch with this controller, I can swap between a Steam Deck and a Switch faster than the time it takes the TV to switch inputs.
It does have some drawbacks though: It only does X/Switch signals (no android or apple modes), the triggers are uncomfortable, and input lag seems to be affected by the time it took to connect to the dongle/switch.
I thought this was the best it could get, but like my time with Xbox controllers I was operating on assumptions that started to sound like old brand loyalty reflexes coming back. What I'd hoped to upgrade it to was such a disappointment it swiftly shook me from those assumptions.
tgt_seg:
8BitDo Ultimate蓝牙手柄是一个几乎完美的手柄。
霍尔效应摇杆，包含充电底座兼作包含适配器的端口，专用2.4ghz/蓝牙切换开关，NS Pro布局配有大大改进的方向键，模拟扳机，以及可编程背部拨片。当我拿着这个手柄坐在沙发上时，我可以在Steam Deck和Switch之间切换，比电视切换输入的时间还快。
但它确实有一些缺点：它只支持X/Switch信号（没有安卓或苹果模式），扳机不舒服，输入延迟似乎受到连接到适配器/switch所需时间的影响。
我以为这已经是最好的了，但就像我使用Xbox手柄的经历一样，我的假设开始听起来像是回归的旧品牌忠诚反射。我希望升级到的东西是如此令人失望，以至于迅速将我从这些假设中摇醒。

src_seg:
Even though I've mostly transitioned to PC gaming over the past decade, my preferred peripherals are still controllers.
I understand the advantages of KB+M play, but as someone who already uses those tools for work I find picking up a controller helps separate the two activities and gives my wrists a break. I've also been playing video games long enough to see the technology and layouts used drastically change, though some first party controllers seem to have stagnated a bit.
I recently found a controller I really liked because it has features that have really impressed me enough to want to talk about it at length, but to do that I feel the need for some context; not a whole history lesson, just a little stroll through my collection of controllers that materialized over a lifetime of engaging in this hobby.
By the end I hope you'll understand why this is a topic I care so much about I'd spend all day talking about these devices.
tgt_seg:
虽然过去十年我主要玩的是电脑游戏，但我仍然更喜欢使用手柄。
我知道键盘和鼠标在游戏中的优势，但由于我平时工作已经需要使用这些工具，所以玩游戏时使用手柄可以很好地将工作和娱乐区分开，而且还能让我的手腕得到休息。此外，我已经玩游戏很久了，见证了游戏技术和手柄设计的巨大变化，不过，有些官方手柄的设计似乎有些停滞不前。
最近，我发现了一款我很喜欢的手柄，它的某些功能让我印象深刻，以至于我想详细地谈谈它。但为了更好地介绍它，我觉得有必要先介绍一下我的手柄收藏，毕竟这些手柄是我多年游戏生涯中积累下来的。
希望通过我的介绍，你们能理解为什么我对这个话题如此感兴趣，甚至愿意花一整天的时间来讨论这些设备。

src_seg:
My decision to build up a PC game collection started during the transition between the Xbox 360 and the Xbox One; I thoroughly enjoyed the 360, but the One was looking like a disaster. Since the new consoles from all three major companies held little interest and I'd been in school for Computer Information Systems, I got myself a 360 pc dongle and resolved to make the switch.
Each of these controllers saw extensive use, and the 360 had the asymmetrical stick placement I preferred. All but two of the controllers in this picture are currently unusable either from loose/drifting sticks, faulty buttons, or failing cables/connections; both of the working ones are 3rd party Afterglows (which have their own problems).
As much as I loved these controllers, the official ones were the worst in terms of durability, and some were faulty from day one but Microsoft would refuse my RMA request.
It got worse when I tried the most expensive one.
tgt_seg:
我开始收藏PC游戏，源于从Xbox 360过渡到Xbox One期间。我很喜欢Xbox 360，但Xbox One的表现却令人失望。由于当时三大游戏厂商推出的新款游戏机都没能引起我的兴趣，而且我还在学习计算机信息系统，所以我买了一个Xbox 360的适配器，并决定转向PC游戏。
这些手柄都得到了广泛的使用，而且Xbox 360的手柄布局（摇杆位置）是我最喜欢的。除了照片中这几个手柄之外，其他的都已经无法使用了，原因包括摇杆松动/漂移、按键失灵或线缆/连接出现问题。而其中仅有的两个还能正常使用的手柄，都是第三方品牌“Afterglow”（但它们也有各自的问题）。
虽然我很喜欢这些手柄，但官方手柄的耐用性最差，有些甚至从一开始就有问题，但微软却拒绝了我的退货申请。
情况变得更糟，当我尝试使用最昂贵的那款手柄时。

src_seg:
There was a time when I fell for the myth that "You get what you pay for" was as true for expensive stuff as it was for cheap stuff; it's because of this controller that I know better. I got this Elite Series 2 controller despite knowing the first iteration had some serious flaws.
That controller lasted just under a year before the stick drift started to set in, and the right bumper only registered half of the time. The cable it came with sucks ass, never worked with any other controllers. The lag from using bluetooth was so bad the dongle was practically necessary. On top of all that, the back paddles didn't work no matter what software/drivers I used, none of my games ever read those paddles as an inputs.
The Raikiri Pro (was bundled with a laptop) is my current dedicated desktop controller and it works fine [for now], but I will never spend another dime on Official Xbox branded controllers. Fuck Microsoft, I hope Xbox rots!
tgt_seg:
我曾经相信“一分钱一分货”这个说法，认为无论便宜还是昂贵的商品，都适用这个原则。但这款手柄让我彻底改变了看法。尽管我知道第一代产品存在一些严重问题，但我还是购买了这款Elite Series 2手柄。
这款手柄使用不到一年，就开始出现摇杆漂移的问题，而且右侧的肩键经常无法正常工作。它附带的线材质量很差，而且无法与其他手柄配合使用。使用蓝牙连接时，延迟非常严重，几乎必须使用适配器。更糟糕的是，无论我使用什么软件或驱动程序，手柄背面的额外按键都无法正常工作，我的游戏也无法识别这些按键。
我现在使用的是Raikiri Pro（随笔记本电脑一起购买），它是我的专用桌面手柄，目前使用起来还不错，但以后我再也不会花一分钱购买官方Xbox品牌的手柄了。去你的微软，希望Xbox早点完蛋！

src_seg:
The Nintendo Switch reignited my love for portable gaming after years of surviving out of crappy laptops. The joycons were small but versatile, and the pro controller felt really comfortable in the hands.
I loved these controllers so much I modified them and swapped in hall-effect sticks [and metal latches] this past year, and while I'm well aware of the drift issue, mine have worked flawlessly since 2017 with no signs of wearing out. I've put just as many hours into these controllers as I did all those Xbox controllers; either I got very lucky or microsoft designs their controllers to fail faster than both of their competitors combined. Nintendo's offerings have some drawbacks, but the fact it's additional features like Gyro input have been officially supported is noteworthy.
I hope to keep these controllers working for as long as they continue to be supported on other platforms; there are many like them, but these ones are mine.
tgt_seg:
在经历了多年使用性能不佳的笔记本电脑之后，任天堂Switch重新点燃了我对掌机游戏的热爱。Switch的Joy-Con手柄虽然小巧，但功能非常多样，而且Pro手柄握起来非常舒适。
我非常喜欢这些手柄，去年我还对它们进行了改装，更换了霍尔效应摇杆[以及金属卡扣]。虽然我知道“摇杆漂移”问题，但我的手柄自2017年以来一直运行良好，而且没有任何磨损迹象。我使用这些手柄的时间和使用所有Xbox手柄的时间一样长；要么我很幸运，要么微软的设计让他们的手柄比竞争对手更快损坏。任天堂的产品虽然有一些缺点，但官方支持诸如陀螺仪输入等附加功能，这一点值得称赞。
我希望这些手柄能够继续使用，只要它们仍然可以在其他平台上使用。虽然有很多类似的手柄，但这些手柄是属于我的。

src_seg:
A brief note on Play Station controllers to round out the 1st party lineup: I never liked them.
Dual Shock 1-3 felt exactly the same to me with exactly the same flaws: Oversized thumbsticks placed too close together, mushy face/shoulder/trigger buttons that seemed to wear out very quickly, and a D-pad that just felt wrong. Dual Shock 4 fixed a lot of problems, but introduced a bunch of new ones. I got a Dual Sense because some friends had a hard time with asymmetrical thumbsticks, and for some reason local stores were selling them for $20 less than DS4 controllers.
I don't really use this controller: Face buttons are spaced too far apart, my audio in/output keeps defaulting to the controller when it's connected, the bumpers are weirdly tall, and I keep accidentally pressing the track pad when trying to hit menu/share.
They are fine guest controllers that have come a long way in terms of design, but for me they're a novelty at best.
tgt_seg:
最后，我想简单谈谈PlayStation手柄，作为索尼自家产品的补充：我个人一直不太喜欢它们。
从Dual Shock 1到3，我感觉它们几乎没什么区别，而且都存在同样的问题：摇杆太大，而且位置太近，按键（包括面部按键、肩部按键和扳机按键）手感松软，而且很容易损坏，还有方向键，感觉很不舒服。Dual Shock 4虽然解决了一些问题，但也带来了一些新的问题。我买了Dual Sense，是因为有些朋友觉得非对称摇杆不太好用，而且不知什么原因，当地商店的Dual Sense手柄比Dual Shock 4手柄便宜20美元。
我不太常用这个手柄：面部按键之间的距离太远，而且每次连接手柄时，音频输入/输出都会自动切换到手柄，肩部按键也太高了，而且我经常会不小心按到触摸板，而我本来想按的是菜单/分享键。
它们作为备用手柄来说还不错，而且在设计方面也取得了很大的进步，但对我来说，它们最多只是一种新奇玩意。

src_seg:
8BitDo was my first foray into good 3rd party controllers. This original SN30 Pro (later versions have hall-effect sticks and do not come in the SNES colour scheme) remains one of my favourites because holding it is reminiscent of my first console, the SNES.
If I'm having a crappy day and need a nostalgic escape, this is the first controller I reach for. It has all the functionality of a Switch Pro controller, but compacted into a modernized rendition of the SNES controller, complete with concave X/Y + convex A/B buttons, and possibly the best D-pad I've ever used. It's got some minor problems, but it's been a constant source of comfort.
One day the sticks will fail, or the battery will discharge for the last time; but if it means getting one of the modern versions (with hall-effect sticks) and shell-swapping them, I'll do it when the time comes.
With such a connection, surely 8BitDo can't do better than this, right? Well...
tgt_seg:
8BitDo是我第一次购买的优质第三方游戏手柄。这款最初的SN30 Pro（后续版本采用了霍尔效应摇杆，并且没有推出SNES配色）至今仍是我最喜欢的手柄之一，因为它握在手里时，总能让我回忆起我第一台游戏机——SNES。
如果我心情不好，想找点怀旧的感觉，我首先就会拿起这款手柄。它具备了Switch Pro手柄的所有功能，但却以一种现代化的方式呈现了SNES手柄的经典设计，包括凹陷的X/Y键和凸起的A/B键，以及我用过的最好的方向键。虽然它有一些小缺点，但它一直是我放松心情的好帮手。
总有一天，摇杆会损坏，或者电池会彻底没电；但如果这意味着我需要购买新款（配备霍尔效应摇杆）并更换外壳，我也会在必要的时候这么做。
因为我对这款手柄有如此深厚的感情，8BitDo肯定不可能再推出比这款更好的产品了吧？嗯……

src_seg:
When I want the familiar comforts of the SN30 Pro but with all the features of a modern controller, the 8BitDo Pro 2 has been my multi-platform controller of choice.
Everything about this is a functional upgrade from the SN30 Pro: more comfortable grips, hall-effect sticks, analog triggers, programmable back paddles, a physical X/D/S/A mode toggle switch, and a [somewhat] easily replaceable battery with the option of using AAs in a pinch. I also sprung for the carrying case and the mobile phone holster, which doesn't see as much use with a phone (I don't trust its grip that much), but for more compact retro emulation handhelds, it can expand the list of playable games to include ones that need precise analog controls.
There's very few negatives I can say about this controller, but it sits at a close 3rd for favourite controller of my collection. I'll talk about my number 2 pick in a moment, but before that I need to talk about...
tgt_seg:
如果我既想要SN30 Pro那种经典的手感，又想体验现代手柄的所有功能，那么8BitDo Pro 2就是我首选的多平台手柄。
这款手柄在SN30 Pro的基础上进行了全面的升级：更舒适的握把、霍尔效应摇杆、模拟扳机、可编程的后置按钮、物理的X/D/S/A模式切换开关，以及[相对]容易更换的电池，并且在紧急情况下还可以使用AA电池。我还购买了它的收纳盒和手机支架，虽然手机支架的实用性不高（我不太信任它的固定效果），但对于那些更小巧的复古游戏掌机来说，它可以扩展游戏列表，让那些需要精确模拟控制的游戏也能玩。
这款手柄几乎没有缺点，而且在我所有的手柄中，它紧随其后，排名第三。我稍后会谈谈我的第二选择，但在那之前，我需要先谈谈……

tgt_seg:
现在要找到一款现代化的任天堂64（N64）手柄，难度有多大？
市面上有很多廉价的N64仿制手柄，但原版的三叉形手柄设计确实存在缺陷。虽然可以通过巧妙的设置，将现代手柄的按键映射为N64手柄的C键，从而玩N64游戏，但这在很多方面都无法达到原汁原味的效果。
为了解决这个问题，我购买了“RetroFighters Brawler 64”手柄，这款手柄超出了我的预期。它完美地模仿了任天堂官方的N64手柄，甚至能让Switch将其识别为官方手柄，并且还提供了一个切换选项，使其可以作为Pro手柄使用（但不包括右摇杆）。
这款手柄虽然也存在一些问题，但凭借其布局和兼容性，它解决了原版手柄所存在的大部分问题。它非常适合向别人展示N64模拟游戏，而无需让他们面对原版手柄的复杂操作，也不需要让他们费心去设置现代手柄以达到相同的游戏体验。
总而言之，这款手柄在它所追求的目标方面做得非常出色。

src_seg:
I got this steam controller from a pawn shop after negotiating the price down shortly after the fire sale came to an end on steam. It needed some TLC, and I did what I could to get it up and running again.
It remains one of the most customizable controllers in my collection, with a unique [if questionable] design and features ahead of it's time (gyro aim, back paddles, haptic feedback, etc). It has some problems though; It requires AAs, uses Micro-USB for wired connections, occasionally turns itself back on after being turned off, the back paddles are stiff enough to cause fatigue, the thumbstick cap is necessary since the rubber on it is deteriorating, and it's functionality tends to fluctuate with every update to steam input.
It's more of a unique historical artifact than a regularly used input, but it's a welcome addition and fun to tinker with on rainy days.
It also isn't my number 2 pick, that honour goes to the fact that...
tgt_seg:
这款Steam手柄是我在Steam清仓活动结束后不久，从一家二手店淘来的，当时我还成功地砍了价。它当时状况不太好，但我尽力把它修复并使其恢复正常使用。
它是我收藏中可定制性最高的控制器之一，设计独特（虽然有些古怪），并且拥有许多超前的特性（例如：陀螺仪瞄准、后置按钮、触觉反馈等）。不过，它也存在一些问题：需要使用AA电池、使用Micro-USB进行有线连接、有时会在关机后自行重启、后置按钮比较硬，容易导致疲劳、摇杆帽是必需品，因为原有的橡胶已经老化，而且每次Steam输入更新，它的功能都会受到影响。
它更像是一件具有历史意义的独特收藏品，而不是一个经常使用的控制器，但它确实是一个不错的补充，而且在下雨天摆弄它也很有趣。
而且，它也不是我最喜欢的第二款控制器，这个荣誉属于……

src_seg:

Hall-effect sticks, included charging dock that doubles as a port for the included dongle, dedicated 2.4ghz/bluetooth toggle switch, NS Pro layout with a much improved D-pad, analog triggers, and programmable back paddles. I thought this was the best it could get, but like my time with Xbox controllers I was operating on assumptions that started to sound like old brand loyalty reflexes coming back. What I'd hoped to upgrade it to was such a disappointment it swiftly shook me from those assumptions.
tgt_seg:
8BitDo Ultimate蓝牙手柄是一款近乎完美的控制器。
它配备了霍尔效应摇杆、集充电底座和适配器接口于一体的充电座、专用的2.4GHz/蓝牙切换开关、改进后的D-pad（方向键）、模拟扳机以及可编程的后置按钮。当我坐在沙发上使用这款手柄时，我可以比电视切换输入源的速度更快地在Steam Deck和Switch之间切换。
当然，它也存在一些缺点：它仅支持X/Switch模式（不支持安卓或苹果模式），扳机手感不佳，而且连接适配器/Switch所需的时间似乎会影响输入延迟。
我原本以为这款手柄已经达到了极致，但就像我使用Xbox手柄的经历一样，我开始受到一些先入为主的观念的影响，这些观念听起来就像是出于对某个品牌的忠诚。而我原本希望对其进行升级的想法却令人非常失望，这让我彻底摆脱了那些先入为主的观念。

src_seg:
Even though I've mostly transitioned to PC gaming over the past decade, my preferred peripherals are still controllers.
I understand the advantages of KB+M play, but as someone who already uses those tools for work I find picking up a controller helps separate the two activities and gives my wrists a break. I've also been playing video games long enough to see the technology and layouts used drastically change, though some first party controllers seem to have stagnated a bit.
I recently found a controller I really liked because it has features that have really impressed me enough to want to talk about it at length, but to do that I feel the need for some context; not a whole history lesson, just a little stroll through my collection of controllers that materialized over a lifetime of engaging in this hobby.
By the end I hope you'll understand why this is a topic I care so much about I'd spend all day talking about these devices.
tgt_seg: 尽管过去十年我主要转向了PC游戏，但我偏爱的外设仍然是手柄。我理解键盘+手写笔的优势，但作为一个已经在工作中使用这些工具的人，我发现拿起手柄有助于区分这两项活动，让我的手腕得到休息。我玩电子游戏的时间也足够长，见证了技术和布局的巨变，尽管一些第一方手柄似乎停滞不前。我最近发现了一款我非常喜欢的手柄，因为它的一些功能给我留下了深刻的印象，让我想好好聊聊它，但要做到这一点，我觉得有必要先了解一下背景；不是一整堂历史课，只是简单回顾一下我一生从事这项爱好过程中收集的手柄。最后，我希望你能理解为什么我如此关注这个话题，以至于我会花一整天的时间来谈论这些设备。

src_seg:
My decision to build up a PC game collection started during the transition between the Xbox 360 and the Xbox One; I thoroughly enjoyed the 360, but the One was looking like a disaster. Since the new consoles from all three major companies held little interest and I'd been in school for Computer Information Systems, I got myself a 360 pc dongle and resolved to make the switch.
Each of these controllers saw extensive use, and the 360 had the asymmetrical stick placement I preferred. All but two of the controllers in this picture are currently unusable either from loose/drifting sticks, faulty buttons, or failing cables/connections; both of the working ones are 3rd party Afterglows (which have their own problems).
As much as I loved these controllers, the official ones were the worst in terms of durability, and some were faulty from day one but Microsoft would refuse my RMA request.
It got worse when I tried the most expensive one.
tgt_seg: 我决定收藏PC游戏，是在Xbox 360和Xbox One的过渡期。我非常喜欢Xbox 360，但Xbox One看起来简直糟透了。由于三大主机厂商的新主机都没什么人气，而且我之前在学校学的是计算机信息系统专业，所以我买了个Xbox 360的PC手柄，决心换到Xbox One。这些手柄都用过，Xbox 360的摇杆不对称设计我很喜欢。图片中除了两个手柄外，其他的都无法使用，要么是因为摇杆松动/漂移，要么是按键故障，要么是线缆/连接故障；两个能用的都是第三方的Afterglows（它们也存在各自的问题）。虽然我很喜欢这些手柄，但官方的耐用性最差，有些手柄从第一天开始就出了问题，但微软拒绝了我的退货授权申请。当我试用最贵的那个时，情况更糟了。

src_seg:
There was a time when I fell for the myth that "You get what you pay for" was as true for expensive stuff as it was for cheap stuff; it's because of this controller that I know better. I got this Elite Series 2 controller despite knowing the first iteration had some serious flaws.
That controller lasted just under a year before the stick drift started to set in, and the right bumper only registered half of the time. The cable it came with sucks ass, never worked with any other controllers. The lag from using bluetooth was so bad the dongle was practically necessary. On top of all that, the back paddles didn't work no matter what software/drivers I used, none of my games ever read those paddles as an inputs.
The Raikiri Pro (was bundled with a laptop) is my current dedicated desktop controller and it works fine [for now], but I will never spend another dime on Official Xbox branded controllers. Fuck Microsoft, I hope Xbox rots!
tgt_seg: 曾经有一段时间，我迷信“一分钱一分货”这个说法，贵的和便宜的都一样；正是因为这个手柄，我才更加明白这一点。尽管我知道第一代精英系列手柄存在一些严重的缺陷，我还是买了它。这个手柄用了不到一年，摇杆就开始漂移，右保险杠也只有一半的时间能正常使用。它自带的线材简直烂透了，根本没法和其他手柄兼容。蓝牙延迟太严重了，几乎得用转接器。更糟糕的是，无论我用什么软件/驱动程序，后拨片都无法工作，我的游戏也从来没把这些拨片当成输入信号。Raikiri Pro（笔记本电脑随机附赠）是我目前专用的桌面手柄，目前用起来还不错，但我再也不会花一分钱买Xbox官方品牌的手柄了。操微软，真希望Xbox烂透了！

src_seg:
The Nintendo Switch reignited my love for portable gaming after years of surviving out of crappy laptops. The joycons were small but versatile, and the pro controller felt really comfortable in the hands.
I loved these controllers so much I modified them and swapped in hall-effect sticks [and metal latches] this past year, and while I'm well aware of the drift issue, mine have worked flawlessly since 2017 with no signs of wearing out. I've put just as many hours into these controllers as I did all those Xbox controllers; either I got very lucky or microsoft designs their controllers to fail faster than both of their competitors combined. Nintendo's offerings have some drawbacks, but the fact it's additional features like Gyro input have been officially supported is noteworthy.
I hope to keep these controllers working for as long as they continue to be supported on other platforms; there are many like them, but these ones are mine.
tgt_seg: 在我多年依赖蹩脚的笔记本电脑之后，任天堂 Switch 重新点燃了我对便携游戏的热爱。Joycon 虽小但功能多样，Pro 控制器握在手中感觉非常舒适。我太喜欢这些控制器了，以至于在过去的一年里对其进行了改装，换上了霍尔效应摇杆（和金属闩锁）。虽然我很清楚漂移问题，但我的控制器自 2017 年以来一直运行良好，没有磨损的迹象。我花在这些控制器上的时间与我花在所有 Xbox 控制器上的时间一样多；要么我非常幸运，要么微软设计的控制器比两个竞争对手的总和还要快失效。任天堂的产品有一些缺点，但值得注意的是，它的附加功能（如陀螺仪输入）已得到官方支持。我希望只要这些控制器在其他平台上继续受支持，它们就能一直工作；有很多类似的控制器，但这些是我的。

src_seg:
A brief note on Play Station controllers to round out the 1st party lineup: I never liked them.
Dual Shock 1-3 felt exactly the same to me with exactly the same flaws: Oversized thumbsticks placed too close together, mushy face/shoulder/trigger buttons that seemed to wear out very quickly, and a D-pad that just felt wrong. Dual Shock 4 fixed a lot of problems, but introduced a bunch of new ones. I got a Dual Sense because some friends had a hard time with asymmetrical thumbsticks, and for some reason local stores were selling them for $20 less than DS4 controllers.
I don't really use this controller: Face buttons are spaced too far apart, my audio in/output keeps defaulting to the controller when it's connected, the bumpers are weirdly tall, and I keep accidentally pressing the track pad when trying to hit menu/share.
They are fine guest controllers that have come a long way in terms of design, but for me they're a novelty at best.
tgt_seg: 关于第一方阵容的 PlayStation 手柄，简单说一下：我一直都不喜欢它们。Dual Shock 1-3 给我的感觉完全一样，而且也有一些缺点：摇杆尺寸过大，位置太近；面板/肩部/扳机键软塌塌的，而且很容易磨损；方向键感觉不太对劲。Dual Shock 4 修复了很多问题，但也带来了一些新问题。我买了一个 Dual Sense，因为一些朋友用不对称的摇杆感觉不太好，而且不知何故，当地商店的售价比 DS4 手柄低 20 美元。我不太常用这个手柄：面板按键间距太大；连接手柄后，我的音频输入/输出总是默认连接到手柄；保险杠高得离谱；而且我在点击菜单/分享时总是不小心按到触控板。它们是优秀的客制手柄，在设计方面取得了长足的进步，但对我来说，它们充其量只是个新奇玩意儿。

src_seg:
8BitDo was my first foray into good 3rd party controllers. This original SN30 Pro (later versions have hall-effect sticks and do not come in the SNES colour scheme) remains one of my favourites because holding it is reminiscent of my first console, the SNES.
If I'm having a crappy day and need a nostalgic escape, this is the first controller I reach for. It has all the functionality of a Switch Pro controller, but compacted into a modernized rendition of the SNES controller, complete with concave X/Y + convex A/B buttons, and possibly the best D-pad I've ever used. It's got some minor problems, but it's been a constant source of comfort.
One day the sticks will fail, or the battery will discharge for the last time; but if it means getting one of the modern versions (with hall-effect sticks) and shell-swapping them, I'll do it when the time comes.
With such a connection, surely 8BitDo can't do better than this, right? Well...
tgt_seg: 8BitDo 是我第一次尝试优质第三方控制器。这款初代 SN30 Pro（后续版本配备霍尔效应摇杆，并且没有 SNES 配色方案）仍然是我的最爱之一，因为拿着它让我想起了我的第一款游戏机 SNES。如果我过得很糟糕，需要怀旧一下，这就是我第一个想到的控制器。它具备 Switch Pro 控制器的所有功能，但却被精简成了 SNES 控制器的现代化版本，配有凹形 X/Y 按钮和凸形 A/B 按钮，以及可能是我用过的最好的方向键。它有一些小问题，但它一直是一个舒适的来源。总有一天，摇杆会失灵，或者电池会最后一次放电；但如果这意味着要买一个现代版本（带霍尔效应摇杆）并换壳，到时候我就会这么做。有了这样的连接，8BitDo 肯定也做不到比这更好了，对吧？嗯……

src_seg:
When I want the familiar comforts of the SN30 Pro but with all the features of a modern controller, the 8BitDo Pro 2 has been my multi-platform controller of choice.
Everything about this is a functional upgrade from the SN30 Pro: more comfortable grips, hall-effect sticks, analog triggers, programmable back paddles, a physical X/D/S/A mode toggle switch, and a [somewhat] easily replaceable battery with the option of using AAs in a pinch. I also sprung for the carrying case and the mobile phone holster, which doesn't see as much use with a phone (I don't trust its grip that much), but for more compact retro emulation handhelds, it can expand the list of playable games to include ones that need precise analog controls.
There's very few negatives I can say about this controller, but it sits at a close 3rd for favourite controller of my collection. I'll talk about my number 2 pick in a moment, but before that I need to talk about...
tgt_seg: 当我想要拥有 SN30 Pro 熟悉的舒适体验，同时又兼具现代手柄的所有功能时，八位堂 Pro 2 一直是我的多平台手柄之选。它的所有功能都比 SN30 Pro 有所提升：更舒适的握把、霍尔效应摇杆、模拟扳机键、可编程后拨片、物理 X/D/S/A 模式切换开关，以及（相对）易于更换的电池（必要时可以使用 AA 电池）。我还额外购买了便携包和手机皮套，虽然手机皮套用起来不太方便（我不太相信手机的握持手感），但对于更紧凑的复古模拟游戏掌机来说，它可以扩展可玩的游戏范围，包括需要精确模拟控制的游戏。关于这款手柄，我几乎没有什么缺点，但它在我的收藏中排名第三，位列最爱。稍后我会介绍我的第二选择，但在此之前，我需要先说说……

src_seg:
How hard is it to find a modernized N64 controller?
There are plenty of cheap N64 imitation controllers, but the three-pronged original was an objectively bad design. I could play N64 games with a modern controller using clever configuration to make the face buttons function as C-buttons, but it's not the same for so many reasons.
I got the RetroFighters Brawler 64 to solve this anachronistic conundrum, and it's gone above and beyond my expectations. It was made to mimic the official NSO N64 controller down to the Switch recognizing it as one, with a toggle to make it register as a Pro controller sans right-stick.
It has some problems, but between its layout and compatibility it solves way more problems the official version has. It's perfect for showing someone N64 emulation without the intimidation of the original or the anachronism from finagling a modern controller to work the same.
It's very good at what it's trying to do.
tgt_seg: 找到一款现代化的 N64 控制器有多难？市面上有很多便宜的 N64 仿制控制器，但原版的三叉戟设计客观上很糟糕。我可以用现代控制器玩 N64 游戏，通过巧妙的配置让面部按钮像 C 按钮一样工作，但由于很多原因，它还是不一样。我买了 RetroFighters Brawler 64 来解决这个不合时宜的难题，它的表现远远超出了我的预期。它模仿了官方的 NSO N64 控制器，甚至 Switch 都能识别，并带有一个开关可以将其注册为没有右摇杆的 Pro 控制器。它存在一些问题，但其布局和兼容性解决了官方版更多的问题。它非常适合向人们展示 N64 仿真，既没有原版控制器的威胁性，也没有用现代控制器来实现相同功能带来的不合时宜。它非常擅长它想要做的事情。

src_seg:
I got this steam controller from a pawn shop after negotiating the price down shortly after the fire sale came to an end on steam. It needed some TLC, and I did what I could to get it up and running again.
It remains one of the most customizable controllers in my collection, with a unique [if questionable] design and features ahead of it's time (gyro aim, back paddles, haptic feedback, etc). It has some problems though; It requires AAs, uses Micro-USB for wired connections, occasionally turns itself back on after being turned off, the back paddles are stiff enough to cause fatigue, the thumbstick cap is necessary since the rubber on it is deteriorating, and it's functionality tends to fluctuate with every update to steam input.
It's more of a unique historical artifact than a regularly used input, but it's a welcome addition and fun to tinker with on rainy days.
It also isn't my number 2 pick, that honour goes to the fact that...
tgt_seg: Steam 火爆促销结束后不久，我通过讨价还价从一家当铺淘到了这款 Steam 控制器。它需要一些精心呵护，我竭尽所能让它重新运转起来。它仍然是我收藏中可定制性最高的控制器之一，拥有独特（尽管存在疑问）的设计和超越时代的功能（陀螺仪瞄准、后拨片、触觉反馈等等）。不过它也存在一些问题：需要使用 AA 电池，使用 Micro-USB 进行有线连接，偶尔会在关闭后自动重启，后拨片过硬容易造成疲劳，摇杆帽必不可少，因为上面的橡胶正在老化，而且它的功能会随着 Steam 输入法的每次更新而波动。与其说它是一款常用的输入法，不如说它更像是一件独特的历史文物，但它是一个受欢迎的补充，在雨天摆弄它也很有趣。它也不是我的第二选择，我的第二选择归功于……

src_seg:
The 8BitDo Ultimate Bluetooth controller is an almost perfect controller.
Hall-effect sticks, included charging dock that doubles as a port for the included dongle, dedicated 2.4ghz/bluetooth toggle switch, NS Pro layout with a much improved D-pad, analog triggers, and programmable back paddles. When I sit down on a couch with this controller, I can swap between a Steam Deck and a Switch faster than the time it takes the TV to switch inputs.
It does have some drawbacks though: It only does X/Switch signals (no android or apple modes), the triggers are uncomfortable, and input lag seems to be affected by the time it took to connect to the dongle/switch.
I thought this was the best it could get, but like my time with Xbox controllers I was operating on assumptions that started to sound like old brand loyalty reflexes coming back. What I'd hoped to upgrade it to was such a disappointment it swiftly shook me from those assumptions.
tgt_seg: 8BitDo Ultimate 蓝牙控制器几乎是完美的控制器。它配备霍尔效应摇杆、可兼作随附加密狗端口的充电底座、专用的 2.4ghz/蓝牙拨动开关、带有改进的方向键的 NS Pro 布局、模拟扳机键和可编程后拨片。当我拿着这款控制器坐在沙发上时，我可以在 Steam Deck 和 Switch 之间切换，速度比电视切换输入的速度还快。但它也有一些缺点：它只接收 X/Switch 信号（没有安卓或苹果模式），扳机键不舒服，输入延迟似乎受到连接加密狗/开关所需时间的影响。我以为这是它能达到的最好水平，但就像我使用 Xbox 控制器时一样，我当时的一些假设听起来像是旧品牌忠诚度反射又回来了。我原本希望将它升级到现在，但却大失所望，它迅速地打消了我的这些假设。

tgt_seg:
我决定建立一个PC游戏收藏开始在Xbox 360和Xbox One之间的过渡期间;我非常喜欢360,但One看起来像是一场灾难.由于所有三大公司的新游戏机都很不感兴趣,我一直在计算机信息系统学校,我给自己买了一个360电脑关,并决定进行切换.
这些控制器都被广泛使用,而360有我喜欢的不对称的棒位置.这张照片中的所有控制器,除了两个,目前都无法使用,由于松散/漂移的棒,故障的按或故障的电缆/连接;两者都是第三方Afterglows (它们都有自己的问题).
尽管我很喜欢这些控制器, 官方的控制器在耐用性方面是最糟糕的,
当我尝试最昂贵的时,情况变得更糟.

有一段时间,我相信"你得到的是你付出的代价"的说法对昂贵的东西和便宜的东西同样是真实的;这是因为我更了解这个控制器.我买了这个精英系列2控制器,尽管我知道第一个代有严重的缺陷.
那个控制器用了不到一年的时间,然后棒漂移开始起作用,而右边的保险只能记录一半的时间. 它带来的电缆很糟糕,从来没有与其他控制器一起工作过. 使用蓝牙的延迟太糟糕了,实际上是必须的. 最重要的是,无论我使用什么软件/驱动程序,后面的都不起作用,我的任何游戏都没有把这些作为输入.
我目前的专用桌面控制器是Raikiri Pro (附带笔记本电脑), 目前还很好, 但我再也不会花一分钱买官方Xbox品牌控制器.

src_seg:
The Nintendo Switch reignited my love for portable gaming after years of surviving out of crappy laptops. The joycons were small but versatile, and the pro controller felt really comfortable in the hands.
I loved these controllers so much I modified them and swapped in hall-effect sticks [and metal latches] this past year, and while I'm well aware of the drift issue, mine have worked flawlessly since 2017 with no signs of wearing out. I've put just as many hours into these controllers as I did all those Xbox controllers; either I got very lucky or microsoft designs their controllers to fail faster than both of their competitors combined. Nintendo's offerings have some drawbacks, but the fact it's additional features like Gyro input have been officially supported is noteworthy.
I hope to keep these controllers working for as long as they continue to be supported on other platforms; there are many like them, but these ones are mine.
tgt_seg:
任天堂Switch重新点燃了我对便携式游戏的热爱, 在多年以后, 便携式电脑的运行一直很糟糕. 欢乐电脑虽然很小, 但又多功能, 专业控制器在手中感觉非常舒服.
我非常喜欢这些控制器,所以在过去的一年里,我修改了它们,并换成了大厅效应棒 (和金属锁),虽然我很清楚漂移问题,但自2017年以来,我的控制器工作完美,没有任何磨损的迹象.我花了和Xbox控制器一样多的时间在这些控制器上;要么我很幸运,要么微软设计他们的控制器比他们的竞争对手加起来更快失败.任天堂的产品有一些缺点,但它像Gyro输入这样的额外功能已经得到官方支持这一事实值得注意.
我希望这些控制器能在其他平台上继续运行,

src_seg:
A brief note on Play Station controllers to round out the 1st party lineup: I never liked them.
Dual Shock 1-3 felt exactly the same to me with exactly the same flaws: Oversized thumbsticks placed too close together, mushy face/shoulder/trigger buttons that seemed to wear out very quickly, and a D-pad that just felt wrong. Dual Shock 4 fixed a lot of problems, but introduced a bunch of new ones. I got a Dual Sense because some friends had a hard time with asymmetrical thumbsticks, and for some reason local stores were selling them for $20 less than DS4 controllers.
I don't really use this controller: Face buttons are spaced too far apart, my audio in/output keeps defaulting to the controller when it's connected, the bumpers are weirdly tall, and I keep accidentally pressing the track pad when trying to hit menu/share.
They are fine guest controllers that have come a long way in terms of design, but for me they're a novelty at best.
tgt_seg:
我从来不喜欢他们.
双冲击1-3对我来说感觉完全相同,但缺点完全相同:超大尺寸的指针放在太近,柔软的面部/肩膀/触发似乎很快就会磨损,D-pad感觉不好.双冲击4解决了很多问题,但引入了很多新问题.我买了双感觉,因为一些朋友很难使用不对称的指针,出于某种原因,当地商店的售价比DS4控制器低20美元.
我实际上并没有使用这个控制器:脸上的按太远,我的音频输入/输出在连接时一直默认是控制器,
对于我来说, 它们至少是新鲜事物.

src_seg:
8BitDo was my first foray into good 3rd party controllers. This original SN30 Pro (later versions have hall-effect sticks and do not come in the SNES colour scheme) remains one of my favourites because holding it is reminiscent of my first console, the SNES.
If I'm having a crappy day and need a nostalgic escape, this is the first controller I reach for. It has all the functionality of a Switch Pro controller, but compacted into a modernized rendition of the SNES controller, complete with concave X/Y + convex A/B buttons, and possibly the best D-pad I've ever used. It's got some minor problems, but it's been a constant source of comfort.
One day the sticks will fail, or the battery will discharge for the last time; but if it means getting one of the modern versions (with hall-effect sticks) and shell-swapping them, I'll do it when the time comes.
With such a connection, surely 8BitDo can't do better than this, right? Well...
tgt_seg:
8BitDo是我第一次接触到第三方控制器.这款原始的SN30 Pro (后来的版本有hall-effect棒,没有SNES配色方案) 仍然是我最喜欢的之一,因为它让我想起了我的第一个控制台SNES.
如果我有个糟糕的一天,需要一个怀旧的逃避,这是我达到的第一个控制器. 它有所有功能的Switch Pro控制器,但紧成SNES控制器的现代化版本,完整的形X/Y+凸的A/B按,可能是我使用过的最好的D-pad. 它有一些小问题,但它一直是舒适的来源.
但如果这意味着要买一个现代版本 (带有大厅效应的棒) 并换掉它们的外, 我会在时间到来时这样做.
有了这样的连接, 8BitDo一定不能做得更好,对吧?

src_seg:
When I want the familiar comforts of the SN30 Pro but with all the features of a modern controller, the 8BitDo Pro 2 has been my multi-platform controller of choice.
Everything about this is a functional upgrade from the SN30 Pro: more comfortable grips, hall-effect sticks, analog triggers, programmable back paddles, a physical X/D/S/A mode toggle switch, and a [somewhat] easily replaceable battery with the option of using AAs in a pinch. I also sprung for the carrying case and the mobile phone holster, which doesn't see as much use with a phone (I don't trust its grip that much), but for more compact retro emulation handhelds, it can expand the list of playable games to include ones that need precise analog controls.
There's very few negatives I can say about this controller, but it sits at a close 3rd for favourite controller of my collection. I'll talk about my number 2 pick in a moment, but before that I need to talk about...
tgt_seg:
8BitDo Pro 2一直是我最喜欢的多平台控制器.
这款SN30 Pro的功能升级了一切:更舒适的手柄,大厅效应棒,模拟触发器,可编程的后方,物理X/D/S/A模式切换开关,以及可以轻松更换的电池,可以在短时间内使用AAs.我还选择了携带箱子和手机,这与手机没有那么多用途 (我不太相信它的手柄),但对于更紧的复古仿真手持设备,它可以扩展可玩游戏列表,包括需要精确模拟控制的游戏.
对于这个控制器,我说的很少,但它是我收藏中最喜欢的第三个控制器. 我会在一会儿谈谈我的第二个选择,

src_seg:
How hard is it to find a modernized N64 controller?
There are plenty of cheap N64 imitation controllers, but the three-pronged original was an objectively bad design. I could play N64 games with a modern controller using clever configuration to make the face buttons function as C-buttons, but it's not the same for so many reasons.
I got the RetroFighters Brawler 64 to solve this anachronistic conundrum, and it's gone above and beyond my expectations. It was made to mimic the official NSO N64 controller down to the Switch recognizing it as one, with a toggle to make it register as a Pro controller sans right-stick.
It has some problems, but between its layout and compatibility it solves way more problems the official version has. It's perfect for showing someone N64 emulation without the intimidation of the original or the anachronism from finagling a modern controller to work the same.
It's very good at what it's trying to do.
tgt_seg:
找到一个现代化的N64控制器有多难?
有很多廉价的N64仿制控制器,但三角原始的设计是客观上很糟糕的.我可以用现代控制器玩N64游戏,使用聪明的配置使面部按作为C按,但由于很多原因,它不一样.
我买了RetroFighters Brawler 64来解决这个古老的难题, 它超出了我的预期. 它是为了模仿官方的NSO N64控制器,
它有一些问题,但在它的布局和兼容性之间,它解决了官方版本的更多问题. 它非常适合向某人展示N64仿真,而不会受到原始的恐吓或古主义,
它在做它想要做的事情上非常出色.

src_seg:
I got this steam controller from a pawn shop after negotiating the price down shortly after the fire sale came to an end on steam. It needed some TLC, and I did what I could to get it up and running again.
It remains one of the most customizable controllers in my collection, with a unique [if questionable] design and features ahead of it's time (gyro aim, back paddles, haptic feedback, etc). It has some problems though; It requires AAs, uses Micro-USB for wired connections, occasionally turns itself back on after being turned off, the back paddles are stiff enough to cause fatigue, the thumbstick cap is necessary since the rubber on it is deteriorating, and it's functionality tends to fluctuate with every update to steam input.
It's more of a unique historical artifact than a regularly used input, but it's a welcome addition and fun to tinker with on rainy days.
It also isn't my number 2 pick, that honour goes to the fact that...
tgt_seg:
需要一些TLC, 我尽我所能让它恢复运行.
它仍然是我收藏中最可定制的控制器之一,具有独特的 (如果有疑问) 设计和功能 (陀螺准,后方,触觉反等).它有一些问题;它需要AAs,使用Micro-USB进行有线连接,偶尔在关闭后会自行重新开启,后方足够硬以引起疲劳,指针盖是必要的,因为它上的正在恶化,它的功能倾向于随着每次更新到蒸汽输入而波动.
它更像是一个独特的历史文物而不是经常使用的输入, 但它是一个受欢迎的补充,
这也不是我的第二个选择, 荣誉归于事实...

src_seg:
The 8BitDo Ultimate Bluetooth controller is an almost perfect controller.
Hall-effect sticks, included charging dock that doubles as a port for the included dongle, dedicated 2.4ghz/bluetooth toggle switch, NS Pro layout with a much improved D-pad, analog triggers, and programmable back paddles. When I sit down on a couch with this controller, I can swap between a Steam Deck and a Switch faster than the time it takes the TV to switch inputs.
It does have some drawbacks though: It only does X/Switch signals (no android or apple modes), the triggers are uncomfortable, and input lag seems to be affected by the time it took to connect to the dongle/switch.
I thought this was the best it could get, but like my time with Xbox controllers I was operating on assumptions that started to sound like old brand loyalty reflexes coming back. What I'd hoped to upgrade it to was such a disappointment it swiftly shook me from those assumptions.
tgt_seg:
8BitDo终极蓝牙控制器是一个几乎完美的控制器.
霍尔效应棒,包括充电码头,可作为附带的关的端口,专用2.4ghz/蓝牙切换开关,NS Pro布局带有改进的D-pad,模拟触发器和可编程的后方.当我坐在沙发上使用这个控制器时,我可以在Steam Deck和Switch之间更快地切换,比电视切换输入所需的时间更快.
它确实有一些缺点:它只做X/Switch信号 (没有安卓或果模式),触发器是不舒服的,并且输入延迟似乎受到连接到dongle/switch所花费的时间的影响.
我认为这是最好的,但就像我在Xbox控制器的时代一样,我的假设开始听起来像旧品牌忠诚的反射回来.我希望将其升级为如此令人失望,它迅速让我摆脱了这些假设.

src_seg:
Even though I've mostly transitioned to PC gaming over the past decade, my preferred peripherals are still controllers.
I understand the advantages of KB+M play, but as someone who already uses those tools for work I find picking up a controller helps separate the two activities and gives my wrists a break. I've also been playing video games long enough to see the technology and layouts used drastically change, though some first party controllers seem to have stagnated a bit.
I recently found a controller I really liked because it has features that have really impressed me enough to want to talk about it at length, but to do that I feel the need for some context; not a whole history lesson, just a little stroll through my collection of controllers that materialized over a lifetime of engaging in this hobby.
By the end I hope you'll understand why this is a topic I care so much about I'd spend all day talking about these devices.
tgt_seg:
尽管过去十年我主要转向了 PC 游戏，但我仍然偏爱手柄。
我理解 KB+M 游戏的优势，但作为一名已经使用这些工具进行工作的人，我发现拿起手柄有助于区分这两种活动，并让我的手腕得到休息。我也玩游戏已经足够长的时间了，见证了技术和布局发生了巨大的变化，尽管一些第一方手柄似乎有点停滞不前。
最近我发现了一个非常喜欢的手柄，因为它具有一些真正让我印象深刻的功能，以至于我想详细谈论它，但为了做到这一点，我觉得需要一些背景信息；不是一篇完整的历史课程，而只是在从事这项爱好一生中收集的手柄中漫步一下。
到最后，我希望您能理解为什么这个话题对我来说如此重要，我会花一整天的时间来谈论这些设备。

src_seg:
My decision to build up a PC game collection started during the transition between the Xbox 360 and the Xbox One; I thoroughly enjoyed the 360, but the One was looking like a disaster. Since the new consoles from all three major companies held little interest and I'd been in school for Computer Information Systems, I got myself a 360 pc dongle and resolved to make the switch.
Each of these controllers saw extensive use, and the 360 had the asymmetrical stick placement I preferred. All but two of the controllers in this picture are currently unusable either from loose/drifting sticks, faulty buttons, or failing cables/connections; both of the working ones are 3rd party Afterglows (which have their own problems).
As much as I loved these controllers, the official ones were the worst in terms of durability, and some were faulty from day one but Microsoft would refuse my RMA request.
It got worse when I tried the most expensive one.
tgt_seg:
我建立 PC 游戏收藏的决定始于 Xbox 360 和 Xbox One 之间的过渡时期；我非常喜欢 360，但 One 看起来像是一场灾难。由于所有三家主要公司的新主机都没有引起我的兴趣，而且我一直在为计算机信息系统学习，所以我买了一个 360 PC 适配器，并决心做出改变。
这些手柄都得到了广泛的使用，360 手柄具有我偏好的不对称摇杆布局。这张图片中的所有手柄除了两个之外目前都无法使用，要么是摇杆松动/漂移，要么是按钮故障，要么是电缆/连接故障；这两个可以使用的都是第三方的 Afterglow（它们也有自己的问题）。
尽管我非常喜欢这些手柄，但官方手柄在耐用性方面是最差的，有些手柄从第一天开始就存在故障，但微软拒绝我的 RMA 请求。
当我尝试最昂贵的手柄时，情况变得更糟了。

src_seg:
There was a time when I fell for the myth that "You get what you pay for" was as true for expensive stuff as it was for cheap stuff; it's because of this controller that I know better. I got this Elite Series 2 controller despite knowing the first iteration had some serious flaws.
That controller lasted just under a year before the stick drift started to set in, and the right bumper only registered half of the time. The cable it came with sucks ass, never worked with any other controllers. The lag from using bluetooth was so bad the dongle was practically necessary. On top of all that, the back paddles didn't work no matter what software/drivers I used, none of my games ever read those paddles as an inputs.
The Raikiri Pro (was bundled with a laptop) is my current dedicated desktop controller and it works fine [for now], but I will never spend another dime on Official Xbox branded controllers. Fuck Microsoft, I hope Xbox rots!
tgt_seg:
曾经有一段时间，我信奉“你付多少钱就得到多少”的说法，对于昂贵的东西和便宜的东西都是如此；正因为有了这款手柄，我才意识到这并非事实。尽管我知道第一代存在一些严重的问题，我还是购买了这款 Elite Series 2 手柄。
这款手柄在使用不到一年时，摇杆漂移就开始出现，右侧肩部按钮只能注册到一半的时间。它附带的电缆简直一坨垃圾，无法与其他任何手柄配合使用。由于使用蓝牙的延迟非常糟糕，适配器几乎是必需的。更糟糕的是，无论我使用什么软件/驱动程序，背部拨片都无法工作，我的游戏从未将这些拨片识别为输入。
Raikiri Pro（与笔记本电脑捆绑）是我的当前专用桌面手柄，目前它运行良好[暂时]，但我永远不会再花一分钱购买官方 Xbox 品牌的控制器。去死吧微软，希望 Xbox 腐烂吧！

src_seg:
The Nintendo Switch reignited my love for portable gaming after years of surviving out of crappy laptops. The joycons were small but versatile, and the pro controller felt really comfortable in the hands.
I loved these controllers so much I modified them and swapped in hall-effect sticks [and metal latches] this past year, and while I'm well aware of the drift issue, mine have worked flawlessly since 2017 with no signs of wearing out. I've put just as many hours into these controllers as I did all those Xbox controllers; either I got very lucky or microsoft designs their controllers to fail faster than both of their competitors combined. Nintendo's offerings have some drawbacks, but the fact it's additional features like Gyro input have been officially supported is noteworthy.
I hope to keep these controllers working for as long as they continue to be supported on other platforms; there are many like them, but these ones are mine.
tgt_seg:
任天堂 Switch 在我多年来依靠糟糕的笔记本电脑生存之后，重新点燃了我对掌机游戏的喜爱。Joycons 尺寸小巧但用途广泛，Pro 控制器握在手中感觉非常舒适。
我非常喜欢这些手柄，以至于我过去一年对其进行了修改，并更换了霍尔效应摇杆[和金属卡扣]，虽然我非常清楚漂移问题，但自 2017 年以来，它们一直运行良好，没有磨损的迹象。我在这款手柄上投入的时间与我所有 Xbox 手柄上的时间一样长；要么我非常幸运，要么微软设计他们的手柄比他们的两个竞争对手更快地失效。任天堂的设备有一些缺点，但它添加的 Gyro 输入等功能得到了官方支持，这一点值得称赞。
我希望这些手柄能够继续在其他平台上得到支持，因为它们有很多类似的产品，但这些是我的。

src_seg:
A brief note on Play Station controllers to round out the 1st party lineup: I never liked them.
Dual Shock 1-3 felt exactly the same to me with exactly the same flaws: Oversized thumbsticks placed too close together, mushy face/shoulder/trigger buttons that seemed to wear out very quickly, and a D-pad that just felt wrong. Dual Shock 4 fixed a lot of problems, but introduced a bunch of new ones. I got a Dual Sense because some friends had a hard time with asymmetrical thumbsticks, and for some reason local stores were selling them for $20 less than DS4 controllers.
I don't really use this controller: Face buttons are spaced too far apart, my audio in/output keeps defaulting to the controller when it's connected, the bumpers are weirdly tall, and I keep accidentally pressing the track pad when trying to hit menu/share.

tgt_seg:
关于 PlayStation 手柄的简短说明，以完善第一方阵容：我从来不喜欢它们。
Dual Shock 1-3 对我来说感觉完全一样，并且存在完全相同的问题：过大的拇指摇杆放置得太近，按键/肩部/触发按钮松软，似乎很快就会磨损，并且 D 键感觉不对。Dual Shock 4 修复了许多问题，但又引入了许多新问题。我购买了 Dual Sense，因为一些朋友在使用不对称拇指摇杆时遇到了困难，而且由于某种原因，当地商店以 DS4 控制器少 20 美元的价格出售 Dual Sense。
我不太使用这款手柄：按键之间的间距太远，当我连接时，我的音频输入/输出会默认到手柄，挡板很奇怪地高，我总是意外地按下触摸板来尝试按下菜单/分享。
它们是过客控制器，在设计方面取得了很大的进步，但对我来说，它们最多只能算是新奇品。

src_seg:
8BitDo was my first foray into good 3rd party controllers. This original SN30 Pro (later versions have hall-effect sticks and do not come in the SNES colour scheme) remains one of my favourites because holding it is reminiscent of my first console, the SNES.
If I'm having a crappy day and need a nostalgic escape, this is the first controller I reach for. With such a connection, surely 8BitDo can't do better than this, right? Well...
tgt_seg:
8BitDo 是我进入优秀第三方手柄的首次尝试。这款原始的 SN30 Pro（后续版本具有霍尔效应摇杆，并且不提供 SNES 颜色方案）仍然是我最喜欢的之一，因为它握在手中让人想起我的第一款主机，SNES。
如果我心情不好，需要一种怀旧的逃避，我会首先伸手去拿这款手柄。它具有 Switch Pro 控制器的所有功能，但被压缩成 SNES 控制器的现代化版本，带有凹陷的 X/Y + 凸起的 A/B 按钮，并且可能是我用过的最好的 D 键。它有一些小问题，但它一直是舒适的源泉。
有一天摇杆会失效，或者电池会耗尽，但如果这意味着我能得到一个现代版本（具有霍尔效应摇杆）并更换外壳，那么到时我会这么做的。
有了这种联系，8BitDo 肯定无法做得比这更好，对吧？嗯...

src_seg:
When I want the familiar comforts of the SN30 Pro but with all the features of a modern controller, the 8BitDo Pro 2 has been my multi-platform controller of choice.
Everything about this is a functional upgrade from the SN30 Pro: more comfortable grips, hall-effect sticks, analog triggers, programmable back paddles, a physical X/D/S/A mode toggle switch, and a [somewhat] easily replaceable battery with the option of using AAs in a pinch. There's very few negatives I can say about this controller, but it sits at a close 3rd for favourite controller of my collection. I'll talk about my number 2 pick in a moment, but before that I need to talk about...
tgt_seg:
当我想体验 SN30 Pro 的熟悉舒适感，同时拥有现代控制器的所有功能时，8BitDo Pro 2 已经成为我首选的多平台控制器。
这款手柄的方方面面都是 SN30 Pro 的功能升级：更舒适的握把，霍尔效应摇杆，模拟触发器，可编程背部拨片，物理 X/D/S/A 模式切换开关，以及[某种程度上] 易于更换的电池，并且在紧急情况下可以使用 AA 电池。我还购买了携带盒和手机支架，后者与手机的使用频率不高（我不信任它的握力），但对于更紧凑的复古模拟掌机，它可以扩展可玩游戏列表，以包括需要精确模拟控制的游戏。
我很难说这款手柄有什么缺点，但它在我的收藏中最受欢迎的控制器中排第三位。我稍后会谈论我的第二名，但在那之前，我需要谈谈...

src_seg:
How hard is it to find a modernized N64 controller?
There are plenty of cheap N64 imitation controllers, but the three-pronged original was an objectively bad design. I could play N64 games with a modern controller using clever configuration to make the face buttons function as C-buttons, but it's not the same for so many reasons.
I got the RetroFighters Brawler 64 to solve this anachronistic conundrum, and it's gone above and beyond my expectations. It was made to mimic the official NSO N64 controller down to the Switch recognizing it as one, with a toggle to make it register as a Pro controller sans right-stick.
It has some problems, but between its layout and compatibility it solves way more problems the official version has. It's perfect for showing someone N64 emulation without the intimidation of the original or the anachronism from finagling a modern controller to work the same.
It's very good at what it's trying to do.
tgt_seg:
很难找到现代化的 N64 控制器吗？
有很多便宜的 N64 仿冒控制器，但三叉戟的原始设计是客观上糟糕的设计。我可以使用巧妙的配置来使面部按钮充当 C 按钮，从而使用现代控制器玩 N64 游戏，但这有很多原因都不一样。
我购买了 RetroFighters Brawler 64 来解决这个历史难题，它超出了我的期望。它被设计成模仿官方 NSO N64 控制器，甚至可以被 Switch 识别为其中一个，并且有一个切换开关，可以将其注册为 Pro 控制器，而无需右摇杆。
它有一些问题，但考虑到它的布局和兼容性，它解决了官方版本存在的问题更多。它非常适合向某人展示 N64 模拟器，而无需让他们感到害怕原始版本或通过调整现代控制器使其正常工作。
它非常擅长它所要做的。

src_seg:
I got this steam controller from a pawn shop after negotiating the price down shortly after the fire sale came to an end on steam. It needed some TLC, and I did what I could to get it up and running again.
It remains one of the most customizable controllers in my collection, with a unique [if questionable] design and features ahead of it's time (gyro aim, back paddles, haptic feedback, etc). It has some problems though; It requires AAs, uses Micro-USB for wired connections, occasionally turns itself back on after being turned off, the back paddles are stiff enough to cause fatigue, the thumbstick cap is necessary since the rubber on it is deteriorating, and it's functionality tends to fluctuate with every update to steam input.
It's more of a unique historical artifact than a regularly used input, but it's a welcome addition and fun to tinker with on rainy days.
It also isn't my number 2 pick, that honour goes to the fact that...
tgt_seg:
我在 Steam 销售结束后不久，从一家典当行以协商后的价格购买了这款 Steam 控制器。它需要一些 TLC，我尽我所能让它重新启动。
这款手柄仍然是我收藏中最具可定制性的手柄之一，它具有独特[如果有些可疑] 的设计和超前的功能（陀螺瞄准，背部拨片，触觉反馈等）。它也有一些问题；它需要 AA 电池，使用 Micro-USB 进行有线连接，偶尔在关闭后会重新打开，背部拨片太僵硬，以至于会造成疲劳，摇杆帽上的橡胶正在恶化，摇杆的功能会随着 Steam 输入的每次更新而波动。
它更像是一个独特的历史文物而不是一个常用的输入设备，但它是一个欢迎的补充，在雨天玩起来很有趣。
它也不是我的第二名，这个荣誉属于...

src_seg:
The 8BitDo Ultimate Bluetooth controller is an almost perfect controller.
Hall-effect sticks, included charging dock that doubles as a port for the included dongle, dedicated 2.4ghz/bluetooth toggle switch, NS Pro layout with a much improved D-pad, analog triggers, and programmable back paddles. When I sit down on a couch with this controller, I can swap between a Steam Deck and a Switch faster than the time it takes the TV to switch inputs.
It does have some drawbacks though: It only does X/Switch signals (no android or apple modes), the triggers are uncomfortable, and input lag seems to be affected by the time it took to connect to the dongle/switch.
I thought this was the best it could get, but like my time with Xbox controllers I was operating on assumptions that started to sound like old brand loyalty reflexes coming back. What I'd hoped to upgrade it to was such a disappointment it swiftly shook me from those assumptions.
tgt_seg:
8BitDo Ultimate 蓝牙控制器是一款近乎完美的控制器。
霍尔效应摇杆，包含的充电底座兼作包含适配器的端口，专用的 2.4ghz/蓝牙切换开关，NS Pro 布局，改进了 D 键，模拟触发器和可编程背部拨片。当我坐在沙发上使用这款手柄时，我可以比电视切换输入所需的时间更快地在 Steam Deck 和 Switch 之间切换。
它确实有一些缺点：它只能执行 X/Switch 信号（没有 android 或 apple 模式），触发器不舒服，并且输入延迟似乎受到连接适配器/切换所需时间的影响。
我曾经认为这已经是最好了，但就像我使用 Xbox 控制器的经历一样，我正在基于一些开始听起来像旧品牌忠诚度反射的假设来操作。我希望升级到的是如此令人失望，以至于它迅速让我摆脱了这些假设。

src_seg:
Even though I've mostly transitioned to PC gaming over the past decade, my preferred peripherals are still controllers.
I understand the advantages of KB+M play, but as someone who already uses those tools for work I find picking up a controller helps separate the two activities and gives my wrists a break. I've also been playing video games long enough to see the technology and layouts used drastically change, though some first party controllers seem to have stagnated a bit.
I recently found a controller I really liked because it has features that have really impressed me enough to want to talk about it at length, but to do that I feel the need for some context; not a whole history lesson, just a little stroll through my collection of controllers that materialized over a lifetime of engaging in this hobby.
By the end I hope you'll understand why this is a topic I care so much about I'd spend all day talking about these devices.
tgt_seg:
尽管过去十年我基本转向了PC游戏，但我最喜欢的外设仍然是游戏手柄。
我明白键鼠组合在游戏中的优势，但作为一个日常工作中已经使用这些工具的人，我觉得拿起手柄有助于区分工作和娱乐，也能让我的手腕得到休息。我玩电子游戏的时间足够长，见证了技术与布局的大幅演变，尽管一些第一方手柄似乎有些停滞不前。
我最近发现了一款我非常喜欢的手柄，它的一些功能给我留下了深刻印象，以至于我想要详细地谈论它。但在此之前，我觉得需要一些背景介绍；不是一堂完整的历史课，只是简单回顾一下我多年来收集的这些手柄。
希望到最后你能理解，为什么这个话题对我来说如此重要，以至于我愿意花一整天时间谈论这些设备。

src_seg:
My decision to build up a PC game collection started during the transition between the Xbox 360 and the Xbox One; I thoroughly enjoyed the 360, but the One was looking like a disaster. Since the new consoles from all three major companies held little interest and I'd been in school for Computer Information Systems, I got myself a 360 pc dongle and resolved to make the switch.
Each of these controllers saw extensive use, and the 360 had the asymmetrical stick placement I preferred. All but two of the controllers in this picture are currently unusable either from loose/drifting sticks, faulty buttons, or failing cables/connections; both of the working ones are 3rd party Afterglows (which have their own problems).
As much as I loved these controllers, the official ones were the worst in terms of durability, and some were faulty from day one but Microsoft would refuse my RMA request.
It got worse when I tried the most expensive one.
tgt_seg:
我开始建立PC游戏收藏的决定，是在Xbox 360和Xbox One之间过渡的时期做出的；我非常喜爱360，但One看起来却像一场灾难。由于三大厂商的新主机都提不起我的兴趣，而我又在学习计算机信息系统专业，于是我买了一个360 PC适配器，决定彻底转向PC。
这些手柄我都广泛使用过，360手柄的不对称摇杆布局是我偏爱的设计。这张照片中的手柄，除了两个还能用之外，其余的都因为摇杆松动/漂移、按键故障或线缆/连接问题而无法使用；那两个还能用的都是第三方Afterglow品牌（它们也有自己的问题）。
尽管我非常喜爱这些手柄，但官方出品的耐用性最差，有些甚至从第一天起就有问题，但微软却拒绝了我的退货请求。
当我尝试最贵的那款时，情况变得更糟。

src_seg:
There was a time when I fell for the myth that "You get what you pay for" was as true for expensive stuff as it was for cheap stuff; it's because of this controller that I know better. I got this Elite Series 2 controller despite knowing the first iteration had some serious flaws.
That controller lasted just under a year before the stick drift started to set in, and the right bumper only registered half of the time. The cable it came with sucks ass, never worked with any other controllers. The lag from using bluetooth was so bad the dongle was practically necessary. On top of all that, the back paddles didn't work no matter what software/drivers I used, none of my games ever read those paddles as an inputs.
The Raikiri Pro (was bundled with a laptop) is my current dedicated desktop controller and it works fine [for now], but I will never spend another dime on Official Xbox branded controllers. Fuck Microsoft, I hope Xbox rots!
tgt_seg:
曾经有一段时间，我深信“一分钱一分货”这个道理，无论是贵的东西还是便宜的东西都适用；但正是因为这款手柄，我改变了看法。我明知道第一代存在严重缺陷，还是购买了这款Elite Series 2手柄。
这款手柄使用了不到一年就开始出现摇杆漂移问题，右肩键只有半数时间能正常响应。它附带的线缆质量极差，从未与其他手柄兼容过。使用蓝牙时延迟严重，几乎必须依赖适配器。更糟糕的是，无论我使用什么软件或驱动，背后的拨片始终无法正常工作，我的游戏从未识别到这些拨片的输入。
Raikiri Pro（随笔记本电脑附送）是我目前专用的桌面手柄，目前还能正常使用[暂时]，但我再也不会花一分钱购买任何官方Xbox品牌的手柄了。去他的微软，希望Xbox彻底完蛋！

src_seg:
The Nintendo Switch reignited my love for portable gaming after years of surviving out of crappy laptops. The joycons were small but versatile, and the pro controller felt really comfortable in the hands.
I loved these controllers so much I modified them and swapped in hall-effect sticks [and metal latches] this past year, and while I'm well aware of the drift issue, mine have worked flawlessly since 2017 with no signs of wearing out. I've put just as many hours into these controllers as I did all those Xbox controllers; either I got very lucky or microsoft designs their controllers to fail faster than both of their competitors combined. Nintendo's offerings have some drawbacks, but the fact it's additional features like Gyro input have been officially supported is noteworthy.
I hope to keep these controllers working for as long as they continue to be supported on other platforms; there are many like them, but these ones are mine.
tgt_seg:
Nintendo Switch重新点燃了我对便携式游戏的热爱，结束了我多年依赖糟糕笔记本的日子。Joy-Con体积虽小但功能多样，Pro手柄握感也非常舒适。
我如此喜爱这些手柄，以至于今年对它们进行了改装，换上了霍尔效应摇杆[和金属卡扣]。尽管我清楚漂移问题的存在，但自2017年以来，我的Joy-Con一直运行良好，没有任何磨损迹象。这些手柄的使用时间与我之前那些Xbox手柄相当；要么是我运气太好，要么就是微软设计手柄时就打算让它们比竞争对手更快出问题。任天堂的产品当然也有缺点，但其陀螺仪输入等额外功能得到了官方支持，这一点值得肯定。
我希望这些手柄能在其他平台继续获得支持，只要它们还能用，它们就是我最珍爱的设备。

src_seg:
A brief note on Play Station controllers to round out the 1st party lineup: I never liked them.
Dual Shock 1-3 felt exactly the same to me with exactly the same flaws: Oversized thumbsticks placed too close together, mushy face/shoulder/trigger buttons that seemed to wear out very quickly, and a D-pad that just felt wrong. Dual Shock 4 fixed a lot of problems, but introduced a bunch of new ones. I got a Dual Sense because some friends had a hard time with asymmetrical thumbsticks, and for some reason local stores were selling them for $20 less than DS4 controllers.
I don't really use this controller: Face buttons are spaced too far apart, my audio in/output keeps defaulting to the controller when it's connected, the bumpers are weirdly tall, and I keep accidentally pressing the track pad when trying to hit menu/share.
They are fine guest controllers that have come a long way in terms of design, but for me they're a novelty at best.
tgt_seg:
简要提一下PlayStation系列手柄，以完成第一方产品的回顾：我从未喜欢过它们。
Dual Shock 1到3对我来说感觉完全一样，存在相同的缺陷：拇指摇杆过大且间距过近，按键、肩键和扳机键手感松软且容易磨损，方向键的设计也让人感到别扭。Dual Shock 4解决了许多问题，但也引入了新的问题。我购买Dual Sense是因为一些朋友对不对称摇杆不太适应，而且当时本地商店的售价比DS4便宜了20美元。
我几乎不怎么使用这款手柄：按键间距过大，连接后音频输入/输出总是默认到手柄，肩键设计过高，我经常在按下菜单/分享键时误触触控板。
它们作为临时借用的控制器还不错，设计上也有了长足进步，但对我来说，它们最多只是个新鲜玩意。

src_seg:
8BitDo was my first foray into good 3rd party controllers. This original SN30 Pro (later versions have hall-effect sticks and do not come in the SNES colour scheme) remains one of my favourites because holding it is reminiscent of my first console, the SNES.
If I'm having a crappy day and need a nostalgic escape, this is the first controller I reach for. It has all the functionality of a Switch Pro controller, but compacted into a modernized rendition of the SNES controller, complete with concave X/Y + convex A/B buttons, and possibly the best D-pad I've ever used. It's got some minor problems, but it's been a constant source of comfort.
One day the sticks will fail, or the battery will discharge for the last time; but if it means getting one of the modern versions (with hall-effect sticks) and shell-swapping them, I'll do it when the time comes.
With such a connection, surely 8BitDo can't do better than this, right? Well...
tgt_seg:
8BitDo是我第一次接触优质第三方手柄的开始。这款最初的SN30 Pro（后续版本配备了霍尔效应摇杆，且不再提供SNES配色）至今仍是我最喜欢的手柄之一，因为握持它的感觉让我回想起我的第一台主机SNES。
如果我心情不好，需要一些怀旧的慰藉，我第一个想到的就是这款手柄。它具备Switch Pro手柄的所有功能，但被浓缩成了一款现代化的SNES手柄设计，拥有凹面X/Y键和凸面A/B键，以及我用过最好的方向键。它也有一些小问题，但一直是我心灵的慰藉。
总有一天它的摇杆会坏掉，电池也会彻底耗尽；但如果这意味着我可以换上现代版本（配备霍尔效应摇杆）并进行外壳更换，那我也会欣然接受。
拥有如此深厚的情感联系，8BitDo应该无法超越这款了吧？其实不然……

src_seg:
When I want the familiar comforts of the SN30 Pro but with all the features of a modern controller, the 8BitDo Pro 2 has been my multi-platform controller of choice.
Everything about this is a functional upgrade from the SN30 Pro: more comfortable grips, hall-effect sticks, analog triggers, programmable back paddles, a physical X/D/S/A mode toggle switch, and a [somewhat] easily replaceable battery with the option of using AAs in a pinch. I also sprung for the carrying case and the mobile phone holster, which doesn't see as much use with a phone (I don't trust its grip that much), but for more compact retro emulation handhelds, it can expand the list of playable games to include ones that need precise analog controls.
There's very few negatives I can say about this controller, but it sits at a close 3rd for favourite controller of my collection. I'll talk about my number 2 pick in a moment, but before that I need to talk about...
tgt_seg:
当我想要SN30 Pro的熟悉手感，同时又希望拥有现代手柄的所有功能时，8BitDo Pro 2就成了我跨平台的首选。
这款手柄在各方面都比SN30 Pro有所提升：更舒适的握把、霍尔效应摇杆、模拟扳机、可编程的后拨片、物理的X/D/S/A模式切换开关，以及一个[相对]易于更换的电池，必要时还可以使用AA电池。我还购买了便携盒和手机支架，虽然手机使用频率不高（我不太信任它的夹持力），但对于更小巧的复古模拟掌机来说，它能扩展可玩的游戏列表，包括那些需要精确模拟控制的游戏。
这款手柄几乎没什么缺点，但它在我收藏中仅排第三。我最喜欢的第二名我会稍后介绍，但在那之前，我需要先谈谈……

src_seg:

tgt_seg:
尽管过去十年我主要转向了PC游戏，但最钟爱的外设仍是手柄。  
我理解键鼠操作的优势，但作为日常已用它们工作的人，拿起手柄能帮助区分工作与娱乐，同时让手腕得到休息。游戏生涯足够漫长，见证了外设技术与布局的巨变，尽管某些第一方手柄似乎停滞不前。  
最近发现一款令我惊艳到想详谈的手柄，但首先需要铺垫——不是历史课，只是回顾伴随游戏人生积累的收藏。  
希望读完你能明白，为何我愿花整天时间聊这些设备。

src_seg:
My decision to build up a PC game collection started during the transition between the Xbox 360 and the Xbox One; I thoroughly enjoyed the 360, but the One was looking like a disaster. Since the new consoles from all three major companies held little interest and I'd been in school for Computer Information Systems, I got myself a 360 pc dongle and resolved to make the switch.
Each of these controllers saw extensive use, and the 360 had the asymmetrical stick placement I preferred. All but two of the controllers in this picture are currently unusable either from loose/drifting sticks, faulty buttons, or failing cables/connections; both of the working ones are 3rd party Afterglows (which have their own problems).
As much as I loved these controllers, the official ones were the worst in terms of durability, and some were faulty from day one but Microsoft would refuse my RMA request.
It got worse when I tried the most expensive one.
tgt_seg:
我决定组建PC游戏库始于Xbox 360向Xbox One过渡时期。深爱360，但One宛如灾难。因对三巨头新主机兴趣寥寥，加上攻读计算机信息系统专业，便购入360PC接收器决心转型。  
图中手柄都曾高频使用，360的非对称摇杆布局深得我心。除两个第三方Afterglow手柄（也有自身问题）外，其余皆因摇杆漂移/按键失灵/线材损坏报废。  
这些官方手柄耐用性最差，有些出厂即故障，微软却拒绝售后。  
最贵的那款更是噩梦。

src_seg:
There was a time when I fell for the myth that "You get what you pay for" was as true for expensive stuff as it was for cheap stuff; it's because of this controller that I know better. I got this Elite Series 2 controller despite knowing the first iteration had some serious flaws.
That controller lasted just under a year before the stick drift started to set in, and the right bumper only registered half of the time. The cable it came with sucks ass, never worked with any other controllers. The lag from using bluetooth was so bad the dongle was practically necessary. On top of all that, the back paddles didn't work no matter what software/drivers I used, none of my games ever read those paddles as an inputs.
The Raikiri Pro (was bundled with a laptop) is my current dedicated desktop controller and it works fine [for now], but I will never spend another dime on Official Xbox branded controllers. Fuck Microsoft, I hope Xbox rots!
tgt_seg:
曾迷信"一分钱一分货"适用于所有价位，正是这款手柄让我醒悟。明知初代精英版有缺陷，仍购入Elite Series 2。  
使用不足年便出现摇杆漂移，右肩键半数时间无响应。原装线材极差且不兼容其他手柄，蓝牙延迟严重到必须用接收器。最糟的是，无论何种驱动，背键始终无法被游戏识别为输入。  
现役桌面手柄Raikiri Pro（笔记本捆绑）暂未故障，但我再不会为Xbox官方手柄花一分钱。去他的微软，愿Xbox腐烂！

src_seg:
The Nintendo Switch reignited my love for portable gaming after years of surviving out of crappy laptops. The joycons were small but versatile, and the pro controller felt really comfortable in the hands.
I loved these controllers so much I modified them and swapped in hall-effect sticks [and metal latches] this past year, and while I'm well aware of the drift issue, mine have worked flawlessly since 2017 with no signs of wearing out. I've put just as many hours into these controllers as I did all those Xbox controllers; either I got very lucky or microsoft designs their controllers to fail faster than both of their competitors combined. Nintendo's offerings have some drawbacks, but the fact it's additional features like Gyro input have been officially supported is noteworthy.
I hope to keep these controllers working for as long as they continue to be supported on other platforms; there are many like them, but these ones are mine.
tgt_seg:
任天堂Switch重燃了我对便携游戏的热情。Joy-Con小巧多功能，Pro手柄握感舒适。  
去年为它们改装了霍尔摇杆[及金属卡扣]，尽管知晓漂移问题，但自2017年使用至今毫无磨损迹象。其使用时长不亚于所有Xbox手柄总和——要么我运气极佳，要么微软故意缩短产品寿命。任系手柄虽有不足，但官方支持体感等附加功能值得称道。  
希望它们能持续兼容其他平台，同类虽多，这些属于我。

src_seg:
A brief note on Play Station controllers to round out the 1st party lineup: I never liked them.
Dual Shock 1-3 felt exactly the same to me with exactly the same flaws: Oversized thumbsticks placed too close together, mushy face/shoulder/trigger buttons that seemed to wear out very quickly, and a D-pad that just felt wrong. Dual Shock 4 fixed a lot of problems, but introduced a bunch of new ones. I got a Dual Sense because some friends had a hard time with asymmetrical thumbsticks, and for some reason local stores were selling them for $20 less than DS4 controllers.
I don't really use this controller: Face buttons are spaced too far apart, my audio in/output keeps defaulting to the controller when it's connected, the bumpers are weirdly tall, and I keep accidentally pressing the track pad when trying to hit menu/share.
They are fine guest controllers that have come a long way in terms of design, but for me they're a novelty at best.
tgt_seg:
简评第一方阵容中的PlayStation手柄：始终无感。  
Dual Shock 1-3于我如出一辙：过大的摇杆间距过近，易磨损的软塌按键，反人类的十字键。Dual Shock 4改良诸多却新增缺陷。购入Dual Sense仅因朋友不习惯非对称摇杆，且本地售价反比DS4低20美元。  
它基本闲置：按键间距过大，连接时音频总默认切到手柄，肩键过高，常误触触摸板。  
作为客用手柄设计进步显著，但对我仅是猎奇。

src_seg:
8BitDo was my first foray into good 3rd party controllers. This original SN30 Pro (later versions have hall-effect sticks and do not come in the SNES colour scheme) remains one of my favourites because holding it is reminiscent of my first console, the SNES.
If I'm having a crappy day and need a nostalgic escape, this is the first controller I reach for. It has all the functionality of a Switch Pro controller, but compacted into a modernized rendition of the SNES controller, complete with concave X/Y + convex A/B buttons, and possibly the best D-pad I've ever used. It's got some minor problems, but it's been a constant source of comfort.
One day the sticks will fail, or the battery will discharge for the last time; but if it means getting one of the modern versions (with hall-effect sticks) and shell-swapping them, I'll do it when the time comes.
With such a connection, surely 8BitDo can't do better than this, right? Well...
tgt_seg:
8BitDo SN30 Pro初代（非霍尔摇杆版/SNES配色）是首次接触优质第三方手柄的起点，握持时总唤起SFC时代的回忆。  
情绪低落时，它是我首选的精神避风港。在复刻SFC造型中融入Switch Pro功能，凹面XY+凸面AB键搭配可能是我用过最出色的十字键。虽有小瑕疵，却是永恒的慰藉。  
待摇杆报废或电池寿终时，我会购入霍尔摇杆新版进行外壳移植。  
如此情怀加持，8BitDo难以超越了吧？然而...

src_seg:
When I want the familiar comforts of the SN30 Pro but with all the features of a modern controller, the 8BitDo Pro 2 has been my multi-platform controller of choice.
Everything about this is a functional upgrade from the SN30 Pro: more comfortable grips, hall-effect sticks, analog triggers, programmable back paddles, a physical X/D/S/A mode toggle switch, and a [somewhat] easily replaceable battery with the option of using AAs in a pinch. I also sprung for the carrying case and the mobile phone holster, which doesn't see as much use with a phone (I don't trust its grip that much), but for more compact retro emulation handhelds, it can expand the list of playable games to include ones that need precise analog controls.
There's very few negatives I can say about this controller, but it sits at a close 3rd for favourite controller of my collection. I'll talk about my number 2 pick in a moment, but before that I need to talk about...
tgt_seg:
当需要SN30 Pro的熟悉感与现代功能时，8BitDo Pro 2成为多平台首选。  
全面升级：更舒适握把、霍尔摇杆、线性扳机、可编程背键、物理模式切换键、[较]易更换电池（支持AA应急）。另购的携带盒与手机支架虽少用于手机（对其固定性存疑），但能让复古掌机兼容需要精确摇杆的游戏。  
几无缺点的它位列收藏第三名，而第二名是...

src_seg:
How hard is it to find a modernized N64 controller?
There are plenty of cheap N64 imitation controllers, but the three-pronged original was an objectively bad design. I could play N64 games with a modern controller using clever configuration to make the face buttons function as C-buttons, but it's not the same for so many reasons.
I got the RetroFighters Brawler 64 to solve this anachronistic conundrum, and it's gone above and beyond my expectations. It was made to mimic the official NSO N64 controller down to the Switch recognizing it as one, with a toggle to make it register as a Pro controller sans right-stick.
It has some problems, but between its layout and compatibility it solves way more problems the official version has. It's perfect for showing someone N64 emulation without the intimidation of the original or the anachronism from finagling a modern controller to work the same.
It's very good at what it's trying to do.
tgt_seg:
寻找现代化N64手柄有多难？  
廉价仿品泛滥，但三叉戟原版设计本就反人类。虽可通过键位映射让现代手柄模拟C键，终非完美方案。  
RetroFighters Brawler 64远超预期地解决了这一时代错位难题。它被Switch识别为官方NSO N64手柄，另有Pro手柄模式。  
布局与兼容性完美规避了原版缺陷，是向新人展示N64模拟器的最佳媒介。  
在其专业领域无可挑剔。

src_seg:
I got this steam controller from a pawn shop after negotiating the price down shortly after the fire sale came to an end on steam. It needed some TLC, and I did what I could to get it up and running again.
It remains one of the most customizable controllers in my collection, with a unique [if questionable] design and features ahead of it's time (gyro aim, back paddles, haptic feedback, etc). It has some problems though; It requires AAs, uses Micro-USB for wired connections, occasionally turns itself back on after being turned off, the back paddles are stiff enough to cause fatigue, the thumbstick cap is necessary since the rubber on it is deteriorating, and it's functionality tends to fluctuate with every update to steam input.
It's more of a unique historical artifact than a regularly used input, but it's a welcome addition and fun to tinker with on rainy days.
It also isn't my number 2 pick, that honour goes to the fact that...
tgt_seg:
Steam清仓结束后，我从当铺砍价购得这款Steam手柄。经悉心打理重获新生。  
作为收藏中最可定制的设备，其超前设计（体感瞄准/背键/触觉反馈等）兼具争议性。缺点亦明显：需AA电池、Micro-USB接口、关机后偶自启、背键过硬致疲劳、摇杆胶皮脱落需套帽、功能随Steam输入更新波动。  
更多作为历史标本而非常用设备，却是阴雨天的趣味玩具。  
它并非第二名，因为...

src_seg:
The 8BitDo Ultimate Bluetooth controller is an almost perfect controller.
Hall-effect sticks, included charging dock that doubles as a port for the included dongle, dedicated 2.4ghz/bluetooth toggle switch, NS Pro layout with a much improved D-pad, analog triggers, and programmable back paddles. When I sit down on a couch with this controller, I can swap between a Steam Deck and a Switch faster than the time it takes the TV to switch inputs.
It does have some drawbacks though: It only does X/Switch signals (no android or apple modes), the triggers are uncomfortable, and input lag seems to be affected by the time it took to connect to the dongle/switch.
I thought this was the best it could get, but like my time with Xbox controllers I was operating on assumptions that started to sound like old brand loyalty reflexes coming back. What I'd hoped to upgrade it to was such a disappointment it swiftly shook me from those assumptions.
tgt_seg:
8BitDo Ultimate蓝牙手柄近乎完美。  
霍尔摇杆、含接收器位的充电座、独立2.4G/蓝牙切换键、改良十字键、线性扳机、可编程背键。用它能在电视切换输入源前，快速转接Steam Deck与Switch。  
缺憾：仅支持X/Switch信号（无安卓/iOS模式）、扳机手感不佳、输入延迟受连接速度影响。  
原以为这是终点，但如同曾对Xbox的盲目信任，这份假设终被一次升级彻底粉碎。

src_seg:
Even though I've mostly transitioned to PC gaming over the past decade, my preferred peripherals are still controllers.
I understand the advantages of KB+M play, but as someone who already uses those tools for work I find picking up a controller helps separate the two activities and gives my wrists a break. I've also been playing video games long enough to see the technology and layouts used drastically change, though some first party controllers seem to have stagnated a bit.
I recently found a controller I really liked because it has features that have really impressed me enough to want to talk about it at length, but to do that I feel the need for some context; not a whole history lesson, just a little stroll through my collection of controllers that materialized over a lifetime of engaging in this hobby.
By the end I hope you'll understand why this is a topic I care so much about I'd spend all day talking about these devices.
tgt_seg:
尽管在过去的十年里我大多转向了玩PC游戏，但我最喜欢的外设仍然是游戏控制器。
我理解使用键盘+鼠标的游戏方式的优点，但作为一名已经将这些工具用于工作的人，我发现使用游戏手柄有助于把这两项活动区分开来，并能让我的手腕得到休息。我还玩电子游戏已经很长一段时间了，看到技术与布局都发生了巨大变化，不过有些第三方厂商的控制器似乎停滞不前。
我最近发现了一个让我非常喜欢的控制器，因为它具备了一些令我印象深刻的功能，以至于我渴望详细谈谈它，但要做到这一点，我觉得需要一些背景介绍；并不是要讲一堂完整的历史课，只是简单地回顾一下我在这一爱好中逐步积累的控制器收藏。
最后，我希望你能理解为什么我对这个话题如此关心，以至于愿意花整天的时间谈论这些设备。

src_seg:

tgt_seg:
我决定建立一个PC游戏收藏库是在Xbox 360和Xbox One之间的过渡期开始的；我非常享受360的游戏体验，但Xbox One看起来实在是一场灾难。由于三大公司的新游戏机几乎不让我感兴趣，而我又一直在学习计算机信息系统，于是我为自己买了一个360的电脑适配器，并决心进行转换。
这些控制器中的每一个都得到了广泛的使用，而360则采用了我更喜欢的非对称摇杆布局。图片中的控制器中只有两个目前处于可用状态，其余的要么是因为摇杆松动/漂移、按钮故障，要么是电缆/连接故障而无法使用；两个能用的控制器都是第三方的Afterglows品牌（它们也有自己的问题）。
尽管我很喜欢这些控制器，但官方产品在耐用性方面是最差的，有些从一开始就存在缺陷，但微软却拒绝了我的退货请求。
当我尝试了最贵的那款时，情况变得更糟。

src_seg:
There was a time when I fell for the myth that "You get what you pay for" was as true for expensive stuff as it was for cheap stuff; it's because of this controller that I know better. I got this Elite Series 2 controller despite knowing the first iteration had some serious flaws.
That controller lasted just under a year before the stick drift started to set in, and the right bumper only registered half of the time. The cable it came with sucks ass, never worked with any other controllers. The lag from using bluetooth was so bad the dongle was practically necessary. On top of all that, the back paddles didn't work no matter what software/drivers I used, none of my games ever read those paddles as an inputs.
The Raikiri Pro (was bundled with a laptop) is my current dedicated desktop controller and it works fine [for now], but I will never spend another dime on Official Xbox branded controllers. Fuck Microsoft, I hope Xbox rots!
tgt_seg:
曾经有一段时间我迷信于“一分钱一分货”这个说法，认为这句话对于昂贵的东西和廉价的东西都同样适用；正是因为有了这个控制器，我才更加懂得了其中的道理。我选择了这款精英系列2的控制器，尽管我知道第一代产品有一些严重的缺陷。
这个控制器使用不到一年，摇杆就开始出现漂移现象，右键按下时有一半的时间根本不会被识别到。它附带的线缆糟透了，和其他控制器完全不兼容。使用蓝牙时的延迟非常严重，以至于不得不使用适配器。除此之外，无论我使用什么软件/驱动程序，后侧的摇杆都一直无法正常工作，我的游戏从来没有把那些摇杆识别为输入装置。
Raikiri Pro（当时是与笔记本电脑捆绑出售的）是我目前专用的桌面控制器，并且目前运作良好，但我再也不会花钱买微软官方品牌的控制器了。该死的微软，我希望Xbox尽快倒掉！

src_seg:

I hope to keep these controllers working for as long as they continue to be supported on other platforms; there are many like them, but these ones are mine.
tgt_seg:
任天堂Switch重新点燃了我对便携游戏的热爱，此前多年我不得不使用劣质的笔记本玩游戏。Joy-Con手柄小巧但功能多样，专业版控制器拿在手上感觉十分舒适。
我非常喜欢这些控制器，去年我对它们进行了改装，更换了霍尔效应摇杆和金属闩锁，尽管我很清楚漂移问题的存在，但这些控制器自2017年以来一直运作良好，没有出现任何磨损的迹象。我对这些控制器投入的时间和精力与我对所有Xbox控制器投入的一样多；要么是我运气非常好，要么是微软设计的控制器比他们两位竞争对手的都更容易出现故障。任天堂的产品有一些缺点，但官方支持像陀螺仪输入这样的额外功能这一点值得关注。
我希望这些控制器能一直工作，只要它们在其他平台上继续受到支持就行；还有许多类似控制器，但这些是我的。

src_seg:
A brief note on Play Station controllers to round out the 1st party lineup: I never liked them.
