tgt_seg:
关于 PlayStation 控制器的简短评论，以补充第一方产品阵容：我从来不喜欢它们。
Dual Shock 1-3 对我来说感觉完全相同，也存在相同的缺陷：拇指摇杆间距太近、面板/肩部/触发按钮显得过于松软且很快磨损，还有那个让人感觉不对劲的方向垫（D-pad）。Dual Shock 4 解决了很多问题，但也引入了许多新的问题。我之所以选了Dual Sense，是因为一些朋友对非对称的拇指摇杆感到难以适应，而且本地商店的售价比DS4控制器便宜20美元。
我不太使用这个控制器：面部按键之间的距离太远，连接时音频输入/输出总是默认切换到控制器上，侧边按钮的尺寸奇怪地偏大，而且我在试图按下菜单/分享按钮时总是不小心碰到了触控板。
它们是性能出色的客制控制器，在设计上已经取得了长足的进步，但对我来说，它们充其量只是一个新奇的玩意儿。

src_seg:
8BitDo was my first foray into good 3rd party controllers. This original SN30 Pro (later versions have hall-effect sticks and do not come in the SNES colour scheme) remains one of my favourites because holding it is reminiscent of my first console, the SNES.
If I'm having a crappy day and need a nostalgic escape, this is the first controller I reach for. It has all the functionality of a Switch Pro controller, but compacted into a modernized rendition of the SNES controller, complete with concave X/Y + convex A/B buttons, and possibly the best D-pad I've ever used. It's got some minor problems, but it's been a constant source of comfort.
One day the sticks will fail, or the battery will discharge for the last time; but if it means getting one of the modern versions (with hall-effect sticks) and shell-swapping them, I'll do it when the time comes.
With such a connection, surely 8BitDo can't do better than this, right? Well...
tgt_seg:
8BitDo是我首次接触优质的第三方控制器之一。这款原始版的SN30 Pro（后续版本带有霍尔效应摇杆，并不采用SNES的配色方案）仍然是我最喜欢的产品之一，因为握住它让我想起了我的第一个游戏机——SNES。
如果我心情不好，急需一种怀旧的方式来解压，我会第一个选择这个控制器。它拥有新任天堂Switch Pro控制器的所有功能，但被设计成了现代化的SNES风格。具有凹陷的X/Y键和凸起的A/B键，并且可能是我用过的最好的方向键（D-pad）。它有一些小问题，但它一直是我的安慰之源。
总有一天这些摇杆会失灵，或者电池会最终耗尽；但如果这意味着我可以换上现代版本（带霍尔效应摇杆）并更换外壳，我就会在时机成熟时这样做。
在这样的连接下，8BitDo肯定无法做得更好，对吧？嗯……

src_seg:
When I want the familiar comforts of the SN30 Pro but with all the features of a modern controller, the 8BitDo Pro 2 has been my multi-platform controller of choice.
Everything about this is a functional upgrade from the SN30 Pro: more comfortable grips, hall-effect sticks, analog triggers, programmable back paddles, a physical X/D/S/A mode toggle switch, and a [somewhat] easily replaceable battery with the option of using AAs in a pinch. I also sprung for the carrying case and the mobile phone holster, which doesn't see as much use with a phone (I don't trust its grip that much), but for more compact retro emulation handhelds, it can expand the list of playable games to include ones that need precise analog controls.
There's very few negatives I can say about this controller, but it sits at a close 3rd for favourite controller of my collection. I'll talk about my number 2 pick in a moment, but before that I need to talk about...
tgt_seg:
当我想要体验SN30 Pro的熟悉舒适感，但又希望拥有现代控制器的所有功能时，8BitDo Pro 2 就是我的多平台首选控制器。
这款产品在各方面都比SN30 Pro更具功能性：更舒适的握把、霍尔感应摇杆、模拟触发器、可编程的后摇杆、实体的X/D/S/A模式切换开关，以及[相对]容易更换的电池（紧急情况下可以使用AA电池）。我还购买了手提箱和手机套，尽管这些配件与手机结合使用时并没有那么实用（我不太信任它的握持力度），但对于更紧凑的复古模拟掌机来说，它可以扩展游戏可玩列表，包括那些需要精致模拟控制的游戏。
我几乎没有什么可以批评这个控制器的，但它在我收藏的控制器中位居第三，是我最喜欢的控制器之一。我会稍后谈到我的第二选择，但在此之前我需要先谈谈……

src_seg:
How hard is it to find a modernized N64 controller?
There are plenty of cheap N64 imitation controllers, but the three-pronged original was an objectively bad design. I could play N64 games with a modern controller using clever configuration to make the face buttons function as C-buttons, but it's not the same for so many reasons.
I got the RetroFighters Brawler 64 to solve this anachronistic conundrum, and it's gone above and beyond my expectations. It was made to mimic the official NSO N64 controller down to the Switch recognizing it as one, with a toggle to make it register as a Pro controller sans right-stick.
It has some problems, but between its layout and compatibility it solves way more problems the official version has. It's perfect for showing someone N64 emulation without the intimidation of the original or the anachronism from finagling a modern controller to work the same.
It's very good at what it's trying to do.
tgt_seg:
找到一款现代化的N64控制器有多难？
市面上有许多便宜的N64仿制控制器，但原版的三叉控制器在设计上确实有缺陷。我可以使用现代控制器进行N64游戏的操控，通过巧妙的设置使正面按钮充当C键，但这在很多方面并不一样。
我选择了RetroFighters的Brawler 64来解决这个过时的难题，它的表现超出了我的预期。它模仿了官方的NSO N64控制器，甚至连Switch都能识别它为这样的控制器，并且还有一个切换开关，可以让它以没有右摇杆的Pro控制器模式运行。
它虽然有一些问题，但它的布局和兼容性比官方版本要好很多，能够解决更多的问题。它非常适合向某人展示N64模拟体验，而不会让人感到受到原版游戏的压力或受到尝试用现代控制器仿效原版玩法的繁琐过程的困扰。
它在所要做的事情上表现得非常出色。

src_seg:
I got this steam controller from a pawn shop after negotiating the price down shortly after the fire sale came to an end on steam. It needed some TLC, and I did what I could to get it up and running again.
It remains one of the most customizable controllers in my collection, with a unique [if questionable] design and features ahead of it's time (gyro aim, back paddles, haptic feedback, etc). It has some problems though; It requires AAs, uses Micro-USB for wired connections, occasionally turns itself back on after being turned off, the back paddles are stiff enough to cause fatigue, the thumbstick cap is necessary since the rubber on it is deteriorating, and it's functionality tends to fluctuate with every update to steam input.
It's more of a unique historical artifact than a regularly used input, but it's a welcome addition and fun to tinker with on rainy days.
It also isn't my number 2 pick, that honour goes to the fact that...
tgt_seg:
我是在特卖结束后不久从一家典当行以讨价还价后的价格获得这个Steam控制器的。它需要一些修补和保养，我尽了我所能让它再次运作起来。
它仍然是我收藏中可定制性最强的控制器之一，具有独特的（尽管有些值得商榷的）设计和先进的功能（陀螺仪瞄准、背板摇杆、触觉反馈等）。不过也存在一些问题：它需要使用AA电池，使用Micro-USB进行有线连接，偶尔会在关机后自行重新启动，背板摇杆太僵硬容易导致疲劳，拇指摇杆盖是必需的，因为表面上的橡胶正在老化，并且其功能往往会随着每次Steam输入更新而波动。
这更像是一件独特的历史文物，而不是一个常被使用的工具，但它是值得欢迎的补充，在雨天摆弄它也是一种乐趣。
这也不是我的第二选择，这个荣誉属于……

src_seg:
The 8BitDo Ultimate Bluetooth controller is an almost perfect controller.
Hall-effect sticks, included charging dock that doubles as a port for the included dongle, dedicated 2.4ghz/bluetooth toggle switch, NS Pro layout with a much improved D-pad, analog triggers, and programmable back paddles. When I sit down on a couch with this controller, I can swap between a Steam Deck and a Switch faster than the time it takes the TV to switch inputs.
It does have some drawbacks though: It only does X/Switch signals (no android or apple modes), the triggers are uncomfortable, and input lag seems to be affected by the time it took to connect to the dongle/switch.
I thought this was the best it could get, but like my time with Xbox controllers I was operating on assumptions that started to sound like old brand loyalty reflexes coming back. What I'd hoped to upgrade it to was such a disappointment it swiftly shook me from those assumptions.
tgt_seg:
8BitDo终极蓝牙控制器是一款几乎完美的控制器。
霍尔效应手柄，配有充电底座，可兼作附带的适配器的接口，专用的2.4GHz/蓝牙切换开关，采用NS Pro布局，包含大幅改进的方向板、模拟触发器和可编程的后侧操作按键。当我在沙发上拿着这个手柄时，我可以在Steam Deck和Switch之间切换，速度比电视更换输入源的时间还要快。
然而它确实有一些缺点：只支持 X/Switch 信号（没有安卓或苹果模式），触发器使用起来不太舒适，输入延迟似乎受连接到适配器/开关所需的时间影响。
我本以为这就是它能达到的最好水平，但就像我使用Xbox控制面板的经历一样，我是在基于一些假设的前提下去操作的，而这些假设刚开始听起来就像是旧有的品牌忠诚反应的重现。实际上，我原本期待的升级体验却令人失望，这迅速打破了我之前的那些假设。

src_seg:
Even though I've mostly transitioned to PC gaming over the past decade, my preferred peripherals are still controllers.
I understand the advantages of KB+M play, but as someone who already uses those tools for work I find picking up a controller helps separate the two activities and gives my wrists a break. I've also been playing video games long enough to see the technology and layouts used drastically change, though some first party controllers seem to have stagnated a bit.
I recently found a controller I really liked because it has features that have really impressed me enough to want to talk about it at length, but to do that I feel the need for some context; not a whole history lesson, just a little stroll through my collection of controllers that materialized over a lifetime of engaging in this hobby.
By the end I hope you'll understand why this is a topic I care so much about I'd spend all day talking about these devices.
tgt_seg:
尽管在过去十年里，我主要转向了PC游戏，但我偏爱的外设依然是手柄。
我理解键鼠操作的优势，但作为一个已经用这些工具工作的人，我发现拿起手柄有助于将工作和娱乐这两种活动分开，也能让我的手腕得到休息。我玩电子游戏的时间也足够长，见证了所用技术和布局的巨大变化，尽管一些第一方手柄似乎有些停滞不前。
我最近找到了一款我非常喜欢的手柄，它的功能给我留下了深刻的印象，让我想好好聊一聊它。但要做到这一点，我觉得需要一些背景介绍；不是一堂完整的历史课，只是在我毕生投入这个爱好而收集的手柄中稍作徜徉。
我希望到最后，你能明白为什么这是一个我如此关心的话题，以至于我愿意花一整天来谈论这些设备。

src_seg:
My decision to build up a PC game collection started during the transition between the Xbox 360 and the Xbox One; I thoroughly enjoyed the 360, but the One was looking like a disaster. Since the new consoles from all three major companies held little interest and I'd been in school for Computer Information Systems, I got myself a 360 pc dongle and resolved to make the switch.
Each of these controllers saw extensive use, and the 360 had the asymmetrical stick placement I preferred. All but two of the controllers in this picture are currently unusable either from loose/drifting sticks, faulty buttons, or failing cables/connections; both of the working ones are 3rd party Afterglows (which have their own problems).
As much as I loved these controllers, the official ones were the worst in terms of durability, and some were faulty from day one but Microsoft would refuse my RMA request.
It got worse when I tried the most expensive one.
tgt_seg:
我决定建立一个PC游戏库，始于Xbox 360到Xbox One的过渡时期；我非常喜欢360，但One看起来像是一场灾难。由于三家主要公司的新主机都引不起我多大兴趣，而我当时又在学校学习计算机信息系统，于是我给自己买了一个360的PC接收器，并下定决心转换平台。
这些手柄中的每一个都曾被我大量使用，而且360的非对称摇杆布局正是我所偏爱的。这张照片里除了两个手柄外，其余的目前都已无法使用，原因要么是摇杆松动或漂移，要么是按键失灵，要么是线缆或连接故障；那两个能用的都是第三方的Afterglow手柄（它们也有自己的问题）。
尽管我非常喜欢这些手柄，但就耐用性而言，官方手柄是最差的，有些从第一天起就有问题，但微软却会拒绝我的返修申请。
当我尝试了最贵的那款后，情况变得更糟。

src_seg:
There was a time when I fell for the myth that "You get what you pay for" was as true for expensive stuff as it was for cheap stuff; it's because of this controller that I know better. I got this Elite Series 2 controller despite knowing the first iteration had some serious flaws.
That controller lasted just under a year before the stick drift started to set in, and the right bumper only registered half of the time. The cable it came with sucks ass, never worked with any other controllers. The lag from using bluetooth was so bad the dongle was practically necessary. On top of all that, the back paddles didn't work no matter what software/drivers I used, none of my games ever read those paddles as an inputs.
The Raikiri Pro (was bundled with a laptop) is my current dedicated desktop controller and it works fine [for now], but I will never spend another dime on Official Xbox branded controllers. Fuck Microsoft, I hope Xbox rots!
tgt_seg:
曾有一段时间，我误信了“一分钱一分货”这个说法，以为它对贵的东西和便宜的东西同样适用；正是因为这款手柄，我才有了更清醒的认识。尽管知道第一代产品存在一些严重缺陷，我还是买了这款精英二代手柄。
那款手柄用了不到一年，摇杆漂移就开始出现，右肩键也只有一半时间能成功触发。它附带的数据线烂得要死，从来没在任何其他手柄上正常工作过。使用蓝牙的延迟非常严重，以至于接收器几乎是必需品。最重要的是，无论我用什么软件或驱动，背部拨片都无法工作，我所有的游戏都从未将这些拨片识别为输入。
Raikiri Pro（是买笔记本电脑时捆绑的）是我目前专用的桌面手柄，它用起来还行【暂时】，但我再也不会在Xbox官方品牌的手柄上多花一分钱了。微软去死吧，祝Xbox早日凉凉！

src_seg:
The Nintendo Switch reignited my love for portable gaming after years of surviving out of crappy laptops. The joycons were small but versatile, and the pro controller felt really comfortable in the hands.
I loved these controllers so much I modified them and swapped in hall-effect sticks [and metal latches] this past year, and while I'm well aware of the drift issue, mine have worked flawlessly since 2017 with no signs of wearing out. I've put just as many hours into these controllers as I did all those Xbox controllers; either I got very lucky or microsoft designs their controllers to fail faster than both of their competitors combined. Nintendo's offerings have some drawbacks, but the fact it's additional features like Gyro input have been officially supported is noteworthy.
I hope to keep these controllers working for as long as they continue to be supported on other platforms; there are many like them, but these ones are mine.
tgt_seg:
在靠着破烂笔记本电脑熬了几年后，任天堂Switch重新点燃了我对掌机游戏的热爱。Joy-Con小巧但功能多样，而Pro手柄握在手里感觉非常舒适。
我太喜欢这些手柄了，于是在去年对它们进行了改造，换上了霍尔摇杆【和金属卡扣】。虽然我很清楚漂移问题，但我的手柄从2017年至今一直完美运行，没有任何磨损的迹象。我在这些手柄上投入的游戏时间和我用过的所有Xbox手柄加起来一样多；要么是我运气特别好，要么就是微软设计的手柄比他们两个竞争对手加起来坏得都快。任天堂的产品有一些缺点，但值得注意的是，像陀螺仪输入这样的附加功能得到了官方支持。
我希望只要这些手柄还能在其他平台上得到支持，就让它们一直工作下去；它们有很多同类，但这些是属于我的。

src_seg:
A brief note on Play Station controllers to round out the 1st party lineup: I never liked them.
Dual Shock 1-3 felt exactly the same to me with exactly the same flaws: Oversized thumbsticks placed too close together, mushy face/shoulder/trigger buttons that seemed to wear out very quickly, and a D-pad that just felt wrong. Dual Shock 4 fixed a lot of problems, but introduced a bunch of new ones. I got a Dual Sense because some friends had a hard time with asymmetrical thumbsticks, and for some reason local stores were selling them for $20 less than DS4 controllers.
I don't really use this controller: Face buttons are spaced too far apart, my audio in/output keeps defaulting to the controller when it's connected, the bumpers are weirdly tall, and I keep accidentally pressing the track pad when trying to hit menu/share.
They are fine guest controllers that have come a long way in terms of design, but for me they're a novelty at best.
tgt_seg:
关于PlayStation手柄的简短说明，以补全第一方产品线：我从来都不喜欢它们。
Dual Shock 1到3代给我的感觉完全一样，缺陷也完全一样：尺寸过大的摇杆靠得太近，软绵绵的面板键、肩键和扳机键似乎很快就会磨损，还有感觉就是不对劲的十字键。Dual Shock 4修复了很多问题，但又引入了一堆新问题。我买了一个Dual Sense，是因为一些朋友用不惯非对称摇杆，而且不知为何，本地商店卖的Dual Sense比DS4手柄还便宜20美元。
我其实不怎么用这个手柄：面板键间距太远，连接时我的音频输入输出总是默认切换到手柄，肩键高得奇怪，而且我总是在想按菜单键或分享键时误触到触摸板。
它们是还不错的客用手柄，在设计上已经有了长足的进步，但对我来说，它们充其量只是个新奇玩意儿。

src_seg:
8BitDo was my first foray into good 3rd party controllers. This original SN30 Pro (later versions have hall-effect sticks and do not come in the SNES colour scheme) remains one of my favourites because holding it is reminiscent of my first console, the SNES.
If I'm having a crappy day and need a nostalgic escape, this is the first controller I reach for. It has all the functionality of a Switch Pro controller, but compacted into a modernized rendition of the SNES controller, complete with concave X/Y + convex A/B buttons, and possibly the best D-pad I've ever used. It's got some minor problems, but it's been a constant source of comfort.
One day the sticks will fail, or the battery will discharge for the last time; but if it means getting one of the modern versions (with hall-effect sticks) and shell-swapping them, I'll do it when the time comes.
With such a connection, surely 8BitDo can't do better than this, right? Well...
tgt_seg:
八位堂是我首次涉足优秀第三方手柄的开始。这款初代的SN30 Pro（后来的版本有霍尔摇杆，且没有SNES配色方案）至今仍是我的最爱之一，因为握着它就让我想起我的第一台主机——SNES。
如果我哪天心情不好，需要一次怀旧的逃离，我第一个拿起的总是这款手柄。它拥有Switch Pro手柄的全部功能，但被压缩在一个现代化的SNES手柄复刻版中，配有内凹的X/Y键和外凸的A/B键，以及可能是我用过的最好的十字键。它有一些小问题，但它一直是我慰藉的源泉。
总有一天，摇杆会失灵，或者电池会耗尽最后一次电；但如果这意味着我可以买一个现代版本（带霍尔摇杆的）然后给它们换壳，那么时机成熟时我就会这么做。
有了这样一份情怀，八位堂肯定做不出比这更好的了吧？嗯……

src_seg:
When I want the familiar comforts of the SN30 Pro but with all the features of a modern controller, the 8BitDo Pro 2 has been my multi-platform controller of choice.
Everything about this is a functional upgrade from the SN30 Pro: more comfortable grips, hall-effect sticks, analog triggers, programmable back paddles, a physical X/D/S/A mode toggle switch, and a [somewhat] easily replaceable battery with the option of using AAs in a pinch. I also sprung for the carrying case and the mobile phone holster, which doesn't see as much use with a phone (I don't trust its grip that much), but for more compact retro emulation handhelds, it can expand the list of playable games to include ones that need precise analog controls.
There's very few negatives I can say about this controller, but it sits at a close 3rd for favourite controller of my collection. I'll talk about my number 2 pick in a moment, but before that I need to talk about...
tgt_seg:
当我想拥有SN30 Pro那熟悉的舒适感，同时又具备现代手柄的所有功能时，八位堂Pro 2就成了我多平台手柄的首选。
它的每一处都是对SN30 Pro的功能性升级：更舒适的握把、霍尔摇杆、线性扳机、可编程背键、一个物理的X/D/S/A模式切换开关，以及一个【还算】容易更换的电池，并可在紧急情况下选择使用5号电池。我还特意买了便携包和手机支架，后者用在手机上不多（我不太信任它的夹持力），但对于更小巧的复古模拟掌机来说，它可以扩展可玩游戏的列表，将那些需要精确模拟操控的游戏也包含进来。
关于这款手柄，我几乎说不出什么负面评价，但在我收藏的手柄中，它以微弱的差距排在第三位。我稍后会谈到我心目中的第二名，但在此之前，我需要谈谈……

I got the RetroFighters Brawler 64 to solve this anachronistic conundrum, and it's gone above and beyond my expectations. It was made to mimic the official NSO N64 controller down to the Switch recognizing it as one, with a toggle to make it register as a Pro controller sans right-stick.
It has some problems, but between its layout and compatibility it solves way more problems the official version has. It's perfect for showing someone N64 emulation without the intimidation of the original or the anachronism from finagling a modern controller to work the same.
It's very good at what it's trying to do.
tgt_seg:
要找到一款现代化的N64手柄有多难？
市面上有很多廉价的N64仿制手柄，但三叉戟式的原版设计客观上就是很糟糕。我可以用现代手柄，通过巧妙的配置让面板键充当C键来玩N64游戏，但出于种种原因，感觉就是不一样。
为了解决这个时代错位的难题，我买了RetroFighters Brawler 64，它的表现超出了我的预期。它的制作旨在模仿NSO官方N64手柄，甚至Switch都会将其识别为官方手柄，并且可以通过一个开关让它被识别为缺少右摇杆的Pro手柄。
它有一些问题，但凭借其布局和兼容性，它解决的问题远比官方版本多。它非常适合向别人展示N64模拟器，既没有原版手柄的上手门槛，也没有费劲调校现代手柄使其功能一致的时代错位感。
在它所尝试的领域里，它做得非常出色。

src_seg:
I got this steam controller from a pawn shop after negotiating the price down shortly after the fire sale came to an end on steam. It needed some TLC, and I did what I could to get it up and running again.
It remains one of the most customizable controllers in my collection, with a unique [if questionable] design and features ahead of it's time (gyro aim, back paddles, haptic feedback, etc). It has some problems though; It requires AAs, uses Micro-USB for wired connections, occasionally turns itself back on after being turned off, the back paddles are stiff enough to cause fatigue, the thumbstick cap is necessary since the rubber on it is deteriorating, and it's functionality tends to fluctuate with every update to steam input.
It's more of a unique historical artifact than a regularly used input, but it's a welcome addition and fun to tinker with on rainy days.
It also isn't my number 2 pick, that honour goes to the fact that...
tgt_seg:
这款Steam手柄是我在Steam清仓大甩卖结束后不久，在一家当铺里砍价买下的。它需要一番爱护和修理，我尽我所能让它重新恢复了运行。
它至今仍是我收藏中最具可定制性的手柄之一，拥有独特【尽管可能存疑】的设计和领先于时代的功能（陀螺仪瞄准、背部拨片、触觉回馈等）。不过它也有一些问题：它需要用5号电池，使用Micro-USB进行有线连接，有时在关闭后会自动重新开启，背部拨片硬得足以导致疲劳，摇杆帽是必需品因为上面的橡胶正在老化，而且它的功能性似乎随着Steam Input的每次更新而波动。
它更像一件独特的历史文物，而不是一个经常使用的输入设备，但它是一个受欢迎的收藏品，在下雨天捣鼓一下也很有趣。
它也不是我心目中的第二名，那个荣誉属于……

src_seg:
The 8BitDo Ultimate Bluetooth controller is an almost perfect controller.
Hall-effect sticks, included charging dock that doubles as a port for the included dongle, dedicated 2.4ghz/bluetooth toggle switch, NS Pro layout with a much improved D-pad, analog triggers, and programmable back paddles. When I sit down on a couch with this controller, I can swap between a Steam Deck and a Switch faster than the time it takes the TV to switch inputs.
It does have some drawbacks though: It only does X/Switch signals (no android or apple modes), the triggers are uncomfortable, and input lag seems to be affected by the time it took to connect to the dongle/switch.
I thought this was the best it could get, but like my time with Xbox controllers I was operating on assumptions that started to sound like old brand loyalty reflexes coming back. What I'd hoped to upgrade it to was such a disappointment it swiftly shook me from those assumptions.
tgt_seg:
八位堂猎户座蓝牙手柄是一款近乎完美的手柄。
霍尔摇杆，附带的充电底座可兼作附赠接收器的接口，专用的2.4G/蓝牙切换开关，NS Pro布局但十字键大幅改进，线性扳机，以及可编程背键。当我拿着这款手柄坐在沙发上时，我可以在Steam Deck和Switch之间切换，速度比电视切换输入信号还快。
不过它确实有一些缺点：它只支持X-input和Switch信号（没有安卓或苹果模式），扳机键不舒服，而且输入延迟似乎受到连接到接收器或Switch所需时间的影响。
我曾以为这已经是最好的了，但就像我使用Xbox手柄的经历一样，我当时是基于一些假设在行事，而这些假设开始听起来像是旧的品牌忠诚度条件反射又回来了。我曾希望升级到的那款产品是如此令人失望，以至于它迅速将我从那些假设中惊醒。

src_seg:
Even though I've mostly transitioned to PC gaming over the past decade, my preferred peripherals are still controllers.
I understand the advantages of KB+M play, but as someone who already uses those tools for work I find picking up a controller helps separate the two activities and gives my wrists a break. I've also been playing video games long enough to see the technology and layouts used drastically change, though some first party controllers seem to have stagnated a bit.
I recently found a controller I really liked because it has features that have really impressed me enough to want to talk about it at length, but to do that I feel the need for some context; not a whole history lesson, just a little stroll through my collection of controllers that materialized over a lifetime of engaging in this hobby.
By the end I hope you'll understand why this is a topic I care so much about I'd spend all day talking about these devices.
tgt_seg:
尽管过去十年我主要转向了PC游戏，但我仍然更偏爱使用手柄作为外设。
我明白键鼠操作的优势，但作为一个已经在工作中使用这些工具的人，我发现使用手柄能帮助我区分这两种活动，同时也能让我的手腕得到休息。此外，我玩电子游戏的时间足够长，见证了技术和布局的巨大变化，尽管某些一线厂商的手柄似乎有些停滞不前。
最近我找到了一个让我非常喜欢的手柄，因为它的一些功能让我印象深刻，甚至想要详细谈论它。但为了做到这一点，我需要提供一些背景信息；不是一整堂历史课，只是带大家简单回顾一下我多年来在这个爱好中积累的手柄收藏。
最后，我希望你们能理解为什么我会如此关注这个话题，甚至愿意花上一整天来讨论这些设备。

src_seg:
My decision to build up a PC game collection started during the transition between the Xbox 360 and the Xbox One; I thoroughly enjoyed the 360, but the One was looking like a disaster. Since the new consoles from all three major companies held little interest and I'd been in school for Computer Information Systems, I got myself a 360 pc dongle and resolved to make the switch.
Each of these controllers saw extensive use, and the 360 had the asymmetrical stick placement I preferred. All but two of the controllers in this picture are currently unusable either from loose/drifting sticks, faulty buttons, or failing cables/connections; both of the working ones are 3rd party Afterglows (which have their own problems).
As much as I loved these controllers, the official ones were the worst in terms of durability, and some were faulty from day one but Microsoft would refuse my RMA request.
It got worse when I tried the most expensive one.
tgt_seg:
我决定收集PC游戏始于Xbox 360向Xbox One过渡的时期；我非常喜欢360，但One看起来像是一场灾难。由于三大主要公司的新主机都不太吸引我，而且我当时正在学习计算机信息系统专业，于是我买了一个360的PC转接器，并决定转向PC游戏。
这些手柄都经过了大量使用，而360的不对称摇杆布局正是我所偏爱的。这张照片中除了两个之外的所有手柄现在都无法使用，要么是因为摇杆松动或漂移，要么是按键故障，或者是电缆/连接问题；目前能用的两个都是第三方的Afterglow手柄（它们也有自己的问题）。
尽管我非常喜欢这些手柄，但官方手柄的耐用性是最差的，有些从第一天开始就有问题，但微软拒绝了我的退换货申请。
当我尝试使用最贵的那个手柄时，情况变得更糟。

src_seg:
There was a time when I fell for the myth that "You get what you pay for" was as true for expensive stuff as it was for cheap stuff; it's because of this controller that I know better. I got this Elite Series 2 controller despite knowing the first iteration had some serious flaws.
That controller lasted just under a year before the stick drift started to set in, and the right bumper only registered half of the time. The cable it came with sucks ass, never worked with any other controllers. The lag from using bluetooth was so bad the dongle was practically necessary. On top of all that, the back paddles didn't work no matter what software/drivers I used, none of my games ever read those paddles as an inputs.
The Raikiri Pro (was bundled with a laptop) is my current dedicated desktop controller and it works fine [for now], but I will never spend another dime on Official Xbox branded controllers. Fuck Microsoft, I hope Xbox rots!
tgt_seg:
曾经有段时间，我深信“不花钱买不到好东西”这句话无论是对便宜货还是高价品都同样适用；但正是因为这个手柄，我才明白过来。尽管知道第一代产品存在严重缺陷，我还是买了这款Elite Series 2手柄。
这款手柄用了不到一年，摇杆漂移问题就开始出现，右侧扳机键也只能识别一半的按压。随附的数据线简直烂透了，从来没能用在其他手柄上。蓝牙连接的延迟严重到几乎必须依赖接收器才能用。更糟的是，无论我用什么软件或驱动，背部按键始终无法工作，没有一款游戏能识别这些按键的输入。
Raikiri Pro（随笔记本电脑捆绑销售）是我现在专用的桌面手柄，目前还能正常使用[暂时如此]，但我再也不会花一分钱购买官方Xbox品牌的手柄了。去他的微软，希望Xbox烂掉！

src_seg:
The Nintendo Switch reignited my love for portable gaming after years of surviving out of crappy laptops. The joycons were small but versatile, and the pro controller felt really comfortable in the hands.
I loved these controllers so much I modified them and swapped in hall-effect sticks [and metal latches] this past year, and while I'm well aware of the drift issue, mine have worked flawlessly since 2017 with no signs of wearing out. I've put just as many hours into these controllers as I did all those Xbox controllers; either I got very lucky or microsoft designs their controllers to fail faster than both of their competitors combined. Nintendo's offerings have some drawbacks, but the fact it's additional features like Gyro input have been officially supported is noteworthy.
I hope to keep these controllers working for as long as they continue to be supported on other platforms; there are many like them, but these ones are mine.
tgt_seg:
任天堂Switch重新点燃了我对掌机游戏的热爱，此前我多年只能依赖劣质笔记本电脑。Joy-Con手柄虽小但功能多样，而Pro手柄握感非常舒适。
我太喜欢这些手柄了，去年我对它们进行了改装，更换了霍尔效应摇杆和金属卡扣。虽然我清楚漂移问题的存在，但我的手柄自2017年以来一直完美运行，没有任何磨损迹象。我在这些手柄上投入的时间与我使用所有Xbox手柄的时间相当；要么是我特别幸运，要么是微软故意设计让他们的手柄比两个竞争对手加起来还要更快损坏。任天堂的产品确实有一些缺点，但官方支持陀螺仪输入等额外功能这一点值得称道。
我希望这些手柄能在其他平台继续得到支持，并能一直使用下去；类似的手柄有很多，但这些是属于我的。

src_seg:
A brief note on Play Station controllers to round out the 1st party lineup: I never liked them.
Dual Shock 1-3 felt exactly the same to me with exactly the same flaws: Oversized thumbsticks placed too close together, mushy face/shoulder/trigger buttons that seemed to wear out very quickly, and a D-pad that just felt wrong. Dual Shock 4 fixed a lot of problems, but introduced a bunch of new ones. I got a Dual Sense because some friends had a hard time with asymmetrical thumbsticks, and for some reason local stores were selling them for $20 less than DS4 controllers.
I don't really use this controller: Face buttons are spaced too far apart, my audio in/output keeps defaulting to the controller when it's connected, the bumpers are weirdly tall, and I keep accidentally pressing the track pad when trying to hit menu/share.
They are fine guest controllers that have come a long way in terms of design, but for me they're a novelty at best.
tgt_seg:
关于PlayStation手柄的简要评论，以完善一线厂商阵容：我从来不喜欢它们。
Dual Shock 1-3对我来说感觉完全一样，也有着完全相同的缺陷：摇杆过大且间距过近，面板/肩键/扳机按键手感松软且似乎磨损得非常快，十字键的手感也总是不对劲。Dual Shock 4修复了很多问题，但也引入了一堆新问题。我买了Dual Sense，因为一些朋友对不对称摇杆感到困扰，而且不知为何当地商店以比DS4手柄低20美元的价格出售。
我并不常用这个手柄：面板按键间距过大，连接时音频输入/输出总是默认切换到手柄，扳机键异常高，而且我总是不小心在尝试按菜单/分享键时触碰到触控板。
它们作为客用手柄在设计上已经有了长足进步，但对我来说，充其量只是个新奇玩意儿。

src_seg:
8BitDo was my first foray into good 3rd party controllers. This original SN30 Pro (later versions have hall-effect sticks and do not come in the SNES colour scheme) remains one of my favourites because holding it is reminiscent of my first console, the SNES.
If I'm having a crappy day and need a nostalgic escape, this is the first controller I reach for. It has all the functionality of a Switch Pro controller, but compacted into a modernized rendition of the SNES controller, complete with concave X/Y + convex A/B buttons, and possibly the best D-pad I've ever used. It's got some minor problems, but it's been a constant source of comfort.
One day the sticks will fail, or the battery will discharge for the last time; but if it means getting one of the modern versions (with hall-effect sticks) and shell-swapping them, I'll do it when the time comes.
With such a connection, surely 8BitDo can't do better than this, right? Well...
tgt_seg:
8BitDo 是我首次接触优质第三方手柄的品牌。这款原版 SN30 Pro（后续版本采用霍尔效应摇杆，且不再提供 SNES 配色方案）至今仍是我最喜欢的手柄之一，因为握持它会让我想起我的第一台游戏机——SNES。
如果某天心情糟糕，需要寻求怀旧的慰藉，这款手柄总是我的首选。它拥有 Switch Pro 手柄的全部功能，却将其浓缩进一款现代化的 SNES 手柄设计中，配备了凹面 X/Y 按键和凸面 A/B 按键，以及我用过的最好的十字键。虽然它有一些小问题，但始终是我安慰的源泉。
总有一天，摇杆会失效，或者电池会彻底耗尽；但如果这意味着要购买一款现代版本（带霍尔效应摇杆）并更换外壳，我到时候一定会这么做。
拥有如此深厚的情感联结，8BitDo 显然无法超越这款手柄了，对吧？嗯……

src_seg:
When I want the familiar comforts of the SN30 Pro but with all the features of a modern controller, the 8BitDo Pro 2 has been my multi-platform controller of choice.
Everything about this is a functional upgrade from the SN30 Pro: more comfortable grips, hall-effect sticks, analog triggers, programmable back paddles, a physical X/D/S/A mode toggle switch, and a [somewhat] easily replaceable battery with the option of using AAs in a pinch. I also sprung for the carrying case and the mobile phone holster, which doesn't see as much use with a phone (I don't trust its grip that much), but for more compact retro emulation handhelds, it can expand the list of playable games to include ones that need precise analog controls.
There's very few negatives I can say about this controller, but it sits at a close 3rd for favourite controller of my collection. I'll talk about my number 2 pick in a moment, but before that I need to talk about...
tgt_seg:
当我想要SN30 Pro的熟悉舒适感，同时拥有现代控制器的所有功能时，8BitDo Pro 2一直是我跨平台控制器的首选。
这款控制器在SN30 Pro的基础上进行了全面升级：更舒适的握把、霍尔效应摇杆、模拟扳机、可编程背键、实体X/D/S/A模式切换开关，以及一个[相对]容易更换的电池，必要时还能使用AA电池应急。我还购买了携带箱和手机支架，虽然手机支架的使用频率不高（我不太信任它的握持感），但对于更紧凑的复古模拟掌机来说，它能扩展可玩游戏的范围，包括那些需要精确模拟控制的游戏。
关于这款控制器，我几乎找不到什么缺点，但它在我的收藏中排名第三。稍后我会谈谈我的第二选择，但在此之前，我需要先说说...

src_seg:
How hard is it to find a modernized N64 controller?
There are plenty of cheap N64 imitation controllers, but the three-pronged original was an objectively bad design. I could play N64 games with a modern controller using clever configuration to make the face buttons function as C-buttons, but it's not the same for so many reasons.
I got the RetroFighters Brawler 64 to solve this anachronistic conundrum, and it's gone above and beyond my expectations. It was made to mimic the official NSO N64 controller down to the Switch recognizing it as one, with a toggle to make it register as a Pro controller sans right-stick.
It has some problems, but between its layout and compatibility it solves way more problems the official version has. It's perfect for showing someone N64 emulation without the intimidation of the original or the anachronism from finagling a modern controller to work the same.
It's very good at what it's trying to do.
tgt_seg:
寻找一款现代化的N64手柄有多难？
市面上有很多廉价的N64仿制手柄，但原版的三叉设计客观来说确实很差。我可以通过巧妙的配置，用现代手柄玩N64游戏，将面板按键设置为C按键，但无论如何都无法达到相同的体验。
为了解决这个时代错位的难题，我入手了RetroFighters Brawler 64，它的表现远超我的预期。这款手柄完全模仿了官方NSO N64手柄，甚至Switch都能识别它为官方手柄，还有一个开关可以让它被识别为Pro手柄（但没有右摇杆）。
它确实存在一些问题，但在布局和兼容性方面，它解决了官方版本的诸多问题。它非常适合向他人展示N64模拟器，既不会像原版手柄那样让人望而生畏，也不会像现代手柄那样显得格格不入。
它在实现目标方面做得非常出色。

src_seg:
My decision to build up a PC game collection started during the transition between the Xbox 360 and the Xbox One; I thoroughly enjoyed the 360, but the One was looking like a disaster. Since the new consoles from all three major companies held little interest and I'd been in school for Computer Information Systems, I got myself a 360 pc dongle and resolved to make the switch.
Each of these controllers saw extensive use, and the 360 had the asymmetrical stick placement I preferred. All but two of the controllers in this picture are currently unusable either from loose/drifting sticks, faulty buttons, or failing cables/connections; both of the working ones are 3rd party Afterglows (which have their own problems).
As much as I loved these controllers, the official ones were the worst in terms of durability, and some were faulty from day one but Microsoft would refuse my RMA request.
It got worse when I tried the most expensive one.
tgt_seg:
我的决定开始建立电脑版游戏集合是在 Xbox 360 和 Xbox One 之间的转型期间；我非常喜欢 360，但 One 看起来像一场灾难。由于新的三家公司的控制器对我来说没有什么兴趣，我正在学习计算机信息系统，所以我买了一个 360 电脑接口，决定转向电脑版。
每个控制器都经历了广泛的使用，360 的控制器是我喜欢的那种非对称摇杆布局。这张照片中的大多数控制器都无法使用，是由于摇杆松动或漂移、故障的按钮或坏掉的线缆/连接而导致的；这张照片中的两个可用的控制器都是第三方 Afterglow（它们自身也有问题）。
尽管我非常喜欢这些控制器，但官方的控制器在耐用性方面是最差的，有些从一开始就有问题，但微软拒绝了我的 RMA 请求。
情况变得更糟，当我试用了最昂贵的一个时。

src_seg:
There was a time when I fell for the myth that "You get what you pay for" was as true for expensive stuff as it was for cheap stuff; it's because of this controller that I know better. I got this Elite Series 2 controller despite knowing the first iteration had some serious flaws.
That controller lasted just under a year before the stick drift started to set in, and the right bumper only registered half of the time. The cable it came with sucks ass, never worked with any other controllers. The lag from using bluetooth was so bad the dongle was practically necessary. On top of all that, the back paddles didn't work no matter what software/drivers I used, none of my games ever read those paddles as an inputs.
The Raikiri Pro (was bundled with a laptop) is my current dedicated desktop controller and it works fine [for now], but I will never spend another dime on Official Xbox branded controllers. Fuck Microsoft, I hope Xbox rots!
tgt_seg:
有一段时间，我被那个“你付多少就得多少”的说法所迷惑，认为它对于贵重的东西和廉价的东西都是如此；这个控制器让我知道了更多。我在知道第一代有一些严重的问题的情况下，还是买了这个Elite Series 2控制器。
这个控制器在一年之前就开始出问题了，摇杆开始偏移，右边的触发器只有一半的时候才能注册。它配备的线条很差，与其他控制器无法兼容。使用蓝牙的延迟非常严重，使用铜匠基本上是必要的。除此之外，背部按键无论使用什么软件/驱动程序，都无法工作，我的游戏永远无法识别这些按键作为输入。
我目前的专用桌面控制器是 Raikiri Pro（与一台笔记本一起包装），目前运行良好，但我永远不会再花一分钱购买官方 Xbox 控制器。唔，微软，我希望 Xbox腐蚀！

src_seg:
The Nintendo Switch reignited my love for portable gaming after years of surviving out of crappy laptops. The joycons were small but versatile, and the pro controller felt really comfortable in the hands.
I loved these controllers so much I modified them and swapped in hall-effect sticks [and metal latches] this past year, and while I'm well aware of the drift issue, mine have worked flawlessly since 2017 with no signs of wearing out. I've put just as many hours into these controllers as I did all those Xbox controllers; either I got very lucky or microsoft designs their controllers to fail faster than both of their competitors combined. Nintendo's offerings have some drawbacks, but the fact it's additional features like Gyro input have been officially supported is noteworthy.
I hope to keep these controllers working for as long as they continue to be supported on other platforms; there are many like them, but these ones are mine.
tgt_seg:
Nintendo Switch重新唤醒了我几年来对移动游戏的热情，我一直在坏坏的笔记本电脑上生存着。joy-con虽然小，但是灵活性很强，而 pro 控制器在手中感觉很舒服。
我对这些控制器喜欢得很，过去一年我甚至修改了它们，并将霍尔效应杠子和金属锁子替换了，虽然我很清楚有漂移问题，但是自从2017年以来它们一直工作得很好，没有任何痛点。我在这些控制器上花费的时间与我在 Xbox 控制器上花费的时间相当，或者我很幸运，还是微软设计的控制器比两个竞争对手的组合更快速失效。Nintendo的产品有一些缺点，但是官方支持了 Gyro 输入这一功能是值得注意的。
我希望这些控制器在它们在其他平台上得到支持的时候继续工作，有很多人类似，但是这些是我的。

src_seg:
A brief note on Play Station controllers to round out the 1st party lineup: I never liked them.
Dual Shock 1-3 felt exactly the same to me with exactly the same flaws: Oversized thumbsticks placed too close together, mushy face/shoulder/trigger buttons that seemed to wear out very quickly, and a D-pad that just felt wrong. Dual Shock 4 fixed a lot of problems, but introduced a bunch of new ones. I got a Dual Sense because some friends had a hard time with asymmetrical thumbsticks, and for some reason local stores were selling them for $20 less than DS4 controllers.
I don't really use this controller: Face buttons are spaced too far apart, my audio in/output keeps defaulting to the controller when it's connected, the bumpers are weirdly tall, and I keep accidentally pressing the track pad when trying to hit menu/share.
They are fine guest controllers that have come a long way in terms of design, but for me they're a novelty at best.
tgt_seg:
PlayStation控制器的简要说明，以完成第一方产品的整体：我从来不喜欢它们。
Dual Shock 1-3对我来说感觉一模一样，具有相同的缺陷：拇指杆过大，拇指杆之间太接近，脸部/肩部/触发器按钮感觉很软，似乎很快就会磨损，D-pad感觉不对劲。Dual Shock 4解决了很多问题，但引入了一些新问题。我因为一些朋友有难度使用不对称的拇指杆，并且本地商店在DS4控制器比较便宜，所以我买了Dual Sense。
我不经常使用这个控制器：面部按钮太远，我的音频输入/输出在连接时默认为控制器，扳机过高，我经常误操作触摸板，试图点击菜单/分享。
它们是很好的客人控制器，在设计方面已经走了很长一步，但对我来说最多只是一种新颖感。
(注：本文中的Dual Shock、Dual Sense、DS4和DS4控制器均为PlayStation的产品名称，不需要翻译。)

src_seg:
8BitDo was my first foray into good 3rd party controllers. This original SN30 Pro (later versions have hall-effect sticks and do not come in the SNES colour scheme) remains one of my favourites because holding it is reminiscent of my first console, the SNES.
If I'm having a crappy day and need a nostalgic escape, this is the first controller I reach for. It has all the functionality of a Switch Pro controller, but compacted into a modernized rendition of the SNES controller, complete with concave X/Y + convex A/B buttons, and possibly the best D-pad I've ever used. It's got some minor problems, but it's been a constant source of comfort.
One day the sticks will fail, or the battery will discharge for the last time; but if it means getting one of the modern versions (with hall-effect sticks) and shell-swapping them, I'll do it when the time comes.
With such a connection, surely 8BitDo can't do better than this, right? Well...
tgt_seg:
"8BitDo 是我首次接触到好的第三方控制器。这个原始 SN30 Pro（后来版本使用霍尔效应杠杆，不采用 SNES 色彩方案）仍然是我最喜欢的，因为持有它感觉就像是我第一台控制台，SNES。
如果我有一个糟糕的日子，需要一次 nostalgic 的逃脱，那么这是我第一次抓取的控制器。它拥有 Switch Pro 控制器的所有功能，但是将其压缩到了 SNES 控制器的现代化版本中，包括凹凸的 X/Y + 凸出的 A/B 按钮，以及我曾经使用过的最好的 D-pad。它有一些小问题，但是它一直是我的常驻舒适区。
有一天，杠杆可能会失效，或者电池会充满最后一次；但是如果这意味着购买一台使用霍尔效应杠杆的现代版本（并将其与外壳交换），那么当时会发生这一事情。"
"然而，8BitDo 在这方面可能无法做得更好，对吧？好像... 8BitDo 可能会做得更好。"

src_seg:
When I want the familiar comforts of the SN30 Pro but with all the features of a modern controller, the 8BitDo Pro 2 has been my multi-platform controller of choice.
Everything about this is a functional upgrade from the SN30 Pro: more comfortable grips, hall-effect sticks, analog triggers, programmable back paddles, a physical X/D/S/A mode toggle switch, and a [somewhat] easily replaceable battery with the option of using AAs in a pinch. I also sprung for the carrying case and the mobile phone holster, which doesn't see as much use with a phone (I don't trust its grip that much), but for more compact retro emulation handhelds, it can expand the list of playable games to include ones that need precise analog controls.
There's very few negatives I can say about this controller, but it sits at a close 3rd for favourite controller of my collection. I'll talk about my number 2 pick in a moment, but before that I need to talk about...
tgt_seg:
SN30 Pro的熟悉舒适感，但具有现代控制器所有功能的，8BitDo Pro 2是我的多平台控制器的首选。
这一切都是SN30 Pro的功能升级：更舒适的手柄，使用厚效应摇杆，模拟触发器，可编程后背按键，物理X/D/S/A模式切换开关，并且易于替换的电池，可选择在紧急情况下使用A型电池。我还购买了运输箱和手机挂钩，虽然在手机上使用不是很多（我对其抓住力不太放心），但对于需要精确模拟控制的更加紧凑的旧游戏手机，它可以扩展可玩游戏列表。
我关于这个控制器的负面评论很少，但它排名第三，是我收集中的最喜欢的控制器。我很快要谈论我的第二名选择，但是先要谈论...
(注意：保留了原文中的标点符号和大小写，并且保留了原文中的特定平台元素，如[某些]和[AAs]。)

src_seg:
How hard is it to find a modernized N64 controller?
There are plenty of cheap N64 imitation controllers, but the three-pronged original was an objectively bad design. I could play N64 games with a modern controller using clever configuration to make the face buttons function as C-buttons, but it's not the same for so many reasons.
I got the RetroFighters Brawler 64 to solve this anachronistic conundrum, and it's gone above and beyond my expectations. It was made to mimic the official NSO N64 controller down to the Switch recognizing it as one, with a toggle to make it register as a Pro controller sans right-stick.
It has some problems, but between its layout and compatibility it solves way more problems the official version has. It's perfect for showing someone N64 emulation without the intimidation of the original or the anachronism from finagling a modern controller to work the same.
It's very good at what it's trying to do.
tgt_seg:
找到现代化的N64控制器有多难？
有很多廉价的N64模仿控制器，但原来的三根腿设计是客观上的一个坏设计。我可以使用巧妙的配置来让面部按键作为C-按键来玩N64游戏，但是有太多的原因不是一样的。
我使用RetroFighters Brawler 64来解决这个古老的矛盾，它超出了我的期望。它是为了模仿官方NSO N64控制器，直到Switch能够识别它，并提供一个开关来使它作为Pro控制器，但没有右摇杆。
它有一些问题，但在其布局和兼容性方面，它解决了比官方版本更多的问题。它非常适合在不带原来的吓人感或使用现代控制器来做同样的情况下展示N64模拟。
它非常擅长做自己想做的事情。
(注意：本文中的NSO、Pro控制器等是原文中的缩写，保留了原文中的缩写。)

src_seg:
I got this steam controller from a pawn shop after negotiating the price down shortly after the fire sale came to an end on steam. It needed some TLC, and I did what I could to get it up and running again.
It remains one of the most customizable controllers in my collection, with a unique [if questionable] design and features ahead of it's time (gyro aim, back paddles, haptic feedback, etc). It has some problems though; It requires AAs, uses Micro-USB for wired connections, occasionally turns itself back on after being turned off, the back paddles are stiff enough to cause fatigue, the thumbstick cap is necessary since the rubber on it is deteriorating, and it's functionality tends to fluctuate with every update to steam input.
It's more of a unique historical artifact than a regularly used input, but it's a welcome addition and fun to tinker with on rainy days.
It also isn't my number 2 pick, that honour goes to the fact that...
tgt_seg:
我在pawn店买到了一台 Steam 控制器，在 Steam 的清仓销售结束后就和店主谈了一下价格。它需要一些 TLC，我做了一些尝试，让它再次运行正常。
它仍然是我的控制器集合中最可定制的一部分，具有独特的 [如果有疑问的] 设计和比其时代先进的特色（陀螺仪瞄准、后背按键、震动反馈等）。然而，它也有一些问题：它需要 AA 电池，用 Micro-USB 进行有线连接，偶尔会自动重新开机，后背按键过于坚硬可能导致疲劳，手柄盖必须使用，因为它上面的塑料正在腐蚀，它的功能随着 Steam 输入的每个更新而有所波动。
它更多地是一个独特的历史文化遗产，而不是常用的输入设备，但它是一个有趣的补充，在雨天可以搞笑地折腾。
它不是我的第二选择，那个荣誉归于... 但是...
(注意：本文中的 "Steam" 和 "Steam Input" 应保持原文的拼写，不要将其翻译成 "蒸汽" 或 "Steam 输入"。)

src_seg:
The 8BitDo Ultimate Bluetooth controller is an almost perfect controller.
Hall-effect sticks, included charging dock that doubles as a port for the included dongle, dedicated 2.4ghz/bluetooth toggle switch, NS Pro layout with a much improved D-pad, analog triggers, and programmable back paddles. When I sit down on a couch with this controller, I can swap between a Steam Deck and a Switch faster than the time it takes the TV to switch inputs.
It does have some drawbacks though: It only does X/Switch signals (no android or apple modes), the triggers are uncomfortable, and input lag seems to be affected by the time it took to connect to the dongle/switch.
I thought this was the best it could get, but like my time with Xbox controllers I was operating on assumptions that started to sound like old brand loyalty reflexes coming back. What I'd hoped to upgrade it to was such a disappointment it swiftly shook me from those assumptions.
tgt_seg:
Ultimate 8BitDo Bluetooth控制器几乎是一个完美的控制器。
包括霍尔效应摇杆、附带充电站，同时也是插入铜吊腕的端口，有专用的2.4GHz/蓝牙切换开关，NS Pro布局，D-pad有很大的改进，还有模拟触发器和可编程背部按键。当我坐在沙发上，拿这个控制器，我可以在TV切换输入的时间内更快地切换之间Steam Deck和Switch。
但是，它也有一些缺点：只支持X/Switch信号（没有安卓或苹果模式），触发器不舒服，并且连接到铜吊腕/Switch的时间似乎会影响输入延迟。
我以为这是最好的，但我的Xbox控制器的时间与我的老牌品牌的老情结似乎在回来了。我希望能够升级它，但我所期望的升级却让我从这些假设中震惊了。
(注：Xbox控制器的时间与老牌品牌的老情结是一个比喻，不是实际的品牌名称。)

src_seg:
Even though I've mostly transitioned to PC gaming over the past decade, my preferred peripherals are still controllers.
I understand the advantages of KB+M play, but as someone who already uses those tools for work I find picking up a controller helps separate the two activities and gives my wrists a break. I've also been playing video games long enough to see the technology and layouts used drastically change, though some first party controllers seem to have stagnated a bit.
I recently found a controller I really liked because it has features that have really impressed me enough to want to talk about it at length, but to do that I feel the need for some context; not a whole history lesson, just a little stroll through my collection of controllers that materialized over a lifetime of engaging in this hobby.
By the end I hope you'll understand why this is a topic I care so much about I'd spend all day talking about these devices.
tgt_seg:
尽管在过去的十年里我已经基本转战PC游戏，但我最喜欢的外设依然是手柄。
我明白键盘+鼠标的优势，但作为一名已经在工作中使用这些工具的人，我发现使用手柄可以帮助区分两种活动，并让我的手腕得到休息。我玩电子游戏的时间也足够长，见证了技术和布局发生巨大变化的过程，尽管一些第一方手柄似乎有些停滞不前。
最近我发现了一个我非常喜欢的手柄，因为它的一些功能让我印象深刻，以至于想长篇大论地谈论它，但为了做到这一点，我觉得有必要提供一些背景；不是完整的历史课程，只是简单地浏览一下我在从事这个爱好的一生中收集的手柄。
到最后，我希望你们能理解为什么我如此关心这个话题，以至于我可以整天谈论这些设备。

src_seg:
A brief note on Play Station controllers to round out the 1st party lineup: I never liked them.
Dual Shock 1-3 felt exactly the same to me with exactly the same flaws: Oversized thumbsticks placed too close together, mushy face/shoulder/trigger buttons that seemed to wear out very quickly, and a D-pad that just felt wrong. Dual Shock 4 fixed a lot of problems, but introduced a bunch of new ones. I got a Dual Sense because some friends had a hard time with asymmetrical thumbsticks, and for some reason local stores were selling them for $20 less than DS4 controllers.
I don't really use this controller: Face buttons are spaced too far apart, my audio in/output keeps defaulting to the controller when it's connected, the bumpers are weirdly tall, and I keep accidentally pressing the track pad when trying to hit menu/share.
They are fine guest controllers that have come a long way in terms of design, but for me they're a novelty at best.
tgt_seg:
关于Play Station手柄的简短说明，以完成第一方阵容：我从不喜欢它们。
Dual Shock 1-3在我看来感觉完全一样，有着完全一样的缺陷：过大的摇杆放置得太近，柔软的面部/肩部/触发按钮似乎很快就会磨损，而D-pad感觉不对劲。Dual Shock 4修复了许多问题，但引入了许多新问题。我买了一个Dual Sense，因为一些朋友在使用非对称摇杆时遇到困难，而且由于某种原因，当地商店以比DS4手柄低20美元的价格出售它们。
我几乎不使用这个手柄：面部按钮间隔太远，我的音频输入/输出在连接时总是默认到手柄，肩键奇怪地高，而且我在尝试按菜单/分享键时总是意外按到触摸板。
它们是很好的客人手柄，在设计方面取得了长足的进步，但对我来说，它们充其量只是一个新奇事物。

src_seg:
8BitDo was my first foray into good 3rd party controllers. This original SN30 Pro (later versions have hall-effect sticks and do not come in the SNES colour scheme) remains one of my favourites because holding it is reminiscent of my first console, the SNES.
If I'm having a crappy day and need a nostalgic escape, this is the first controller I reach for. It has all the functionality of a Switch Pro controller, but compacted into a modernized rendition of the SNES controller, complete with concave X/Y + convex A/B buttons, and possibly the best D-pad I've ever used. It's got some minor problems, but it's been a constant source of comfort.
One day the sticks will fail, or the battery will discharge for the last time; but if it means getting one of the modern versions (with hall-effect sticks) and shell-swapping them, I'll do it when the time comes.
With such a connection, surely 8BitDo can't do better than this, right? Well...
tgt_seg:
8BitDo是我第一次尝试优质第三方手柄。这款原始的SN30 Pro（后期版本具有霍尔效应摇杆，且不采用SNES配色方案）仍然是我最喜欢的手柄之一，因为握持它让我想起了我的第一款游戏机，SNES。
如果我有一天过得很糟糕，需要怀旧的逃避，这是我首先拿起的手柄。它具有Switch Pro手柄的所有功能，但压缩到了现代化的SNES手柄中，配备了凹陷的X/Y和凸起的A/B按钮，以及可能是我用过最好的D-pad。它有一些小问题，但它一直是我舒适的源泉。
有一天，摇杆会失效，或者电池会最后一次放电；但如果这意味着获得现代版本（具有霍尔效应摇杆）并进行外壳交换，我会在时机成熟时这样做。
有了这样的联系，8BitDo肯定无法做得比这更好，对吧？嗯……

src_seg:
When I want the familiar comforts of the SN30 Pro but with all the features of a modern controller, the 8BitDo Pro 2 has been my multi-platform controller of choice.
Everything about this is a functional upgrade from the SN30 Pro: more comfortable grips, hall-effect sticks, analog triggers, programmable back paddles, a physical X/D/S/A mode toggle switch, and a [somewhat] easily replaceable battery with the option of using AAs in a pinch. I also sprung for the carrying case and the mobile phone holster, which doesn't see as much use with a phone (I don't trust its grip that much), but for more compact retro emulation handhelds, it can expand the list of playable games to include ones that need precise analog controls.
There's very few negatives I can say about this controller, but it sits at a close 3rd for favourite controller of my collection. I'll talk about my number 2 pick in a moment, but before that I need to talk about...
tgt_seg:
当我想要SN30 Pro的熟悉舒适感，但又拥有现代手柄的所有功能时，8BitDo Pro 2一直是我多平台手柄的首选。
这款手柄在各个方面都是对SN30 Pro的功能升级：更舒适的握把，霍尔效应摇杆，模拟触发器，可编程后置按键，物理X/D/S/A模式切换开关，以及[某种程度上]易于更换的电池，在紧急情况下可以使用AA电池。我还购买了携带盒和手机套，虽然在手机上使用不多（我不信任它的握把），但对于更紧凑的复古模拟便携设备，它可以扩展可玩游戏的列表，包括需要精确模拟控制的游戏。
关于这个手柄，我几乎没有什么负面评价，但它在我收藏的手柄中排名第三。我稍后会谈到我排名第二的手柄，但在此之前，我需要谈谈……

src_seg:
How hard is it to find a modernized N64 controller?
There are plenty of cheap N64 imitation controllers, but the three-pronged original was an objectively bad design. I could play N64 games with a modern controller using clever configuration to make the face buttons function as C-buttons, but it's not the same for so many reasons.
I got the RetroFighters Brawler 64 to solve this anachronistic conundrum, and it's gone above and beyond my expectations. It was made to mimic the official NSO N64 controller down to the Switch recognizing it as one, with a toggle to make it register as a Pro controller sans right-stick.
It has some problems, but between its layout and compatibility it solves way more problems the official version has. It's perfect for showing someone N64 emulation without the intimidation of the original or the anachronism from finagling a modern controller to work the same.
It's very good at what it's trying to do.
tgt_seg:
找到现代化的N64手柄有多难？
有许多便宜的N64模仿手柄，但原始的三叉手柄客观上是一个糟糕的设计。我可以使用现代手柄玩N64游戏，通过巧妙的配置使面部按钮充当C按钮，但这在许多方面都不一样。
我买了RetroFighters Brawler 64来解决这个时代错误的难题，它超出了我的预期。它旨在模仿官方NSO N64手柄，甚至Switch也能识别它，并有一个切换开关，使其注册为Pro手柄，没有右摇杆。
它有一些问题，但在布局和兼容性之间，它解决了官方版本更多的问题。它非常适合向某人展示N64模拟，而不会像原始手柄那样令人望而却步，也不会像现代手柄那样时代错误。
它在试图做的事情上做得非常好。

src_seg:
I got this steam controller from a pawn shop after negotiating the price down shortly after the fire sale came to an end on steam. It needed some TLC, and I did what I could to get it up and running again.
It remains one of the most customizable controllers in my collection, with a unique [if questionable] design and features ahead of it's time (gyro aim, back paddles, haptic feedback, etc). It has some problems though; It requires AAs, uses Micro-USB for wired connections, occasionally turns itself back on after being turned off, the back paddles are stiff enough to cause fatigue, the thumbstick cap is necessary since the rubber on it is deteriorating, and it's functionality tends to fluctuate with every update to steam input.
It's more of a unique historical artifact than a regularly used input, but it's a welcome addition and fun to tinker with on rainy days.
It also isn't my number 2 pick, that honour goes to the fact that...
tgt_seg:
我在Steam火爆促销结束后不久，从当铺以较低的价格购买了这个Steam手柄。它需要一些照顾，我尽我所能让它再次运行。
它仍然是我收藏中最可定制的手柄之一，具有独特的[如果有争议的]设计和超前的功能（陀螺仪瞄准，后置按键，触觉反馈等）。不过它也有一些问题；它需要AA电池，使用Micro-USB进行有线连接，偶尔会在关闭后自动重新打开，后置按键足够僵硬以至于会导致疲劳，摇杆帽是必需的，因为它的橡胶正在恶化，并且其功能倾向于随着Steam输入的每次更新而波动。
它更像是一个独特的历史文物，而不是经常使用的输入设备，但它是一个受欢迎的补充，在雨天摆弄它很有趣。
它也不是我排名第二的手柄，这个荣誉属于……

src_seg:
The 8BitDo Ultimate Bluetooth controller is an almost perfect controller.
Hall-effect sticks, included charging dock that doubles as a port for the included dongle, dedicated 2.4ghz/bluetooth toggle switch, NS Pro layout with a much improved D-pad, analog triggers, and programmable back paddles. When I sit down on a couch with this controller, I can swap between a Steam Deck and a Switch faster than the time it takes the TV to switch inputs.
It does have some drawbacks though: It only does X/Switch signals (no android or apple modes), the triggers are uncomfortable, and input lag seems to be affected by the time it took to connect to the dongle/switch.
I thought this was the best it could get, but like my time with Xbox controllers I was operating on assumptions that started to sound like old brand loyalty reflexes coming back. What I'd hoped to upgrade it to was such a disappointment it swiftly shook me from those assumptions.
tgt_seg:
8BitDo Ultimate Bluetooth手柄几乎是一个完美的手柄。
霍尔效应摇杆，附带的充电底座兼作适配器端口，专用的2.4GHz/蓝牙切换开关，NS Pro布局，改进的D-pad，模拟触发器，以及可编程后置按键。当我坐在沙发上使用这个手柄时，我可以在Steam Deck和Switch之间切换，比电视切换输入所花费的时间还要快。
不过它也有一些缺点：它只能发送X/Switch信号（没有安卓或苹果模式），触发器不舒服，输入延迟似乎受到连接到适配器/Switch所花费的时间的影响。
我认为这是最好的，但就像我在Xbox手柄上的经历一样，我是在假设的基础上运作的，这些假设开始听起来像旧品牌忠诚度的反射。我希望将其升级到的东西让我非常失望，迅速让我摆脱了这些假设。

src_seg:
Even though I've mostly transitioned to PC gaming over the past decade, my preferred peripherals are still controllers.
I understand the advantages of KB+M play, but as someone who already uses those tools for work I find picking up a controller helps separate the two activities and gives my wrists a break. I've also been playing video games long enough to see the technology and layouts used drastically change, though some first party controllers seem to have stagnated a bit.
I recently found a controller I really liked because it has features that have really impressed me enough to want to talk about it at length, but to do that I feel the need for some context; not a whole history lesson, just a little stroll through my collection of controllers that materialized over a lifetime of engaging in this hobby.
By the end I hope you'll understand why this is a topic I care so much about I'd spend all day talking about these devices.
tgt_seg:
尽管我在过去十年中主要转向了PC游戏，但我最喜欢的外设仍然是手柄。
我理解KB+M（键盘鼠标）游戏的好处，但作为一名已经使用这些工具进行工作的人来说，拿起手柄能帮助我将这两项活动区分开来，也能让我的手腕得到休息。我玩电子游戏的时间已经足够长，见证了技术和布局的巨大变化，但有些第一方手柄似乎有些停滞不前。
我最近发现了一个我非常喜欢的手柄，因为它的一些功能真的让我印象深刻，以至于我想花很多时间来谈论它，但为了做到这一点，我觉得需要一些背景信息；不是一个完整的历史课程，只是简单地回顾一下我一生中积累的这些手柄收藏。
到最后，我希望你能理解为什么这个话题对我来说如此重要，我会花一整天的时间来谈论这些设备。

src_seg:
My decision to build up a PC game collection started during the transition between the Xbox 360 and the Xbox One; I thoroughly enjoyed the 360, but the One was looking like a disaster. Since the new consoles from all three major companies held little interest and I'd been in school for Computer Information Systems, I got myself a 360 pc dongle and resolved to make the switch.
Each of these controllers saw extensive use, and the 360 had the asymmetrical stick placement I preferred. All but two of the controllers in this picture are currently unusable either from loose/drifting sticks, faulty buttons, or failing cables/connections; both of the working ones are 3rd party Afterglows (which have their own problems).
As much as I loved these controllers, the official ones were the worst in terms of durability, and some were faulty from day one but Microsoft would refuse my RMA request.
It got worse when I tried the most expensive one.
tgt_seg:
我决定建立一个PC游戏收藏的决定始于Xbox 360和Xbox One之间的过渡期；我非常喜欢360，但Xbox One看起来像是一场灾难。由于来自所有三家主要公司的全新主机都没有引起我的兴趣，而且我正在学习计算机信息系统，所以我买了一个360的PC适配器，并决定进行转换。
这些控制器都得到了广泛的使用，而360的非对称摇杆布局是我所偏爱的。照片中除了两个之外的所有控制器目前都无法使用，要么是摇杆松动/漂移，要么是按键故障，要么是电缆/连接出现问题；这两个可用的控制器都是第三方品牌的Afterglow（它们也有自己的问题）。
尽管我非常喜欢这些控制器，但官方的控制器在耐用性方面是最差的，有些从第一天开始就出现故障，但微软却拒绝我的RMA申请。
当我尝试最昂贵的一个时，情况变得更糟。

src_seg:
There was a time when I fell for the myth that "You get what you pay for" was as true for expensive stuff as it was for cheap stuff; it's because of this controller that I know better. I got this Elite Series 2 controller despite knowing the first iteration had some serious flaws.
That controller lasted just under a year before the stick drift started to set in, and the right bumper only registered half of the time. The cable it came with sucks ass, never worked with any other controllers. The lag from using bluetooth was so bad the dongle was practically necessary. On top of all that, the back paddles didn't work no matter what software/drivers I used, none of my games ever read those paddles as an inputs.
The Raikiri Pro (was bundled with a laptop) is my current dedicated desktop controller and it works fine [for now], but I will never spend another dime on Official Xbox branded controllers. Fuck Microsoft, I hope Xbox rots!
tgt_seg:
曾经有一段时间，我信奉“你付多少钱就得到多少东西”这个神话，认为它对昂贵的东西和廉价的东西都同样适用；正是因为这个控制器，我才意识到这并非事实。尽管我知道第一代Elite Series 2控制器存在一些严重缺陷，我还是购买了它。
这个控制器在使用不到一年的时间后，开始出现摇杆漂移的问题，而且右侧的肩键只有一半的时间才能被识别。它附带的电缆简直一无是处，无法与任何其他控制器配合使用。蓝牙连接的延迟非常严重，几乎需要使用适配器才能正常工作。更糟糕的是，无论我使用什么软件/驱动程序，背面的按键都无法工作，我的游戏从未将这些按键识别为输入。
我现在使用的Raikiri Pro（与笔记本电脑捆绑销售）是我的专用桌面控制器，目前运行良好[暂时是这样]，但我永远不会再花一分钱购买官方Xbox品牌的控制器。去你的微软，我希望Xbox彻底衰败！

src_seg:
The Nintendo Switch reignited my love for portable gaming after years of surviving out of crappy laptops. The joycons were small but versatile, and the pro controller felt really comfortable in the hands.
I loved these controllers so much I modified them and swapped in hall-effect sticks [and metal latches] this past year, and while I'm well aware of the drift issue, mine have worked flawlessly since 2017 with no signs of wearing out. I've put just as many hours into these controllers as I did all those Xbox controllers; either I got very lucky or microsoft designs their controllers to fail faster than both of their competitors combined. Nintendo's offerings have some drawbacks, but the fact it's additional features like Gyro input have been officially supported is noteworthy.
I hope to keep these controllers working for as long as they continue to be supported on other platforms; there are many like them, but these ones are mine.
tgt_seg:
任天堂的Switch重新点燃了我对掌上游戏的热情，结束了多年来在糟糕的笔记本电脑上挣扎的日子。Joycons虽然小巧，但功能多变，而Pro手柄的手感则非常舒适。
我非常喜欢这些手柄，所以在过去的一年里我对其进行了改造，更换了霍尔效应摇杆[和金属锁扣]。虽然我清楚地知道漂移问题，但自2017年以来，我的手柄一直运行良好，没有任何磨损的迹象。我在这款手柄上投入了和所有Xbox手柄一样多的时间；要么我非常幸运，要么微软的设计导致他们的手柄比竞争对手更快地失效。任天堂的设备有一些缺点，但值得注意的是，像陀螺仪输入这样的附加功能得到了官方支持。
我希望这些手柄能够继续在其他平台上得到支持，它们有很多同类，但这些是我的。

tgt_seg:
关于Play Station手柄的简短说明，以完善第一方产品线：我从来都不喜欢它们。
Dual Shock 1-3对我来说感觉完全一样，有着同样的缺点：过大的摇杆位置太近，面键/肩键/触发键手感软绵绵，似乎很快就会磨损，以及一个感觉不对劲的D键。Dual Shock 4解决了许多问题，但也引入了许多新的问题。我买了Dual Sense，因为有些朋友难以适应不对称的摇杆，而且不知为何当地商店的价格比DS4手柄便宜20美元。
我真的很少使用这个手柄：面键之间的距离太远，我的音频输入/输出总是默认连接到手柄上，肩键太高，而且我经常在尝试按下菜单/分享键时意外地触碰到触控板。
它们作为客用手柄来说，在设计上有了很大的进步，但对我来说，它们充其量只是一个新奇玩具。

With such a connection, surely 8BitDo can't do better than this, right? Well...

There are plenty of cheap N64 imitation controllers, but the three-pronged original was an objectively bad design. I could play N64 games with a modern controller using clever configuration to make the face buttons function as C-buttons, but it's not the same for so many reasons.
I got the RetroFighters Brawler 64 to solve this anachronistic conundrum, and it's gone above and beyond my expectations. It was made to mimic the official NSO N64 controller down to the Switch recognizing it as one, with a toggle to make it register as a Pro controller sans right-stick.
It has some problems, but between its layout and compatibility it solves way more problems the official version has. It's perfect for showing someone N64 emulation without the intimidation of the original or the anachronism from finagling a modern controller to work the same.
It's very good at what it's trying to do.
tgt_seg:
找到一个现代化的N64手柄有多难？
市面上有很多廉价的N64仿制手柄，但原版的三个按键设计客观来说很糟糕。我可以利用巧妙的配置，用现代手柄来玩N64游戏，让面部按键充当C键，但原因有很多，这并不一样。
我购买了RetroFighters Brawler 64来解决这个时代错位的难题，它超出了我的预期。它被设计成模仿官方的NSO N64手柄，甚至让Switch将其识别为其中一个，并有一个开关可以将其注册为没有右摇杆的Pro手柄。
它有一些问题，但考虑到它的布局和兼容性，它解决了比官方版本更多的问题。它非常适合向某人展示N64模拟器，而无需面对原版手柄的威慑感或通过调整现代手柄使其正常工作所带来的时代错位感。
它在尝试做的事情上做得非常出色。

src_seg:
I got this steam controller from a pawn shop after negotiating the price down shortly after the fire sale came to an end on steam. It needed some TLC, and I did what I could to get it up and running again.
It remains one of the most customizable controllers in my collection, with a unique [if questionable] design and features ahead of it's time (gyro aim, back paddles, haptic feedback, etc). It has some problems though; It requires AAs, uses Micro-USB for wired connections, occasionally turns itself back on after being turned off, the back paddles are stiff enough to cause fatigue, the thumbstick cap is necessary since the rubber on it is deteriorating, and it's functionality tends to fluctuate with every update to steam input.
It's more of a unique historical artifact than a regularly used input, but it's a welcome addition and fun to tinker with on rainy days.
It also isn't my number 2 pick, that honour goes to the fact that...
tgt_seg:
我从一家典当行买下了这个Steam手柄，在Steam的清仓活动结束后不久，我通过协商将价格降了下来。它需要一些维护，我尽我所能让它重新启动。
它仍然是我收藏中最具可定制性的手柄之一，拥有独特（虽然有些古怪）的设计和超前的功能（陀螺仪瞄准、后背按键、触觉反馈等）。不过，它也存在一些问题：它需要AA电池，使用Micro-USB进行有线连接，偶尔会在关机后自动重启，后背按键的硬度足以导致疲劳，拇指摇杆的盖子是必需的，因为它的橡胶正在恶化，而且它的功能往往会随着Steam输入更新而波动。
它更像是一件独特的历史文物，而不是一个常用的输入设备，但它是一个受欢迎的补充，在雨天玩耍时很有趣。
它也不是我的第二选择，那个荣誉属于...

src_seg:
The 8BitDo Ultimate Bluetooth controller is an almost perfect controller.
Hall-effect sticks, included charging dock that doubles as a port for the included dongle, dedicated 2.4ghz/bluetooth toggle switch, NS Pro layout with a much improved D-pad, analog triggers, and programmable back paddles. When I sit down on a couch with this controller, I can swap between a Steam Deck and a Switch faster than the time it takes the TV to switch inputs.
It does have some drawbacks though: It only does X/Switch signals (no android or apple modes), the triggers are uncomfortable, and input lag seems to be affected by the time it took to connect to the dongle/switch.
I thought this was the best it could get, but like my time with Xbox controllers I was operating on assumptions that started to sound like old brand loyalty reflexes coming back. What I'd hoped to upgrade it to was such a disappointment it swiftly shook me from those assumptions.
tgt_seg:
8BitDo Ultimate 蓝牙控制器几乎是一款完美的手柄。
它配备了霍尔效应摇杆，包含一个充电底座，该底座同时也是包含的适配器的接口；有一个专门的 2.4GHz/蓝牙切换开关；NS Pro 布局，拥有大幅改进的 D-pad，模拟触发器，以及可编程的后背按键。当我坐在沙发上使用这个手柄时，我可以比电视切换输入更快地在 Steam Deck 和 Switch 之间切换。
不过，它也有一些缺点：它只支持 X/Switch 信号（没有 Android 或 Apple 模式），触发器不太舒适，输入延迟似乎受到连接到适配器/Switch 所需时间的影响。
我一度认为这是最好的选择，但就像我使用 Xbox 控制器的经历一样，我基于一些假设，这些假设开始听起来像旧的品牌忠诚度反应。我原本希望对其进行升级，但结果令人失望，迅速让我摆脱了这些假设。

src_seg:
Even though I've mostly transitioned to PC gaming over the past decade, my preferred peripherals are still controllers.
I understand the advantages of KB+M play, but as someone who already uses those tools for work I find picking up a controller helps separate the two activities and gives my wrists a break. I've also been playing video games long enough to see the technology and layouts used drastically change, though some first party controllers seem to have stagnated a bit.
I recently found a controller I really liked because it has features that have really impressed me enough to want to talk about it at length, but to do that I feel the need for some context; not a whole history lesson, just a little stroll through my collection of controllers that materialized over a lifetime of engaging in this hobby.
By the end I hope you'll understand why this is a topic I care so much about I'd spend all day talking about these devices.
tgt_seg:
尽管我在过去十年里主要转向了PC游戏，但我仍然更喜欢使用控制器。
我理解键盘+鼠标游戏的优势，但作为已经在工作中使用这些工具的人，我发现拿起控制器有助于将工作和游戏分开，让手腕得到休息。我也已经玩了足够长的时间，见证了游戏技术与布局的巨大变化，尽管一些第一方控制器似乎有些停滞不前。
最近我发现了一个让我印象深刻并想详细讨论的控制器，但我认为需要一些背景；不是整个历史课，只是简要浏览一下我一生中收集的控制器。
希望到那时你能理解，为什么这个话题对我来说如此重要，以至于我愿意花一整天的时间来谈论这些设备。

src_seg:
My decision to build up a PC game collection started during the transition between the Xbox 360 and the Xbox One; I thoroughly enjoyed the 360, but the One was looking like a disaster. Since the new consoles from all three major companies held little interest and I'd been in school for Computer Information Systems, I got myself a 360 pc dongle and resolved to make the switch.
Each of these controllers saw extensive use, and the 360 had the asymmetrical stick placement I preferred. All but two of the controllers in this picture are currently unusable either from loose/drifting sticks, faulty buttons, or failing cables/connections; both of the working ones are 3rd party Afterglows (which have their own problems).
As much as I loved these controllers, the official ones were the worst in terms of durability, and some were faulty from day one but Microsoft would refuse my RMA request.
It got worse when I tried the most expensive one.
tgt_seg:
我的PC游戏收藏的决定始于Xbox 360向Xbox One的过渡；我对360非常满意，但One看起来像是灾难。由于新主机对所有三大公司来说都缺乏兴趣，而我在计算机信息系统专业上学过，所以我买了一个360 PC适配器，决定进行转换。
这些控制器都得到了广泛使用，360的不对称摇杆布局是我偏好的。除了两台控制器外，这张照片中的所有控制器目前都无法使用，要么是摇杆松动或漂移，要么是按钮故障，或者电缆/连接故障；剩下的两台工作控制器是第三方Afterglow（它们也有自己的问题）。
尽管我非常喜欢这些控制器，但官方控制器在耐用性方面最差，有些从第一天开始就存在问题，但微软拒绝了我的RMA请求。
当我尝试最昂贵的控制器时，情况变得更糟。

src_seg:
There was a time when I fell for the myth that "You get what you pay for" was as true for expensive stuff as it was for cheap stuff; it's because of this controller that I know better. I got this Elite Series 2 controller despite knowing the first iteration had some serious flaws.
That controller lasted just under a year before the stick drift started to set in, and the right bumper only registered half of the time. The cable it came with sucks ass, never worked with any other controllers. The lag from using bluetooth was so bad the dongle was practically necessary. On top of all that, the back paddles didn't work no matter what software/drivers I used, none of my games ever read those paddles as an inputs.
The Raikiri Pro (was bundled with a laptop) is my current dedicated desktop controller and it works fine [for now], but I will never spend another dime on Official Xbox branded controllers. Fuck Microsoft, I hope Xbox rots!
tgt_seg:
曾经有一段时间，我信奉“一分钱一分货”的说法，认为这适用于昂贵的东西和便宜的东西；正是这个控制器让我明白并非如此。尽管我知道第一代精英系列2控制器存在一些严重缺陷，我还是决定购买它。
这款控制器仅使用了一年多，摇杆就开始漂移，右侧扳机只有一半时间能正常工作。随附的电缆质量很差，无法与其他控制器兼容。使用蓝牙时的延迟非常糟糕，几乎需要适配器。除此之外，后部拨片无论使用什么软件/驱动程序都无法工作，我的游戏中从未读取过这些拨片。
雷克里Pro（随笔记本电脑捆绑）是我目前的专用桌面控制器，目前工作正常，但绝不会再花一分钱在官方Xbox控制器上。去他的微软，我希望Xbox烂掉！

src_seg:
The Nintendo Switch reignited my love for portable gaming after years of surviving out of crappy laptops. The joycons were small but versatile, and the pro controller felt really comfortable in the hands.
I loved these controllers so much I modified them and swapped in hall-effect sticks [and metal latches] this past year, and while I'm well aware of the drift issue, mine have worked flawlessly since 2017 with no signs of wearing out. I've put just as many hours into these controllers as I did all those Xbox controllers; either I got very lucky or microsoft designs their controllers to fail faster than both of their competitors combined. Nintendo's offerings have some drawbacks, but the fact it's additional features like Gyro input have been officially supported is noteworthy.
I hope to keep these controllers working for as long as they continue to be supported on other platforms; there are many like them, but these ones are mine.
tgt_seg:
任天堂Switch重新点燃了我对掌上游戏的热情，多年以来一直依赖于糟糕的笔记本电脑。Joy-Con小巧但功能多样，Pro控制器握感非常舒适。
我非常喜欢这些控制器，今年还对它们进行了改装，换上了霍尔效应摇杆和金属卡扣，尽管我知道存在漂移问题，但自2017年以来它们一直工作正常，没有任何磨损迹象。我投入这些控制器的时间与Xbox控制器一样多；要么我非常幸运，要么微软设计的控制器比他们的竞争对手更快地失效。任天堂的产品有一些缺点，但官方支持陀螺仪输入这一点值得注意。
我希望这些控制器能在其他平台上继续得到支持，这样它们就能继续工作；有很多类似的控制器，但这些是我的。

src_seg:
A brief note on Play Station controllers to round out the 1st party lineup: I never liked them.
Dual Shock 1-3 felt exactly the same to me with exactly the same flaws: Oversized thumbsticks placed too close together, mushy face/shoulder/trigger buttons that seemed to wear out very quickly, and a D-pad that just felt wrong. Dual Shock 4 fixed a lot of problems, but introduced a bunch of new ones. I got a Dual Sense because some friends had a hard time with asymmetrical thumbsticks, and for some reason local stores were selling them for $20 less than DS4 controllers.
I don't really use this controller: Face buttons are spaced too far apart, my audio in/output keeps defaulting to the controller when it's connected, the bumpers are weirdly tall, and I keep accidentally pressing the track pad when trying to hit menu/share.
They are fine guest controllers that have come a long way in terms of design, but for me they're a novelty at best.
tgt_seg:
关于第一方PlayStation控制器的简短说明：我从未喜欢过它们。
Dual Shock 1-3感觉完全相同，有相同的缺陷：拇指摇杆过大且间距过近，面部/肩部/扳机按钮感觉很快就会磨损，以及一个感觉不对劲的方向键。Dual Shock 4解决了许多问题，但也引入了许多新问题。我买了一个Dual Sense，因为一些朋友难以适应不对称的拇指摇杆，而且不知为何当地商店以比DS4控制器便宜20美元的价格出售。
我不经常使用这个控制器：面部按钮间距过大，连接时音频输入/输出总是默认为控制器，扳机键过高，尝试按菜单/分享时经常按到触摸板。
它们在设计上进步很大，但对我来说最多只能算是一个新奇的东西。

src_seg:
8BitDo was my first foray into good 3rd party controllers. This original SN30 Pro (later versions have hall-effect sticks and do not come in the SNES colour scheme) remains one of my favourites because holding it is reminiscent of my first console, the SNES.
If I'm having a crappy day and need a nostalgic escape, this is the first controller I reach for. It has all the functionality of a Switch Pro controller, but compacted into a modernized rendition of the SNES controller, complete with concave X/Y + convex A/B buttons, and possibly the best D-pad I've ever used. It's got some minor problems, but it's been a constant source of comfort.
One day the sticks will fail, or the battery will discharge for the last time; but if it means getting one of the modern versions (with hall-effect sticks) and shell-swapping them, I'll do it when the time comes.
With such a connection, surely 8BitDo can't do better than this, right? Well...
tgt_seg:
8BitDo是我第一次接触好的第三方控制器。这款原始SN30 Pro（后来版本有霍尔效应摇杆，不提供SNES配色）仍然是我最喜欢的一款，因为握持它让我想起了我的第一台游戏机——SNES。
如果我有一个糟糕的一天，需要一个怀旧的逃避，我首先会拿起这款控制器。它具有Switch Pro控制器的所有功能，但紧凑地融合了现代版的SNES控制器，配有凹面X/Y键和凸面A/B键，可能是我用过的最好的方向键。它有一些小问题，但一直是我最可靠的伙伴。
有一天摇杆会失效，或者电池会耗尽；但如果这意味着可以升级到现代版本（带有霍尔效应摇杆）并更换外壳，我将在适当的时候这样做。
有了这种联系，8BitDo能做得比这更好吗？好吧……

src_seg:
When I want the familiar comforts of the SN30 Pro but with all the features of a modern controller, the 8BitDo Pro 2 has been my multi-platform controller of choice.
Everything about this is a functional upgrade from the SN30 Pro: more comfortable grips, hall-effect sticks, analog triggers, programmable back paddles, a physical X/D/S/A mode toggle switch, and a [somewhat] easily replaceable battery with the option of using AAs in a pinch. I also sprung for the carrying case and the mobile phone holster, which doesn't see as much use with a phone (I don't trust its grip that much), but for more compact retro emulation handhelds, it can expand the list of playable games to include ones that need precise analog controls.
There's very few negatives I can say about this controller, but it sits at a close 3rd for favourite controller of my collection. I'll talk about my number 2 pick in a moment, but before that I need to talk about...
tgt_seg:
当我想要SN30 Pro的熟悉舒适感，但又想拥有现代控制器的所有功能时，8BitDo Pro 2一直是我的多平台控制器首选。
这款控制器在几乎所有方面都比SN30 Pro有所改进：更舒适的握把，霍尔效应摇杆，模拟扳机，可编程后拨片，物理X/D/S/A模式切换开关，以及可更换电池（可使用AA电池）。我还购买了携带套和手机套，尽管手机套的使用频率不高（我不信任它的抓握），但对于更紧凑的复古模拟手持设备，它可以扩展可玩游戏的列表，包括那些需要精确模拟控制的游戏。
这款控制器几乎没有缺点，但它是我的收藏中排名第三的最爱。我将在下一刻谈到我的第二选择，但在那之前我需要谈谈……
