The Raikiri Pro (was bundled with a laptop) is my current dedicated desktop controller and it works fine [for now], but I will never spend another dime on Official Xbox branded controllers. Fuck Microsoft, I hope Xbox rots!
tgt_seg:
我曾经被“物有所值”的信条所迷惑，以为它对于昂贵的东西和便宜的东西一样适用，但正是因为这款控制器的缘故，我才明白它的局限性。我买了这款 Elite Series 2 控制器，虽然我知道第一代控制器存在一些严重的缺陷。
该控制器大约只用了近一年时间，然后开始出现摇杆飘移的情况，而右按钮只在半数情况下得到响应。附带的电缆很差劲，根本无法和其他控制器兼容。蓝牙操作的延迟实在太糟糕，不得不使用适配器。此外，无论使用什么软件和驱动程序，后部手柄都无法使用，我玩的所有游戏都无法读取这些手柄的输入。
我目前专门用来玩电脑游戏的控制器是 Raikiri Pro（这款控制器已经随笔记本电脑附送过来了），目前用着还不错，但我再也不买任何 Xbox 官方品牌控制器了。可恶的微软，我真希望 Xbox 彻底倒闭！

src_seg:
The Nintendo Switch reignited my love for portable gaming after years of surviving out of crappy laptops. The joycons were small but versatile, and the pro controller felt really comfortable in the hands.
I loved these controllers so much I modified them and swapped in hall-effect sticks [and metal latches] this past year, and while I'm well aware of the drift issue, mine have worked flawlessly since 2017 with no signs of wearing out. I've put just as many hours into these controllers as I did all those Xbox controllers; either I got very lucky or microsoft designs their controllers to fail faster than both of their competitors combined. Nintendo's offerings have some drawbacks, but the fact it's additional features like Gyro input have been officially supported is noteworthy.
I hope to keep these controllers working for as long as they continue to be supported on other platforms; there are many like them, but these ones are mine.
tgt_seg:
多年来，我一直用着性能一般的笔记本，但 Nintendo Switch 让我重新爱上便携游戏。Joy-Con 的体积小，功能多，Pro 控制器握在手里非常舒适。
我非常喜欢这款控制器，去年我对它进行了改装，换上了霍尔效应式的操纵杆和金属锁扣，虽然我知道这款控制器存在漂移问题，但自 2017 年以来，我用过的控制器都没有出现过磨损现象。我投入在这款控制器上的时间和所有 Xbox 控制器上的时间一样多，我要么运气真好，要么微软设计的控制器质量更差，比竞争对手的产品总和还要差。虽然任天堂的产品也有一些不足之处，但官方支持的陀螺仪输入等附加功能还是值得称道的。
我希望这些控制器能在其他平台上继续得到支持，我希望它们能够继续工作下去；类似的控制器有很多，但这些是我的。

src_seg:
A brief note on Play Station controllers to round out the 1st party lineup: I never liked them.
Dual Shock 1-3 felt exactly the same to me with exactly the same flaws: Oversized thumbsticks placed too close together, mushy face/shoulder/trigger buttons that seemed to wear out very quickly, and a D-pad that just felt wrong. Dual Shock 4 fixed a lot of problems, but introduced a bunch of new ones. I got a Dual Sense because some friends had a hard time with asymmetrical thumbsticks, and for some reason local stores were selling them for $20 less than DS4 controllers.
I don't really use this controller: Face buttons are spaced too far apart, my audio in/output keeps defaulting to the controller when it's connected, the bumpers are weirdly tall, and I keep accidentally pressing the track pad when trying to hit menu/share.
They are fine guest controllers that have come a long way in terms of design, but for me they're a novelty at best.
tgt_seg:
最后谈谈我对 PlayStation 控制器的看法，以完成第一方阵容的介绍。这些控制器我一直不太喜欢。
我觉得 Dual Shock 1-3 的感觉完全相同，缺点也一样：触摸板尺寸过大，放在一起的距离很近，手柄/肩部/触发按钮的手感很不好，而且很容易磨损，方向盘的设计也不是很对劲。Dual Shock 4 解决了许多问题，但也引入了一些新的问题。我是因为几个朋友对不对称触摸板很有意见，才买了 Dual Sense 控制器，而且当地的商店把 Dual Sense 控制器卖得比 DS4 控制器便宜 20 美元。
我通常很少使用这个手柄：面部按钮之间的距离过大，设备连接到手柄时，音频输入/输出就会自动切换到手柄，挡杆又太高了，我每次想按“菜单”或“分享”键时，就会无意中按到触控板。
它们是优秀的宾客控制器，设计上已经取得了长足的进步，但对我而言，它们充其量只能算是新奇之物。

src_seg:
8BitDo was my first foray into good 3rd party controllers. This original SN30 Pro (later versions have hall-effect sticks and do not come in the SNES colour scheme) remains one of my favourites because holding it is reminiscent of my first console, the SNES.
If I'm having a crappy day and need a nostalgic escape, this is the first controller I reach for. It has all the functionality of a Switch Pro controller, but compacted into a modernized rendition of the SNES controller, complete with concave X/Y + convex A/B buttons, and possibly the best D-pad I've ever used. It's got some minor problems, but it's been a constant source of comfort.
One day the sticks will fail, or the battery will discharge for the last time; but if it means getting one of the modern versions (with hall-effect sticks) and shell-swapping them, I'll do it when the time comes.
With such a connection, surely 8BitDo can't do better than this, right? Well...
tgt_seg:
对于我来说，8BitDo 是我接触第三方高质量手柄的第一站。这款原始的 SN30 Pro 手柄（之后的版本配备霍尔效应手柄杆，且外观和 SNES 颜色设计不一样）是我最喜欢的手柄之一，因为握住它会让我联想到我第一款游戏机——SNES。
如果我遇到糟糕的一天，需要寻求怀旧的慰藉，我最先拿出的就是这个游戏控制器。它拥有 Switch Pro 控制器的所有功能，却以复古的 SNES 控制器外观出现，包括凹陷的 X/Y 键和凸出的 A/B 键，还配备了可能是我用过最好的 D 按键。虽然它有一些小毛病，但一直是我的慰藉之源。
有一天，控制杆会坏掉，电池也将耗尽；但如果意味着需要购买现代版的控制杆（霍尔效应控制杆）并更换外壳，那么，到了时候我就会这么做。
有了这样一个连接，8BitDo 肯定不能做的更好，对吧？但事实并非如此……

src_seg:
When I want the familiar comforts of the SN30 Pro but with all the features of a modern controller, the 8BitDo Pro 2 has been my multi-platform controller of choice.
Everything about this is a functional upgrade from the SN30 Pro: more comfortable grips, hall-effect sticks, analog triggers, programmable back paddles, a physical X/D/S/A mode toggle switch, and a [somewhat] easily replaceable battery with the option of using AAs in a pinch. I also sprung for the carrying case and the mobile phone holster, which doesn't see as much use with a phone (I don't trust its grip that much), but for more compact retro emulation handhelds, it can expand the list of playable games to include ones that need precise analog controls.
There's very few negatives I can say about this controller, but it sits at a close 3rd for favourite controller of my collection. I'll talk about my number 2 pick in a moment, but before that I need to talk about...
tgt_seg:
每当我想要 SN30 Pro 熟悉的舒适感，但又想拥有现代控制器所具备的所有功能时，我都会选择 8BitDo Pro 2，它成为了我首选的多平台控制器。
这款游戏手柄在功能上都比 SN30 Pro 有所提升：更舒适的握把，霍尔效应传感器，模拟扳机，可编程后面板，物理式 X/D/S/A 模式切换开关，电池更换方便（并可替换为 AA 电池）。我还额外购买了保护壳和手机托（手机托用处不大，因为我不太信任它的握把），但是对于更小型的复古游戏机，它可以提供精确的模拟控制，从而让更多的游戏成为玩家的选择。
这个控制器几乎没有什么缺点，但它只排在我的最爱控制器名单中第三名。接下来我会提到我第二最爱的控制器，但在此之前我需要先说说...

src_seg:
How hard is it to find a modernized N64 controller?
There are plenty of cheap N64 imitation controllers, but the three-pronged original was an objectively bad design. I could play N64 games with a modern controller using clever configuration to make the face buttons function as C-buttons, but it's not the same for so many reasons.
I got the RetroFighters Brawler 64 to solve this anachronistic conundrum, and it's gone above and beyond my expectations. It was made to mimic the official NSO N64 controller down to the Switch recognizing it as one, with a toggle to make it register as a Pro controller sans right-stick.
It has some problems, but between its layout and compatibility it solves way more problems the official version has. It's perfect for showing someone N64 emulation without the intimidation of the original or the anachronism from finagling a modern controller to work the same.
It's very good at what it's trying to do.
tgt_seg:
现代版的 N64 控制器有多难找到？
市面上有许多便宜的任天堂 64 仿真控制器，但三叉形状的原版设计存在明显缺陷。我用现代控制器（通过巧妙配置让面部按钮作为 C 按钮使用）也能玩任天堂 64 的游戏，但这并不足以满足我的需求，原因很多。
为了解决这一不合时宜的难题，我买了一款名为“RetroFighters Brawler 64”的游戏手柄，效果超出了我的预期。这款游戏手柄旨在模拟任天堂64的官方控制器，甚至连Switch也能将其识别为任天堂64的控制器，而且有一个可切换的功能，可以使其在没有右摇杆的情况下显示为专业游戏手柄。
它确实存在一些问题，但从布局和兼容性方面来说，它解决的问题比官方版本要多得多。这款模拟器非常适合展示 N64 模拟器，它不会让人感到像原版那样令人生畏，也不需要再费劲地尝试让现代控制器做出完全相同的动作。
它在所要做的事情方面做得非常出色。

src_seg:
I got this steam controller from a pawn shop after negotiating the price down shortly after the fire sale came to an end on steam. It needed some TLC, and I did what I could to get it up and running again.
It remains one of the most customizable controllers in my collection, with a unique [if questionable] design and features ahead of it's time (gyro aim, back paddles, haptic feedback, etc). It has some problems though; It requires AAs, uses Micro-USB for wired connections, occasionally turns itself back on after being turned off, the back paddles are stiff enough to cause fatigue, the thumbstick cap is necessary since the rubber on it is deteriorating, and it's functionality tends to fluctuate with every update to steam input.
It's more of a unique historical artifact than a regularly used input, but it's a welcome addition and fun to tinker with on rainy days.
It also isn't my number 2 pick, that honour goes to the fact that...
tgt_seg:
我在古玩铺里以议价的方式买下了这款 Steam 控制器，当时 Steam 的火爆促销刚刚结束。它需要一些小修小补，我尽力让它恢复工作状态。
这款游戏手柄仍然是我收藏中最具定制性的一种，具有独特（尽管有些值得商榷）的设计，性能在当时就领先了一大步（例如：陀螺仪瞄准、后部操纵杆、触觉反馈等）。但它也存在一些问题：需要 6 节 AA 电池，有线连接采用微型 USB，关闭后偶尔会自动开启，后部操纵杆过硬，使用一段时间会使人感到疲劳，橡胶盖需要紧闭，不然橡胶会渐渐脱落，而且每次更新 Steam 输入控制器的功能都会有波动。
这是一件比较独特的历史文物，而不是日常使用之物，但它可谓是雨天时的福音，玩起来也很有趣。
这也不是我的第二选择，因为该殊荣属于……

src_seg:
The 8BitDo Ultimate Bluetooth controller is an almost perfect controller.
Hall-effect sticks, included charging dock that doubles as a port for the included dongle, dedicated 2.4ghz/bluetooth toggle switch, NS Pro layout with a much improved D-pad, analog triggers, and programmable back paddles. When I sit down on a couch with this controller, I can swap between a Steam Deck and a Switch faster than the time it takes the TV to switch inputs.
It does have some drawbacks though: It only does X/Switch signals (no android or apple modes), the triggers are uncomfortable, and input lag seems to be affected by the time it took to connect to the dongle/switch.
I thought this was the best it could get, but like my time with Xbox controllers I was operating on assumptions that started to sound like old brand loyalty reflexes coming back. What I'd hoped to upgrade it to was such a disappointment it swiftly shook me from those assumptions.
tgt_seg:
8BitDo 终极蓝牙控制器的性能几乎堪称完美。
这款游戏手柄还配有霍尔效应传感器，其中的充电底座还可以充当专用适配器（随附的适配器）的接口，还有一个用于开启 2.4G 无线和蓝牙的独立切换开关，采用了 NS Pro 布局设计，方向键、模拟摇杆和可编程背部按键都经过了重大改进。我用这款游戏手柄坐在沙发上，更换 Steam Deck 和 Switch 游戏主机的时间比电视更换输入信号的时间还要短。
不过也有一些不良之处：它只支持X/Switch信号（不支持安卓和苹果模式），触发器使用起来不太舒适，输入延迟似乎会受到与适配器/Switch连接所需时间的影响。
起初我认为它已经达到最佳水平了，但就像我使用 Xbox 控制器的那段时间一样，我发现自己的行为基于一系列假设，这些假设似乎又引发了对旧款产品的忠诚度反射。我一直希望升级它，结果却让我大失所望，导致我很快就对这些假设产生了怀疑。

src_seg:
Even though I've mostly transitioned to PC gaming over the past decade, my preferred peripherals are still controllers.
I understand the advantages of KB+M play, but as someone who already uses those tools for work I find picking up a controller helps separate the two activities and gives my wrists a break. I've also been playing video games long enough to see the technology and layouts used drastically change, though some first party controllers seem to have stagnated a bit.
I recently found a controller I really liked because it has features that have really impressed me enough to want to talk about it at length, but to do that I feel the need for some context; not a whole history lesson, just a little stroll through my collection of controllers that materialized over a lifetime of engaging in this hobby.
By the end I hope you'll understand why this is a topic I care so much about I'd spend all day talking about these devices.
tgt_seg:
尽管在过去的十年中，我大部分时间都过渡到PC游戏，但我的首选外围设备仍然是控制器。
我理解KB+M play的优点，但作为一个已经使用这些工具工作的人，我发现拿起一个控制器有助于分离两个活动，并让我的手腕休息一下。 我也一直在玩视频游戏足够长的时间，看到使用的技术和布局发生了巨大变化，尽管一些第一方控制器似乎停滞不前了一点。
我最近发现了一个我非常喜欢的控制器，因为它的特性给我留下了深刻的印象，我想详细地谈论它，但要做到这一点，我觉得需要一些背景；不是一个完整的历史课，只是在我的控制器集合中漫步一下，这些控制器在从事这个爱好的一生中实现了。
最后，我希望你能理解为什么这是一个我非常关心的话题，我会花一整天的时间谈论这些设备。

src_seg:
My decision to build up a PC game collection started during the transition between the Xbox 360 and the Xbox One; I thoroughly enjoyed the 360, but the One was looking like a disaster. Since the new consoles from all three major companies held little interest and I'd been in school for Computer Information Systems, I got myself a 360 pc dongle and resolved to make the switch.
Each of these controllers saw extensive use, and the 360 had the asymmetrical stick placement I preferred. All but two of the controllers in this picture are currently unusable either from loose/drifting sticks, faulty buttons, or failing cables/connections; both of the working ones are 3rd party Afterglows (which have their own problems).
As much as I loved these controllers, the official ones were the worst in terms of durability, and some were faulty from day one but Microsoft would refuse my RMA request.
It got worse when I tried the most expensive one.
tgt_seg:
我决定建立一个PC游戏系列是在Xbox360和Xbox One之间的过渡期间开始的;我非常喜欢360，但那个看起来像是一场灾难。 由于所有三家大公司的新游戏机都没有多大兴趣，而且我一直在学校学习计算机信息系统，所以我给自己买了一台360pc加密狗，并决心进行切换。
这些控制器中的每一个都得到了广泛的使用，并且360具有我喜欢的不对称棒放置。 除了这张照片中的两个控制器之外，所有的控制器目前都无法使用，无论是松散的/漂移的棒，错误的按钮，还是失败的电缆/连接；两个工作的都是第三方余辉（它们有自己的问题）。
就像我喜欢这些控制器一样，官方的控制器在耐用性方面是最差的，有些从第一天起就出现了故障，但微软会拒绝我的RMA请求。
当我尝试最昂贵的时候，情况变得更糟。

src_seg:
There was a time when I fell for the myth that "You get what you pay for" was as true for expensive stuff as it was for cheap stuff; it's because of this controller that I know better. I got this Elite Series 2 controller despite knowing the first iteration had some serious flaws.
That controller lasted just under a year before the stick drift started to set in, and the right bumper only registered half of the time. The cable it came with sucks ass, never worked with any other controllers. The lag from using bluetooth was so bad the dongle was practically necessary. On top of all that, the back paddles didn't work no matter what software/drivers I used, none of my games ever read those paddles as an inputs.
The Raikiri Pro (was bundled with a laptop) is my current dedicated desktop controller and it works fine [for now], but I will never spend another dime on Official Xbox branded controllers. Fuck Microsoft, I hope Xbox rots!
tgt_seg:
曾经有一段时间，我爱上了"你得到你所支付的"的神话，对于昂贵的东西和便宜的东西一样真实;正是因为这个控制器，我知道得更好。 我得到了这个精英系列2控制器，尽管我知道第一次迭代有一些严重的缺陷。
那个控制器在棒漂移开始进入之前持续了不到一年，而右保险杠只记录了一半的时间。 它附带的电缆很糟糕，从未与任何其他控制器一起工作。 使用蓝牙的滞后非常糟糕，实际上是必要的。 最重要的是，无论我使用什么软件/驱动程序，后面的拨片都不起作用，我的游戏都没有将这些拨片作为输入。
Raikiri Pro（与笔记本电脑捆绑在一起）是我目前的专用桌面控制器，它可以正常工作[目前]，但我永远不会在官方Xbox品牌控制器上花费另一分钱。 他妈的微软，我希望Xbox腐烂！

src_seg:
The Nintendo Switch reignited my love for portable gaming after years of surviving out of crappy laptops. The joycons were small but versatile, and the pro controller felt really comfortable in the hands.
I loved these controllers so much I modified them and swapped in hall-effect sticks [and metal latches] this past year, and while I'm well aware of the drift issue, mine have worked flawlessly since 2017 with no signs of wearing out. I've put just as many hours into these controllers as I did all those Xbox controllers; either I got very lucky or microsoft designs their controllers to fail faster than both of their competitors combined. Nintendo's offerings have some drawbacks, but the fact it's additional features like Gyro input have been officially supported is noteworthy.
I hope to keep these controllers working for as long as they continue to be supported on other platforms; there are many like them, but these ones are mine.
tgt_seg:
经过多年从蹩脚的笔记本电脑中幸存下来，Nintendo Switch重新点燃了我对便携式游戏的热爱。 Joycons很小，但用途广泛，pro控制器在手中感觉非常舒适。
我非常喜欢这些控制器，我在过去的一年里对它们进行了修改并交换了霍尔效应棒[和金属闩锁]，虽然我很清楚漂移问题，但我的控制器自2017年以来一直 我在这些控制器上投入了与我所做的所有Xbox控制器一样多的时间;要么我非常幸运，要么微软设计他们的控制器比他们的竞争对手加起来更快地失败。 任天堂的产品有一些缺点，但事实上它的额外功能，如陀螺输入已经正式支持是值得注意的。
我希望保持这些控制器的工作，只要他们继续在其他平台上支持;有很多像他们一样，但这些是我的。

src_seg:
A brief note on Play Station controllers to round out the 1st party lineup: I never liked them.
Dual Shock 1-3 felt exactly the same to me with exactly the same flaws: Oversized thumbsticks placed too close together, mushy face/shoulder/trigger buttons that seemed to wear out very quickly, and a D-pad that just felt wrong. Dual Shock 4 fixed a lot of problems, but introduced a bunch of new ones. I got a Dual Sense because some friends had a hard time with asymmetrical thumbsticks, and for some reason local stores were selling them for $20 less than DS4 controllers.
I don't really use this controller: Face buttons are spaced too far apart, my audio in/output keeps defaulting to the controller when it's connected, the bumpers are weirdly tall, and I keep accidentally pressing the track pad when trying to hit menu/share.
They are fine guest controllers that have come a long way in terms of design, but for me they're a novelty at best.
tgt_seg:
一个关于游戏站控制器的简短说明，以完善第一党的阵容：我从不喜欢他们。
Dual Shock1-3对我来说感觉完全一样，有完全相同的缺陷：超大的拇指放得太近，糊状的脸部/肩部/触发器按钮似乎很快磨损，还有一个D-pad，只是感觉不对。 Dual Shock4修复了很多问题，但引入了一堆新问题。 我得到了双重感觉，因为一些朋友很难使用不对称的拇指柄，并且由于某种原因，当地商店以比DS4控制器少20美元的价格出售它们。
我并没有真正使用这个控制器：面部按钮间隔太远，我的音频输入/输出在连接时一直默认到控制器，保险杠非常高，并且我在尝试点击菜单/共享时不小心按
他们是很好的客人控制器，在设计方面已经走了很长的路，但对我来说，他们是一个新奇的充其量。

src_seg:
8BitDo was my first foray into good 3rd party controllers. This original SN30 Pro (later versions have hall-effect sticks and do not come in the SNES colour scheme) remains one of my favourites because holding it is reminiscent of my first console, the SNES.
If I'm having a crappy day and need a nostalgic escape, this is the first controller I reach for. It has all the functionality of a Switch Pro controller, but compacted into a modernized rendition of the SNES controller, complete with concave X/Y + convex A/B buttons, and possibly the best D-pad I've ever used. It's got some minor problems, but it's been a constant source of comfort.
One day the sticks will fail, or the battery will discharge for the last time; but if it means getting one of the modern versions (with hall-effect sticks) and shell-swapping them, I'll do it when the time comes.
With such a connection, surely 8BitDo can't do better than this, right? Well...
tgt_seg:
8BitDo是我第一次涉足优秀的第三方控制器。 这个原始的SN30Pro（后来的版本有霍尔效应棒，没有在SNES配色方案）仍然是我的最爱之一，因为拿着它让人想起我的第一个控制台，SNES。
如果我有一个糟糕的一天，需要一个怀旧的逃避，这是我接触的第一个控制器。 它具有Switch Pro控制器的所有功能，但压缩为SNES控制器的现代化再现，配有凹形X/Y+凸形A/B按钮，可能是我用过的最好的D-pad。 它有一些小问题，但它一直是安慰的源泉。
有一天棒会失败，或者电池会最后一次放电;但如果这意味着获得现代版本之一（带有霍尔效应棒）并将它们换壳，我会在时机成熟时这样做。
有了这样的联系，肯定8BitDo不能做得比这更好，对吧？ 好吧。..

src_seg:
When I want the familiar comforts of the SN30 Pro but with all the features of a modern controller, the 8BitDo Pro 2 has been my multi-platform controller of choice.
Everything about this is a functional upgrade from the SN30 Pro: more comfortable grips, hall-effect sticks, analog triggers, programmable back paddles, a physical X/D/S/A mode toggle switch, and a [somewhat] easily replaceable battery with the option of using AAs in a pinch. I also sprung for the carrying case and the mobile phone holster, which doesn't see as much use with a phone (I don't trust its grip that much), but for more compact retro emulation handhelds, it can expand the list of playable games to include ones that need precise analog controls.
There's very few negatives I can say about this controller, but it sits at a close 3rd for favourite controller of my collection. I'll talk about my number 2 pick in a moment, but before that I need to talk about...
tgt_seg:
当我想要sn30Pro的熟悉舒适，但具有现代控制器的所有功能时，8BitDo Pro2一直是我的多平台控制器的选择。
这一切都是SN30Pro的功能升级：更舒适的握把，霍尔效应棒，模拟触发器，可编程后拨片，物理X/D/S/a模式切换开关，以及一个[有点]易于更换的电池，可以选 我还为手提箱和手机皮套如雨后春笋般出现，这对手机没有多大用处（我不太相信它的抓地力），但对于更紧凑的复古仿效手持设备，它可以扩展可玩游戏的列表，包括那些需要精确模拟控制的游戏。
有很少的负面我可以说这个控制器，但它坐在一个接近3rd我收藏的最喜欢的控制器。 我一会儿再谈我的第二号选择，但在此之前我需要谈谈。..

src_seg:
How hard is it to find a modernized N64 controller?
There are plenty of cheap N64 imitation controllers, but the three-pronged original was an objectively bad design. I could play N64 games with a modern controller using clever configuration to make the face buttons function as C-buttons, but it's not the same for so many reasons.
I got the RetroFighters Brawler 64 to solve this anachronistic conundrum, and it's gone above and beyond my expectations. It was made to mimic the official NSO N64 controller down to the Switch recognizing it as one, with a toggle to make it register as a Pro controller sans right-stick.
It has some problems, but between its layout and compatibility it solves way more problems the official version has. It's perfect for showing someone N64 emulation without the intimidation of the original or the anachronism from finagling a modern controller to work the same.
It's very good at what it's trying to do.
tgt_seg:
找到现代化的N64控制器有多难？
有很多便宜的n64模仿控制器，但三管齐下的原始是一个客观糟糕的设计。 我可以用一个现代控制器玩N64游戏，使用巧妙的配置使脸部按钮功能为C按钮，但由于很多原因，它是不一样的。
我得到了RetroFighters Brawler64来解决这个不合时宜的难题，它超出了我的预期。 它是为了模仿官方的NSO N64控制器，直到开关识别它作为一个，与一个切换，使它注册为一个专业控制器没有右棒。
它有一些问题，但在它的布局和兼容性之间，它解决了官方版本的更多问题。 这是完美的显示某人N64仿真没有恐吓的原始或不合时宜的敲定一个现代控制器工作相同。
它很擅长它想做的事情。

src_seg:
I got this steam controller from a pawn shop after negotiating the price down shortly after the fire sale came to an end on steam. It needed some TLC, and I did what I could to get it up and running again.
It remains one of the most customizable controllers in my collection, with a unique [if questionable] design and features ahead of it's time (gyro aim, back paddles, haptic feedback, etc). It has some problems though; It requires AAs, uses Micro-USB for wired connections, occasionally turns itself back on after being turned off, the back paddles are stiff enough to cause fatigue, the thumbstick cap is necessary since the rubber on it is deteriorating, and it's functionality tends to fluctuate with every update to steam input.
It's more of a unique historical artifact than a regularly used input, but it's a welcome addition and fun to tinker with on rainy days.
It also isn't my number 2 pick, that honour goes to the fact that...
tgt_seg:
在火灾销售结束后不久，我从当铺买到了这个蒸汽控制器。 它需要一些薄层色谱，我尽我所能让它恢复运行。
它仍然是我收藏中最可定制的控制器之一，具有独特的（如果有问题的话）设计和功能（陀螺瞄准，后拨片，触觉反馈等）。 它有一些问题，虽然;它需要AAs，使用Micro-USB进行有线连接，偶尔会在关闭后重新打开，后拨片足够僵硬，导致疲劳，拇指杆帽是必要的，因为它上的橡胶正在恶化，
它更像是一个独特的历史文物，而不是一个经常使用的输入，但它是一个受欢迎的补充和有趣的修补在雨天。
这也不是我的第二选择，这一荣誉是因为这一事实。..

src_seg:
The 8BitDo Ultimate Bluetooth controller is an almost perfect controller.
Hall-effect sticks, included charging dock that doubles as a port for the included dongle, dedicated 2.4ghz/bluetooth toggle switch, NS Pro layout with a much improved D-pad, analog triggers, and programmable back paddles. When I sit down on a couch with this controller, I can swap between a Steam Deck and a Switch faster than the time it takes the TV to switch inputs.
It does have some drawbacks though: It only does X/Switch signals (no android or apple modes), the triggers are uncomfortable, and input lag seems to be affected by the time it took to connect to the dongle/switch.
I thought this was the best it could get, but like my time with Xbox controllers I was operating on assumptions that started to sound like old brand loyalty reflexes coming back. What I'd hoped to upgrade it to was such a disappointment it swiftly shook me from those assumptions.
tgt_seg:
8BitDo Ultimate蓝牙控制器是一款近乎完美的控制器。
霍尔效应棒，包括兼作端口的充电码头，专用的2.4ghz/蓝牙切换开关，NSPRO布局与一个大大改进的D-pad，模拟触发器和可编程后拨。 当我用这个控制器坐在沙发上时，我可以比电视切换输入所需的时间更快地在蒸汽甲板和开关之间交换。
它确实有一些缺点：它只做X/Switch信号（没有android或apple模式），触发器不舒服，输入滞后似乎受到连接到加密狗/交换机所需时间的影响。
我认为这是它能得到的最好的，但就像我与Xbox控制器的时间一样，我的假设开始听起来像旧品牌的忠诚度反应回来。 我希望将其升级为如此令人失望，它很快就让我摆脱了这些假设。

src_seg:
Even though I've mostly transitioned to PC gaming over the past decade, my preferred peripherals are still controllers.
I understand the advantages of KB+M play, but as someone who already uses those tools for work I find picking up a controller helps separate the two activities and gives my wrists a break. I've also been playing video games long enough to see the technology and layouts used drastically change, though some first party controllers seem to have stagnated a bit.
I recently found a controller I really liked because it has features that have really impressed me enough to want to talk about it at length, but to do that I feel the need for some context; not a whole history lesson, just a little stroll through my collection of controllers that materialized over a lifetime of engaging in this hobby.
By the end I hope you'll understand why this is a topic I care so much about I'd spend all day talking about these devices.
tgt_seg:
尽管过去十年我主要转向 PC 游戏，但我首选的外围设备仍然是控制器。
我了解 KB+M 游戏的优势，但作为已经在工作中使用这些工具的人，我发现拿起控制器有助于区分这两项活动并让我的手腕得到休息。我玩电子游戏的时间也足够长，见证了所使用的技术和布局发生了巨大的变化，尽管一些第一方控制器似乎有点停滞不前。
我最近发现了一个我非常喜欢的控制器，因为它的功能给我留下了深刻的印象，让我想详细地谈论它，但要做到这一点，我觉得需要一些背景知识；不是一整堂历史课，只是稍微浏览一下我一生从事这项爱好时收集的控制器。
最后，我希望你能理解为什么我如此关心这个话题，我愿意花一整天的时间谈论这些设备。

src_seg:
My decision to build up a PC game collection started during the transition between the Xbox 360 and the Xbox One; I thoroughly enjoyed the 360, but the One was looking like a disaster. Since the new consoles from all three major companies held little interest and I'd been in school for Computer Information Systems, I got myself a 360 pc dongle and resolved to make the switch.
Each of these controllers saw extensive use, and the 360 had the asymmetrical stick placement I preferred. All but two of the controllers in this picture are currently unusable either from loose/drifting sticks, faulty buttons, or failing cables/connections; both of the working ones are 3rd party Afterglows (which have their own problems).
As much as I loved these controllers, the official ones were the worst in terms of durability, and some were faulty from day one but Microsoft would refuse my RMA request.
It got worse when I tried the most expensive one.
tgt_seg:
我建立 PC 游戏收藏的决定始于 Xbox 360 和 Xbox One 之间的过渡期间;我非常喜欢 360 度，但 One 看起来就像一场灾难。由于这三家大公司的新游戏机都没什么兴趣，而且我一直在上计算机信息系统学校，所以我给自己买了一个 360 pc 加密狗，并决定进行转换。
这些控制器均得到了广泛的使用，而 360 具有我喜欢的不对称摇杆位置。此图片中除两个控制器外，其余所有控制器目前均无法使用，原因是摇杆松动/漂移、按钮故障或电缆/连接故障；两个可以正常工作的控制器都是第三方 Afterglows（它们有自己的问题）。
尽管我很喜欢这些控制器，但官方的控制器在耐用性方面是最差的，有些从第一天起就有故障，但微软拒绝了我的 RMA 请求。
当我尝试最贵的一个时，情况变得更糟了。

src_seg:
There was a time when I fell for the myth that "You get what you pay for" was as true for expensive stuff as it was for cheap stuff; it's because of this controller that I know better. I got this Elite Series 2 controller despite knowing the first iteration had some serious flaws.
That controller lasted just under a year before the stick drift started to set in, and the right bumper only registered half of the time. The cable it came with sucks ass, never worked with any other controllers. The lag from using bluetooth was so bad the dongle was practically necessary. On top of all that, the back paddles didn't work no matter what software/drivers I used, none of my games ever read those paddles as an inputs.
The Raikiri Pro (was bundled with a laptop) is my current dedicated desktop controller and it works fine [for now], but I will never spend another dime on Official Xbox branded controllers. Fuck Microsoft, I hope Xbox rots!
tgt_seg:
曾经有一段时间，我误以为“一分钱一分货”这个道理对于昂贵的东西和便宜的东西都适用；有了这个控制器，我才更加了解它。尽管我知道第一代 Elite Series 2 控制器存在一些严重缺陷，但我还是购买了它。
该控制器仅使用了不到一年的时间，之后就开始出现摇杆漂移，并且右保险杠只有一半的时间能够正常工作。它附带的电缆很烂，无法与任何其他控制器配合使用。使用蓝牙的延迟非常严重，因此实际上需要使用加密狗。最重要的是，无论我使用什么软件/驱动程序，后拨片都不起作用，我的任何游戏都无法将这些拨片读取为输入。
Raikiri Pro（与笔记本电脑捆绑销售）是我目前的专用桌面控制器，它现在运行良好，但我永远不会再花一分钱购买官方 Xbox 品牌控制器。操微软，我希望 Xbox 烂掉！

src_seg:
The Nintendo Switch reignited my love for portable gaming after years of surviving out of crappy laptops. The joycons were small but versatile, and the pro controller felt really comfortable in the hands.
I loved these controllers so much I modified them and swapped in hall-effect sticks [and metal latches] this past year, and while I'm well aware of the drift issue, mine have worked flawlessly since 2017 with no signs of wearing out. I've put just as many hours into these controllers as I did all those Xbox controllers; either I got very lucky or microsoft designs their controllers to fail faster than both of their competitors combined. Nintendo's offerings have some drawbacks, but the fact it's additional features like Gyro input have been officially supported is noteworthy.
I hope to keep these controllers working for as long as they continue to be supported on other platforms; there are many like them, but these ones are mine.
tgt_seg:
在使用劣质笔记本电脑多年之后，任天堂 Switch 重新点燃了我对便携式游戏的热爱。Joycon 虽小但功能多样，而且专业控制器握在手中感觉非常舒适。
我非常喜欢这些控制器，在过去的一年里，我修改了它们并更换了霍尔效应摇杆 [和金属闩锁]，虽然我很清楚漂移问题，但我的控制器自 2017 年以来一直完美运行，没有磨损的迹象。我在这些控制器上投入的时间与我在所有这些 Xbox 控制器上投入的时间一样多;要么我很幸运，要么微软设计的控制器失败速度比他们的两个竞争对手加起来还要快。任天堂的产品有一些缺点，但值得注意的是，它的官方支持之类的附加功能（如陀螺仪输入）。
我希望只要这些控制器在其他平台上继续受支持，它们就能继续工作；有很多类似的控制器，但这些是我的。

src_seg:
A brief note on Play Station controllers to round out the 1st party lineup: I never liked them.
Dual Shock 1-3 felt exactly the same to me with exactly the same flaws: Oversized thumbsticks placed too close together, mushy face/shoulder/trigger buttons that seemed to wear out very quickly, and a D-pad that just felt wrong. Dual Shock 4 fixed a lot of problems, but introduced a bunch of new ones. I got a Dual Sense because some friends had a hard time with asymmetrical thumbsticks, and for some reason local stores were selling them for $20 less than DS4 controllers.
I don't really use this controller: Face buttons are spaced too far apart, my audio in/output keeps defaulting to the controller when it's connected, the bumpers are weirdly tall, and I keep accidentally pressing the track pad when trying to hit menu/share.
They are fine guest controllers that have come a long way in terms of design, but for me they're a novelty at best.
tgt_seg:
关于 Play Station 控制器的简要说明，以完善第一方阵容：我从来都不喜欢它们。
Dual Shock 1-3 对我来说感觉完全相同，但存在完全相同的缺陷：超大的拇指杆放置得太近，糊状的脸/肩膀/扳机按钮似乎很快就磨损了，以及感觉不对劲的方向键。Dual Shock 4 解决了很多问题，但引入了一堆新问题。我之所以得到 Dual Sense，是因为一些朋友很难使用不对称的拇指摇杆，并且出于某种原因，当地商店以比 DS20 控制器低 4 美元的价格出售它们。
我实际上并不使用这个控制器：面部按钮之间的距离太远，连接时我的音频输入/输出始终默认为控制器，保险杠异常高，并且我在尝试点击菜单/共享时总是意外按下触控板。
它们是优质的客座控制器，在设计方面已经取得了长足的进步，但对我来说，它们充其量只是一种新奇事物。

有了这样的连接，8BitDo 肯定不能做得比这更好，对吧？出色地...

src_seg:
I got this steam controller from a pawn shop after negotiating the price down shortly after the fire sale came to an end on steam. It needed some TLC, and I did what I could to get it up and running again.
It remains one of the most customizable controllers in my collection, with a unique [if questionable] design and features ahead of it's time (gyro aim, back paddles, haptic feedback, etc). It has some problems though; It requires AAs, uses Micro-USB for wired connections, occasionally turns itself back on after being turned off, the back paddles are stiff enough to cause fatigue, the thumbstick cap is necessary since the rubber on it is deteriorating, and it's functionality tends to fluctuate with every update to steam input.
It's more of a unique historical artifact than a regularly used input, but it's a welcome addition and fun to tinker with on rainy days.
It also isn't my number 2 pick, that honour goes to the fact that...
tgt_seg:
在 Steam 大减价结束后不久，我通过谈判降价从一家当铺买到了这个 Steam 控制器。它需要一些 TLC，我尽我所能让它重新启动并运行。
它仍然是我收藏中最可定制的控制器之一，具有独特的（如果有疑问的话）设计和领先于时代的功能（陀螺仪瞄准、后拨片、触觉反馈等）。但它也存在一些问题；它需要 AA 电池，使用 Micro-USB 进行有线连接，关闭后偶尔会自动重新打开，后拨片太硬容易引起疲劳，拇指摇杆帽是必需的，因为其上的橡胶正在老化，并且它的功能往往会随着蒸汽输入的每次更新而波动。
它更像是一种独特的历史文物，而不是一种经常使用的输入，但它是一种受欢迎的补充，并且在雨天摆弄它很有趣。
它也不是我的第二选择，这个荣誉归功于......

src_seg:
The 8BitDo Ultimate Bluetooth controller is an almost perfect controller.
Hall-effect sticks, included charging dock that doubles as a port for the included dongle, dedicated 2.4ghz/bluetooth toggle switch, NS Pro layout with a much improved D-pad, analog triggers, and programmable back paddles. When I sit down on a couch with this controller, I can swap between a Steam Deck and a Switch faster than the time it takes the TV to switch inputs.
It does have some drawbacks though: It only does X/Switch signals (no android or apple modes), the triggers are uncomfortable, and input lag seems to be affected by the time it took to connect to the dongle/switch.
I thought this was the best it could get, but like my time with Xbox controllers I was operating on assumptions that started to sound like old brand loyalty reflexes coming back. What I'd hoped to upgrade it to was such a disappointment it swiftly shook me from those assumptions.
tgt_seg:
8BitDo Ultimate 蓝牙控制器是一款近乎完美的控制器。
霍尔效应摇杆，包括可兼作随附加密狗端口的充电座、专用 2.4ghz/蓝牙拨动开关、带有大大改进的方向键的 NS Pro 布局、模拟触发器和可编程后桨。当我带着这个控制器坐在沙发上时，我可以在 Steam Deck 和 Switch 之间切换，比电视切换输入的时间还要快。
但它确实有一些缺点：它只接收 X/Switch 信号（没有安卓或苹果模式），触发器不舒服，并且输入延迟似乎受到连接到加密狗/开关所花费时间的影响。
我认为这是它能达到的最好效果，但就像我使用 Xbox 控制器时一样，我所依据的假设听起来像是旧的品牌忠诚度反射又回来了。我原本希望将其升级到如此程度却让我大失所望，这让我很快放弃了这些假设。

src_seg:
Even though I've mostly transitioned to PC gaming over the past decade, my preferred peripherals are still controllers.
I understand the advantages of KB+M play, but as someone who already uses those tools for work I find picking up a controller helps separate the two activities and gives my wrists a break. I've also been playing video games long enough to see the technology and layouts used drastically change, though some first party controllers seem to have stagnated a bit.
I recently found a controller I really liked because it has features that have really impressed me enough to want to talk about it at length, but to do that I feel the need for some context; not a whole history lesson, just a little stroll through my collection of controllers that materialized over a lifetime of engaging in this hobby.
By the end I hope you'll understand why this is a topic I care so much about I'd spend all day talking about these devices.
tgt_seg:
尽管在过去十年里我大多数时间都转向了PC游戏，但我仍然更喜欢用手柄。
我理解键盘加鼠标玩游戏的优势，但作为已经在工作中使用这些工具的人，我发现拿起手柄可以帮助我将这两种活动区分开，并给我的手腕一个休息。我玩电子游戏的时间够长，见证了技术和布局的巨大变化，尽管一些第一方手柄似乎停滞不前。
我最近找到了一款让我非常喜欢的手柄，因为它有一些让我印象深刻的功能，足以让我想详细谈谈，但我觉得有必要提供一些背景资料；不是整个历史课，只是简单回顾一下我这辈子在这个爱好中积累的手柄收藏。
我希望到最后你能明白为什么这是一个我如此关心的话题，我愿意花一整天的时间去谈论这些设备。

src_seg:
My decision to build up a PC game collection started during the transition between the Xbox 360 and the Xbox One; I thoroughly enjoyed the 360, but the One was looking like a disaster. Since the new consoles from all three major companies held little interest and I'd been in school for Computer Information Systems, I got myself a 360 pc dongle and resolved to make the switch.
Each of these controllers saw extensive use, and the 360 had the asymmetrical stick placement I preferred. All but two of the controllers in this picture are currently unusable either from loose/drifting sticks, faulty buttons, or failing cables/connections; both of the working ones are 3rd party Afterglows (which have their own problems).
As much as I loved these controllers, the official ones were the worst in terms of durability, and some were faulty from day one but Microsoft would refuse my RMA request.
It got worse when I tried the most expensive one.
tgt_seg:
我决定开始建立PC游戏收藏是在Xbox 360与Xbox One过渡期间；我非常喜欢360，但One看起来像个灾难。因为三大公司的新主机都让我兴趣不大，而我一直在学习计算机信息系统，所以我给自己买了一个360的PC接收器，决心做出转变。
这些手柄都被广泛使用，而360有我喜欢的非对称摇杆布局。这张照片中的手柄除了两个以外都目前无法使用，原因是摇杆松动/漂移、按钮故障或电缆/连接问题；两个仍然可以工作的都是第三方的Afterglow款（它们也有自己的问题）。
虽然我很喜欢这些手柄，但官方的手柄在耐用性方面是最糟糕的，有些从一开始就有缺陷，但微软会拒绝我的退货请求。
当我尝试最贵的那款时，情况变得更糟。

src_seg:
There was a time when I fell for the myth that "You get what you pay for" was as true for expensive stuff as it was for cheap stuff; it's because of this controller that I know better. I got this Elite Series 2 controller despite knowing the first iteration had some serious flaws.
That controller lasted just under a year before the stick drift started to set in, and the right bumper only registered half of the time. The cable it came with sucks ass, never worked with any other controllers. The lag from using bluetooth was so bad the dongle was practically necessary. On top of all that, the back paddles didn't work no matter what software/drivers I used, none of my games ever read those paddles as an inputs.
The Raikiri Pro (was bundled with a laptop) is my current dedicated desktop controller and it works fine [for now], but I will never spend another dime on Official Xbox branded controllers. Fuck Microsoft, I hope Xbox rots!
tgt_seg:
曾经有一段时间，我相信“你花的每一分钱都值得”的说法在贵的东西和便宜的东西上都是成立的；正是因为这款手柄我才知道事实并非如此。我买了这个Elite Series 2手柄，尽管知道第一代有严重缺陷。
那个手柄不到一年就开始出现摇杆漂移，而且右侧肩键的注册率只有一半。它附带的线缆很糟糕，从未与其他手柄兼容。使用蓝牙的延迟非常严重，以至于接收器几乎是必需的。更糟的是，后面的拨片无论我使用什么软件/驱动程序都无法正常工作，我的游戏从未识别到这些拨片作为输入。
Raikiri Pro（与一台笔记本电脑捆绑在一起）是我当前专用的桌面手柄，暂时能正常工作，但我再也不会在官方Xbox品牌的手柄上花一分钱。去你妈的微软，我希望Xbox烂掉！

src_seg:
The Nintendo Switch reignited my love for portable gaming after years of surviving out of crappy laptops. The joycons were small but versatile, and the pro controller felt really comfortable in the hands.
I loved these controllers so much I modified them and swapped in hall-effect sticks [and metal latches] this past year, and while I'm well aware of the drift issue, mine have worked flawlessly since 2017 with no signs of wearing out. I've put just as many hours into these controllers as I did all those Xbox controllers; either I got very lucky or microsoft designs their controllers to fail faster than both of their competitors combined. Nintendo's offerings have some drawbacks, but the fact it's additional features like Gyro input have been officially supported is noteworthy.
I hope to keep these controllers working for as long as they continue to be supported on other platforms; there are many like them, but these ones are mine.
tgt_seg:
任天堂Switch在我多年依赖糟糕笔记本电脑的生存中重新点燃了我对便携式游戏的热爱。Joy-Con小巧但功能多样，专业手柄在手中感觉非常舒适。
我非常喜欢这些手柄，于是在过去一年里对它们进行了改装，换上了霍尔效应摇杆和金属钩扣，虽然我很清楚漂移问题，但自2017年以来我的手柄一直工作得很好，没有磨损的迹象。我在这些手柄上投入的时间与之前所有Xbox手柄的时间一样；要么我运气很好，要么微软设计的手柄比他们的两个竞争对手的手柄更容易失败。任天堂的产品有一些缺陷，但像陀螺仪输入这样的额外功能获得官方支持是值得注意的。
我希望这些手柄能在其他平台继续获得支持的同时工作尽可能长的时间；有很多类似的手柄，但这些是我的。

src_seg:
A brief note on Play Station controllers to round out the 1st party lineup: I never liked them.
Dual Shock 1-3 felt exactly the same to me with exactly the same flaws: Oversized thumbsticks placed too close together, mushy face/shoulder/trigger buttons that seemed to wear out very quickly, and a D-pad that just felt wrong. Dual Shock 4 fixed a lot of problems, but introduced a bunch of new ones. I got a Dual Sense because some friends had a hard time with asymmetrical thumbsticks, and for some reason local stores were selling them for $20 less than DS4 controllers.
I don't really use this controller: Face buttons are spaced too far apart, my audio in/output keeps defaulting to the controller when it's connected, the bumpers are weirdly tall, and I keep accidentally pressing the track pad when trying to hit menu/share.
They are fine guest controllers that have come a long way in terms of design, but for me they're a novelty at best.
tgt_seg:
关于PlayStation手柄的简要说明，补充第一方阵容：我从来不喜欢它们。
Dual Shock 1-3在我眼中感觉完全一样，缺陷也完全相同：过大的摇杆放得太近，脸部、肩部、触发按钮很糟糕，似乎很快就会磨损，还有一个感觉很糟糕的十字键。Dual Shock 4解决了很多问题，但引入了一堆新问题。我买了Dual Sense，因为一些朋友在使用非对称摇杆时有困难，而当地商店以比DS4手柄便宜20美元的价格出售。
我并不真地使用这个手柄：脸部按钮间距太远，连接时我音频输入/输出总是默认到手柄，肩键奇高，每次试图点击菜单/分享时都会不小心按到触摸板。
它们是不错的客用手柄，在设计上进步很大，但对我来说最多算是一种新奇。

src_seg:
8BitDo was my first foray into good 3rd party controllers. This original SN30 Pro (later versions have hall-effect sticks and do not come in the SNES colour scheme) remains one of my favourites because holding it is reminiscent of my first console, the SNES.
If I'm having a crappy day and need a nostalgic escape, this is the first controller I reach for. It has all the functionality of a Switch Pro controller, but compacted into a modernized rendition of the SNES controller, complete with concave X/Y + convex A/B buttons, and possibly the best D-pad I've ever used. It's got some minor problems, but it's been a constant source of comfort.
One day the sticks will fail, or the battery will discharge for the last time; but if it means getting one of the modern versions (with hall-effect sticks) and shell-swapping them, I'll do it when the time comes.
With such a connection, surely 8BitDo can't do better than this, right? Well...
tgt_seg:
8BitDo是我首次接触优秀第三方手柄的品牌。这款原版SN30 Pro（后续版本有霍尔效应摇杆，并且没有SNES配色方案）仍是我最喜欢的手柄之一，因为拿着它让我想起了我的第一台游戏机，SNES。
如果我过得不太好，想要怀旧的逃避，这是我第一个会拿起来的手柄。它具备Switch Pro手柄的所有功能，但以现代化风格压缩了SNES手柄的设计，配有凹形X/Y和凸形A/B按钮，以及我用过的可能是最好的十字键。它有一些小问题，但一直是我舒适感的来源。
有一天，摇杆会失效，或者电池会最终耗尽；但如果这意味着我可以得到一个现代版本（带霍尔效应摇杆）并进行外壳更换，我会在那时进行。
有如此的联系，8BitDo难道不能再做到更好吗？那就...

src_seg:
When I want the familiar comforts of the SN30 Pro but with all the features of a modern controller, the 8BitDo Pro 2 has been my multi-platform controller of choice.
Everything about this is a functional upgrade from the SN30 Pro: more comfortable grips, hall-effect sticks, analog triggers, programmable back paddles, a physical X/D/S/A mode toggle switch, and a [somewhat] easily replaceable battery with the option of using AAs in a pinch. I also sprung for the carrying case and the mobile phone holster, which doesn't see as much use with a phone (I don't trust its grip that much), but for more compact retro emulation handhelds, it can expand the list of playable games to include ones that need precise analog controls.
There's very few negatives I can say about this controller, but it sits at a close 3rd for favourite controller of my collection. I'll talk about my number 2 pick in a moment, but before that I need to talk about...
tgt_seg:
当我想要SN30 Pro的熟悉感，但又希望拥有现代手柄的所有功能时，8BitDo Pro 2就是我青睐的多平台手柄。
这一切都比SN30 Pro更具实用性：更舒适的握把、霍尔效应摇杆、模拟触发器、可编程的后拨片、一个实体的X/D/S/A模式切换开关，还有一个[相对]容易更换的电池，在紧急情况下可以使用AA电池。我还买了一个收纳包和手机支架，尽管用手机时没有太多用处（我不太信任它的抓握力），但对于更紧凑的复古模拟掌机，它可以扩大可玩游戏的列表，包括那些需要精确模拟控制的游戏。
我能说关于这个手柄的缺点不多，但它在我收藏的手柄中位列第三。稍后我会谈谈我的第二名选择，但在此之前我需要先谈谈...

src_seg:
How hard is it to find a modernized N64 controller?
There are plenty of cheap N64 imitation controllers, but the three-pronged original was an objectively bad design. I could play N64 games with a modern controller using clever configuration to make the face buttons function as C-buttons, but it's not the same for so many reasons.
I got the RetroFighters Brawler 64 to solve this anachronistic conundrum, and it's gone above and beyond my expectations. It was made to mimic the official NSO N64 controller down to the Switch recognizing it as one, with a toggle to make it register as a Pro controller sans right-stick.
It has some problems, but between its layout and compatibility it solves way more problems the official version has. It's perfect for showing someone N64 emulation without the intimidation of the original or the anachronism from finagling a modern controller to work the same.
It's very good at what it's trying to do.
tgt_seg:
找到一个现代版的N64手柄有多难？
市场上有很多便宜的N64仿制手柄，但三爪原版在客观上是一个糟糕的设计。我可以用现代手柄巧妙地配置N64游戏的按钮，模拟C按钮功能，但原因有很多，这并不是同样的体验。
为了破解这个时代的矛盾，我购买了RetroFighters Brawler 64，它超出了我的期望。它被制作成模仿官方NSO N64手柄，Switch能够识别它作为一个手柄，并且有一键切换使其被识别为无右摇杆的专业手柄。
它确实有一些问题，但在布局和兼容性方面，它解决了官方手柄有的更多问题。它非常适合向某人展示N64模拟，而不会让他们不再感到恐惧或现代手柄无法正常工作的时间错位。
它在做它想做的事情上非常出色。

src_seg:
I got this steam controller from a pawn shop after negotiating the price down shortly after the fire sale came to an end on steam. It needed some TLC, and I did what I could to get it up and running again.
It remains one of the most customizable controllers in my collection, with a unique [if questionable] design and features ahead of it's time (gyro aim, back paddles, haptic feedback, etc). It has some problems though; It requires AAs, uses Micro-USB for wired connections, occasionally turns itself back on after being turned off, the back paddles are stiff enough to cause fatigue, the thumbstick cap is necessary since the rubber on it is deteriorating, and it's functionality tends to fluctuate with every update to steam input.
It's more of a unique historical artifact than a regularly used input, but it's a welcome addition and fun to tinker with on rainy days.
It also isn't my number 2 pick, that honour goes to the fact that...
tgt_seg:
在一场被火灾销售结束后的谈判后，我从一个典当店买到了这款Steam手柄。它需要一些呵护，我尽我所能让它重新运转。
它曾是我收藏中最具可定制性的手柄之一，设计独特（尽管有些可疑）且功能超前（陀螺瞄准、后拨片、触觉反馈等）。不过它也有一些问题；它需要AA电池，使用Micro-USB进行有线连接，有时关闭后会自行重开，后拨片的结果是很难造成疲劳，摇杆帽是必须的，因为橡胶正在退化，功能性也因每次Steam输入更新而波动。
它更像是一个独特的历史文物，而不是经常使用的输入，但它是一个受欢迎的补充，在雨天玩弄也很有趣。
而且它不是我第二喜欢的选择，那一荣誉属于...

tgt_seg:
我决定建立 PC 游戏收藏的决定始于 Xbox 360 和 Xbox One 之间的过渡期；我非常喜欢 360，但 One 看起来像是一场灾难。由于三大公司的最新游戏机都没什么吸引力，而且我在学习计算机信息系统，所以我给自己买了一个 360 PC 适配器，并决定进行切换。
这些手柄中的每一个都经过了大量使用，而 360 的手柄具有我喜欢的非对称摇杆布局。除了两款手柄外，图片中的其他手柄目前都无法使用，原因包括松动/漂移的摇杆、故障按钮或损坏的电缆/连接；两款可用的手柄是第三方 Afterglow 手柄（它们也有自己的问题）。
尽管我非常喜欢这些手柄，但官方手柄在耐用性方面是最差的，有些手柄从第一天起就有故障，但微软拒绝了我的 RMA 请求。
当我尝试最昂贵的那款时，情况变得更糟。

src_seg:
There was a time when I fell for the myth that "You get what you pay for" was as true for expensive stuff as it was for cheap stuff; it's because of this controller that I know better. I got this Elite Series 2 controller despite knowing the first iteration had some serious flaws.
That controller lasted just under a year before the stick drift started to set in, and the right bumper only registered half of the time. The cable it came with sucks ass, never worked with any other controllers. The lag from using bluetooth was so bad the dongle was practically necessary. On top of all that, the back paddles didn't work no matter what software/drivers I used, none of my games ever read those paddles as an inputs.
The Raikiri Pro (was bundled with a laptop) is my current dedicated desktop controller and it works fine [for now], but I will never spend another dime on Official Xbox branded controllers. Fuck Microsoft, I hope Xbox rots!
tgt_seg:
曾经有一段时间，我相信“一分钱一分货”的神话，认为这对昂贵的东西和便宜的东西同样适用；正是因为这个手柄，我才明白了真相。我买了这款 Elite Series 2 手柄，尽管我知道第一代产品有一些严重缺陷。
这款手柄使用不到一年，摇杆漂移问题就开始出现，右边保险杠也只能一半时间被识别。它附带的电缆非常糟糕，从不与其他手柄兼容。使用蓝牙时的延迟非常严重，以至于适配器几乎是必需的。此外，无论我使用什么软件/驱动程序，后置按键都无法工作，我的游戏从不将这些按键识别为输入。
Raikiri Pro（与笔记本电脑捆绑销售）是我目前专用的台式机手柄，它目前运行良好，但我永远不会再花一分钱购买官方 Xbox 品牌的手柄。去死吧，微软，我希望 Xbox 烂掉！

src_seg:
The Nintendo Switch reignited my love for portable gaming after years of surviving out of crappy laptops. The joycons were small but versatile, and the pro controller felt really comfortable in the hands.
I loved these controllers so much I modified them and swapped in hall-effect sticks [and metal latches] this past year, and while I'm well aware of the drift issue, mine have worked flawlessly since 2017 with no signs of wearing out. I've put just as many hours into these controllers as I did all those Xbox controllers; either I got very lucky or microsoft designs their controllers to fail faster than both of their competitors combined. Nintendo's offerings have some drawbacks, but the fact it's additional features like Gyro input have been officially supported is noteworthy.
I hope to keep these controllers working for as long as they continue to be supported on other platforms; there are many like them, but these ones are mine.
tgt_seg:
任天堂 Switch 在我多年使用糟糕笔记本电脑后，重新点燃了我对便携式游戏的热爱。Joy-Con 手柄虽然小巧，但功能多样，而 Pro 手柄握在手中感觉非常舒适。
我非常喜欢这些手柄，以至于去年我对它们进行了改装，换上了霍尔效应摇杆[和金属卡扣]。尽管我很清楚漂移问题，但我的手柄自 2017 年以来一直运行完美，没有磨损迹象。我在这些手柄上花费的时间与我在所有 Xbox 手柄上花费的时间一样多；要么我非常幸运，要么微软设计的手柄比其两个竞争对手加起来都更容易损坏。任天堂的产品有一些缺点，但值得注意的是，它的一些额外功能（如陀螺仪输入）得到了官方支持。
我希望这些手柄能够在其他平台上继续得到支持，并保持正常运行；这样的手柄有很多，但这些是我的。

src_seg:
A brief note on Play Station controllers to round out the 1st party lineup: I never liked them.
Dual Shock 1-3 felt exactly the same to me with exactly the same flaws: Oversized thumbsticks placed too close together, mushy face/shoulder/trigger buttons that seemed to wear out very quickly, and a D-pad that just felt wrong. Dual Shock 4 fixed a lot of problems, but introduced a bunch of new ones. I got a Dual Sense because some friends had a hard time with asymmetrical thumbsticks, and for some reason local stores were selling them for $20 less than DS4 controllers.
I don't really use this controller: Face buttons are spaced too far apart, my audio in/output keeps defaulting to the controller when it's connected, the bumpers are weirdly tall, and I keep accidentally pressing the track pad when trying to hit menu/share.
They are fine guest controllers that have come a long way in terms of design, but for me they're a novelty at best.
tgt_seg:
关于 PlayStation 手柄的简短说明，以补充第一方产品阵容：我从不喜欢它们。
Dual Shock 1-3 在我看来感觉完全一样，都有同样的缺点：过大的摇杆距离太近，松软的面部/肩部/触发按钮似乎很快就会磨损，而 D-pad 的感觉也完全不对。Dual Shock 4 解决了许多问题，但也引入了许多新问题。我买了 Dual Sense，因为一些朋友对非对称摇杆感到不适应，而且不知为何，当地商店的售价比 DS4 手柄便宜 20 美元。
我几乎不使用这个手柄：面部按钮间距太远，我的音频输入/输出在连接时总是默认到手柄上，保险杠异常高，而且我总是不小心按下触控板而不是菜单/分享按钮。
它们是很不错的客用手柄，在设计上取得了很大进步，但对我来说，它们充其量只是一种新奇事物。

src_seg:
8BitDo was my first foray into good 3rd party controllers. This original SN30 Pro (later versions have hall-effect sticks and do not come in the SNES colour scheme) remains one of my favourites because holding it is reminiscent of my first console, the SNES.
If I'm having a crappy day and need a nostalgic escape, this is the first controller I reach for. It has all the functionality of a Switch Pro controller, but compacted into a modernized rendition of the SNES controller, complete with concave X/Y + convex A/B buttons, and possibly the best D-pad I've ever used. It's got some minor problems, but it's been a constant source of comfort.
One day the sticks will fail, or the battery will discharge for the last time; but if it means getting one of the modern versions (with hall-effect sticks) and shell-swapping them, I'll do it when the time comes.
With such a connection, surely 8BitDo can't do better than this, right? Well...
tgt_seg:
8BitDo 是我第一次尝试优质第三方手柄。这款原始的 SN30 Pro（后期版本具有霍尔效应摇杆，且不采用 SNES 配色方案）仍然是我最喜欢的手柄之一，因为握着它让我想起了我的第一款游戏机——SNES。
如果我有一天心情不好，需要怀旧的逃避，我会首先拿起这个手柄。它具有 Switch Pro 手柄的所有功能，但压缩到了现代化的 SNES 手柄设计中，配备了凹形 X/Y 键和凸形 A/B 键，以及可能是我用过最好的 D-pad。它有一些小问题，但一直是我的一种安慰来源。
有一天，摇杆会损坏，或者电池会最后一次放电；但如果这意味着我可以获得现代版本（带有霍尔效应摇杆）并更换外壳，我会在时机成熟时这样做。
有了这样的联系，8BitDo 肯定无法做得比这更好了，对吧？嗯……

src_seg:
When I want the familiar comforts of the SN30 Pro but with all the features of a modern controller, the 8BitDo Pro 2 has been my multi-platform controller of choice.
Everything about this is a functional upgrade from the SN30 Pro: more comfortable grips, hall-effect sticks, analog triggers, programmable back paddles, a physical X/D/S/A mode toggle switch, and a [somewhat] easily replaceable battery with the option of using AAs in a pinch. I also sprung for the carrying case and the mobile phone holster, which doesn't see as much use with a phone (I don't trust its grip that much), but for more compact retro emulation handhelds, it can expand the list of playable games to include ones that need precise analog controls.
There's very few negatives I can say about this controller, but it sits at a close 3rd for favourite controller of my collection. I'll talk about my number 2 pick in a moment, but before that I need to talk about...
tgt_seg:
当我想要 SN30 Pro 的熟悉舒适感，但又希望拥有现代手柄的所有功能时，8BitDo Pro 2 就是我选择的多平台手柄。
这款手柄在各个方面都是对 SN30 Pro 的功能升级：更舒适的握把、霍尔效应摇杆、模拟触发器、可编程后置按键、物理 X/D/S/A 模式切换开关，以及[相对]易于更换的电池，紧急情况下还可以使用 AA 电池。我还购买了收纳盒和手机支架，虽然手机支架的使用频率不高（我不太信任它的握力），但对于更紧凑的复古模拟便携设备，它可以扩展可玩游戏列表，包括需要精确模拟控制的游戏。
我对这款手柄几乎没有什么负面评价，但它在我的收藏中排名第三。我稍后会谈到我最喜欢的第二款手柄，但在此之前，我需要谈谈……

src_seg:
How hard is it to find a modernized N64 controller?
There are plenty of cheap N64 imitation controllers, but the three-pronged original was an objectively bad design. I could play N64 games with a modern controller using clever configuration to make the face buttons function as C-buttons, but it's not the same for so many reasons.
I got the RetroFighters Brawler 64 to solve this anachronistic conundrum, and it's gone above and beyond my expectations. It was made to mimic the official NSO N64 controller down to the Switch recognizing it as one, with a toggle to make it register as a Pro controller sans right-stick.
It has some problems, but between its layout and compatibility it solves way more problems the official version has. It's perfect for showing someone N64 emulation without the intimidation of the original or the anachronism from finagling a modern controller to work the same.
It's very good at what it's trying to do.
tgt_seg:
找到一款现代化的 N64 手柄有多难？
市面上有很多廉价的 N64 仿制手柄，但原始的三叉设计客观上来说是糟糕的。我可以通过巧妙的配置，使用现代手柄玩 N64 游戏，让面部按钮充当 C 按钮，但这在许多方面都不一样。
我购买了 RetroFighters Brawler 64 来解决这个时代错位的难题，它超出了我的预期。它旨在模仿官方 NSO N64 手柄，甚至 Switch 也能将其识别为 N64 手柄，并有一个开关可以将其注册为无右摇杆的 Pro 手柄。
它有一些问题，但从布局到兼容性，它解决了官方版本更多的问题。它非常适合向他人展示 N64 模拟，而无需面对原始手柄的威慑力或现代手柄的时代错位感。
它非常擅长它所尝试做的事情。

src_seg:
I got this steam controller from a pawn shop after negotiating the price down shortly after the fire sale came to an end on steam. It needed some TLC, and I did what I could to get it up and running again.
It remains one of the most customizable controllers in my collection, with a unique [if questionable] design and features ahead of it's time (gyro aim, back paddles, haptic feedback, etc). It has some problems though; It requires AAs, uses Micro-USB for wired connections, occasionally turns itself back on after being turned off, the back paddles are stiff enough to cause fatigue, the thumbstick cap is necessary since the rubber on it is deteriorating, and it's functionality tends to fluctuate with every update to steam input.
It's more of a unique historical artifact than a regularly used input, but it's a welcome addition and fun to tinker with on rainy days.
It also isn't my number 2 pick, that honour goes to the fact that...
tgt_seg:
我在 Steam 火爆促销结束后不久，从当铺以较低的价格购买了这款 Steam 手柄。它需要一些保养，我尽力让它重新运行。
它仍然是我收藏中最可定制的手柄之一，具有独特的[尽管有争议的]设计和超前的功能（陀螺仪瞄准、后置按键、触觉反馈等）。不过它也有一些问题：它需要 AA 电池，使用 Micro-USB 进行有线连接，有时在关机后会自动重新打开，后置按键非常僵硬，会导致疲劳，摇杆帽是必需的，因为其橡胶部分正在老化，而且其功能会随着 Steam 输入的每次更新而波动。
它更像是一个独特的历史文物，而不是经常使用的输入设备，但它是个受欢迎的补充，在雨天摆弄它很有趣。
它也不是我最喜欢的第二款手柄，这一荣誉属于……

src_seg:
The 8BitDo Ultimate Bluetooth controller is an almost perfect controller.
Hall-effect sticks, included charging dock that doubles as a port for the included dongle, dedicated 2.4ghz/bluetooth toggle switch, NS Pro layout with a much improved D-pad, analog triggers, and programmable back paddles. When I sit down on a couch with this controller, I can swap between a Steam Deck and a Switch faster than the time it takes the TV to switch inputs.
It does have some drawbacks though: It only does X/Switch signals (no android or apple modes), the triggers are uncomfortable, and input lag seems to be affected by the time it took to connect to the dongle/switch.
I thought this was the best it could get, but like my time with Xbox controllers I was operating on assumptions that started to sound like old brand loyalty reflexes coming back. What I'd hoped to upgrade it to was such a disappointment it swiftly shook me from those assumptions.
tgt_seg:
8BitDo Ultimate 蓝牙手柄几乎是完美的。
霍尔效应摇杆、附带的充电底座（可兼作适配器端口）、专用的 2.4GHz/蓝牙切换开关、NS Pro 布局（带有改进的 D-pad）、模拟触发器和可编程后置按键。当我坐在沙发上使用这款手柄时，我可以在 Steam Deck 和 Switch 之间切换，速度比电视切换输入还要快。
不过它也有一些缺点：它只能发送 X/Switch 信号（不支持安卓或苹果模式），触发器不舒服，输入延迟似乎受到连接适配器/Switch 所需时间的影响。
我以为这已经是最佳选择了，但就像我使用 Xbox 手柄时的经历一样，我基于一些假设行事，这些假设逐渐变得像旧的品牌忠诚度反射一样。我本希望将其升级到更好的版本，但结果却让我大失所望，这迅速打破了我的这些假设。

src_seg:
Even though I've mostly transitioned to PC gaming over the past decade, my preferred peripherals are still controllers.
I understand the advantages of KB+M play, but as someone who already uses those tools for work I find picking up a controller helps separate the two activities and gives my wrists a break. I've also been playing video games long enough to see the technology and layouts used drastically change, though some first party controllers seem to have stagnated a bit.
I recently found a controller I really liked because it has features that have really impressed me enough to want to talk about it at length, but to do that I feel the need for some context; not a whole history lesson, just a little stroll through my collection of controllers that materialized over a lifetime of engaging in this hobby.
By the end I hope you'll understand why this is a topic I care so much about I'd spend all day talking about these devices.
tgt_seg:
尽管过去十年我主要转向了 PC 游戏，但我仍然更喜欢使用控制器。
我理解键盘鼠标操作的优势，但作为已经将这些工具用于工作的人，我发现拿起控制器有助于将这两项活动分开，让我的手腕得到休息。我也玩游戏的时间足够长，见证了技术和布局的巨大变化，尽管一些第一方控制器似乎停滞不前。
最近我发现了一个我非常喜欢的控制器，因为它的一些功能给我留下了深刻的印象，以至于我想详细谈谈。但要做到这一点，我觉得需要一些背景；不是整个历史课，只是对我在一生中从事这个爱好过程中积累的控制器进行一次简单的回顾。
希望到最后，你会明白为什么这是一个我非常关心的话题，以至于我会花整天时间谈论这些设备。

src_seg:
My decision to build up a PC game collection started during the transition between the Xbox 360 and the Xbox One; I thoroughly enjoyed the 360, but the One was looking like a disaster. Since the new consoles from all three major companies held little interest and I'd been in school for Computer Information Systems, I got myself a 360 pc dongle and resolved to make the switch.
Each of these controllers saw extensive use, and the 360 had the asymmetrical stick placement I preferred. All but two of the controllers in this picture are currently unusable either from loose/drifting sticks, faulty buttons, or failing cables/connections; both of the working ones are 3rd party Afterglows (which have their own problems).
As much as I loved these controllers, the official ones were the worst in terms of durability, and some were faulty from day one but Microsoft would refuse my RMA request.
It got worse when I tried the most expensive one.

tgt_seg:
关于 Play Station 控制器，为了完善第一方阵容，我有一点要补充：我从未喜欢它们。
Dual Shock 1-3 对我来说感觉完全一样，有着完全相同的缺陷：拇指摇杆过大，放置得太近；面部/肩部/扳机按钮松软，似乎很快就会磨损；方向十字键感觉不对。Dual Shock 4 解决了许多问题，但也引入了许多新问题。我买了一个 Dual Sense，因为一些朋友对非对称拇指摇杆感到困难，而且出于某种原因，当地商店以比 DS4 控制器便宜 20 美元的价格销售它们。
我实际上不使用这个控制器：面部按钮间隔太远，连接时我的音频输入/输出总是默认为控制器；保险杠很奇怪，我尝试按菜单/分享键时，经常不小心按了触控板。
它们是不错的客用控制器，在设计上已经取得了很大进步，但对我来说，它们充其量只是新奇玩意。

src_seg:
8BitDo was my first foray into good 3rd party controllers. This original SN30 Pro (later versions have hall-effect sticks and do not come in the SNES colour scheme) remains one of my favourites because holding it is reminiscent of my first console, the SNES.
If I'm having a crappy day and need a nostalgic escape, this is the first controller I reach for. It has all the functionality of a Switch Pro controller, but compacted into a modernized rendition of the SNES controller, complete with concave X/Y + convex A/B buttons, and possibly the best D-pad I've ever used. It's got some minor problems, but it's been a constant source of comfort.
One day the sticks will fail, or the battery will discharge for the last time; but if it means getting one of the modern versions (with hall-effect sticks) and shell-swapping them, I'll do it when the time comes.
With such a connection, surely 8BitDo can't do better than this, right? Well...
tgt_seg:
8BitDo 是我第一次接触到好的第三方控制器。这个原版 SN30 Pro（后来的版本有霍尔效应摇杆并且没有 SNES 色彩方案）仍然是我最喜欢的之一，因为它让我想起了我的第一台游戏机 SNES。
如果我度过了一个糟糕的一天，需要一次怀旧的逃避，这是我首先会拿到的控制器。它拥有 Switch Pro 控制器的所有功能，但紧凑成一个现代化的 SNES 控制器版本，包括凹陷的 X/Y + 凸起的 A/B 按钮，以及我用过的最好的方向十字键。它有一些小问题，但它一直是一个舒适的来源。
总有一天，摇杆会失效，或者电池会最后一次放电；但如果这意味着得到一个现代版本（带有霍尔效应摇杆）并更换外壳，我会在合适的时候去做。
有了这样的连接，8BitDo 肯定不能做得比这更好，对吧？嗯...

src_seg:
When I want the familiar comforts of the SN30 Pro but with all the features of a modern controller, the 8BitDo Pro 2 has been my multi-platform controller of choice.
Everything about this is a functional upgrade from the SN30 Pro: more comfortable grips, hall-effect sticks, analog triggers, programmable back paddles, a physical X/D/S/A mode toggle switch, and a [somewhat] easily replaceable battery with the option of using AAs in a pinch. I also sprung for the carrying case and the mobile phone holster, which doesn't see as much use with a phone (I don't trust its grip that much), but for more compact retro emulation handhelds, it can expand the list of playable games to include ones that need precise analog controls.
There's very few negatives I can say about this controller, but it sits at a close 3rd for favourite controller of my collection. I'll talk about my number 2 pick in a moment, but before that I need to talk about...
tgt_seg:
当我想要 SN30 Pro 的熟悉舒适感，但又想要现代控制器的所有功能，8BitDo Pro 2 已经成为我首选的多平台控制器。
这个控制器的所有方面都是 SN30 Pro 的功能升级：更舒适的握柄，霍尔效应摇杆，模拟扳机，可编程背部踏板，物理 X/D/S/A 模式切换开关，以及[相对]容易更换的电池，在紧急情况下可以使用 AA 电池。我还买了携带盒和手机夹，虽然手机使用频率不高（我不太信任它的握持力），但对于更紧凑的复古模拟手柄，它可以扩展可玩游戏的列表，包括需要精确模拟控制的游戏。
这个控制器几乎没有缺点，但它在收藏中排名第三。我马上会谈论我的第二名选择，但在此之前，我需要谈谈...

src_seg:
How hard is it to find a modernized N64 controller?
There are plenty of cheap N64 imitation controllers, but the three-pronged original was an objectively bad design. I could play N64 games with a modern controller using clever configuration to make the face buttons function as C-buttons, but it's not the same for so many reasons.
I got the RetroFighters Brawler 64 to solve this anachronistic conundrum, and it's gone above and beyond my expectations. It was made to mimic the official NSO N64 controller down to the Switch recognizing it as one, with a toggle to make it register as a Pro controller sans right-stick.
It has some problems, but between its layout and compatibility it solves way more problems the official version has. It's perfect for showing someone N64 emulation without the intimidation of the original or the anachronism from finagling a modern controller to work the same.
It's very good at what it's trying to do.
tgt_seg:
找到一个现代化的 N64 控制器有多难？
有很多便宜的 N64 模拟控制器，但三叉头的原版设计是客观糟糕的。我可以用现代控制器玩 N64 游戏，通过巧妙的配置使面部按钮充当 C 按钮，但这出于许多原因不是一样的。
我买了 RetroFighters Brawler 64 来解决这个时代错误的问题，它超出了我的预期。它模仿官方 NSO N64 控制器，甚至 Switch 也能识别它，有一个开关可以将其识别为 Pro 控制器，但没有右摇杆。
它有一些问题，但在布局和兼容性方面，它解决了官方版本的大部分问题。它是向别人展示 N64 模拟而不使用原始控制器或使用现代控制器来解决相同问题的时代错误的完美方式。
它非常擅长它所尝试做的事情。

src_seg:
I got this steam controller from a pawn shop after negotiating the price down shortly after the fire sale came to an end on steam. It needed some TLC, and I did what I could to get it up and running again.
It remains one of the most customizable controllers in my collection, with a unique [if questionable] design and features ahead of it's time (gyro aim, back paddles, haptic feedback, etc). It has some problems though; It requires AAs, uses Micro-USB for wired connections, occasionally turns itself back on after being turned off, the back paddles are stiff enough to cause fatigue, the thumbstick cap is necessary since the rubber on it is deteriorating, and it's functionality tends to fluctuate with every update to steam input.
It's more of a unique historical artifact than a regularly used input, but it's a welcome addition and fun to tinker with on rainy days.
It also isn't my number 2 pick, that honour goes to the fact that...
tgt_seg:
我在拍卖行将价格压低后，从一家拍卖行买到了这个 Steam 控制器。它需要一些 TLC，我尽了最大努力让它重新运行。
它仍然是我收藏中可定制性最高的控制器之一，拥有独特[但可疑]的设计和超前于时代的功能（陀螺仪瞄准、背部踏板、触觉反馈等）。它有一些问题；它需要 AA 电池，使用 Micro-USB 进行有线连接，偶尔会自行打开，背部踏板足够僵硬以至于会引起疲劳，需要拇指帽，因为橡胶正在磨损，它的功能在每次 Steam 输入更新时都会波动。
它更像是一个独特的历史文物，而不是一个经常使用的输入，但它是一个受欢迎的补充，在雨天玩弄它很有趣。
它也不是我的第二名选择，那个荣誉属于...

src_seg:
The 8BitDo Ultimate Bluetooth controller is an almost perfect controller.
Hall-effect sticks, included charging dock that doubles as a port for the included dongle, dedicated 2.4ghz/bluetooth toggle switch, NS Pro layout with a much improved D-pad, analog triggers, and programmable back paddles. When I sit down on a couch with this controller, I can swap between a Steam Deck and a Switch faster than the time it takes the TV to switch inputs.
It does have some drawbacks though: It only does X/Switch signals (no android or apple modes), the triggers are uncomfortable, and input lag seems to be affected by the time it took to connect to the dongle/switch.
I thought this was the best it could get, but like my time with Xbox controllers I was operating on assumptions that started to sound like old brand loyalty reflexes coming back. What I'd hoped to upgrade it to was such a disappointment it swiftly shook me from those assumptions.
tgt_seg:
8BitDo 终极蓝牙控制器几乎是一个完美的控制器。
霍尔效应摇杆，包含的充电底座可作为随附适配器的端口，专用 2.4GHz/蓝牙切换开关，NS Pro 布局，方向十字键改进，模拟扳机和可编程背部踏板。当我用这个控制器坐在沙发上时，我可以比电视切换输入更快地在 Steam Deck 和 Switch 之间切换。
它确实有一些缺点：它只处理 X/Switch 信号（没有安卓或苹果模式），扳机不舒服，输入延迟似乎会受到连接到适配器/交换机所需的时间的影响。
我以为这是最好的，但就像我与 Xbox 控制器的时间一样，我一直在基于假设行动，这些假设开始听起来像旧品牌忠诚反射回来的声音。我希望升级它，但结果却让我从这些假设中迅速清醒过来。

src_seg:
Even though I've mostly transitioned to PC gaming over the past decade, my preferred peripherals are still controllers.
I understand the advantages of KB+M play, but as someone who already uses those tools for work I find picking up a controller helps separate the two activities and gives my wrists a break. I've also been playing video games long enough to see the technology and layouts used drastically change, though some first party controllers seem to have stagnated a bit.
I recently found a controller I really liked because it has features that have really impressed me enough to want to talk about it at length, but to do that I feel the need for some context; not a whole history lesson, just a little stroll through my collection of controllers that materialized over a lifetime of engaging in this hobby.
By the end I hope you'll understand why this is a topic I care so much about I'd spend all day talking about these devices.
tgt_seg:
即使在过去十年中，我已经主要转向了PC游戏，但我最喜欢的配件仍然是以手柄为代表的控制器。
我理解KB+M游戏的优势，但作为已经在工作中使用这些工具的人，我发现拿起一个手柄可以帮助我区分这两项活动，并为我的手腕提供休息。我也看到了视频游戏技术和布局大幅变化的过程，尽管一些第一方手柄似乎在某种程度上停滞不前。
我最近发现了一个我非常喜欢的手柄，因为它具有让我印象深刻的特点，以至于我想详细谈谈它，但为了做到这一点，我觉得需要一些背景；不是整个历史课，只是对我一生中积累的手柄收藏的简短漫步。
希望到最后你能理解为什么这个话题对我如此重要，我会花一整天时间谈论这些设备。

src_seg:
My decision to build up a PC game collection started during the transition between the Xbox 360 and the Xbox One; I thoroughly enjoyed the 360, but the One was looking like a disaster. Since the new consoles from all three major companies held little interest and I'd been in school for Computer Information Systems, I got myself a 360 pc dongle and resolved to make the switch.
Each of these controllers saw extensive use, and the 360 had the asymmetrical stick placement I preferred. All but two of the controllers in this picture are currently unusable either from loose/drifting sticks, faulty buttons, or failing cables/connections; both of the working ones are 3rd party Afterglows (which have their own problems).
As much as I loved these controllers, the official ones were the worst in terms of durability, and some were faulty from day one but Microsoft would refuse my RMA request.
It got worse when I tried the most expensive one.
tgt_seg:
我决定建立PC游戏收藏的起点是在Xbox 360和Xbox One之间的过渡时期；我非常喜欢360，但One看起来像是一个灾难。由于三大公司的新机缺乏吸引力，而我正在学习计算机信息系统，我买了一个360 PC插件，并决心进行转换。
这些手柄都得到了广泛使用，360的异形摇杆是我喜欢的。除了两个手柄外，目前所有手柄都无法使用，要么是摇杆松动/漂移，按钮故障，要么是电缆/连接故障；两个正常工作的手柄是第三方Afterglow（它们也有自己的问题）。
尽管我非常喜欢这些手柄，但官方手柄在耐用性方面是最差的，有些甚至从一开始就存在故障，但微软拒绝了我的退货请求。
情况变得更糟，当我尝试最昂贵的一个时。

src_seg:
There was a time when I fell for the myth that "You get what you pay for" was as true for expensive stuff as it was for cheap stuff; it's because of this controller that I know better. I got this Elite Series 2 controller despite knowing the first iteration had some serious flaws.
That controller lasted just under a year before the stick drift started to set in, and the right bumper only registered half of the time. The cable it came with sucks ass, never worked with any other controllers. The lag from using bluetooth was so bad the dongle was practically necessary. On top of all that, the back paddles didn't work no matter what software/drivers I used, none of my games ever read those paddles as an inputs.
The Raikiri Pro (was bundled with a laptop) is my current dedicated desktop controller and it works fine [for now], but I will never spend another dime on Official Xbox branded controllers. Fuck Microsoft, I hope Xbox rots!
tgt_seg:
曾经有一个时间，我相信“你付出的就是你得到的”这一神话在昂贵的东西上也同样成立；正是这个手柄让我知道了更好。我买了这个Elite系列2手柄，尽管知道第一版有严重缺陷。
这个手柄使用了一年多后，开始出现摇杆漂移的问题，右扳机只有半时间能被注册。它随附的电缆很糟糕，从来没有与其他手柄一起工作。蓝牙延迟非常严重，几乎需要使用插件。此外，背面的触控板无论使用什么软件/驱动都不会被识别为输入。
Raikiri Pro（与笔记本电脑一起购买）是我目前专用的桌面手柄，它目前工作正常[暂时]，但我永远不会再花一分钱买官方的Xbox手柄。对微软说“去死吧！我希望Xbox倒闭！”

src_seg:
The Nintendo Switch reignited my love for portable gaming after years of surviving out of crappy laptops. The joycons were small but versatile, and the pro controller felt really comfortable in the hands.
I loved these controllers so much I modified them and swapped in hall-effect sticks [and metal latches] this past year, and while I'm well aware of the drift issue, mine have worked flawlessly since 2017 with no signs of wearing out. I've put just as many hours into these controllers as I did all those Xbox controllers; either I got very lucky or microsoft designs their controllers to fail faster than both of their competitors combined. Nintendo's offerings have some drawbacks, but the fact it's additional features like Gyro input have been officially supported is noteworthy.
I hope to keep these controllers working for as long as they continue to be supported on other platforms; there are many like them, but these ones are mine.
tgt_seg:
任天堂Switch重新点燃了我对便携式游戏的热爱，在经历了多年糟糕的笔记本电脑后。Joycon小但灵活，Pro手柄在手上感觉非常舒适。
我非常喜欢这些手柄，以至于在过去一年中修改了它们，并用霍尔效应摇杆和金属拉合替换了它们。尽管我知道有漂移问题，但自2017年以来，我的手柄一直工作正常，没有任何磨损迹象。我投入了与所有那些Xbox手柄相媲美的时间；要么我非常幸运，要么微软设计他们的手柄以更快地故障。任天堂的产品也有缺点，但官方支持陀螺输入等额外功能是值得注意的。
我希望这些手柄能继续工作，只要它们在其他平台上得到支持；有很多像它们这样的手柄，但这些是我的。

src_seg:
A brief note on Play Station controllers to round out the 1st party lineup: I never liked them.
Dual Shock 1-3 felt exactly the same to me with exactly the same flaws: Oversized thumbsticks placed too close together, mushy face/shoulder/trigger buttons that seemed to wear out very quickly, and a D-pad that just felt wrong. Dual Shock 4 fixed a lot of problems, but introduced a bunch of new ones. I got a Dual Sense because some friends had a hard time with asymmetrical thumbsticks, and for some reason local stores were selling them for $20 less than DS4 controllers.
I don't really use this controller: Face buttons are spaced too far apart, my audio in/output keeps defaulting to the controller when it's connected, the bumpers are weirdly tall, and I keep accidentally pressing the track pad when trying to hit menu/share.
They are fine guest controllers that have come a long way in terms of design, but for me they're a novelty at best.
tgt_seg:
关于PlayStation手柄的简要说明：我从来不喜欢它们。
Dual Shock 1-3在我看来感觉相同，都有相同的缺陷：位置过于靠近的超大摇杆，感觉松软的面部/肩部/扳机按钮，以及感觉不对劲的D-pad。Dual Shock 4解决了许多问题，但也引入了新的问题。我买了Dual Sense，因为一些朋友很难适应不对称的摇杆，而且当地商店以20美元的折扣出售，比DS4手柄便宜。
我不太使用这个手柄：面部按钮间距太远，我的音频输入/输出会默认到手柄上连接，扳机有点高，我经常误触触控板。
它们作为客座手柄还不错，设计上已经有很大的改进，但对我来说只是玩味。

src_seg:
8BitDo was my first foray into good 3rd party controllers. This original SN30 Pro (later versions have hall-effect sticks and do not come in the SNES colour scheme) remains one of my favourites because holding it is reminiscent of my first console, the SNES.

It's got some minor problems, but it's been a constant source of comfort.
One day the sticks will fail, or the battery will discharge for the last time; but if it means getting one of the modern versions (with hall-effect sticks) and shell-swapping them, I'll do it when the time comes.
With such a connection, surely 8BitDo can't do better than this, right? Well...

8BitDo是我第一次接触到好的第三方手柄。这个原始SN30 Pro（后续版本有霍尔效应摇杆，并且不以SNES颜色呈现）仍然是我最喜欢的手柄之一，因为握在手里让人想起我的第一个游戏机，SNES。

有了这样的联系，8BitDo难道不能做得更好吗？好吧...
