tgt_seg:
曾经有一段时间，我相信“一分钱一分货”的谚语，无论是贵的还是便宜的东西都适用；正是由于这个手柄，我明白了这一点。我购买了精英系列2手柄，尽管知道第一代手柄有严重的缺陷。
那款手柄使用不到一年，摇杆漂移就开始出现，右挡板只有半数时间能正常工作。它附带的电缆非常差，从未与其他手柄兼容。使用蓝牙的延迟非常严重，以至于转接器几乎是必不可少的。此外，后置划船桨无论我使用什么软件/驱动程序都无法工作，我的游戏从未将这些划船桨识别为输入。
雷基里专业版（与笔记本电脑捆绑销售）是我目前专用的台式机手柄，目前运行正常[暂且如此]，但我永远不会再花一分钱购买官方Xbox品牌手柄。去死吧，微软，希望Xbox烂掉！

src_seg:
The Nintendo Switch reignited my love for portable gaming after years of surviving out of crappy laptops. The joycons were small but versatile, and the pro controller felt really comfortable in the hands.
I loved these controllers so much I modified them and swapped in hall-effect sticks [and metal latches] this past year, and while I'm well aware of the drift issue, mine have worked flawlessly since 2017 with no signs of wearing out. I've put just as many hours into these controllers as I did all those Xbox controllers; either I got very lucky or microsoft designs their controllers to fail faster than both of their competitors combined. Nintendo's offerings have some drawbacks, but the fact it's additional features like Gyro input have been officially supported is noteworthy.
I hope to keep these controllers working for as long as they continue to be supported on other platforms; there are many like them, but these ones are mine.
tgt_seg:
任天堂Switch重新点燃了我对便携式游戏的热爱，之前我多年来一直依赖于劣质的笔记本电脑。Joy-Con手柄虽然小巧，但功能强大，专业手柄在手中的感觉非常舒适。
我非常喜欢这些手柄，去年我对它们进行了改装，更换了霍尔效应摇杆[和金属扣]。尽管我很清楚漂移问题，但我的手柄自2017年以来一直运行完美，没有任何磨损迹象。我使用这些手柄的时间与使用所有Xbox手柄的时间一样长；要么我非常幸运，要么微软设计的手柄比竞争对手的产品更快地失效。任天堂的产品有一些缺点，但官方支持额外功能（如陀螺仪输入）是值得注意的。
我希望这些手柄能继续在其他平台上运行，只要它们继续得到支持；有很多类似的产品，但这些是我的。

src_seg:
A brief note on Play Station controllers to round out the 1st party lineup: I never liked them.
Dual Shock 1-3 felt exactly the same to me with exactly the same flaws: Oversized thumbsticks placed too close together, mushy face/shoulder/trigger buttons that seemed to wear out very quickly, and a D-pad that just felt wrong. Dual Shock 4 fixed a lot of problems, but introduced a bunch of new ones. I got a Dual Sense because some friends had a hard time with asymmetrical thumbsticks, and for some reason local stores were selling them for $20 less than DS4 controllers.
I don't really use this controller: Face buttons are spaced too far apart, my audio in/output keeps defaulting to the controller when it's connected, the bumpers are weirdly tall, and I keep accidentally pressing the track pad when trying to hit menu/share.
They are fine guest controllers that have come a long way in terms of design, but for me they're a novelty at best.
tgt_seg:
关于PlayStation手柄简要说明，以完成一线品牌：我从来不喜欢它们。
Dual Shock 1-3在我看来完全相同，都有同样的缺陷：过大的拇指棒放置得太近，柔软的面/肩/触发按钮似乎很快就会磨损，以及感觉不对的方向键。Dual Shock 4修复了许多问题，但引入了更多新问题。我购买了Dual Sense，因为一些朋友对不对称拇指棒有困难，而且当地商店以比DS4手柄低20美元的价格出售它们。
我几乎不使用这个手柄：面按钮之间的距离太远，我的音频输入/输出总是在连接时默认设置为手柄，挡板奇怪地高，我在尝试按菜单/分享按钮时经常意外按下触摸板。
它们是很好的客用手柄，在设计上已经取得了长足的进步，但对我来说，它们充其量只是新奇的玩意。

src_seg:
8BitDo was my first foray into good 3rd party controllers. This original SN30 Pro (later versions have hall-effect sticks and do not come in the SNES colour scheme) remains one of my favourites because holding it is reminiscent of my first console, the SNES.
If I'm having a crappy day and need a nostalgic escape, this is the first controller I reach for. It has all the functionality of a Switch Pro controller, but compacted into a modernized rendition of the SNES controller, complete with concave X/Y + convex A/B buttons, and possibly the best D-pad I've ever used. It's got some minor problems, but it's been a constant source of comfort.
One day the sticks will fail, or the battery will discharge for the last time; but if it means getting one of the modern versions (with hall-effect sticks) and shell-swapping them, I'll do it when the time comes.
With such a connection, surely 8BitDo can't do better than this, right? Well...
tgt_seg:
8BitDo是我第一次尝试使用高质量第三方手柄。这款原始SN30专业版（后来版本采用霍尔效应摇杆，不采用SNES颜色方案）仍然是我最喜欢的手柄之一，因为握住它让我想起了我的第一台主机，即SNES。
如果我有个糟糕的日子，需要怀旧的逃避，这是我首先选择的手柄。它具有Switch专业手柄的所有功能，但缩小到现代化的SNES手柄的尺寸，包括凹陷的X/Y按钮和凸起的A/B按钮，以及我使用过的最好的方向键。它有一些小问题，但一直是一个安慰的来源。
有一天，摇杆会失效，或者电池会最后一次放电；但如果这意味着获得现代版本（采用霍尔效应摇杆）并更换外壳，当时间到来时，我会这样做。
有了这样的联系，8BitDo能做得比这更好吗？嗯...

src_seg:
When I want the familiar comforts of the SN30 Pro but with all the features of a modern controller, the 8BitDo Pro 2 has been my multi-platform controller of choice.
Everything about this is a functional upgrade from the SN30 Pro: more comfortable grips, hall-effect sticks, analog triggers, programmable back paddles, a physical X/D/S/A mode toggle switch, and a [somewhat] easily replaceable battery with the option of using AAs in a pinch. I also sprung for the carrying case and the mobile phone holster, which doesn't see as much use with a phone (I don't trust its grip that much), but for more compact retro emulation handhelds, it can expand the list of playable games to include ones that need precise analog controls.
There's very few negatives I can say about this controller, but it sits at a close 3rd for favourite controller of my collection. I'll talk about my number 2 pick in a moment, but before that I need to talk about...
tgt_seg:
当我想要SN30专业版所提供的熟悉舒适感，同时拥有现代手柄的所有功能时，8BitDo专业版2就是我跨平台手柄的首选。
这个手柄在功能上比SN30专业版有很大的提升：更舒适的握把、霍尔效应摇杆、模拟触发按钮、可编程的后置划船桨、物理X/D/S/A模式切换开关，以及[相对]易于替换的电池，可选择使用AA电池。我还购买了携带盒和手机套，虽然手机套的使用不频繁（我不信任它的握力），但对于更紧凑的复古模拟便携式设备，它可以扩展可播放游戏的列表，包括需要精确模拟控制的游戏。
我对这个手柄的负面评价很少，但它在我收藏的手柄中排名第三。我将在稍后谈论我排名第二的选择，但在那之前，我需要谈谈...

src_seg:
How hard is it to find a modernized N64 controller?
There are plenty of cheap N64 imitation controllers, but the three-pronged original was an objectively bad design. I could play N64 games with a modern controller using clever configuration to make the face buttons function as C-buttons, but it's not the same for so many reasons.
I got the RetroFighters Brawler 64 to solve this anachronistic conundrum, and it's gone above and beyond my expectations. It was made to mimic the official NSO N64 controller down to the Switch recognizing it as one, with a toggle to make it register as a Pro controller sans right-stick.
It has some problems, but between its layout and compatibility it solves way more problems the official version has. It's perfect for showing someone N64 emulation without the intimidation of the original or the anachronism from finagling a modern controller to work the same.
It's very good at what it's trying to do.
tgt_seg:
寻找现代化的N64手柄有多难？
市场上有很多廉价的N64模仿手柄，但三叉原版设计客观上存在缺陷。我可以使用现代手柄通过巧妙的配置让面按钮充当C按钮来玩N64游戏，但这与原始手柄相比有太多的不同。
我购买了RetroFighters Brawler 64手柄来解决这个过时的难题，它超出了我的期望。它模仿了官方NSO N64手柄，甚至Switch可以将其识别为N64手柄，并具有切换功能，使其注册为没有右摇杆的专业手柄。
它有一些问题，但它的布局和兼容性解决了官方版本存在的大量问题。它非常适合向他人展示N64模拟，而不会受到原始手柄的恐吓，或者通过调整现代手柄来实现相同功能的过时问题。
它非常擅长它试图做的事情。

src_seg:
I got this steam controller from a pawn shop after negotiating the price down shortly after the fire sale came to an end on steam. It needed some TLC, and I did what I could to get it up and running again.
It remains one of the most customizable controllers in my collection, with a unique [if questionable] design and features ahead of it's time (gyro aim, back paddles, haptic feedback, etc). It has some problems though; It requires AAs, uses Micro-USB for wired connections, occasionally turns itself back on after being turned off, the back paddles are stiff enough to cause fatigue, the thumbstick cap is necessary since the rubber on it is deteriorating, and it's functionality tends to fluctuate with every update to steam input.
It's more of a unique historical artifact than a regularly used input, but it's a welcome addition and fun to tinker with on rainy days.
It also isn't my number 2 pick, that honour goes to the fact that...
tgt_seg:
我从当铺买了这个Steam手柄，在Steam清仓销售结束后，我通过谈判降低了价格。它需要一些关爱，我尽我所能让它再次正常运行。
它仍然是我收藏中最可定制的手柄之一，具有独特的[如果有争议的]设计和超前的功能（陀螺仪瞄准、后置划船桨、触觉反馈等）。尽管它有一些问题：需要AA电池、使用Micro-USB进行有线连接、偶尔会在关闭后自动打开、后置划船桨的刚性会导致疲劳、拇指棒的橡胶正在老化，需要保护套，以及它的功能在每次Steam输入更新时都会波动。
它更像是一个独特的历史文物，而不是经常使用的输入设备，但它是一个欢迎的添加项，在雨天可以用来把玩。
它也不是我排名第二的选择，这个荣誉属于...

src_seg:
The 8BitDo Ultimate Bluetooth controller is an almost perfect controller.
Hall-effect sticks, included charging dock that doubles as a port for the included dongle, dedicated 2.4ghz/bluetooth toggle switch, NS Pro layout with a much improved D-pad, analog triggers, and programmable back paddles. When I sit down on a couch with this controller, I can swap between a Steam Deck and a Switch faster than the time it takes the TV to switch inputs.
It does have some drawbacks though: It only does X/Switch signals (no android or apple modes), the triggers are uncomfortable, and input lag seems to be affected by the time it took to connect to the dongle/switch.
I thought this was the best it could get, but like my time with Xbox controllers I was operating on assumptions that started to sound like old brand loyalty reflexes coming back. What I'd hoped to upgrade it to was such a disappointment it swiftly shook me from those assumptions.
tgt_seg:
8BitDo终极蓝牙手柄几乎是一个完美的控制器。
霍尔效应摇杆、包含充电底座，可作为包含转接器的端口使用、专用的2.4GHz/蓝牙切换开关、NS专业布局，具有大大改进的方向键、模拟触发按钮和可编程的后置划船桨。当我坐在沙发上使用这个手柄时，我可以比电视切换输入更快地在一台Steam Deck和一台Switch之间切换。
尽管它有一些缺点：它只有X/Switch信号（没有安卓或苹果模式）、触发按钮不舒服，并且输入延迟似乎受到连接到转接器/Switch所需时间的的影响。
我认为这是最好的，但就像我与Xbox手柄的经历一样，我当时基于一些假设，这些假设开始听起来像是一种古老的品牌忠诚反射。我希望升级的东西让我大失所望，很快就让我从这些假设中清醒过来。

src_seg:
Even though I've mostly transitioned to PC gaming over the past decade, my preferred peripherals are still controllers.
I understand the advantages of KB+M play, but as someone who already uses those tools for work I find picking up a controller helps separate the two activities and gives my wrists a break. I've also been playing video games long enough to see the technology and layouts used drastically change, though some first party controllers seem to have stagnated a bit.
I recently found a controller I really liked because it has features that have really impressed me enough to want to talk about it at length, but to do that I feel the need for some context; not a whole history lesson, just a little stroll through my collection of controllers that materialized over a lifetime of engaging in this hobby.
By the end I hope you'll understand why this is a topic I care so much about I'd spend all day talking about these devices.
tgt_seg:
尽管在过去十年里我大多转向了PC游戏，但我最喜欢的外设依然是手柄。
我理解键盘加鼠标的优势，但作为一个已经在工作中频繁使用这些工具的人，拿起手柄能让我区分工作和娱乐，并且让手腕得到休息。我玩电子游戏的时间也足够长，见证了手柄技术和布局的巨大变化，尽管有些一方手柄似乎有些停滞不前。
最近我找到了一款非常喜欢的手柄，因为它的功能让我印象深刻，甚至想专门写一篇长文来介绍它。但在此之前，我觉得有必要先做一些背景介绍；不是要讲一整段历史，只是带大家简单回顾一下我这些年收藏的手柄。
希望到最后你能明白，为什么我会如此在意这个话题，甚至愿意花上一整天来聊这些设备。

src_seg:
My decision to build up a PC game collection started during the transition between the Xbox 360 and the Xbox One; I thoroughly enjoyed the 360, but the One was looking like a disaster. Since the new consoles from all three major companies held little interest and I'd been in school for Computer Information Systems, I got myself a 360 pc dongle and resolved to make the switch.
Each of these controllers saw extensive use, and the 360 had the asymmetrical stick placement I preferred. All but two of the controllers in this picture are currently unusable either from loose/drifting sticks, faulty buttons, or failing cables/connections; both of the working ones are 3rd party Afterglows (which have their own problems).
As much as I loved these controllers, the official ones were the worst in terms of durability, and some were faulty from day one but Microsoft would refuse my RMA request.
It got worse when I tried the most expensive one.
tgt_seg:
我决定开始收集PC游戏，是在Xbox 360和Xbox One交替的时期；我非常喜欢360，但One看起来简直是一场灾难。由于三大主机厂商的新主机都提不起我的兴趣，而我又在学计算机信息系统，于是我买了个360的PC适配器，决定转向PC。
这些手柄都被我用得很频繁，360的非对称摇杆布局正合我意。照片里的手柄除了两个以外，其余都因为摇杆松动/漂移、按键失灵或线缆/接口故障而无法使用；仅有的两个还能用的是第三方Afterglow（但它们也有自己的问题）。
虽然我很喜欢这些手柄，但官方手柄的耐用性最差，有些一开始就有问题，微软还拒绝了我的保修申请。
最糟糕的是我试了最贵的那款。

src_seg:
There was a time when I fell for the myth that "You get what you pay for" was as true for expensive stuff as it was for cheap stuff; it's because of this controller that I know better. I got this Elite Series 2 controller despite knowing the first iteration had some serious flaws.
That controller lasted just under a year before the stick drift started to set in, and the right bumper only registered half of the time. The cable it came with sucks ass, never worked with any other controllers. The lag from using bluetooth was so bad the dongle was practically necessary. On top of all that, the back paddles didn't work no matter what software/drivers I used, none of my games ever read those paddles as an inputs.
The Raikiri Pro (was bundled with a laptop) is my current dedicated desktop controller and it works fine [for now], but I will never spend another dime on Official Xbox branded controllers. Fuck Microsoft, I hope Xbox rots!
tgt_seg:
曾经我也相信“你一分钱一分货”这句话，无论贵的还是便宜的都适用；正是因为这款手柄，我才明白事实并非如此。我买了这款Elite Series 2手柄，尽管知道第一代有严重缺陷。
这只手柄不到一年就开始出现摇杆漂移，右肩键只有一半时间能识别。附带的线缆质量极差，其他手柄都用不了。蓝牙延迟严重，几乎必须用适配器。更糟糕的是，无论用什么软件/驱动，背部拨片都无法正常工作，所有游戏都识别不到这些拨片的输入。
Raikiri Pro（和笔记本捆绑的）是我现在专用的桌面手柄，目前用着还行[暂时]，但我再也不会为官方Xbox手柄花一分钱。微软见鬼去吧，希望Xbox烂掉！

src_seg:
The Nintendo Switch reignited my love for portable gaming after years of surviving out of crappy laptops. The joycons were small but versatile, and the pro controller felt really comfortable in the hands.
I loved these controllers so much I modified them and swapped in hall-effect sticks [and metal latches] this past year, and while I'm well aware of the drift issue, mine have worked flawlessly since 2017 with no signs of wearing out. I've put just as many hours into these controllers as I did all those Xbox controllers; either I got very lucky or microsoft designs their controllers to fail faster than both of their competitors combined. Nintendo's offerings have some drawbacks, but the fact it's additional features like Gyro input have been officially supported is noteworthy.
I hope to keep these controllers working for as long as they continue to be supported on other platforms; there are many like them, but these ones are mine.
tgt_seg:
任天堂Switch重新点燃了我对掌机游戏的热爱，之前我一直靠破旧笔记本凑合。Joy-Con虽然小巧但很灵活，Pro手柄握感也非常舒适。
我太喜欢这些手柄了，去年还给它们换上了霍尔效应摇杆[和金属卡扣]，虽然我知道漂移问题很常见，但我的手柄自2017年起一直完美无损，没有任何磨损迹象。我用这些手柄的时间和Xbox手柄一样多；要么我运气太好，要么微软的手柄寿命比两家竞争对手加起来还短。任天堂的手柄也有一些缺点，但像陀螺仪输入这样的附加功能能被官方支持，还是很值得称道的。
只要这些手柄还能在其他平台上用，我就会一直让它们保持工作状态；市面上有很多类似的手柄，但这些是属于我的。

src_seg:
A brief note on Play Station controllers to round out the 1st party lineup: I never liked them.
Dual Shock 1-3 felt exactly the same to me with exactly the same flaws: Oversized thumbsticks placed too close together, mushy face/shoulder/trigger buttons that seemed to wear out very quickly, and a D-pad that just felt wrong. Dual Shock 4 fixed a lot of problems, but introduced a bunch of new ones. I got a Dual Sense because some friends had a hard time with asymmetrical thumbsticks, and for some reason local stores were selling them for $20 less than DS4 controllers.
I don't really use this controller: Face buttons are spaced too far apart, my audio in/output keeps defaulting to the controller when it's connected, the bumpers are weirdly tall, and I keep accidentally pressing the track pad when trying to hit menu/share.
They are fine guest controllers that have come a long way in terms of design, but for me they're a novelty at best.
tgt_seg:
简单说说Play Station手柄，补全一方阵容：我从来不喜欢它们。
Dual Shock 1-3对我来说手感完全一样，缺点也一样：拇指摇杆太大且距离太近，正面/肩部/扳机按键手感松软且很快就会磨损，方向键手感也很奇怪。Dual Shock 4解决了不少问题，但又带来了新的问题。我买了个Dual Sense，因为有朋友不习惯非对称摇杆，而且本地商店卖得比DS4还便宜20美元。
我其实很少用这个手柄：正面按键间距太大，音频输入输出总是默认到手柄，肩键高度奇怪，按菜单/分享时总会误触触控板。
它们作为客人用手柄还不错，设计上进步很大，但对我来说最多只是个新鲜玩意。

src_seg:
8BitDo was my first foray into good 3rd party controllers. This original SN30 Pro (later versions have hall-effect sticks and do not come in the SNES colour scheme) remains one of my favourites because holding it is reminiscent of my first console, the SNES.
If I'm having a crappy day and need a nostalgic escape, this is the first controller I reach for. It has all the functionality of a Switch Pro controller, but compacted into a modernized rendition of the SNES controller, complete with concave X/Y + convex A/B buttons, and possibly the best D-pad I've ever used. It's got some minor problems, but it's been a constant source of comfort.
One day the sticks will fail, or the battery will discharge for the last time; but if it means getting one of the modern versions (with hall-effect sticks) and shell-swapping them, I'll do it when the time comes.
With such a connection, surely 8BitDo can't do better than this, right? Well...
tgt_seg:
8BitDo是我第一次接触到的优质第三方手柄。这款最初的SN30 Pro（后续版本有霍尔效应摇杆且不再有SNES配色）依然是我的最爱之一，因为它让我想起了我的第一台主机SNES。
如果哪天心情糟糕需要怀旧，这就是我第一时间会拿起的手柄。它拥有Switch Pro手柄的全部功能，但被压缩进了现代化的SNES手柄外形，配有凹陷的X/Y和凸起的A/B按键，以及可能是我用过最好的方向键。虽然有些小问题，但它一直是我的安慰源泉。
总有一天摇杆会坏，或者电池会彻底报废；但如果能换成现代版（带霍尔效应摇杆）再换壳，我一定会去做。
有了这样的情感联系，8BitDo还能做得更好吗？其实……

src_seg:
When I want the familiar comforts of the SN30 Pro but with all the features of a modern controller, the 8BitDo Pro 2 has been my multi-platform controller of choice.
Everything about this is a functional upgrade from the SN30 Pro: more comfortable grips, hall-effect sticks, analog triggers, programmable back paddles, a physical X/D/S/A mode toggle switch, and a [somewhat] easily replaceable battery with the option of using AAs in a pinch. I also sprung for the carrying case and the mobile phone holster, which doesn't see as much use with a phone (I don't trust its grip that much), but for more compact retro emulation handhelds, it can expand the list of playable games to include ones that need precise analog controls.
There's very few negatives I can say about this controller, but it sits at a close 3rd for favourite controller of my collection. I'll talk about my number 2 pick in a moment, but before that I need to talk about...
tgt_seg:
当我想要SN30 Pro的熟悉手感，同时又想要现代手柄的全部功能时，8BitDo Pro 2就是我多平台的首选。
它在各方面都是对SN30 Pro的升级：更舒适的握把、霍尔效应摇杆、模拟扳机、可编程背部拨片、实体X/D/S/A模式切换开关，以及[相对]容易更换的电池，还能临时用AA电池。我还买了收纳盒和手机支架，虽然手机用得不多（我不太信任它的夹持力），但对于更小巧的复古掌机来说，它能让更多需要精确模拟控制的游戏变得可玩。
这个手柄几乎没有什么缺点，但在我收藏中只能排第三。我的第二名马上就要说，但在那之前还得聊聊……

src_seg:
How hard is it to find a modernized N64 controller?
There are plenty of cheap N64 imitation controllers, but the three-pronged original was an objectively bad design. I could play N64 games with a modern controller using clever configuration to make the face buttons function as C-buttons, but it's not the same for so many reasons.
I got the RetroFighters Brawler 64 to solve this anachronistic conundrum, and it's gone above and beyond my expectations. It was made to mimic the official NSO N64 controller down to the Switch recognizing it as one, with a toggle to make it register as a Pro controller sans right-stick.
It has some problems, but between its layout and compatibility it solves way more problems the official version has. It's perfect for showing someone N64 emulation without the intimidation of the original or the anachronism from finagling a modern controller to work the same.
It's very good at what it's trying to do.
tgt_seg:
现代化N64手柄有多难找？
市面上有很多廉价N64仿制手柄，但原版三叉设计客观上很糟糕。虽然可以通过巧妙配置用现代手柄玩N64游戏，把正面按键当作C键，但体验还是差很多。
我买了RetroFighters Brawler 64来解决这个时代错位的问题，结果远超预期。它模仿了官方NSO N64手柄，连Switch都能识别为N64手柄，还能切换成Pro手柄模式（没有右摇杆）。
虽然有些问题，但它的布局和兼容性解决了官方手柄的更多问题。用它给别人展示N64模拟器时，不会有原版手柄的压迫感，也不会有用现代手柄强行适配的违和感。
它在自己的定位上做得非常好。

src_seg:
I got this steam controller from a pawn shop after negotiating the price down shortly after the fire sale came to an end on steam. It needed some TLC, and I did what I could to get it up and running again.
It remains one of the most customizable controllers in my collection, with a unique [if questionable] design and features ahead of it's time (gyro aim, back paddles, haptic feedback, etc). It has some problems though; It requires AAs, uses Micro-USB for wired connections, occasionally turns itself back on after being turned off, the back paddles are stiff enough to cause fatigue, the thumbstick cap is necessary since the rubber on it is deteriorating, and it's functionality tends to fluctuate with every update to steam input.
It's more of a unique historical artifact than a regularly used input, but it's a welcome addition and fun to tinker with on rainy days.
It also isn't my number 2 pick, that honour goes to the fact that...
tgt_seg:
我是在Steam大促结束后，在当铺砍价买到这只Steam手柄的。它需要一些修复，我也尽力让它恢复了正常。
它依然是我收藏里最可定制的手柄之一，设计独特（虽然有争议），功能也很超前（陀螺仪瞄准、背部拨片、触觉反馈等）。但也有不少问题：需要用AA电池，连线用的是Micro-USB，偶尔关机后会自己重启，背部拨片太硬容易疲劳，摇杆帽必须用因为橡胶已经老化，每次Steam输入更新后功能表现都不稳定。
它更像是一件独特的历史文物，而不是常用的输入设备，但在雨天摆弄一下也挺有趣。
不过它不是我的第二名，这个荣誉属于……

src_seg:
The 8BitDo Ultimate Bluetooth controller is an almost perfect controller.
Hall-effect sticks, included charging dock that doubles as a port for the included dongle, dedicated 2.4ghz/bluetooth toggle switch, NS Pro layout with a much improved D-pad, analog triggers, and programmable back paddles. When I sit down on a couch with this controller, I can swap between a Steam Deck and a Switch faster than the time it takes the TV to switch inputs.
It does have some drawbacks though: It only does X/Switch signals (no android or apple modes), the triggers are uncomfortable, and input lag seems to be affected by the time it took to connect to the dongle/switch.
I thought this was the best it could get, but like my time with Xbox controllers I was operating on assumptions that started to sound like old brand loyalty reflexes coming back. What I'd hoped to upgrade it to was such a disappointment it swiftly shook me from those assumptions.
tgt_seg:
8BitDo Ultimate蓝牙手柄几乎是完美的手柄。
霍尔效应摇杆，带充电底座（同时也是适配器插口），专用2.4G/蓝牙切换开关，NS Pro布局但方向键大幅改进，模拟扳机，可编程背部拨片。坐在沙发上用这个手柄，我能在Steam Deck和Switch之间切换，比电视切换输入源还快。
当然也有缺点：只支持X/Switch信号（不支持安卓或苹果模式），扳机手感不舒服，输入延迟似乎和连接适配器/切换所用时间有关。
我本以为这已经是最好的了，但就像我用Xbox手柄时一样，我的判断其实还是受了品牌忠诚的惯性影响。后来我想升级的那款手柄却让我大失所望，彻底打破了这些假设。

src_seg:
Even though I've mostly transitioned to PC gaming over the past decade, my preferred peripherals are still controllers.
I understand the advantages of KB+M play, but as someone who already uses those tools for work I find picking up a controller helps separate the two activities and gives my wrists a break. I've also been playing video games long enough to see the technology and layouts used drastically change, though some first party controllers seem to have stagnated a bit.
I recently found a controller I really liked because it has features that have really impressed me enough to want to talk about it at length, but to do that I feel the need for some context; not a whole history lesson, just a little stroll through my collection of controllers that materialized over a lifetime of engaging in this hobby.
By the end I hope you'll understand why this is a topic I care so much about I'd spend all day talking about these devices.
tgt_seg:
尽管我在过去十年里大多转向了电脑游戏，但我最喜欢的外围设备依然是控制器。
我理解 KB + M 游戏的优势，但作为已经使用这些工具的工作者，我发现拿起控制器有助于把这两项活动区分开来，并让我的手腕休息一下。 我玩电子游戏的时间足够长，可以看到使用的技术和布局发生了巨大变化，尽管一些第一方的控制器似乎有点停滞了。
不久之前，我找到了一个我真的喜欢的控制器，因为它具有一些功能让我印象深刻，以至于我想详细谈论它，但要做到这一点，我觉得我需要一些背景；不是整个历史课程，只是简单介绍我在一生中从事这项爱好所积累的控制器收藏。
最后，我希望您能理解为什么我如此关心这个话题，我愿意花一整天谈论这些设备。

src_seg:
My decision to build up a PC game collection started during the transition between the Xbox 360 and the Xbox One; I thoroughly enjoyed the 360, but the One was looking like a disaster. Since the new consoles from all three major companies held little interest and I'd been in school for Computer Information Systems, I got myself a 360 pc dongle and resolved to make the switch.
Each of these controllers saw extensive use, and the 360 had the asymmetrical stick placement I preferred. All but two of the controllers in this picture are currently unusable either from loose/drifting sticks, faulty buttons, or failing cables/connections; both of the working ones are 3rd party Afterglows (which have their own problems).
As much as I loved these controllers, the official ones were the worst in terms of durability, and some were faulty from day one but Microsoft would refuse my RMA request.
It got worse when I tried the most expensive one.
tgt_seg:
我在切换从 Xbox 360 到 Xbox One 的过程中，开始建立个人电脑游戏收藏；我非常喜欢 360，但 One 似乎是一场灾难。 由于三个主要公司的新游戏机都没有让我感兴趣，而且我已经上了计算机信息系统的学校，所以我买了一个 360 电脑连接器，决心要换机。
这些控制器中的每一款都得到了广泛使用，360 的操纵杆位置不对称，我更喜欢这种方式。 除了两张图片中的控制器外，其他所有的控制器都无法使用，因为操纵杆松动/漂移、按钮故障或电缆/连接失效；两个可以使用的控制器都是第三方 Afterglow（它们本身也有问题）。
尽管我很喜欢这些控制器，但官方的控制器在耐用性方面是最差的，有的从一开始就有问题，但微软却拒绝我的 RMA 要求。
当我尝试了最昂贵的产品时，情况变得更糟。

src_seg:
There was a time when I fell for the myth that "You get what you pay for" was as true for expensive stuff as it was for cheap stuff; it's because of this controller that I know better. I got this Elite Series 2 controller despite knowing the first iteration had some serious flaws.
That controller lasted just under a year before the stick drift started to set in, and the right bumper only registered half of the time. The cable it came with sucks ass, never worked with any other controllers. The lag from using bluetooth was so bad the dongle was practically necessary. On top of all that, the back paddles didn't work no matter what software/drivers I used, none of my games ever read those paddles as an inputs.
The Raikiri Pro (was bundled with a laptop) is my current dedicated desktop controller and it works fine [for now], but I will never spend another dime on Official Xbox branded controllers. Fuck Microsoft, I hope Xbox rots!
tgt_seg:
有一段时间，我以为“付出就是得到”这个神话既适用于贵重商品，也适用于廉价的商品；正是由于这个控制器，我才有了更好的认识。 尽管我知道第一代控制器存在一些严重缺陷，但我还是买了 Elite Series 2 控制器。
在那台控制器的操作持续不到一年后，操纵杆开始失敏，而且右侧的缓冲器仅能记录一半的时间。 随附的连接线非常糟糕，无法与任何其他控制器兼容。 使用蓝牙带来的延迟太严重了，几乎需要使用一个适配器。 除此之外，无论我使用了什么软件/驱动程序都无法使用背部的桨叶操作，我的任何游戏都没有将这些桨叶作为输入读入。
Raikiri Pro（与笔记本电脑捆绑出售）是我现在的专用桌面控制器，它[目前]运行良好，但我永远不会再花一分钱购买官方 Xbox 品牌控制器。 妈的微软，我希望 Xbox 会腐烂！

src_seg:
The Nintendo Switch reignited my love for portable gaming after years of surviving out of crappy laptops. The joycons were small but versatile, and the pro controller felt really comfortable in the hands.
I loved these controllers so much I modified them and swapped in hall-effect sticks [and metal latches] this past year, and while I'm well aware of the drift issue, mine have worked flawlessly since 2017 with no signs of wearing out. I've put just as many hours into these controllers as I did all those Xbox controllers; either I got very lucky or microsoft designs their controllers to fail faster than both of their competitors combined. Nintendo's offerings have some drawbacks, but the fact it's additional features like Gyro input have been officially supported is noteworthy.
I hope to keep these controllers working for as long as they continue to be supported on other platforms; there are many like them, but these ones are mine.
tgt_seg:
任天堂的Switch重新点燃了我对便携式游戏的热情，此前我多年来一直依靠糟糕的笔记本电脑玩游戏。 Joy-Con 小但多功能，Pro 控制器在手中感觉很舒服。
我非常喜欢这些控制器，去年我修改了它们，并用霍尔效应棒（和金属锁）替换了它们，虽然我很清楚漂移问题，但自2017年以来，我的控制器一直完美无缺陷，没有任何磨损迹象。 我用这些控制器花费的小时数与所有Xbox控制器一样多；要么我很幸运，要么微软设计他们的控制器比他们的竞争对手更快失效。 任天堂的产品有一些缺点，但值得注意的是，它官方支持了像Gyro输入这样的附加功能。
我希望这些控制器能继续工作，只要其他平台继续支持它们；有很多像这样的控制器，但这些控制器是我的。

src_seg:
A brief note on Play Station controllers to round out the 1st party lineup: I never liked them.
Dual Shock 1-3 felt exactly the same to me with exactly the same flaws: Oversized thumbsticks placed too close together, mushy face/shoulder/trigger buttons that seemed to wear out very quickly, and a D-pad that just felt wrong. Dual Shock 4 fixed a lot of problems, but introduced a bunch of new ones. I got a Dual Sense because some friends had a hard time with asymmetrical thumbsticks, and for some reason local stores were selling them for $20 less than DS4 controllers.
I don't really use this controller: Face buttons are spaced too far apart, my audio in/output keeps defaulting to the controller when it's connected, the bumpers are weirdly tall, and I keep accidentally pressing the track pad when trying to hit menu/share.
They are fine guest controllers that have come a long way in terms of design, but for me they're a novelty at best.
tgt_seg:
一点关于 PlayStation 控制器的简短的说明，以补充第一方的阵容：我从来不喜欢它们。
Dual Shock 1-3 对我来说感觉和DS4一模一样，有着同样的缺点：尺寸大的拇指杆太靠近了，脸部/肩膀/扳手按钮很软弱，而且D-pad感觉很不对劲。 Dual Shock 4 解决了很多问题，但也带来了一些新问题。 我买了一个双感应器，因为一些朋友很难使用不对称的拇指杆，由于某种原因，当地商店的 Dual Sense 售价比 DS4 控制器低 20 美元。
其实我不太用这种控制器，因为面部按钮的间距太远了，我的音频输入/输出在连接时总是以控制器为缺位，缓冲器高得奇怪，当我尝试点击菜单/分享时，我总是不小心按下触控板。
它们是很好的客用控制器，在设计方面取得了长足进步，但对我来说，它们至多只是新奇的东西。

src_seg:
8BitDo was my first foray into good 3rd party controllers. This original SN30 Pro (later versions have hall-effect sticks and do not come in the SNES colour scheme) remains one of my favourites because holding it is reminiscent of my first console, the SNES.
If I'm having a crappy day and need a nostalgic escape, this is the first controller I reach for. It has all the functionality of a Switch Pro controller, but compacted into a modernized rendition of the SNES controller, complete with concave X/Y + convex A/B buttons, and possibly the best D-pad I've ever used. It's got some minor problems, but it's been a constant source of comfort.
One day the sticks will fail, or the battery will discharge for the last time; but if it means getting one of the modern versions (with hall-effect sticks) and shell-swapping them, I'll do it when the time comes.
With such a connection, surely 8BitDo can't do better than this, right? Well...
tgt_seg:
对于我来说，8BitDo 是我第一次接触好第三方控制器。这款原始的 SN30 Pro（后来的版本有霍尔效应杆，并且不采用 SNES 的配色方案）仍然是我的最爱之一，因为握着它让我想起了我的第一台游戏机：SNES。
当我度过一个糟糕的一天时，需要一种怀旧的逃避，这就是我首先选择的控制器的原因。 它具有 Switch Pro 控制器的所有功能，但将其压缩成一款现代化的 SNES 控制器，配有凹式 X/Y +凸式 A/B 按钮，可能也是我使用过的最好的 D-pad。 它有一些小问题，但一直是我的安慰来源。
总有一天，这把棍子会失效，或者电池将最后一次放电；但如果这意味着要购买现代版本（带有霍尔效应的棍子）并更换外壳，那么我会等到时机成熟的时候去做。
有了这样的连接，8BitDo 肯定不能做得更好，对吧? 嗯……

src_seg:
When I want the familiar comforts of the SN30 Pro but with all the features of a modern controller, the 8BitDo Pro 2 has been my multi-platform controller of choice.
Everything about this is a functional upgrade from the SN30 Pro: more comfortable grips, hall-effect sticks, analog triggers, programmable back paddles, a physical X/D/S/A mode toggle switch, and a [somewhat] easily replaceable battery with the option of using AAs in a pinch. I also sprung for the carrying case and the mobile phone holster, which doesn't see as much use with a phone (I don't trust its grip that much), but for more compact retro emulation handhelds, it can expand the list of playable games to include ones that need precise analog controls.
There's very few negatives I can say about this controller, but it sits at a close 3rd for favourite controller of my collection. I'll talk about my number 2 pick in a moment, but before that I need to talk about...
tgt_seg:
虽然我希望拥有熟悉的 SN30 Pro 的舒适感，但同时要具备现代控制器的所有功能，8BitDo Pro 2 是我的多平台控制器之选。
所有功能都比 SN30 Pro 更出色：更舒适的手柄、Hall 效应的手柄和模拟扳手；可以编程的后部滑板；一个可切换的物理 X/D/S/A 模式开关；以及一个（有点）容易更换的电池，并且可以选择在紧急情况下使用 AA 电池。 我还买了一个携带盒和手机套筒，虽然我不太用手机（我不信任它的握感），但对于更紧凑的复古仿真手持设备，它可以扩展可玩的游戏列表，包括需要精确的模拟控制的游戏。
我很少能对这款控制器表示负面意见，但它在我收藏中的最喜欢的控制器中排名第三。 我马上就要谈我的第二选了，但在此之前，我需要谈谈……

src_seg:
How hard is it to find a modernized N64 controller?
There are plenty of cheap N64 imitation controllers, but the three-pronged original was an objectively bad design. I could play N64 games with a modern controller using clever configuration to make the face buttons function as C-buttons, but it's not the same for so many reasons.
I got the RetroFighters Brawler 64 to solve this anachronistic conundrum, and it's gone above and beyond my expectations. It was made to mimic the official NSO N64 controller down to the Switch recognizing it as one, with a toggle to make it register as a Pro controller sans right-stick.
It has some problems, but between its layout and compatibility it solves way more problems the official version has. It's perfect for showing someone N64 emulation without the intimidation of the original or the anachronism from finagling a modern controller to work the same.
It's very good at what it's trying to do.
tgt_seg:
找到现代化的 N64 控制器有多难？
市面上有很多廉价仿制N64控制器，但原本的三针式设计客观上是糟糕的。 我可以用一个现代控制器玩N64游戏，通过巧妙配置让面按钮充当C键，但这在很多方面并不一样。
我买了一台 RetroFighters Brawler 64 来解决这个不合时宜的难题，它超出了我的预期。 它被制作为模仿官方 NSO N64 控制器，甚至让 Switch 将其识别为一个控制器，还有一个切换按钮，可以让它注册为不带右杆的 Pro 控制器。
它在某些方面存在一些问题，但从它的布局和兼容性来看，它可以解决比官方版本更多的问题。 它非常适合向其他人展示 N64 仿真，而不会像使用原始版本那样让人感到害怕，也不会像利用现代控制器来实现相同功能那样令人感到不合时宜。
它可以很好地完成它所要做的任务。

src_seg:
I got this steam controller from a pawn shop after negotiating the price down shortly after the fire sale came to an end on steam. It needed some TLC, and I did what I could to get it up and running again.
It remains one of the most customizable controllers in my collection, with a unique [if questionable] design and features ahead of it's time (gyro aim, back paddles, haptic feedback, etc). It has some problems though; It requires AAs, uses Micro-USB for wired connections, occasionally turns itself back on after being turned off, the back paddles are stiff enough to cause fatigue, the thumbstick cap is necessary since the rubber on it is deteriorating, and it's functionality tends to fluctuate with every update to steam input.
It's more of a unique historical artifact than a regularly used input, but it's a welcome addition and fun to tinker with on rainy days.
It also isn't my number 2 pick, that honour goes to the fact that...
tgt_seg:
在蒸汽销售结束后不久，我在一家放货店买了一台蒸汽控制器，价格经过谈判降低。 它需要一些保养，我尽我所能让它重新运行。
它仍然是我收藏中最易于自定义的控制器的之一，具有独特的设计和领先于时代的功能（陀旋瞄准、背部桨叶、触觉反馈等）。但它也有一些问题；它需要AA电池，使用Micro-USB进行有线连接，在关闭后偶尔会重新启动，背部桨叶很硬，容易让人感到疲劳，由于橡胶正在变坏，所以需要一个拇指手柄，而且它的功能在每次 Steam 输入更新时都会波动。
尽管它更像是一种独特的历史性文物，而不是经常使用的输入工具，但它是一个值得欢迎的附加功能，在雨天玩时很有趣。
这也不属于我的第二选择，这一殊荣归功于……

src_seg:
The 8BitDo Ultimate Bluetooth controller is an almost perfect controller.
Hall-effect sticks, included charging dock that doubles as a port for the included dongle, dedicated 2.4ghz/bluetooth toggle switch, NS Pro layout with a much improved D-pad, analog triggers, and programmable back paddles. When I sit down on a couch with this controller, I can swap between a Steam Deck and a Switch faster than the time it takes the TV to switch inputs.
It does have some drawbacks though: It only does X/Switch signals (no android or apple modes), the triggers are uncomfortable, and input lag seems to be affected by the time it took to connect to the dongle/switch.
I thought this was the best it could get, but like my time with Xbox controllers I was operating on assumptions that started to sound like old brand loyalty reflexes coming back. What I'd hoped to upgrade it to was such a disappointment it swiftly shook me from those assumptions.
tgt_seg:
8BitDo Ultimate Bluetooth 控制器几乎是完美的控制器。
有霍尔效应的手柄，带有一个充电坞，可以同时用作附带的连接器的端口，还有专门的 2.4ghz/蓝牙切换开关，NS Pro 布局具有大幅改进的 D-pad、模拟触发器和可编程背桨。 当我坐在沙发上使用这款控制器时，我可以比电视切换输入更快速地切换 Steam Deck 和 Switch。
但它也有一些缺点：它只处理 X/Switch 信号（没有 Android 或 Apple 模式），触发器不舒服，而且输入延迟似乎受连接通达/切换器所花费的时间影响。
当时我以为这样才是最好办法了，但就像我在使用Xbox控制器的时候一样，我一直在做一些假设，这些假设开始听起来像是老式的品牌忠诚反应。 我原本希望将其升级到更高水平，但结果却让我失望，这很快就让我从这些假设中摆脱了出来。

src_seg:
Even though I've mostly transitioned to PC gaming over the past decade, my preferred peripherals are still controllers.
I understand the advantages of KB+M play, but as someone who already uses those tools for work I find picking up a controller helps separate the two activities and gives my wrists a break. I've also been playing video games long enough to see the technology and layouts used drastically change, though some first party controllers seem to have stagnated a bit.
I recently found a controller I really liked because it has features that have really impressed me enough to want to talk about it at length, but to do that I feel the need for some context; not a whole history lesson, just a little stroll through my collection of controllers that materialized over a lifetime of engaging in this hobby.
By the end I hope you'll understand why this is a topic I care so much about I'd spend all day talking about these devices.
tgt_seg:
尽管在过去十年里我主要转向了PC游戏，但我偏爱的外设依然是手柄。
我明白键鼠操作的优势，但作为一个工作时已经在使用这些工具的人，我发现拿起手柄有助于将这两项活动区分开来，也能让我的手腕得到休息。我玩电子游戏的时间也足够长，足以见证其技术和布局发生的巨大变化，尽管一些第一方手柄似乎有些停滞不前。
最近，我发现了一款非常喜欢的手柄，它的一些功能令我印象深刻，让我想专门好好谈一谈。但在此之前，我觉得有必要介绍一些背景；这算不上是完整的历史课，只是带大家回顾一下我因这个爱好而常年收集的各式手柄。
到最后，我希望你能明白为什么我如此关心这个话题，以至于愿意花一整天的时间来讨论这些设备。

src_seg:
My decision to build up a PC game collection started during the transition between the Xbox 360 and the Xbox One; I thoroughly enjoyed the 360, but the One was looking like a disaster. Since the new consoles from all three major companies held little interest and I'd been in school for Computer Information Systems, I got myself a 360 pc dongle and resolved to make the switch.
Each of these controllers saw extensive use, and the 360 had the asymmetrical stick placement I preferred. All but two of the controllers in this picture are currently unusable either from loose/drifting sticks, faulty buttons, or failing cables/connections; both of the working ones are 3rd party Afterglows (which have their own problems).
As much as I loved these controllers, the official ones were the worst in terms of durability, and some were faulty from day one but Microsoft would refuse my RMA request.
It got worse when I tried the most expensive one.
tgt_seg:
我决定开始扩充自己的PC游戏收藏，这始于Xbox 360向Xbox One过渡的时期；我非常喜欢360，但One看起来就是一场灾难。由于三家主要公司的新主机都没能引起我的兴趣，而我当时又在学校学习计算机信息系统，于是我给自己买了一个360的PC接收器，决心转向PC平台。
这些手柄都曾被我重度使用，而且360手柄采用了我偏爱的非对称摇杆布局。这张图里除了两个手柄，其他的都因为摇杆松动/漂移、按键失灵或线缆/连接故障而无法使用；那两个能用的都是第三方的Afterglow手柄（它们本身也有问题）。
尽管我非常喜欢这些手柄，但官方原装货在耐用性方面是最差的，有些甚至从买来第一天就有毛病，可微软却拒绝我的返厂维修申请。
当我尝试了最贵的那一款后，情况变得更糟了。

src_seg:
There was a time when I fell for the myth that "You get what you pay for" was as true for expensive stuff as it was for cheap stuff; it's because of this controller that I know better. I got this Elite Series 2 controller despite knowing the first iteration had some serious flaws.
That controller lasted just under a year before the stick drift started to set in, and the right bumper only registered half of the time. The cable it came with sucks ass, never worked with any other controllers. The lag from using bluetooth was so bad the dongle was practically necessary. On top of all that, the back paddles didn't work no matter what software/drivers I used, none of my games ever read those paddles as an inputs.
The Raikiri Pro (was bundled with a laptop) is my current dedicated desktop controller and it works fine [for now], but I will never spend another dime on Official Xbox branded controllers. Fuck Microsoft, I hope Xbox rots!
tgt_seg:
我曾一度迷信“一分钱一分货”的说法，以为这句话对高价和廉价商品同样适用；正是因为这款手柄，我才明白事实并非如此。尽管知道第一代产品有一些严重的缺陷，我还是入手了这款精英手柄二代。
那个手柄用了不到一年就开始摇杆漂移，右肩键也时灵时不灵。它附带的数据线烂透了，完全无法用于任何其他手柄。蓝牙连接的延迟非常严重，导致无线接收器几乎成了必需品。最可气的是，无论我用什么软件或驱动，背后的拨片都毫无反应，我玩的所有游戏都无法将它们识别为有效输入。
雷切专业版（买笔记本电脑送的）是我目前台式机专用的手柄，现在用着还行【暂时】，但我绝不会再在任何Xbox官方品牌的手柄上多花一分钱。去他妈的微软，祝Xbox早日凉凉！

src_seg:
The Nintendo Switch reignited my love for portable gaming after years of surviving out of crappy laptops. The joycons were small but versatile, and the pro controller felt really comfortable in the hands.
I loved these controllers so much I modified them and swapped in hall-effect sticks [and metal latches] this past year, and while I'm well aware of the drift issue, mine have worked flawlessly since 2017 with no signs of wearing out. I've put just as many hours into these controllers as I did all those Xbox controllers; either I got very lucky or microsoft designs their controllers to fail faster than both of their competitors combined. Nintendo's offerings have some drawbacks, but the fact it's additional features like Gyro input have been officially supported is noteworthy.
I hope to keep these controllers working for as long as they continue to be supported on other platforms; there are many like them, but these ones are mine.
tgt_seg:
在靠着几台破烂笔记本电脑熬了几年后，任天堂Switch重新点燃了我对便携游戏的热爱。Joy-Con手柄小巧但功能多样，而Switch Pro手柄的握持感则非常舒适。
我太喜欢这些手柄了，于是在去年对它们进行了改装，换上了霍尔效应摇杆[和金属卡扣]。虽然我很清楚摇杆漂移的问题，但我的这两个从2017年开始就一直用得好好的，丝毫没有磨损的迹象。我在这些手柄上投入的游戏时长，和我用过的所有Xbox手柄加起来一样多；这要么说明我运气爆棚，要么就说明微软设计的手柄，其损坏速度比另外两家竞争对手的总和还快。任天堂的产品也有一些缺点，但像陀螺仪输入这类附加功能获得了官方支持，这一点值得称道。
我希望只要其他平台还支持，这些手柄就能一直用下去；有很多这样的手柄，但这些是属于我的。

src_seg:
A brief note on Play Station controllers to round out the 1st party lineup: I never liked them.
Dual Shock 1-3 felt exactly the same to me with exactly the same flaws: Oversized thumbsticks placed too close together, mushy face/shoulder/trigger buttons that seemed to wear out very quickly, and a D-pad that just felt wrong. Dual Shock 4 fixed a lot of problems, but introduced a bunch of new ones. I got a Dual Sense because some friends had a hard time with asymmetrical thumbsticks, and for some reason local stores were selling them for $20 less than DS4 controllers.
I don't really use this controller: Face buttons are spaced too far apart, my audio in/output keeps defaulting to the controller when it's connected, the bumpers are weirdly tall, and I keep accidentally pressing the track pad when trying to hit menu/share.
They are fine guest controllers that have come a long way in terms of design, but for me they're a novelty at best.
tgt_seg:
关于PlayStation手柄，这里简单提一下，算是对第一方手柄阵容的一个补充：我从来都不喜欢它们。
在我看来，DualShock 1到3代手感完全一样，缺点也如出一辙：摇杆帽太大且位置太近，面板按键、肩键和扳机键手感很肉，而且似乎特别容易磨损，十字键的感觉也总是不对劲。DualShock 4修正了许多问题，但也引出了一堆新毛病。我买了一个DualSense手柄，是因为有些朋友用不惯非对称摇杆，并且出于某种原因，本地商店里它的售价比DS4手柄还要便宜20美元。
我其实不怎么用这个手柄：面板按键间距太开，每次连接手柄时电脑的音频输入/输出都会自动切换过去，肩键的高度很奇怪，而且当我想按菜单/分享键时总会误触到触摸板。
它们作为给客人用的手柄还不错，在设计上也确实有了长足的进步，但对我而言，充其量算是个新奇玩意儿。

src_seg:
8BitDo was my first foray into good 3rd party controllers. This original SN30 Pro (later versions have hall-effect sticks and do not come in the SNES colour scheme) remains one of my favourites because holding it is reminiscent of my first console, the SNES.
If I'm having a crappy day and need a nostalgic escape, this is the first controller I reach for. It has all the functionality of a Switch Pro controller, but compacted into a modernized rendition of the SNES controller, complete with concave X/Y + convex A/B buttons, and possibly the best D-pad I've ever used. It's got some minor problems, but it's been a constant source of comfort.
One day the sticks will fail, or the battery will discharge for the last time; but if it means getting one of the modern versions (with hall-effect sticks) and shell-swapping them, I'll do it when the time comes.
With such a connection, surely 8BitDo can't do better than this, right? Well...
tgt_seg:
八位堂（8BitDo）是我首次尝试优秀第三方手柄的开端。这款初代的SN30 Pro（后续版本配备了霍尔摇杆，且不再提供超任配色）至今仍是我的最爱之一，因为握着它总能让我想起我的第一台游戏机——超任（SNES）。
每当我度过了糟糕的一天，需要一些怀旧的慰藉时，我第一个就会拿起这款手柄。它拥有Switch Pro手柄的全部功能，但又将一切都浓缩进了一个现代版的超任手柄设计中，配有内凹的X/Y键和外凸的A/B键，以及可能是我用过最棒的十字键。它有一些小毛病，但一直都是我慰藉的稳定来源。
总有一天，它的摇杆会失灵，或者电池会耗尽最后一丝电量；但如果这意味着需要我买一个现代版（带霍尔摇杆）的手柄来为它换壳，那么到时候我也会毫不犹豫地去做。
拥有这样一份情怀加持，八位堂（8BitDo）肯定也无法超越这款产品了吧，对吗？嗯……

src_seg:
When I want the familiar comforts of the SN30 Pro but with all the features of a modern controller, the 8BitDo Pro 2 has been my multi-platform controller of choice.
Everything about this is a functional upgrade from the SN30 Pro: more comfortable grips, hall-effect sticks, analog triggers, programmable back paddles, a physical X/D/S/A mode toggle switch, and a [somewhat] easily replaceable battery with the option of using AAs in a pinch. I also sprung for the carrying case and the mobile phone holster, which doesn't see as much use with a phone (I don't trust its grip that much), but for more compact retro emulation handhelds, it can expand the list of playable games to include ones that need precise analog controls.
There's very few negatives I can say about this controller, but it sits at a close 3rd for favourite controller of my collection. I'll talk about my number 2 pick in a moment, but before that I need to talk about...
tgt_seg:
当我想既要SN30 Pro那熟悉的舒适感，又想拥有现代手柄的全部功能时，八位堂Pro 2便成了我的首选多平台手柄。
这款手柄的方方面面都是对SN30 Pro的功能性升级：更舒适的握把、霍尔摇杆、线性扳机、可编程背键、一个实体的X/D/S/A模式切换开关，以及一块【还算】方便更换的电池，并可在紧急情况下选择使用AA电池。我还另外购买了收纳包和手机支架。这个支架不常用于夹手机（我不太信任它的夹持力），但对于那些更小巧的复古模拟掌机来说，它能扩展可玩游戏的范围，让你能玩上那些需要精确模拟控制的游戏。
对于这款手柄，我几乎挑不出什么毛病，但在我最喜爱的收藏中，它只能勉强排到第三名。我稍后会聊聊我心目中的第二名，但在此之前，我需要先谈谈……

src_seg:
How hard is it to find a modernized N64 controller?
There are plenty of cheap N64 imitation controllers, but the three-pronged original was an objectively bad design. I could play N64 games with a modern controller using clever configuration to make the face buttons function as C-buttons, but it's not the same for so many reasons.
I got the RetroFighters Brawler 64 to solve this anachronistic conundrum, and it's gone above and beyond my expectations. It was made to mimic the official NSO N64 controller down to the Switch recognizing it as one, with a toggle to make it register as a Pro controller sans right-stick.
It has some problems, but between its layout and compatibility it solves way more problems the official version has. It's perfect for showing someone N64 emulation without the intimidation of the original or the anachronism from finagling a modern controller to work the same.
It's very good at what it's trying to do.
tgt_seg:
找一个现代化的N64手柄有多难？
市面上有很多廉价的N64仿制手柄，但原版的三叉戟设计客观来说确实很糟糕。我本可以通过巧妙的配置，用现代手柄的面板按键来玩N64游戏，让它们充当C键，但无论从哪个方面来说，感觉都完全不对。
我入手了RetroFighters的Brawler 64手柄来解决这个不合时宜的难题，而它的表现超出了我的预期。这款手柄旨在模仿官方的NSO N64手柄，甚至能让Switch主机直接将其识别为官方手柄，同时它还有一个切换开关，可以让它被注册为一个没有右摇杆的Pro手柄。
它有一些问题，但其布局和兼容性解决了比官方版本多得多的问题。它非常适合用来向别人展示N64模拟游戏，既没有原版手柄的上手门槛，也避免了费力调校现代手柄所带来的时代错位感。
在它所专注的领域，它做得非常出色。

src_seg:
I got this steam controller from a pawn shop after negotiating the price down shortly after the fire sale came to an end on steam. It needed some TLC, and I did what I could to get it up and running again.
It remains one of the most customizable controllers in my collection, with a unique [if questionable] design and features ahead of it's time (gyro aim, back paddles, haptic feedback, etc). It has some problems though; It requires AAs, uses Micro-USB for wired connections, occasionally turns itself back on after being turned off, the back paddles are stiff enough to cause fatigue, the thumbstick cap is necessary since the rubber on it is deteriorating, and it's functionality tends to fluctuate with every update to steam input.
It's more of a unique historical artifact than a regularly used input, but it's a welcome addition and fun to tinker with on rainy days.
It also isn't my number 2 pick, that honour goes to the fact that...
tgt_seg:
这个Steam手柄是Steam官方清仓大甩卖结束后不久，我从一家当铺里砍价淘来的。它当时需要一番悉心照料，我尽了最大努力才让它重新恢复正常使用。
它至今仍是我收藏中自定义程度最高的手柄之一，拥有独特【尽管可能存在争议】的设计和超越时代的功能（陀螺仪瞄准、背键、触觉反馈等）。不过它也有些毛病：需要使用AA电池，有线连接是Micro-USB接口，关机后偶尔会自动开机，背键太硬容易导致疲劳，摇杆橡胶正在老化所以必须加装摇杆帽，并且其功能稳定性会随着每次Steam输入的更新而起伏不定。
它与其说是一个日常使用的输入设备，不如说是一件独特的历史藏品。不过，它依然是我收藏中的一个亮点，很适合在下雨天拿出来摆弄一番。
它也不是我心目中的第二名，那个荣誉属于……

tgt_seg:
八位堂猎户座蓝牙版（8BitDo Ultimate Bluetooth）是一款近乎完美的手柄。
它拥有霍尔摇杆、一个可兼作接收器接口的充电底座、独立的2.4G/蓝牙切换开关、大幅改进了十字键的Switch Pro布局、线性扳机以及可编程背键。当我拿着这款手柄坐在沙发上时，我在Steam Deck和Switch之间切换的速度，比电视切换输入信号的速度还要快。

我曾以为这已是天花板级别的产品了，但就像我当年对Xbox手柄的态度一样，我是在基于一些假设行事，而这些假设听起来越来越像是一种旧有的品牌忠诚度本能的回归。我本想用来升级它的那款产品是如此令人失望，它迅速地把我从这些假设中震醒了。

tgt_seg:
我的决定建立 PC 游戏收藏始于 Xbox 360 到 Xbox One 的过渡；我非常喜欢 360，但 One 看起来像是灾难。由于三大公司的新游戏机都没有太大的吸引力，我在学习计算机信息系统期间买了一台 360 PC 转接器，并决定切换。
这些控制器都得到了广泛的使用，360 有我喜欢的非对称式手柄布局。这张照片中的所有控制器，除了两个外，都无法使用，原因是手柄松动/漂移、按钮故障或电缆/连接故障；两个可用的都是第三方 Afterglow（它们也有自己的问题）。
尽管我喜欢这些控制器，但官方控制器在耐用性方面最差，有些从一开始就存在故障，但微软拒绝了我的 RMA 请求。
当我试用最昂贵的控制器时，情况变得更糟。

src_seg:
There was a time when I fell for the myth that "You get what you pay for" was as true for expensive stuff as it was for cheap stuff; it's because of this controller that I know better. I got this Elite Series 2 controller despite knowing the first iteration had some serious flaws.
That controller lasted just under a year before the stick drift started to set in, and the right bumper only registered half of the time. The cable it came with sucks ass, never worked with any other controllers. The lag from using bluetooth was so bad the dongle was practically necessary. On top of all that, the back paddles didn't work no matter what software/drivers I used, none of my games ever read those paddles as an inputs.
The Raikiri Pro (was bundled with a laptop) is my current dedicated desktop controller and it works fine [for now], but I will never spend another dime on Official Xbox branded controllers. Fuck Microsoft, I hope Xbox rots!
tgt_seg:
我曾经相信“你付出什么就能得到什么”这个神话，无论是昂贵的还是便宜的东西都是如此；正是因为这个控制器，我才知道这个神话不成立。我知道第一代控制器有严重的缺陷，但我还是买了这个Elite Series 2控制器。
这个控制器用了不到一年，就开始出现摇杆漂移，右按钮只有一半时间能正常工作。随附的电缆很垃圾，从来不能和其他控制器配合使用。使用蓝牙的延迟实在太糟糕，几乎需要使用适配器。此外，无论我使用什么软件/驱动程序，背面的踏板都无法工作，我所有的游戏都从来没有将这些踏板识别为输入。
Raikiri Pro（随笔记本电脑附送）是我目前的专用台式机控制器，目前还能正常工作，但我再也不想花一分钱买官方的Xbox品牌控制器了。我恨Microsoft，希望Xbox会倒闭！

src_seg:
The Nintendo Switch reignited my love for portable gaming after years of surviving out of crappy laptops. The joycons were small but versatile, and the pro controller felt really comfortable in the hands.
I loved these controllers so much I modified them and swapped in hall-effect sticks [and metal latches] this past year, and while I'm well aware of the drift issue, mine have worked flawlessly since 2017 with no signs of wearing out. I've put just as many hours into these controllers as I did all those Xbox controllers; either I got very lucky or microsoft designs their controllers to fail faster than both of their competitors combined. Nintendo's offerings have some drawbacks, but the fact it's additional features like Gyro input have been officially supported is noteworthy.
I hope to keep these controllers working for as long as they continue to be supported on other platforms; there are many like them, but these ones are mine.
tgt_seg:
任天堂 Switch 重新点燃了我对便携式游戏的热爱，多年来我一直在使用那些差劲的笔记本电脑。Joy-Con 很小但功能多样，Pro 控制器在手中感觉非常舒适。
我非常喜欢这些控制器，去年我对它们进行了改装，换上了霍尔效应杆和金属卡扣，尽管我清楚地知道漂移问题，但自 2017 年以来，我的控制器一直工作正常，没有任何磨损迹象。我投入的这些控制器的时间与 Xbox 控制器的时间一样多；要么我运气很好，要么微软设计的控制器故障速度比竞争对手的控制器快两倍。任天堂的产品有一些缺点，但像陀螺仪输入这样的额外功能得到了官方支持，这是值得注意的。
我希望这些控制器能够继续在其他平台上运行，直到它们停止支持；虽然有很多类似的控制器，但这些是我的。

src_seg:
A brief note on Play Station controllers to round out the 1st party lineup: I never liked them.
Dual Shock 1-3 felt exactly the same to me with exactly the same flaws: Oversized thumbsticks placed too close together, mushy face/shoulder/trigger buttons that seemed to wear out very quickly, and a D-pad that just felt wrong. Dual Shock 4 fixed a lot of problems, but introduced a bunch of new ones. I got a Dual Sense because some friends had a hard time with asymmetrical thumbsticks, and for some reason local stores were selling them for $20 less than DS4 controllers.
I don't really use this controller: Face buttons are spaced too far apart, my audio in/output keeps defaulting to the controller when it's connected, the bumpers are weirdly tall, and I keep accidentally pressing the track pad when trying to hit menu/share.
They are fine guest controllers that have come a long way in terms of design, but for me they're a novelty at best.
tgt_seg:
PlayStation 控制器简评：补充一下第一方阵营：我从来不喜欢它们。
Dual Shock 1-3 给我留下了完全相同的印象，也存在完全相同的缺陷：过大的触控板太靠近，面部/肩部/触发按钮感觉很软，而且磨损得很快，D 轮盘感觉不对。Dual Shock 4 解决了很多问题，但也引入了很多新的问题。我买了 Dual Sense，因为一些朋友对不对称触控板很难适应，而且当地商店以 $20 的价格出售 DS4 控制器。
我不经常使用这个控制器：面部按钮间距太大，我的音频输入/输出连接时总是默认使用控制器，按键太高，我总是无意中按下轨迹板试图按下菜单/分享。
它们是很好的客人控制器，在设计上已经有了很大的进步，但对我来说，它们充其量只是一个新奇之物。

src_seg:
8BitDo was my first foray into good 3rd party controllers. This original SN30 Pro (later versions have hall-effect sticks and do not come in the SNES colour scheme) remains one of my favourites because holding it is reminiscent of my first console, the SNES.
If I'm having a crappy day and need a nostalgic escape, this is the first controller I reach for. It has all the functionality of a Switch Pro controller, but compacted into a modernized rendition of the SNES controller, complete with concave X/Y + convex A/B buttons, and possibly the best D-pad I've ever used. It's got some minor problems, but it's been a constant source of comfort.
One day the sticks will fail, or the battery will discharge for the last time; but if it means getting one of the modern versions (with hall-effect sticks) and shell-swapping them, I'll do it when the time comes.
With such a connection, surely 8BitDo can't do better than this, right? Well...
tgt_seg:
8BitDo 是我第一次接触好第三方控制器的机会。这个原版 SN30 Pro（后续版本有霍尔效应杆，不采用 SNES 颜色方案）仍然是我最喜欢的，因为拿在手里让我想起了我的第一台游戏机 SNES。
如果我心情不好，需要怀旧逃避一下，这就是我首先拿出的控制器。它具有 Switch Pro 控制器的所有功能，但压缩成 SNES 控制器的现代化版本，配有凹陷的 X/Y + 凸出的 A/B 按钮，以及我可能用过的最好的 D 轮。它有一些小问题，但一直是我的安慰来源。
有一天，杆子会坏掉，电池会最后一次耗尽；但如果意味着要买现代版本（有霍尔效应杆），换壳，那么到了时候我会这么做。
有了这样的联系，8BitDo 肯定不能做得更好，对吧？嗯...

src_seg:
When I want the familiar comforts of the SN30 Pro but with all the features of a modern controller, the 8BitDo Pro 2 has been my multi-platform controller of choice.
Everything about this is a functional upgrade from the SN30 Pro: more comfortable grips, hall-effect sticks, analog triggers, programmable back paddles, a physical X/D/S/A mode toggle switch, and a [somewhat] easily replaceable battery with the option of using AAs in a pinch. I also sprung for the carrying case and the mobile phone holster, which doesn't see as much use with a phone (I don't trust its grip that much), but for more compact retro emulation handhelds, it can expand the list of playable games to include ones that need precise analog controls.
There's very few negatives I can say about this controller, but it sits at a close 3rd for favourite controller of my collection. I'll talk about my number 2 pick in a moment, but before that I need to talk about...
tgt_seg:
当我想要 SN30 Pro 的舒适感，但又希望拥有现代控制器的所有功能时，8BitDo Pro 2 成为了我多平台控制器的首选。
这款控制器在每个方面都对 SN30 Pro 进行了功能升级：更舒适的握把、霍尔效应摇杆、模拟扳机、可编程后按键、物理 X/D/S/A 模式切换开关，以及 [相对] 容易更换的电池，同时还可以使用 AA 电池作为备用。我还购买了携带箱和手机固定夹，虽然手机握持不太稳定，但对于更小型的复古模拟游戏机，它可以扩展可玩游戏的范围，包括需要精确模拟控制的游戏。
我几乎没有什么可以批评这款控制器的，但它在我收藏的控制器中排名第三。我会在下面谈谈我的第二选择，但在此之前，我需要谈谈...

src_seg:
How hard is it to find a modernized N64 controller?
There are plenty of cheap N64 imitation controllers, but the three-pronged original was an objectively bad design. I could play N64 games with a modern controller using clever configuration to make the face buttons function as C-buttons, but it's not the same for so many reasons.
I got the RetroFighters Brawler 64 to solve this anachronistic conundrum, and it's gone above and beyond my expectations. It was made to mimic the official NSO N64 controller down to the Switch recognizing it as one, with a toggle to make it register as a Pro controller sans right-stick.
It has some problems, but between its layout and compatibility it solves way more problems the official version has. It's perfect for showing someone N64 emulation without the intimidation of the original or the anachronism from finagling a modern controller to work the same.
It's very good at what it's trying to do.
tgt_seg:
现代化 N64 控制器有多难找？
市面上有很多廉价的 N64 仿制控制器，但三键的正版设计确实有问题。我用现代控制器通过巧妙配置让面按键作为 C 按键，可以玩 N64 游戏，但原因很多，效果不一样。
我买了 RetroFighters Brawler 64 来解决这个过时问题，它超出了我的预期。它模仿了官方 NSO N64 控制器，连 Switch 都能识别为一个，还有一个开关可以让它注册为 Pro 控制器，不用右摇杆。
它有一些问题，但布局和兼容性解决了官方版本的问题。它非常适合向别人展示 N64 模拟，不用担心原版或现代控制器在模拟时会出现过时问题。
它做得很好，达到了它的目标。

src_seg:
I got this steam controller from a pawn shop after negotiating the price down shortly after the fire sale came to an end on steam. It needed some TLC, and I did what I could to get it up and running again.
It remains one of the most customizable controllers in my collection, with a unique [if questionable] design and features ahead of it's time (gyro aim, back paddles, haptic feedback, etc). It has some problems though; It requires AAs, uses Micro-USB for wired connections, occasionally turns itself back on after being turned off, the back paddles are stiff enough to cause fatigue, the thumbstick cap is necessary since the rubber on it is deteriorating, and it's functionality tends to fluctuate with every update to steam input.
It's more of a unique historical artifact than a regularly used input, but it's a welcome addition and fun to tinker with on rainy days.
It also isn't my number 2 pick, that honour goes to the fact that...
tgt_seg:
我在跳蚤市场用谈判的方式把这个蒸汽控制器买下来，当时蒸汽的打折促销活动刚刚结束。它需要一些小修小补，我尽力让它重新运行起来。
它仍然是我收藏中最可定制的控制器之一，设计独特（如果说有点可疑），功能领先于时代（陀螺仪瞄准、背部按键、触觉反馈等）。它也有一些问题；需要使用 AA 电池，使用微 USB 进行有线连接，偶尔在关闭后自动开启，背部按键足够硬以造成疲劳，触摸板帽子是必要的，因为橡胶在磨损，功能在每次更新蒸汽输入时波动。
它更像是一个独特的历史文物，而不是经常使用的输入设备，但它是一个欢迎的补充，雨天时很有趣可以用来调试。
它也不是我的第二选择，那个荣誉属于...

src_seg:
The 8BitDo Ultimate Bluetooth controller is an almost perfect controller.
Hall-effect sticks, included charging dock that doubles as a port for the included dongle, dedicated 2.4ghz/bluetooth toggle switch, NS Pro layout with a much improved D-pad, analog triggers, and programmable back paddles. When I sit down on a couch with this controller, I can swap between a Steam Deck and a Switch faster than the time it takes the TV to switch inputs.
It does have some drawbacks though: It only does X/Switch signals (no android or apple modes), the triggers are uncomfortable, and input lag seems to be affected by the time it took to connect to the dongle/switch.
I thought this was the best it could get, but like my time with Xbox controllers I was operating on assumptions that started to sound like old brand loyalty reflexes coming back. What I'd hoped to upgrade it to was such a disappointment it swiftly shook me from those assumptions.
tgt_seg:
8BitDo 蓝牙终极控制器几乎是一个完美的控制器。
霍尔效应手柄、内置充电站，可以作为内置适配器的端口，2.4GHz/蓝牙切换开关，NS Pro 布局，改进了 D 轮，模拟触发器和可编程后按钮。当我坐在沙发上使用这个控制器时，我可以比电视切换输入更快地切换 Steam Deck 和 Switch。
它确实有一些缺点：只能发送 X/Switch 信号（没有 Android 或苹果模式），触发器不舒服，输入延迟似乎会受到连接适配器/Switch 所需时间的影响。
我认为这是最好的，但就像我使用 Xbox 控制器时一样，我开始怀疑这些假设，这些假设开始听起来像是旧品牌忠诚度反射。我希望升级它，但结果让我失望，这让我迅速摆脱了这些假设。

src_seg: so of course i pick it up and i eat it and it tastges like the taco bell beef seasoning mixed with nacho cheese with that little hint of somehow synthesized taco bell lettuce and it tastes spot-on, big prop to the dorito scientists who are in hell, but i continue to be plagued by the concept of doritos late night line. flavors that are representative of late night. i begin to think: what other late night flavors are possible? Several Beers flavor? Indica Nightmare?

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.
tgt_seg:
🧵 Netflix加入了Ebay、Amazon和Zelle的名单，因为“可疑活动”而停用/锁定了我的账户。在我们工作中所谓的“坏流程”图里，我正面临着最坏的情况。
Freenet Funk三次拒绝了我，但第四次成功了。终于收到了他们的SIM卡。Expatrio在第一次拒绝我的有效居住证明（我的安meldung证明，他们说有效...）后终于解除了对我账户的锁定。上周，我的账户被解冻了。那些消失的钱？它们又回来了。所以不是所有的事情都很糟糕，但我确实是在逆流而上，对抗一个决心要让我生活尽可能困难的系统。
在这里，我可以谈谈系统性压迫是如何通过数字系统体现出来的，以及这些问题为什么不会发生在通过工作调动过来的人身上。但我是以艰难的方式过来的，未注册，被标记了一个系统，这肯定会触发下一个系统和下一个系统。这一切都始于我停止了旅游活动:P。但最终，我的可疑行为就是突然移居海外。Ebay的客服人员明确告诉我这一点。（他们甚至告诉我，搬到另一个国家是非常罕见的，所以在Ebay的案例中，你总是会被标记）。

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.

src_seg:
🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.
tgt_seg:
🧵 Netflix、eBay、亚马逊和Zelle等公司都因为“可疑活动”而冻结或关闭了我的账户。而且，还有很多其他系统，让我陷入了我们所说的“麻烦境地”（就像工作场所中，针对“潜在的恶意行为者”所设定的最坏情况流程）。
Freenet Funk 拒绝了我三次，但第四次终于成功了。我终于收到了他们的SIM卡。Expatrio 最初拒绝了我的有效居住证明（实际上就是我的“注册证明”，他们也承认这是有效的……），但后来还是接受了，并且上周解除了我的账户限制。而且，那些“消失”的钱也回来了。所以，并非所有事情都那么糟糕，但说实话，我确实是在逆流而上，对抗着一个竭尽全力要让我生活变得尽可能困难的系统。
在这里，我可以谈谈这种“系统性压迫”实际上就是数字系统，以及这些问题不会发生在那些通过工作调动来这里的人身上。但我选择了一条更艰难的道路，没有进行注册，并且触发了一个系统，而这个系统又触发了下一个，再下一个。这一切都始于我不再进行“旅游活动”的时候：P。但归根结底，我的“可疑行为”就是突然搬到国外。eBay的工作人员在电话里明确告诉我了这一点。（他们甚至还说，一个人搬到国外是非常罕见的事情，所以，在eBay看来，你似乎总是会被标记为“可疑”）。
顺便说一句：一个胜利！我从房东那里买了洗衣币！我记住了几个词，然后通过WhatsApp给他发了消息，结果他立刻给我打了电话 xD。

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.
tgt_seg: 🧵 Netflix 和 eBay、Amazon 以及 Zelle 一起，以“可疑活动”为由停用/锁定了我的账户。此外，还有更多系统将我置于所谓的“工作中的糟糕流程”（流程图展示了疑似恶意行为者可能遇到的最坏情况）。Freenet Funk 拒绝了我三次，但第四次成功了。我终于收到了他们的 SIM 卡。Expatrio 在第一次拒绝我之后，终于接受了我完全有效的居住证明（我的正式注册证明，他们声称它是有效的……），并在上周解锁了我的账户。那些消失的钱呢？终于找到了。所以，并非所有事情都危险到极点，但我实际上是在逆流而上，对抗一个一心想让我的生活变得尽可能艰难的系统。在这里，我可以谈谈系统性压迫是真正的数字系统，以及这些问题如何不会发生在那些因为工作调动而来的人身上。但我一路走来很不容易，注销了账户，还举报了一个系统，我肯定这又触发了下一个又一个系统。一切都是从我停止旅游开始的 :P。但最终，我最可疑的行为是突然移居海外。eBay 的工作人员在电话里明确地告诉我了这一点。（他们甚至告诉我，一个人移居国外的可能性微乎其微。所以在 ebay 上，听起来你总是会被举报）。附言：从房东那里买到洗衣券，真是个胜利！我 WhatsApp 上和他联系的时候，他立刻就给我打电话了，我记住了一些单词和一些脏话 xD。

And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).

🧵 Okay... I dont want the honeymoon phase to end >_>. More great German things plz :P
Okay. There are some downsides. All food tastes so..... how do I put it... German XD. Comically so!
I've eaten Korean, Chinese, Taiwanese and Japanese cuisine now. And all of them have the distinct taste of.. sauerkraut?? But, it's in the rice itself. The part thats supposed to be the most neutral of flavor.
I made Gnocci Carbonarra (white sause) and, while it was funking delicious, tasted like Brätwurst. I thought I was safe making food at home, but I'm not xD. 
Now, I've eaten authentic italian in Syracuse NY (it's an italian historic city) and been to Taiwan. So I wonder if given time my taste buds will adapt and I will think everything tastes like how I remember it. Like as if there are subtle tones I'm just not used to yet 🤔 . And hense why I THINK everything has a foreign taste to it.
Aside: Also these arn't new foods to me so Im comparing them to what I know. Versus trying... say... Ethiopian cuisine (something new)

好吧，这里也有一些缺点。所有食物的味道都太……怎么说呢……德国味 XD。
我吃过韩国菜、中国菜、台湾菜和日本料理。但它们都有一种明显……酸菜味？？但连米饭里都有这种味道，而米饭本来应该是最中性的。
我做了Gnocci Carbonara（白酱），虽然很好吃，但味道像香肠。我以为在家做饭应该没问题，结果也不是 xD。
我之前在纽约锡拉丘兹（一个意大利历史城市）吃过正宗的意大利菜，也去过台湾。所以我想，也许随着时间推移，我的味蕾会适应，然后我会觉得食物的味道和我记忆中的一样。也许只是有些细微的味道我还没习惯 🤔。所以我现在觉得所有东西都有点“异国风味”。
另外：这些食物对我来说都不是新东西，所以我是在和我熟悉的味道做比较，而不是尝试像埃塞俄比亚菜这种完全陌生的东西。

src_seg:
🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.
tgt_seg:
🧵 Netflix也加入了eBay、Amazon和Zelle的行列，因为“可疑活动”而冻结/锁定我的账户。再加上一长串系统把我归入我们工作中所谓的“坏流程”（也就是最坏情况的流程图）。
Freenet Funk拒绝了我三次，第四次才通过。终于收到了他们的SIM卡。Expatrio终于接受了我完全合法的居住证明（第一次他们拒绝了，尽管他们自己说这个证明是有效的……），上周解封了我的账户。之前消失的钱也回来了。所以不是所有事情都那么糟糕，但我真的像是在逆流而上，对抗一个一心要让我生活更难的系统。
在这里我可以谈谈系统性压迫如何在现实中体现为数字系统，以及这些问题不会发生在那些通过公司外派来德国的人身上。而我走的是最难的路，没有注册，还被某个系统标记，触发了接下来一连串的麻烦。这一切大概从我停止旅游活动时开始的 :P。但归根结底，我的“可疑行为”就是突然搬到海外。eBay的客服人员甚至亲口告诉我就是这个原因。（他们还说，很少有人真的会跨国搬家。所以eBay的情况来看，你只要搬家就很可能被标记。）
附言：一个小小的胜利，从楼管那里买洗衣币！我记住了几个单词，结果我用WhatsApp发消息给他，他居然直接打电话过来，我吓坏了 xD。

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.
tgt_seg:
🧵 Netflix、Ebay、亚马逊和Zelle已经加入了列表，成为了因“可疑活动”而停用/锁定我账户的公司之一。再加上其他一些系统，这些都把我推入了我们在工作中称之为“不良状态”的情况中。（这是针对可能的恶意行为者可能面临的最糟糕情境的流程图）
弗瑞内特蜂克（Freenet Funk）拒绝了我的申请3次，但第四次成功了。终于收到他们的SIM卡。而Expatrio在第一次拒绝我的合法居住证明之后，终于接受了它（就是我提供的入住登记证明，他们声称它是有效的……）并在上星期解锁了我的账户。而那笔消失在黑洞中的钱呢？它最终还是出现了。所以，事情并非完全糟糕至极，但我确实是在与一个一心想让我的生活尽可能困难的系统抗争，逆流而行。
这里我就可以谈谈系统性压迫是如何具体体现在数字系统中的，以及这些问题不会发生在因工作调动而来到这里的人身上。我则是通过更艰难的方式来到这里的，没有登记，所以某个系统触发了警示信号，我相信这引起了下一个系统和随后更多的系统的警觉。这一切都是在我停止做旅游相关业务的时候开始的 :P。但最终，我的可疑行为导致我突然被转移到国外。这是我在电话中明确听eBay人员说的。（他们甚至告诉我，一个人会突然换国家是一件极不可能发生的事情，所以对于eBay来说，似乎你总是会受到警戒。）

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.
tgt_seg:
🧵 Netflix也和Ebay、亚马逊、Zelle一样，因为“可疑活动”停用或锁定了我的账户。而且还被更多系统推进了我们工作时所说的“糟糕流程”中。（也就是为潜在不良行为者设计的最坏情况流程图）。
Freenet Funk拒绝了我3次，但第4次通过了。我终于收到了他们的SIM卡。Expatrio在第一次拒绝了我完全有效的居住证明后（就是我的户籍登记证明，他们自己都说这个是有效的……），上周也终于接受了并解封了我的账户。那笔凭空消失的钱呢？也到账了。所以，并非所有事情都那么糟糕，但我确实是在逆流而上，对抗一个一心想让我的生活变得尽可能困难的系统。
在这里我本可以谈谈系统性压迫就是字面意义上的数字系统，以及这些问题不会发生在那些通过工作调动过来的人身上。但我是用最困难的方式过来的，没有预先登记，结果触发了一个系统警报，我敢肯定这个警报又触发了下一个，接连不断。这一切大概是从我不再做游客会做的事情时开始的 :p。但归根结底，我的可疑行为就是突然移居海外。Ebay的客服在电话里明确地告诉了我这一点。（他们甚至说，一个人移居到另一个国家是极不可能的，所以在Ebay看来，这种情况似乎总会被标记）。
旁白：一个小胜利，我从公寓管理员（Hausmeister）那里买到了洗衣币！我背了几个单词，用WhatsApp给他发了消息，结果他立马就给我打来了电话，吓得我屁滚尿流 xD。

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.
tgt_seg:
🧵 Netflix已经加入了eBay、Amazon和Zelle的行列，因“可疑活动”而停用/锁定了我的账户。此外，还有更多的系统将我归入了我们工作中所谓的“糟糕流程”（即可能的恶意行为者在最坏情况下的流程图）。
Freenet Funk拒绝了我三次，但第四次终于成功了。终于收到了他们的SIM卡。Expatrio在第一次拒绝后，最终接受了我完全有效的居住证明（我的正式注册证明，他们明明说是有效的...），并在上周解锁了我的账户。而那些消失的钱呢？最终也找回来了。所以并非所有事情都糟透了，但我确实是在逆流而上，对抗一个决心让我的生活尽可能艰难的系统。
在这里，我本可以谈论系统性压迫如何体现在数字系统中，以及这些问题不会发生在通过工作调动来到这里的人身上。但我是以更艰难的方式来到这里的，未登记在册，并且触发了一个系统，我相信这引发了接下来的一连串反应。这一切大约始于我停止做游客的事情的时候：P。但说到底，我的“可疑行为”就是突然搬到海外。eBay的客服人员在电话里明确告诉我，人们搬到其他国家的可能性极低，所以在他看来，这种情况总会被标记。

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.

And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).

But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
