🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.
tgt_seg:
🧵 Netflix加入了Ebay、亚马逊和Zelle的名单，它们都因为“可疑活动”而停用/锁定我的账户。而这些系统也让我陷入了我们在工作中称之为“糟糕流程”的境地。（这是针对潜在恶意行为者的最坏情况流程图）。
Freenet Funk三次拒绝了我，但第四次终于通过了。我终于收到了他们的SIM卡。Expatrio最终接受了我的完全有效的居住证明（他们之前拒绝过一次，我的实际登记证明，他们说这是有效的...），并在上周解锁了我的账户。而那些进入虚无的钱呢？它们最终出现了。所以并非所有事情都非常糟糕，但我实际上是在逆流而上，对抗一个决心让我的生活尽可能困难的系统。
在这里，我可以谈谈系统性压迫是字面意义上的数字系统，以及这些问题不会发生在通过工作调动来的人身上。但我以一种艰难的方式来到这里，没有注册，并触发了一个系统，我确信这触发了下一个又下一个。这一切都始于我停止做旅游活动的时候：P。但最终，我的可疑行为正在迅速转移到海外。Ebay的客服人员在电话中明确告诉我了这一点。（他们甚至告诉我，一个人搬到另一个国家非常罕见，所以在Ebay的案例中，似乎你总是会被标记）。

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.

Freenet Funk 拒绝了我 3 次，但第 4 次还是通过了。终于收到了他们的 sim 卡。Expatrio 在第一次拒绝之后终于接受了我的完全有效的居住证明（我字面上的安曼登证明，他们说是有效的......），并在上周解锁了我的账户。那被作废的钱呢？它确实出现了。因此，并非所有事情都很糟糕，但我确实是在逆流而上，与一个一心想让我的生活尽可能困难的系统对抗。
在这里，我可以谈谈系统性压迫是字面意义上的数字系统，以及这些问题如何不会发生在一个通过工作调动过来的人身上。但我是硬着头皮过来的，没有注册，被一个系统标记了，我确信这引发了下一个又下一个系统。这一切都始于我不再做游客的时候：P。但归根结底，我的可疑行为是突然转移到海外。ebay 的工作人员在电话中明确告诉了我。(他们甚至告诉我，一个人移居国外的可能性极小，所以在 ebay 看来，你总是会被标记）。

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.

Freenet Funk 拒绝了我三次，但第四次通过了。终于收到了他们的 SIM 卡。Expatrio 终于在第一次拒绝后接受了我的有效居住证明（我的实际注册证明，他们声称是有效的），并在上周解锁了我的账户。而那些消失的钱呢？最终还是找回来了。所以并非所有事情都那么糟糕，但我确实在与一心想让我生活变得尽可能困难的系统作斗争。
在这里，我可以谈谈系统性压迫是字面意义上的数字系统，以及这些问题不会发生在通过工作调动来到的人身上。但我是非法入境，没有注册，并且触发了一个系统，我确信这引发了接下来的系统反应。这一切都是在我停止做游客时开始的：P。但最终，我的可疑行为是突然移居海外。我在电话里被 eBay 的人明确告知了这一点（他们甚至告诉我，对某人来说移居国外是极不可能的，所以在 eBay 的例子中，你总会被标记）。

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.
tgt_seg:
🧵Netflix、eBay、亚马逊和Zelle等公司均以“可疑行为”为由，冻结或关闭了我的账户。再加上有更多系统将我纳入我们称之为“恶性情况”的行列（即最糟糕情况的流程图，指的是极有可能涉及不良行为）。
Freenet Funk 已经拒绝了我三次，但第四次通过了。终于收到了他们的 SIM 卡。Expatrio 第一次拒绝了我的完全有效的居住证明（我的登记证明，他们说这是有效的），但在上周解除了我的账户限制。而那被扣掉的钱呢？居然找回来了。所以并不是所有事情都那么糟糕，但我简直是在和一个系统周而复始地斗争，他们的目的是要尽可能把我的生活搞得一团糟。
我可以将这种系统性压迫与实际的数字系统相类比，解释这类问题不会发生在通过职位调动来这儿的员工身上。但我是在非法入境后通过非正规途径来到这里的，我的行为触发了一个系统，我坚信这导致了随后一系列的连锁反应。这一切都始于我停止做导游工作之时（哈哈）。最终，我这种“可疑行为”让我不得不迁往海外。我接到卖家电话时，他们明确告诉我，要想转移至另一国几乎是不可能的，所以对于eBay来说，这种情况无一例外都会被标记。
顺便说一句：赢了一场，从家管那里买了洗衣代金券！我用 WhatsApp 给他发了几句话，他立刻就打电话给我了！（笑）

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.

由于"可疑活动"，Netflix与Ebay，亚马逊和Zelle一起停用/锁定我的帐户。 在更多的系统中，我被称为工作中的"坏流"。 （对于一个可能的坏演员来说，最坏情况是什么样子的流程图）。
Freenet Funk否认了我3次，但第4次通过。 终于收到了他们的sim卡。 Expatrio在第一次拒绝后终于接受了我完全有效的居住证明（我对anmeldung的字面证明，他们说这是有效的。..）并在上周解锁了我的帐户。 那进入虚空的钱呢？ 它确实出现了。 所以并不是所有的事情都是危险的，但我实际上是在上游游泳，反对一个让我的生活尽可能困难的系统。
在这里，我可以谈论系统性压迫是字面上的数字系统，以及这些问题如何不会发生在转职的人身上。 但是我艰难地走过来，未注册，并标记了一个系统，我确信它触发了下一个和下一个系统。 这一切都始于我停止做旅游的事情：P.但最终我的可疑行为突然转移到海外。 Ebay的工作人员在电话里明确地告诉我。 （他们甚至告诉我，某人不太可能移动国家。 所以在ebay的情况下，听起来你总是会被标记）。

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.

🧵 Netflix 已与 Ebay、Amazon 和 Zelle 一起因“可疑活动”停用/锁定我的帐户。在众多系统中，我被置于工作中的所谓“不良流程”之中。（对于可能的不良行为者来说，最坏情况的流程图）。
Freenet Funk 拒绝了我 3 次，但第 4 次成功了。终于收到了他们的 SIM 卡。Expatrio 在第一次拒绝了我的居住证明之后，最终接受了我的完全有效的居住证明（他们声称我的居住证明是有效的......），并于上周解锁了我的帐户。那么那些消失在虚空的钱呢？它确实出现了。所以，并不是所有的事情都危险，但我确实在逆流而上，对抗着一个一心想让我的生活变得尽可能困难的系统。
在这里我可以谈谈系统性压迫实际上是数字系统，以及这些问题不会发生在工作调动过来的人身上。但我经历了艰难困苦，取消了注册，并标记了一个系统，我确信这会触发下一个系统，再下一个系统。这一切都始于我停止从事旅游活动的时候：P。但最终我的可疑行为却突然转移到海外。eBay 工作人员在电话中明确地告诉了我这一点。（他们甚至告诉我，一个人移居国外的可能性极小。所以在 eBay 的案例中，听起来你总是会被标记）。

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.
tgt_seg:
🧵 Netflix加入了Ebay、Amazon和Zelle的行列，因“可疑活动”而停用/锁定我的账户。在工作中，我也被更大的系统归类为“坏流”（The Bad Flow），这是最坏情况下的可能坏演员流程图。
Freenet Funk拒绝了我三次，但第四次通过了。我终于收到了他们的SIM卡。Expatrio在第一次拒绝我的完全有效的住址证明后，终于接受了它（我实际的Anmeldung证明，他们说这是有效的……）并在上周解锁了我的账户。那些消失的钱？它们出现了。所以不是所有事情都非常糟糕，但我正在逆流而上，对抗一个决心让我的生活尽可能困难的系统。
这里我可以谈谈系统性压迫实际上是数字系统，以及这些问题不会发生在因工作调动而来的人的身上。但我走的是艰难的道路，没有注册，被一个系统标记，我确信这触发了下一个系统，然后是下一个系统。这都始于我不再做游客的事情时 :P。但归根结底，我可疑的行为是突然搬到了海外。eBay的客服人员在电话中明确告诉了我这一点。（他们甚至告诉我，一个人搬迁到另一个国家是极不可能的。所以在eBay的情况下，你总是会被标记。）

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.

Freenet Funk拒绝了我3次，但第4次就通过了。终于收到了他们的SIM卡。Expatrio终于接受了我完全有效的居住证明，尽管他们第一次拒绝了（我的字面上的Anmeldung证明，他们说有效...），并在上周解锁了我的账户。而之前消失的钱？它出现了。所以并不是所有的事情都险象环生，但我在一个系统中努力游逆流，这个系统决心要让我的生活尽可能艰难。
而这就是我可以谈论的系统压迫是文字上的数字系统，以及这些问题不会发生在通过工作转调来的人身上。但我以未注册的方式来了，标记了第一个系统，这很可能触发了下一个和下一个。这一切大约是在我停止做游客的时候开始的：p。但最终，我的可疑行为是因为我突然搬到了海外。我被Ebay的电话人员明确告知了这一点。 (他们甚至告诉我，对于一个人来说，搬到另一个国家是非常不可能的。所以对于Ebay来说，听起来你总是会被标记)

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).

Freenet Funk拒绝了我三次，但第四次成功了。终于收到了他们的SIM卡。Expatrio最终接受了我的完全有效的居住证明，尽管他们第一次拒绝了（我的实际的注册证明，他们表示这是有效的…），上周解锁了我的账户。被吞入空洞的钱最终出现了。所以并非所有事情都是危险的，但我实际上是在逆流而上，对抗一个决心让我的生活尽可能困难的系统。
这里我可以谈谈系统性压迫是实际的数字系统，以及这些问题不会发生在通过工作调动来的人身上。但我以不注册的方式艰难地来到这里，触发了一个系统，我确信这引发了下一个系统，下一个系统…一切都始于我停止做旅游活动的时候。但最终，我的可疑行为突然地搬到了海外。eBay的员工在电话中明确告诉我这一点。（他们甚至告诉我，有人搬国家极其不常见，所以在eBay的情况下，你几乎总是会被标记）。

🧵 Okay... I dont want the honeymoon phase to end >_>. More great German things plz :P
Okay. There are some downsides. All food tastes so..... how do I put it... German XD. Comically so!
I've eaten Korean, Chinese, Taiwanese and Japanese cuisine now. And all of them have the distinct taste of.. sauerkraut?? But, it's in the rice itself. The part thats supposed to be the most neutral of flavor.
I made Gnocci Carbonarra (white sause) and, while it was funking delicious, tasted like Brätwurst. I thought I was safe making food at home, but I'm not xD. 
Now, I've eaten authentic italian in Syracuse NY (it's an italian historic city) and been to Taiwan. So I wonder if given time my taste buds will adapt and I will think everything tastes like how I remember it. Like as if there are subtle tones I'm just not used to yet 🤔 . And hense why I THINK everything has a foreign taste to it.
Aside: Also these arn't new foods to me so Im comparing them to what I know. Versus trying... say... Ethiopian cuisine (something new)

src_seg:
🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.
tgt_seg:
🧵 Netflix 也加入了 eBay、亚马逊和 Zelle 的名单，它们都因为“可疑活动”而停用/锁定我的账户。而且，在工作中，我遇到的各种系统都让我陷入了麻烦流程（一个可能恶意行为者最坏情况的流程图）。
Freenet Funk 拒绝了我三次，但第四次成功了。我终于收到了他们的 SIM 卡。Expatrio 最终在第一次拒绝后接受了我的完全有效的居住证明（我提供的实际的 anmelden 证明，他们也表示这是有效的……），并在上周解锁了我的账户。而那些消失的钱呢？也找回来了。所以并非所有事情都糟糕透顶，但我感觉自己正在逆流而上，对抗一个一心想让我生活变得艰难的系统。
在这里我可以谈谈系统性压迫是如何体现在实际的数字系统中，以及这些问题不太可能发生在通过工作调动来到的人身上。但我走的是一条艰难的道路，没有注册，并且触发了一个系统，我相信这又触发了下一个，再下一个。这一切都始于我停止做旅游相关的事情之后：P。但归根结底，我的“可疑行为”是突然移居海外。eBay 的客服人员明确地告诉我了这一点。（他们甚至告诉我，一个人搬家到其他国家的情况非常罕见，所以从 eBay 的角度来看，你似乎总是会被标记）。
顺便说一句：一个胜利，我从房东那里买了洗衣房代币！我在 WhatsApp 上给他发消息时，记住了几个词，结果他立刻打电话给我 xD。

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).

在这里，我可以谈谈系统性压迫就是字面意义上的数字系统，以及这些问题不会发生在通过工作调动过来的人身上。但我走的是艰难的道路，没有登记，触发了一个系统，我确信这触发了下一个系统，然后又触发了下一个系统。这一切都始于我停止做旅游活动的时候：P。但最终，我的可疑行为是突然搬到海外。ebay 的工作人员在电话里明确告诉我（他们甚至告诉我，搬家到另一个国家的可能性极低，所以就 ebay 的情况而言，你总是会被标记）。

不过确实也有一些缺点。所有食物吃起来的味道都很……怎么说呢……非常“德式”（German-style），甚至有点夸张到好笑的程度！  
我已经吃过韩国菜、中国菜、台湾菜和日本料理了，但它们似乎都带有一种……酸菜的味道？甚至米饭本身也带有这种味道，而米饭本应是最中性、无味的食物才对。  
我做过一道意式白酱土豆团子（Gnocchi Carbonara），虽然真的非常美味，但吃起来却像德国香肠（Brätwurst）。我以为在家做饭应该能避免这种问题，结果还是不行呢 xD。  
要知道，我曾在纽约州的锡拉丘兹（Syracuse，一座具有意大利移民历史的城市）吃过正宗的意大利菜，也去过台湾。所以我在想，或许只要给我足够的时间，我的味蕾就会逐渐适应，之后我就会觉得所有食物的味道都和我记忆中的一样了。也许现在只是还不习惯某些细微的风味罢了 🤔。  
另外，这些食物对我来说都不是全新的东西，所以我是在拿它们和我熟悉的味道做比较。这和尝试一种全新的食物（比如埃塞俄比亚菜）是不一样的。

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.
tgt_seg:
🧵 Netflix 也加入了 eBay、亚马逊和 Zelle 的行列，以“可疑活动”为由停用了我的账户。还有许多其他系统也将我归入了我们工作中所说的“异常处理流程”（即针对疑似不良行为者的最坏情况处理流程）。  
Freenet Funk 三次拒绝了我的申请，但第四次终于通过了；我终于收到了他们的 SIM 卡。Expatrio 最终也接受了我提供的、完全有效的居住证明（虽然他们第一次拒绝了我的申请，尽管他们自己也承认该证明是有效的），并于上周解封了我的账户。至于那笔“凭空消失”的钱……其实也最终到账了。所以并非所有事情都糟糕透顶，但我确实是在对抗一个处处刁难、执意让我的生活变得无比艰难的系统。  
其实我本可以谈谈这些数字化系统如何构成了一种系统性压迫，以及这些麻烦绝不会发生在那些通过工作调动来到这里的人身上……不过我选择了一条更艰难的路：我没有提前注册，结果触发了某个系统的警报，进而引发了一系列连锁反应。这一切大概是从我停止“游客该做的事”开始的吧……归根结底，我的“可疑行为”其实只是突然移居海外而已。eBay 的客服人员甚至亲口这么告诉我的；他们还说很少有人真的会跨国搬家，因此只要这么做就几乎肯定会触发他们的警报系统。  
小插曲：算是个小胜利吧——我从公寓管理员（Hausmeister）那里成功买到了洗衣代币！我提前背熟了几句德语，结果发 WhatsApp 给他后他立刻打电话过来……吓得我差点语无伦次 xD.

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.

Freenet Funk拒绝了我3次，但第4次申请通过了。我终于收到了他们的SIM卡。Expatrio在我完全有效的居住证明第一次被拒后，终于接受了它（就是我的入管登记证明，他们自己也说这是有效的……），并于上周解锁了我的账户。那笔凭空消失的钱呢？也确实到账了。所以并非所有事情都糟透了，但我确实是在逆流而上，对抗一个一心想让我日子难过的系统。
这时候我就可以谈谈，所谓的系统性压迫是如何体现在这些实实在在的数字系统上的，以及这些问题是不会发生在那些通过工作调动过来的人身上的。但我走的是一条更艰难的路，没有预先登记，结果被一个系统标记，然后我敢肯定，这又触发了下一个、再下一个系统的警报。这一切大概是从我不再做游客会做的事情时开始的:p。但归根结底，我的可疑行为就是突然搬到了海外。Ebay的客服在电话里明确地告诉了我这一点。（他们甚至告诉我，一个人搬到另一个国家是极不寻常的，所以在Ebay看来，你似乎总会被标记）。

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.

Netflix已经加入了 Ebay、Amazon 和 Zelle 的行列，出于“可疑活动”的原因，关闭了我的账户。并且在工作中，我被列入了更大的系统黑名单，简直就是“坏流” (The Bad Flow)。
Freenet Funk拒绝了我三次，但第四次通过了。终于收到了他们的sim卡。Expatrio在第一次拒绝我的居住证明（我的证明是有效的，Expatrio也承认了）之后，最后一次接受了我的居住证明，并在上周解锁了我的账户。那么，进入黑洞的钱呢？它也找到了。所以，并不是所有的事情都很糟糕，但我却在一个想方设法使我的生活变得困难的系统中，奋力逆流而上。
这里我可以谈论系统性压迫是数字系统的体现，以及这些问题不会发生在来中国工作转移的人身上。但是我是通过非法途径来中国的，触发了一个系统，接着又触发了另一个系统。所有这一切发生在我停止做旅游活动之后。然而，最终我的可疑行为是突然地跨国迁移的。 Ebay的工作人员在电话中明确告诉我：极不可能有人会跨国迁移。 (他们甚至告诉我， Ebay 的情况下，似乎你总是会被标记为可疑)。

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.
tgt_seg:
🧵 由于“可疑活动”，Netflix 与 eBay、亚马逊和 Zelle 一起将我的账户停用/锁定。而且，在我工作中被我们称为“坏流程”的系统中，我被列入了更大的名单。 (这是一种最坏情况的流程图，适合可能的坏人)。
Freenet Funk 三次拒绝我，但第四次通过了。我终于收到了他们的 SIM 卡。Expatrio 最终接受了我完全有效的居住证明，尽管他们第一次拒绝了（我的实际 anmeldung 证明，他们说它是有效的……），并在上周解锁了我的账户。那么，那些消失的钱呢？它们出现了。所以，事情并没有那么糟糕，但我真的在与一个一心想让我生活尽可能艰难的系统作斗争。
在这里，我可以谈论系统性压迫是字面意义上的数字系统，以及这些问题不会发生在通过工作调动来到这里的人身上。但我以艰难的方式来到这里，未注册，并标记了一个系统，我相信这触发了下一个和下一个。这一切都始于我停止做旅游活动的时候：P。但最终，我的可疑行为是突然搬到海外。eBay 的电话工作人员明确告诉我了这一点。 (他们甚至告诉我，一个人搬到另一个国家的情况非常罕见。所以，在 eBay 的情况下，听起来你总是会被标记)。
插曲：一个胜利，从 hausmeister 那里买了洗衣代币！我记住了几个词，当我给他发 WhatsApp 时，他立即给我打电话 xD。

And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.

Freenet Funk拒绝了我3次，第4次终于通过了。终于收到了他们的SIM卡。Expatrio最终也接受了我完全有效的居住证明（就是我的Anmeldung证明，他们明明说有效……）并在上周解锁了我的账户。至于那笔进了黑洞的钱？也找回来了。所以并不是所有事情都很糟，但我真的在和一个处处为难我的系统逆流而上。  
本来可以聊聊“系统性压迫”就是这些数字系统，以及如果我是工作调动过来的人就不会遇到这些问题。但我是以“非注册”身份来的，触发了一个系统，接着又触发下一个。大概就是我不再做游客的时候开始的:P。归根结底，我的“可疑行为”就是突然搬到海外。ebay客服在电话里明确告诉我了。（他们还说几乎没人会跨国搬家，所以在ebay看来你总会被标记）

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.

🧵 Netflix has joined the list alongside Ebay, Amazon, and Zelle in deactivating/locking my accounts due to 'suspicious activity'. And amongst the greater list of systems putting me in what we'd call "The Bad Flow" at work. (The flowchart of what the worst-case scenario looks like for a probable bad-actor).
Freenet Funk denied me 3 times, but the 4th went through. FINALLY received their sim card. Expatrio did finally accepted my totally valid proof of residence after declining it the first time (my literal proof of anmeldung, which they stated is valid...) and unlocked my account last week. And the money that went into the void? It did turn up. So not all things are perilously bad, but I am literally swimming upstream against a system hellbent on making my life as difficult as possible.
And here is where I could talk about systemic oppression being literal digital systems, and how these issues wouldn't happen to someone who came over on a job transfer. But I came over the hard way, unregistered, and flagged one system which I'm sure triggered the next and the next. It all started around when I stopped doing tourist stuff :P. But ultimately my suspicious behavior is abruptly moving overseas. I was explicitly told so by the ebay personnel on the phone. (They even told me it's extremely unlikely for someone to move countries. so in ebay's case it sounds like you'd always get flagged).
Aside: A victory, buying laundry tokens from the hausmeister! I memorized a few words and shit bricks when I WhatsApp'd him and he called me immediately on the phone xD.

🧵 Netflix加入了Ebay、Amazon和Zelle的行列，以“可疑活动”为由停用/锁定了我的账户。此外，还有更多系统将我列入了工作中的所谓“坏流程”名单。（这是一个针对潜在恶意行为者的最坏情况流程图）。
Freenet Funk拒绝了我3次，但第4次申请通过了。我终于收到了他们的SIM卡。Expatrio在我完全有效的居住证明第一次被拒后，终于接受了它（就是我的入管登记证明，他们自己也说这是有效的……），并于上周解锁了我的账户。那笔凭空消失的钱呢？也确实到账了。所以并非所有事情都糟透了，但我确实是在逆流而上，对抗一个一心想让我日子难过的系统。
这时候我就可以谈谈，所谓的系统性压迫是如何体现在这些实实在在的数字系统上的，以及这些问题是不会发生在那些通过工作调动过来的人身上的。但我走的是一条更艰难的路，没有预先登记，结果被一个系统标记，然后我敢肯定，这又触发了下一个、再下一个系统的警报。这一切大概是从我不再做游客会做的事情时开始的:p。但归根结底，我的可疑行为就是突然搬到了海外。Ebay的客服在电话里明确地告诉了我这一点。（他们甚至告诉我，一个人搬到另一个国家是极不寻常的，所以在Ebay看来，你似乎总会被标记）。

🧵 Okay... I dont want the honeymoon phase to end >_>. More great German things plz :P
Okay. There are some downsides. All food tastes so..... how do I put it... German XD. Comically so!
I've eaten Korean, Chinese, Taiwanese and Japanese cuisine now. And all of them have the distinct taste of.. sauerkraut?? But, it's in the rice itself. The part thats supposed to be the most neutral of flavor.
I made Gnocci Carbonarra (white sause) and, while it was funking delicious, tasted like Brätwurst. I thought I was safe making food at home, but I'm not xD. 
Now, I've eaten authentic italian in Syracuse NY (it's an italian historic city) and been to Taiwan. So I wonder if given time my taste buds will adapt and I will think everything tastes like how I remember it. Like as if there are subtle tones I'm just not used to yet 🤔 . And hense why I THINK everything has a foreign taste to it.
Aside: Also these arn't new foods to me so Im comparing them to what I know. Versus trying... say... Ethiopian cuisine (something new)
